verses.original: אֹהֵ֣ב מ֭וּסָר אֹ֣הֵֽב דָּ֑עַת וְ/שֹׂנֵ֖א תוֹכַ֣חַת בָּֽעַר
verses.translit: 'hb mvsr 'hb d't vshn' tvkhcht b'r
verses.translation: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.

verses.original: ט֗וֹב יָפִ֣יק רָ֭צוֹן מֵ/יְהוָ֑ה וְ/אִ֖ישׁ מְזִמּ֣וֹת יַרְשִֽׁיעַ
verses.translit: tvb ypyq rtsvn myhvh v'ysh mzmvt yrshy'
verses.translation: A good man obtaineth favour of the LORD : but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.

verses.original: לֹא יִכּ֣וֹן אָדָ֣ם בְּ/רֶ֑שַׁע וְ/שֹׁ֥רֶשׁ צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים בַּל יִמּֽוֹט
verses.translit: l' ykhvn 'dm brsh' vshrsh tsdyqym bl ymvt
verses.translation: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

verses.original: אֵֽשֶׁת חַ֭יִל עֲטֶ֣רֶת בַּעְלָ֑/הּ וּ/כְ/רָקָ֖ב בְּ/עַצְמוֹתָ֣י/ו מְבִישָֽׁה
verses.translit: 'sht chyl 'trt b'lh vkhrqb b'tsmvtyv mbyshh
verses.translation: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.

verses.original: מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת צַדִּיקִ֣ים מִשְׁפָּ֑ט תַּחְבֻּל֖וֹת רְשָׁעִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה
verses.translit: mchshbvt tsdyqym mshpt tchblvt rsh'ym mrmh
verses.translation: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֱרָב דָּ֑ם וּ/פִ֥י יְ֝שָׁרִ֗ים יַצִּילֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: dbry rsh'ym 'rb dm vpy yshrym ytsylm
verses.translation: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.

verses.original: הָפ֣וֹךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים וְ/אֵינָ֑/ם וּ/בֵ֖ית צַדִּיקִ֣ים יַעֲמֹֽד
verses.translit: hpvkh rsh'ym v'ynm vbyt tsdyqym y'md
verses.translation: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.

verses.original: לְֽ/פִי שִׂ֭כְל/וֹ יְהֻלַּל אִ֑ישׁ וְ/נַעֲוֵה לֵ֝֗ב יִהְיֶ֥ה לָ/בֽוּז
verses.translit: lpy shkhlv yhll 'ysh vn'vh lb yhyh lbvz
verses.translation: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.

verses.original: ט֣וֹב נִ֭קְלֶה וְ/עֶ֣בֶד ל֑/וֹ מִ֝/מְּתַכַּבֵּ֗ד וַ/חֲסַר לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: tvb nqlh v'bd lv mmtkhbd vchsr lchm
verses.translation: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.

verses.original: יוֹדֵ֣עַ צַ֭דִּיק נֶ֣פֶשׁ בְּהֶמְתּ֑/וֹ וְֽ/רַחֲמֵ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים אַכְזָרִֽי
verses.translit: yvd' tsdyq npsh bhmtv vrchmy rsh'ym 'khzry
verses.translation: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

verses.original: עֹבֵ֣ד אַ֭דְמָת/וֹ יִֽשְׂבַּֽע לָ֑חֶם וּ/מְרַדֵּ֖ף רֵיקִ֣ים חֲסַר לֵֽב
verses.translit: 'bd 'dmtv yshb' lchm vmrdf ryqym chsr lb
verses.translation: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.

verses.original: חָמַ֣ד רָ֭שָׁע מְצ֣וֹד רָעִ֑ים וְ/שֹׁ֖רֶשׁ צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִתֵּֽן
verses.translit: chmd rsh' mtsvd r'ym vshrsh tsdyqym ytn
verses.translation: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit .

verses.original: בְּ/פֶ֣שַׁע שְׂ֭פָתַיִם מוֹקֵ֣שׁ רָ֑ע וַ/יֵּצֵ֖א מִ/צָּרָ֣ה צַדִּֽיק
verses.translit: bpsh' shptym mvqsh r' vyts' mtsrh tsdyq
verses.translation: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.

verses.original: מִ/פְּרִ֣י פִי אִ֭ישׁ יִשְׂבַּע ט֑וֹב וּ/גְמ֥וּל יְדֵי אָ֝דָ֗ם ישוב יָשִׁ֥יב לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mpry py 'ysh yshb' tvb vgmvl ydy 'dm yshvb yshyb lv
verses.translation: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man’s hands shall be rendered unto him.

verses.original: דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֱ֭וִיל יָשָׁ֣ר בְּ/עֵינָ֑י/ו וְ/שֹׁמֵ֖עַ לְ/עֵצָ֣ה חָכָֽם
verses.translit: drkh 'vyl yshr b'ynyv vshm' l'tsh chkhm
verses.translation: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.

verses.original: אֱוִ֗יל בַּ֭/יּוֹם יִוָּדַ֣ע כַּעְס֑/וֹ וְ/כֹסֶ֖ה קָל֣וֹן עָרֽוּם
verses.translit: 'vyl byvm yvd' kh'sv vkhsh qlvn 'rvm
verses.translation: A fool’s wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.

verses.original: יָפִ֣יחַ אֱ֭מוּנָה יַגִּ֣יד צֶ֑דֶק וְ/עֵ֖ד שְׁקָרִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה
verses.translit: ypych 'mvnh ygyd tsdq v'd shqrym mrmh
verses.translation: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.

verses.original: יֵ֣שׁ בּ֭וֹטֶה כְּ/מַדְקְר֣וֹת חָ֑רֶב וּ/לְשׁ֖וֹן חֲכָמִ֣ים מַרְפֵּֽא
verses.translit: ysh bvth khmdqrvt chrb vlshvn chkhmym mrp'
verses.translation: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.

verses.original: שְֽׂפַת אֱ֭מֶת תִּכּ֣וֹן לָ/עַ֑ד וְ/עַד אַ֝רְגִּ֗יעָה לְשׁ֣וֹן שָֽׁקֶר
verses.translit: shpt 'mt tkhvn l'd v'd 'rgy'h lshvn shqr
verses.translation: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.

verses.original: מִ֭רְמָה בְּ/לֶב חֹ֣רְשֵׁי רָ֑ע וּֽ/לְ/יֹעֲצֵ֖י שָׁל֣וֹם שִׂמְחָֽה
verses.translit: mrmh blb chrshy r' vly'tsy shlvm shmchh
verses.translation: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.

verses.original: לֹא יְאֻנֶּ֣ה לַ/צַּדִּ֣יק כָּל אָ֑וֶן וּ֝/רְשָׁעִ֗ים מָ֣לְאוּ רָֽע
verses.translit: l' y'nh ltsdyq khl 'vn vrsh'ym ml'v r'
verses.translation: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה שִׂפְתֵי שָׁ֑קֶר וְ/עֹשֵׂ֖י אֱמוּנָ֣ה רְצוֹנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: tv'bt yhvh shpty shqr v'shy 'mvnh rtsvnv
verses.translation: Lying lips are abomination to the LORD : but they that deal truly are his delight.

verses.original: אָדָ֣ם עָ֭רוּם כֹּ֣סֶה דָּ֑עַת וְ/לֵ֥ב כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים יִקְרָ֥א אִוֶּֽלֶת
verses.translit: 'dm 'rvm khsh d't vlb khsylym yqr' 'vlt
verses.translation: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.

verses.original: יַד חָרוּצִ֥ים תִּמְשׁ֑וֹל ו֝/רְמִיָּ֗ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לָ/מַֽס
verses.translit: yd chrvtsym tmshvl vrmyh thyh lms
verses.translation: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.

verses.original: דְּאָגָ֣ה בְ/לֶב אִ֣ישׁ יַשְׁחֶ֑/נָּה וְ/דָבָ֖ר ט֣וֹב יְשַׂמְּחֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: d'gh blb 'ysh yshchnh vdbr tvb yshmchnh
verses.translation: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.

verses.original: יָתֵ֣ר מֵ/רֵעֵ֣/הוּ צַדִּ֑יק וְ/דֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תַּתְעֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: ytr mr'hv tsdyq vdrkh rsh'ym tt'm
verses.translation: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.

verses.original: לֹא יַחֲרֹ֣ךְ רְמִיָּ֣ה צֵיד֑/וֹ וְ/הוֹן אָדָ֖ם יָקָ֣ר חָרֽוּץ
verses.translit: l' ychrkh rmyh tsydv vhvn 'dm yqr chrvts
verses.translation: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.

verses.original: בְּ/אֹֽרַח צְדָקָ֥ה חַיִּ֑ים וְ/דֶ֖רֶךְ נְתִיבָ֣ה אַל מָֽוֶת
verses.translit: b'rch tsdqh chyym vdrkh ntybh 'l mvt
verses.translation: In the way of righteousness is life; and in the pathway thereof there is no death.

verses.original: בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם מ֣וּסַר אָ֑ב וְ֝/לֵ֗ץ לֹא שָׁמַ֥ע גְּעָרָֽה
verses.translit: bn chkhm mvsr 'b vlts l' shm' g'rh
verses.translation: A wise son heareth his father’s instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.

verses.original: מִ/פְּרִ֣י פִי אִ֭ישׁ יֹ֣אכַל ט֑וֹב וְ/נֶ֖פֶשׁ בֹּגְדִ֣ים חָמָֽס
verses.translit: mpry py 'ysh y'khl tvb vnpsh bgdym chms
verses.translation: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.

verses.original: נֹצֵ֣ר פִּ֭י/ו שֹׁמֵ֣ר נַפְשׁ֑/וֹ פֹּשֵׂ֥ק שְׂ֝פָתָ֗י/ו מְחִתָּה לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: ntsr pyv shmr npshv pshq shptyv mchth lv
verses.translation: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.

verses.original: מִתְאַוָּ֣ה וָ֭/אַיִן נַפְשׁ֣/וֹ עָצֵ֑ל וְ/נֶ֖פֶשׁ חָרֻצִ֣ים תְּדֻשָּֽׁן
verses.translit: mt'vh v'yn npshv 'tsl vnpsh chrtsym tdshn
verses.translation: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.

verses.original: דְּבַר שֶׁ֭קֶר יִשְׂנָ֣א צַדִּ֑יק וְ֝/רָשָׁ֗ע יַבְאִ֥ישׁ וְ/יַחְפִּֽיר
verses.translit: dbr shqr yshn' tsdyq vrsh' yb'ysh vychpyr
verses.translation: A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.

verses.original: צְ֭דָקָה תִּצֹּ֣ר תָּם דָּ֑רֶךְ וְ֝/רִשְׁעָ֗ה תְּסַלֵּ֥ף חַטָּֽאת
verses.translit: tsdqh ttsr tm drkh vrsh'h tslf cht't
verses.translation: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.

verses.original: יֵ֣שׁ מִ֭תְעַשֵּׁר וְ/אֵ֣ין כֹּ֑ל מִ֝תְרוֹשֵׁ֗שׁ וְ/ה֣וֹן רָֽב
verses.translit: ysh mt'shr v'yn khl mtrvshsh vhvn rb
verses.translation: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.

verses.original: כֹּ֣פֶר נֶֽפֶשׁ אִ֣ישׁ עָשְׁר֑/וֹ וְ֝/רָ֗שׁ לֹא שָׁמַ֥ע גְּעָרָֽה
verses.translit: khpr npsh 'ysh 'shrv vrsh l' shm' g'rh
verses.translation: The ransom of a man’s life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.

verses.original: אוֹר צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִשְׂמָ֑ח וְ/נֵ֖ר רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִדְעָֽךְ
verses.translit: 'vr tsdyqym yshmch vnr rsh'ym yd'kh
verses.translation: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.

verses.original: רַק בְּ֭/זָדוֹן יִתֵּ֣ן מַצָּ֑ה וְ/אֶת נ֖וֹעָצִ֣ים חָכְמָֽה
verses.translit: rq bzdvn ytn mtsh v't nv'tsym chkhmh
verses.translation: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.

verses.original: ה֭וֹן מֵ/הֶ֣בֶל יִמְעָ֑ט וְ/קֹבֵ֖ץ עַל יָ֣ד יַרְבֶּֽה
verses.translit: hvn mhbl ym't vqbts 'l yd yrbh
verses.translation: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.

verses.original: תּוֹחֶ֣לֶת מְ֭מֻשָּׁכָה מַחֲלָה לֵ֑ב וְ/עֵ֥ץ חַ֝יִּ֗ים תַּאֲוָ֥ה בָאָֽה
verses.translit: tvchlt mmshkhh mchlh lb v'ts chyym t'vh b'h
verses.translation: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.

verses.original: בָּ֣ז לְ֭/דָבָר יֵחָ֣בֶל ל֑/וֹ וִ/ירֵ֥א מִ֝צְוָ֗ה ה֣וּא יְשֻׁלָּֽם
verses.translit: bz ldbr ychbl lv vyr' mtsvh hv' yshlm
verses.translation: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.

verses.original: תּוֹרַ֣ת חָ֭כָם מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים לָ֝/ס֗וּר מִ/מֹּ֥קְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת
verses.translit: tvrt chkhm mqvr chyym lsvr mmqshy mvt
verses.translation: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

verses.original: שֵֽׂכֶל ט֭וֹב יִתֶּן חֵ֑ן וְ/דֶ֖רֶךְ בֹּגְדִ֣ים אֵיתָֽן
verses.translit: shkhl tvb ytn chn vdrkh bgdym 'ytn
verses.translation: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.

verses.original: כָּל עָ֭רוּם יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה בְ/דָ֑עַת וּ֝/כְסִ֗יל יִפְרֹ֥שׂ אִוֶּֽלֶת
verses.translit: khl 'rvm y'shh bd't vkhsyl yprsh 'vlt
verses.translation: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly.

verses.original: מַלְאָ֣ךְ רָ֭שָׁע יִפֹּ֣ל בְּ/רָ֑ע וְ/צִ֖יר אֱמוּנִ֣ים מַרְפֵּֽא
verses.translit: ml'kh rsh' ypl br' vtsyr 'mvnym mrp'
verses.translation: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.

verses.original: רֵ֣ישׁ וְ֭/קָלוֹן פּוֹרֵ֣עַ מוּסָ֑ר וְ/שׁוֹמֵ֖ר תּוֹכַ֣חַת יְכֻבָּֽד
verses.translit: rysh vqlvn pvr' mvsr vshvmr tvkhcht ykhbd
verses.translation: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.

verses.original: תַּאֲוָ֣ה נִ֭הְיָה תֶּעֱרַ֣ב לְ/נָ֑פֶשׁ וְ/תוֹעֲבַ֥ת כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים ס֣וּר מֵ/רָֽע
verses.translit: t'vh nhyh t'rb lnpsh vtv'bt khsylym svr mr'
verses.translation: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.

verses.original: הלוך הוֹלֵ֣ךְ אֶת חֲכָמִ֣ים ו/חכם יֶחְכָּ֑ם וְ/רֹעֶ֖ה כְסִילִ֣ים יֵרֽוֹעַ
verses.translit: hlvkh hvlkh 't chkhmym vchkhm ychkhm vr'h khsylym yrv'
verses.translation: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.

verses.original: חַ֭טָּאִים תְּרַדֵּ֣ף רָעָ֑ה וְ/אֶת צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים יְשַׁלֶּם טֽוֹב
verses.translit: cht'ym trdf r'h v't tsdyqym yshlm tvb
verses.translation: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.

verses.original: ט֗וֹב יַנְחִ֥יל בְּנֵֽי בָנִ֑ים וְ/צָפ֥וּן לַ֝/צַּדִּ֗יק חֵ֣יל חוֹטֵֽא
verses.translit: tvb ynchyl bny bnym vtspvn ltsdyq chyl chvt'
verses.translation: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children’s children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.

verses.original: רָב אֹ֭כֶל נִ֣יר רָאשִׁ֑ים וְ/יֵ֥שׁ נִ֝סְפֶּ֗ה בְּ/לֹ֣א מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: rb 'khl nyr r'shym vysh nsph bl' mshpt
verses.translation: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.

verses.original: חוֹשֵׂ֣ךְ שִׁ֭בְט/וֹ שׂוֹנֵ֣א בְנ֑/וֹ וְ֝/אֹהֲב֗/וֹ שִֽׁחֲר֥/וֹ מוּסָֽר
verses.translit: chvshkh shbtv shvn' bnv v'hbv shchrv mvsr
verses.translation: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.

verses.original: צַדִּ֗יק אֹ֭כֵל לְ/שֹׂ֣בַע נַפְשׁ֑/וֹ וּ/בֶ֖טֶן רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֶּחְסָֽר
verses.translit: tsdyq 'khl lshb' npshv vbtn rsh'ym tchsr
verses.translation: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.

verses.original: חַכְמ֣וֹת נָ֭שִׁים בָּנְתָ֣ה בֵיתָ֑/הּ וְ֝/אִוֶּ֗לֶת בְּ/יָדֶ֥י/הָ תֶהֶרְסֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: chkhmvt nshym bnth byth v'vlt bydyh thrsnv
verses.translation: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.

verses.original: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּ֭/יָשְׁר/וֹ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּ/נְל֖וֹז דְּרָכָ֣י/ו בּוֹזֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: hvlkh byshrv yr' yhvh vnlvz drkhyv bvzhv
verses.translation: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD : but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.

verses.original: בְּֽ/פִי אֱ֭וִיל חֹ֣טֶר גַּאֲוָ֑ה וְ/שִׂפְתֵ֥י חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים תִּשְׁמוּרֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: bpy 'vyl chtr g'vh vshpty chkhmym tshmvrm
verses.translation: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.

verses.original: בְּ/אֵ֣ין אֲ֭לָפִים אֵב֣וּס בָּ֑ר וְ/רָב תְּ֝בוּא֗וֹת בְּ/כֹ֣חַ שֽׁוֹר
verses.translit: b'yn 'lpym 'bvs br vrb tbv'vt bkhch shvr
verses.translation: Where no oxen are , the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

verses.original: עֵ֣ד אֱ֭מוּנִים לֹ֣א יְכַזֵּ֑ב וְ/יָפִ֥יחַ כְּ֝זָבִ֗ים עֵ֣ד שָֽׁקֶר
verses.translit: 'd 'mvnym l' ykhzb vypych khzbym 'd shqr
verses.translation: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.

verses.original: בִּקֶּשׁ לֵ֣ץ חָכְמָ֣ה וָ/אָ֑יִן וְ/דַ֖עַת לְ/נָב֣וֹן נָקָֽל
verses.translit: bqsh lts chkhmh v'yn vd't lnbvn nql
verses.translation: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.

verses.original: לֵ֣ךְ מִ֭/נֶּגֶד לְ/אִ֣ישׁ כְּסִ֑יל וּ/בַל יָ֝דַ֗עְתָּ שִׂפְתֵי דָֽעַת
verses.translit: lkh mngd l'ysh khsyl vbl yd't shpty d't
verses.translation: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.

verses.original: חָכְמַ֣ת עָ֭רוּם הָבִ֣ין דַּרְכּ֑/וֹ וְ/אִוֶּ֖לֶת כְּסִילִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה
verses.translit: chkhmt 'rvm hbyn drkhv v'vlt khsylym mrmh
verses.translation: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.

verses.original: אֱ֭וִלִים יָלִ֣יץ אָשָׁ֑ם וּ/בֵ֖ין יְשָׁרִ֣ים רָצֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'vlym ylyts 'shm vbyn yshrym rtsvn
verses.translation: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.

verses.original: לֵ֗ב י֭וֹדֵעַ מָרַּ֣ת נַפְשׁ֑/וֹ וּ֝/בְ/שִׂמְחָת֗/וֹ לֹא יִתְעָ֥רַב זָֽר
verses.translit: lb yvd' mrt npshv vbshmchtv l' yt'rb zr
verses.translation: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית רְ֭שָׁעִים יִשָּׁמֵ֑ד וְ/אֹ֖הֶל יְשָׁרִ֣ים יַפְרִֽיחַ
verses.translit: byt rsh'ym yshmd v'hl yshrym yprych
verses.translation: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.

verses.original: יֵ֤שׁ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יָ֭שָׁר לִ/פְנֵי אִ֑ישׁ וְ֝/אַחֲרִיתָ֗/הּ דַּרְכֵי מָֽוֶת
verses.translit: ysh drkh yshr lpny 'ysh v'chryth drkhy mvt
verses.translation: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.

verses.original: גַּם בִּ/שְׂח֥וֹק יִכְאַב לֵ֑ב וְ/אַחֲרִיתָ֖/הּ שִׂמְחָ֣ה תוּגָֽה
verses.translit: gm bshchvq ykh'b lb v'chryth shmchh tvgh
verses.translation: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.

verses.original: מִ/דְּרָכָ֣י/ו יִ֭שְׂבַּע ס֣וּג לֵ֑ב וּ֝/מֵ/עָלָ֗י/ו אִ֣ישׁ טֽוֹב
verses.translit: mdrkhyv yshb' svg lb vm'lyv 'ysh tvb
verses.translation: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.

verses.original: פֶּ֭תִי יַאֲמִ֣ין לְ/כָל דָּבָ֑ר וְ֝/עָר֗וּם יָבִ֥ין לַ/אֲשֻׁרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: pty y'myn lkhl dbr v'rvm ybyn l'shrv
verses.translation: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.

verses.original: חָכָ֣ם יָ֭רֵא וְ/סָ֣ר מֵ/רָ֑ע וּ֝/כְסִ֗יל מִתְעַבֵּ֥ר וּ/בוֹטֵֽחַ
verses.translit: chkhm yr' vsr mr' vkhsyl mt'br vbvtch
verses.translation: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.

verses.original: קְֽצַר אַ֭פַּיִם יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה אִוֶּ֑לֶת וְ/אִ֥ישׁ מְ֝זִמּ֗וֹת יִשָּׂנֵֽא
verses.translit: qtsr 'pym y'shh 'vlt v'ysh mzmvt yshn'
verses.translation: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.

verses.original: נָחֲל֣וּ פְתָאיִ֣ם אִוֶּ֑לֶת וַֽ֝/עֲרוּמִ֗ים יַכְתִּ֥רוּ דָֽעַת
verses.translit: nchlv pt'ym 'vlt v'rvmym ykhtrv d't
verses.translation: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

verses.original: שַׁח֣וּ רָ֭עִים לִ/פְנֵ֣י טוֹבִ֑ים וּ֝/רְשָׁעִ֗ים עַֽל שַׁעֲרֵ֥י צַדִּֽיק
verses.translit: shchv r'ym lpny tvbym vrsh'ym 'l sh'ry tsdyq
verses.translation: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

verses.original: גַּם לְ֭/רֵעֵ/הוּ יִשָּׂ֣נֵא רָ֑שׁ וְ/אֹהֲבֵ֖י עָשִׁ֣יר רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: gm lr'hv yshn' rsh v'hby 'shyr rbym
verses.translation: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.

verses.original: בָּז לְ/רֵעֵ֥/הוּ חוֹטֵ֑א וּ/מְחוֹנֵ֖ן עניים עֲנָוִ֣ים אַשְׁרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: bz lr'hv chvt' vmchvnn 'nyym 'nvym 'shryv
verses.translation: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.

verses.original: הֲֽ/לוֹא יִ֭תְעוּ חֹ֣רְשֵׁי רָ֑ע וְ/חֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝/אֱמֶ֗ת חֹ֣רְשֵׁי טֽוֹב
verses.translit: hlv' yt'v chrshy r' vchsd v'mt chrshy tvb
verses.translation: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.

verses.original: בְּ/כָל עֶ֭צֶב יִהְיֶ֣ה מוֹתָ֑ר וּ/דְבַר שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם אַךְ לְ/מַחְסֽוֹר
verses.translit: bkhl 'tsb yhyh mvtr vdbr shptym 'kh lmchsvr
verses.translation: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.

verses.original: עֲטֶ֣רֶת חֲכָמִ֣ים עָשְׁרָ֑/ם אִוֶּ֖לֶת כְּסִילִ֣ים אִוֶּֽלֶת
verses.translit: 'trt chkhmym 'shrm 'vlt khsylym 'vlt
verses.translation: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.

verses.original: מַצִּ֣יל נְ֭פָשׁוֹת עֵ֣ד אֱמֶ֑ת וְ/יָפִ֖חַ כְּזָבִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה
verses.translit: mtsyl npshvt 'd 'mt vypch khzbym mrmh
verses.translation: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.

verses.original: בְּ/יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מִבְטַח עֹ֑ז וּ֝/לְ/בָנָ֗י/ו יִהְיֶ֥ה מַחְסֶֽה
verses.translit: byr't yhvh mbtch 'z vlbnyv yhyh mchsh
verses.translation: In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.

verses.original: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים לָ֝/ס֗וּר מִ/מֹּ֥קְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת
verses.translit: yr't yhvh mqvr chyym lsvr mmqshy mvt
verses.translation: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

verses.original: בְּ/רָב עָ֥ם הַדְרַת מֶ֑לֶךְ וּ/בְ/אֶ֥פֶס לְ֝אֹ֗ם מְחִתַּ֥ת רָזֽוֹן
verses.translit: brb 'm hdrt mlkh vb'ps l'm mchtt rzvn
verses.translation: In the multitude of people is the king’s honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.

verses.original: אֶ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם רַב תְּבוּנָ֑ה וּ/קְצַר ר֝֗וּחַ מֵרִ֥ים אִוֶּֽלֶת
verses.translit: 'rkh 'pym rb tbvnh vqtsr rvch mrym 'vlt
verses.translation: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.

verses.original: חַיֵּ֣י בְ֭שָׂרִים לֵ֣ב מַרְפֵּ֑א וּ/רְקַ֖ב עֲצָמ֣וֹת קִנְאָֽה
verses.translit: chyy bshrym lb mrp' vrqb 'tsmvt qn'h
verses.translation: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.

verses.original: עֹ֣שֵֽׁק דָּ֭ל חֵרֵ֣ף עֹשֵׂ֑/הוּ וּ֝/מְכַבְּד֗/וֹ חֹנֵ֥ן אֶבְיֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'shq dl chrf 'shhv vmkhbdv chnn 'byvn
verses.translation: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.

verses.original: בְּֽ֭/רָעָת/וֹ יִדָּחֶ֣ה רָשָׁ֑ע וְ/חֹסֶ֖ה בְ/מוֹת֣/וֹ צַדִּֽיק
verses.translit: br'tv ydchh rsh' vchsh bmvtv tsdyq
verses.translation: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.

verses.original: בְּ/לֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן תָּנ֣וּחַ חָכְמָ֑ה וּ/בְ/קֶ֥רֶב כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים תִּוָּדֵֽעַ
verses.translit: blb nbvn tnvch chkhmh vbqrb khsylym tvd'
verses.translation: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.

verses.original: צְדָקָ֥ה תְרֽוֹמֵֽם גּ֑וֹי וְ/חֶ֖סֶד לְאֻמִּ֣ים חַטָּֽאת
verses.translit: tsdqh trvmm gvy vchsd l'mym cht't
verses.translation: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.

verses.original: רְֽצוֹן מֶ֭לֶךְ לְ/עֶ֣בֶד מַשְׂכִּ֑יל וְ֝/עֶבְרָת֗/וֹ תִּהְיֶ֥ה מֵבִֽישׁ
verses.translit: rtsvn mlkh l'bd mshkhyl v'brtv thyh mbysh
verses.translation: The king’s favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.

verses.original: מַֽעֲנֶה רַּ֭ךְ יָשִׁ֣יב חֵמָ֑ה וּ/דְבַר עֶ֝֗צֶב יַעֲלֶה אָֽף
verses.translit: m'nh rkh yshyb chmh vdbr 'tsb y'lh 'f
verses.translation: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

verses.original: לְשׁ֣וֹן חֲ֭כָמִים תֵּיטִ֣יב דָּ֑עַת וּ/פִ֥י כְ֝סִילִ֗ים יַבִּ֥יעַ אִוֶּֽלֶת
verses.translit: lshvn chkhmym tytyb d't vpy khsylym yby' 'vlt
verses.translation: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.

verses.original: בְּֽ/כָל מָ֭קוֹם עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה צֹ֝פ֗וֹת רָעִ֥ים ו/טוֹבִֽים
verses.translit: bkhl mqvm 'yny yhvh tspvt r'ym vtvbym
verses.translation: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.

verses.original: מַרְפֵּ֣א לָ֭שׁוֹן עֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים וְ/סֶ֥לֶף בָּ֝֗/הּ שֶׁ֣בֶר בְּ/רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: mrp' lshvn 'ts chyym vslf bh shbr brvch
verses.translation: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.

verses.original: אֱוִ֗יל יִ֭נְאַץ מוּסַ֣ר אָבִ֑י/ו וְ/שֹׁמֵ֖ר תּוֹכַ֣חַת יַעְרִֽם
verses.translit: 'vyl yn'ts mvsr 'byv vshmr tvkhcht y'rm
verses.translation: A fool despiseth his father’s instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית צַ֭דִּיק חֹ֣סֶן רָ֑ב וּ/בִ/תְבוּאַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע נֶעְכָּֽרֶת
verses.translit: byt tsdyq chsn rb vbtbv't rsh' n'khrt
verses.translation: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.

verses.original: שִׂפְתֵ֣י חֲ֭כָמִים יְזָ֣רוּ דָ֑עַת וְ/לֵ֖ב כְּסִילִ֣ים לֹא כֵֽן
verses.translit: shpty chkhmym yzrv d't vlb khsylym l' khn
verses.translation: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.

verses.original: זֶ֣בַח רְ֭שָׁעִים תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וּ/תְפִלַּ֖ת יְשָׁרִ֣ים רְצוֹנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: zbch rsh'ym tv'bt yhvh vtplt yshrym rtsvnv
verses.translation: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD : but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ רָשָׁ֑ע וּ/מְרַדֵּ֖ף צְדָקָ֣ה יֶאֱהָֽב
verses.translit: tv'bt yhvh drkh rsh' vmrdf tsdqh y'hb
verses.translation: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD : but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.

verses.original: מוּסָ֣ר רָ֭ע לְ/עֹזֵ֣ב אֹ֑רַח שׂוֹנֵ֖א תוֹכַ֣חַת יָמֽוּת
verses.translit: mvsr r' l'zb 'rch shvn' tvkhcht ymvt
verses.translation: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.

verses.original: שְׁא֣וֹל וַ֭/אֲבַדּוֹן נֶ֣גֶד יְהוָ֑ה אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי לִבּ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי אָדָֽם
verses.translit: sh'vl v'bdvn ngd yhvh 'f khy lbvt bny 'dm
verses.translation: Hell and destruction are before the LORD : how much more then the hearts of the children of men?

verses.original: לֹ֣א יֶאֱהַב לֵ֭ץ הוֹכֵ֣חַֽ ל֑/וֹ אֶל חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים לֹ֣א יֵלֵֽךְ
verses.translit: l' y'hb lts hvkhch lv 'l chkhmym l' ylkh
verses.translation: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.

verses.original: לֵ֣ב שָׂ֭מֵחַ יֵיטִ֣ב פָּנִ֑ים וּ/בְ/עַצְּבַת לֵ֝ב ר֣וּחַ נְכֵאָֽה
verses.translit: lb shmch yytb pnym vb'tsbt lb rvch nkh'h
verses.translation: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.

verses.original: לֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן יְבַקֶּשׁ דָּ֑עַת ו/פני וּ/פִ֥י כְ֝סִילִ֗ים יִרְעֶ֥ה אִוֶּֽלֶת
verses.translit: lb nbvn ybqsh d't vpny vpy khsylym yr'h 'vlt
verses.translation: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.

verses.original: כָּל יְמֵ֣י עָנִ֣י רָעִ֑ים וְ/טֽוֹב לֵ֝֗ב מִשְׁתֶּ֥ה תָמִֽיד
verses.translit: khl ymy 'ny r'ym vtvb lb mshth tmyd
verses.translation: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.

verses.original: טוֹב מְ֭עַט בְּ/יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה מֵ/אוֹצָ֥ר רָ֝֗ב וּ/מְה֥וּמָה בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: tvb m't byr't yhvh m'vtsr rb vmhvmh bv
verses.translation: Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.

verses.original: ט֤וֹב אֲרֻחַ֣ת יָ֭רָק וְ/אַהֲבָה שָׁ֑ם מִ/שּׁ֥וֹר אָ֝ב֗וּס וְ/שִׂנְאָה בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: tvb 'rcht yrq v'hbh shm mshvr 'bvs vshn'h bv
verses.translation: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ חֵ֭מָה יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וְ/אֶ֥רֶך אַ֝פַּ֗יִם יַשְׁקִ֥יט רִֽיב
verses.translit: 'ysh chmh ygrh mdvn v'rkh 'pym yshqyt ryb
verses.translation: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.

verses.original: דֶּ֣רֶךְ עָ֭צֵל כִּ/מְשֻׂ֣כַת חָ֑דֶק וְ/אֹ֖רַח יְשָׁרִ֣ים סְלֻלָֽה
verses.translit: drkh 'tsl khmshkht chdq v'rch yshrym sllh
verses.translation: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.

verses.original: בֵּ֣ן חָ֭כָם יְשַׂמַּח אָ֑ב וּ/כְסִ֥יל אָ֝דָ֗ם בּוֹזֶ֥ה אִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: bn chkhm yshmch 'b vkhsyl 'dm bvzh 'mv
verses.translation: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.

verses.original: אִ֭וֶּלֶת שִׂמְחָ֣ה לַ/חֲסַר לֵ֑ב וְ/אִ֥ישׁ תְּ֝בוּנָ֗ה יְיַשֶׁר לָֽכֶת
verses.translit: 'vlt shmchh lchsr lb v'ysh tbvnh yyshr lkht
verses.translation: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.

verses.original: הָפֵ֣ר מַ֭חֲשָׁבוֹת בְּ/אֵ֣ין ס֑וֹד וּ/בְ/רֹ֖ב יוֹעֲצִ֣ים תָּקֽוּם
verses.translit: hpr mchshbvt b'yn svd vbrb yv'tsym tqvm
verses.translation: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.

verses.original: שִׂמְחָ֣ה לָ֭/אִישׁ בְּ/מַעֲנֵה פִ֑י/ו וְ/דָבָ֖ר בְּ/עִתּ֣/וֹ מַה טּֽוֹב
verses.translit: shmchh l'ysh bm'nh pyv vdbr b'tv mh tvb
verses.translation: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it !

verses.original: אֹ֣רַח חַ֭יִּים לְ/מַ֣עְלָ/ה לְ/מַשְׂכִּ֑יל לְמַ֥עַן ס֝֗וּר מִ/שְּׁא֥וֹל מָֽטָּה
verses.translit: 'rch chyym lm'lh lmshkhyl lm'n svr msh'vl mth
verses.translation: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית גֵּ֭אִים יִסַּ֥ח יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝/יַצֵּ֗ב גְּב֣וּל אַלְמָנָֽה
verses.translit: byt g'ym ysch yhvh vytsb gbvl 'lmnh
verses.translation: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת רָ֑ע וּ֝/טְהֹרִ֗ים אִמְרֵי נֹֽעַם
verses.translit: tv'bt yhvh mchshbvt r' vthrym 'mry n'm
verses.translation: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the LORD : but the words of the pure are pleasant words.

verses.original: עֹכֵ֣ר בֵּ֭ית/וֹ בּוֹצֵ֣עַ בָּ֑צַע וְ/שׂוֹנֵ֖א מַתָּנֹ֣ת יִחְיֶֽה
verses.translit: 'khr bytv bvts' bts' vshvn' mtnt ychyh
verses.translation: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.

verses.original: לֵ֣ב צַ֭דִּיק יֶהְגֶּ֣ה לַ/עֲנ֑וֹת וּ/פִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יַבִּ֥יעַ רָעֽוֹת
verses.translit: lb tsdyq yhgh l'nvt vpy rsh'ym yby' r'vt
verses.translation: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.

verses.original: רָח֣וֹק יְ֭הוָה מֵ/רְשָׁעִ֑ים וּ/תְפִלַּ֖ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים יִשְׁמָֽע
verses.translit: rchvq yhvh mrsh'ym vtplt tsdyqym yshm'
verses.translation: The LORD is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.

verses.original: מְֽאוֹר עֵ֭ינַיִם יְשַׂמַּֽח לֵ֑ב שְׁמוּעָ֥ה ט֝וֹבָ֗ה תְּדַשֶּׁן עָֽצֶם
verses.translit: m'vr 'ynym yshmch lb shmv'h tvbh tdshn 'tsm
verses.translation: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.

verses.original: אֹ֗זֶן שֹׁ֭מַעַת תּוֹכַ֣חַת חַיִּ֑ים בְּ/קֶ֖רֶב חֲכָמִ֣ים תָּלִֽין
verses.translit: 'zn shm't tvkhcht chyym bqrb chkhmym tlyn
verses.translation: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.

verses.original: פּוֹרֵ֣עַ מ֭וּסָר מוֹאֵ֣ס נַפְשׁ֑/וֹ וְ/שׁוֹמֵ֥עַ תּ֝וֹכַ֗חַת ק֣וֹנֶה לֵּֽב
verses.translit: pvr' mvsr mv's npshv vshvm' tvkhcht qvnh lb
verses.translation: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.

verses.original: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מוּסַ֣ר חָכְמָ֑ה וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֖י כָב֣וֹד עֲנָוָֽה
verses.translit: yr't yhvh mvsr chkhmh vlpny khbvd 'nvh
verses.translation: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.

verses.original: לְ/אָדָ֥ם מַֽעַרְכֵי לֵ֑ב וּ֝/מֵ/יְהוָ֗ה מַעֲנֵ֥ה לָשֽׁוֹן
verses.translit: l'dm m'rkhy lb vmyhvh m'nh lshvn
verses.translation: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the LORD .

verses.original: כָּֽל דַּרְכֵי אִ֭ישׁ זַ֣ךְ בְּ/עֵינָ֑י/ו וְ/תֹכֵ֖ן רוּח֣וֹת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khl drkhy 'ysh zkh b'ynyv vtkhn rvchvt yhvh
verses.translation: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.

verses.original: גֹּ֣ל אֶל יְהוָ֣ה מַעֲשֶׂ֑י/ךָ וְ֝/יִכֹּ֗נוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: gl 'l yhvh m'shykh vykhnv mchshbtykh
verses.translation: Commit thy works unto the LORD , and thy thoughts shall be established.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ל פָּעַ֣ל יְ֭הוָה לַֽ/מַּעֲנֵ֑/הוּ וְ/גַם רָ֝שָׁ֗ע לְ/י֣וֹם רָעָֽה
verses.translit: khl p'l yhvh lm'nhv vgm rsh' lyvm r'h
verses.translation: The LORD hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה כָּל גְּבַהּ לֵ֑ב יָ֥ד לְ֝/יָ֗ד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה
verses.translit: tv'bt yhvh khl gbh lb yd lyd l' ynqh
verses.translation: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD : though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.

verses.original: בְּ/חֶ֣סֶד וֶ֭/אֱמֶת יְכֻפַּ֣ר עָוֺ֑ן וּ/בְ/יִרְאַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה ס֣וּר מֵ/רָֽע
verses.translit: bchsd v'mt ykhpr 'vn vbyr't yhvh svr mr'
verses.translation: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.

verses.original: בִּ/רְצ֣וֹת יְ֭הוָה דַּרְכֵי אִ֑ישׁ גַּם א֝וֹיְבָ֗י/ו יַשְׁלִ֥ם אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: brtsvt yhvh drkhy 'ysh gm 'vybyv yshlm 'tv
verses.translation: When a man’s ways please the LORD , he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.

verses.original: טוֹב מְ֭עַט בִּ/צְדָקָ֑ה מֵ/רֹ֥ב תְּ֝בוּא֗וֹת בְּ/לֹ֣א מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: tvb m't btsdqh mrb tbv'vt bl' mshpt
verses.translation: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.

verses.original: לֵ֣ב אָ֭דָם יְחַשֵּׁ֣ב דַּרְכּ֑/וֹ וַֽ֝/יהוָ֗ה יָכִ֥ין צַעֲדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lb 'dm ychshb drkhv vyhvh ykhyn ts'dv
verses.translation: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.

verses.original: קֶ֤סֶם עַֽל שִׂפְתֵי מֶ֑לֶךְ בְּ֝/מִשְׁפָּ֗ט לֹ֣א יִמְעַל פִּֽי/ו
verses.translit: qsm 'l shpty mlkh bmshpt l' ym'l pyv
verses.translation: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.

verses.original: פֶּ֤לֶס וּ/מֹאזְנֵ֣י מִ֭שְׁפָּט לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗/הוּ כָּל אַבְנֵי כִֽיס
verses.translit: pls vm'zny mshpt lyhvh m'shhv khl 'bny khys
verses.translation: A just weight and balance are the LORD’s : all the weights of the bag are his work.

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת מְ֭לָכִים עֲשׂ֣וֹת רֶ֑שַׁע כִּ֥י בִ֝/צְדָקָ֗ה יִכּ֥וֹן כִּסֵּֽא
verses.translit: tv'bt mlkhym 'shvt rsh' khy btsdqh ykhvn khs'
verses.translation: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.

verses.original: רְצ֣וֹן מְ֭לָכִים שִׂפְתֵי צֶ֑דֶק וְ/דֹבֵ֖ר יְשָׁרִ֣ים יֶאֱהָֽב
verses.translit: rtsvn mlkhym shpty tsdq vdbr yshrym y'hb
verses.translation: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.

verses.original: חֲמַת מֶ֥לֶךְ מַלְאֲכֵי מָ֑וֶת וְ/אִ֖ישׁ חָכָ֣ם יְכַפְּרֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: chmt mlkh ml'khy mvt v'ysh chkhm ykhprnh
verses.translation: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.

verses.original: בְּ/אוֹר פְּנֵי מֶ֥לֶךְ חַיִּ֑ים וּ֝/רְצוֹנ֗/וֹ כְּ/עָ֣ב מַלְקֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: b'vr pny mlkh chyym vrtsvnv kh'b mlqvsh
verses.translation: In the light of the king’s countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.

verses.original: קְֽנֹה חָכְמָ֗ה מַה טּ֥וֹב מֵ/חָר֑וּץ וּ/קְנ֥וֹת בִּ֝ינָ֗ה נִבְחָ֥ר מִ/כָּֽסֶף
verses.translit: qnh chkhmh mh tvb mchrvts vqnvt bynh nbchr mkhsf
verses.translation: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!

verses.original: מְסִלַּ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים ס֣וּר מֵ/רָ֑ע שֹׁמֵ֥ר נַ֝פְשׁ֗/וֹ נֹצֵ֥ר דַּרְכּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mslt yshrym svr mr' shmr npshv ntsr drkhv
verses.translation: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.

verses.original: לִ/פְנֵי שֶׁ֥בֶר גָּא֑וֹן וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֥י כִ֝שָּׁל֗וֹן גֹּ֣בַהּ רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: lpny shbr g'vn vlpny khshlvn gbh rvch
verses.translation: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.

verses.original: ט֣וֹב שְׁפַל ר֭וּחַ אֶת עניים עֲנָוִ֑ים מֵֽ/חַלֵּ֥ק שָׁ֝לָ֗ל אֶת גֵּאִֽים
verses.translit: tvb shpl rvch 't 'nyym 'nvym mchlq shll 't g'ym
verses.translation: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.

verses.original: מַשְׂכִּ֣יל עַל דָּ֭בָר יִמְצָא ט֑וֹב וּ/בוֹטֵ֖חַ בַּ/יהוָ֣ה אַשְׁרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: mshkhyl 'l dbr ymts' tvb vbvtch byhvh 'shryv
verses.translation: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD , happy is he.

verses.original: לַ/חֲכַם לֵ֭ב יִקָּרֵ֣א נָב֑וֹן וּ/מֶ֥תֶק שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח
verses.translit: lchkhm lb yqr' nbvn vmtq shptym ysyf lqch
verses.translation: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.

verses.original: מְק֣וֹר חַ֭יִּים שֵׂ֣כֶל בְּעָלָ֑י/ו וּ/מוּסַ֖ר אֱוִלִ֣ים אִוֶּֽלֶת
verses.translit: mqvr chyym shkhl b'lyv vmvsr 'vlym 'vlt
verses.translation: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.

verses.original: לֵ֣ב חָ֭כָם יַשְׂכִּ֣יל פִּ֑י/הוּ וְ/עַל שְׂ֝פָתָ֗י/ו יֹסִ֥יף לֶֽקַח
verses.translit: lb chkhm yshkhyl pyhv v'l shptyv ysyf lqch
verses.translation: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.

verses.original: צוּף דְּ֭בַשׁ אִמְרֵי נֹ֑עַם מָת֥וֹק לַ֝/נֶּפֶשׁ וּ/מַרְפֵּ֥א לָ/עָֽצֶם
verses.translit: tsvf dbsh 'mry n'm mtvq lnpsh vmrp' l'tsm
verses.translation: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

verses.original: יֵ֤שׁ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יָ֭שָׁר לִ/פְנֵי אִ֑ישׁ וְ֝/אַחֲרִיתָ֗/הּ דַּרְכֵי מָֽוֶת
verses.translit: ysh drkh yshr lpny 'ysh v'chryth drkhy mvt
verses.translation: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.

verses.original: נֶ֣פֶשׁ עָ֭מֵל עָ֣מְלָה לּ֑/וֹ כִּֽי אָכַ֖ף עָלָ֣י/ו פִּֽי/הוּ
verses.translit: npsh 'ml 'mlh lv khy 'khf 'lyv pyhv
verses.translation: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ בְּ֭לִיַּעַל כֹּרֶ֣ה רָעָ֑ה וְ/עַל שפתי/ו שְׂ֝פָת֗/וֹ כְּ/אֵ֣שׁ צָרָֽבֶת
verses.translit: 'ysh bly'l khrh r'h v'l shptyv shptv kh'sh tsrbt
verses.translation: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ תַּ֭הְפֻּכוֹת יְשַׁלַּ֣ח מָד֑וֹן וְ֝/נִרְגָּ֗ן מַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף
verses.translit: 'ysh thpkhvt yshlch mdvn vnrgn mpryd 'lvf
verses.translation: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ חָ֭מָס יְפַתֶּ֣ה רֵעֵ֑/הוּ וְ֝/הוֹלִיכ֗/וֹ בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ לֹא טֽוֹב
verses.translit: 'ysh chms ypth r'hv vhvlykhv bdrkh l' tvb
verses.translation: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.

verses.original: עֹצֶ֣ה עֵ֭ינָי/ו לַ/חְשֹׁ֣ב תַּהְפֻּכ֑וֹת קֹרֵ֥ץ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗י/ו כִּלָּ֥ה רָעָֽה
verses.translit: 'tsh 'ynyv lchshb thpkhvt qrts shptyv khlh r'h
verses.translation: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.

verses.original: עֲטֶ֣רֶת תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת שֵׂיבָ֑ה בְּ/דֶ֥רֶךְ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה תִּמָּצֵֽא
verses.translit: 'trt tp'rt shybh bdrkh tsdqh tmts'
verses.translation: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.

verses.original: ט֤וֹב אֶ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם מִ/גִּבּ֑וֹר וּ/מֹשֵׁ֥ל בְּ֝/רוּח֗/וֹ מִ/לֹּכֵ֥ד עִֽיר
verses.translit: tvb 'rkh 'pym mgbvr vmshl brvchv mlkhd 'yr
verses.translation: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.

verses.original: בַּ֭/חֵיק יוּטַ֣ל אֶת הַ/גּוֹרָ֑ל וּ֝/מֵ/יְהוָ֗ה כָּל מִשְׁפָּטֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: bchyq yvtl 't hgvrl vmyhvh khl mshptv
verses.translation: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD .

verses.original: ט֤וֹב פַּ֣ת חֲ֭רֵבָה וְ/שַׁלְוָה בָ֑/הּ מִ֝/בַּ֗יִת מָלֵ֥א זִבְחֵי רִֽיב
verses.translit: tvb pt chrbh vshlvh bh mbyt ml' zbchy ryb
verses.translation: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.

verses.original: עֶֽבֶד מַשְׂכִּ֗יל יִ֭מְשֹׁל בְּ/בֵ֣ן מֵבִ֑ישׁ וּ/בְ/ת֥וֹךְ אַ֝חִ֗ים יַחֲלֹ֥ק נַחֲלָֽה
verses.translit: 'bd mshkhyl ymshl bbn mbysh vbtvkh 'chym ychlq nchlh
verses.translation: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.

verses.original: מַצְרֵ֣ף לַ֭/כֶּסֶף וְ/כ֣וּר לַ/זָּהָ֑ב וּ/בֹחֵ֖ן לִבּ֣וֹת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: mtsrf lkhsf vkhvr lzhb vbchn lbvt yhvh
verses.translation: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the LORD trieth the hearts.

verses.original: מֵ֭רַע מַקְשִׁ֣יב עַל שְׂפַת אָ֑וֶן שֶׁ֥קֶר מֵ֝זִין עַל לְשׁ֥וֹן הַוֺּֽת
verses.translit: mr' mqshyb 'l shpt 'vn shqr mzyn 'l lshvn hvt
verses.translation: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.

verses.original: לֹעֵ֣ג לָ֭/רָשׁ חֵרֵ֣ף עֹשֵׂ֑/הוּ שָׂמֵ֥חַ לְ֝/אֵ֗יד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה
verses.translit: l'g lrsh chrf 'shhv shmch l'yd l' ynqh
verses.translation: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.

verses.original: עֲטֶ֣רֶת זְ֭קֵנִים בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֑ים וְ/תִפְאֶ֖רֶת בָּנִ֣ים אֲבוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'trt zqnym bny bnym vtp'rt bnym 'bvtm
verses.translation: Children’s children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.

verses.original: לֹא נָאוָ֣ה לְ/נָבָ֣ל שְׂפַת יֶ֑תֶר אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי לְ/נָדִ֥יב שְׂפַת שָֽׁקֶר
verses.translit: l' n'vh lnbl shpt ytr 'f khy lndyb shpt shqr
verses.translation: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.

verses.original: אֶֽבֶן חֵ֣ן הַ֭/שֹּׁחַד בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י בְעָלָ֑י/ו אֶֽל כָּל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִפְנֶ֣ה יַשְׂכִּֽיל
verses.translit: 'bn chn hshchd b'yny b'lyv 'l khl 'shr ypnh yshkhyl
verses.translation: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.

verses.original: מְֽכַסֶּה פֶּ֭שַׁע מְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אַהֲבָ֑ה וְ/שֹׁנֶ֥ה בְ֝/דָבָ֗ר מַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף
verses.translit: mkhsh psh' mbqsh 'hbh vshnh bdbr mpryd 'lvf
verses.translation: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.

verses.original: תֵּ֣חַת גְּעָרָ֣ה בְ/מֵבִ֑ין מֵ/הַכּ֖וֹת כְּסִ֣יל מֵאָֽה
verses.translit: tcht g'rh bmbyn mhkhvt khsyl m'h
verses.translation: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.

verses.original: אַךְ מְרִ֥י יְבַקֶּשׁ רָ֑ע וּ/מַלְאָ֥ךְ אַ֝כְזָרִ֗י יְשֻׁלַּח בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'kh mry ybqsh r' vml'kh 'khzry yshlch bv
verses.translation: An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

verses.original: פָּג֬וֹשׁ דֹּ֣ב שַׁכּ֣וּל בְּ/אִ֑ישׁ וְ/אַל כְּ֝סִ֗יל בְּ/אִוַּלְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: pgvsh db shkhvl b'ysh v'l khsyl b'vltv
verses.translation: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

verses.original: מֵשִׁ֣יב רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה לֹא תמיש תָמ֥וּשׁ רָ֝עָ֗ה מִ/בֵּיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mshyb r'h tcht tvbh l' tmysh tmvsh r'h mbytv
verses.translation: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

verses.original: פּ֣וֹטֵֽר מַ֭יִם רֵאשִׁ֣ית מָד֑וֹן וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֥י הִ֝תְגַּלַּ֗ע הָ/רִ֥יב נְטֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: pvtr mym r'shyt mdvn vlpny htgl' hryb ntvsh
verses.translation: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.

verses.original: מַצְדִּ֣יק רָ֭שָׁע וּ/מַרְשִׁ֣יעַ צַדִּ֑יק תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה גַּם שְׁנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: mtsdyq rsh' vmrshy' tsdyq tv'bt yhvh gm shnyhm
verses.translation: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the LORD .

verses.original: לָ/מָּה זֶּ֣ה מְחִ֣יר בְּ/יַד כְּסִ֑יל לִ/קְנ֖וֹת חָכְמָ֣ה וְ/לֶב אָֽיִן
verses.translit: lmh zh mchyr byd khsyl lqnvt chkhmh vlb 'yn
verses.translation: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart to it ?

verses.original: בְּ/כָל עֵ֭ת אֹהֵ֣ב הָ/רֵ֑עַ וְ/אָ֥ח לְ֝/צָרָ֗ה יִוָּלֵֽד
verses.translit: bkhl 't 'hb hr' v'ch ltsrh yvld
verses.translation: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

verses.original: אָדָ֣ם חֲסַר לֵ֭ב תּוֹקֵ֣עַ כָּ֑ף עֹרֵ֥ב עֲ֝רֻבָּ֗ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י רֵעֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: 'dm chsr lb tvq' khf 'rb 'rbh lpny r'hv
verses.translation: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.

verses.original: אֹ֣הֵֽב פֶּ֭שַׁע אֹהֵ֣ב מַצָּ֑ה מַגְבִּ֥יהַּ פִּ֝תְח֗/וֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ שָֽׁבֶר
verses.translit: 'hb psh' 'hb mtsh mgbyh ptchv mbqsh shbr
verses.translation: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.

verses.original: עִקֶּשׁ לֵ֭ב לֹ֣א יִמְצָא ט֑וֹב וְ/נֶהְפָּ֥ךְ בִּ֝/לְשׁוֹנ֗/וֹ יִפּ֥וֹל בְּ/רָעָֽה
verses.translit: 'qsh lb l' ymts' tvb vnhpkh blshvnv ypvl br'h
verses.translation: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.

verses.original: יֹלֵ֣ד כְּ֭סִיל לְ/ת֣וּגָה ל֑/וֹ וְ/לֹֽא יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח אֲבִ֣י נָבָֽל
verses.translit: yld khsyl ltvgh lv vl' yshmch 'by nbl
verses.translation: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.

verses.original: לֵ֣ב שָׂ֭מֵחַ יֵיטִ֣ב גֵּהָ֑ה וְ/ר֥וּחַ נְ֝כֵאָ֗ה תְּיַבֶּשׁ גָּֽרֶם
verses.translit: lb shmch yytb ghh vrvch nkh'h tybsh grm
verses.translation: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.

verses.original: שֹׁ֣חַד מֵ֭/חֵיק רָשָׁ֣ע יִקָּ֑ח לְ֝/הַטּ֗וֹת אָרְח֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: shchd mchyq rsh' yqch lhtvt 'rchvt mshpt
verses.translation: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.

verses.original: אֶת פְּנֵ֣י מֵבִ֣ין חָכְמָ֑ה וְ/עֵינֵ֥י כְ֝סִ֗יל בִּ/קְצֵה אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: 't pny mbyn chkhmh v'yny khsyl bqtsh 'rts
verses.translation: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.

verses.original: כַּ֣עַס לְ֭/אָבִי/ו בֵּ֣ן כְּסִ֑יל וּ֝/מֶ֗מֶר לְ/יוֹלַדְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: kh's l'byv bn khsyl vmmr lyvldtv
verses.translation: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.

verses.original: גַּ֤ם עֲנ֣וֹשׁ לַ/צַּדִּ֣יק לֹא ט֑וֹב לְ/הַכּ֖וֹת נְדִיבִ֣ים עַל יֹֽשֶׁר
verses.translit: gm 'nvsh ltsdyq l' tvb lhkhvt ndybym 'l yshr
verses.translation: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.

verses.original: חוֹשֵׂ֣ךְ אֲ֭מָרָי/ו יוֹדֵ֣עַ דָּ֑עַת ו/קר יְקַר ר֝֗וּחַ אִ֣ישׁ תְּבוּנָֽה
verses.translit: chvshkh 'mryv yvd' d't vqr yqr rvch 'ysh tbvnh
verses.translation: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.

verses.original: גַּ֤ם אֱוִ֣יל מַ֭חֲרִישׁ חָכָ֣ם יֵחָשֵׁ֑ב אֹטֵ֖ם שְׂפָתָ֣י/ו נָבֽוֹן
verses.translit: gm 'vyl mchrysh chkhm ychshb 'tm shptyv nbvn
verses.translation: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.

verses.original: לְֽ֭/תַאֲוָה יְבַקֵּ֣שׁ נִפְרָ֑ד בְּ/כָל תּ֝וּשִׁיָּ֗ה יִתְגַּלָּֽע
verses.translit: lt'vh ybqsh nprd bkhl tvshyh ytgl'
verses.translation: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.

verses.original: לֹֽא יַחְפֹּ֣ץ כְּ֭סִיל בִּ/תְבוּנָ֑ה כִּ֝֗י אִֽם בְּ/הִתְגַּלּ֥וֹת לִבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: l' ychpts khsyl btbvnh khy 'm bhtglvt lbv
verses.translation: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.

verses.original: בְּֽ/בוֹא רָ֭שָׁע בָּ֣א גַם בּ֑וּז וְֽ/עִם קָל֥וֹן חֶרְפָּֽה
verses.translit: bbv' rsh' b' gm bvz v'm qlvn chrph
verses.translation: When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.

verses.original: מַ֣יִם עֲ֭מֻקִּים דִּבְרֵ֣י פִי אִ֑ישׁ נַ֥חַל נֹ֝בֵ֗עַ מְק֣וֹר חָכְמָֽה
verses.translit: mym 'mqym dbry py 'ysh nchl nb' mqvr chkhmh
verses.translation: The words of a man’s mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.

verses.original: שְׂאֵ֣ת פְּנֵי רָשָׁ֣ע לֹא ט֑וֹב לְ/הַטּ֥וֹת צַ֝דִּ֗יק בַּ/מִּשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: sh't pny rsh' l' tvb lhtvt tsdyq bmshpt
verses.translation: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.

verses.original: שִׂפְתֵ֣י כְ֭סִיל יָבֹ֣אֽוּ בְ/רִ֑יב וּ֝/פִ֗י/ו לְֽ/מַהֲלֻמ֥וֹת יִקְרָֽא
verses.translit: shpty khsyl yb'v bryb vpyv lmhlmvt yqr'
verses.translation: A fool’s lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.

verses.original: פִּֽי כְ֭סִיל מְחִתָּה ל֑/וֹ וּ֝/שְׂפָתָ֗י/ו מוֹקֵ֥שׁ נַפְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: py khsyl mchth lv vshptyv mvqsh npshv
verses.translation: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֣י נִ֭רְגָּן כְּ/מִֽתְלַהֲמִ֑ים וְ֝/הֵ֗ם יָרְד֥וּ חַדְרֵי בָֽטֶן
verses.translit: dbry nrgn khmtlhmym vhm yrdv chdry btn
verses.translation: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

verses.original: גַּ֭ם מִתְרַפֶּ֣ה בִ/מְלַאכְתּ֑/וֹ אָ֥ח ה֝֗וּא לְ/בַ֣עַל מַשְׁחִֽית
verses.translit: gm mtrph bml'khtv 'ch hv' lb'l mshchyt
verses.translation: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.

verses.original: מִגְדַּל עֹ֭ז שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה בּֽ/וֹ יָר֖וּץ צַדִּ֣יק וְ/נִשְׂגָּֽב
verses.translit: mgdl 'z shm yhvh bv yrvts tsdyq vnshgb
verses.translation: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

verses.original: ה֣וֹן עָ֭שִׁיר קִרְיַ֣ת עֻזּ֑/וֹ וּ/כְ/חוֹמָ֥ה נִ֝שְׂגָּבָ֗ה בְּ/מַשְׂכִּיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hvn 'shyr qryt 'zv vkhchvmh nshgbh bmshkhytv
verses.translation: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.

verses.original: לִ/פְנֵי שֶׁ֭בֶר יִגְבַּ֣הּ לֵב אִ֑ישׁ וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֖י כָב֣וֹד עֲנָוָֽה
verses.translit: lpny shbr ygbh lb 'ysh vlpny khbvd 'nvh
verses.translation: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.

verses.original: מֵשִׁ֣יב דָּ֭בָר בְּ/טֶ֣רֶם יִשְׁמָ֑ע אִוֶּ֥לֶת הִיא ל֝֗/וֹ וּ/כְלִמָּֽה
verses.translit: mshyb dbr btrm yshm' 'vlt hy' lv vkhlmh
verses.translation: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it , it is folly and shame unto him.

verses.original: רֽוּחַ אִ֭ישׁ יְכַלְכֵּ֣ל מַחֲלֵ֑/הוּ וְ/ר֥וּחַ נְ֝כֵאָ֗ה מִ֣י יִשָּׂאֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: rvch 'ysh ykhlkhl mchlhv vrvch nkh'h my ysh'nh
verses.translation: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?

verses.original: לֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן יִקְנֶה דָּ֑עַת וְ/אֹ֥זֶן חֲ֝כָמִ֗ים תְּבַקֶּשׁ דָּֽעַת
verses.translit: lb nbvn yqnh d't v'zn chkhmym tbqsh d't
verses.translation: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.

verses.original: מַתָּ֣ן אָ֭דָם יַרְחִ֣יב ל֑/וֹ וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֖י גְדֹלִ֣ים יַנְחֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: mtn 'dm yrchyb lv vlpny gdlym ynchnv
verses.translation: A man’s gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.

verses.original: צַדִּ֣יק הָ/רִאשׁ֣וֹן בְּ/רִיב֑/וֹ יבא וּ/בָֽא רֵ֝עֵ֗/הוּ וַ/חֲקָרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: tsdyq hr'shvn brybv yb' vb' r'hv vchqrv
verses.translation: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.

verses.original: מִ֭דְיָנִים יַשְׁבִּ֣ית הַ/גּוֹרָ֑ל וּ/בֵ֖ין עֲצוּמִ֣ים יַפְרִֽיד
verses.translit: mdynym yshbyt hgvrl vbyn 'tsvmym ypryd
verses.translation: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.

verses.original: אָ֗ח נִפְשָׁ֥ע מִ/קִּרְיַת עֹ֑ז ו/מדונים וּ֝/מִדְיָנִ֗ים כִּ/בְרִ֥יחַ אַרְמֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'ch npsh' mqryt 'z vmdvnym vmdynym khbrych 'rmvn
verses.translation: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.

verses.original: מִ/פְּרִ֣י פִי אִ֭ישׁ תִּשְׂבַּ֣ע בִּטְנ֑/וֹ תְּבוּאַ֖ת שְׂפָתָ֣י/ו יִשְׂבָּֽע
verses.translit: mpry py 'ysh tshb' btnv tbv't shptyv yshb'
verses.translation: A man’s belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.

verses.original: מָ֣וֶת וְ֭/חַיִּים בְּ/יַד לָשׁ֑וֹן וְ֝/אֹהֲבֶ֗י/הָ יֹאכַ֥ל פִּרְיָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: mvt vchyym byd lshvn v'hbyh y'khl pryh
verses.translation: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.

verses.original: מָצָ֣א אִ֭שָּׁה מָ֣צָא ט֑וֹב וַ/יָּ֥פֶק רָ֝צ֗וֹן מֵ/יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: mts' 'shh mts' tvb vypq rtsvn myhvh
verses.translation: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing , and obtaineth favour of the LORD .

verses.original: תַּחֲנוּנִ֥ים יְדַבֶּר רָ֑שׁ וְ֝/עָשִׁ֗יר יַעֲנֶ֥ה עַזּֽוֹת
verses.translit: tchnvnym ydbr rsh v'shyr y'nh 'zvt
verses.translation: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ רֵ֭עִים לְ/הִתְרֹעֵ֑עַ וְ/יֵ֥שׁ אֹ֝הֵ֗ב דָּבֵ֥ק מֵ/אָֽח
verses.translit: 'ysh r'ym lhtr'' vysh 'hb dbq m'ch
verses.translation: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.

verses.original: טֽוֹב רָ֭שׁ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּ/תֻמּ֑/וֹ מֵ/עִקֵּ֥שׁ שְׂ֝פָתָ֗י/ו וְ/ה֣וּא כְסִֽיל
verses.translit: tvb rsh hvlkh btmv m'qsh shptyv vhv' khsyl
verses.translation: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.

verses.original: גַּ֤ם בְּ/לֹא דַ֣עַת נֶ֣פֶשׁ לֹא ט֑וֹב וְ/אָ֖ץ בְּ/רַגְלַ֣יִם חוֹטֵֽא
verses.translit: gm bl' d't npsh l' tvb v'ts brglym chvt'
verses.translation: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.

verses.original: אִוֶּ֣לֶת אָ֭דָם תְּסַלֵּ֣ף דַּרְכּ֑/וֹ וְ/עַל יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִזְעַ֥ף לִבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'vlt 'dm tslf drkhv v'l yhvh yz'f lbv
verses.translation: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the LORD .

verses.original: ה֗וֹן יֹ֭סִיף רֵעִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝/דָ֗ל מֵרֵ֥ע/הוּ יִפָּרֵֽד
verses.translit: hvn ysyf r'ym rbym vdl mr'hv yprd
verses.translation: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.

verses.original: עֵ֣ד שְׁ֭קָרִים לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶ֑ה וְ/יָפִ֥יחַ כְּ֝זָבִ֗ים לֹ֣א יִמָּלֵֽט
verses.translit: 'd shqrym l' ynqh vypych khzbym l' ymlt
verses.translation: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.

verses.original: רַ֭בִּים יְחַלּ֣וּ פְנֵֽי נָדִ֑יב וְ/כָל הָ֝/רֵ֗עַ לְ/אִ֣ישׁ מַתָּֽן
verses.translit: rbym ychlv pny ndyb vkhl hr' l'ysh mtn
verses.translation: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.

verses.original: כָּ֥ל אֲחֵי רָ֨שׁ שְֽׂנֵאֻ֗/הוּ אַ֤ף כִּ֣י מְ֭רֵעֵ/הוּ רָחֲק֣וּ מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ מְרַדֵּ֖ף אֲמָרִ֣ים לא ל/וֹ הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: khl 'chy rsh shn'hv 'f khy mr'hv rchqv mmnv mrdf 'mrym l' lv hmh
verses.translation: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him .

verses.original: קֹֽנֶה לֵּ֭ב אֹהֵ֣ב נַפְשׁ֑/וֹ שֹׁמֵ֥ר תְּ֝בוּנָ֗ה לִ/מְצֹא טֽוֹב
verses.translit: qnh lb 'hb npshv shmr tbvnh lmts' tvb
verses.translation: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.

verses.original: עֵ֣ד שְׁ֭קָרִים לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶ֑ה וְ/יָפִ֖יחַ כְּזָבִ֣ים יֹאבֵֽד
verses.translit: 'd shqrym l' ynqh vypych khzbym y'bd
verses.translation: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.

verses.original: לֹֽא נָאוֶ֣ה לִ/כְסִ֣יל תַּעֲנ֑וּג אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי לְ/עֶ֤בֶד מְשֹׁ֬ל בְּ/שָׂרִֽים
verses.translit: l' n'vh lkhsyl t'nvg 'f khy l'bd mshl bshrym
verses.translation: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

verses.original: שֵׂ֣כֶל אָ֭דָם הֶאֱרִ֣יךְ אַפּ֑/וֹ וְ֝/תִפאַרְתּ֗/וֹ עֲבֹ֣ר עַל פָּֽשַׁע
verses.translit: shkhl 'dm h'rykh 'pv vtp'rtv 'br 'l psh'
verses.translation: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.

verses.original: נַ֣הַם כַּ֭/כְּפִיר זַ֣עַף מֶ֑לֶךְ וּ/כְ/טַ֖ל עַל עֵ֣שֶׂב רְצוֹנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: nhm khkhpyr z'f mlkh vkhtl 'l 'shb rtsvnv
verses.translation: The king’s wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.

verses.original: הַוֺּ֣ת לְ֭/אָבִי/ו בֵּ֣ן כְּסִ֑יל וְ/דֶ֥לֶף טֹ֝רֵ֗ד מִדְיְנֵ֥י אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: hvt l'byv bn khsyl vdlf trd mdyny 'shh
verses.translation: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.

verses.original: בַּ֣יִת וָ֭/הוֹן נַחֲלַ֣ת אָב֑וֹת וּ֝/מֵ/יְהוָ֗ה אִשָּׁ֥ה מַשְׂכָּֽלֶת
verses.translit: byt vhvn nchlt 'bvt vmyhvh 'shh mshkhlt
verses.translation: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the LORD .

verses.original: עַ֭צְלָה תַּפִּ֣יל תַּרְדֵּמָ֑ה וְ/נֶ֖פֶשׁ רְמִיָּ֣ה תִרְעָֽב
verses.translit: 'tslh tpyl trdmh vnpsh rmyh tr'b
verses.translation: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֣ר מִ֭צְוָה שֹׁמֵ֣ר נַפְשׁ֑/וֹ בּוֹזֵ֖ה דְרָכָ֣י/ו יומת יָמֽוּת
verses.translit: shmr mtsvh shmr npshv bvzh drkhyv yvmt ymvt
verses.translation: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.

verses.original: מַלְוֵ֣ה יְ֭הוָה ח֣וֹנֵֽן דָּ֑ל וּ֝/גְמֻל֗/וֹ יְשַׁלֶּם לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mlvh yhvh chvnn dl vgmlv yshlm lv
verses.translation: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD ; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.

verses.original: יַסֵּ֣ר בִּ֭נְ/ךָ כִּי יֵ֣שׁ תִּקְוָ֑ה וְ/אֶל הֲ֝מִית֗/וֹ אַל תִּשָּׂ֥א נַפְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: ysr bnkh khy ysh tqvh v'l hmytv 'l tsh' npshkh
verses.translation: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.

verses.original: גרל גְּֽדָל חֵ֭מָה נֹ֣שֵׂא עֹ֑נֶשׁ כִּ֥י אִם תַּ֝צִּ֗יל וְ/ע֣וֹד תּוֹסִֽף
verses.translit: grl gdl chmh nsh' 'nsh khy 'm ttsyl v'vd tvsf
verses.translation: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him , yet thou must do it again.

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע עֵ֭צָה וְ/קַבֵּ֣ל מוּסָ֑ר לְ֝מַ֗עַן תֶּחְכַּ֥ם בְּ/אַחֲרִיתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: shm' 'tsh vqbl mvsr lm'n tchkhm b'chrytkh
verses.translation: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.

verses.original: רַבּ֣וֹת מַחֲשָׁב֣וֹת בְּ/לֶב אִ֑ישׁ וַ/עֲצַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה הִ֣יא תָקֽוּם
verses.translit: rbvt mchshbvt blb 'ysh v'tst yhvh hy' tqvm
verses.translation: There are many devices in a man’s heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD , that shall stand.

verses.original: תַּאֲוַ֣ת אָדָ֣ם חַסְדּ֑/וֹ וְ/טֽוֹב רָ֝שׁ מֵ/אִ֥ישׁ כָּזָֽב
verses.translit: t'vt 'dm chsdv vtvb rsh m'ysh khzb
verses.translation: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.

verses.original: יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה לְ/חַיִּ֑ים וְ/שָׂבֵ֥עַ יָ֝לִ֗ין בַּל יִפָּ֥קֶד רָֽע
verses.translit: yr't yhvh lchyym vshb' ylyn bl ypqd r'
verses.translation: The fear of the LORD tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.

verses.original: טָ֘מַ֤ן עָצֵ֣ל יָ֭ד/וֹ בַּ/צַּלָּ֑חַת גַּם אֶל פִּ֝֗י/הוּ לֹ֣א יְשִׁיבֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: tmn 'tsl ydv btslcht gm 'l pyhv l' yshybnh
verses.translation: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

verses.original: לֵ֣ץ תַּ֭כֶּה וּ/פֶ֣תִי יַעְרִ֑ם וְ/הוֹכִ֥יחַ לְ֝/נָב֗וֹן יָבִ֥ין דָּֽעַת
verses.translit: lts tkhh vpty y'rm vhvkhych lnbvn ybyn d't
verses.translation: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.

verses.original: מְֽשַׁדֶּד אָ֭ב יַבְרִ֣יחַ אֵ֑ם בֵּ֝֗ן מֵבִ֥ישׁ וּ/מַחְפִּֽיר
verses.translit: mshdd 'b ybrych 'm bn mbysh vmchpyr
verses.translation: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.

verses.original: חַֽדַל בְּ֭נִ/י לִ/שְׁמֹ֣עַ מוּסָ֑ר לִ֝/שְׁג֗וֹת מֵֽ/אִמְרֵי דָֽעַת
verses.translit: chdl bny lshm' mvsr lshgvt m'mry d't
verses.translation: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.

verses.original: עֵ֣ד בְּ֭לִיַּעַל יָלִ֣יץ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ/פִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְבַלַּע אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: 'd bly'l ylyts mshpt vpy rsh'ym ybl' 'vn
verses.translation: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.

verses.original: נָכ֣וֹנוּ לַ/לֵּצִ֣ים שְׁפָטִ֑ים וּ֝/מַהֲלֻמ֗וֹת לְ/גֵ֣ו כְּסִילִֽים
verses.translit: nkhvnv lltsym shptym vmhlmvt lgv khsylym
verses.translation: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.

verses.original: לֵ֣ץ הַ֭/יַּין הֹמֶ֣ה שֵׁכָ֑ר וְ/כָל שֹׁ֥גֶה בּ֝֗/וֹ לֹ֣א יֶחְכָּֽם
verses.translit: lts hyyn hmh shkhr vkhl shgh bv l' ychkhm
verses.translation: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.

verses.original: נַ֣הַם כַּ֭/כְּפִיר אֵ֣ימַת מֶ֑לֶךְ מִ֝תְעַבְּר֗/וֹ חוֹטֵ֥א נַפְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: nhm khkhpyr 'ymt mlkh mt'brv chvt' npshv
verses.translation: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.

verses.original: כָּב֣וֹד לָ֭/אִישׁ שֶׁ֣בֶת מֵ/רִ֑יב וְ/כָל אֱ֝וִ֗יל יִתְגַּלָּֽע
verses.translit: khbvd l'ysh shbt mryb vkhl 'vyl ytgl'
verses.translation: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.

verses.original: מֵ֭/חֹרֶף עָצֵ֣ל לֹא יַחֲרֹ֑שׁ ישאל וְ/שָׁאַ֖ל בַּ/קָּצִ֣יר וָ/אָֽיִן
verses.translit: mchrf 'tsl l' ychrsh ysh'l vsh'l bqtsyr v'yn
verses.translation: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.

verses.original: מַ֣יִם עֲ֭מֻקִּים עֵצָ֣ה בְ/לֶב אִ֑ישׁ וְ/אִ֖ישׁ תְּבוּנָ֣ה יִדְלֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: mym 'mqym 'tsh blb 'ysh v'ysh tbvnh ydlnh
verses.translation: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.

verses.original: רָב אָדָ֗ם יִ֭קְרָא אִ֣ישׁ חַסְדּ֑/וֹ וְ/אִ֥ישׁ אֱ֝מוּנִ֗ים מִ֣י יִמְצָֽא
verses.translit: rb 'dm yqr' 'ysh chsdv v'ysh 'mvnym my ymts'
verses.translation: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?

verses.original: מִתְהַלֵּ֣ךְ בְּ/תֻמּ֣/וֹ צַדִּ֑יק אַשְׁרֵ֖י בָנָ֣י/ו אַחֲרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: mthlkh btmv tsdyq 'shry bnyv 'chryv
verses.translation: The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.

verses.original: מֶ֗לֶךְ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל כִּסֵּא דִ֑ין מְזָרֶ֖ה בְ/עֵינָ֣י/ו כָּל רָֽע
verses.translit: mlkh yvshb 'l khs' dyn mzrh b'ynyv khl r'
verses.translation: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.

verses.original: מִֽי יֹ֭אמַר זִכִּ֣יתִי לִבִּ֑/י טָ֝הַ֗רְתִּי מֵ/חַטָּאתִֽ/י
verses.translit: my y'mr zkhyty lby thrty mcht'ty
verses.translation: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?

verses.original: אֶ֣בֶן וָ֭/אֶבֶן אֵיפָ֣ה וְ/אֵיפָ֑ה תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה גַּם שְׁנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'bn v'bn 'yph v'yph tv'bt yhvh gm shnyhm
verses.translation: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to the LORD .

verses.original: גַּ֣ם בְּ֭/מַעֲלָלָי/ו יִתְנַכֶּר נָ֑עַר אִם זַ֖ךְ וְ/אִם יָשָׁ֣ר פָּעֳלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: gm bm'llyv ytnkhr n'r 'm zkh v'm yshr p'lv
verses.translation: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.

verses.original: אֹ֣זֶן שֹׁ֭מַעַת וְ/עַ֣יִן רֹאָ֑ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עָשָׂ֥ה גַם שְׁנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'zn shm't v'yn r'h yhvh 'shh gm shnyhm
verses.translation: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD hath made even both of them.

verses.original: אַל תֶּֽאֱהַ֣ב שֵׁ֭נָה פֶּן תִּוָּרֵ֑שׁ פְּקַ֖ח עֵינֶ֣י/ךָ שְֽׂבַֽע לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: 'l t'hb shnh pn tvrsh pqch 'ynykh shb' lchm
verses.translation: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.

verses.original: רַ֣ע רַ֭ע יֹאמַ֣ר הַ/קּוֹנֶ֑ה וְ/אֹזֵ֥ל ל֝֗/וֹ אָ֣ז יִתְהַלָּֽל
verses.translit: r' r' y'mr hqvnh v'zl lv 'z ythll
verses.translation: It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.

verses.original: יֵ֣שׁ זָ֭הָב וְ/רָב פְּנִינִ֑ים וּ/כְלִ֥י יְ֝קָ֗ר שִׂפְתֵי דָֽעַת
verses.translit: ysh zhb vrb pnynym vkhly yqr shpty d't
verses.translation: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.

verses.original: לְֽקַח בִּ֭גְד/וֹ כִּי עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וּ/בְעַ֖ד נכרים נָכְרִיָּ֣ה חַבְלֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: lqch bgdv khy 'rb zr vb'd nkhrym nkhryh chblhv
verses.translation: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.

verses.original: עָרֵ֣ב לָ֭/אִישׁ לֶ֣חֶם שָׁ֑קֶר וְ֝/אַחַ֗ר יִמָּֽלֵא פִ֥י/הוּ חָצָֽץ
verses.translit: 'rb l'ysh lchm shqr v'chr yml' pyhv chtsts
verses.translation: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.

verses.original: מַ֭חֲשָׁבוֹת בְּ/עֵצָ֣ה תִכּ֑וֹן וּ֝/בְ/תַחְבֻּל֗וֹת עֲשֵׂ֣ה מִלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: mchshbvt b'tsh tkhvn vbtchblvt 'shh mlchmh
verses.translation: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.

verses.original: גּֽוֹלֶה סּ֭וֹד הוֹלֵ֣ךְ רָכִ֑יל וּ/לְ/פֹתֶ֥ה שְׂ֝פָתָ֗י/ו לֹ֣א תִתְעָרָֽב
verses.translit: gvlh svd hvlkh rkhyl vlpth shptyv l' tt'rb
verses.translation: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.

verses.original: מְ֭קַלֵּל אָבִ֣י/ו וְ/אִמּ֑/וֹ יִֽדְעַ֥ךְ נֵ֝ר֗/וֹ ב/אישון בֶּ/אֱשׁ֥וּן חֹֽשֶׁךְ
verses.translit: mqll 'byv v'mv yd'kh nrv b'yshvn b'shvn chshkh
verses.translation: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.

verses.original: נַ֭חֲלָה מבחלת מְבֹהֶ֣לֶת בָּ/רִאשֹׁנָ֑ה וְ֝/אַחֲרִיתָ֗/הּ לֹ֣א תְבֹרָֽךְ
verses.translit: nchlh mbchlt mbhlt br'shnh v'chryth l' tbrkh
verses.translation: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.

verses.original: אַל תֹּאמַ֥ר אֲשַׁלְּמָה רָ֑ע קַוֵּ֥ה לַֽ֝/יהוָ֗ה וְ/יֹ֣שַֽׁע לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'l t'mr 'shlmh r' qvh lyhvh vysh' lkh
verses.translation: Say not thou, I will recompense evil; but wait on the LORD , and he shall save thee.

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה אֶ֣בֶן וָ/אָ֑בֶן וּ/מֹאזְנֵ֖י מִרְמָ֣ה לֹא טֽוֹב
verses.translit: tv'bt yhvh 'bn v'bn vm'zny mrmh l' tvb
verses.translation: Divers weights are an abomination unto the LORD ; and a false balance is not good.

verses.original: מֵ/יהוָ֥ה מִצְעֲדֵי גָ֑בֶר וְ֝/אָדָ֗ם מַה יָּבִ֥ין דַּרְכּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: myhvh mts'dy gbr v'dm mh ybyn drkhv
verses.translation: Man’s goings are of the LORD ; how can a man then understand his own way?

verses.original: מוֹקֵ֣שׁ אָ֭דָם יָ֣לַע קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְ/אַחַ֖ר נְדָרִ֣ים לְ/בַקֵּֽר
verses.translit: mvqsh 'dm yl' qdsh v'chr ndrym lbqr
verses.translation: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.

verses.original: מְזָרֶ֣ה רְ֭שָׁעִים מֶ֣לֶךְ חָכָ֑ם וַ/יָּ֖שֶׁב עֲלֵי/הֶ֣ם אוֹפָֽן
verses.translit: mzrh rsh'ym mlkh chkhm vyshb 'lyhm 'vpn
verses.translation: A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.

verses.original: נֵ֣ר יְ֭הוָה נִשְׁמַ֣ת אָדָ֑ם חֹ֝פֵ֗שׂ כָּל חַדְרֵי בָֽטֶן
verses.translit: nr yhvh nshmt 'dm chpsh khl chdry btn
verses.translation: The spirit of man is the candle of the LORD , searching all the inward parts of the belly.

verses.original: חֶ֣סֶד וֶ֭/אֱמֶת יִצְּרוּ מֶ֑לֶךְ וְ/סָעַ֖ד בַּ/חֶ֣סֶד כִּסְאֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: chsd v'mt ytsrv mlkh vs'd bchsd khs'v
verses.translation: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.

verses.original: תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת בַּחוּרִ֣ים כֹּחָ֑/ם וַ/הֲדַ֖ר זְקֵנִ֣ים שֵׂיבָֽה
verses.translit: tp'rt bchvrym khchm vhdr zqnym shybh
verses.translation: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the gray head.

verses.original: חַבֻּר֣וֹת פֶּ֭צַע תמריק תַּמְר֣וּק בְּ/רָ֑ע וּ֝/מַכּ֗וֹת חַדְרֵי בָֽטֶן
verses.translit: chbrvt pts' tmryq tmrvq br' vmkhvt chdry btn
verses.translation: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.

verses.original: פַּלְגֵי מַ֣יִם לֶב מֶ֭לֶךְ בְּ/יַד יְהוָ֑ה עַֽל כָּל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יַחְפֹּ֣ץ יַטֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: plgy mym lb mlkh byd yhvh 'l khl 'shr ychpts ytnv
verses.translation: The king’s heart is in the hand of the LORD , as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.

verses.original: כָּֽל דֶּרֶךְ אִ֭ישׁ יָשָׁ֣ר בְּ/עֵינָ֑י/ו וְ/תֹכֵ֖ן לִבּ֣וֹת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khl drkh 'ysh yshr b'ynyv vtkhn lbvt yhvh
verses.translation: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the LORD pondereth the hearts.

verses.original: עֲ֭שֹׂה צְדָקָ֣ה וּ/מִשְׁפָּ֑ט נִבְחָ֖ר לַ/יהוָ֣ה מִ/זָּֽבַח
verses.translit: 'shh tsdqh vmshpt nbchr lyhvh mzbch
verses.translation: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.

verses.original: רוּם עֵ֭ינַיִם וּ/רְחַב לֵ֑ב נִ֖ר רְשָׁעִ֣ים חַטָּֽאת
verses.translit: rvm 'ynym vrchb lb nr rsh'ym cht't
verses.translation: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.

verses.original: מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת חָ֭רוּץ אַךְ לְ/מוֹתָ֑ר וְ/כָל אָ֝֗ץ אַךְ לְ/מַחְסֽוֹר
verses.translit: mchshbvt chrvts 'kh lmvtr vkhl 'ts 'kh lmchsvr
verses.translation: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.

verses.original: פֹּ֣עַל א֭וֹצָרוֹת בִּ/לְשׁ֣וֹן שָׁ֑קֶר הֶ֥בֶל נִ֝דָּ֗ף מְבַקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת
verses.translit: p'l 'vtsrvt blshvn shqr hbl ndf mbqshy mvt
verses.translation: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.

verses.original: שֹׁד רְשָׁעִ֥ים יְגוֹרֵ֑/ם כִּ֥י מֵ֝אֲנ֗וּ לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: shd rsh'ym ygvrm khy m'nv l'shvt mshpt
verses.translation: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.

verses.original: הֲפַכְפַּ֬ךְ דֶּ֣רֶךְ אִ֣ישׁ וָזָ֑ר וְ֝/זַ֗ךְ יָשָׁ֥ר פָּעֳלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hpkhpkh drkh 'ysh vzr vzkh yshr p'lv
verses.translation: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.

verses.original: ט֗וֹב לָ/שֶׁ֥בֶת עַל פִּנַּת גָּ֑ג מֵ/אֵ֥שֶׁת מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים וּ/בֵ֥ית חָֽבֶר
verses.translit: tvb lshbt 'l pnt gg m'sht mdynym vbyt chbr
verses.translation: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.

verses.original: נֶ֣פֶשׁ רָ֭שָׁע אִוְּתָה רָ֑ע לֹא יֻחַ֖ן בְּ/עֵינָ֣י/ו רֵעֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: npsh rsh' 'vth r' l' ychn b'ynyv r'hv
verses.translation: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.

verses.original: בַּ/עְנָשׁ לֵ֭ץ יֶחְכַּם פֶּ֑תִי וּ/בְ/הַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְ֝/חָכָ֗ם יִקַּח דָּֽעַת
verses.translit: b'nsh lts ychkhm pty vbhshkhyl lchkhm yqch d't
verses.translation: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.

verses.original: מַשְׂכִּ֣יל צַ֭דִּיק לְ/בֵ֣ית רָשָׁ֑ע מְסַלֵּ֖ף רְשָׁעִ֣ים לָ/רָֽע
verses.translit: mshkhyl tsdyq lbyt rsh' mslf rsh'ym lr'
verses.translation: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.

verses.original: אֹטֵ֣ם אָ֭זְנ/וֹ מִ/זַּעֲקַת דָּ֑ל גַּֽם ה֥וּא יִ֝קְרָ֗א וְ/לֹ֣א יֵעָנֶֽה
verses.translit: 'tm 'znv mz'qt dl gm hv' yqr' vl' y'nh
verses.translation: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.

verses.original: מַתָּ֣ן בַּ֭/סֵּתֶר יִכְפֶּה אָ֑ף וְ/שֹׁ֥חַד בַּ֝/חֵ֗ק חֵמָ֥ה עַזָּֽה
verses.translit: mtn bstr ykhph 'f vshchd bchq chmh 'zh
verses.translation: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.

verses.original: שִׂמְחָ֣ה לַ֭/צַּדִּיק עֲשׂ֣וֹת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝/מְחִתָּ֗ה לְ/פֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: shmchh ltsdyq 'shvt mshpt vmchth lp'ly 'vn
verses.translation: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.

verses.original: אָדָ֗ם תּ֭וֹעֶה מִ/דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַשְׂכֵּ֑ל בִּ/קְהַ֖ל רְפָאִ֣ים יָנֽוּחַ
verses.translit: 'dm tv'h mdrkh hshkhl bqhl rp'ym ynvch
verses.translation: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ מַ֭חְסוֹר אֹהֵ֣ב שִׂמְחָ֑ה אֹהֵ֥ב יַֽיִן וָ֝/שֶׁ֗מֶן לֹ֣א יַעֲשִֽׁיר
verses.translit: 'ysh mchsvr 'hb shmchh 'hb yyn vshmn l' y'shyr
verses.translation: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.

verses.original: כֹּ֣פֶר לַ/צַּדִּ֣יק רָשָׁ֑ע וְ/תַ֖חַת יְשָׁרִ֣ים בּוֹגֵֽד
verses.translit: khpr ltsdyq rsh' vtcht yshrym bvgd
verses.translation: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.

verses.original: ט֗וֹב שֶׁ֥בֶת בְּ/אֶֽרֶץ מִדְבָּ֑ר מֵ/אֵ֖שֶׁת מדונים מִדְיָנִ֣ים וָ/כָֽעַס
verses.translit: tvb shbt b'rts mdbr m'sht mdvnym mdynym vkh's
verses.translation: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.

verses.original: אוֹצָ֤ר נֶחְמָ֣ד וָ֭/שֶׁמֶן בִּ/נְוֵ֣ה חָכָ֑ם וּ/כְסִ֖יל אָדָ֣ם יְבַלְּעֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: 'vtsr nchmd vshmn bnvh chkhm vkhsyl 'dm ybl'nv
verses.translation: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.

verses.original: רֹ֭דֵף צְדָקָ֣ה וָ/חָ֑סֶד יִמְצָ֥א חַ֝יִּ֗ים צְדָקָ֥ה וְ/כָבֽוֹד
verses.translit: rdf tsdqh vchsd ymts' chyym tsdqh vkhbvd
verses.translation: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.

verses.original: עִ֣יר גִּ֭בֹּרִים עָלָ֣ה חָכָ֑ם וַ֝/יֹּ֗רֶד עֹ֣ז מִבְטֶחָֽ/ה
verses.translit: 'yr gbrym 'lh chkhm vyrd 'z mbtchh
verses.translation: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פִּ֭י/ו וּ/לְשׁוֹנ֑/וֹ שֹׁמֵ֖ר מִ/צָּר֣וֹת נַפְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: shmr pyv vlshvnv shmr mtsrvt npshv
verses.translation: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.

verses.original: זֵ֣ד יָ֭הִיר לֵ֣ץ שְׁמ֑/וֹ ע֝וֹשֶׂ֗ה בְּ/עֶבְרַ֥ת זָדֽוֹן
verses.translit: zd yhyr lts shmv 'vshh b'brt zdvn
verses.translation: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.

verses.original: תַּאֲוַ֣ת עָצֵ֣ל תְּמִיתֶ֑/נּוּ כִּֽי מֵאֲנ֖וּ יָדָ֣י/ו לַ/עֲשֽׂוֹת
verses.translit: t'vt 'tsl tmytnv khy m'nv ydyv l'shvt
verses.translation: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.

verses.original: כָּל הַ֭/יּוֹם הִתְאַוָּ֣ה תַאֲוָ֑ה וְ/צַדִּ֥יק יִ֝תֵּ֗ן וְ/לֹ֣א יַחְשֹֽׂךְ
verses.translit: khl hyvm ht'vh t'vh vtsdyq ytn vl' ychshkh
verses.translation: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.

verses.original: זֶ֣בַח רְ֭שָׁעִים תּוֹעֵבָ֑ה אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי בְ/זִמָּ֥ה יְבִיאֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: zbch rsh'ym tv'bh 'f khy bzmh yby'nv
verses.translation: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?

verses.original: עֵד כְּזָבִ֥ים יֹאבֵ֑ד וְ/אִ֥ישׁ שׁ֝וֹמֵ֗עַ לָ/נֶ֥צַח יְדַבֵּֽר
verses.translit: 'd khzbym y'bd v'ysh shvm' lntsch ydbr
verses.translation: A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly.

verses.original: הֵעֵ֬ז אִ֣ישׁ רָשָׁ֣ע בְּ/פָנָ֑י/ו וְ֝/יָשָׁ֗ר ה֤וּא יכין יָבִ֬ין דרכי/ו דַּרְכּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: h'z 'ysh rsh' bpnyv vyshr hv' ykhyn ybyn drkhyv drkhv
verses.translation: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.

verses.original: אֵ֣ין חָ֭כְמָה וְ/אֵ֣ין תְּבוּנָ֑ה וְ/אֵ֥ין עֵ֝צָ֗ה לְ/נֶ֣גֶד יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'yn chkhmh v'yn tbvnh v'yn 'tsh lngd yhvh
verses.translation: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD .

verses.original: ס֗וּס מ֭וּכָן לְ/י֣וֹם מִלְחָמָ֑ה וְ֝/לַֽ/יהוָ֗ה הַ/תְּשׁוּעָֽה
verses.translit: svs mvkhn lyvm mlchmh vlyhvh htshv'h
verses.translation: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of the LORD .

verses.original: נִבְחָ֣ר שֵׁ֭ם מֵ/עֹ֣שֶׁר רָ֑ב מִ/כֶּ֥סֶף וּ֝/מִ/זָּהָ֗ב חֵ֣ן טֽוֹב
verses.translit: nbchr shm m'shr rb mkhsf vmzhb chn tvb
verses.translation: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.

verses.original: עָשִׁ֣יר וָ/רָ֣שׁ נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ עֹשֵׂ֖ה כֻלָּ֣/ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'shyr vrsh npgshv 'shh khlm yhvh
verses.translation: The rich and poor meet together: the LORD is the maker of them all.

verses.original: עָר֤וּם רָאָ֣ה רָעָ֣ה ו/יסתר וְ/נִסְתָּ֑ר וּ֝/פְתָיִ֗ים עָבְר֥וּ וְֽ/נֶעֱנָֽשׁוּ
verses.translit: 'rvm r'h r'h vystr vnstr vptyym 'brv vn'nshv
verses.translation: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.

verses.original: עֵ֣קֶב עֲ֭נָוָה יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֖שֶׁר וְ/כָב֣וֹד וְ/חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: 'qb 'nvh yr't yhvh 'shr vkhbvd vchyym
verses.translation: By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches, and honour, and life.

verses.original: צִנִּ֣ים פַּ֭חִים בְּ/דֶ֣רֶךְ עִקֵּ֑שׁ שׁוֹמֵ֥ר נַ֝פְשׁ֗/וֹ יִרְחַ֥ק מֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: tsnym pchym bdrkh 'qsh shvmr npshv yrchq mhm
verses.translation: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.

verses.original: חֲנֹ֣ךְ לַ֭/נַּעַר עַל פִּ֣י דַרְכּ֑/וֹ גַּ֥ם כִּֽי יַ֝זְקִ֗ין לֹֽא יָס֥וּר מִמֶּֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: chnkh ln'r 'l py drkhv gm khy yzqyn l' ysvr mmnh
verses.translation: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.

verses.original: עָ֭שִׁיר בְּ/רָשִׁ֣ים יִמְשׁ֑וֹל וְ/עֶ֥בֶד לֹ֝וֶ֗ה לְ/אִ֣ישׁ מַלְוֶֽה
verses.translit: 'shyr brshym ymshvl v'bd lvh l'ysh mlvh
verses.translation: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.

verses.original: זוֹרֵ֣עַ עַ֭וְלָה יקצור יִקְצָר אָ֑וֶן וְ/שֵׁ֖בֶט עֶבְרָת֣/וֹ יִכְלֶֽה
verses.translit: zvr' 'vlh yqtsvr yqtsr 'vn vshbt 'brtv ykhlh
verses.translation: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.

verses.original: טֽוֹב עַ֭יִן ה֣וּא יְבֹרָ֑ךְ כִּֽי נָתַ֖ן מִ/לַּחְמ֣/וֹ לַ/דָּֽל
verses.translit: tvb 'yn hv' ybrkh khy ntn mlchmv ldl
verses.translation: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.

verses.original: גָּ֣רֵֽשׁ לֵ֭ץ וְ/יֵצֵ֣א מָד֑וֹן וְ֝/יִשְׁבֹּ֗ת דִּ֣ין וְ/קָלֽוֹן
verses.translit: grsh lts vyts' mdvn vyshbt dyn vqlvn
verses.translation: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.

verses.original: אֹהֵ֥ב טהור טְהָר לֵ֑ב חֵ֥ן שְׂ֝פָתָ֗י/ו רֵעֵ֥/הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: 'hb thvr thr lb chn shptyv r'hv mlkh
verses.translation: He that loveth pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.

verses.original: עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה נָ֣צְרוּ דָ֑עַת וַ֝/יְסַלֵּ֗ף דִּבְרֵ֥י בֹגֵֽד
verses.translit: 'yny yhvh ntsrv d't vyslf dbry bgd
verses.translation: The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.

verses.original: אָמַ֣ר עָ֭צֵל אֲרִ֣י בַ/ח֑וּץ בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ רְ֝חֹב֗וֹת אֵֽרָצֵֽחַ
verses.translit: 'mr 'tsl 'ry bchvts btvkh rchbvt 'rtsch
verses.translation: The slothful man saith, There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.

verses.original: שׁוּחָ֣ה עֲ֭מֻקָּה פִּ֣י זָר֑וֹת זְע֥וּם יְ֝הוָ֗ה יפול יִפָּל שָֽׁם
verses.translit: shvchh 'mqh py zrvt z'vm yhvh ypvl ypl shm
verses.translation: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of the LORD shall fall therein.

verses.original: אִ֭וֶּלֶת קְשׁוּרָ֣ה בְ/לֶב נָ֑עַר שֵׁ֥בֶט מ֝וּסָ֗ר יַרְחִיקֶ֥/נָּה מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: 'vlt qshvrh blb n'r shbt mvsr yrchyqnh mmnv
verses.translation: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.

verses.original: עֹ֣שֵֽׁק דָּ֭ל לְ/הַרְבּ֣וֹת ל֑/וֹ נֹתֵ֥ן לְ֝/עָשִׁ֗יר אַךְ לְ/מַחְסֽוֹר
verses.translit: 'shq dl lhrbvt lv ntn l'shyr 'kh lmchsvr
verses.translation: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, and he that giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.

verses.original: הַ֥ט אָזְנְ/ךָ֗ וּ֭/שְׁמַע דִּבְרֵ֣י חֲכָמִ֑ים וְ֝/לִבְּ/ךָ֗ תָּשִׁ֥ית לְ/דַעְתִּֽ/י
verses.translit: ht 'znkh vshm' dbry chkhmym vlbkh tshyt ld'ty
verses.translation: Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.

verses.original: כִּֽי נָ֭עִים כִּֽי תִשְׁמְרֵ֣/ם בְּ/בִטְנֶ֑/ךָ יִכֹּ֥נוּ יַ֝חְדָּ֗ו עַל שְׂפָתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: khy n'ym khy tshmrm bbtnkh ykhnv ychdv 'l shptykh
verses.translation: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.

verses.original: לִ/הְי֣וֹת בַּ֭/יהוָה מִבְטַחֶ֑/ךָ הוֹדַעְתִּ֖י/ךָ הַ/יּ֣וֹם אַף אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: lhyvt byhvh mbtchkh hvd'tykh hyvm 'f 'th
verses.translation: That thy trust may be in the LORD , I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.
