verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֤א כָתַ֣בְתִּי לְ֭/ךָ שלשום שָׁלִישִׁ֑ים בְּ/מ֖וֹעֵצֹ֣ת וָ/דָֽעַת
verses.translit: hl' khtbty lkh shlshvm shlyshym bmv'tst vd't
verses.translation: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,

verses.original: לְ/הוֹדִֽיעֲ/ךָ֗ קֹ֭שְׁטְ אִמְרֵ֣י אֱמֶ֑ת לְ/הָשִׁ֥יב אֲמָרִ֥ים אֱ֝מֶ֗ת לְ/שֹׁלְחֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: lhvdy'kh qsht 'mry 'mt lhshyb 'mrym 'mt lshlchykh
verses.translation: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?

verses.original: אַֽל תִּגְזָל דָּ֭ל כִּ֣י דַל ה֑וּא וְ/אַל תְּדַכֵּ֖א עָנִ֣י בַ/שָּֽׁעַר
verses.translit: 'l tgzl dl khy dl hv' v'l tdkh' 'ny bsh'r
verses.translation: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:

verses.original: כִּֽי יְ֭הוָה יָרִ֣יב רִיבָ֑/ם וְ/קָבַ֖ע אֶת קֹבְעֵי/הֶ֣ם נָֽפֶשׁ
verses.translit: khy yhvh yryb rybm vqb' 't qb'yhm npsh
verses.translation: For the LORD will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.

verses.original: אַל תִּ֭תְרַע אֶת בַּ֣עַל אָ֑ף וְ/אֶת אִ֥ישׁ חֵ֝מוֹת לֹ֣א תָבֽוֹא
verses.translit: 'l ttr' 't b'l 'f v't 'ysh chmvt l' tbv'
verses.translation: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:

verses.original: פֶּן תֶּאֱלַ֥ף ארחת/ו אֹֽרְחֹתָ֑י/ו וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֖ מוֹקֵ֣שׁ לְ/נַפְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: pn t'lf 'rchtv 'rchtyv vlqcht mvqsh lnpshkh
verses.translation: Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.

verses.original: אַל תְּהִ֥י בְ/תֹֽקְעֵי כָ֑ף בַּ֝/עֹרְבִ֗ים מַשָּׁאֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'l thy btq'y khf b'rbym msh'vt
verses.translation: Be not thou one of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts.

verses.translit: 'm 'yn lkh lshlm lmh yqch mshkhbkh mtchtykh
verses.translation: If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?

verses.original: אַל תַּ֭סֵּג גְּב֣וּל עוֹלָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עָשׂ֣וּ אֲבוֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'l tsg gbvl 'vlm 'shr 'shv 'bvtykh
verses.translation: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.

verses.original: חָזִ֡יתָ אִ֤ישׁ מָ֘הִ֤יר בִּ/מְלַאכְתּ֗/וֹ לִֽ/פְנֵֽי מְלָכִ֥ים יִתְיַצָּ֑ב בַּל יִ֝תְיַצֵּב לִ/פְנֵ֥י חֲשֻׁכִּֽים
verses.translit: chzyt 'ysh mhyr bml'khtv lpny mlkhym ytytsb bl ytytsb lpny chshkhym
verses.translation: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men .

verses.original: כִּֽי תֵ֭שֵׁב לִ/לְח֣וֹם אֶת מוֹשֵׁ֑ל בִּ֥ין תָּ֝בִ֗ין אֶת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְ/פָנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: khy tshb llchvm 't mvshl byn tbyn 't 'shr lpnykh
verses.translation: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before thee:

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתָּ֣ שַׂכִּ֣ין בְּ/לֹעֶ֑/ךָ אִם בַּ֖עַל נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: vshmt shkhyn bl'kh 'm b'l npsh 'th
verses.translation: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.

verses.original: אַל תִּ֭תְאָו לְ/מַטְעַמּוֹתָ֑י/ו וְ֝/ה֗וּא לֶ֣חֶם כְּזָבִֽים
verses.translit: 'l tt'v lmt'mvtyv vhv' lchm khzbym
verses.translation: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.

verses.original: אַל תִּיגַ֥ע לְֽ/הַעֲשִׁ֑יר מִֽ/בִּינָתְ/ךָ֥ חֲדָֽל
verses.translit: 'l tyg' lh'shyr mbyntkh chdl
verses.translation: Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.

verses.original: ה/תעוף הֲ/תָ֤עִיף עֵינֶ֥י/ךָ בּ֗/וֹ וְֽ/אֵ֫ינֶ֥/נּוּ כִּ֤י עָשֹׂ֣ה יַעֲשֶׂה לּ֣/וֹ כְנָפַ֑יִם כְּ֝/נֶ֗שֶׁר ו/עיף יָע֥וּף הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: ht'vf ht'yf 'ynykh bv v'ynnv khy 'shh y'shh lv khnpym khnshr v'yf y'vf hshmym
verses.translation: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.

verses.original: אַל תִּלְחַ֗ם אֶת לֶ֭חֶם רַ֣ע עָ֑יִן וְ/אַל תתאו תִּ֝תְאָ֗יו לְ/מַטְעַמֹּתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'l tlchm 't lchm r' 'yn v'l tt'v tt'yv lmt'mtyv
verses.translation: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats:

verses.original: כִּ֤י כְּמוֹ שָׁעַ֥ר בְּ/נַפְשׁ֗/וֹ כֶּ֫ן ה֥וּא אֱכֹ֣ל וּ֭/שְׁתֵה יֹ֣אמַר לָ֑/ךְ וְ֝/לִבּ֗/וֹ בַּל עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khy khmv sh'r bnpshv khn hv' 'khl vshth y'mr lkh vlbv bl 'mkh
verses.translation: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.

verses.original: פִּֽתְּ/ךָ אָכַ֥לְתָּ תְקִיאֶ֑/נָּה וְ֝/שִׁחַ֗תָּ דְּבָרֶ֥י/ךָ הַ/נְּעִימִֽים
verses.translit: ptkh 'khlt tqy'nh vshcht dbrykh hn'ymym
verses.translation: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.

verses.original: בְּ/אָזְנֵ֣י כְ֭סִיל אַל תְּדַבֵּ֑ר כִּֽי יָ֝ב֗וּז לְ/שֵׂ֣כֶל מִלֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: b'zny khsyl 'l tdbr khy ybvz lshkhl mlykh
verses.translation: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.

verses.original: אַל תַּ֭סֵּג גְּב֣וּל עוֹלָ֑ם וּ/בִ/שְׂדֵ֥י יְ֝תוֹמִ֗ים אַל תָּבֹֽא
verses.translit: 'l tsg gbvl 'vlm vbshdy ytvmym 'l tb'
verses.translation: Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless:

verses.original: כִּֽי גֹאֲלָ֥/ם חָזָ֑ק הֽוּא יָרִ֖יב אֶת רִיבָ֣/ם אִתָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khy g'lm chzq hv' yryb 't rybm 'tkh
verses.translation: For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.

verses.original: הָבִ֣יאָ/ה לַ/מּוּסָ֣ר לִבֶּ֑/ךָ וְ֝/אָזְנֶ֗/ךָ לְ/אִמְרֵי דָֽעַת
verses.translit: hby'h lmvsr lbkh v'znkh l'mry d't
verses.translation: Apply thine heart unto instruction, and thine ears to the words of knowledge.

verses.original: אַל תִּמְנַ֣ע מִ/נַּ֣עַר מוּסָ֑ר כִּֽי תַכֶּ֥/נּוּ בַ֝/שֵּׁ֗בֶט לֹ֣א יָמֽוּת
verses.translit: 'l tmn' mn'r mvsr khy tkhnv bshbt l' ymvt
verses.translation: Withhold not correction from the child: for if thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.

verses.translit: 'th bshbt tkhnv vnpshv msh'vl ttsyl
verses.translation: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.

verses.original: בְּ֭נִ/י אִם חָכַ֣ם לִבֶּ֑/ךָ יִשְׂמַ֖ח לִבִּ֣/י גַם אָֽנִי
verses.translit: bny 'm chkhm lbkh yshmch lby gm 'ny
verses.translation: My son, if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.

verses.original: וְ/תַעְלֹ֥זְנָה כִלְיוֹתָ֑/י בְּ/דַבֵּ֥ר שְׂ֝פָתֶ֗י/ךָ מֵישָׁרִֽים
verses.translit: vt'lznh khlyvty bdbr shptykh myshrym
verses.translation: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.

verses.original: אַל יְקַנֵּ֣א לִ֭בְּ/ךָ בַּֽ/חַטָּאִ֑ים כִּ֥י אִם בְּ/יִרְאַת יְ֝הוָ֗ה כָּל הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: 'l yqn' lbkh bcht'ym khy 'm byr't yhvh khl hyvm
verses.translation: Let not thine heart envy sinners: but be thou in the fear of the LORD all the day long.

verses.original: כִּ֭י אִם יֵ֣שׁ אַחֲרִ֑ית וְ֝/תִקְוָתְ/ךָ֗ לֹ֣א תִכָּרֵֽת
verses.translit: khy 'm ysh 'chryt vtqvtkh l' tkhrt
verses.translation: For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off.

verses.translit: shm' 'th bny vchkhm v'shr bdrkh lbkh
verses.translation: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.

verses.original: אַל תְּהִ֥י בְ/סֹֽבְאֵי יָ֑יִן בְּ/זֹלֲלֵ֖י בָשָׂ֣ר לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: 'l thy bsb'y yyn bzlly bshr lmv
verses.translation: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:

verses.original: כִּי סֹבֵ֣א וְ֭/זוֹלֵל יִוָּרֵ֑שׁ וּ֝/קְרָעִ֗ים תַּלְבִּ֥ישׁ נוּמָֽה
verses.translit: khy sb' vzvll yvrsh vqr'ym tlbysh nvmh
verses.translation: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע לְ֭/אָבִי/ךָ זֶ֣ה יְלָדֶ֑/ךָ וְ/אַל תָּ֝ב֗וּז כִּֽי זָקְנָ֥ה אִמֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: shm' l'bykh zh yldkh v'l tbvz khy zqnh 'mkh
verses.translation: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.

verses.original: אֱמֶ֣ת קְ֭נֵה וְ/אַל תִּמְכֹּ֑ר חָכְמָ֖ה וּ/מוּסָ֣ר וּ/בִינָֽה
verses.translit: 'mt qnh v'l tmkhr chkhmh vmvsr vbynh
verses.translation: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.

verses.original: גול גִּ֣יל יגול יָ֭גִיל אֲבִ֣י צַדִּ֑יק יולד וְ/יוֹלֵ֥ד חָ֝כָ֗ם ו/ישמח יִשְׂמַח בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: gvl gyl ygvl ygyl 'by tsdyq yvld vyvld chkhm vyshmch yshmch bv
verses.translation: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.

verses.original: יִֽשְׂמַח אָבִ֥י/ךָ וְ/אִמֶּ֑/ךָ וְ֝/תָגֵ֗ל יֽוֹלַדְתֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: yshmch 'bykh v'mkh vtgl yvldtkh
verses.translation: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, and she that bare thee shall rejoice.

verses.original: תְּנָֽ/ה בְנִ֣/י לִבְּ/ךָ֣ לִ֑/י וְ֝/עֵינֶ֗י/ךָ דְּרָכַ֥/י תרצנה תִּצֹּֽרְנָה
verses.translit: tnh bny lbkh ly v'ynykh drkhy trtsnh ttsrnh
verses.translation: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.

verses.original: כִּֽי שׁוּחָ֣ה עֲמֻקָּ֣ה זוֹנָ֑ה וּ/בְאֵ֥ר צָ֝רָ֗ה נָכְרִיָּֽה
verses.translit: khy shvchh 'mqh zvnh vb'r tsrh nkhryh
verses.translation: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.

verses.original: אַף הִ֭יא כְּ/חֶ֣תֶף תֶּֽאֱרֹ֑ב וּ֝/בוֹגְדִ֗ים בְּ/אָדָ֥ם תּוֹסִֽף
verses.translit: 'f hy' khchtf t'rb vbvgdym b'dm tvsf
verses.translation: She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.

verses.original: לְ/מִ֨י א֥וֹי לְ/מִ֪י אֲב֡וֹי לְ/מִ֤י מדונים מִדְיָנִ֨ים לְ/מִ֥י שִׂ֗יחַ לְ֭/מִי פְּצָעִ֣ים חִנָּ֑ם לְ֝/מִ֗י חַכְלִל֥וּת עֵינָֽיִם
verses.translit: lmy 'vy lmy 'bvy lmy mdvnym mdynym lmy shych lmy pts'ym chnm lmy chkhllvt 'ynym
verses.translation: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?

verses.original: לַֽ/מְאַחֲרִ֥ים עַל הַ/יָּ֑יִן לַ֝/בָּאִ֗ים לַ/חְקֹ֥ר מִמְסָֽךְ
verses.translit: lm'chrym 'l hyyn lb'ym lchqr mmskh
verses.translation: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.

verses.original: אַל תֵּ֥רֶא יַיִן֮ כִּ֪י יִתְאַ֫דָּ֥ם כִּֽי יִתֵּ֣ן ב/כיס בַּ/כּ֣וֹס עֵינ֑/וֹ יִ֝תְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בְּ/מֵישָׁרִֽים
verses.translit: 'l tr' yyn khy yt'dm khy ytn bkhys bkhvs 'ynv ythlkh bmyshrym
verses.translation: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.

verses.original: אַ֭חֲרִית/וֹ כְּ/נָחָ֣שׁ יִשָּׁ֑ךְ וּֽ/כְ/צִפְעֹנִ֥י יַפְרִֽשׁ
verses.translit: 'chrytv khnchsh yshkh vkhtsp'ny yprsh
verses.translation: At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.

verses.original: עֵ֭ינֶי/ךָ יִרְא֣וּ זָר֑וֹת וְ֝/לִבְּ/ךָ֗ יְדַבֵּ֥ר תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'ynykh yr'v zrvt vlbkh ydbr thpkhvt
verses.translation: Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.

verses.original: וְ֭/הָיִיתָ כְּ/שֹׁכֵ֣ב בְּ/לֶב יָ֑ם וּ֝/כְ/שֹׁכֵ֗ב בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ חִבֵּֽל
verses.translit: vhyyt khshkhb blb ym vkhshkhb br'sh chbl
verses.translation: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.

verses.original: הִכּ֥וּ/נִי בַל חָלִיתִי֮ הֲלָמ֗וּ/נִי בַּל יָ֫דָ֥עְתִּי מָתַ֥י אָקִ֑יץ א֝וֹסִ֗יף אֲבַקְשֶׁ֥/נּוּ עֽוֹד
verses.translit: hkhvny bl chlyty hlmvny bl yd'ty mty 'qyts 'vsyf 'bqshnv 'vd
verses.translation: They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.

verses.original: אַל תְּ֭קַנֵּא בְּ/אַנְשֵׁ֣י רָעָ֑ה וְ/אַל תתאו תִּ֝תְאָ֗יו לִ/הְי֥וֹת אִתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'l tqn' b'nshy r'h v'l tt'v tt'yv lhyvt 'tm
verses.translation: Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.

verses.original: כִּי שֹׁ֭ד יֶהְגֶּ֣ה לִבָּ֑/ם וְ֝/עָמָ֗ל שִׂפְתֵי/הֶ֥ם תְּדַבֵּֽרְנָה
verses.translit: khy shd yhgh lbm v'ml shptyhm tdbrnh
verses.translation: For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.

verses.original: בְּ֭/חָכְמָה יִבָּ֣נֶה בָּ֑יִת וּ֝/בִ/תְבוּנָ֗ה יִתְכּוֹנָֽן
verses.translit: bchkhmh ybnh byt vbtbvnh ytkhvnn
verses.translation: Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established:

verses.original: וּ֭/בְ/דַעַת חֲדָרִ֣ים יִמָּלְא֑וּ כָּל ה֖וֹן יָקָ֣ר וְ/נָעִֽים
verses.translit: vbd't chdrym yml'v khl hvn yqr vn'ym
verses.translation: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.

verses.original: גֶּֽבֶר חָכָ֥ם בַּ/ע֑וֹז וְ/אִֽישׁ דַּ֝֗עַת מְאַמֶּץ כֹּֽחַ
verses.translit: gbr chkhm b'vz v'ysh d't m'mts khch
verses.translation: A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.

verses.original: כִּ֣י בְ֭/תַחְבֻּלוֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה לְּ/ךָ֣ מִלְחָמָ֑ה וּ֝/תְשׁוּעָ֗ה בְּ/רֹ֣ב יוֹעֵֽץ
verses.translit: khy btchblvt t'shh lkh mlchmh vtshv'h brb yv'ts
verses.translation: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.

verses.original: רָאמ֣וֹת לֶֽ/אֱוִ֣יל חָכְמ֑וֹת בַּ֝/שַּׁ֗עַר לֹ֣א יִפְתַּח פִּֽי/הוּ
verses.translit: r'mvt l'vyl chkhmvt bsh'r l' yptch pyhv
verses.translation: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.

verses.original: מְחַשֵּׁ֥ב לְ/הָרֵ֑עַ ל֝֗/וֹ בַּֽעַל מְזִמּ֥וֹת יִקְרָֽאוּ
verses.translit: mchshb lhr' lv b'l mzmvt yqr'v
verses.translation: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.

verses.original: זִמַּ֣ת אִוֶּ֣לֶת חַטָּ֑את וְ/תוֹעֲבַ֖ת לְ/אָדָ֣ם לֵֽץ
verses.translit: zmt 'vlt cht't vtv'bt l'dm lts
verses.translation: The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.

verses.original: הִ֭תְרַפִּיתָ בְּ/י֥וֹם צָרָ֗ה צַ֣ר כֹּחֶֽ/כָה
verses.translit: htrpyt byvm tsrh tsr khchkhh
verses.translation: If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.

verses.original: הַ֭צֵּל לְקֻחִ֣ים לַ/מָּ֑וֶת וּ/מָטִ֥ים לַ֝/הֶ֗רֶג אִם תַּחְשֽׂוֹךְ
verses.translit: htsl lqchym lmvt vmtym lhrg 'm tchshvkh
verses.translation: If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, and those that are ready to be slain;

verses.original: כִּֽי תֹאמַ֗ר הֵן֮ לֹא יָדַ֪עְנ֫וּ זֶ֥ה הֲֽ/לֹא תֹ֘כֵ֤ן לִבּ֨וֹת הֽוּא יָבִ֗ין וְ/נֹצֵ֣ר נַ֭פְשְׁ/ךָ ה֣וּא יֵדָ֑ע וְ/הֵשִׁ֖יב לְ/אָדָ֣ם כְּ/פָעֳלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy t'mr hn l' yd'nv zh hl' tkhn lbvt hv' ybyn vntsr npshkh hv' yd' vhshyb l'dm khp'lv
verses.translation: If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it ? and he that keepeth thy soul, doth not he know it ? and shall not he render to every man according to his works?

verses.original: אֱכָל בְּנִ֣/י דְבַ֣שׁ כִּי ט֑וֹב וְ/נֹ֥פֶת מָ֝ת֗וֹק עַל חִכֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'khl bny dbsh khy tvb vnpt mtvq 'l chkhkh
verses.translation: My son, eat thou honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to thy taste:

verses.original: כֵּ֤ן דְּעֶ֥/ה חָכְמָ֗ה לְ/נַ֫פְשֶׁ֥/ךָ אִם מָ֭צָאתָ וְ/יֵ֣שׁ אַחֲרִ֑ית וְ֝/תִקְוָתְ/ךָ֗ לֹ֣א תִכָּרֵֽת
verses.translit: khn d'h chkhmh lnpshkh 'm mts't vysh 'chryt vtqvtkh l' tkhrt
verses.translation: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul: when thou hast found it , then there shall be a reward, and thy expectation shall not be cut off.

verses.original: אַל תֶּאֱרֹ֣ב רָ֭שָׁע לִ/נְוֵ֣ה צַדִּ֑יק אַֽל תְּשַׁדֵּ֥ד רִבְצ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'l t'rb rsh' lnvh tsdyq 'l tshdd rbtsv
verses.translation: Lay not wait, O wicked man , against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:

verses.original: כִּ֤י שֶׁ֨בַע יִפּ֣וֹל צַדִּ֣יק וָ/קָ֑ם וּ֝/רְשָׁעִ֗ים יִכָּשְׁל֥וּ בְ/רָעָֽה
verses.translit: khy shb' ypvl tsdyq vqm vrsh'ym ykhshlv br'h
verses.translation: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.

verses.original: בִּ/נְפֹ֣ל אויבי/ך אֽ֭וֹיִבְ/ךָ אַל תִּשְׂמָ֑ח וּ֝/בִ/כָּשְׁל֗/וֹ אַל יָגֵ֥ל לִבֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: bnpl 'vybykh 'vybkh 'l tshmch vbkhshlv 'l ygl lbkh
verses.translation: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth:

verses.original: פֶּן יִרְאֶ֣ה יְ֭הוָה וְ/רַ֣ע בְּ/עֵינָ֑י/ו וְ/הֵשִׁ֖יב מֵ/עָלָ֣י/ו אַפּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: pn yr'h yhvh vr' b'ynyv vhshyb m'lyv 'pv
verses.translation: Lest the LORD see it , and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.

verses.original: אַל תִּתְחַ֥ר בַּ/מְּרֵעִ֑ים אַל תְּ֝קַנֵּ֗א בָּ/רְשָׁעִֽים
verses.translit: 'l ttchr bmr'ym 'l tqn' brsh'ym
verses.translation: Fret not thyself because of evil men , neither be thou envious at the wicked;

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹֽא תִהְיֶ֣ה אַחֲרִ֣ית לָ/רָ֑ע נֵ֖ר רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִדְעָֽךְ
verses.translit: khy l' thyh 'chryt lr' nr rsh'ym yd'kh
verses.translation: For there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked shall be put out.

verses.original: יְרָֽא אֶת יְהוָ֣ה בְּנִ֣/י וָ/מֶ֑לֶךְ עִם שׁ֝וֹנִ֗ים אַל תִּתְעָרָֽב
verses.translit: yr' 't yhvh bny vmlkh 'm shvnym 'l tt'rb
verses.translation: My son, fear thou the LORD and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:

verses.original: כִּֽי פִ֭תְאֹם יָק֣וּם אֵידָ֑/ם וּ/פִ֥יד שְׁ֝נֵי/הֶ֗ם מִ֣י יוֹדֵֽעַ
verses.translit: khy pt'm yqvm 'ydm vpyd shnyhm my yvd'
verses.translation: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?

verses.original: גַּם אֵ֥לֶּה לַֽ/חֲכָמִ֑ים הַֽכֵּר פָּנִ֖ים בְּ/מִשְׁפָּ֣ט בַּל טֽוֹב
verses.translit: gm 'lh lchkhmym hkhr pnym bmshpt bl tvb
verses.translation: These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.

verses.original: אֹ֤מֵ֨ר לְ/רָשָׁע֮ צַדִּ֪יק אָ֥תָּה יִקְּבֻ֥/הוּ עַמִּ֑ים יִזְעָמ֥וּ/הוּ לְאֻמִּֽים
verses.translit: 'mr lrsh' tsdyq 'th yqbhv 'mym yz'mvhv l'mym
verses.translation: He that saith unto the wicked, Thou art righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:

verses.original: וְ/לַ/מּוֹכִיחִ֥ים יִנְעָ֑ם וַֽ֝/עֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם תָּב֥וֹא בִרְכַּת טֽוֹב
verses.translit: vlmvkhychym yn'm v'lyhm tbv' brkht tvb
verses.translation: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.

verses.original: שְׂפָתַ֥יִם יִשָּׁ֑ק מֵ֝שִׁ֗יב דְּבָרִ֥ים נְכֹחִֽים
verses.translit: shptym yshq mshyb dbrym nkhchym
verses.translation: Every man shall kiss his lips that giveth a right answer.

verses.original: הָ֘כֵ֤ן בַּ/ח֨וּץ מְלַאכְתֶּ֗/ךָ וְ/עַתְּדָ֣/הּ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֣ה לָ֑/ךְ אַ֝חַ֗ר וּ/בָנִ֥יתָ בֵיתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: hkhn bchvts ml'khtkh v'tdh bshdh lkh 'chr vbnyt bytkh
verses.translation: Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house.

verses.original: אַל תְּהִ֣י עֵד חִנָּ֣ם בְּ/רֵעֶ֑/ךָ וַ֝/הֲ/פִתִּ֗יתָ בִּ/שְׂפָתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'l thy 'd chnm br'kh vhptyt bshptykh
verses.translation: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; and deceive not with thy lips.

verses.original: אַל תֹּאמַ֗ר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָֽשָׂה לִ֭/י כֵּ֤ן אֶֽעֱשֶׂה לּ֑/וֹ אָשִׁ֖יב לָ/אִ֣ישׁ כְּ/פָעֳלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'l t'mr kh'shr 'shh ly khn ''shh lv 'shyb l'ysh khp'lv
verses.translation: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.

verses.original: עַל שְׂדֵ֣ה אִישׁ עָצֵ֣ל עָבַ֑רְתִּי וְ/עַל כֶּ֝֗רֶם אָדָ֥ם חֲסַר לֵֽב
verses.translit: 'l shdh 'ysh 'tsl 'brty v'l khrm 'dm chsr lb
verses.translation: I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה עָ֘לָ֤ה כֻלּ֨/וֹ קִמְּשֹׂנִ֗ים כָּסּ֣וּ פָנָ֣י/ו חֲרֻלִּ֑ים וְ/גֶ֖דֶר אֲבָנָ֣י/ו נֶהֱרָֽסָה
verses.translit: vhnh 'lh khlv qmshnym khsv pnyv chrlym vgdr 'bnyv nhrsh
verses.translation: And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.

verses.original: וָֽ/אֶחֱזֶ֣ה אָ֭נֹכִֽי אָשִׁ֣ית לִבִּ֑/י רָ֝אִ֗יתִי לָקַ֥חְתִּי מוּסָֽר
verses.translit: v'chzh 'nkhy 'shyt lby r'yty lqchty mvsr
verses.translation: Then I saw, and considered it well: I looked upon it, and received instruction.

verses.original: מְעַ֣ט שֵׁ֭נוֹת מְעַ֣ט תְּנוּמ֑וֹת מְעַ֓ט חִבֻּ֖ק יָדַ֣יִם לִ/שְׁכָּֽב
verses.translit: m't shnvt m't tnvmvt m't chbq ydym lshkhb
verses.translation: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:

verses.original: וּ/בָֽא מִתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ רֵישֶׁ֑/ךָ וּ֝/מַחְסֹרֶ֗י/ךָ כְּ/אִ֣ישׁ מָגֵֽן
verses.translit: vb' mthlkh ryshkh vmchsrykh kh'ysh mgn
verses.translation: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth; and thy want as an armed man.

verses.original: גַּם אֵ֭לֶּה מִשְׁלֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶ֝עְתִּ֗יקוּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י חִזְקִיָּ֬ה מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: gm 'lh mshly shlmh 'shr h'tyqv 'nshy chzqyh mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: These are also proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.

verses.original: כְּבֹ֣ד אֱ֭לֹהִים הַסְתֵּ֣ר דָּבָ֑ר וּ/כְבֹ֥ד מְ֝לָכִ֗ים חֲקֹ֣ר דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: khbd 'lhym hstr dbr vkhbd mlkhym chqr dbr
verses.translation: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter.

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣יִם לָ֭/רוּם וָ/אָ֣רֶץ לָ/עֹ֑מֶק וְ/לֵ֥ב מְ֝לָכִ֗ים אֵ֣ין חֵֽקֶר
verses.translit: shmym lrvm v'rts l'mq vlb mlkhym 'yn chqr
verses.translation: The heaven for height, and the earth for depth, and the heart of kings is unsearchable.

verses.original: הָג֣וֹ סִיגִ֣ים מִ/כָּ֑סֶף וַ/יֵּצֵ֖א לַ/צֹּרֵ֣ף כֶּֽלִי
verses.translit: hgv sygym mkhsf vyts' ltsrf khly
verses.translation: Take away the dross from the silver, and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer.

verses.original: הָג֣וֹ רָ֭שָׁע לִ/פְנֵי מֶ֑לֶךְ וְ/יִכּ֖וֹן בַּ/צֶּ֣דֶק כִּסְאֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hgv rsh' lpny mlkh vykhvn btsdq khs'v
verses.translation: Take away the wicked from before the king, and his throne shall be established in righteousness.

verses.original: אַל תִּתְהַדַּ֥ר לִ/פְנֵי מֶ֑לֶךְ וּ/בִ/מְק֥וֹם גְּ֝דֹלִ֗ים אַֽל תַּעֲמֹֽד
verses.translit: 'l tthdr lpny mlkh vbmqvm gdlym 'l t'md
verses.translation: Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king, and stand not in the place of great men:

verses.original: כִּ֤י ט֥וֹב אֲמָר לְ/ךָ֗ עֲֽלֵ֫ה הֵ֥נָּה מֵֽ֭/הַשְׁפִּ֣ילְ/ךָ לִ/פְנֵ֣י נָדִ֑יב אֲשֶׁ֖ר רָא֣וּ עֵינֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: khy tvb 'mr lkh 'lh hnh mhshpylkh lpny ndyb 'shr r'v 'ynykh
verses.translation: For better it is that it be said unto thee, Come up hither; than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince whom thine eyes have seen.

verses.original: אַל תֵּצֵ֥א לָ/רִ֗ב מַ֫הֵ֥ר פֶּ֣ן מַה תַּ֭עֲשֶׂה בְּ/אַחֲרִיתָ֑/הּ בְּ/הַכְלִ֖ים אֹתְ/ךָ֣ רֵעֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'l tts' lrb mhr pn mh t'shh b'chryth bhkhlym 'tkh r'kh
verses.translation: Go not forth hastily to strive, lest thou know not what to do in the end thereof, when thy neighbour hath put thee to shame.

verses.original: רִֽ֭יבְ/ךָ רִ֣יב אֶת רֵעֶ֑/ךָ וְ/ס֖וֹד אַחֵ֣ר אַל תְּגָֽל
verses.translit: rybkh ryb 't r'kh vsvd 'chr 'l tgl
verses.translation: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself; and discover not a secret to another:

verses.translit: pn ychsdkh shm' vdbtkh l' tshvb
verses.translation: Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame, and thine infamy turn not away.

verses.original: תַּפּוּחֵ֣י זָ֭הָב בְּ/מַשְׂכִּיּ֥וֹת כָּ֑סֶף דָּ֝בָ֗ר דָּבֻ֥ר עַל אָפְנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: tpvchy zhb bmshkhyvt khsf dbr dbr 'l 'pnyv
verses.translation: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.

verses.original: נֶ֣זֶם זָ֭הָב וַ/חֲלִי כָ֑תֶם מוֹכִ֥יחַ חָ֝כָ֗ם עַל אֹ֥זֶן שֹׁמָֽעַת
verses.translit: nzm zhb vchly khtm mvkhych chkhm 'l 'zn shm't
verses.translation: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.

verses.original: כְּ/צִנַּת שֶׁ֨לֶג בְּ/י֬וֹם קָצִ֗יר צִ֣יר נֶ֭אֱמָן לְ/שֹׁלְחָ֑י/ו וְ/נֶ֖פֶשׁ אֲדֹנָ֣י/ו יָשִֽׁיב
verses.translit: khtsnt shlg byvm qtsyr tsyr n'mn lshlchyv vnpsh 'dnyv yshyb
verses.translation: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to them that send him: for he refresheth the soul of his masters.

verses.original: נְשִׂיאִ֣ים וְ֭/רוּחַ וְ/גֶ֣שֶׁם אָ֑יִן אִ֥ישׁ מִ֝תְהַלֵּ֗ל בְּ/מַתַּת שָֽׁקֶר
verses.translit: nshy'ym vrvch vgshm 'yn 'ysh mthll bmtt shqr
verses.translation: Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain.

verses.original: בְּ/אֹ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם יְפֻתֶּ֣ה קָצִ֑ין וְ/לָשׁ֥וֹן רַ֝כָּ֗ה תִּשְׁבָּר גָּֽרֶם
verses.translit: b'rkh 'pym ypth qtsyn vlshvn rkhh tshbr grm
verses.translation: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaketh the bone.

verses.translit: dbsh mts't 'khl dykh pn tshb'nv vhq'tv
verses.translation: Hast thou found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for thee, lest thou be filled therewith, and vomit it.

verses.translit: hqr rglkh mbyt r'kh pn yshb'kh vshn'kh
verses.translation: Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour’s house; lest he be weary of thee, and so hate thee.

verses.original: מֵפִ֣יץ וְ֭/חֶרֶב וְ/חֵ֣ץ שָׁנ֑וּן אִ֥ישׁ עֹנֶ֥ה בְ֝/רֵעֵ֗/הוּ עֵ֣ד שָֽׁקֶר
verses.translit: mpyts vchrb vchts shnvn 'ysh 'nh br'hv 'd shqr
verses.translation: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.

verses.original: שֵׁ֣ן רֹ֭עָה וְ/רֶ֣גֶל מוּעָ֑דֶת מִבְטָ֥ח בּ֝וֹגֵ֗ד בְּ/י֣וֹם צָרָֽה
verses.translit: shn r'h vrgl mv'dt mbtch bvgd byvm tsrh
verses.translation: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.

verses.original: מַ֥עֲדֶה בֶּ֨גֶד בְּ/י֣וֹם קָ֭רָה חֹ֣מֶץ עַל נָ֑תֶר וְ/שָׁ֥ר בַּ֝/שִּׁרִ֗ים עַ֣ל לֶב רָֽע
verses.translit: m'dh bgd byvm qrh chmts 'l ntr vshr bshrym 'l lb r'
verses.translation: As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar upon nitre, so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart.

verses.original: אִם רָעֵ֣ב שֹׂ֭נַאֲ/ךָ הַאֲכִלֵ֣/הוּ לָ֑חֶם וְ/אִם צָ֝מֵ֗א הַשְׁקֵ֥/הוּ מָֽיִם
verses.translit: 'm r'b shn'kh h'khlhv lchm v'm tsm' hshqhv mym
verses.translation: If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:

verses.original: כִּ֤י גֶֽחָלִ֗ים אַ֭תָּה חֹתֶ֣ה עַל רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ וַֽ֝/יהוָ֗ה יְשַׁלֶּם לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khy gchlym 'th chth 'l r'shv vyhvh yshlm lkh
verses.translation: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the LORD shall reward thee.

verses.original: ר֣וּחַ צָ֭פוֹן תְּח֣וֹלֵֽל גָּ֑שֶׁם וּ/פָנִ֥ים נִ֝זְעָמִ֗ים לְשׁ֣וֹן סָֽתֶר
verses.translit: rvch tspvn tchvll gshm vpnym nz'mym lshvn str
verses.translation: The north wind driveth away rain: so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue.

verses.original: ט֗וֹב שֶׁ֥בֶת עַל פִּנַּת גָּ֑ג מֵ/אֵ֥שֶׁת מדונים מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים וּ/בֵ֥ית חָֽבֶר
verses.translit: tvb shbt 'l pnt gg m'sht mdvnym mdynym vbyt chbr
verses.translation: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman and in a wide house.

verses.original: מַ֣יִם קָ֭רִים עַל נֶ֣פֶשׁ עֲיֵפָ֑ה וּ/שְׁמוּעָ֥ה ט֝וֹבָ֗ה מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מֶרְחָֽק
verses.translit: mym qrym 'l npsh 'yph vshmv'h tvbh m'rts mrchq
verses.translation: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.

verses.original: מַעְיָ֣ן נִ֭רְפָּשׂ וּ/מָק֣וֹר מָשְׁחָ֑ת צַ֝דִּ֗יק מָ֣ט לִ/פְנֵֽי רָשָֽׁע
verses.translit: m'yn nrpsh vmqvr mshcht tsdyq mt lpny rsh'
verses.translation: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain, and a corrupt spring.

verses.original: אָ֘כֹ֤ל דְּבַ֣שׁ הַרְבּ֣וֹת לֹא ט֑וֹב וְ/חֵ֖קֶר כְּבֹדָ֣/ם כָּבֽוֹד
verses.translit: 'khl dbsh hrbvt l' tvb vchqr khbdm khbvd
verses.translation: It is not good to eat much honey: so for men to search their own glory is not glory.

verses.original: עִ֣יר פְּ֭רוּצָה אֵ֣ין חוֹמָ֑ה אִ֝֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵ֖ין מַעְצָ֣ר לְ/רוּחֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'yr prvtsh 'yn chvmh 'ysh 'shr 'yn m'tsr lrvchv
verses.translation: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.

verses.original: כַּ/שֶּׁ֤לֶג בַּ/קַּ֗יִץ וְ/כַ/מָּטָ֥ר בַּ/קָּצִ֑יר כֵּ֤ן לֹא נָאוֶ֖ה לִ/כְסִ֣יל כָּבֽוֹד
verses.translit: khshlg bqyts vkhmtr bqtsyr khn l' n'vh lkhsyl khbvd
verses.translation: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.

verses.original: כַּ/צִּפּ֣וֹר לָ֭/נוּד כַּ/דְּר֣וֹר לָ/ע֑וּף כֵּ֥ן קִֽלְלַ֥ת חִ֝נָּ֗ם לא ל֣/וֹ תָבֹֽא
verses.translit: khtspvr lnvd khdrvr l'vf khn qllt chnm l' lv tb'
verses.translation: As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come.

verses.original: שׁ֣וֹט לַ֭/סּוּס מֶ֣תֶג לַ/חֲמ֑וֹר וְ֝/שֵׁ֗בֶט לְ/גֵ֣ו כְּסִילִֽים
verses.translit: shvt lsvs mtg lchmvr vshbt lgv khsylym
verses.translation: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool’s back.

verses.original: אַל תַּ֣עַן כְּ֭סִיל כְּ/אִוַּלְתּ֑/וֹ פֶּֽן תִּשְׁוֶה לּ֥/וֹ גַם אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: 'l t'n khsyl kh'vltv pn tshvh lv gm 'th
verses.translation: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest thou also be like unto him.

verses.original: עֲנֵ֣ה כְ֭סִיל כְּ/אִוַּלְתּ֑/וֹ פֶּן יִהְיֶ֖ה חָכָ֣ם בְּ/עֵינָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'nh khsyl kh'vltv pn yhyh chkhm b'ynyv
verses.translation: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own conceit.

verses.original: מְקַצֶּ֣ה רַ֭גְלַיִם חָמָ֣ס שֹׁתֶ֑ה שֹׁלֵ֖חַ דְּבָרִ֣ים בְּ/יַד כְּסִֽיל
verses.translit: mqtsh rglym chms shth shlch dbrym byd khsyl
verses.translation: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, and drinketh damage.

verses.original: דַּלְי֣וּ שֹׁ֭קַיִם מִ/פִּסֵּ֑חַ וּ֝/מָשָׁ֗ל בְּ/פִ֣י כְסִילִֽים
verses.translit: dlyv shqym mpsch vmshl bpy khsylym
verses.translation: The legs of the lame are not equal: so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

verses.original: כִּ/צְר֣וֹר אֶ֭בֶן בְּ/מַרְגֵּמָ֑ה כֵּן נוֹתֵ֖ן לִ/כְסִ֣יל כָּבֽוֹד
verses.translit: khtsrvr 'bn bmrgmh khn nvtn lkhsyl khbvd
verses.translation: As he that bindeth a stone in a sling, so is he that giveth honour to a fool.

verses.original: ח֭וֹחַ עָלָ֣ה בְ/יַד שִׁכּ֑וֹר וּ֝/מָשָׁ֗ל בְּ/פִ֣י כְסִילִֽים
verses.translit: chvch 'lh byd shkhvr vmshl bpy khsylym
verses.translation: As a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

verses.original: רַ֥ב מְחֽוֹלֵֽל כֹּ֑ל וְ/שֹׂכֵ֥ר כְּ֝סִ֗יל וְ/שֹׂכֵ֥ר עֹבְרִֽים
verses.translit: rb mchvll khl vshkhr khsyl vshkhr 'brym
verses.translation: The great God that formed all things both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors.

verses.original: כְּ֭/כֶלֶב שָׁ֣ב עַל קֵא֑/וֹ כְּ֝סִ֗יל שׁוֹנֶ֥ה בְ/אִוַּלְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khkhlb shb 'l q'v khsyl shvnh b'vltv
verses.translation: As a dog returneth to his vomit, so a fool returneth to his folly.

verses.original: רָאִ֗יתָ אִ֭ישׁ חָכָ֣ם בְּ/עֵינָ֑י/ו תִּקְוָ֖ה לִ/כְסִ֣יל מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: r'yt 'ysh chkhm b'ynyv tqvh lkhsyl mmnv
verses.translation: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit? there is more hope of a fool than of him.

verses.original: אָמַ֣ר עָ֭צֵל שַׁ֣חַל בַּ/דָּ֑רֶךְ אֲ֝רִ֗י בֵּ֣ין הָ/רְחֹבֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'mr 'tsl shchl bdrkh 'ry byn hrchbvt
verses.translation: The slothful man saith, There is a lion in the way; a lion is in the streets.

verses.original: הַ֭/דֶּלֶת תִּסּ֣וֹב עַל צִירָ֑/הּ וְ֝/עָצֵ֗ל עַל מִטָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hdlt tsvb 'l tsyrh v'tsl 'l mttv
verses.translation: As the door turneth upon his hinges, so doth the slothful upon his bed.

verses.original: טָ֘מַ֤ן עָצֵ֣ל יָ֭ד/וֹ בַּ/צַּלָּ֑חַת נִ֝לְאָ֗ה לַֽ/הֲשִׁיבָ֥/הּ אֶל פִּֽי/ו
verses.translit: tmn 'tsl ydv btslcht nl'h lhshybh 'l pyv
verses.translation: The slothful hideth his hand in his bosom; it grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth.

verses.original: חָכָ֣ם עָצֵ֣ל בְּ/עֵינָ֑י/ו מִ֝/שִּׁבְעָ֗ה מְשִׁ֣יבֵי טָֽעַם
verses.translit: chkhm 'tsl b'ynyv mshb'h mshyby t'm
verses.translation: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason.

verses.original: מַחֲזִ֥יק בְּ/אָזְנֵי כָ֑לֶב עֹבֵ֥ר מִ֝תְעַבֵּ֗ר עַל רִ֥יב לֹּֽא לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mchzyq b'zny khlb 'br mt'br 'l ryb l' lv
verses.translation: He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.

verses.original: כְּֽ֭/מִתְלַהְלֵהַּ הַ/יֹּרֶ֥ה זִקִּ֗ים חִצִּ֥ים וָ/מָֽוֶת
verses.translit: khmtlhlh hyrh zqym chtsym vmvt
verses.translation: As a mad man who casteth firebrands, arrows, and death,

verses.original: כֵּֽן אִ֭ישׁ רִמָּ֣ה אֶת רֵעֵ֑/הוּ וְ֝/אָמַ֗ר הֲֽ/לֹא מְשַׂחֵ֥ק אָֽנִי
verses.translit: khn 'ysh rmh 't r'hv v'mr hl' mshchq 'ny
verses.translation: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour, and saith, Am not I in sport?

verses.original: בְּ/אֶ֣פֶס עֵ֭צִים תִּכְבֶּה אֵ֑שׁ וּ/בְ/אֵ֥ין נִ֝רְגָּ֗ן יִשְׁתֹּ֥ק מָדֽוֹן
verses.translit: b'ps 'tsym tkhbh 'sh vb'yn nrgn yshtq mdvn
verses.translation: Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.

verses.original: פֶּחָ֣ם לְ֭/גֶחָלִים וְ/עֵצִ֣ים לְ/אֵ֑שׁ וְ/אִ֥ישׁ מדונים מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים לְ/חַרְחַר רִֽיב
verses.translit: pchm lgchlym v'tsym l'sh v'ysh mdvnym mdynym lchrchr ryb
verses.translation: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; so is a contentious man to kindle strife.

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֣י נִ֭רְגָּן כְּ/מִֽתְלַהֲמִ֑ים וְ֝/הֵ֗ם יָרְד֥וּ חַדְרֵי בָֽטֶן
verses.translit: dbry nrgn khmtlhmym vhm yrdv chdry btn
verses.translation: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

verses.original: כֶּ֣סֶף סִ֭יגִים מְצֻפֶּ֣ה עַל חָ֑רֶשׂ שְׂפָתַ֖יִם דֹּלְקִ֣ים וְ/לֶב רָֽע
verses.translit: khsf sygym mtsph 'l chrsh shptym dlqym vlb r'
verses.translation: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross.

verses.original: ב/שפת/ו בִּ֭/שְׂפָתָי/ו יִנָּכֵ֣ר שׂוֹנֵ֑א וּ֝/בְ/קִרְבּ֗/וֹ יָשִׁ֥ית מִרְמָֽה
verses.translit: bshptv bshptyv ynkhr shvn' vbqrbv yshyt mrmh
verses.translation: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, and layeth up deceit within him;

verses.original: כִּֽי יְחַנֵּ֣ן ק֭וֹל/וֹ אַל תַּֽאֲמֶן בּ֑/וֹ כִּ֤י שֶׁ֖בַע תּוֹעֵב֣וֹת בְּ/לִבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy ychnn qvlv 'l t'mn bv khy shb' tv'bvt blbv
verses.translation: When he speaketh fair, believe him not: for there are seven abominations in his heart.

verses.original: תִּכַּסֶּ֣ה שִׂ֭נְאָה בְּ/מַשָּׁא֑וֹן תִּגָּלֶ֖ה רָעָת֣/וֹ בְ/קָהָֽל
verses.translit: tkhsh shn'h bmsh'vn tglh r'tv bqhl
verses.translation: Whose hatred is covered by deceit, his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation.

verses.original: כֹּֽרֶה שַּׁ֭חַת בָּ֣/הּ יִפֹּ֑ל וְ/גֹ֥לֵ֥ל אֶ֝בֶן אֵלָ֥י/ו תָּשֽׁוּב
verses.translit: khrh shcht bh ypl vgll 'bn 'lyv tshvb
verses.translation: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein: and he that rolleth a stone, it will return upon him.

verses.original: לְֽשׁוֹן שֶׁ֭קֶר יִשְׂנָ֣א דַכָּ֑י/ו וּ/פֶ֥ה חָ֝לָ֗ק יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה מִדְחֶֽה
verses.translit: lshvn shqr yshn' dkhyv vph chlq y'shh mdchh
verses.translation: A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin.

verses.original: אַֽל תִּ֭תְהַלֵּל בְּ/י֣וֹם מָחָ֑ר כִּ֤י לֹא תֵ֝דַ֗ע מַה יֵּ֥לֶד יֽוֹם
verses.translit: 'l tthll byvm mchr khy l' td' mh yld yvm
verses.translation: Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.

verses.original: יְהַלֶּלְ/ךָ֣ זָ֣ר וְ/לֹא פִ֑י/ךָ נָ֝כְרִ֗י וְ/אַל שְׂפָתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: yhllkh zr vl' pykh nkhry v'l shptykh
verses.translation: Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; a stranger, and not thine own lips.

verses.original: כֹּֽבֶד אֶ֭בֶן וְ/נֵ֣טֶל הַ/ח֑וֹל וְ/כַ֥עַס אֱ֝וִ֗יל כָּבֵ֥ד מִ/שְּׁנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khbd 'bn vntl hchvl vkh's 'vyl khbd mshnyhm
verses.translation: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool’s wrath is heavier than them both.

verses.original: אַכְזְרִיּ֣וּת חֵ֭מָה וְ/שֶׁ֣טֶף אָ֑ף וּ/מִ֥י יַ֝עֲמֹד לִ/פְנֵ֥י קִנְאָֽה
verses.translit: 'khzryvt chmh vshtf 'f vmy y'md lpny qn'h
verses.translation: Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy?

verses.original: ט֭וֹבָה תּוֹכַ֣חַת מְגֻלָּ֑ה מֵֽ/אַהֲבָ֥ה מְסֻתָּֽרֶת
verses.translit: tvbh tvkhcht mglh m'hbh mstrt
verses.translation: Open rebuke is better than secret love.

verses.original: נֶ֭אֱמָנִים פִּצְעֵ֣י אוֹהֵ֑ב וְ֝/נַעְתָּר֗וֹת נְשִׁיק֥וֹת שׂוֹנֵֽא
verses.translit: n'mnym pts'y 'vhb vn'trvt nshyqvt shvn'
verses.translation: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.

verses.original: נֶ֣פֶשׁ שְׂ֭בֵעָה תָּב֣וּס נֹ֑פֶת וְ/נֶ֥פֶשׁ רְ֝עֵבָ֗ה כָּל מַ֥ר מָתֽוֹק
verses.translit: npsh shb'h tbvs npt vnpsh r'bh khl mr mtvq
verses.translation: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.

verses.original: כְּ֭/צִפּוֹר נוֹדֶ֣דֶת מִן קִנָּ֑/הּ כֵּֽן אִ֝֗ישׁ נוֹדֵ֥ד מִ/מְּקוֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khtspvr nvddt mn qnh khn 'ysh nvdd mmqvmv
verses.translation: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth from his place.

verses.original: שֶׁ֣מֶן וּ֭/קְטֹרֶת יְשַׂמַּֽח לֵ֑ב וּ/מֶ֥תֶק רֵ֝עֵ֗/הוּ מֵֽ/עֲצַת נָֽפֶשׁ
verses.translit: shmn vqtrt yshmch lb vmtq r'hv m'tst npsh
verses.translation: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man’s friend by hearty counsel.

verses.original: רֵֽעֲ/ךָ֨ ו/רעה וְ/רֵ֪עַ אָבִ֡י/ךָ אַֽל תַּעֲזֹ֗ב וּ/בֵ֥ית אָחִ֗י/ךָ אַל תָּ֭בוֹא בְּ/י֣וֹם אֵידֶ֑/ךָ ט֥וֹב שָׁכֵ֥ן קָ֝ר֗וֹב מֵ/אָ֥ח רָחֽוֹק
verses.translit: r'kh vr'h vr' 'bykh 'l t'zb vbyt 'chykh 'l tbv' byvm 'ydkh tvb shkhn qrvb m'ch rchvq
verses.translation: Thine own friend, and thy father’s friend, forsake not; neither go into thy brother’s house in the day of thy calamity: for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.

verses.original: חֲכַ֣ם בְּ֭נִ/י וְ/שַׂמַּ֣ח לִבִּ֑/י וְ/אָשִׁ֖יבָה חֹרְפִ֣/י דָבָֽר
verses.translit: chkhm bny vshmch lby v'shybh chrpy dbr
verses.translation: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that reproacheth me.

verses.original: עָר֤וּם רָאָ֣ה רָעָ֣ה נִסְתָּ֑ר פְּ֝תָאיִ֗ם עָבְר֥וּ נֶעֱנָֽשׁוּ
verses.translit: 'rvm r'h r'h nstr pt'ym 'brv n'nshv
verses.translation: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself; but the simple pass on, and are punished.

verses.original: קַח בִּ֭גְד/וֹ כִּי עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וּ/בְעַ֖ד נָכְרִיָּ֣ה חַבְלֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: qch bgdv khy 'rb zr vb'd nkhryh chblhv
verses.translation: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.

verses.original: מְבָ֘רֵ֤ךְ רֵעֵ֨/הוּ בְּ/ק֣וֹל גָּ֭דוֹל בַּ/בֹּ֣קֶר הַשְׁכֵּ֑ים קְ֝לָלָ֗ה תֵּחָ֥שֶׁב לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mbrkh r'hv bqvl gdvl bbqr hshkhym qllh tchshb lv
verses.translation: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse to him.

verses.original: דֶּ֣לֶף ט֭וֹרֵד בְּ/י֣וֹם סַגְרִ֑יר וְ/אֵ֥שֶׁת מדונים מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים נִשְׁתָּוָֽה
verses.translit: dlf tvrd byvm sgryr v'sht mdvnym mdynym nshtvh
verses.translation: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.

verses.original: צֹפְנֶ֥י/הָ צָֽפַן ר֑וּחַ וְ/שֶׁ֖מֶן יְמִינ֣/וֹ יִקְרָֽא
verses.translit: tspnyh tspn rvch vshmn ymynv yqr'
verses.translation: Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind, and the ointment of his right hand, which bewrayeth itself .

verses.original: בַּרְזֶ֣ל בְּ/בַרְזֶ֣ל יָ֑חַד וְ֝/אִ֗ישׁ יַ֣חַד פְּנֵֽי רֵעֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: brzl bbrzl ychd v'ysh ychd pny r'hv
verses.translation: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

verses.original: נֹצֵ֣ר תְּ֭אֵנָה יֹאכַ֣ל פִּרְיָ֑/הּ וְ/שֹׁמֵ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י/ו יְכֻבָּֽד
verses.translit: ntsr t'nh y'khl pryh vshmr 'dnyv ykhbd
verses.translation: Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured.

verses.original: כַּ֭/מַּיִם הַ/פָּנִ֣ים לַ/פָּנִ֑ים כֵּ֤ן לֵֽב הָ֝/אָדָ֗ם לָ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: khmym hpnym lpnym khn lb h'dm l'dm
verses.translation: As in water face answereth to face, so the heart of man to man.

verses.original: שְׁא֣וֹל ו/אבדה וַ֭/אֲבַדּוֹ לֹ֣א תִשְׂבַּ֑עְנָה וְ/עֵינֵ֥י הָ֝/אָדָ֗ם לֹ֣א תִשְׂבַּֽעְנָה
verses.translit: sh'vl v'bdh v'bdv l' tshb'nh v'yny h'dm l' tshb'nh
verses.translation: Hell and destruction are never full; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.

verses.original: מַצְרֵ֣ף לַ֭/כֶּסֶף וְ/כ֣וּר לַ/זָּהָ֑ב וְ֝/אִ֗ישׁ לְ/פִ֣י מַהֲלָלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mtsrf lkhsf vkhvr lzhb v'ysh lpy mhllv
verses.translation: As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so is a man to his praise.

verses.original: אִ֥ם תִּכְתּֽוֹשׁ אֶת הָ/אֱוִ֨יל בַּֽ/מַּכְתֵּ֡שׁ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הָ֭/רִיפוֹת בַּֽ/עֱלִ֑י לֹא תָס֥וּר מֵ֝/עָלָ֗י/ו אִוַּלְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'm tkhtvsh 't h'vyl bmkhtsh btvkh hrypvt b'ly l' tsvr m'lyv 'vltv
verses.translation: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.

verses.original: יָדֹ֣עַ תֵּ֭דַע פְּנֵ֣י צֹאנֶ֑/ךָ שִׁ֥ית לִ֝בְּ/ךָ֗ לַ/עֲדָרִֽים
verses.translit: yd' td' pny ts'nkh shyt lbkh l'drym
verses.translation: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חֹ֑סֶן וְ/אִם נֵ֝֗זֶר לְ/ד֣וֹר דור וָ/דֽוֹר
verses.translit: khy l' l'vlm chsn v'm nzr ldvr dvr vdvr
verses.translation: For riches are not for ever: and doth the crown endure to every generation?

verses.original: גָּלָ֣ה חָ֭צִיר וְ/נִרְאָה דֶ֑שֶׁא וְ֝/נֶאֶסְפ֗וּ עִשְּׂב֥וֹת הָרִֽים
verses.translit: glh chtsyr vnr'h dsh' vn'spv 'shbvt hrym
verses.translation: The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.

verses.original: כְּבָשִׂ֥ים לִ/לְבוּשֶׁ֑/ךָ וּ/מְחִ֥יר שָׂ֝דֶ֗ה עַתּוּדִֽים
verses.translit: khbshym llbvshkh vmchyr shdh 'tvdym
verses.translation: The lambs are for thy clothing, and the goats are the price of the field.

verses.original: וְ/דֵ֤י חֲלֵ֬ב עִזִּ֗ים לְֽ֭/לַחְמְ/ךָ לְ/לֶ֣חֶם בֵּיתֶ֑/ךָ וְ֝/חַיִּ֗ים לְ/נַעֲרוֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vdy chlb 'zym llchmkh llchm bytkh vchyym ln'rvtykh
verses.translation: And thou shalt have goats’ milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household, and for the maintenance for thy maidens.

verses.original: נָ֣סוּ וְ/אֵין רֹדֵ֣ף רָשָׁ֑ע וְ֝/צַדִּיקִ֗ים כִּ/כְפִ֥יר יִבְטָֽח
verses.translit: nsv v'yn rdf rsh' vtsdyqym khkhpyr ybtch
verses.translation: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.

verses.original: בְּ/פֶ֣שַֽׁע אֶ֭רֶץ רַבִּ֣ים שָׂרֶ֑י/הָ וּ/בְ/אָדָ֥ם מֵבִ֥ין יֹ֝דֵ֗עַ כֵּ֣ן יַאֲרִֽיךְ
verses.translit: bpsh' 'rts rbym shryh vb'dm mbyn yd' khn y'rykh
verses.translation: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.

verses.original: גֶּ֣בֶר רָ֭שׁ וְ/עֹשֵׁ֣ק דַּלִּ֑ים מָטָ֥ר סֹ֝חֵ֗ף וְ/אֵ֣ין לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: gbr rsh v'shq dlym mtr schf v'yn lchm
verses.translation: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.

verses.original: עֹזְבֵ֣י ת֭וֹרָה יְהַֽלְל֣וּ רָשָׁ֑ע וְ/שֹׁמְרֵ֥י ת֝וֹרָ֗ה יִתְגָּ֥רוּ בָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'zby tvrh yhllv rsh' vshmry tvrh ytgrv bm
verses.translation: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁי רָ֭ע לֹא יָבִ֣ינוּ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ/מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה יָבִ֥ינוּ כֹֽל
verses.translit: 'nshy r' l' ybynv mshpt vmbqshy yhvh ybynv khl
verses.translation: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the LORD understand all things .

verses.original: טֽוֹב רָ֭שׁ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ בְּ/תֻמּ֑/וֹ מֵ/עִקֵּ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכַ֗יִם וְ/ה֣וּא עָשִֽׁיר
verses.translit: tvb rsh hvlkh btmv m'qsh drkhym vhv' 'shyr
verses.translation: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.

verses.original: נוֹצֵ֣ר תּ֭וֹרָה בֵּ֣ן מֵבִ֑ין וְ/רֹעֶה זֽ֝וֹלְלִ֗ים יַכְלִ֥ים אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: nvtsr tvrh bn mbyn vr'h zvllym ykhlym 'byv
verses.translation: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.

verses.original: מַרְבֶּ֣ה ה֭וֹנ/וֹ בְּ/נֶ֣שֶׁךְ ו/ב/תרבית וְ/תַרְבִּ֑ית לְ/חוֹנֵ֖ן דַּלִּ֣ים יִקְבְּצֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: mrbh hvnv bnshkh vbtrbyt vtrbyt lchvnn dlym yqbtsnv
verses.translation: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.

verses.original: מֵסִ֣יר אָ֭זְנ/וֹ מִ/שְּׁמֹ֣עַ תּוֹרָ֑ה גַּֽם תְּ֝פִלָּת֗/וֹ תּוֹעֵבָֽה
verses.translit: msyr 'znv mshm' tvrh gm tpltv tv'bh
verses.translation: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.

verses.original: מַשְׁגֶּ֤ה יְשָׁרִ֨ים בְּ/דֶ֥רֶךְ רָ֗ע בִּ/שְׁחוּת֥/וֹ הֽוּא יִפּ֑וֹל וּ֝/תְמִימִ֗ים יִנְחֲלוּ טֽוֹב
verses.translit: mshgh yshrym bdrkh r' bshchvtv hv' ypvl vtmymym ynchlv tvb
verses.translation: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.

verses.original: חָכָ֣ם בְּ֭/עֵינָי/ו אִ֣ישׁ עָשִׁ֑יר וְ/דַ֖ל מֵבִ֣ין יַחְקְרֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: chkhm b'ynyv 'ysh 'shyr vdl mbyn ychqrnv
verses.translation: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.

verses.original: בַּ/עֲלֹ֣ץ צַ֭דִּיקִים רַבָּ֣ה תִפְאָ֑רֶת וּ/בְ/ק֥וּם רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יְחֻפַּ֥שׂ אָדָֽם
verses.translit: b'lts tsdyqym rbh tp'rt vbqvm rsh'ym ychpsh 'dm
verses.translation: When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.

verses.original: מְכַסֶּ֣ה פְ֭שָׁעָי/ו לֹ֣א יַצְלִ֑יחַ וּ/מוֹדֶ֖ה וְ/עֹזֵ֣ב יְרֻחָֽם
verses.translit: mkhsh psh'yv l' ytslych vmvdh v'zb yrchm
verses.translation: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י אָ֭דָם מְפַחֵ֣ד תָּמִ֑יד וּ/מַקְשֶׁ֥ה לִ֝בּ֗/וֹ יִפּ֥וֹל בְּ/רָעָֽה
verses.translit: 'shry 'dm mpchd tmyd vmqshh lbv ypvl br'h
verses.translation: Happy is the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.

verses.original: אֲרִי נֹ֭הֵם וְ/דֹ֣ב שׁוֹקֵ֑ק מֹשֵׁ֥ל רָ֝שָׁ֗ע עַ֣ל עַם דָּֽל
verses.translit: 'ry nhm vdb shvqq mshl rsh' 'l 'm dl
verses.translation: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.

verses.original: נָגִ֗יד חֲסַ֣ר תְּ֭בוּנוֹת וְ/רַ֥ב מַעֲשַׁקּ֑וֹת שנאי שֹׂ֥נֵא בֶ֝֗צַע יַאֲרִ֥יךְ יָמִֽים
verses.translit: ngyd chsr tbvnvt vrb m'shqvt shn'y shn' bts' y'rykh ymym
verses.translation: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.

verses.original: אָ֭דָם עָשֻׁ֣ק בְּ/דַם נָפֶשׁ עַד בּ֥וֹר יָ֝נ֗וּס אַל יִתְמְכוּ בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'dm 'shq bdm npsh 'd bvr ynvs 'l ytmkhv bv
verses.translation: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.

verses.original: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ תָּ֭מִים יִוָּשֵׁ֑עַ וְ/נֶעְקַ֥שׁ דְּ֝רָכַ֗יִם יִפּ֥וֹל בְּ/אֶחָֽת
verses.translit: hvlkh tmym yvsh' vn'qsh drkhym ypvl b'cht
verses.translation: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.

verses.original: עֹבֵ֣ד אַ֭דְמָת/וֹ יִֽשְׂבַּֽע לָ֑חֶם וּ/מְרַדֵּ֥ף רֵ֝קִ֗ים יִֽשְׂבַּֽע רִֽישׁ
verses.translit: 'bd 'dmtv yshb' lchm vmrdf rqym yshb' rysh
verses.translation: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ אֱ֭מוּנוֹת רַב בְּרָכ֑וֹת וְ/אָ֥ץ לְ֝/הַעֲשִׁ֗יר לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה
verses.translit: 'ysh 'mvnvt rb brkhvt v'ts lh'shyr l' ynqh
verses.translation: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.

verses.original: הַֽכֵּר פָּנִ֥ים לֹא ט֑וֹב וְ/עַל פַּת לֶ֝֗חֶם יִפְשַׁע גָּֽבֶר
verses.translit: hkhr pnym l' tvb v'l pt lchm ypsh' gbr
verses.translation: To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.

verses.original: נִֽבֳהָ֥ל לַ/ה֗וֹן אִ֭ישׁ רַ֣ע עָ֑יִן וְ/לֹֽא יֵ֝דַע כִּי חֶ֥סֶר יְבֹאֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: nbhl lhvn 'ysh r' 'yn vl' yd' khy chsr yb'nv
verses.translation: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.

verses.original: מ֘וֹכִ֤יחַ אָדָ֣ם אַ֭חֲרַי חֵ֣ן יִמְצָ֑א מִֽ/מַּחֲלִ֥יק לָשֽׁוֹן
verses.translit: mvkhych 'dm 'chry chn ymts' mmchlyq lshvn
verses.translation: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.

verses.original: גּוֹזֵ֤ל אָ֘בִ֤י/ו וְ/אִמּ֗/וֹ וְ/אֹמֵ֥ר אֵֽין פָּ֑שַׁע חָבֵ֥ר ה֝֗וּא לְ/אִ֣ישׁ מַשְׁחִֽית
verses.translit: gvzl 'byv v'mv v'mr 'yn psh' chbr hv' l'ysh mshchyt
verses.translation: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, It is no transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer.

verses.original: רְחַב נֶ֭פֶשׁ יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וּ/בוֹטֵ֖חַ עַל יְהוָ֣ה יְדֻשָּֽׁן
verses.translit: rchb npsh ygrh mdvn vbvtch 'l yhvh ydshn
verses.translation: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in the LORD shall be made fat.

verses.original: בּוֹטֵ֣חַ בְּ֭/לִבּ/וֹ ה֣וּא כְסִ֑יל וְ/הוֹלֵ֥ךְ בְּ֝/חָכְמָ֗ה ה֣וּא יִמָּלֵֽט
verses.translit: bvtch blbv hv' khsyl vhvlkh bchkhmh hv' ymlt
verses.translation: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.

verses.original: נוֹתֵ֣ן לָ֭/רָשׁ אֵ֣ין מַחְס֑וֹר וּ/מַעְלִ֥ים עֵ֝ינָ֗י/ו רַב מְאֵרֽוֹת
verses.translit: nvtn lrsh 'yn mchsvr vm'lym 'ynyv rb m'rvt
verses.translation: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.

verses.original: בְּ/ק֣וּם רְ֭שָׁעִים יִסָּתֵ֣ר אָדָ֑ם וּ֝/בְ/אָבְדָ֗/ם יִרְבּ֥וּ צַדִּיקִֽים
verses.translit: bqvm rsh'ym ystr 'dm vb'bdm yrbv tsdyqym
verses.translation: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ תּ֭וֹכָחוֹת מַקְשֶׁה עֹ֑רֶף פֶּ֥תַע יִ֝שָּׁבֵ֗ר וְ/אֵ֣ין מַרְפֵּֽא
verses.translit: 'ysh tvkhchvt mqshh 'rf pt' yshbr v'yn mrp'
verses.translation: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.

verses.original: בִּ/רְב֣וֹת צַ֭דִּיקִים יִשְׂמַ֣ח הָ/עָ֑ם וּ/בִ/מְשֹׁ֥ל רָ֝שָׁ֗ע יֵאָ֥נַֽח עָֽם
verses.translit: brbvt tsdyqym yshmch h'm vbmshl rsh' y'nch 'm
verses.translation: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.

verses.original: אִֽישׁ אֹהֵ֣ב חָ֭כְמָה יְשַׂמַּ֣ח אָבִ֑י/ו וְ/רֹעֶ֥ה ז֝וֹנ֗וֹת יְאַבֶּד הֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'ysh 'hb chkhmh yshmch 'byv vr'h zvnvt y'bd hvn
verses.translation: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father: but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance.

verses.original: מֶ֗לֶךְ בְּ֭/מִשְׁפָּט יַעֲמִ֣יד אָ֑רֶץ וְ/אִ֖ישׁ תְּרוּמ֣וֹת יֶֽהֶרְסֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: mlkh bmshpt y'myd 'rts v'ysh trvmvt yhrsnh
verses.translation: The king by judgment establisheth the land: but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it.

verses.original: גֶּ֭בֶר מַחֲלִ֣יק עַל רֵעֵ֑/הוּ רֶ֝֗שֶׁת פּוֹרֵ֥שׂ עַל פְּעָמָֽי/ו
verses.translit: gbr mchlyq 'l r'hv rsht pvrsh 'l p'myv
verses.translation: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet.

verses.original: בְּ/פֶ֤שַֽׁע אִ֣ישׁ רָ֣ע מוֹקֵ֑שׁ וְ֝/צַדִּ֗יק יָר֥וּן וְ/שָׂמֵֽחַ
verses.translit: bpsh' 'ysh r' mvqsh vtsdyq yrvn vshmch
verses.translation: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.

verses.original: יֹדֵ֣עַ צַ֭דִּיק דִּ֣ין דַּלִּ֑ים רָ֝שָׁ֗ע לֹא יָבִ֥ין דָּֽעַת
verses.translit: yd' tsdyq dyn dlym rsh' l' ybyn d't
verses.translation: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regardeth not to know it .

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י לָ֭צוֹן יָפִ֣יחוּ קִרְיָ֑ה וַ֝/חֲכָמִ֗ים יָשִׁ֥יבוּ אָֽף
verses.translit: 'nshy ltsvn ypychv qryh vchkhmym yshybv 'f
verses.translation: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.

verses.original: אִֽישׁ חָכָ֗ם נִ֭שְׁפָּט אֶת אִ֣ישׁ אֱוִ֑יל וְ/רָגַ֥ז וְ֝/שָׂחַ֗ק וְ/אֵ֣ין נָֽחַת
verses.translit: 'ysh chkhm nshpt 't 'ysh 'vyl vrgz vshchq v'yn ncht
verses.translation: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י דָ֭מִים יִשְׂנְאוּ תָ֑ם וִֽ֝/ישָׁרִ֗ים יְבַקְשׁ֥וּ נַפְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'nshy dmym yshn'v tm vyshrym ybqshv npshv
verses.translation: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.

verses.original: כָּל ר֭וּח/וֹ יוֹצִ֣יא כְסִ֑יל וְ֝/חָכָ֗ם בְּ/אָח֥וֹר יְשַׁבְּחֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: khl rvchv yvtsy' khsyl vchkhm b'chvr yshbchnh
verses.translation: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.

verses.original: מֹ֭שֵׁל מַקְשִׁ֣יב עַל דְּבַר שָׁ֑קֶר כָּֽל מְשָׁרְתָ֥י/ו רְשָׁעִֽים
verses.translit: mshl mqshyb 'l dbr shqr khl mshrtyv rsh'ym
verses.translation: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.

verses.original: רָ֤שׁ וְ/אִ֣ישׁ תְּכָכִ֣ים נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ מֵ֤אִיר עֵינֵ֖י שְׁנֵי/הֶ֣ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: rsh v'ysh tkhkhym npgshv m'yr 'yny shnyhm yhvh
verses.translation: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: the LORD lighteneth both their eyes.

verses.original: מֶ֤לֶךְ שׁוֹפֵ֣ט בֶּֽ/אֱמֶ֣ת דַּלִּ֑ים כִּ֝סְא֗/וֹ לָ/עַ֥ד יִכּֽוֹן
verses.translit: mlkh shvpt b'mt dlym khs'v l'd ykhvn
verses.translation: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.

verses.original: שֵׁ֣בֶט וְ֭/תוֹכַחַת יִתֵּ֣ן חָכְמָ֑ה וְ/נַ֥עַר מְ֝שֻׁלָּ֗ח מֵבִ֥ישׁ אִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: shbt vtvkhcht ytn chkhmh vn'r mshlch mbysh 'mv
verses.translation: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.

verses.original: בִּ/רְב֣וֹת רְ֭שָׁעִים יִרְבֶּה פָּ֑שַׁע וְ֝/צַדִּיקִ֗ים בְּֽ/מַפַּלְתָּ֥/ם יִרְאֽוּ
verses.translit: brbvt rsh'ym yrbh psh' vtsdyqym bmpltm yr'v
verses.translation: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous shall see their fall.

verses.original: יַסֵּ֣ר בִּ֭נְ/ךָ וִֽ/ינִיחֶ֑/ךָ וְ/יִתֵּ֖ן מַעֲדַנִּ֣ים לְ/נַפְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: ysr bnkh vynychkh vytn m'dnym lnpshkh
verses.translation: Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.

verses.original: בְּ/אֵ֣ין חָ֭זוֹן יִפָּ֣רַֽע עָ֑ם וְ/שֹׁמֵ֖ר תּוֹרָ֣ה אַשְׁרֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: b'yn chzvn ypr' 'm vshmr tvrh 'shrhv
verses.translation: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.

verses.original: בִּ֭/דְבָרִים לֹא יִוָּ֣סֶר עָ֑בֶד כִּֽי יָ֝בִ֗ין וְ/אֵ֣ין מַעֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: bdbrym l' yvsr 'bd khy ybyn v'yn m'nh
verses.translation: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.

verses.original: חָזִ֗יתָ אִ֭ישׁ אָ֣ץ בִּ/דְבָרָ֑י/ו תִּקְוָ֖ה לִ/כְסִ֣יל מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: chzyt 'ysh 'ts bdbryv tqvh lkhsyl mmnv
verses.translation: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.

verses.original: מְפַנֵּ֣ק מִ/נֹּ֣עַר עַבְדּ֑/וֹ וְ֝/אַחֲרִית֗/וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה מָנֽוֹן
verses.translit: mpnq mn'r 'bdv v'chrytv yhyh mnvn
verses.translation: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.

verses.original: אִֽישׁ אַ֭ף יְגָרֶ֣ה מָד֑וֹן וּ/בַ֖עַל חֵמָ֣ה רַב פָּֽשַׁע
verses.translit: 'ysh 'f ygrh mdvn vb'l chmh rb psh'
verses.translation: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.

verses.original: גַּאֲוַ֣ת אָ֭דָם תַּשְׁפִּילֶ֑/נּוּ וּ/שְׁפַל ר֝֗וּחַ יִתְמֹ֥ךְ כָּבֽוֹד
verses.translit: g'vt 'dm tshpylnv vshpl rvch ytmkh khbvd
verses.translation: A man’s pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.

verses.original: חוֹלֵ֣ק עִם גַּ֭נָּב שׂוֹנֵ֣א נַפְשׁ֑/וֹ אָלָ֥ה יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע וְ/לֹ֣א יַגִּֽיד
verses.translit: chvlq 'm gnb shvn' npshv 'lh yshm' vl' ygyd
verses.translation: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth it not.

verses.original: חֶרְדַּ֣ת אָ֭דָם יִתֵּ֣ן מוֹקֵ֑שׁ וּ/בוֹטֵ֖חַ בַּ/יהוָ֣ה יְשֻׂגָּֽב
verses.translit: chrdt 'dm ytn mvqsh vbvtch byhvh yshgb
verses.translation: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.

verses.original: רַ֭בִּים מְבַקְשִׁ֣ים פְּנֵי מוֹשֵׁ֑ל וּ֝/מֵ/יְהוָ֗ה מִשְׁפַּט אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: rbym mbqshym pny mvshl vmyhvh mshpt 'ysh
verses.translation: Many seek the ruler’s favour; but every man’s judgment cometh from the LORD .

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת צַ֭דִּיקִים אִ֣ישׁ עָ֑וֶל וְ/תוֹעֲבַ֖ת רָשָׁ֣ע יְשַׁר דָּֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: tv'bt tsdyqym 'ysh 'vl vtv'bt rsh' yshr drkh
verses.translation: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֤י אָג֥וּר בִּן יָקֶ֗ה הַ/מַּ֫שָּׂ֥א נְאֻ֣ם הַ֭/גֶּבֶר לְ/אִֽיתִיאֵ֑ל לְ/אִ֖יתִיאֵ֣ל וְ/אֻכָֽל
verses.translit: dbry 'gvr bn yqh hmsh' n'm hgbr l'yty'l l'yty'l v'khl
verses.translation: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,

verses.original: כִּ֤י בַ֣עַר אָנֹכִ֣י מֵ/אִ֑ישׁ וְ/לֹֽא בִינַ֖ת אָדָ֣ם לִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy b'r 'nkhy m'ysh vl' bynt 'dm ly
verses.translation: Surely I am more brutish than any man, and have not the understanding of a man.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא לָמַ֥דְתִּי חָכְמָ֑ה וְ/דַ֖עַת קְדֹשִׁ֣ים אֵדָֽע
verses.translit: vl' lmdty chkhmh vd't qdshym 'd'
verses.translation: I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy.

verses.original: מִ֤י עָלָֽה שָׁמַ֨יִם וַ/יֵּרַ֡ד מִ֤י אָֽסַף ר֨וּחַ בְּ/חָפְנָ֡י/ו מִ֤י צָֽרַר מַ֨יִם בַּ/שִּׂמְלָ֗ה מִ֭י הֵקִ֣ים כָּל אַפְסֵי אָ֑רֶץ מַה שְּׁמ֥/וֹ וּ/מַֽה שֶּׁם בְּ֝נ֗/וֹ כִּ֣י תֵדָֽע
verses.translit: my 'lh shmym vyrd my 'sf rvch bchpnyv my tsrr mym bshmlh my hqym khl 'psy 'rts mh shmv vmh shm bnv khy td'
verses.translation: Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended? who hath gathered the wind in his fists? who hath bound the waters in a garment? who hath established all the ends of the earth? what is his name, and what is his son’s name, if thou canst tell?

verses.original: כָּל אִמְרַ֣ת אֱל֣וֹהַּ צְרוּפָ֑ה מָגֵ֥ן ה֝֗וּא לַֽ/חֹסִ֥ים בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khl 'mrt 'lvh tsrvph mgn hv' lchsym bv
verses.translation: Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.

verses.original: אַל תּ֥וֹסְףְּ עַל דְּבָרָ֑י/ו פֶּן יוֹכִ֖יחַ בְּ/ךָ֣ וְ/נִכְזָֽבְתָּ
verses.translit: 'l tvsf 'l dbryv pn yvkhych bkh vnkhzbt
verses.translation: Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.

verses.original: שְׁ֭תַּיִם שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵ/אִתָּ֑/ךְ אַל תִּמְנַ֥ע מִ֝מֶּ֗/נִּי בְּ/טֶ֣רֶם אָמֽוּת
verses.translit: shtym sh'lty m'tkh 'l tmn' mmny btrm 'mvt
verses.translation: Two things have I required of thee; deny me them not before I die:

verses.original: שָׁ֤וְא וּֽ/דְבַר כָּזָ֡ב הַרְחֵ֬ק מִמֶּ֗/נִּי רֵ֣אשׁ וָ֭/עֹשֶׁר אַל תִּֽתֶּן לִ֑/י הַ֝טְרִיפֵ֗/נִי לֶ֣חֶם חֻקִּֽ/י
verses.translit: shv' vdbr khzb hrchq mmny r'sh v'shr 'l ttn ly htrypny lchm chqy
verses.translation: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:

verses.original: פֶּ֥ן אֶשְׂבַּ֨ע וְ/כִחַשְׁתִּי֮ וְ/אָמַ֗רְתִּי מִ֥י יְה֫וָ֥ה וּ/פֶֽן אִוָּרֵ֥שׁ וְ/גָנַ֑בְתִּי וְ֝/תָפַ֗שְׂתִּי שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: pn 'shb' vkhchshty v'mrty my yhvh vpn 'vrsh vgnbty vtpshty shm 'lhy
verses.translation: Lest I be full, and deny thee , and say, Who is the LORD ? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my God in vain .

verses.original: אַל תַּלְשֵׁ֣ן עֶ֭בֶד אֶל אדנ/ו אֲדֹנָ֑י/ו פֶּֽן יְקַלֶּלְ/ךָ֥ וְ/אָשָֽׁמְתָּ
verses.translit: 'l tlshn 'bd 'l 'dnv 'dnyv pn yqllkh v'shmt
verses.translation: Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.

verses.original: דּ֭וֹר אָבִ֣י/ו יְקַלֵּ֑ל וְ/אֶת אִ֝מּ֗/וֹ לֹ֣א יְבָרֵֽךְ
verses.translit: dvr 'byv yqll v't 'mv l' ybrkh
verses.translation: There is a generation that curseth their father, and doth not bless their mother.

verses.original: דּ֭וֹר טָה֣וֹר בְּ/עֵינָ֑י/ו וּ֝/מִ/צֹּאָת֗/וֹ לֹ֣א רֻחָֽץ
verses.translit: dvr thvr b'ynyv vmts'tv l' rchts
verses.translation: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet is not washed from their filthiness.

verses.original: דּ֭וֹר מָה רָמ֣וּ עֵינָ֑י/ו וְ֝/עַפְעַפָּ֗י/ו יִנָּשֵֽׂאוּ
verses.translit: dvr mh rmv 'ynyv v'p'pyv ynsh'v
verses.translation: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.

verses.original: דּ֤וֹר חֲרָב֣וֹת שִׁנָּי/ו֮ וּֽ/מַאֲכָל֪וֹת מְֽתַלְּעֹ֫תָ֥י/ו לֶ/אֱכֹ֣ל עֲנִיִּ֣ים מֵ/אֶ֑רֶץ וְ֝/אֶבְיוֹנִ֗ים מֵ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: dvr chrbvt shnyv vm'khlvt mtl'tyv l'khl 'nyym m'rts v'byvnym m'dm
verses.translation: There is a generation, whose teeth are as swords, and their jaw teeth as knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.

verses.original: לַֽ/עֲלוּקָ֨ה שְׁתֵּ֥י בָנוֹת֮ הַ֤ב הַ֥ב שָׁל֣וֹשׁ הֵ֭נָּה לֹ֣א תִשְׂבַּ֑עְנָה אַ֝רְבַּ֗ע לֹא אָ֥מְרוּ הֽוֹן
verses.translit: l'lvqh shty bnvt hb hb shlvsh hnh l' tshb'nh 'rb' l' 'mrv hvn
verses.translation: The horseleach hath two daughters, crying , Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, yea , four things say not, It is enough:

verses.original: שְׁאוֹל֮ וְ/עֹ֪צֶ֫ר רָ֥חַם אֶ֭רֶץ לֹא שָׂ֣בְעָה מַּ֑יִם וְ֝/אֵ֗שׁ לֹא אָ֥מְרָה הֽוֹן
verses.translit: sh'vl v'tsr rchm 'rts l' shb'h mym v'sh l' 'mrh hvn
verses.translation: The grave; and the barren womb; the earth that is not filled with water; and the fire that saith not, It is enough.

verses.original: עַ֤יִן תִּֽלְעַ֣ג לְ/אָב֮ וְ/תָב֪וּז לִֽ/יקֲּהַ֫ת אֵ֥ם יִקְּר֥וּ/הָ עֹרְבֵי נַ֑חַל וְֽ/יֹאכְל֥וּ/הָ בְנֵי נָֽשֶׁר
verses.translit: 'yn tl'g l'b vtbvz lyqht 'm yqrvh 'rby nchl vy'khlvh bny nshr
verses.translation: The eye that mocketh at his father, and despiseth to obey his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.

verses.original: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה הֵ֭מָּה נִפְלְא֣וּ מִמֶּ֑/נִּי ו/ארבע וְ֝/אַרְבָּעָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְדַעְתִּֽי/ם
verses.translit: shlshh hmh npl'v mmny v'rb' v'rb'h l' yd'tym
verses.translation: There be three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:

verses.original: דֶּ֤רֶךְ הַ/נֶּ֨שֶׁר בַּ/שָּׁמַיִם֮ דֶּ֥רֶךְ נָחָ֗שׁ עֲלֵ֫י צ֥וּר דֶּֽרֶךְ אֳנִיָּ֥ה בְ/לֶב יָ֑ם וְ/דֶ֖רֶךְ גֶּ֣בֶר בְּ/עַלְמָֽה
verses.translit: drkh hnshr bshmym drkh nchsh 'ly tsvr drkh 'nyh blb ym vdrkh gbr b'lmh
verses.translation: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maid.

verses.original: כֵּ֤ן דֶּ֥רֶךְ אִשָּׁ֗ה מְנָ֫אָ֥פֶת אָ֭כְלָה וּ/מָ֣חֲתָה פִ֑י/הָ וְ֝/אָמְרָ֗ה לֹֽא פָעַ֥לְתִּי אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: khn drkh 'shh mn'pt 'khlh vmchth pyh v'mrh l' p'lty 'vn
verses.translation: Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.

verses.original: תַּ֣חַת שָׁ֭לוֹשׁ רָ֣גְזָה אֶ֑רֶץ וְ/תַ֥חַת אַ֝רְבַּ֗ע לֹא תוּכַ֥ל שְׂאֵֽת
verses.translit: tcht shlvsh rgzh 'rts vtcht 'rb' l' tvkhl sh't
verses.translation: For three things the earth is disquieted, and for four which it cannot bear:

verses.original: תַּֽחַת עֶ֭בֶד כִּ֣י יִמְל֑וֹךְ וְ֝/נָבָ֗ל כִּ֣י יִֽשְׂבַּֽע לָֽחֶם
verses.translit: tcht 'bd khy ymlvkh vnbl khy yshb' lchm
verses.translation: For a servant when he reigneth; and a fool when he is filled with meat;

verses.original: תַּ֣חַת שְׂ֭נוּאָה כִּ֣י תִבָּעֵ֑ל וְ֝/שִׁפְחָ֗ה כִּֽי תִירַ֥שׁ גְּבִרְתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: tcht shnv'h khy tb'l vshpchh khy tyrsh gbrth
verses.translation: For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.

verses.original: אַרְבָּ֣עָה הֵ֭ם קְטַנֵּי אָ֑רֶץ וְ֝/הֵ֗מָּה חֲכָמִ֥ים מְחֻכָּמִֽים
verses.translit: 'rb'h hm qtny 'rts vhmh chkhmym mchkhmym
verses.translation: There be four things which are little upon the earth, but they are exceeding wise:

verses.original: הַ֭/נְּמָלִים עַ֣ם לֹא עָ֑ז וַ/יָּכִ֖ינוּ בַ/קַּ֣יִץ לַחְמָֽ/ם
verses.translit: hnmlym 'm l' 'z vykhynv bqyts lchmm
verses.translation: The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;

verses.original: שְׁ֭פַנִּים עַ֣ם לֹא עָצ֑וּם וַ/יָּשִׂ֖ימוּ בַ/סֶּ֣לַע בֵּיתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: shpnym 'm l' 'tsvm vyshymv bsl' bytm
verses.translation: The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;

verses.original: מֶ֭לֶךְ אֵ֣ין לָ/אַרְבֶּ֑ה וַ/יֵּצֵ֖א חֹצֵ֣ץ כֻּלּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mlkh 'yn l'rbh vyts' chtsts khlv
verses.translation: The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;

verses.original: שְׂ֭מָמִית בְּ/יָדַ֣יִם תְּתַפֵּ֑שׂ וְ֝/הִ֗יא בְּ/הֵ֣יכְלֵי מֶֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: shmmyt bydym ttpsh vhy' bhykhly mlkh
verses.translation: The spider taketh hold with her hands, and is in kings’ palaces.

verses.original: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה הֵ֭מָּה מֵיטִ֣יבֵי צָ֑עַד וְ֝/אַרְבָּעָ֗ה מֵיטִ֥בֵי לָֽכֶת
verses.translit: shlshh hmh mytyby ts'd v'rb'h mytby lkht
verses.translation: There be three things which go well, yea, four are comely in going:

verses.original: לַ֭יִשׁ גִּבּ֣וֹר בַּ/בְּהֵמָ֑ה וְ/לֹא יָ֝שׁ֗וּב מִ/פְּנֵי כֹֽל
verses.translit: lysh gbvr bbhmh vl' yshvb mpny khl
verses.translation: A lion which is strongest among beasts, and turneth not away for any;

verses.original: זַרְזִ֣יר מָתְנַ֣יִם אוֹ תָ֑יִשׁ וּ֝/מֶ֗לֶךְ אַלְק֥וּם עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: zrzyr mtnym 'v tysh vmlkh 'lqvm 'mv
verses.translation: A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom there is no rising up.

verses.original: אִם נָבַ֥לְתָּ בְ/הִתְנַשֵּׂ֑א וְ/אִם זַ֝מּ֗וֹתָ יָ֣ד לְ/פֶֽה
verses.translit: 'm nblt bhtnsh' v'm zmvt yd lph
verses.translation: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if thou hast thought evil, lay thine hand upon thy mouth.

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִ֪יץ חָלָ֡ב י֘וֹצִ֤יא חֶמְאָ֗ה וּֽ/מִיץ אַ֭ף י֣וֹצִיא דָ֑ם וּ/מִ֥יץ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם י֣וֹצִיא רִֽיב
verses.translit: khy myts chlb yvtsy' chm'h vmyts 'f yvtsy' dm vmyts 'pym yvtsy' ryb
verses.translation: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood: so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.

verses.original: דִּ֭בְרֵי לְמוּאֵ֣ל מֶ֑לֶךְ מַ֝שָּׂ֗א אֲֽשֶׁר יִסְּרַ֥תּ/וּ אִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: dbry lmv'l mlkh msh' 'shr ysrtv 'mv
verses.translation: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.

verses.original: מַה בְּ֭רִ/י וּ/מַֽה בַּר בִּטְנִ֑/י וּ֝/מֶה בַּר נְדָרָֽ/י
verses.translit: mh bry vmh br btny vmh br ndry
verses.translation: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?

verses.original: אַל תִּתֵּ֣ן לַ/נָּשִׁ֣ים חֵילֶ֑/ךָ וּ֝/דְרָכֶ֗י/ךָ לַֽ/מְח֥וֹת מְלָכִֽין
verses.translit: 'l ttn lnshym chylkh vdrkhykh lmchvt mlkhyn
verses.translation: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.

verses.original: אַ֤ל לַֽ/מְלָכִ֨ים לְֽמוֹאֵ֗ל אַ֣ל לַֽ/מְלָכִ֣ים שְׁתוֹ יָ֑יִן וּ֝/לְ/רוֹזְנִ֗ים או אֵ֣י שֵׁכָֽר
verses.translit: 'l lmlkhym lmv'l 'l lmlkhym shtv yyn vlrvznym 'v 'y shkhr
verses.translation: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:

verses.original: פֶּן יִ֭שְׁתֶּה וְ/יִשְׁכַּ֣ח מְחֻקָּ֑ק וִֽ֝/ישַׁנֶּה דִּ֣ין כָּל בְּנֵי עֹֽנִי
verses.translit: pn yshth vyshkhch mchqq vyshnh dyn khl bny 'ny
verses.translation: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.

verses.original: תְּנוּ שֵׁכָ֣ר לְ/אוֹבֵ֑ד וְ֝/יַיִן לְ/מָ֣רֵי נָֽפֶשׁ
verses.translit: tnv shkhr l'vbd vyyn lmry npsh
verses.translation: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.

verses.original: יִ֭שְׁתֶּה וְ/יִשְׁכַּ֣ח רִישׁ֑/וֹ וַ֝/עֲמָל֗/וֹ לֹ֣א יִזְכָּר עֽוֹד
verses.translit: yshth vyshkhch ryshv v'mlv l' yzkhr 'vd
verses.translation: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

verses.original: פְּתַח פִּ֥י/ךָ לְ/אִלֵּ֑ם אֶל דִּ֝֗ין כָּל בְּנֵ֥י חֲלֽוֹף
verses.translit: ptch pykh l'lm 'l dyn khl bny chlvf
verses.translation: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.

verses.original: פְּתַח פִּ֥י/ךָ שְׁפָט צֶ֑דֶק וְ֝/דִ֗ין עָנִ֥י וְ/אֶבְיֽוֹן
verses.translit: ptch pykh shpt tsdq vdyn 'ny v'byvn
verses.translation: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.

verses.original: אֵֽשֶׁת חַ֭יִל מִ֣י יִמְצָ֑א וְ/רָחֹ֖ק מִ/פְּנִינִ֣ים מִכְרָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'sht chyl my ymts' vrchq mpnynym mkhrh
verses.translation: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.

verses.original: בָּ֣טַח בָּ֭/הּ לֵ֣ב בַּעְלָ֑/הּ וְ֝/שָׁלָ֗ל לֹ֣א יֶחְסָֽר
verses.translit: btch bh lb b'lh vshll l' ychsr
verses.translation: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.

verses.original: גְּמָלַ֣תְ/הוּ ט֣וֹב וְ/לֹא רָ֑ע כֹּ֝֗ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּֽי/ה
verses.translit: gmlthv tvb vl' r' khl ymy chyyh
verses.translation: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.

verses.translit: drshh tsmr vpshtym vt'sh bchpts khpyh
verses.translation: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.

verses.original: הָ֭יְתָה כָּ/אֳנִיּ֣וֹת סוֹחֵ֑ר מִ֝/מֶּרְחָ֗ק תָּבִ֥יא לַחְמָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: hyth kh'nyvt svchr mmrchq tby' lchmh
verses.translation: She is like the merchants’ ships; she bringeth her food from afar.

verses.original: וַ/תָּ֤קָם בְּ/ע֬וֹד לַ֗יְלָה וַ/תִּתֵּ֣ן טֶ֣רֶף לְ/בֵיתָ֑/הּ וְ֝/חֹ֗ק לְ/נַעֲרֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vtqm b'vd lylh vttn trf lbyth vchq ln'rtyh
verses.translation: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.

verses.original: זָמְמָ֣ה שָׂ֭דֶה וַ/תִּקָּחֵ֑/הוּ מִ/פְּרִ֥י כַ֝פֶּ֗י/הָ נטע נָ֣טְעָה כָּֽרֶם
verses.translit: zmmh shdh vtqchhv mpry khpyh nt' nt'h khrm
verses.translation: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.

verses.original: חָֽגְרָ֣ה בְ/ע֣וֹז מָתְנֶ֑י/הָ וַ֝/תְּאַמֵּ֗ץ זְרֹעוֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: chgrh b'vz mtnyh vt'mts zr'vtyh
verses.translation: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.

verses.original: טָ֭עֲמָה כִּי ט֣וֹב סַחְרָ֑/הּ לֹֽא יִכְבֶּ֖ה ב/ליל בַ/לַּ֣יְלָה נֵרָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: t'mh khy tvb schrh l' ykhbh blyl blylh nrh
verses.translation: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goeth not out by night.

verses.original: יָ֭דֶי/הָ שִׁלְּחָ֣ה בַ/כִּישׁ֑וֹר וְ֝/כַפֶּ֗י/הָ תָּ֣מְכוּ פָֽלֶךְ
verses.translit: ydyh shlchh bkhyshvr vkhpyh tmkhv plkh
verses.translation: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.

verses.original: כַּ֭פָּ/הּ פָּרְשָׂ֣ה לֶ/עָנִ֑י וְ֝/יָדֶ֗י/הָ שִׁלְּחָ֥ה לָֽ/אֶבְיֽוֹן
verses.translit: khph prshh l'ny vydyh shlchh l'byvn
verses.translation: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.

verses.original: לֹא תִירָ֣א לְ/בֵיתָ֣/הּ מִ/שָּׁ֑לֶג כִּ֥י כָל בֵּ֝יתָ֗/הּ לָבֻ֥שׁ שָׁנִֽים
verses.translit: l' tyr' lbyth mshlg khy khl byth lbsh shnym
verses.translation: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

verses.original: מַרְבַדִּ֥ים עָֽשְׂתָה לָּ֑/הּ שֵׁ֖שׁ וְ/אַרְגָּמָ֣ן לְבוּשָֽׁ/הּ
verses.translit: mrbdym 'shth lh shsh v'rgmn lbvshh
verses.translation: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.

verses.original: נוֹדָ֣ע בַּ/שְּׁעָרִ֣ים בַּעְלָ֑/הּ בְּ֝/שִׁבְתּ֗/וֹ עִם זִקְנֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: nvd' bsh'rym b'lh bshbtv 'm zqny 'rts
verses.translation: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.

verses.original: סָדִ֣ין עָ֭שְׂתָה וַ/תִּמְכֹּ֑ר וַ֝/חֲג֗וֹר נָתְנָ֥ה לַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִֽי
verses.translit: sdyn 'shth vtmkhr vchgvr ntnh lkhn'ny
verses.translation: She maketh fine linen, and selleth it; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.

verses.original: עֹז וְ/הָדָ֥ר לְבוּשָׁ֑/הּ וַ֝/תִּשְׂחַ֗ק לְ/י֣וֹם אַחֲרֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'z vhdr lbvshh vtshchq lyvm 'chrvn
verses.translation: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.

verses.original: פִּ֭י/הָ פָּתְחָ֣ה בְ/חָכְמָ֑ה וְ/תֽוֹרַת חֶ֝֗סֶד עַל לְשׁוֹנָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: pyh ptchh bchkhmh vtvrt chsd 'l lshvnh
verses.translation: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.

verses.original: צ֭וֹפִיָּה הֲלִיכ֣וֹת בֵּיתָ֑/הּ וְ/לֶ֥חֶם עַ֝צְל֗וּת לֹ֣א תֹאכֵֽל
verses.translit: tsvpyh hlykhvt byth vlchm 'tslvt l' t'khl
verses.translation: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.

verses.translit: qmv bnyh vy'shrvh b'lh vyhllh
verses.translation: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also , and he praiseth her.

verses.original: רַבּ֣וֹת בָּ֭נוֹת עָ֣שׂוּ חָ֑יִל וְ֝/אַ֗תְּ עָלִ֥ית עַל כֻּלָּֽ/נָה
verses.translit: rbvt bnvt 'shv chyl v't 'lyt 'l khlnh
verses.translation: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.

verses.original: שֶׁ֣קֶר הַ֭/חֵן וְ/הֶ֣בֶל הַ/יֹּ֑פִי אִשָּׁ֥ה יִרְאַת יְ֝הוָ֗ה הִ֣יא תִתְהַלָּֽל
verses.translit: shqr hchn vhbl hypy 'shh yr't yhvh hy' tthll
verses.translation: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the LORD , she shall be praised.

verses.original: תְּנוּ לָ֭/הּ מִ/פְּרִ֣י יָדֶ֑י/הָ וִֽ/יהַלְל֖וּ/הָ בַ/שְּׁעָרִ֣ים מַעֲשֶֽׂי/הָ
verses.translit: tnv lh mpry ydyh vyhllvh bsh'rym m'shyh
verses.translation: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.

verses.original: דִּבְרֵי֙ קֹהֶ֣לֶת בֶּן דָּוִ֔ד מֶ֖לֶךְ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: dbry qhlt bn dvd mlkh byrvshlm
verses.translation: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.

verses.original: הֲבֵ֤ל הֲבָלִים֙ אָמַ֣ר קֹהֶ֔לֶת הֲבֵ֥ל הֲבָלִ֖ים הַ/כֹּ֥ל הָֽבֶל
verses.translit: hbl hblym 'mr qhlt hbl hblym hkhl hbl
verses.translation: Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all is vanity.

verses.original: מַה יִּתְר֖וֹן לָֽ/אָדָ֑ם בְּ/כָל עֲמָל֔/וֹ שֶֽׁ/יַּעֲמֹ֖ל תַּ֥חַת הַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: mh ytrvn l'dm bkhl 'mlv shy'ml tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: What profit hath a man of all his labour which he taketh under the sun?

verses.original: דּ֤וֹר הֹלֵךְ֙ וְ/ד֣וֹר בָּ֔א וְ/הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לְ/עוֹלָ֥ם עֹמָֽדֶת
verses.translit: dvr hlkh vdvr b' vh'rts l'vlm 'mdt
verses.translation: One generation passeth away, and another generation cometh: but the earth abideth for ever.

verses.original: וְ/זָרַ֥ח הַ/שֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ וּ/בָ֣א הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וְ/אֶ֨ל מְקוֹמ֔/וֹ שׁוֹאֵ֛ף זוֹרֵ֥חַֽ ה֖וּא שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vzrch hshmsh vb' hshmsh v'l mqvmv shv'f zvrch hv' shm
verses.translation: The sun also ariseth, and the sun goeth down, and hasteth to his place where he arose.

verses.original: הוֹלֵךְ֙ אֶל דָּר֔וֹם וְ/סוֹבֵ֖ב אֶל צָפ֑וֹן סוֹבֵ֤ב סֹבֵב֙ הוֹלֵ֣ךְ הָ/ר֔וּחַ וְ/עַל סְבִיבֹתָ֖י/ו שָׁ֥ב הָ/רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: hvlkh 'l drvm vsvbb 'l tspvn svbb sbb hvlkh hrvch v'l sbybtyv shb hrvch
verses.translation: The wind goeth toward the south, and turneth about unto the north; it whirleth about continually, and the wind returneth again according to his circuits.

verses.original: כָּל הַ/נְּחָלִים֙ הֹלְכִ֣ים אֶל הַ/יָּ֔ם וְ/הַ/יָּ֖ם אֵינֶ֣/נּוּ מָלֵ֑א אֶל מְק֗וֹם שֶׁ֤/הַ/נְּחָלִים֙ הֹֽלְכִ֔ים שָׁ֛ם הֵ֥ם שָׁבִ֖ים לָ/לָֽכֶת
verses.translit: khl hnchlym hlkhym 'l hym vhym 'ynnv ml' 'l mqvm shhnchlym hlkhym shm hm shbym llkht
verses.translation: All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea is not full; unto the place from whence the rivers come, thither they return again.

verses.original: כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים יְגֵעִ֔ים לֹא יוּכַ֥ל אִ֖ישׁ לְ/דַבֵּ֑ר לֹא תִשְׂבַּ֥ע עַ֨יִן֙ לִ/רְא֔וֹת וְ/לֹא תִמָּלֵ֥א אֹ֖זֶן מִ/שְּׁמֹֽעַ
verses.translit: khl hdbrym yg'ym l' yvkhl 'ysh ldbr l' tshb' 'yn lr'vt vl' tml' 'zn mshm'
verses.translation: All things are full of labour; man cannot utter it: the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.

verses.original: מַה שֶּֽׁ/הָיָה֙ ה֣וּא שֶׁ/יִּהְיֶ֔ה וּ/מַה שֶׁ/נַּֽעֲשָׂ֔ה ה֖וּא שֶׁ/יֵּעָשֶׂ֑ה וְ/אֵ֥ין כָּל חָדָ֖שׁ תַּ֥חַת הַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: mh shhyh hv' shyhyh vmh shn'shh hv' shy'shh v'yn khl chdsh tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.

verses.original: יֵ֥שׁ דָּבָ֛ר שֶׁ/יֹּאמַ֥ר רְאֵה זֶ֖ה חָדָ֣שׁ ה֑וּא כְּבָר֙ הָיָ֣ה לְ/עֹֽלָמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה מִ/לְּ/פָנֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: ysh dbr shy'mr r'h zh chdsh hv' khbr hyh l'lmym 'shr hyh mlpnnv
verses.translation: Is there any thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? it hath been already of old time, which was before us.

verses.original: אֵ֥ין זִכְר֖וֹן לָ/רִאשֹׁנִ֑ים וְ/גַ֨ם לָ/אַחֲרֹנִ֜ים שֶׁ/יִּהְי֗וּ לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֤ה לָ/הֶם֙ זִכָּר֔וֹן עִ֥ם שֶׁ/יִּהְי֖וּ לָ/אַחֲרֹנָֽה
verses.translit: 'yn zkhrvn lr'shnym vgm l'chrnym shyhyv l' yhyh lhm zkhrvn 'm shyhyv l'chrnh
verses.translation: There is no remembrance of former things; neither shall there be any remembrance of things that are to come with those that shall come after.

verses.original: אֲנִ֣י קֹהֶ֗לֶת הָיִ֥יתִי מֶ֛לֶךְ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: 'ny qhlt hyyty mlkh 'l yshr'l byrvshlm
verses.translation: I the Preacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַ֣תִּי אֶת לִבִּ֗/י לִ/דְר֤וֹשׁ וְ/לָ/תוּר֙ בַּֽ/חָכְמָ֔ה עַ֛ל כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשָׂ֖ה תַּ֣חַת הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם ה֣וּא עִנְיַ֣ן רָ֗ע נָתַ֧ן אֱלֹהִ֛ים לִ/בְנֵ֥י הָ/אָדָ֖ם לַ/עֲנ֥וֹת בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vntty 't lby ldrvsh vltvr bchkhmh 'l khl 'shr n'shh tcht hshmym hv' 'nyn r' ntn 'lhym lbny h'dm l'nvt bv
verses.translation: And I gave my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all things that are done under heaven: this sore travail hath God given to the sons of man to be exercised therewith.

verses.original: רָאִ֨יתִי֙ אֶת כָּל הַֽ/מַּעֲשִׂ֔ים שֶֽׁ/נַּעֲשׂ֖וּ תַּ֣חַת הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה הַ/כֹּ֛ל הֶ֖בֶל וּ/רְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: r'yty 't khl hm'shym shn'shv tcht hshmsh vhnh hkhl hbl vr'vt rvch
verses.translation: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all is vanity and vexation of spirit.

verses.original: מְעֻוָּ֖ת לֹא יוּכַ֣ל לִ/תְקֹ֑ן וְ/חֶסְר֖וֹן לֹא יוּכַ֥ל לְ/הִמָּנֽוֹת
verses.translit: m'vt l' yvkhl ltqn vchsrvn l' yvkhl lhmnvt
verses.translation: That which is crooked cannot be made straight: and that which is wanting cannot be numbered.

verses.original: דִּבַּ֨רְתִּי אֲנִ֤י עִם לִבִּ/י֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אֲנִ֗י הִנֵּ֨ה הִגְדַּ֤לְתִּי וְ/הוֹסַ֨פְתִּי֙ חָכְמָ֔ה עַ֛ל כָּל אֲשֶׁר הָיָ֥ה לְ/פָנַ֖/י עַל יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/לִבִּ֛/י רָאָ֥ה הַרְבֵּ֖ה חָכְמָ֥ה וָ/דָֽעַת
verses.translit: dbrty 'ny 'm lby l'mr 'ny hnh hgdlty vhvspty chkhmh 'l khl 'shr hyh lpny 'l yrvshlm vlby r'h hrbh chkhmh vd't
verses.translation: I communed with mine own heart, saying, Lo, I am come to great estate, and have gotten more wisdom than all they that have been before me in Jerusalem: yea, my heart had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.

verses.original: וָ/אֶתְּנָ֤/ה לִבִּ/י֙ לָ/דַ֣עַת חָכְמָ֔ה וְ/דַ֥עַת הוֹלֵל֖וֹת וְ/שִׂכְל֑וּת יָדַ֕עְתִּי שֶׁ/גַּם זֶ֥ה ה֖וּא רַעְי֥וֹן רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: v'tnh lby ld't chkhmh vd't hvllvt vshkhlvt yd'ty shgm zh hv' r'yvn rvch
verses.translation: And I gave my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly: I perceived that this also is vexation of spirit.

verses.original: כִּ֛י בְּ/רֹ֥ב חָכְמָ֖ה רָב כָּ֑עַס וְ/יוֹסִ֥יף דַּ֖עַת יוֹסִ֥יף מַכְאֽוֹב
verses.translit: khy brb chkhmh rb kh's vyvsyf d't yvsyf mkh'vb
verses.translation: For in much wisdom is much grief: and he that increaseth knowledge increaseth sorrow.

verses.original: אָמַ֤רְתִּֽי אֲנִי֙ בְּ/לִבִּ֔/י לְכָ/ה נָּ֛א אֲנַסְּ/כָ֛ה בְ/שִׂמְחָ֖ה וּ/רְאֵ֣ה בְ/ט֑וֹב וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה גַם ה֖וּא הָֽבֶל
verses.translit: 'mrty 'ny blby lkhh n' 'nskhh bshmchh vr'h btvb vhnh gm hv' hbl
verses.translation: I said in mine heart, Go to now, I will prove thee with mirth, therefore enjoy pleasure: and, behold, this also is vanity.

verses.original: לִ/שְׂח֖וֹק אָמַ֣רְתִּי מְהוֹלָ֑ל וּ/לְ/שִׂמְחָ֖ה מַה זֹּ֥ה עֹשָֽׂה
verses.translit: lshchvq 'mrty mhvll vlshmchh mh zh 'shh
verses.translation: I said of laughter, It is mad: and of mirth, What doeth it?
