verses.original: תַּ֣רְתִּי בְ/לִבִּ֔/י לִ/מְשׁ֥וֹךְ בַּ/יַּ֖יִן אֶת בְּשָׂרִ֑/י וְ/לִבִּ֞/י נֹהֵ֤ג בַּֽ/חָכְמָה֙ וְ/לֶ/אֱחֹ֣ז בְּ/סִכְל֔וּת עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁר אֶרְאֶ֗ה אֵי זֶ֨ה ט֜וֹב לִ/בְנֵ֤י הָ/אָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַעֲשׂוּ֙ תַּ֣חַת הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם מִסְפַּ֖ר יְמֵ֥י חַיֵּי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: trty blby lmshvkh byyn 't bshry vlby nhg bchkhmh vl'chz bskhlvt 'd 'shr 'r'h 'y zh tvb lbny h'dm 'shr y'shv tcht hshmym mspr ymy chyyhm
verses.translation: I sought in mine heart to give myself unto wine, yet acquainting mine heart with wisdom; and to lay hold on folly, till I might see what was that good for the sons of men, which they should do under the heaven all the days of their life.

verses.original: הִגְדַּ֖לְתִּי מַעֲשָׂ֑/י בָּנִ֤יתִי לִ/י֙ בָּתִּ֔ים נָטַ֥עְתִּי לִ֖/י כְּרָמִֽים
verses.translit: hgdlty m'shy bnyty ly btym nt'ty ly khrmym
verses.translation: I made me great works; I builded me houses; I planted me vineyards:

verses.original: עָשִׂ֣יתִי לִ֔/י גַּנּ֖וֹת וּ/פַרְדֵּסִ֑ים וְ/נָטַ֥עְתִּי בָ/הֶ֖ם עֵ֥ץ כָּל פֶּֽרִי
verses.translit: 'shyty ly gnvt vprdsym vnt'ty bhm 'ts khl pry
verses.translation: I made me gardens and orchards, and I planted trees in them of all kind of fruits:

verses.original: עָשִׂ֥יתִי לִ֖/י בְּרֵכ֣וֹת מָ֑יִם לְ/הַשְׁק֣וֹת מֵ/הֶ֔ם יַ֖עַר צוֹמֵ֥חַ עֵצִֽים
verses.translit: 'shyty ly brkhvt mym lhshqvt mhm y'r tsvmch 'tsym
verses.translation: I made me pools of water, to water therewith the wood that bringeth forth trees:

verses.original: קָנִ֨יתִי֙ עֲבָדִ֣ים וּ/שְׁפָח֔וֹת וּ/בְנֵי בַ֖יִת הָ֣יָה לִ֑/י גַּ֣ם מִקְנֶה֩ בָקָ֨ר וָ/צֹ֤אן הַרְבֵּה֙ הָ֣יָה לִ֔/י מִ/כֹּ֛ל שֶֽׁ/הָי֥וּ לְ/פָנַ֖/י בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: qnyty 'bdym vshpchvt vbny byt hyh ly gm mqnh bqr vts'n hrbh hyh ly mkhl shhyv lpny byrvshlm
verses.translation: I got me servants and maidens, and had servants born in my house; also I had great possessions of great and small cattle above all that were in Jerusalem before me:

verses.original: כָּנַ֤סְתִּי לִ/י֙ גַּם כֶּ֣סֶף וְ/זָהָ֔ב וּ/סְגֻלַּ֥ת מְלָכִ֖ים וְ/הַ/מְּדִינ֑וֹת עָשִׂ֨יתִי לִ֜/י שָׁרִ֣ים וְ/שָׁר֗וֹת וְ/תַעֲנוּגֹ֛ת בְּנֵ֥י הָ/אָדָ֖ם שִׁדָּ֥ה וְ/שִׁדּֽוֹת
verses.translit: khnsty ly gm khsf vzhb vsglt mlkhym vhmdynvt 'shyty ly shrym vshrvt vt'nvgt bny h'dm shdh vshdvt
verses.translation: I gathered me also silver and gold, and the peculiar treasure of kings and of the provinces: I gat me men singers and women singers, and the delights of the sons of men, as musical instruments, and that of all sorts.

verses.original: וְ/גָדַ֣לְתִּי וְ/הוֹסַ֔פְתִּי מִ/כֹּ֛ל שֶׁ/הָיָ֥ה לְ/פָנַ֖/י בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם אַ֥ף חָכְמָתִ֖/י עָ֥מְדָה לִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vgdlty vhvspty mkhl shhyh lpny byrvshlm 'f chkhmty 'mdh ly
verses.translation: So I was great, and increased more than all that were before me in Jerusalem: also my wisdom remained with me.

verses.original: וְ/כֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָֽׁאֲל֣וּ עֵינַ֔/י לֹ֥א אָצַ֖לְתִּי מֵ/הֶ֑ם לֹֽא מָנַ֨עְתִּי אֶת לִבִּ֜/י מִ/כָּל שִׂמְחָ֗ה כִּֽי לִבִּ֤/י שָׂמֵ֨חַ֙ מִ/כָּל עֲמָלִ֔/י וְ/זֶֽה הָיָ֥ה חֶלְקִ֖/י מִ/כָּל עֲמָלִֽ/י
verses.translit: vkhl 'shr sh'lv 'yny l' 'tslty mhm l' mn'ty 't lby mkhl shmchh khy lby shmch mkhl 'mly vzh hyh chlqy mkhl 'mly
verses.translation: And whatsoever mine eyes desired I kept not from them, I withheld not my heart from any joy; for my heart rejoiced in all my labour: and this was my portion of all my labour.

verses.original: וּ/פָנִ֣יתִֽי אֲנִ֗י בְּ/כָל מַעֲשַׂ/י֙ שֶֽׁ/עָשׂ֣וּ יָדַ֔/י וּ/בֶֽ/עָמָ֖ל שֶׁ/עָמַ֣לְתִּי לַ/עֲשׂ֑וֹת וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה הַ/כֹּ֥ל הֶ֨בֶל֙ וּ/רְע֣וּת ר֔וּחַ וְ/אֵ֥ין יִתְר֖וֹן תַּ֥חַת הַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: vpnyty 'ny bkhl m'shy sh'shv ydy vb'ml sh'mlty l'shvt vhnh hkhl hbl vr'vt rvch v'yn ytrvn tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: Then I looked on all the works that my hands had wrought, and on the labour that I had laboured to do: and, behold, all was vanity and vexation of spirit, and there was no profit under the sun.

verses.original: וּ/פָנִ֤יתִֽי אֲנִי֙ לִ/רְא֣וֹת חָכְמָ֔ה וְ/הוֹלֵל֖וֹת וְ/סִכְל֑וּת כִּ֣י מֶ֣ה הָ/אָדָ֗ם שֶׁ/יָּבוֹא֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר כְּבָ֖ר עָשֽׂוּ/הוּ
verses.translit: vpnyty 'ny lr'vt chkhmh vhvllvt vskhlvt khy mh h'dm shybv' 'chry hmlkh 't 'shr khbr 'shvhv
verses.translation: And I turned myself to behold wisdom, and madness, and folly: for what can the man do that cometh after the king? even that which hath been already done.

verses.original: וְ/רָאִ֣יתִי אָ֔נִי שֶׁ/יֵּ֥שׁ יִתְר֛וֹן לַֽ/חָכְמָ֖ה מִן הַ/סִּכְל֑וּת כִּֽ/יתְר֥וֹן הָ/א֖וֹר מִן הַ/חֹֽשֶׁךְ
verses.translit: vr'yty 'ny shysh ytrvn lchkhmh mn hskhlvt khytrvn h'vr mn hchshkh
verses.translation: Then I saw that wisdom excelleth folly, as far as light excelleth darkness.

verses.original: הֶֽ/חָכָם֙ עֵינָ֣י/ו בְּ/רֹאשׁ֔/וֹ וְ/הַ/כְּסִ֖יל בַּ/חֹ֣שֶׁךְ הוֹלֵ֑ךְ וְ/יָדַ֣עְתִּי גַם אָ֔נִי שֶׁ/מִּקְרֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד יִקְרֶ֥ה אֶת כֻּלָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: hchkhm 'ynyv br'shv vhkhsyl bchshkh hvlkh vyd'ty gm 'ny shmqrh 'chd yqrh 't khlm
verses.translation: The wise man’s eyes are in his head; but the fool walketh in darkness: and I myself perceived also that one event happeneth to them all.

verses.original: וְ/אָמַ֨רְתִּֽי אֲנִ֜י בְּ/לִבִּ֗/י כְּ/מִקְרֵ֤ה הַ/כְּסִיל֙ גַּם אֲנִ֣י יִקְרֵ֔/נִי וְ/לָ֧/מָּה חָכַ֛מְתִּי אֲנִ֖י אָ֣ז יוֹתֵ֑ר וְ/דִבַּ֣רְתִּי בְ/לִבִּ֔/י שֶׁ/גַּם זֶ֖ה הָֽבֶל
verses.translit: v'mrty 'ny blby khmqrh hkhsyl gm 'ny yqrny vlmh chkhmty 'ny 'z yvtr vdbrty blby shgm zh hbl
verses.translation: Then said I in my heart, As it happeneth to the fool, so it happeneth even to me; and why was I then more wise? Then I said in my heart, that this also is vanity.

verses.original: כִּי֩ אֵ֨ין זִכְר֧וֹן לֶ/חָכָ֛ם עִֽם הַ/כְּסִ֖יל לְ/עוֹלָ֑ם בְּ/שֶׁ/כְּבָ֞ר הַ/יָּמִ֤ים הַ/בָּאִים֙ הַ/כֹּ֣ל נִשְׁכָּ֔ח וְ/אֵ֛יךְ יָמ֥וּת הֶ/חָכָ֖ם עִֽם הַ/כְּסִֽיל
verses.translit: khy 'yn zkhrvn lchkhm 'm hkhsyl l'vlm bshkhbr hymym hb'ym hkhl nshkhch v'ykh ymvt hchkhm 'm hkhsyl
verses.translation: For there is no remembrance of the wise more than of the fool for ever; seeing that which now is in the days to come shall all be forgotten. And how dieth the wise man ? as the fool.

verses.original: וְ/שָׂנֵ֨אתִי֙ אֶת הַ֣/חַיִּ֔ים כִּ֣י רַ֤ע עָלַ/י֙ הַֽ/מַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה שֶׁ/נַּעֲשָׂ֖ה תַּ֣חַת הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ כִּֽי הַ/כֹּ֥ל הֶ֖בֶל וּ/רְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: vshn'ty 't hchyym khy r' 'ly hm'shh shn'shh tcht hshmsh khy hkhl hbl vr'vt rvch
verses.translation: Therefore I hated life; because the work that is wrought under the sun is grievous unto me: for all is vanity and vexation of spirit.

verses.original: וְ/שָׂנֵ֤אתִֽי אֲנִי֙ אֶת כָּל עֲמָלִ֔/י שֶׁ/אֲנִ֥י עָמֵ֖ל תַּ֣חַת הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ שֶׁ֣/אַנִּיחֶ֔/נּוּ לָ/אָדָ֖ם שֶׁ/יִּהְיֶ֥ה אַחֲרָֽ/י
verses.translit: vshn'ty 'ny 't khl 'mly sh'ny 'ml tcht hshmsh sh'nychnv l'dm shyhyh 'chry
verses.translation: Yea, I hated all my labour which I had taken under the sun: because I should leave it unto the man that shall be after me.

verses.original: וּ/מִ֣י יוֹדֵ֗עַ הֶֽ/חָכָ֤ם יִהְיֶה֙ א֣וֹ סָכָ֔ל וְ/יִשְׁלַט֙ בְּ/כָל עֲמָלִ֔/י שֶֽׁ/עָמַ֥לְתִּי וְ/שֶׁ/חָכַ֖מְתִּי תַּ֣חַת הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ גַּם זֶ֖ה הָֽבֶל
verses.translit: vmy yvd' hchkhm yhyh 'v skhl vyshlt bkhl 'mly sh'mlty vshchkhmty tcht hshmsh gm zh hbl
verses.translation: And who knoweth whether he shall be a wise man or a fool? yet shall he have rule over all my labour wherein I have laboured, and wherein I have shewed myself wise under the sun. This is also vanity.

verses.original: וְ/סַבּ֥וֹתִֽי אֲנִ֖י לְ/יַאֵ֣שׁ אֶת לִבִּ֑/י עַ֚ל כָּל הֶ֣/עָמָ֔ל שֶׁ/עָמַ֖לְתִּי תַּ֥חַת הַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: vsbvty 'ny ly'sh 't lby 'l khl h'ml sh'mlty tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: Therefore I went about to cause my heart to despair of all the labour which I took under the sun.

verses.original: כִּי יֵ֣שׁ אָדָ֗ם שֶׁ/עֲמָל֛/וֹ בְּ/חָכְמָ֥ה וּ/בְ/דַ֖עַת וּ/בְ/כִשְׁר֑וֹן וּ/לְ/אָדָ֞ם שֶׁ/לֹּ֤א עָֽמַל בּ/וֹ֙ יִתְּנֶ֣/נּוּ חֶלְק֔/וֹ גַּם זֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל וְ/רָעָ֥ה רַבָּֽה
verses.translit: khy ysh 'dm sh'mlv bchkhmh vbd't vbkhshrvn vl'dm shl' 'ml bv ytnnv chlqv gm zh hbl vr'h rbh
verses.translation: For there is a man whose labour is in wisdom, and in knowledge, and in equity; yet to a man that hath not laboured therein shall he leave it for his portion. This also is vanity and a great evil.

verses.original: כִּ֠י מֶֽה הֹוֶ֤ה לָֽ/אָדָם֙ בְּ/כָל עֲמָל֔/וֹ וּ/בְ/רַעְי֖וֹן לִבּ֑/ו שֶׁ/ה֥וּא עָמֵ֖ל תַּ֥חַת הַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: khy mh hvh l'dm bkhl 'mlv vbr'yvn lbv shhv' 'ml tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: For what hath man of all his labour, and of the vexation of his heart, wherein he hath laboured under the sun?

verses.original: כִּ֧י כָל יָמָ֣י/ו מַכְאֹבִ֗ים וָ/כַ֨עַס֙ עִנְיָנ֔/וֹ גַּם בַּ/לַּ֖יְלָה לֹא שָׁכַ֣ב לִבּ֑/וֹ גַּם זֶ֖ה הֶ֥בֶל הֽוּא
verses.translit: khy khl ymyv mkh'bym vkh's 'nynv gm blylh l' shkhb lbv gm zh hbl hv'
verses.translation: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail grief; yea, his heart taketh not rest in the night. This is also vanity.

verses.original: אֵֽין ט֤וֹב בָּ/אָדָם֙ שֶׁ/יֹּאכַ֣ל וְ/שָׁתָ֔ה וְ/הֶרְאָ֧ה אֶת נַפְשׁ֛/וֹ ט֖וֹב בַּ/עֲמָל֑/וֹ גַּם זֹה֙ רָאִ֣יתִי אָ֔נִי כִּ֛י מִ/יַּ֥ד הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים הִֽיא
verses.translit: 'yn tvb b'dm shy'khl vshth vhr'h 't npshv tvb b'mlv gm zh r'yty 'ny khy myd h'lhym hy'
verses.translation: There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat and drink, and that he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it was from the hand of God.

verses.original: כִּ֣י מִ֥י יֹאכַ֛ל וּ/מִ֥י יָח֖וּשׁ ח֥וּץ מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: khy my y'khl vmy ychvsh chvts mmny
verses.translation: For who can eat, or who else can hasten hereunto , more than I?

verses.original: כִּ֤י לְ/אָדָם֙ שֶׁ/טּ֣וֹב לְ/פָנָ֔י/ו נָתַ֛ן חָכְמָ֥ה וְ/דַ֖עַת וְ/שִׂמְחָ֑ה וְ/לַ/חוֹטֶא֩ נָתַ֨ן עִנְיָ֜ן לֶ/אֱס֣וֹף וְ/לִ/כְנ֗וֹס לָ/תֵת֙ לְ/טוֹב֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים גַּם זֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל וּ/רְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: khy l'dm shtvb lpnyv ntn chkhmh vd't vshmchh vlchvt' ntn 'nyn l'svf vlkhnvs ltt ltvb lpny h'lhym gm zh hbl vr'vt rvch
verses.translation: For God giveth to a man that is good in his sight wisdom, and knowledge, and joy: but to the sinner he giveth travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him that is good before God. This also is vanity and vexation of spirit.

verses.original: לַ/כֹּ֖ל זְמָ֑ן וְ/עֵ֥ת לְ/כָל חֵ֖פֶץ תַּ֥חַת הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: lkhl zmn v't lkhl chpts tcht hshmym
verses.translation: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:

verses.original: עֵ֥ת לָ/לֶ֖דֶת וְ/עֵ֣ת לָ/מ֑וּת עֵ֣ת לָ/טַ֔עַת וְ/עֵ֖ת לַ/עֲק֥וֹר נָטֽוּעַ
verses.translit: 't lldt v't lmvt 't lt't v't l'qvr ntv'
verses.translation: A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;

verses.original: עֵ֤ת לַ/הֲרוֹג֙ וְ/עֵ֣ת לִ/רְפּ֔וֹא עֵ֥ת לִ/פְר֖וֹץ וְ/עֵ֥ת לִ/בְנֽוֹת
verses.translit: 't lhrvg v't lrpv' 't lprvts v't lbnvt
verses.translation: A time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;

verses.original: עֵ֤ת לִ/בְכּוֹת֙ וְ/עֵ֣ת לִ/שְׂח֔וֹק עֵ֥ת סְפ֖וֹד וְ/עֵ֥ת רְקֽוֹד
verses.translit: 't lbkhvt v't lshchvq 't spvd v't rqvd
verses.translation: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

verses.original: עֵ֚ת לְ/הַשְׁלִ֣יךְ אֲבָנִ֔ים וְ/עֵ֖ת כְּנ֣וֹס אֲבָנִ֑ים עֵ֣ת לַ/חֲב֔וֹק וְ/עֵ֖ת לִ/רְחֹ֥ק מֵ/חַבֵּֽק
verses.translit: 't lhshlykh 'bnym v't khnvs 'bnym 't lchbvq v't lrchq mchbq
verses.translation: A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;

verses.original: עֵ֤ת לְ/בַקֵּשׁ֙ וְ/עֵ֣ת לְ/אַבֵּ֔ד עֵ֥ת לִ/שְׁמ֖וֹר וְ/עֵ֥ת לְ/הַשְׁלִֽיךְ
verses.translit: 't lbqsh v't l'bd 't lshmvr v't lhshlykh
verses.translation: A time to get, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

verses.original: עֵ֤ת לִ/קְר֨וֹעַ֙ וְ/עֵ֣ת לִ/תְפּ֔וֹר עֵ֥ת לַ/חֲשׁ֖וֹת וְ/עֵ֥ת לְ/דַבֵּֽר
verses.translit: 't lqrv' v't ltpvr 't lchshvt v't ldbr
verses.translation: A time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

verses.original: עֵ֤ת לֶֽ/אֱהֹב֙ וְ/עֵ֣ת לִ/שְׂנֹ֔א עֵ֥ת מִלְחָמָ֖ה וְ/עֵ֥ת שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: 't l'hb v't lshn' 't mlchmh v't shlvm
verses.translation: A time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace.

verses.original: מַה יִּתְרוֹן֙ הָֽ/עוֹשֶׂ֔ה בַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר ה֥וּא עָמֵֽל
verses.translit: mh ytrvn h'vshh b'shr hv' 'ml
verses.translation: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth?

verses.original: רָאִ֣יתִי אֶת הָֽ/עִנְיָ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧ן אֱלֹהִ֛ים לִ/בְנֵ֥י הָ/אָדָ֖ם לַ/עֲנ֥וֹת בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: r'yty 't h'nyn 'shr ntn 'lhym lbny h'dm l'nvt bv
verses.translation: I have seen the travail, which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it.

verses.original: אֶת הַ/כֹּ֥ל עָשָׂ֖ה יָפֶ֣ה בְ/עִתּ֑/וֹ גַּ֤ם אֶת הָ/עֹלָם֙ נָתַ֣ן בְּ/לִבָּ֔/ם מִ/בְּלִ֞י אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא יִמְצָ֣א הָ/אָדָ֗ם אֶת הַֽ/מַּעֲשֶׂ֛ה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֥ה הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים מֵ/רֹ֥אשׁ וְ/עַד סֽוֹף
verses.translit: 't hkhl 'shh yph b'tv gm 't h'lm ntn blbm mbly 'shr l' ymts' h'dm 't hm'shh 'shr 'shh h'lhym mr'sh v'd svf
verses.translation: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.

verses.original: יָדַ֕עְתִּי כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין ט֖וֹב בָּ֑/ם כִּ֣י אִם לִ/שְׂמ֔וֹחַ וְ/לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת ט֖וֹב בְּ/חַיָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: yd'ty khy 'yn tvb bm khy 'm lshmvch vl'shvt tvb bchyyv
verses.translation: I know that there is no good in them, but for a man to rejoice, and to do good in his life.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֤ם כָּל הָ/אָדָם֙ שֶׁ/יֹּאכַ֣ל וְ/שָׁתָ֔ה וְ/רָאָ֥ה ט֖וֹב בְּ/כָל עֲמָל֑/וֹ מַתַּ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֖ים הִֽיא
verses.translit: vgm khl h'dm shy'khl vshth vr'h tvb bkhl 'mlv mtt 'lhym hy'
verses.translation: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it is the gift of God.

verses.original: יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֠י כָּל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה הָ/אֱלֹהִים֙ ה֚וּא יִהְיֶ֣ה לְ/עוֹלָ֔ם עָלָי/ו֙ אֵ֣ין לְ/הוֹסִ֔יף וּ/מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ אֵ֣ין לִ/גְרֹ֑עַ וְ/הָ/אֱלֹהִ֣ים עָשָׂ֔ה שֶׁ/יִּֽרְא֖וּ מִ/לְּ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: yd'ty khy khl 'shr y'shh h'lhym hv' yhyh l'vlm 'lyv 'yn lhvsyf vmmnv 'yn lgr' vh'lhym 'shh shyr'v mlpnyv
verses.translation: I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God doeth it , that men should fear before him.

verses.original: מַה שֶּֽׁ/הָיָה֙ כְּבָ֣ר ה֔וּא וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִ/הְי֖וֹת כְּבָ֣ר הָיָ֑ה וְ/הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים יְבַקֵּ֥שׁ אֶת נִרְדָּֽף
verses.translit: mh shhyh khbr hv' v'shr lhyvt khbr hyh vh'lhym ybqsh 't nrdf
verses.translation: That which hath been is now; and that which is to be hath already been; and God requireth that which is past.

verses.original: וְ/ע֥וֹד רָאִ֖יתִי תַּ֣חַת הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ מְק֤וֹם הַ/מִּשְׁפָּט֙ שָׁ֣מָּ/ה הָ/רֶ֔שַׁע וּ/מְק֥וֹם הַ/צֶּ֖דֶק שָׁ֥מָּ/ה הָ/רָֽשַׁע
verses.translit: v'vd r'yty tcht hshmsh mqvm hmshpt shmh hrsh' vmqvm htsdq shmh hrsh'
verses.translation: And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment, that wickedness was there; and the place of righteousness, that iniquity was there.

verses.original: אָמַ֤רְתִּֽי אֲנִי֙ בְּ/לִבִּ֔/י אֶת הַ/צַּדִּיק֙ וְ/אֶת הָ֣/רָשָׁ֔ע יִשְׁפֹּ֖ט הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּי עֵ֣ת לְ/כָל חֵ֔פֶץ וְ/עַ֥ל כָּל הַֽ/מַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה שָֽׁם
verses.translit: 'mrty 'ny blby 't htsdyq v't hrsh' yshpt h'lhym khy 't lkhl chpts v'l khl hm'shh shm
verses.translation: I said in mine heart, God shall judge the righteous and the wicked: for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.

verses.original: אָמַ֤רְתִּֽי אֲנִי֙ בְּ/לִבִּ֔/י עַל דִּבְרַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י הָ/אָדָ֔ם לְ/בָרָ֖/ם הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/לִ/רְא֕וֹת שְׁ/הֶם בְּהֵמָ֥ה הֵ֖מָּה לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'mrty 'ny blby 'l dbrt bny h'dm lbrm h'lhym vlr'vt shhm bhmh hmh lhm
verses.translation: I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.

verses.original: כִּי֩ מִקְרֶ֨ה בְֽנֵי הָ/אָדָ֜ם וּ/מִקְרֶ֣ה הַ/בְּהֵמָ֗ה וּ/מִקְרֶ֤ה אֶחָד֙ לָ/הֶ֔ם כְּ/מ֥וֹת זֶה֙ כֵּ֣ן מ֣וֹת זֶ֔ה וְ/ר֥וּחַ אֶחָ֖ד לַ/כֹּ֑ל וּ/מוֹתַ֨ר הָ/אָדָ֤ם מִן הַ/בְּהֵמָה֙ אָ֔יִן כִּ֥י הַ/כֹּ֖ל הָֽבֶל
verses.translit: khy mqrh bny h'dm vmqrh hbhmh vmqrh 'chd lhm khmvt zh khn mvt zh vrvch 'chd lkhl vmvtr h'dm mn hbhmh 'yn khy hkhl hbl
verses.translation: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast: for all is vanity.

verses.original: הַ/כֹּ֥ל הוֹלֵ֖ךְ אֶל מָק֣וֹם אֶחָ֑ד הַ/כֹּל֙ הָיָ֣ה מִן הֶֽ/עָפָ֔ר וְ/הַ/כֹּ֖ל שָׁ֥ב אֶל הֶ/עָפָֽר
verses.translit: hkhl hvlkh 'l mqvm 'chd hkhl hyh mn h'pr vhkhl shb 'l h'pr
verses.translation: All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.

verses.original: מִ֣י יוֹדֵ֗עַ ר֚וּחַ בְּנֵ֣י הָ/אָדָ֔ם הָ/עֹלָ֥ה הִ֖יא לְ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה וְ/ר֨וּחַ֙ הַ/בְּהֵמָ֔ה הַ/יֹּרֶ֥דֶת הִ֖יא לְ/מַ֥טָּה לָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: my yvd' rvch bny h'dm h'lh hy' lm'lh vrvch hbhmh hyrdt hy' lmth l'rts
verses.translation: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth?

verses.original: וְ/רָאִ֗יתִי כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין טוֹב֙ מֵ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׂמַ֤ח הָ/אָדָם֙ בְּֽ/מַעֲשָׂ֔י/ו כִּי ה֖וּא חֶלְק֑/וֹ כִּ֣י מִ֤י יְבִיאֶ֨/נּוּ֙ לִ/רְא֔וֹת בְּ/מֶ֖ה שֶׁ/יִּהְיֶ֥ה אַחֲרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vr'yty khy 'yn tvb m'shr yshmch h'dm bm'shyv khy hv' chlqv khy my yby'nv lr'vt bmh shyhyh 'chryv
verses.translation: Wherefore I perceive that there is nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his own works; for that is his portion: for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?

verses.original: וְ/שַׁ֣בְתִּֽי אֲנִ֗י וָ/אֶרְאֶה֙ אֶת כָּל הָ֣/עֲשֻׁקִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשִׂ֖ים תַּ֣חַת הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה דִּמְעַ֣ת הָ/עֲשֻׁקִ֗ים וְ/אֵ֤ין לָ/הֶם֙ מְנַחֵ֔ם וּ/מִ/יַּ֤ד עֹֽשְׁקֵי/הֶם֙ כֹּ֔חַ וְ/אֵ֥ין לָ/הֶ֖ם מְנַחֵֽם
verses.translit: vshbty 'ny v'r'h 't khl h'shqym 'shr n'shym tcht hshmsh vhnh dm't h'shqym v'yn lhm mnchm vmyd 'shqyhm khch v'yn lhm mnchm
verses.translation: So I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.

verses.original: וְ/שַׁבֵּ֧חַ אֲנִ֛י אֶת הַ/מֵּתִ֖ים שֶׁ/כְּבָ֣ר מֵ֑תוּ מִן הַ֣/חַיִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥מָּה חַיִּ֖ים עֲדֶֽנָ/ה
verses.translit: vshbch 'ny 't hmtym shkhbr mtv mn hchyym 'shr hmh chyym 'dnh
verses.translation: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.

verses.original: וְ/טוֹב֙ מִ/שְּׁנֵי/הֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר עֲדֶ֖ן לֹ֣א הָיָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא רָאָה֙ אֶת הַ/מַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה הָ/רָ֔ע אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשָׂ֖ה תַּ֥חַת הַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: vtvb mshnyhm 't 'shr 'dn l' hyh 'shr l' r'h 't hm'shh hr' 'shr n'shh tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: Yea, better is he than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.

verses.original: וְ/רָאִ֨יתִֽי אֲנִ֜י אֶת כָּל עָמָ֗ל וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל כִּשְׁר֣וֹן הַֽ/מַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה כִּ֛י הִ֥יא קִנְאַת אִ֖ישׁ מֵ/רֵעֵ֑/הוּ גַּם זֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל וּ/רְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: vr'yty 'ny 't khl 'ml v't khl khshrvn hm'shh khy hy' qn't 'ysh mr'hv gm zh hbl vr'vt rvch
verses.translation: Again, I considered all travail, and every right work, that for this a man is envied of his neighbour. This is also vanity and vexation of spirit.

verses.original: הַ/כְּסִיל֙ חֹבֵ֣ק אֶת יָדָ֔י/ו וְ/אֹכֵ֖ל אֶת בְּשָׂרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hkhsyl chbq 't ydyv v'khl 't bshrv
verses.translation: The fool foldeth his hands together, and eateth his own flesh.

verses.original: ט֕וֹב מְלֹ֥א כַ֖ף נָ֑חַת מִ/מְּלֹ֥א חָפְנַ֛יִם עָמָ֖ל וּ/רְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: tvb ml' khf ncht mml' chpnym 'ml vr'vt rvch
verses.translation: Better is an handful with quietness, than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit.

verses.original: וְ/שַׁ֧בְתִּי אֲנִ֛י וָ/אֶרְאֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל תַּ֥חַת הַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: vshbty 'ny v'r'h hbl tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun.

verses.original: יֵ֣שׁ אֶחָד֩ וְ/אֵ֨ין שֵׁנִ֜י גַּ֣ם בֵּ֧ן וָ/אָ֣ח אֵֽין ל֗/וֹ וְ/אֵ֥ין קֵץ֙ לְ/כָל עֲמָל֔/וֹ גַּם עיני/ו עֵינ֖/וֹ לֹא תִשְׂבַּ֣ע עֹ֑שֶׁר וּ/לְ/מִ֣י אֲנִ֣י עָמֵ֗ל וּ/מְחַסֵּ֤ר אֶת נַפְשִׁ/י֙ מִ/טּוֹבָ֔ה גַּם זֶ֥ה הֶ֛בֶל וְ/עִנְיַ֥ן רָ֖ע הֽוּא
verses.translit: ysh 'chd v'yn shny gm bn v'ch 'yn lv v'yn qts lkhl 'mlv gm 'ynyv 'ynv l' tshb' 'shr vlmy 'ny 'ml vmchsr 't npshy mtvbh gm zh hbl v'nyn r' hv'
verses.translation: There is one alone , and there is not a second; yea, he hath neither child nor brother: yet is there no end of all his labour; neither is his eye satisfied with riches; neither saith he , For whom do I labour, and bereave my soul of good? This is also vanity, yea, it is a sore travail.

verses.original: טוֹבִ֥ים הַ/שְּׁנַ֖יִם מִן הָ/אֶחָ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֧ר יֵשׁ לָ/הֶ֛ם שָׂכָ֥ר ט֖וֹב בַּ/עֲמָלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: tvbym hshnym mn h'chd 'shr ysh lhm shkhr tvb b'mlm
verses.translation: Two are better than one; because they have a good reward for their labour.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם יִפֹּ֔לוּ הָ/אֶחָ֖ד יָקִ֣ים אֶת חֲבֵר֑/וֹ וְ/אִ֣י/ל֗/וֹ הָֽ/אֶחָד֙ שֶׁ/יִּפּ֔וֹל וְ/אֵ֥ין שֵׁנִ֖י לַ/הֲקִימֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy 'm yplv h'chd yqym 't chbrv v'ylv h'chd shypvl v'yn shny lhqymv
verses.translation: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow: but woe to him that is alone when he falleth; for he hath not another to help him up.

verses.original: גַּ֛ם אִם יִשְׁכְּב֥וּ שְׁנַ֖יִם וְ/חַ֣ם לָ/הֶ֑ם וּ/לְ/אֶחָ֖ד אֵ֥יךְ יֵחָֽם
verses.translit: gm 'm yshkhbv shnym vchm lhm vl'chd 'ykh ychm
verses.translation: Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm alone ?

verses.original: וְ/אִֽם יִתְקְפ/וֹ֙ הָ/אֶחָ֔ד הַ/שְּׁנַ֖יִם יַעַמְד֣וּ נֶגְדּ֑/וֹ וְ/הַ/חוּט֙ הַֽ/מְשֻׁלָּ֔שׁ לֹ֥א בִ/מְהֵרָ֖ה יִנָּתֵֽק
verses.translit: v'm ytqpv h'chd hshnym y'mdv ngdv vhchvt hmshlsh l' bmhrh yntq
verses.translation: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

verses.original: ט֛וֹב יֶ֥לֶד מִסְכֵּ֖ן וְ/חָכָ֑ם מִ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ זָקֵן֙ וּ/כְסִ֔יל אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא יָדַ֥ע לְ/הִזָּהֵ֖ר עֽוֹד
verses.translit: tvb yld mskhn vchkhm mmlkh zqn vkhsyl 'shr l' yd' lhzhr 'vd
verses.translation: Better is a poor and a wise child than an old and foolish king, who will no more be admonished.

verses.original: כִּֽי מִ/בֵּ֥ית הָ/סוּרִ֖ים יָצָ֣א לִ/מְלֹ֑ךְ כִּ֛י גַּ֥ם בְּ/מַלְכוּת֖/וֹ נוֹלַ֥ד רָֽשׁ
verses.translit: khy mbyt hsvrym yts' lmlkh khy gm bmlkhvtv nvld rsh
verses.translation: For out of prison he cometh to reign; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor.

verses.original: רָאִ֨יתִי֙ אֶת כָּל הַ֣/חַיִּ֔ים הַֽ/מְהַלְּכִ֖ים תַּ֣חַת הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ עִ֚ם הַ/יֶּ֣לֶד הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲמֹ֖ד תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: r'yty 't khl hchyym hmhlkhym tcht hshmsh 'm hyld hshny 'shr y'md tchtyv
verses.translation: I considered all the living which walk under the sun, with the second child that shall stand up in his stead.

verses.original: אֵֽין קֵ֣ץ לְ/כָל הָ/עָ֗ם לְ/כֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁר הָיָה֙ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֔ם גַּ֥ם הָ/אַחֲרוֹנִ֖ים לֹ֣א יִשְׂמְחוּ ב֑/וֹ כִּֽי גַם זֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל וְ/רַעְי֥וֹן רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: 'yn qts lkhl h'm lkhl 'shr hyh lpnyhm gm h'chrvnym l' yshmchv bv khy gm zh hbl vr'yvn rvch
verses.translation: There is no end of all the people, even of all that have been before them: they also that come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and vexation of spirit.

verses.original: אַל תְּבַהֵ֨ל עַל פִּ֜י/ךָ וְ/לִבְּ/ךָ֧ אַל יְמַהֵ֛ר לְ/הוֹצִ֥יא דָבָ֖ר לִ/פְנֵ֣י הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֣י הָ/אֱלֹהִ֤ים בַּ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ וְ/אַתָּ֣ה עַל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ עַֽל כֵּ֛ן יִהְי֥וּ דְבָרֶ֖י/ךָ מְעַטִּֽים
verses.translit: 'l tbhl 'l pykh vlbkh 'l ymhr lhvtsy' dbr lpny h'lhym khy h'lhym bshmym v'th 'l h'rts 'l khn yhyv dbrykh m'tym
verses.translation: Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God, and be more ready to hear, than to give the sacrifice of fools: for they consider not that they do evil.

verses.original: כִּ֛י בָּ֥א הַ/חֲל֖וֹם בְּ/רֹ֣ב עִנְיָ֑ן וְ/ק֥וֹל כְּסִ֖יל בְּ/רֹ֥ב דְּבָרִֽים
verses.translit: khy b' hchlvm brb 'nyn vqvl khsyl brb dbrym
verses.translation: Be not rash with thy mouth, and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God: for God is in heaven, and thou upon earth: therefore let thy words be few.

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֩ תִּדֹּ֨ר נֶ֜דֶר לֵֽ/אלֹהִ֗ים אַל תְּאַחֵר֙ לְ/שַׁלְּמ֔/וֹ כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין חֵ֖פֶץ בַּ/כְּסִילִ֑ים אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר תִּדֹּ֖ר שַׁלֵּֽם
verses.translit: kh'shr tdr ndr l'lhym 'l t'chr lshlmv khy 'yn chpts bkhsylym 't 'shr tdr shlm
verses.translation: For a dream cometh through the multitude of business; and a fool’s voice is known by multitude of words.

verses.original: ט֖וֹב אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא תִדֹּ֑ר מִ/שֶׁ/תִּדּ֖וֹר וְ/לֹ֥א תְשַׁלֵּֽם
verses.translit: tvb 'shr l' tdr mshtdvr vl' tshlm
verses.translation: When thou vowest a vow unto God, defer not to pay it; for he hath no pleasure in fools: pay that which thou hast vowed.

verses.original: אַל תִּתֵּ֤ן אֶת פִּ֨י/ךָ֙ לַ/חֲטִ֣יא אֶת בְּשָׂרֶ֔/ךָ וְ/אַל תֹּאמַר֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/מַּלְאָ֔ךְ כִּ֥י שְׁגָגָ֖ה הִ֑יא לָ֣/מָּה יִקְצֹ֤ף הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ עַל קוֹלֶ֔/ךָ וְ/חִבֵּ֖ל אֶת מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'l ttn 't pykh lchty' 't bshrkh v'l t'mr lpny hml'kh khy shggh hy' lmh yqtsf h'lhym 'l qvlkh vchbl 't m'shh ydykh
verses.translation: Better is it that thou shouldest not vow, than that thou shouldest vow and not pay.

verses.original: כִּ֣י בְ/רֹ֤ב חֲלֹמוֹת֙ וַ/הֲבָלִ֔ים וּ/דְבָרִ֖ים הַרְבֵּ֑ה כִּ֥י אֶת הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים יְרָֽא
verses.translit: khy brb chlmvt vhblym vdbrym hrbh khy 't h'lhym yr'
verses.translation: Suffer not thy mouth to cause thy flesh to sin; neither say thou before the angel, that it was an error: wherefore should God be angry at thy voice, and destroy the work of thine hands?

verses.original: אִם עֹ֣שֶׁק רָ֠שׁ וְ/גֵ֨זֶל מִשְׁפָּ֤ט וָ/צֶ֨דֶק֙ תִּרְאֶ֣ה בַ/מְּדִינָ֔ה אַל תִּתְמַ֖הּ עַל הַ/חֵ֑פֶץ כִּ֣י גָבֹ֜הַּ מֵ/עַ֤ל גָּבֹ֨הַ֙ שֹׁמֵ֔ר וּ/גְבֹהִ֖ים עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'm 'shq rsh vgzl mshpt vtsdq tr'h bmdynh 'l ttmh 'l hchpts khy gbh m'l gbh shmr vgbhym 'lyhm
verses.translation: For in the multitude of dreams and many words there are also divers vanities: but fear thou God.

verses.original: וְ/יִתְר֥וֹן אֶ֖רֶץ בַּ/כֹּ֣ל היא ה֑וּא מֶ֥לֶךְ לְ/שָׂדֶ֖ה נֶעֱבָֽד
verses.translit: vytrvn 'rts bkhl hy' hv' mlkh lshdh n'bd
verses.translation: If thou seest the oppression of the poor, and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province, marvel not at the matter: for he that is higher than the highest regardeth; and there be higher than they.

verses.original: אֹהֵ֥ב כֶּ֨סֶף֙ לֹא יִשְׂבַּ֣ע כֶּ֔סֶף וּ/מִֽי אֹהֵ֥ב בֶּ/הָמ֖וֹן לֹ֣א תְבוּאָ֑ה גַּם זֶ֖ה הָֽבֶל
verses.translit: 'hb khsf l' yshb' khsf vmy 'hb bhmvn l' tbv'h gm zh hbl
verses.translation: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all: the king himself is served by the field.

verses.original: בִּ/רְבוֹת֙ הַ/טּוֹבָ֔ה רַבּ֖וּ אוֹכְלֶ֑י/הָ וּ/מַה כִּשְׁרוֹן֙ לִ/בְעָלֶ֔י/הָ כִּ֖י אִם ראית רְא֥וּת עֵינָֽי/ו
verses.translit: brbvt htvbh rbv 'vkhlyh vmh khshrvn lb'lyh khy 'm r'yt r'vt 'ynyv
verses.translation: He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he that loveth abundance with increase: this is also vanity.

verses.original: מְתוּקָה֙ שְׁנַ֣ת הָ/עֹבֵ֔ד אִם מְעַ֥ט וְ/אִם הַרְבֵּ֖ה יֹאכֵ֑ל וְ/הַ/שָּׂבָע֙ לֶֽ/עָשִׁ֔יר אֵינֶ֛/נּוּ מַנִּ֥יחַֽ ל֖/וֹ לִ/ישֽׁוֹן
verses.translit: mtvqh shnt h'bd 'm m't v'm hrbh y'khl vhshb' l'shyr 'ynnv mnych lv lyshvn
verses.translation: When goods increase, they are increased that eat them: and what good is there to the owners thereof, saving the beholding of them with their eyes?

verses.original: יֵ֚שׁ רָעָ֣ה חוֹלָ֔ה רָאִ֖יתִי תַּ֣חַת הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ עֹ֛שֶׁר שָׁמ֥וּר לִ/בְעָלָ֖י/ו לְ/רָעָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: ysh r'h chvlh r'yty tcht hshmsh 'shr shmvr lb'lyv lr'tv
verses.translation: The sleep of a labouring man is sweet, whether he eat little or much: but the abundance of the rich will not suffer him to sleep.

verses.original: וְ/אָבַ֛ד הָ/עֹ֥שֶׁר הַ/ה֖וּא בְּ/עִנְיַ֣ן רָ֑ע וְ/הוֹלִ֣יד בֵּ֔ן וְ/אֵ֥ין בְּ/יָד֖/וֹ מְאֽוּמָה
verses.translit: v'bd h'shr hhv' b'nyn r' vhvlyd bn v'yn bydv m'vmh
verses.translation: There is a sore evil which I have seen under the sun, namely , riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt.

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָצָא֙ מִ/בֶּ֣טֶן אִמּ֔/וֹ עָר֛וֹם יָשׁ֥וּב לָ/לֶ֖כֶת כְּ/שֶׁ/בָּ֑א וּ/מְא֨וּמָה֙ לֹא יִשָּׂ֣א בַ/עֲמָל֔/וֹ שֶׁ/יֹּלֵ֖ךְ בְּ/יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: kh'shr yts' mbtn 'mv 'rvm yshvb llkht khshb' vm'vmh l' ysh' b'mlv shylkh bydv
verses.translation: But those riches perish by evil travail: and he begetteth a son, and there is nothing in his hand.

verses.original: וְ/גַם זֹה֙ רָעָ֣ה חוֹלָ֔ה כָּ/ל עֻמַּ֥ת שֶׁ/בָּ֖א כֵּ֣ן יֵלֵ֑ךְ וּ/מַה יִּתְר֣וֹן ל֔/וֹ שֶֽׁ/יַּעֲמֹ֖ל לָ/רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: vgm zh r'h chvlh khl 'mt shb' khn ylkh vmh ytrvn lv shy'ml lrvch
verses.translation: As he came forth of his mother’s womb, naked shall he return to go as he came, and shall take nothing of his labour, which he may carry away in his hand.

verses.original: גַּ֥ם כָּל יָמָ֖י/ו בַּ/חֹ֣שֶׁךְ יֹאכֵ֑ל וְ/כָעַ֥ס הַרְבֵּ֖ה וְ/חָלְי֥/וֹ וָ/קָֽצֶף
verses.translit: gm khl ymyv bchshkh y'khl vkh's hrbh vchlyv vqtsf
verses.translation: And this also is a sore evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go: and what profit hath he that hath laboured for the wind?

verses.original: הִנֵּ֞ה אֲשֶׁר רָאִ֣יתִי אָ֗נִי ט֣וֹב אֲשֶׁר יָפֶ֣ה לֶֽ/אֶכוֹל וְ֠/לִ/שְׁתּוֹת וְ/לִ/רְא֨וֹת טוֹבָ֜ה בְּ/כָל עֲמָל֣/וֹ שֶׁ/יַּעֲמֹ֣ל תַּֽחַת הַ/שֶּׁ֗מֶשׁ מִסְפַּ֧ר יְמֵי חי/ו חַיָּ֛י/ו אֲשֶׁר נָֽתַן ל֥/וֹ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי ה֥וּא חֶלְקֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hnh 'shr r'yty 'ny tvb 'shr yph l'khvl vlshtvt vlr'vt tvbh bkhl 'mlv shy'ml tcht hshmsh mspr ymy chyv chyyv 'shr ntn lv h'lhym khy hv' chlqv
verses.translation: All his days also he eateth in darkness, and he hath much sorrow and wrath with his sickness.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם כָּֽל הָ/אָדָ֡ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָֽתַן ל֣/וֹ הָ/אֱלֹהִים֩ עֹ֨שֶׁר וּ/נְכָסִ֜ים וְ/הִשְׁלִיט֨/וֹ לֶ/אֱכֹ֤ל מִמֶּ֨/נּוּ֙ וְ/לָ/שֵׂ֣את אֶת חֶלְק֔/וֹ וְ/לִ/שְׂמֹ֖חַ בַּ/עֲמָל֑/וֹ זֹ֕ה מַתַּ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֖ים הִֽיא
verses.translit: gm khl h'dm 'shr ntn lv h'lhym 'shr vnkhsym vhshlytv l'khl mmnv vlsh't 't chlqv vlshmch b'mlv zh mtt 'lhym hy'
verses.translation: Behold that which I have seen: it is good and comely for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy the good of all his labour that he taketh under the sun all the days of his life, which God giveth him: for it is his portion.

verses.original: כִּ֚י לֹ֣א הַרְבֵּ֔ה יִזְכֹּ֖ר אֶת יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֑י/ו כִּ֧י הָ/אֱלֹהִ֛ים מַעֲנֶ֖ה בְּ/שִׂמְחַ֥ת לִבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy l' hrbh yzkhr 't ymy chyyv khy h'lhym m'nh bshmcht lbv
verses.translation: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth, and hath given him power to eat thereof, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labour; this is the gift of God.
For he shall not much remember the days of his life; because God answereth him in the joy of his heart.

verses.original: יֵ֣שׁ רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִ֖יתִי תַּ֣חַת הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וְ/רַבָּ֥ה הִ֖יא עַל הָ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: ysh r'h 'shr r'yty tcht hshmsh vrbh hy' 'l h'dm
verses.translation: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is common among men:

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִתֶּן ל֣/וֹ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֡ים עֹשֶׁר֩ וּ/נְכָסִ֨ים וְ/כָב֜וֹד וְֽ/אֵינֶ֨/נּוּ חָסֵ֥ר לְ/נַפְשׁ֣/וֹ מִ/כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר יִתְאַוֶּ֗ה וְ/לֹֽא יַשְׁלִיטֶ֤/נּוּ הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ לֶ/אֱכֹ֣ל מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ כִּ֛י אִ֥ישׁ נָכְרִ֖י יֹֽאכֲלֶ֑/נּוּ זֶ֥ה הֶ֛בֶל וָ/חֳלִ֥י רָ֖ע הֽוּא
verses.translit: 'ysh 'shr ytn lv h'lhym 'shr vnkhsym vkhbvd v'ynnv chsr lnpshv mkhl 'shr yt'vh vl' yshlytnv h'lhym l'khl mmnv khy 'ysh nkhry y'khlnv zh hbl vchly r' hv'
verses.translation: A man to whom God hath given riches, wealth, and honour, so that he wanteth nothing for his soul of all that he desireth, yet God giveth him not power to eat thereof, but a stranger eateth it: this is vanity, and it is an evil disease.

verses.original: אִם יוֹלִ֣יד אִ֣ישׁ מֵאָ֡ה וְ/שָׁנִים֩ רַבּ֨וֹת יִֽחְיֶ֜ה וְ/רַ֣ב שֶׁ/יִּהְי֣וּ יְמֵֽי שָׁנָ֗י/ו וְ/נַפְשׁ/וֹ֙ לֹא תִשְׂבַּ֣ע מִן הַ/טּוֹבָ֔ה וְ/גַם קְבוּרָ֖ה לֹא הָ֣יְתָה לּ֑/וֹ אָמַ֕רְתִּי ט֥וֹב מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ הַ/נָּֽפֶל
verses.translit: 'm yvlyd 'ysh m'h vshnym rbvt ychyh vrb shyhyv ymy shnyv vnpshv l' tshb' mn htvbh vgm qbvrh l' hyth lv 'mrty tvb mmnv hnpl
verses.translation: If a man beget an hundred children , and live many years, so that the days of his years be many, and his soul be not filled with good, and also that he have no burial; I say, that an untimely birth is better than he.

verses.translit: khy bhbl b' vbchshkh ylkh vbchshkh shmv ykhsh
verses.translation: For he cometh in with vanity, and departeth in darkness, and his name shall be covered with darkness.

verses.original: גַּם שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ לֹא רָאָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֣א יָדָ֑ע נַ֥חַת לָ/זֶ֖ה מִ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: gm shmsh l' r'h vl' yd' ncht lzh mzh
verses.translation: Moreover he hath not seen the sun, nor known any thing: this hath more rest than the other.

verses.original: וְ/אִלּ֣וּ חָיָ֗ה אֶ֤לֶף שָׁנִים֙ פַּעֲמַ֔יִם וְ/טוֹבָ֖ה לֹ֣א רָאָ֑ה הֲ/לֹ֛א אֶל מָק֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד הַ/כֹּ֥ל הוֹלֵֽךְ
verses.translit: v'lv chyh 'lf shnym p'mym vtvbh l' r'h hl' 'l mqvm 'chd hkhl hvlkh
verses.translation: Yea, though he live a thousand years twice told , yet hath he seen no good: do not all go to one place?

verses.original: כָּל עֲמַ֥ל הָ/אָדָ֖ם לְ/פִ֑י/הוּ וְ/גַם הַ/נֶּ֖פֶשׁ לֹ֥א תִמָּלֵֽא
verses.translit: khl 'ml h'dm lpyhv vgm hnpsh l' tml'
verses.translation: All the labour of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.

verses.original: כִּ֛י מַה יּוֹתֵ֥ר לֶ/חָכָ֖ם מִֽן הַ/כְּסִ֑יל מַה לֶּ/עָנִ֣י יוֹדֵ֔עַ לַ/הֲלֹ֖ךְ נֶ֥גֶד הַ/חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: khy mh yvtr lchkhm mn hkhsyl mh l'ny yvd' lhlkh ngd hchyym
verses.translation: For what hath the wise more than the fool? what hath the poor, that knoweth to walk before the living?

verses.original: ט֛וֹב מַרְאֵ֥ה עֵינַ֖יִם מֵֽ/הֲלָךְ נָ֑פֶשׁ גַּם זֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל וּ/רְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: tvb mr'h 'ynym mhlkh npsh gm zh hbl vr'vt rvch
verses.translation: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire: this is also vanity and vexation of spirit.

verses.original: מַה שֶּֽׁ/הָיָ֗ה כְּבָר֙ נִקְרָ֣א שְׁמ֔/וֹ וְ/נוֹדָ֖ע אֲשֶׁר ה֣וּא אָדָ֑ם וְ/לֹא יוּכַ֣ל לָ/דִ֔ין עִ֥ם ש/התקיף שֶׁ/תַּקִּ֖יף מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: mh shhyh khbr nqr' shmv vnvd' 'shr hv' 'dm vl' yvkhl ldyn 'm shhtqyf shtqyf mmnv
verses.translation: That which hath been is named already, and it is known that it is man: neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he.

verses.original: כִּ֛י יֵשׁ דְּבָרִ֥ים הַרְבֵּ֖ה מַרְבִּ֣ים הָ֑בֶל מַה יֹּתֵ֖ר לָ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: khy ysh dbrym hrbh mrbym hbl mh ytr l'dm
verses.translation: Seeing there be many things that increase vanity, what is man the better?

verses.original: כִּ֣י מִֽי יוֹדֵעַ֩ מַה טּ֨וֹב לָֽ/אָדָ֜ם בַּֽ/חַיִּ֗ים מִסְפַּ֛ר יְמֵי חַיֵּ֥י הֶבְל֖/וֹ וְ/יַעֲשֵׂ֣/ם כַּ/צֵּ֑ל אֲשֶׁר֙ מִֽי יַגִּ֣יד לָֽ/אָדָ֔ם מַה יִּהְיֶ֥ה אַחֲרָ֖י/ו תַּ֥חַת הַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: khy my yvd' mh tvb l'dm bchyym mspr ymy chyy hblv vy'shm khtsl 'shr my ygyd l'dm mh yhyh 'chryv tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: For who knoweth what is good for man in this life, all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun?

verses.original: ט֥וֹב שֵׁ֖ם מִ/שֶּׁ֣מֶן ט֑וֹב וְ/י֣וֹם הַ/מָּ֔וֶת מִ/יּ֖וֹם הִוָּלְדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: tvb shm mshmn tvb vyvm hmvt myvm hvldv
verses.translation: A good name is better than precious ointment; and the day of death than the day of one’s birth.

verses.original: ט֞וֹב לָ/לֶ֣כֶת אֶל בֵּֽית אֵ֗בֶל מִ/לֶּ֨כֶת֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית מִשְׁתֶּ֔ה בַּ/אֲשֶׁ֕ר ה֖וּא ס֣וֹף כָּל הָ/אָדָ֑ם וְ/הַ/חַ֖י יִתֵּ֥ן אֶל לִבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: tvb llkht 'l byt 'bl mlkht 'l byt mshth b'shr hv' svf khl h'dm vhchy ytn 'l lbv
verses.translation: It is better to go to the house of mourning, than to go to the house of feasting: for that is the end of all men; and the living will lay it to his heart.

verses.original: ט֥וֹב כַּ֖עַס מִ/שְּׂחֹ֑ק כִּֽי בְ/רֹ֥עַ פָּנִ֖ים יִ֥יטַב לֵֽב
verses.translit: tvb kh's mshchq khy br' pnym yytb lb
verses.translation: Sorrow is better than laughter: for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better.

verses.original: לֵ֤ב חֲכָמִים֙ בְּ/בֵ֣ית אֵ֔בֶל וְ/לֵ֥ב כְּסִילִ֖ים בְּ/בֵ֥ית שִׂמְחָֽה
verses.translit: lb chkhmym bbyt 'bl vlb khsylym bbyt shmchh
verses.translation: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.

verses.original: ט֕וֹב לִ/שְׁמֹ֖עַ גַּעֲרַ֣ת חָכָ֑ם מֵ/אִ֕ישׁ שֹׁמֵ֖עַ שִׁ֥יר כְּסִילִֽים
verses.translit: tvb lshm' g'rt chkhm m'ysh shm' shyr khsylym
verses.translation: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise, than for a man to hear the song of fools.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כְ/ק֤וֹל הַ/סִּירִים֙ תַּ֣חַת הַ/סִּ֔יר כֵּ֖ן שְׂחֹ֣ק הַ/כְּסִ֑יל וְ/גַם זֶ֖ה הָֽבֶל
verses.translit: khy khqvl hsyrym tcht hsyr khn shchq hkhsyl vgm zh hbl
verses.translation: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool: this also is vanity.

verses.original: כִּ֥י הָ/עֹ֖שֶׁק יְהוֹלֵ֣ל חָכָ֑ם וִֽ/יאַבֵּ֥ד אֶת לֵ֖ב מַתָּנָֽה
verses.translit: khy h'shq yhvll chkhm vy'bd 't lb mtnh
verses.translation: Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; and a gift destroyeth the heart.

verses.original: ט֛וֹב אַחֲרִ֥ית דָּבָ֖ר מֵֽ/רֵאשִׁית֑/וֹ ט֥וֹב אֶֽרֶךְ ר֖וּחַ מִ/גְּבַהּ רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: tvb 'chryt dbr mr'shytv tvb 'rkh rvch mgbh rvch
verses.translation: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.

verses.original: אַל תְּבַהֵ֥ל בְּ/רֽוּחֲ/ךָ֖ לִ/כְע֑וֹס כִּ֣י כַ֔עַס בְּ/חֵ֥יק כְּסִילִ֖ים יָנֽוּחַ
verses.translit: 'l tbhl brvchkh lkh'vs khy kh's bchyq khsylym ynvch
verses.translation: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.

verses.original: אַל תֹּאמַר֙ מֶ֣ה הָיָ֔ה שֶׁ֤/הַ/יָּמִים֙ הָ/רִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים הָי֥וּ טוֹבִ֖ים מֵ/אֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֛י לֹ֥א מֵ/חָכְמָ֖ה שָׁאַ֥לְתָּ עַל זֶֽה
verses.translit: 'l t'mr mh hyh shhymym hr'shnym hyv tvbym m'lh khy l' mchkhmh sh'lt 'l zh
verses.translation: Say not thou, What is the cause that the former days were better than these? for thou dost not enquire wisely concerning this.

verses.original: טוֹבָ֥ה חָכְמָ֖ה עִֽם נַחֲלָ֑ה וְ/יֹתֵ֖ר לְ/רֹאֵ֥י הַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: tvbh chkhmh 'm nchlh vytr lr'y hshmsh
verses.translation: Wisdom is good with an inheritance: and by it there is profit to them that see the sun.

verses.original: כִּ֛י בְּ/צֵ֥ל הַֽ/חָכְמָ֖ה בְּ/צֵ֣ל הַ/כָּ֑סֶף וְ/יִתְר֣וֹן דַּ֔עַת הַֽ/חָכְמָ֖ה תְּחַיֶּ֥ה בְעָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: khy btsl hchkhmh btsl hkhsf vytrvn d't hchkhmh tchyh b'lyh
verses.translation: For wisdom is a defence, and money is a defence: but the excellency of knowledge is, that wisdom giveth life to them that have it.

verses.original: רְאֵ֖ה אֶת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֣י מִ֤י יוּכַל֙ לְ/תַקֵּ֔ן אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִוְּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: r'h 't m'shh h'lhym khy my yvkhl ltqn 't 'shr 'vtv
verses.translation: Consider the work of God: for who can make that straight, which he hath made crooked?

verses.original: בְּ/י֤וֹם טוֹבָה֙ הֱיֵ֣ה בְ/ט֔וֹב וּ/בְ/י֥וֹם רָעָ֖ה רְאֵ֑ה גַּ֣ם אֶת זֶ֤ה לְ/עֻמַּת זֶה֙ עָשָׂ֣ה הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים עַל דִּבְרַ֗ת שֶׁ/לֹּ֨א יִמְצָ֧א הָֽ/אָדָ֛ם אַחֲרָ֖י/ו מְאֽוּמָה
verses.translit: byvm tvbh hyh btvb vbyvm r'h r'h gm 't zh l'mt zh 'shh h'lhym 'l dbrt shl' ymts' h'dm 'chryv m'vmh
verses.translation: In the day of prosperity be joyful, but in the day of adversity consider: God also hath set the one over against the other, to the end that man should find nothing after him.

verses.original: אֶת הַ/כֹּ֥ל רָאִ֖יתִי בִּ/ימֵ֣י הֶבְלִ֑/י יֵ֤שׁ צַדִּיק֙ אֹבֵ֣ד בְּ/צִדְק֔/וֹ וְ/יֵ֣שׁ רָשָׁ֔ע מַאֲרִ֖יךְ בְּ/רָעָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 't hkhl r'yty bymy hbly ysh tsdyq 'bd btsdqv vysh rsh' m'rykh br'tv
verses.translation: All things have I seen in the days of my vanity: there is a just man that perisheth in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man that prolongeth his life in his wickedness.

verses.original: אַל תְּהִ֤י צַדִּיק֙ הַרְבֵּ֔ה וְ/אַל תִּתְחַכַּ֖ם יוֹתֵ֑ר לָ֖/מָּה תִּשּׁוֹמֵֽם
verses.translit: 'l thy tsdyq hrbh v'l ttchkhm yvtr lmh tshvmm
verses.translation: Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over wise: why shouldest thou destroy thyself?

verses.original: אַל תִּרְשַׁ֥ע הַרְבֵּ֖ה וְ/אַל תְּהִ֣י סָכָ֑ל לָ֥/מָּה תָמ֖וּת בְּ/לֹ֥א עִתֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'l trsh' hrbh v'l thy skhl lmh tmvt bl' 'tkh
verses.translation: Be not over much wicked, neither be thou foolish: why shouldest thou die before thy time?

verses.original: ט֚וֹב אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֶּאֱחֹ֣ז בָּ/זֶ֔ה וְ/גַם מִ/זֶּ֖ה אַל תַּנַּ֣ח אֶת יָדֶ֑/ךָ כִּֽי יְרֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים יֵצֵ֥א אֶת כֻּלָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: tvb 'shr t'chz bzh vgm mzh 'l tnch 't ydkh khy yr' 'lhym yts' 't khlm
verses.translation: It is good that thou shouldest take hold of this; yea, also from this withdraw not thine hand: for he that feareth God shall come forth of them all.

verses.original: הַֽ/חָכְמָ֖ה תָּעֹ֣ז לֶ/חָכָ֑ם מֵֽ/עֲשָׂרָה֙ שַׁלִּיטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֖וּ בָּ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: hchkhmh t'z lchkhm m'shrh shlytym 'shr hyv b'yr
verses.translation: Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אָדָ֔ם אֵ֥ין צַדִּ֖יק בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲשֶׂה טּ֖וֹב וְ/לֹ֥א יֶחֱטָֽא
verses.translit: khy 'dm 'yn tsdyq b'rts 'shr y'shh tvb vl' ycht'
verses.translation: For there is not a just man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.

verses.original: גַּ֤ם לְ/כָל הַ/דְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ אַל תִּתֵּ֖ן לִבֶּ֑/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא תִשְׁמַ֥ע אֶֽת עַבְדְּ/ךָ֖ מְקַלְלֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: gm lkhl hdbrym 'shr ydbrv 'l ttn lbkh 'shr l' tshm' 't 'bdkh mqllkh
verses.translation: Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee:

verses.original: כִּ֛י גַּם פְּעָמִ֥ים רַבּ֖וֹת יָדַ֣ע לִבֶּ֑/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר גַּם את אַתָּ֖ה קִלַּ֥לְתָּ אֲחֵרִֽים
verses.translit: khy gm p'mym rbvt yd' lbkh 'shr gm 't 'th qllt 'chrym
verses.translation: For oftentimes also thine own heart knoweth that thou thyself likewise hast cursed others.

verses.original: כָּל זֹ֖ה נִסִּ֣יתִי בַֽ/חָכְמָ֑ה אָמַ֣רְתִּי אֶחְכָּ֔מָה וְ/הִ֖יא רְחוֹקָ֥ה מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: khl zh nsyty bchkhmh 'mrty 'chkhmh vhy' rchvqh mmny
verses.translation: All this have I proved by wisdom: I said, I will be wise; but it was far from me.

verses.original: רָח֖וֹק מַה שֶּׁ/הָיָ֑ה וְ/עָמֹ֥ק עָמֹ֖ק מִ֥י יִמְצָאֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: rchvq mh shhyh v'mq 'mq my ymts'nv
verses.translation: That which is far off, and exceeding deep, who can find it out?

verses.original: סַבּ֨וֹתִֽי אֲנִ֤י וְ/לִבִּ/י֙ לָ/דַ֣עַת וְ/לָ/ת֔וּר וּ/בַקֵּ֥שׁ חָכְמָ֖ה וְ/חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן וְ/לָ/דַ֨עַת֙ רֶ֣שַׁע כֶּ֔סֶל וְ/הַ/סִּכְל֖וּת הוֹלֵלֽוֹת
verses.translit: sbvty 'ny vlby ld't vltvr vbqsh chkhmh vchshbvn vld't rsh' khsl vhskhlvt hvllvt
verses.translation: I applied mine heart to know, and to search, and to seek out wisdom, and the reason of things , and to know the wickedness of folly, even of foolishness and madness:

verses.original: וּ/מוֹצֶ֨א אֲנִ֜י מַ֣ר מִ/מָּ֗וֶת אֶת הָֽ/אִשָּׁה֙ אֲשֶׁר הִ֨יא מְצוֹדִ֧ים וַ/חֲרָמִ֛ים לִבָּ֖/הּ אֲסוּרִ֣ים יָדֶ֑י/הָ ט֞וֹב לִ/פְנֵ֤י הָ/אֱלֹהִים֙ יִמָּלֵ֣ט מִמֶּ֔/נָּה וְ/חוֹטֵ֖א יִלָּ֥כֶד בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vmvts' 'ny mr mmvt 't h'shh 'shr hy' mtsvdym vchrmym lbh 'svrym ydyh tvb lpny h'lhym ymlt mmnh vchvt' ylkhd bh
verses.translation: And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart is snares and nets, and her hands as bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her.

verses.original: רְאֵה֙ זֶ֣ה מָצָ֔אתִי אָמְרָ֖ה קֹהֶ֑לֶת אַחַ֥ת לְ/אַחַ֖ת לִ/מְצֹ֥א חֶשְׁבּֽוֹן
verses.translit: r'h zh mts'ty 'mrh qhlt 'cht l'cht lmts' chshbvn
verses.translation: Behold, this have I found, saith the preacher, counting one by one, to find out the account:

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֛ר עוֹד בִּקְשָׁ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖/י וְ/לֹ֣א מָצָ֑אתִי אָדָ֞ם אֶחָ֤ד מֵ/אֶ֨לֶף֙ מָצָ֔אתִי וְ/אִשָּׁ֥ה בְ/כָל אֵ֖לֶּה לֹ֥א מָצָֽאתִי
verses.translit: 'shr 'vd bqshh npshy vl' mts'ty 'dm 'chd m'lf mts'ty v'shh bkhl 'lh l' mts'ty
verses.translation: Which yet my soul seeketh, but I find not: one man among a thousand have I found; but a woman among all those have I not found.

verses.original: לְ/בַד֙ רְאֵה זֶ֣ה מָצָ֔אתִי אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֧ה הָ/אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת הָ/אָדָ֖ם יָשָׁ֑ר וְ/הֵ֥מָּה בִקְשׁ֖וּ חִשְּׁבֹנ֥וֹת רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: lbd r'h zh mts'ty 'shr 'shh h'lhym 't h'dm yshr vhmh bqshv chshbnvt rbym
verses.translation: Lo, this only have I found, that God hath made man upright; but they have sought out many inventions.

verses.original: מִ֚י כְּ/הֶ֣/חָכָ֔ם וּ/מִ֥י יוֹדֵ֖עַ פֵּ֣שֶׁר דָּבָ֑ר חָכְמַ֤ת אָדָם֙ תָּאִ֣יר פָּנָ֔י/ו וְ/עֹ֥ז פָּנָ֖י/ו יְשֻׁנֶּֽא
verses.translit: my khhchkhm vmy yvd' pshr dbr chkhmt 'dm t'yr pnyv v'z pnyv yshn'
verses.translation: Who is as the wise man ? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing? a man’s wisdom maketh his face to shine, and the boldness of his face shall be changed.

verses.original: אֲנִי֙ פִּי מֶ֣לֶךְ שְׁמ֔וֹר וְ/עַ֕ל דִּבְרַ֖ת שְׁבוּעַ֥ת אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: 'ny py mlkh shmvr v'l dbrt shbv't 'lhym
verses.translation: I counsel thee to keep the king’s commandment, and that in regard of the oath of God.

verses.original: אַל תִּבָּהֵ֤ל מִ/פָּנָי/ו֙ תֵּלֵ֔ךְ אַֽל תַּעֲמֹ֖ד בְּ/דָבָ֣ר רָ֑ע כִּ֛י כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַחְפֹּ֖ץ יַעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: 'l tbhl mpnyv tlkh 'l t'md bdbr r' khy khl 'shr ychpts y'shh
verses.translation: Be not hasty to go out of his sight: stand not in an evil thing; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him.

verses.original: בַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר דְּבַר מֶ֖לֶךְ שִׁלְט֑וֹן וּ/מִ֥י יֹֽאמַר ל֖/וֹ מַֽה תַּעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: b'shr dbr mlkh shltvn vmy y'mr lv mh t'shh
verses.translation: Where the word of a king is, there is power: and who may say unto him, What doest thou?

verses.original: שׁוֹמֵ֣ר מִצְוָ֔ה לֹ֥א יֵדַ֖ע דָּבָ֣ר רָ֑ע וְ/עֵ֣ת וּ/מִשְׁפָּ֔ט יֵדַ֖ע לֵ֥ב חָכָֽם
verses.translit: shvmr mtsvh l' yd' dbr r' v't vmshpt yd' lb chkhm
verses.translation: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing: and a wise man’s heart discerneth both time and judgment.

verses.original: כִּ֣י לְ/כָל חֵ֔פֶץ יֵ֖שׁ עֵ֣ת וּ/מִשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּֽי רָעַ֥ת הָ/אָדָ֖ם רַבָּ֥ה עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: khy lkhl chpts ysh 't vmshpt khy r't h'dm rbh 'lyv
verses.translation: Because to every purpose there is time and judgment, therefore the misery of man is great upon him.

verses.original: כִּֽי אֵינֶ֥/נּוּ יֹדֵ֖עַ מַה שֶּׁ/יִּֽהְיֶ֑ה כִּ֚י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִֽהְיֶ֔ה מִ֖י יַגִּ֥יד לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy 'ynnv yd' mh shyhyh khy kh'shr yhyh my ygyd lv
verses.translation: For he knoweth not that which shall be: for who can tell him when it shall be?

verses.original: אֵ֣ין אָדָ֞ם שַׁלִּ֤יט בָּ/ר֨וּחַ֙ לִ/כְל֣וֹא אֶת הָ/ר֔וּחַ וְ/אֵ֤ין שִׁלְטוֹן֙ בְּ/י֣וֹם הַ/מָּ֔וֶת וְ/אֵ֥ין מִשְׁלַ֖חַת בַּ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְ/לֹֽא יְמַלֵּ֥ט רֶ֖שַׁע אֶת בְּעָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'yn 'dm shlyt brvch lkhlv' 't hrvch v'yn shltvn byvm hmvt v'yn mshlcht bmlchmh vl' ymlt rsh' 't b'lyv
verses.translation: There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit; neither hath he power in the day of death: and there is no discharge in that war; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it.

verses.original: אֶת כָּל זֶ֤ה רָאִ֨יתִי֙ וְ/נָת֣וֹן אֶת לִבִּ֔/י לְ/כָֽל מַעֲשֶׂ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשָׂ֖ה תַּ֣חַת הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ עֵ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁלַ֧ט הָ/אָדָ֛ם בְּ/אָדָ֖ם לְ/רַ֥ע לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 't khl zh r'yty vntvn 't lby lkhl m'shh 'shr n'shh tcht hshmsh 't 'shr shlt h'dm b'dm lr' lv
verses.translation: All this have I seen, and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun: there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/כֵ֡ן רָאִיתִי֩ רְשָׁעִ֨ים קְבֻרִ֜ים וָ/בָ֗אוּ וּ/מִ/מְּק֤וֹם קָדוֹשׁ֙ יְהַלֵּ֔כוּ וְ/יִֽשְׁתַּכְּח֥וּ בָ/עִ֖יר אֲשֶׁ֣ר כֵּן עָשׂ֑וּ גַּם זֶ֖ה הָֽבֶל
verses.translit: vbkhn r'yty rsh'ym qbrym vb'v vmmqvm qdvsh yhlkhv vyshtkhchv b'yr 'shr khn 'shv gm zh hbl
verses.translation: And so I saw the wicked buried, who had come and gone from the place of the holy, and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done: this is also vanity.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר֙ אֵין נַעֲשָׂ֣ה פִתְגָ֔ם מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הָ/רָעָ֖ה מְהֵרָ֑ה עַל כֵּ֡ן מָלֵ֞א לֵ֧ב בְּֽנֵי הָ/אָדָ֛ם בָּ/הֶ֖ם לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת רָֽע
verses.translit: 'shr 'yn n'shh ptgm m'shh hr'h mhrh 'l khn ml' lb bny h'dm bhm l'shvt r'
verses.translation: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֹטֶ֗א עֹשֶׂ֥ה רָ֛ע מְאַ֖ת וּ/מַאֲרִ֣יךְ ל֑/וֹ כִּ֚י גַּם יוֹדֵ֣עַ אָ֔נִי אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִהְיֶה טּוֹב֙ לְ/יִרְאֵ֣י הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִֽירְא֖וּ מִ/לְּ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'shr cht' 'shh r' m't vm'rykh lv khy gm yvd' 'ny 'shr yhyh tvb lyr'y h'lhym 'shr yyr'v mlpnyv
verses.translation: Though a sinner do evil an hundred times, and his days be prolonged, yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God, which fear before him:

verses.original: וְ/טוֹב֙ לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֣ה לָֽ/רָשָׁ֔ע וְ/לֹֽא יַאֲרִ֥יךְ יָמִ֖ים כַּ/צֵּ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֵינֶ֥/נּוּ יָרֵ֖א מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vtvb l' yhyh lrsh' vl' y'rykh ymym khtsl 'shr 'ynnv yr' mlpny 'lhym
verses.translation: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong his days, which are as a shadow; because he feareth not before God.

verses.original: יֶשׁ הֶבֶל֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נַעֲשָׂ֣ה עַל הָ/אָרֶץ֒ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵ֣שׁ צַדִּיקִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר מַגִּ֤יעַ אֲלֵ/הֶם֙ כְּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה הָ/רְשָׁעִ֔ים וְ/יֵ֣שׁ רְשָׁעִ֔ים שֶׁ/מַּגִּ֥יעַ אֲלֵ/הֶ֖ם כְּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה הַ/צַּדִּיקִ֑ים אָמַ֕רְתִּי שֶׁ/גַּם זֶ֖ה הָֽבֶל
verses.translit: ysh hbl 'shr n'shh 'l h'rts 'shr ysh tsdyqym 'shr mgy' 'lhm khm'shh hrsh'ym vysh rsh'ym shmgy' 'lhm khm'shh htsdyqym 'mrty shgm zh hbl
verses.translation: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth; that there be just men , unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked; again, there be wicked men , to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous: I said that this also is vanity.

verses.original: וְ/שִׁבַּ֤חְתִּֽי אֲנִי֙ אֶת הַ/שִּׂמְחָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֵֽין ט֤וֹב לָֽ/אָדָם֙ תַּ֣חַת הַ/שֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ כִּ֛י אִם לֶ/אֱכ֥וֹל וְ/לִ/שְׁתּ֖וֹת וְ/לִ/שְׂמ֑וֹחַ וְ/ה֞וּא יִלְוֶ֣/נּוּ בַ/עֲמָל֗/וֹ יְמֵ֥י חַיָּ֛י/ו אֲשֶׁר נָֽתַן ל֥/וֹ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים תַּ֥חַת הַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: vshbchty 'ny 't hshmchh 'shr 'yn tvb l'dm tcht hshmsh khy 'm l'khvl vlshtvt vlshmvch vhv' ylvnv b'mlv ymy chyyv 'shr ntn lv h'lhym tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: Then I commended mirth, because a man hath no better thing under the sun, than to eat, and to drink, and to be merry: for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life, which God giveth him under the sun.

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤תִּי אֶת לִבִּ/י֙ לָ/דַ֣עַת חָכְמָ֔ה וְ/לִ/רְאוֹת֙ אֶת הָ֣/עִנְיָ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשָׂ֖ה עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֣י גַ֤ם בַּ/יּוֹם֙ וּ/בַ/לַּ֔יְלָה שֵׁנָ֕ה בְּ/עֵינָ֖י/ו אֵינֶ֥/נּוּ רֹאֶֽה
verses.translit: kh'shr ntty 't lby ld't chkhmh vlr'vt 't h'nyn 'shr n'shh 'l h'rts khy gm byvm vblylh shnh b'ynyv 'ynnv r'h
verses.translation: When I applied mine heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done upon the earth: (for also there is that neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes:)

verses.original: וְ/רָאִיתִי֮ אֶת כָּל מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה הָ/אֱלֹהִים֒ כִּי֩ לֹ֨א יוּכַ֜ל הָ/אָדָ֗ם לִ/מְצוֹא֙ אֶת הַֽ/מַּעֲשֶׂה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נַעֲשָׂ֣ה תַֽחַת הַ/שֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ בְּ֠/שֶׁ/ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲמֹ֧ל הָ/אָדָ֛ם לְ/בַקֵּ֖שׁ וְ/לֹ֣א יִמְצָ֑א וְ/גַ֨ם אִם יֹאמַ֤ר הֶֽ/חָכָם֙ לָ/דַ֔עַת לֹ֥א יוּכַ֖ל לִ/מְצֹֽא
verses.translit: vr'yty 't khl m'shh h'lhym khy l' yvkhl h'dm lmtsv' 't hm'shh 'shr n'shh tcht hshmsh bshl 'shr y'ml h'dm lbqsh vl' ymts' vgm 'm y'mr hchkhm ld't l' yvkhl lmts'
verses.translation: Then I beheld all the work of God, that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun: because though a man labour to seek it out, yet he shall not find it; yea further; though a wise man think to know it , yet shall he not be able to find it .

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֶת כָּל זֶ֞ה נָתַ֤תִּי אֶל לִבִּ/י֙ וְ/לָ/ב֣וּר אֶת כָּל זֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הַ/צַּדִּיקִ֧ים וְ/הַ/חֲכָמִ֛ים וַ/עֲבָדֵי/הֶ֖ם בְּ/יַ֣ד הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים גַּֽם אַהֲבָ֣ה גַם שִׂנְאָ֗ה אֵ֤ין יוֹדֵ֨עַ֙ הָֽ/אָדָ֔ם הַ/כֹּ֖ל לִ/פְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khy 't khl zh ntty 'l lby vlbvr 't khl zh 'shr htsdyqym vhchkhmym v'bdyhm byd h'lhym gm 'hbh gm shn'h 'yn yvd' h'dm hkhl lpnyhm
verses.translation: For all this I considered in my heart even to declare all this, that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in the hand of God: no man knoweth either love or hatred by all that is before them.

verses.original: הַ/כֹּ֞ל כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַ/כֹּ֗ל מִקְרֶ֨ה אֶחָ֜ד לַ/צַּדִּ֤יק וְ/לָ/רָשָׁע֙ לַ/טּוֹב֙ וְ/לַ/טָּה֣וֹר וְ/לַ/טָּמֵ֔א וְ/לַ/זֹּבֵ֔חַ וְ/לַ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֵינֶ֣/נּוּ זֹבֵ֑חַ כַּ/טּוֹב֙ כַּֽ/חֹטֶ֔א הַ/נִּשְׁבָּ֕ע כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר שְׁבוּעָ֥ה יָרֵֽא
verses.translit: hkhl kh'shr lkhl mqrh 'chd ltsdyq vlrsh' ltvb vlthvr vltm' vlzbch vl'shr 'ynnv zbch khtvb khcht' hnshb' kh'shr shbv'h yr'
verses.translation: All things come alike to all: there is one event to the righteous, and to the wicked; to the good and to the clean, and to the unclean; to him that sacrificeth, and to him that sacrificeth not: as is the good, so is the sinner; and he that sweareth, as he that feareth an oath.

verses.original: זֶ֣ה רָ֗ע בְּ/כֹ֤ל אֲשֶֽׁר נַעֲשָׂה֙ תַּ֣חַת הַ/שֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ כִּֽי מִקְרֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד לַ/כֹּ֑ל וְ/גַ֣ם לֵ֣ב בְּֽנֵי הָ֠/אָדָם מָלֵא רָ֨ע וְ/הוֹלֵל֤וֹת בִּ/לְבָבָ/ם֙ בְּ/חַיֵּי/הֶ֔ם וְ/אַחֲרָ֖י/ו אֶל הַ/מֵּתִֽים
verses.translit: zh r' bkhl 'shr n'shh tcht hshmsh khy mqrh 'chd lkhl vgm lb bny h'dm ml' r' vhvllvt blbbm bchyyhm v'chryv 'l hmtym
verses.translation: This is an evil among all things that are done under the sun, that there is one event unto all: yea, also the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.

verses.original: כִּי מִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יבחר יְחֻבַּ֔ר אֶ֥ל כָּל הַ/חַיִּ֖ים יֵ֣שׁ בִּטָּח֑וֹן כִּֽי לְ/כֶ֤לֶב חַי֙ ה֣וּא ט֔וֹב מִן הָ/אַרְיֵ֖ה הַ/מֵּֽת
verses.translit: khy my 'shr ybchr ychbr 'l khl hchyym ysh btchvn khy lkhlb chy hv' tvb mn h'ryh hmt
verses.translation: For to him that is joined to all the living there is hope: for a living dog is better than a dead lion.

verses.original: כִּ֧י הַֽ/חַיִּ֛ים יוֹדְעִ֖ים שֶׁ/יָּמֻ֑תוּ וְ/הַ/מֵּתִ֞ים אֵינָ֧/ם יוֹדְעִ֣ים מְא֗וּמָה וְ/אֵֽין ע֤וֹד לָ/הֶם֙ שָׂכָ֔ר כִּ֥י נִשְׁכַּ֖ח זִכְרָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy hchyym yvd'ym shymtv vhmtym 'ynm yvd'ym m'vmh v'yn 'vd lhm shkhr khy nshkhch zkhrm
verses.translation: For the living know that they shall die: but the dead know not any thing, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם אַהֲבָתָ֧/ם גַּם שִׂנְאָתָ֛/ם גַּם קִנְאָתָ֖/ם כְּבָ֣ר אָבָ֑דָה וְ/חֵ֨לֶק אֵין לָ/הֶ֥ם עוֹד֙ לְ/עוֹלָ֔ם בְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶֽׁר נַעֲשָׂ֖ה תַּ֥חַת הַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: gm 'hbtm gm shn'tm gm qn'tm khbr 'bdh vchlq 'yn lhm 'vd l'vlm bkhl 'shr n'shh tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: Also their love, and their hatred, and their envy, is now perished; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun.

verses.original: לֵ֣ךְ אֱכֹ֤ל בְּ/שִׂמְחָה֙ לַחְמֶ֔/ךָ וּֽ/שֲׁתֵ֥ה בְ/לֶב ט֖וֹב יֵינֶ֑/ךָ כִּ֣י כְבָ֔ר רָצָ֥ה הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶֽת מַעֲשֶֽׂי/ךָ
verses.translit: lkh 'khl bshmchh lchmkh vshth blb tvb yynkh khy khbr rtsh h'lhym 't m'shykh
verses.translation: Go thy way, eat thy bread with joy, and drink thy wine with a merry heart; for God now accepteth thy works.

verses.original: בְּ/כָל עֵ֕ת יִהְי֥וּ בְגָדֶ֖י/ךָ לְבָנִ֑ים וְ/שֶׁ֖מֶן עַל רֹאשְׁ/ךָ֥ אַל יֶחְסָֽר
verses.translit: bkhl 't yhyv bgdykh lbnym vshmn 'l r'shkh 'l ychsr
verses.translation: Let thy garments be always white; and let thy head lack no ointment.

verses.original: רְאֵ֨ה חַיִּ֜ים עִם אִשָּׁ֣ה אֲשֶׁר אָהַ֗בְתָּ כָּל יְמֵי֙ חַיֵּ֣י הֶבְלֶ֔/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽתַן לְ/ךָ֙ תַּ֣חַת הַ/שֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י הֶבְלֶ֑/ךָ כִּ֣י ה֤וּא חֶלְקְ/ךָ֙ בַּֽ/חַיִּ֔ים וּ/בַ/עֲמָ֣לְ/ךָ֔ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֥ה עָמֵ֖ל תַּ֥חַת הַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: r'h chyym 'm 'shh 'shr 'hbt khl ymy chyy hblkh 'shr ntn lkh tcht hshmsh khl ymy hblkh khy hv' chlqkh bchyym vb'mlkh 'shr 'th 'ml tcht hshmsh
verses.translation: Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun, all the days of thy vanity: for that is thy portion in this life, and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun.

verses.original: כֹּ֠ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּמְצָ֧א יָֽדְ/ךָ֛ לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת בְּ/כֹחֲ/ךָ֖ עֲשֵׂ֑ה כִּי֩ אֵ֨ין מַעֲשֶׂ֤ה וְ/חֶשְׁבּוֹן֙ וְ/דַ֣עַת וְ/חָכְמָ֔ה בִּ/שְׁא֕וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה הֹלֵ֥ךְ שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: khl 'shr tmts' ydkh l'shvt bkhchkh 'shh khy 'yn m'shh vchshbvn vd't vchkhmh bsh'vl 'shr 'th hlkh shmh
verses.translation: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might; for there is no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.

verses.original: שַׁ֜בְתִּי וְ/רָאֹ֣ה תַֽחַת הַ/שֶּׁ֗מֶשׁ כִּ֣י לֹא֩ לַ/קַּלִּ֨ים הַ/מֵּר֜וֹץ וְ/לֹ֧א לַ/גִּבּוֹרִ֣ים הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֗ה וְ֠/גַם לֹ֣א לַ/חֲכָמִ֥ים לֶ֨חֶם֙ וְ/גַ֨ם לֹ֤א לַ/נְּבֹנִים֙ עֹ֔שֶׁר וְ/גַ֛ם לֹ֥א לַ/יֹּדְעִ֖ים חֵ֑ן כִּי עֵ֥ת וָ/פֶ֖גַע יִקְרֶ֥ה אֶת כֻּלָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: shbty vr'h tcht hshmsh khy l' lqlym hmrvts vl' lgbvrym hmlchmh vgm l' lchkhmym lchm vgm l' lnbnym 'shr vgm l' lyd'ym chn khy 't vpg' yqrh 't khlm
verses.translation: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.

verses.original: כִּ֡י גַּם֩ לֹֽא יֵדַ֨ע הָ/אָדָ֜ם אֶת עִתּ֗/וֹ כַּ/דָּגִים֙ שֶׁ/נֶּֽאֱחָזִים֙ בִּ/מְצוֹדָ֣ה רָעָ֔ה וְ/כַ֨/צִּפֳּרִ֔ים הָ/אֲחֻז֖וֹת בַּ/פָּ֑ח כָּ/הֵ֗ם יֽוּקָשִׁים֙ בְּנֵ֣י הָֽ/אָדָ֔ם לְ/עֵ֣ת רָעָ֔ה כְּ/שֶׁ/תִּפּ֥וֹל עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם פִּתְאֹֽם
verses.translit: khy gm l' yd' h'dm 't 'tv khdgym shn'chzym bmtsvdh r'h vkhtsprym h'chzvt bpch khhm yvqshym bny h'dm l't r'h khshtpvl 'lyhm pt'm
verses.translation: For man also knoweth not his time: as the fishes that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare; so are the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falleth suddenly upon them.

verses.original: גַּם זֹ֛ה רָאִ֥יתִי חָכְמָ֖ה תַּ֣חַת הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וּ/גְדוֹלָ֥ה הִ֖יא אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: gm zh r'yty chkhmh tcht hshmsh vgdvlh hy' 'ly
verses.translation: This wisdom have I seen also under the sun, and it seemed great unto me:

verses.original: עִ֣יר קְטַנָּ֔ה וַ/אֲנָשִׁ֥ים בָּ֖/הּ מְעָ֑ט וּ/בָֽא אֵלֶ֜י/הָ מֶ֤לֶךְ גָּדוֹל֙ וְ/סָבַ֣ב אֹתָ֔/הּ וּ/בָנָ֥ה עָלֶ֖י/הָ מְצוֹדִ֥ים גְּדֹלִֽים
verses.translit: 'yr qtnh v'nshym bh m't vb' 'lyh mlkh gdvl vsbb 'th vbnh 'lyh mtsvdym gdlym
verses.translation: There was a little city, and few men within it; and there came a great king against it, and besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it:

verses.original: וּ/מָ֣צָא בָ֗/הּ אִ֤ישׁ מִסְכֵּן֙ חָכָ֔ם וּ/מִלַּט ה֥וּא אֶת הָ/עִ֖יר בְּ/חָכְמָת֑/וֹ וְ/אָדָם֙ לֹ֣א זָכַ֔ר אֶת הָ/אִ֥ישׁ הַ/מִּסְכֵּ֖ן הַ/הּֽוּא
verses.translit: vmts' bh 'ysh mskhn chkhm vmlt hv' 't h'yr bchkhmtv v'dm l' zkhr 't h'ysh hmskhn hhv'
verses.translation: Now there was found in it a poor wise man, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.

verses.original: וְ/אָמַ֣רְתִּי אָ֔נִי טוֹבָ֥ה חָכְמָ֖ה מִ/גְּבוּרָ֑ה וְ/חָכְמַ֤ת הַ/מִּסְכֵּן֙ בְּזוּיָ֔ה וּ/דְבָרָ֖י/ו אֵינָ֥/ם נִשְׁמָעִֽים
verses.translit: v'mrty 'ny tvbh chkhmh mgbvrh vchkhmt hmskhn bzvyh vdbryv 'ynm nshm'ym
verses.translation: Then said I, Wisdom is better than strength: nevertheless the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֣י חֲכָמִ֔ים בְּ/נַ֖חַת נִשְׁמָעִ֑ים מִ/זַּעֲקַ֥ת מוֹשֵׁ֖ל בַּ/כְּסִילִֽים
verses.translit: dbry chkhmym bncht nshm'ym mz'qt mvshl bkhsylym
verses.translation: The words of wise men are heard in quiet more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools.

verses.original: טוֹבָ֥ה חָכְמָ֖ה מִ/כְּלֵ֣י קְרָ֑ב וְ/חוֹטֶ֣א אֶחָ֔ד יְאַבֵּ֥ד טוֹבָ֥ה הַרְבֵּֽה
verses.translit: tvbh chkhmh mkhly qrb vchvt' 'chd y'bd tvbh hrbh
verses.translation: Wisdom is better than weapons of war: but one sinner destroyeth much good.

verses.original: זְב֣וּבֵי מָ֔וֶת יַבְאִ֥ישׁ יַבִּ֖יעַ שֶׁ֣מֶן רוֹקֵ֑חַ יָקָ֛ר מֵ/חָכְמָ֥ה מִ/כָּב֖וֹד סִכְל֥וּת מְעָֽט
verses.translit: zbvby mvt yb'ysh yby' shmn rvqch yqr mchkhmh mkhbvd skhlvt m't
verses.translation: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour: so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour.

verses.original: לֵ֤ב חָכָם֙ לִֽ/ימִינ֔/וֹ וְ/לֵ֥ב כְּסִ֖יל לִ/שְׂמֹאלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lb chkhm lymynv vlb khsyl lshm'lv
verses.translation: A wise man’s heart is at his right hand; but a fool’s heart at his left.

verses.original: וְ/גַם בַּ/דֶּ֛רֶךְ כ/ש/ה/סכל כְּ/שֶׁ/סָּכָ֥ל הֹלֵ֖ךְ לִבּ֣/וֹ חָסֵ֑ר וְ/אָמַ֥ר לַ/כֹּ֖ל סָכָ֥ל הֽוּא
verses.translit: vgm bdrkh khshhskhl khshskhl hlkh lbv chsr v'mr lkhl skhl hv'
verses.translation: Yea also, when he that is a fool walketh by the way, his wisdom faileth him , and he saith to every one that he is a fool.

verses.original: אִם ר֤וּחַ הַ/מּוֹשֵׁל֙ תַּעֲלֶ֣ה עָלֶ֔י/ךָ מְקוֹמְ/ךָ֖ אַל תַּנַּ֑ח כִּ֣י מַרְפֵּ֔א יַנִּ֖יחַ חֲטָאִ֥ים גְּדוֹלִֽים
verses.translit: 'm rvch hmvshl t'lh 'lykh mqvmkh 'l tnch khy mrp' ynych cht'ym gdvlym
verses.translation: If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee, leave not thy place; for yielding pacifieth great offences.

verses.original: יֵ֣שׁ רָעָ֔ה רָאִ֖יתִי תַּ֣חַת הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ כִּ/שְׁגָגָ֕ה שֶׁ/יֹּצָ֖א מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/שַּׁלִּֽיט
verses.translit: ysh r'h r'yty tcht hshmsh khshggh shyts' mlpny hshlyt
verses.translation: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, as an error which proceedeth from the ruler:

verses.original: נִתַּ֣ן הַ/סֶּ֔כֶל בַּ/מְּרוֹמִ֖ים רַבִּ֑ים וַ/עֲשִׁירִ֖ים בַּ/שֵּׁ֥פֶל יֵשֵֽׁבוּ
verses.translit: ntn hskhl bmrvmym rbym v'shyrym bshpl yshbv
verses.translation: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in low place.

verses.original: רָאִ֥יתִי עֲבָדִ֖ים עַל סוּסִ֑ים וְ/שָׂרִ֛ים הֹלְכִ֥ים כַּ/עֲבָדִ֖ים עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: r'yty 'bdym 'l svsym vshrym hlkhym kh'bdym 'l h'rts
verses.translation: I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth.

verses.original: חֹפֵ֥ר גּוּמָּ֖ץ בּ֣/וֹ יִפּ֑וֹל וּ/פֹרֵ֥ץ גָּדֵ֖ר יִשְּׁכֶ֥/נּוּ נָחָֽשׁ
verses.translit: chpr gvmts bv ypvl vprts gdr yshkhnv nchsh
verses.translation: He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it; and whoso breaketh an hedge, a serpent shall bite him.

verses.original: מַסִּ֣יעַ אֲבָנִ֔ים יֵעָצֵ֖ב בָּ/הֶ֑ם בּוֹקֵ֥עַ עֵצִ֖ים יִסָּ֥כֶן בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: msy' 'bnym y'tsb bhm bvq' 'tsym yskhn bm
verses.translation: Whoso removeth stones shall be hurt therewith; and he that cleaveth wood shall be endangered thereby.

verses.original: אִם קֵהָ֣ה הַ/בַּרְזֶ֗ל וְ/הוּא֙ לֹא פָנִ֣ים קִלְקַ֔ל וַ/חֲיָלִ֖ים יְגַבֵּ֑ר וְ/יִתְר֥וֹן הכשיר הַכְשֵׁ֖ר חָכְמָֽה
verses.translit: 'm qhh hbrzl vhv' l' pnym qlql vchylym ygbr vytrvn hkhshyr hkhshr chkhmh
verses.translation: If the iron be blunt, and he do not whet the edge, then must he put to more strength: but wisdom is profitable to direct.

verses.original: אִם יִשֹּׁ֥ךְ הַ/נָּחָ֖שׁ בְּ/לוֹא לָ֑חַשׁ וְ/אֵ֣ין יִתְר֔וֹן לְ/בַ֖עַל הַ/לָּשֽׁוֹן
verses.translit: 'm yshkh hnchsh blv' lchsh v'yn ytrvn lb'l hlshvn
verses.translation: Surely the serpent will bite without enchantment; and a babbler is no better.

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֥י פִי חָכָ֖ם חֵ֑ן וְ/שִׂפְת֥וֹת כְּסִ֖יל תְּבַלְּעֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: dbry py chkhm chn vshptvt khsyl tbl'nv
verses.translation: The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious; but the lips of a fool will swallow up himself.

verses.original: תְּחִלַּ֥ת דִּבְרֵי פִ֖י/הוּ סִכְל֑וּת וְ/אַחֲרִ֣ית פִּ֔י/הוּ הוֹלֵל֖וּת רָעָֽה
verses.translit: tchlt dbry pyhv skhlvt v'chryt pyhv hvllvt r'h
verses.translation: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness: and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/סָּכָ֖ל יַרְבֶּ֣ה דְבָרִ֑ים לֹא יֵדַ֤ע הָ/אָדָם֙ מַה שֶׁ/יִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וַ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִֽהְיֶה֙ מֵֽ/אַחֲרָ֔י/ו מִ֖י יַגִּ֥יד לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhskhl yrbh dbrym l' yd' h'dm mh shyhyh v'shr yhyh m'chryv my ygyd lv
verses.translation: A fool also is full of words: a man cannot tell what shall be; and what shall be after him, who can tell him?

verses.original: עֲמַ֥ל הַ/כְּסִילִ֖ים תְּיַגְּעֶ֑/נּוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא יָדַ֖ע לָ/לֶ֥כֶת אֶל עִֽיר
verses.translit: 'ml hkhsylym tyg'nv 'shr l' yd' llkht 'l 'yr
verses.translation: The labour of the foolish wearieth every one of them, because he knoweth not how to go to the city.

verses.original: אִֽי לָ֣/ךְ אֶ֔רֶץ שֶׁ/מַּלְכֵּ֖/ךְ נָ֑עַר וְ/שָׂרַ֖יִ/ךְ בַּ/בֹּ֥קֶר יֹאכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: 'y lkh 'rts shmlkhkh n'r vshrykh bbqr y'khlv
verses.translation: Woe to thee, O land, when thy king is a child, and thy princes eat in the morning!

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֣י/ךְ אֶ֔רֶץ שֶׁ/מַּלְכֵּ֖/ךְ בֶּן חוֹרִ֑ים וְ/שָׂרַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ בָּ/עֵ֣ת יֹאכֵ֔לוּ בִּ/גְבוּרָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א בַ/שְּׁתִֽי
verses.translit: 'shrykh 'rts shmlkhkh bn chvrym vshrykh b't y'khlv bgbvrh vl' bshty
verses.translation: Blessed art thou, O land, when thy king is the son of nobles, and thy princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!

verses.original: בַּ/עֲצַלְתַּ֖יִם יִמַּ֣ךְ הַ/מְּקָרֶ֑ה וּ/בְ/שִׁפְל֥וּת יָדַ֖יִם יִדְלֹ֥ף הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: b'tsltym ymkh hmqrh vbshplvt ydym ydlf hbyt
verses.translation: By much slothfulness the building decayeth; and through idleness of the hands the house droppeth through.

verses.original: לִ/שְׂחוֹק֙ עֹשִׂ֣ים לֶ֔חֶם וְ/יַ֖יִן יְשַׂמַּ֣ח חַיִּ֑ים וְ/הַ/כֶּ֖סֶף יַעֲנֶ֥ה אֶת הַ/כֹּֽל
verses.translit: lshchvq 'shym lchm vyyn yshmch chyym vhkhsf y'nh 't hkhl
verses.translation: A feast is made for laughter, and wine maketh merry: but money answereth all things .

verses.original: גַּ֣ם בְּ/מַדָּֽעֲ/ךָ֗ מֶ֚לֶךְ אַל תְּקַלֵּ֔ל וּ/בְ/חַדְרֵי֙ מִשְׁכָּ֣בְ/ךָ֔ אַל תְּקַלֵּ֖ל עָשִׁ֑יר כִּ֣י ע֤וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ יוֹלִ֣יךְ אֶת הַ/קּ֔וֹל וּ/בַ֥עַל ה/כנפים כְּנָפַ֖יִם יַגֵּ֥יד דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: gm bmd'kh mlkh 'l tqll vbchdry mshkhbkh 'l tqll 'shyr khy 'vf hshmym yvlykh 't hqvl vb'l hkhnpym khnpym ygyd dbr
verses.translation: Curse not the king, no not in thy thought; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber: for a bird of the air shall carry the voice, and that which hath wings shall tell the matter.

verses.original: שַׁלַּ֥ח לַחְמְ/ךָ֖ עַל פְּנֵ֣י הַ/מָּ֑יִם כִּֽי בְ/רֹ֥ב הַ/יָּמִ֖ים תִּמְצָאֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: shlch lchmkh 'l pny hmym khy brb hymym tmts'nv
verses.translation: Cast thy bread upon the waters: for thou shalt find it after many days.

verses.original: תֶּן חֵ֥לֶק לְ/שִׁבְעָ֖ה וְ/גַ֣ם לִ/שְׁמוֹנָ֑ה כִּ֚י לֹ֣א תֵדַ֔ע מַה יִּהְיֶ֥ה רָעָ֖ה עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: tn chlq lshb'h vgm lshmvnh khy l' td' mh yhyh r'h 'l h'rts
verses.translation: Give a portion to seven, and also to eight; for thou knowest not what evil shall be upon the earth.

verses.original: אִם יִמָּלְא֨וּ הֶ/עָבִ֥ים גֶּ֨שֶׁם֙ עַל הָ/אָ֣רֶץ יָרִ֔יקוּ וְ/אִם יִפּ֥וֹל עֵ֛ץ בַּ/דָּר֖וֹם וְ/אִ֣ם בַּ/צָּפ֑וֹן מְק֛וֹם שֶׁ/יִּפּ֥וֹל הָ/עֵ֖ץ שָׁ֥ם יְהֽוּא
verses.translit: 'm yml'v h'bym gshm 'l h'rts yryqv v'm ypvl 'ts bdrvm v'm btspvn mqvm shypvl h'ts shm yhv'
verses.translation: If the clouds be full of rain, they empty themselves upon the earth: and if the tree fall toward the south, or toward the north, in the place where the tree falleth, there it shall be.

verses.original: שֹׁמֵ֥ר ר֖וּחַ לֹ֣א יִזְרָ֑ע וְ/רֹאֶ֥ה בֶ/עָבִ֖ים לֹ֥א יִקְצֽוֹר
verses.translit: shmr rvch l' yzr' vr'h b'bym l' yqtsvr
verses.translation: He that observeth the wind shall not sow; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap.

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֵֽינְ/ךָ֤ יוֹדֵ֨עַ֙ מַה דֶּ֣רֶךְ הָ/ר֔וּחַ כַּ/עֲצָמִ֖ים בְּ/בֶ֣טֶן הַ/מְּלֵאָ֑ה כָּ֗כָה לֹ֤א תֵדַע֙ אֶת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה אֶת הַ/כֹּֽל
verses.translit: kh'shr 'ynkh yvd' mh drkh hrvch kh'tsmym bbtn hml'h khkhh l' td' 't m'shh h'lhym 'shr y'shh 't hkhl
verses.translation: As thou knowest not what is the way of the spirit, nor how the bones do grow in the womb of her that is with child: even so thou knowest not the works of God who maketh all.

verses.original: בַּ/בֹּ֨קֶר֙ זְרַ֣ע אֶת זַרְעֶ֔/ךָ וְ/לָ/עֶ֖רֶב אַל תַּנַּ֣ח יָדֶ֑/ךָ כִּי֩ אֵֽינְ/ךָ֨ יוֹדֵ֜ע אֵ֣י זֶ֤ה יִכְשָׁר֙ הֲ/זֶ֣ה אוֹ זֶ֔ה וְ/אִם שְׁנֵי/הֶ֥ם כְּ/אֶחָ֖ד טוֹבִֽים
verses.translit: bbqr zr' 't zr'kh vl'rb 'l tnch ydkh khy 'ynkh yvd' 'y zh ykhshr hzh 'v zh v'm shnyhm kh'chd tvbym
verses.translation: In the morning sow thy seed, and in the evening withhold not thine hand: for thou knowest not whether shall prosper, either this or that, or whether they both shall be alike good.

verses.original: וּ/מָת֖וֹק הָ/א֑וֹר וְ/ט֥וֹב לַֽ/עֵינַ֖יִם לִ/רְא֥וֹת אֶת הַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: vmtvq h'vr vtvb l'ynym lr'vt 't hshmsh
verses.translation: Truly the light is sweet, and a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to behold the sun:

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם שָׁנִ֥ים הַרְבֵּ֛ה יִחְיֶ֥ה הָ/אָדָ֖ם בְּ/כֻלָּ֣/ם יִשְׂמָ֑ח וְ/יִזְכֹּר֙ אֶת יְמֵ֣י הַ/חֹ֔שֶׁךְ כִּֽי הַרְבֵּ֥ה יִהְי֖וּ כָּל שֶׁ/בָּ֥א הָֽבֶל
verses.translit: khy 'm shnym hrbh ychyh h'dm bkhlm yshmch vyzkhr 't ymy hchshkh khy hrbh yhyv khl shb' hbl
verses.translation: But if a man live many years, and rejoice in them all; yet let him remember the days of darkness; for they shall be many. All that cometh is vanity.

verses.original: שְׂמַ֧ח בָּח֣וּר בְּ/יַלְדוּתֶ֗י/ךָ וִֽ/יטִֽיבְ/ךָ֤ לִבְּ/ךָ֙ בִּ/ימֵ֣י בְחוּרוֹתֶ֔/ךָ וְ/הַלֵּךְ֙ בְּ/דַרְכֵ֣י לִבְּ/ךָ֔ וּ/בְ/מַרְאֵ֖י עֵינֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/דָ֕ע כִּ֧י עַל כָּל אֵ֛לֶּה יְבִֽיאֲ/ךָ֥ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים בַּ/מִּשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: shmch bchvr byldvtykh vytybkh lbkh bymy bchvrvtkh vhlkh bdrkhy lbkh vbmr'y 'ynykh vd' khy 'l khl 'lh yby'kh h'lhym bmshpt
verses.translation: Rejoice, O young man, in thy youth; and let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth, and walk in the ways of thine heart, and in the sight of thine eyes: but know thou, that for all these things God will bring thee into judgment.

verses.original: וְ/הָסֵ֥ר כַּ֨עַס֙ מִ/לִּבֶּ֔/ךָ וְ/הַעֲבֵ֥ר רָעָ֖ה מִ/בְּשָׂרֶ֑/ךָ כִּֽי הַ/יַּלְד֥וּת וְ/הַֽ/שַּׁחֲר֖וּת הָֽבֶל
verses.translit: vhsr kh's mlbkh vh'br r'h mbshrkh khy hyldvt vhshchrvt hbl
verses.translation: Therefore remove sorrow from thy heart, and put away evil from thy flesh: for childhood and youth are vanity.

verses.original: וּ/זְכֹר֙ אֶת בּ֣וֹרְאֶ֔י/ךָ בִּ/ימֵ֖י בְּחוּרֹתֶ֑י/ךָ עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹא יָבֹ֨אוּ֙ יְמֵ֣י הָֽ/רָעָ֔ה וְ/הִגִּ֣יעוּ שָׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֹּאמַ֔ר אֵֽין לִ֥/י בָ/הֶ֖ם חֵֽפֶץ
verses.translit: vzkhr 't bvr'ykh bymy bchvrtykh 'd 'shr l' yb'v ymy hr'h vhgy'v shnym 'shr t'mr 'yn ly bhm chpts
verses.translation: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;

verses.original: עַ֠ד אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא תֶחְשַׁ֤ךְ הַ/שֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ וְ/הָ/א֔וֹר וְ/הַ/יָּרֵ֖חַ וְ/הַ/כּוֹכָבִ֑ים וְ/שָׁ֥בוּ הֶ/עָבִ֖ים אַחַ֥ר הַ/גָּֽשֶׁם
verses.translit: 'd 'shr l' tchshkh hshmsh vh'vr vhyrch vhkhvkhbym vshbv h'bym 'chr hgshm
verses.translation: While the sun, or the light, or the moon, or the stars, be not darkened, nor the clouds return after the rain:

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֗וֹם שֶׁ/יָּזֻ֨עוּ֙ שֹׁמְרֵ֣י הַ/בַּ֔יִת וְ/הִֽתְעַוְּת֖וּ אַנְשֵׁ֣י הֶ/חָ֑יִל וּ/בָטְל֤וּ הַ/טֹּֽחֲנוֹת֙ כִּ֣י מִעֵ֔טוּ וְ/חָשְׁכ֥וּ הָ/רֹא֖וֹת בָּ/אֲרֻבּֽוֹת
verses.translit: byvm shyz'v shmry hbyt vht'vtv 'nshy hchyl vbtlv htchnvt khy m'tv vchshkhv hr'vt b'rbvt
verses.translation: In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those that look out of the windows be darkened,

verses.original: וְ/סֻגְּר֤וּ דְלָתַ֨יִם֙ בַּ/שּׁ֔וּק בִּ/שְׁפַ֖ל ק֣וֹל הַֽ/טַּחֲנָ֑ה וְ/יָקוּם֙ לְ/ק֣וֹל הַ/צִּפּ֔וֹר וְ/יִשַּׁ֖חוּ כָּל בְּנ֥וֹת הַ/שִּֽׁיר
verses.translit: vsgrv dltym bshvq bshpl qvl htchnh vyqvm lqvl htspvr vyshchv khl bnvt hshyr
verses.translation: And the doors shall be shut in the streets, when the sound of the grinding is low, and he shall rise up at the voice of the bird, and all the daughters of musick shall be brought low;

verses.original: גַּ֣ם מִ/גָּבֹ֤הַּ יִרָ֨אוּ֙ וְ/חַתְחַתִּ֣ים בַּ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ וְ/יָנֵ֤אץ הַ/שָּׁקֵד֙ וְ/יִסְתַּבֵּ֣ל הֶֽ/חָגָ֔ב וְ/תָפֵ֖ר הָֽ/אֲבִיּוֹנָ֑ה כִּֽי הֹלֵ֤ךְ הָ/אָדָם֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית עוֹלָמ֔/וֹ וְ/סָבְב֥וּ בָ/שּׁ֖וּק הַ/סֹּפְדִֽים
verses.translit: gm mgbh yr'v vchtchtym bdrkh vyn'ts hshqd vystbl hchgb vtpr h'byvnh khy hlkh h'dm 'l byt 'vlmv vsbbv bshvq hspdym
verses.translation: Also when they shall be afraid of that which is high, and fears shall be in the way, and the almond tree shall flourish, and the grasshopper shall be a burden, and desire shall fail: because man goeth to his long home, and the mourners go about the streets:

verses.original: עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא ירחק יֵרָתֵק֙ חֶ֣בֶל הַ/כֶּ֔סֶף וְ/תָרֻ֖ץ גֻּלַּ֣ת הַ/זָּהָ֑ב וְ/תִשָּׁ֤בֶר כַּד֙ עַל הַ/מַּבּ֔וּעַ וְ/נָרֹ֥ץ הַ/גַּלְגַּ֖ל אֶל הַ/בּֽוֹר
verses.translit: 'd 'shr l' yrchq yrtq chbl hkhsf vtrts glt hzhb vtshbr khd 'l hmbv' vnrts hglgl 'l hbvr
verses.translation: Or ever the silver cord be loosed, or the golden bowl be broken, or the pitcher be broken at the fountain, or the wheel broken at the cistern.

verses.original: וְ/יָשֹׁ֧ב הֶ/עָפָ֛ר עַל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ כְּ/שֶׁ/הָיָ֑ה וְ/הָ/ר֣וּחַ תָּשׁ֔וּב אֶל הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נְתָנָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyshb h'pr 'l h'rts khshhyh vhrvch tshvb 'l h'lhym 'shr ntnh
verses.translation: Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was: and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it.

verses.original: הֲבֵ֧ל הֲבָלִ֛ים אָמַ֥ר הַ/קּוֹהֶ֖לֶת הַ/כֹּ֥ל הָֽבֶל
verses.translit: hbl hblym 'mr hqvhlt hkhl hbl
verses.translation: Vanity of vanities, saith the preacher; all is vanity.

verses.original: וְ/יֹתֵ֕ר שֶׁ/הָיָ֥ה קֹהֶ֖לֶת חָכָ֑ם ע֗וֹד לִמַּד דַּ֨עַת֙ אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם וְ/אִזֵּ֣ן וְ/חִקֵּ֔ר תִּקֵּ֖ן מְשָׁלִ֥ים הַרְבֵּֽה
verses.translit: vytr shhyh qhlt chkhm 'vd lmd d't 't h'm v'zn vchqr tqn mshlym hrbh
verses.translation: And moreover, because the preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge; yea, he gave good heed, and sought out, and set in order many proverbs.

verses.original: בִּקֵּ֣שׁ קֹהֶ֔לֶת לִ/מְצֹ֖א דִּבְרֵי חֵ֑פֶץ וְ/כָת֥וּב יֹ֖שֶׁר דִּבְרֵ֥י אֱמֶֽת
verses.translit: bqsh qhlt lmts' dbry chpts vkhtvb yshr dbry 'mt
verses.translation: The preacher sought to find out acceptable words: and that which was written was upright, even words of truth.

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֤י חֲכָמִים֙ כַּ/דָּ֣רְבֹנ֔וֹת וּֽ/כְ/מַשְׂמְר֥וֹת נְטוּעִ֖ים בַּעֲלֵ֣י אֲסֻפּ֑וֹת נִתְּנ֖וּ מֵ/רֹעֶ֥ה אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: dbry chkhmym khdrbnvt vkhmshmrvt ntv'ym b'ly 'spvt ntnv mr'h 'chd
verses.translation: The words of the wise are as goads, and as nails fastened by the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.

verses.original: וְ/יֹתֵ֥ר מֵ/הֵ֖מָּה בְּנִ֣/י הִזָּהֵ֑ר עֲשׂ֨וֹת סְפָרִ֤ים הַרְבֵּה֙ אֵ֣ין קֵ֔ץ וְ/לַ֥הַג הַרְבֵּ֖ה יְגִעַ֥ת בָּשָֽׂר
verses.translit: vytr mhmh bny hzhr 'shvt sprym hrbh 'yn qts vlhg hrbh yg't bshr
verses.translation: And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.

verses.original: ס֥וֹף דָּבָ֖ר הַ/כֹּ֣ל נִשְׁמָ֑ע אֶת הָ/אֱלֹהִ֤ים יְרָא֙ וְ/אֶת מִצְוֺתָ֣י/ו שְׁמ֔וֹר כִּי זֶ֖ה כָּל הָ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: svf dbr hkhl nshm' 't h'lhym yr' v't mtsvtyv shmvr khy zh khl h'dm
verses.translation: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֶת כָּל מַֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה הָ/אֱלֹהִ֛ים יָבִ֥א בְ/מִשְׁפָּ֖ט עַ֣ל כָּל נֶעְלָ֑ם אִם ט֖וֹב וְ/אִם רָֽע
verses.translit: khy 't khl m'shh h'lhym yb' bmshpt 'l khl n'lm 'm tvb v'm r'
verses.translation: For God shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.

verses.original: שִׁ֥יר הַ/שִּׁירִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִ/שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: shyr hshyrym 'shr lshlmh
verses.translation: The song of songs, which is Solomon’s.

verses.original: יִשָּׁקֵ֨/נִי֙ מִ/נְּשִׁיק֣וֹת פִּ֔י/הוּ כִּֽי טוֹבִ֥ים דֹּדֶ֖י/ךָ מִ/יָּֽיִן
verses.translit: yshqny mnshyqvt pyhv khy tvbym ddykh myyn
verses.translation: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth: for thy love is better than wine.

verses.original: לְ/רֵ֨יחַ֙ שְׁמָנֶ֣י/ךָ טוֹבִ֔ים שֶׁ֖מֶן תּוּרַ֣ק שְׁמֶ֑/ךָ עַל כֵּ֖ן עֲלָמ֥וֹת אֲהֵבֽוּ/ךָ
verses.translit: lrych shmnykh tvbym shmn tvrq shmkh 'l khn 'lmvt 'hbvkh
verses.translation: Because of the savour of thy good ointments thy name is as ointment poured forth, therefore do the virgins love thee.

verses.original: מָשְׁכֵ֖/נִי אַחֲרֶ֣י/ךָ נָּר֑וּצָה הֱבִיאַ֨/נִי הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ חֲדָרָ֗י/ו נָגִ֤ילָה וְ/נִשְׂמְחָה֙ בָּ֔/ךְ נַזְכִּ֤ירָה דֹדֶ֨י/ךָ֙ מִ/יַּ֔יִן מֵישָׁרִ֖ים אֲהֵבֽוּ/ךָ
verses.translit: mshkhny 'chrykh nrvtsh hby'ny hmlkh chdryv ngylh vnshmchh bkh nzkhyrh ddykh myyn myshrym 'hbvkh
verses.translation: Draw me, we will run after thee: the king hath brought me into his chambers: we will be glad and rejoice in thee, we will remember thy love more than wine: the upright love thee.

verses.original: שְׁחוֹרָ֤ה אֲנִי֙ וְֽ/נָאוָ֔ה בְּנ֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כְּ/אָהֳלֵ֣י קֵדָ֔ר כִּ/ירִיע֖וֹת שְׁלֹמֹֽה
verses.translit: shchvrh 'ny vn'vh bnvt yrvshlm kh'hly qdr khyry'vt shlmh
verses.translation: I am black, but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, as the tents of Kedar, as the curtains of Solomon.

verses.original: אַל תִּרְא֨וּ/נִי֙ שֶׁ/אֲנִ֣י שְׁחַרְחֹ֔רֶת שֶׁ/שֱּׁזָפַ֖תְ/נִי הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ בְּנֵ֧י אִמִּ֣/י נִֽחֲרוּ בִ֗/י שָׂמֻ֨/נִי֙ נֹטֵרָ֣ה אֶת הַ/כְּרָמִ֔ים כַּרְמִ֥/י שֶׁ/לִּ֖/י לֹ֥א נָטָֽרְתִּי
verses.translit: 'l tr'vny sh'ny shchrchrt shshzptny hshmsh bny 'my nchrv by shmny ntrh 't hkhrmym khrmy shly l' ntrty
verses.translation: Look not upon me, because I am black, because the sun hath looked upon me: my mother’s children were angry with me; they made me the keeper of the vineyards; but mine own vineyard have I not kept.

verses.original: הַגִּ֣ידָ/ה לִּ֗/י שֶׁ֤/אָהֲבָה֙ נַפְשִׁ֔/י אֵיכָ֣ה תִרְעֶ֔ה אֵיכָ֖ה תַּרְבִּ֣יץ בַּֽ/צָּהֳרָ֑יִם שַׁ/לָּ/מָ֤ה אֶֽהְיֶה֙ כְּ/עֹ֣טְיָ֔ה עַ֖ל עֶדְרֵ֥י חֲבֵרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: hgydh ly sh'hbh npshy 'ykhh tr'h 'ykhh trbyts btshrym shlmh 'hyh kh'tyh 'l 'dry chbrykh
verses.translation: Tell me, O thou whom my soul loveth, where thou feedest, where thou makest thy flock to rest at noon: for why should I be as one that turneth aside by the flocks of thy companions?

verses.original: אִם לֹ֤א תֵדְעִי֙ לָ֔/ךְ הַ/יָּפָ֖ה בַּ/נָּשִׁ֑ים צְֽאִי לָ֞/ךְ בְּ/עִקְבֵ֣י הַ/צֹּ֗אן וּ/רְעִי֙ אֶת גְּדִיֹּתַ֔יִ/ךְ עַ֖ל מִשְׁכְּנ֥וֹת הָ/רֹעִֽים
verses.translit: 'm l' td'y lkh hyph bnshym ts'y lkh b'qby hts'n vr'y 't gdytykh 'l mshkhnvt hr'ym
verses.translation: If thou know not, O thou fairest among women, go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, and feed thy kids beside the shepherds’ tents.

verses.original: לְ/סֻסָתִ/י֙ בְּ/רִכְבֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה דִּמִּיתִ֖י/ךְ רַעְיָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: lssty brkhby pr'h dmytykh r'yty
verses.translation: I have compared thee, O my love, to a company of horses in Pharaoh’s chariots.

verses.original: נָאו֤וּ לְחָיַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ בַּ/תֹּרִ֔ים צַוָּארֵ֖/ךְ בַּ/חֲרוּזִֽים
verses.translit: n'vv lchyykh btrym tsv'rkh bchrvzym
verses.translation: Thy cheeks are comely with rows of jewels , thy neck with chains of gold .

verses.original: תּוֹרֵ֤י זָהָב֙ נַעֲשֶׂה לָּ֔/ךְ עִ֖ם נְקֻדּ֥וֹת הַ/כָּֽסֶף
verses.translit: tvry zhb n'shh lkh 'm nqdvt hkhsf
