verses.translation: We will make thee borders of gold with studs of silver.

verses.translit: 'd shhmlkh bmsbv nrdy ntn rychv
verses.translation: While the king sitteth at his table, my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.

verses.original: צְר֨וֹר הַ/מֹּ֤ר דּוֹדִ/י֙ לִ֔/י בֵּ֥ין שָׁדַ֖/י יָלִֽין
verses.translit: tsrvr hmr dvdy ly byn shdy ylyn
verses.translation: A bundle of myrrh is my wellbeloved unto me; he shall lie all night betwixt my breasts.

verses.original: אֶשְׁכֹּ֨ל הַ/כֹּ֤פֶר דּוֹדִ/י֙ לִ֔/י בְּ/כַרְמֵ֖י עֵ֥ין גֶּֽדִי
verses.translit: 'shkhl hkhpr dvdy ly bkhrmy 'yn gdy
verses.translation: My beloved is unto me as a cluster of camphire in the vineyards of En-gedi.

verses.original: הִנָּ֤/ךְ יָפָה֙ רַעְיָתִ֔/י הִנָּ֥/ךְ יָפָ֖ה עֵינַ֥יִ/ךְ יוֹנִֽים
verses.translit: hnkh yph r'yty hnkh yph 'ynykh yvnym
verses.translation: Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; thou hast doves’ eyes.

verses.original: הִנְּ/ךָ֨ יָפֶ֤ה דוֹדִ/י֙ אַ֣ף נָעִ֔ים אַף עַרְשֵׂ֖/נוּ רַעֲנָנָֽה
verses.translit: hnkh yph dvdy 'f n'ym 'f 'rshnv r'nnh
verses.translation: Behold, thou art fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant: also our bed is green.

verses.original: קֹר֤וֹת בָּתֵּ֨י/נוּ֙ אֲרָזִ֔ים רחיט/נו רַהִיטֵ֖/נוּ בְּרוֹתִֽים
verses.translit: qrvt btynv 'rzym rchytnv rhytnv brvtym
verses.translation: The beams of our house are cedar, and our rafters of fir.

verses.original: אֲנִי֙ חֲבַצֶּ֣לֶת הַ/שָּׁר֔וֹן שֽׁוֹשַׁנַּ֖ת הָ/עֲמָקִֽים
verses.translit: 'ny chbtslt hshrvn shvshnt h'mqym
verses.translation: I am the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valleys.

verses.original: כְּ/שֽׁוֹשַׁנָּה֙ בֵּ֣ין הַ/חוֹחִ֔ים כֵּ֥ן רַעְיָתִ֖/י בֵּ֥ין הַ/בָּנֽוֹת
verses.translit: khshvshnh byn hchvchym khn r'yty byn hbnvt
verses.translation: As the lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.

verses.original: כְּ/תַפּ֨וּחַ֙ בַּ/עֲצֵ֣י הַ/יַּ֔עַר כֵּ֥ן דּוֹדִ֖/י בֵּ֣ין הַ/בָּנִ֑ים בְּ/צִלּ/וֹ֙ חִמַּ֣דְתִּי וְ/יָשַׁ֔בְתִּי וּ/פִרְי֖/וֹ מָת֥וֹק לְ/חִכִּֽ/י
verses.translit: khtpvch b'tsy hy'r khn dvdy byn hbnym btslv chmdty vyshbty vpryv mtvq lchkhy
verses.translation: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, and his fruit was sweet to my taste.

verses.original: הֱבִיאַ֨/נִי֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית הַ/יָּ֔יִן וְ/דִגְל֥/וֹ עָלַ֖/י אַהֲבָֽה
verses.translit: hby'ny 'l byt hyyn vdglv 'ly 'hbh
verses.translation: He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me was love.

verses.original: סַמְּכ֨וּ/נִי֙ בָּֽ/אֲשִׁישׁ֔וֹת רַפְּד֖וּ/נִי בַּ/תַּפּוּחִ֑ים כִּי חוֹלַ֥ת אַהֲבָ֖ה אָֽנִי
verses.translit: smkhvny b'shyshvt rpdvny btpvchym khy chvlt 'hbh 'ny
verses.translation: Stay me with flagons, comfort me with apples: for I am sick of love.

verses.original: שְׂמֹאל/וֹ֙ תַּ֣חַת לְ/רֹאשִׁ֔/י וִ/ימִינ֖/וֹ תְּחַבְּקֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: shm'lv tcht lr'shy vymynv tchbqny
verses.translation: His left hand is under my head, and his right hand doth embrace me.

verses.original: הִשְׁבַּ֨עְתִּי אֶתְ/כֶ֜ם בְּנ֤וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ בִּ/צְבָא֔וֹת א֖וֹ בְּ/אַיְל֣וֹת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה אִם תָּעִ֧ירוּ וְֽ/אִם תְּעֽוֹרְר֛וּ אֶת הָ/אַהֲבָ֖ה עַ֥ד שֶׁ/תֶּחְפָּֽץ
verses.translit: hshb'ty 'tkhm bnvt yrvshlm btsb'vt 'v b'ylvt hshdh 'm t'yrv v'm t'vrrv 't h'hbh 'd shtchpts
verses.translation: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.

verses.original: ק֣וֹל דּוֹדִ֔/י הִנֵּה זֶ֖ה בָּ֑א מְדַלֵּג֙ עַל הֶ֣/הָרִ֔ים מְקַפֵּ֖ץ עַל הַ/גְּבָעֽוֹת
verses.translit: qvl dvdy hnh zh b' mdlg 'l hhrym mqpts 'l hgb'vt
verses.translation: The voice of my beloved! behold, he cometh leaping upon the mountains, skipping upon the hills.

verses.original: דּוֹמֶ֤ה דוֹדִ/י֙ לִ/צְבִ֔י א֖וֹ לְ/עֹ֣פֶר הָֽ/אַיָּלִ֑ים הִנֵּה זֶ֤ה עוֹמֵד֙ אַחַ֣ר כָּתְלֵ֔/נוּ מַשְׁגִּ֨יחַ֙ מִן הַֽ/חֲלֹּנ֔וֹת מֵצִ֖יץ מִן הַֽ/חֲרַכִּֽים
verses.translit: dvmh dvdy ltsby 'v l'pr h'ylym hnh zh 'vmd 'chr khtlnv mshgych mn hchlnvt mtsyts mn hchrkhym
verses.translation: My beloved is like a roe or a young hart: behold, he standeth behind our wall, he looketh forth at the windows, shewing himself through the lattice.

verses.original: עָנָ֥ה דוֹדִ֖/י וְ/אָ֣מַר לִ֑/י ק֥וּמִי לָ֛/ךְ רַעְיָתִ֥/י יָפָתִ֖/י וּ/לְכִי לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'nh dvdy v'mr ly qvmy lkh r'yty ypty vlkhy lkh
verses.translation: My beloved spake, and said unto me, Rise up, my love, my fair one, and come away.

verses.original: כִּֽי הִנֵּ֥ה ה/סתו הַ/סְּתָ֖יו עָבָ֑ר הַ/גֶּ֕שֶׁם חָלַ֖ף הָלַ֥ךְ לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy hnh hstv hstyv 'br hgshm chlf hlkh lv
verses.translation: For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;

verses.original: הַ/נִּצָּנִים֙ נִרְא֣וּ בָ/אָ֔רֶץ עֵ֥ת הַ/זָּמִ֖יר הִגִּ֑יעַ וְ/ק֥וֹל הַ/תּ֖וֹר נִשְׁמַ֥ע בְּ/אַרְצֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: hntsnym nr'v b'rts 't hzmyr hgy' vqvl htvr nshm' b'rtsnv
verses.translation: The flowers appear on the earth; the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;

verses.original: הַ/תְּאֵנָה֙ חָֽנְטָ֣ה פַגֶּ֔י/הָ וְ/הַ/גְּפָנִ֥ים סְמָדַ֖ר נָ֣תְנוּ רֵ֑יחַ ק֥וּמִי לכי לָ֛/ךְ רַעְיָתִ֥/י יָפָתִ֖/י וּ/לְכִי לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: ht'nh chnth pgyh vhgpnym smdr ntnv rych qvmy lkhy lkh r'yty ypty vlkhy lkh
verses.translation: The fig tree putteth forth her green figs, and the vines with the tender grape give a good smell. Arise, my love, my fair one, and come away.

verses.original: יוֹנָתִ֞/י בְּ/חַגְוֵ֣י הַ/סֶּ֗לַע בְּ/סֵ֨תֶר֙ הַ/מַּדְרֵגָ֔ה הַרְאִ֨י/נִי֙ אֶתּ מַרְאַ֔יִ/ךְ הַשְׁמִיעִ֖י/נִי אֶת קוֹלֵ֑/ךְ כִּי קוֹלֵ֥/ךְ עָרֵ֖ב וּ/מַרְאֵ֥י/ךְ נָאוֶֽה
verses.translit: yvnty bchgvy hsl' bstr hmdrgh hr'yny 't mr'ykh hshmy'yny 't qvlkh khy qvlkh 'rb vmr'ykh n'vh
verses.translation: O my dove, that art in the clefts of the rock, in the secret places of the stairs, let me see thy countenance, let me hear thy voice; for sweet is thy voice, and thy countenance is comely.

verses.original: אֶֽחֱזוּ לָ֨/נוּ֙ שֽׁוּעָלִ֔ים שֽׁוּעָלִ֥ים קְטַנִּ֖ים מְחַבְּלִ֣ים כְּרָמִ֑ים וּ/כְרָמֵ֖י/נוּ סְמָדַֽר
verses.translit: 'chzv lnv shv'lym shv'lym qtnym mchblym khrmym vkhrmynv smdr
verses.translation: Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that spoil the vines: for our vines have tender grapes.

verses.original: דּוֹדִ֥/י לִ/י֙ וַ/אֲנִ֣י ל֔/וֹ הָ/רֹעֶ֖ה בַּ/שּׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים
verses.translit: dvdy ly v'ny lv hr'h bshvshnym
verses.translation: My beloved is mine, and I am his: he feedeth among the lilies.

verses.original: עַ֤ד שֶׁ/יָּפ֨וּחַ֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם וְ/נָ֖סוּ הַ/צְּלָלִ֑ים סֹב֩ דְּמֵה לְ/ךָ֨ דוֹדִ֜/י לִ/צְבִ֗י א֛וֹ לְ/עֹ֥פֶר הָ/אַיָּלִ֖ים עַל הָ֥רֵי בָֽתֶר
verses.translit: 'd shypvch hyvm vnsv htsllym sb dmh lkh dvdy ltsby 'v l'pr h'ylym 'l hry btr
verses.translation: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be thou like a roe or a young hart upon the mountains of Bether.

verses.original: עַל מִשְׁכָּבִ/י֙ בַּ/לֵּיל֔וֹת בִּקַּ֕שְׁתִּי אֵ֥ת שֶׁ/אָהֲבָ֖ה נַפְשִׁ֑/י בִּקַּשְׁתִּ֖י/ו וְ/לֹ֥א מְצָאתִֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'l mshkhby blylvt bqshty 't sh'hbh npshy bqshtyv vl' mts'tyv
verses.translation: By night on my bed I sought him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.

verses.original: אָק֨וּמָה נָּ֜א וַ/אֲסוֹבְבָ֣ה בָ/עִ֗יר בַּ/שְּׁוָקִים֙ וּ/בָ֣/רְחֹב֔וֹת אֲבַקְשָׁ֕ה אֵ֥ת שֶׁ/אָהֲבָ֖ה נַפְשִׁ֑/י בִּקַּשְׁתִּ֖י/ו וְ/לֹ֥א מְצָאתִֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'qvmh n' v'svbbh b'yr bshvqym vbrchbvt 'bqshh 't sh'hbh npshy bqshtyv vl' mts'tyv
verses.translation: I will rise now, and go about the city in the streets, and in the broad ways I will seek him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.

verses.original: מְצָא֨וּ/נִי֙ הַ/שֹּׁ֣מְרִ֔ים הַ/סֹּבְבִ֖ים בָּ/עִ֑יר אֵ֛ת שֶׁ/אָהֲבָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖/י רְאִיתֶֽם
verses.translit: mts'vny hshmrym hsbbym b'yr 't sh'hbh npshy r'ytm
verses.translation: The watchmen that go about the city found me: to whom I said , Saw ye him whom my soul loveth?

verses.original: כִּ/מְעַט֙ שֶׁ/עָבַ֣רְתִּי מֵ/הֶ֔ם עַ֣ד שֶֽׁ/מָּצָ֔אתִי אֵ֥ת שֶׁ/אָהֲבָ֖ה נַפְשִׁ֑/י אֲחַזְתִּי/ו֙ וְ/לֹ֣א אַרְפֶּ֔/נּוּ עַד שֶׁ֤/הֲבֵיאתִי/ו֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית אִמִּ֔/י וְ/אֶל חֶ֖דֶר הוֹרָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: khm't sh'brty mhm 'd shmts'ty 't sh'hbh npshy 'chztyv vl' 'rpnv 'd shhby'tyv 'l byt 'my v'l chdr hvrty
verses.translation: It was but a little that I passed from them, but I found him whom my soul loveth: I held him, and would not let him go, until I had brought him into my mother’s house, and into the chamber of her that conceived me.

verses.original: הִשְׁבַּ֨עְתִּי אֶתְ/כֶ֜ם בְּנ֤וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ בִּ/צְבָא֔וֹת א֖וֹ בְּ/אַיְל֣וֹת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה אִם תָּעִ֧ירוּ וְֽ/אִם תְּעֽוֹרְר֛וּ אֶת הָ/אַהֲבָ֖ה עַ֥ד שֶׁ/תֶּחְפָּֽץ
verses.translit: hshb'ty 'tkhm bnvt yrvshlm btsb'vt 'v b'ylvt hshdh 'm t'yrv v'm t'vrrv 't h'hbh 'd shtchpts
verses.translation: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, till he please.

verses.original: מִ֣י זֹ֗את עֹלָה֙ מִן הַ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר כְּ/תִֽימֲר֖וֹת עָשָׁ֑ן מְקֻטֶּ֤רֶת מוֹר֙ וּ/לְבוֹנָ֔ה מִ/כֹּ֖ל אַבְקַ֥ת רוֹכֵֽל
verses.translit: my z't 'lh mn hmdbr khtymrvt 'shn mqtrt mvr vlbvnh mkhl 'bqt rvkhl
verses.translation: Who is this that cometh out of the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all powders of the merchant?

verses.original: הִנֵּ֗ה מִטָּת/וֹ֙ שֶׁ/לִּ/שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה שִׁשִּׁ֥ים גִּבֹּרִ֖ים סָבִ֣יב לָ֑/הּ מִ/גִּבֹּרֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: hnh mttv shlshlmh shshym gbrym sbyb lh mgbry yshr'l
verses.translation: Behold his bed, which is Solomon’s; threescore valiant men are about it, of the valiant of Israel.

verses.original: כֻּלָּ/ם֙ אֲחֻ֣זֵי חֶ֔רֶב מְלֻמְּדֵ֖י מִלְחָמָ֑ה אִ֤ישׁ חַרְבּ/וֹ֙ עַל יְרֵכ֔/וֹ מִ/פַּ֖חַד בַּ/לֵּילּֽוֹת
verses.translit: khlm 'chzy chrb mlmdy mlchmh 'ysh chrbv 'l yrkhv mpchd blylvt
verses.translation: They all hold swords, being expert in war: every man hath his sword upon his thigh because of fear in the night.

verses.original: אַפִּרְי֗וֹן עָ֤שָׂה ל/וֹ֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה מֵ/עֲצֵ֖י הַ/לְּבָנֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'pryvn 'shh lv hmlkh shlmh m'tsy hlbnvn
verses.translation: King Solomon made himself a chariot of the wood of Lebanon.

verses.original: עַמּוּדָי/ו֙ עָ֣שָׂה כֶ֔סֶף רְפִידָת֣/וֹ זָהָ֔ב מֶרְכָּב֖/וֹ אַרְגָּמָ֑ן תּוֹכ/וֹ֙ רָצ֣וּף אַהֲבָ֔ה מִ/בְּנ֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: 'mvdyv 'shh khsf rpydtv zhb mrkhbv 'rgmn tvkhv rtsvf 'hbh mbnvt yrvshlm
verses.translation: He made the pillars thereof of silver, the bottom thereof of gold, the covering of it of purple, the midst thereof being paved with love, for the daughters of Jerusalem.

verses.original: צְאֶ֧ינָה וּֽ/רְאֶ֛ינָה בְּנ֥וֹת צִיּ֖וֹן בַּ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בָּ/עֲטָרָ֗ה שֶׁ/עִטְּרָה לּ֤/וֹ אִמּ/וֹ֙ בְּ/י֣וֹם חֲתֻנָּת֔/וֹ וּ/בְ/י֖וֹם שִׂמְחַ֥ת לִבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: ts'ynh vr'ynh bnvt tsyvn bmlkh shlmh b'trh sh'trh lv 'mv byvm chtntv vbyvm shmcht lbv
verses.translation: Go forth, O ye daughters of Zion, and behold king Solomon with the crown wherewith his mother crowned him in the day of his espousals, and in the day of the gladness of his heart.

verses.original: הִנָּ֨/ךְ יָפָ֤ה רַעְיָתִ/י֙ הִנָּ֣/ךְ יָפָ֔ה עֵינַ֣יִ/ךְ יוֹנִ֔ים מִ/בַּ֖עַד לְ/צַמָּתֵ֑/ךְ שַׂעְרֵ/ךְ֙ כְּ/עֵ֣דֶר הָֽ/עִזִּ֔ים שֶׁ/גָּלְשׁ֖וּ מֵ/הַ֥ר גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: hnkh yph r'yty hnkh yph 'ynykh yvnym mb'd ltsmtkh sh'rkh kh'dr h'zym shglshv mhr gl'd
verses.translation: Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; thou hast doves’ eyes within thy locks: thy hair is as a flock of goats, that appear from mount Gilead.

verses.original: שִׁנַּ֨יִ/ךְ֙ כְּ/עֵ֣דֶר הַ/קְּצוּב֔וֹת שֶׁ/עָל֖וּ מִן הָ/רַחְצָ֑ה שֶׁ/כֻּלָּ/ם֙ מַתְאִימ֔וֹת וְ/שַׁכֻּלָ֖ה אֵ֥ין בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: shnykh kh'dr hqtsvbvt sh'lv mn hrchtsh shkhlm mt'ymvt vshkhlh 'yn bhm
verses.translation: Thy teeth are like a flock of sheep that are even shorn, which came up from the washing; whereof every one bear twins, and none is barren among them.

verses.original: כְּ/ח֤וּט הַ/שָּׁנִי֙ שִׂפְתֹתַ֔יִ/ךְ וּ/מִדְבָּרֵ֖י/ךְ נָאוֶ֑ה כְּ/פֶ֤לַח הָֽ/רִמּוֹן֙ רַקָּתֵ֔/ךְ מִ/בַּ֖עַד לְ/צַמָּתֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khchvt hshny shpttykh vmdbrykh n'vh khplch hrmvn rqtkh mb'd ltsmtkh
verses.translation: Thy lips are like a thread of scarlet, and thy speech is comely: thy temples are like a piece of a pomegranate within thy locks.

verses.original: כְּ/מִגְדַּ֤ל דָּוִיד֙ צַוָּארֵ֔/ךְ בָּנ֖וּי לְ/תַלְפִּיּ֑וֹת אֶ֤לֶף הַ/מָּגֵן֙ תָּל֣וּי עָלָ֔י/ו כֹּ֖ל שִׁלְטֵ֥י הַ/גִּבּוֹרִֽים
verses.translit: khmgdl dvyd tsv'rkh bnvy ltlpyvt 'lf hmgn tlvy 'lyv khl shlty hgbvrym
verses.translation: Thy neck is like the tower of David builded for an armoury, whereon there hang a thousand bucklers, all shields of mighty men.

verses.original: שְׁנֵ֥י שָׁדַ֛יִ/ךְ כִּ/שְׁנֵ֥י עֳפָרִ֖ים תְּאוֹמֵ֣י צְבִיָּ֑ה הָ/רוֹעִ֖ים בַּ/שּׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים
verses.translit: shny shdykh khshny 'prym t'vmy tsbyh hrv'ym bshvshnym
verses.translation: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins, which feed among the lilies.

verses.original: עַ֤ד שֶׁ/יָּפ֨וּחַ֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם וְ/נָ֖סוּ הַ/צְּלָלִ֑ים אֵ֤לֶךְ לִ/י֙ אֶל הַ֣ר הַ/מּ֔וֹר וְ/אֶל גִּבְעַ֖ת הַ/לְּבוֹנָֽה
verses.translit: 'd shypvch hyvm vnsv htsllym 'lkh ly 'l hr hmvr v'l gb't hlbvnh
verses.translation: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, I will get me to the mountain of myrrh, and to the hill of frankincense.

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֤/ךְ יָפָה֙ רַעְיָתִ֔/י וּ/מ֖וּם אֵ֥ין בָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khlkh yph r'yty vmvm 'yn bkh
verses.translation: Thou art all fair, my love; there is no spot in thee.

verses.original: אִתִּ֤/י מִ/לְּבָנוֹן֙ כַּלָּ֔ה אִתִּ֖/י מִ/לְּבָנ֣וֹן תָּב֑וֹאִי תָּשׁ֣וּרִי מֵ/רֹ֣אשׁ אֲמָנָ֗ה מֵ/רֹ֤אשׁ שְׂנִיר֙ וְ/חֶרְמ֔וֹן מִ/מְּעֹנ֣וֹת אֲרָי֔וֹת מֵֽ/הַרְרֵ֖י נְמֵרִֽים
verses.translit: 'ty mlbnvn khlh 'ty mlbnvn tbv'y tshvry mr'sh 'mnh mr'sh shnyr vchrmvn mm'nvt 'ryvt mhrry nmrym
verses.translation: Come with me from Lebanon, my spouse, with me from Lebanon: look from the top of Amana, from the top of Shenir and Hermon, from the lions’ dens, from the mountains of the leopards.

verses.original: לִבַּבְתִּ֖/נִי אֲחֹתִ֣/י כַלָּ֑ה לִבַּבְתִּ֨י/נִי֙ ב/אחד בְּ/אַחַ֣ת מֵ/עֵינַ֔יִ/ךְ בְּ/אַחַ֥ד עֲנָ֖ק מִ/צַּוְּרֹנָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: lbbtny 'chty khlh lbbtyny b'chd b'cht m'ynykh b'chd 'nq mtsvrnykh
verses.translation: Thou hast ravished my heart, my sister, my spouse; thou hast ravished my heart with one of thine eyes, with one chain of thy neck.

verses.original: מַה יָּפ֥וּ דֹדַ֖יִ/ךְ אֲחֹתִ֣/י כַלָּ֑ה מַה טֹּ֤בוּ דֹדַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ מִ/יַּ֔יִן וְ/רֵ֥יחַ שְׁמָנַ֖יִ/ךְ מִ/כָּל בְּשָׂמִֽים
verses.translit: mh ypv ddykh 'chty khlh mh tbv ddykh myyn vrych shmnykh mkhl bshmym
verses.translation: How fair is thy love, my sister, my spouse! how much better is thy love than wine! and the smell of thine ointments than all spices!

verses.original: נֹ֛פֶת תִּטֹּ֥פְנָה שִׂפְתוֹתַ֖יִ/ךְ כַּלָּ֑ה דְּבַ֤שׁ וְ/חָלָב֙ תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנֵ֔/ךְ וְ/רֵ֥יחַ שַׂלְמֹתַ֖יִ/ךְ כְּ/רֵ֥יחַ לְבָנֽוֹן
verses.translit: npt ttpnh shptvtykh khlh dbsh vchlb tcht lshvnkh vrych shlmtykh khrych lbnvn
verses.translation: Thy lips, O my spouse, drop as the honeycomb: honey and milk are under thy tongue; and the smell of thy garments is like the smell of Lebanon.

verses.original: גַּ֥ן נָע֖וּל אֲחֹתִ֣/י כַלָּ֑ה גַּ֥ל נָע֖וּל מַעְיָ֥ן חָתֽוּם
verses.translit: gn n'vl 'chty khlh gl n'vl m'yn chtvm
verses.translation: A garden inclosed is my sister, my spouse; a spring shut up, a fountain sealed.

verses.original: שְׁלָחַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ פַּרְדֵּ֣ס רִמּוֹנִ֔ים עִ֖ם פְּרִ֣י מְגָדִ֑ים כְּפָרִ֖ים עִם נְרָדִֽים
verses.translit: shlchykh prds rmvnym 'm pry mgdym khprym 'm nrdym
verses.translation: Thy plants are an orchard of pomegranates, with pleasant fruits; camphire, with spikenard,

verses.original: נֵ֣רְדְּ וְ/כַרְכֹּ֗ם קָנֶה֙ וְ/קִנָּמ֔וֹן עִ֖ם כָּל עֲצֵ֣י לְבוֹנָ֑ה מֹ֚ר וַ/אֲהָל֔וֹת עִ֖ם כָּל רָאשֵׁ֥י בְשָׂמִֽים
verses.translit: nrd vkhrkhm qnh vqnmvn 'm khl 'tsy lbvnh mr v'hlvt 'm khl r'shy bshmym
verses.translation: Spikenard and saffron; calamus and cinnamon, with all trees of frankincense; myrrh and aloes, with all the chief spices:

verses.original: מַעְיַ֣ן גַּנִּ֔ים בְּאֵ֖ר מַ֣יִם חַיִּ֑ים וְ/נֹזְלִ֖ים מִן לְבָנֽוֹן
verses.translit: m'yn gnym b'r mym chyym vnzlym mn lbnvn
verses.translation: A fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, and streams from Lebanon.

verses.original: ע֤וּרִי צָפוֹן֙ וּ/ב֣וֹאִי תֵימָ֔ן הָפִ֥יחִי גַנִּ֖/י יִזְּל֣וּ בְשָׂמָ֑י/ו יָבֹ֤א דוֹדִ/י֙ לְ/גַנּ֔/וֹ וְ/יֹאכַ֖ל פְּרִ֥י מְגָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'vry tspvn vbv'y tymn hpychy gny yzlv bshmyv yb' dvdy lgnv vy'khl pry mgdyv
verses.translation: Awake, O north wind; and come, thou south; blow upon my garden, that the spices thereof may flow out. Let my beloved come into his garden, and eat his pleasant fruits.

verses.original: בָּ֣אתִי לְ/גַנִּ/י֮ אֲחֹתִ֣/י כַלָּה֒ אָרִ֤יתִי מוֹרִ/י֙ עִם בְּשָׂמִ֔/י אָכַ֤לְתִּי יַעְרִ/י֙ עִם דִּבְשִׁ֔/י שָׁתִ֥יתִי יֵינִ֖/י עִם חֲלָבִ֑/י אִכְל֣וּ רֵעִ֔ים שְׁת֥וּ וְ/שִׁכְר֖וּ דּוֹדִֽים
verses.translit: b'ty lgny 'chty khlh 'ryty mvry 'm bshmy 'khlty y'ry 'm dbshy shtyty yyny 'm chlby 'khlv r'ym shtv vshkhrv dvdym
verses.translation: I am come into my garden, my sister, my spouse: I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk: eat, O friends; drink, yea, drink abundantly, O beloved.

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י יְשֵׁנָ֖ה וְ/לִבִּ֣/י עֵ֑ר ק֣וֹל דּוֹדִ֣/י דוֹפֵ֗ק פִּתְחִי לִ֞/י אֲחֹתִ֤/י רַעְיָתִ/י֙ יוֹנָתִ֣/י תַמָּתִ֔/י שֶׁ/רֹּאשִׁ/י֙ נִמְלָא טָ֔ל קְוֻּצּוֹתַ֖/י רְסִ֥יסֵי לָֽיְלָה
verses.translit: 'ny yshnh vlby 'r qvl dvdy dvpq ptchy ly 'chty r'yty yvnty tmty shr'shy nml' tl qvtsvty rsysy lylh
verses.translation: I sleep, but my heart waketh: it is the voice of my beloved that knocketh, saying , Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my undefiled: for my head is filled with dew, and my locks with the drops of the night.

verses.original: פָּשַׁ֨טְתִּי֙ אֶת כֻּתָּנְתִּ֔/י אֵיכָ֖כָה אֶלְבָּשֶׁ֑/נָּה רָחַ֥צְתִּי אֶת רַגְלַ֖/י אֵיכָ֥כָה אֲטַנְּפֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: pshtty 't khtnty 'ykhkhh 'lbshnh rchtsty 't rgly 'ykhkhh 'tnpm
verses.translation: I have put off my coat; how shall I put it on? I have washed my feet; how shall I defile them?

verses.original: דּוֹדִ֗/י שָׁלַ֤ח יָד/וֹ֙ מִן הַ/חֹ֔ר וּ/מֵעַ֖/י הָמ֥וּ עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: dvdy shlch ydv mn hchr vm'y hmv 'lyv
verses.translation: My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door , and my bowels were moved for him.

verses.original: קַ֥מְתִּֽי אֲנִ֖י לִ/פְתֹּ֣חַ לְ/דוֹדִ֑/י וְ/יָדַ֣/י נָֽטְפוּ מ֗וֹר וְ/אֶצְבְּעֹתַ/י֙ מ֣וֹר עֹבֵ֔ר עַ֖ל כַּפּ֥וֹת הַ/מַּנְעֽוּל
verses.translit: qmty 'ny lptch ldvdy vydy ntpv mvr v'tsb'ty mvr 'br 'l khpvt hmn'vl
verses.translation: I rose up to open to my beloved; and my hands dropped with myrrh, and my fingers with sweet smelling myrrh, upon the handles of the lock.

verses.original: פָּתַ֤חְתִּֽי אֲנִי֙ לְ/דוֹדִ֔/י וְ/דוֹדִ֖/י חָמַ֣ק עָבָ֑ר נַפְשִׁ/י֙ יָֽצְאָ֣ה בְ/דַבְּר֔/וֹ בִּקַּשְׁתִּ֨י/הוּ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א מְצָאתִ֔י/הוּ קְרָאתִ֖י/ו וְ/לֹ֥א עָנָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: ptchty 'ny ldvdy vdvdy chmq 'br npshy yts'h bdbrv bqshtyhv vl' mts'tyhv qr'tyv vl' 'nny
verses.translation: I opened to my beloved; but my beloved had withdrawn himself, and was gone: my soul failed when he spake: I sought him, but I could not find him; I called him, but he gave me no answer.

verses.original: מְצָאֻ֧/נִי הַ/שֹּׁמְרִ֛ים הַ/סֹּבְבִ֥ים בָּ/עִ֖יר הִכּ֣וּ/נִי פְצָע֑וּ/נִי נָשְׂא֤וּ אֶת רְדִידִ/י֙ מֵֽ/עָלַ֔/י שֹׁמְרֵ֖י הַ/חֹמֽוֹת
verses.translit: mts'ny hshmrym hsbbym b'yr hkhvny pts'vny nsh'v 't rdydy m'ly shmry hchmvt
verses.translation: The watchmen that went about the city found me, they smote me, they wounded me; the keepers of the walls took away my veil from me.

verses.original: הִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם בְּנ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם אִֽם תִּמְצְאוּ֙ אֶת דּוֹדִ֔/י מַה תַּגִּ֣ידוּ ל֔/וֹ שֶׁ/חוֹלַ֥ת אַהֲבָ֖ה אָֽנִי
verses.translit: hshb'ty 'tkhm bnvt yrvshlm 'm tmts'v 't dvdy mh tgydv lv shchvlt 'hbh 'ny
verses.translation: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, if ye find my beloved, that ye tell him, that I am sick of love.

verses.original: מַה דּוֹדֵ֣/ךְ מִ/דּ֔וֹד הַ/יָּפָ֖ה בַּ/נָּשִׁ֑ים מַה דּוֹדֵ֣/ךְ מִ/דּ֔וֹד שֶׁ/כָּ֖כָה הִשְׁבַּעְתָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: mh dvdkh mdvd hyph bnshym mh dvdkh mdvd shkhkhh hshb'tnv
verses.translation: What is thy beloved more than another beloved, O thou fairest among women? what is thy beloved more than another beloved, that thou dost so charge us?

verses.original: דּוֹדִ֥/י צַח֙ וְ/אָד֔וֹם דָּג֖וּל מֵ/רְבָבָֽה
verses.translit: dvdy tsch v'dvm dgvl mrbbh
verses.translation: My beloved is white and ruddy, the chiefest among ten thousand.

verses.original: רֹאשׁ֖/וֹ כֶּ֣תֶם פָּ֑ז קְוּצּוֹתָי/ו֙ תַּלְתַּלִּ֔ים שְׁחֹר֖וֹת כָּ/עוֹרֵֽב
verses.translit: r'shv khtm pz qvtsvtyv tltlym shchrvt kh'vrb
verses.translation: His head is as the most fine gold, his locks are bushy, and black as a raven.

verses.original: עֵינָ֕י/ו כְּ/יוֹנִ֖ים עַל אֲפִ֣יקֵי מָ֑יִם רֹֽחֲצוֹת֙ בֶּֽ/חָלָ֔ב יֹשְׁב֖וֹת עַל מִלֵּֽאת
verses.translit: 'ynyv khyvnym 'l 'pyqy mym rchtsvt bchlb yshbvt 'l ml't
verses.translation: His eyes are as the eyes of doves by the rivers of waters, washed with milk, and fitly set.

verses.original: לְחָיָ/ו֙ כַּ/עֲרוּגַ֣ת הַ/בֹּ֔שֶׂם מִגְדְּל֖וֹת מֶרְקָחִ֑ים שִׂפְתוֹתָי/ו֙ שֽׁוֹשַׁנִּ֔ים נֹטְפ֖וֹת מ֥וֹר עֹבֵֽר
verses.translit: lchyv kh'rvgt hbshm mgdlvt mrqchym shptvtyv shvshnym ntpvt mvr 'br
verses.translation: His cheeks are as a bed of spices, as sweet flowers: his lips like lilies, dropping sweet smelling myrrh.

verses.original: יָדָי/ו֙ גְּלִילֵ֣י זָהָ֔ב מְמֻלָּאִ֖ים בַּ/תַּרְשִׁ֑ישׁ מֵעָי/ו֙ עֶ֣שֶׁת שֵׁ֔ן מְעֻלֶּ֖פֶת סַפִּירִֽים
verses.translit: ydyv glyly zhb mml'ym btrshysh m'yv 'sht shn m'lpt spyrym
verses.translation: His hands are as gold rings set with the beryl: his belly is as bright ivory overlaid with sapphires.

verses.original: שׁוֹקָי/ו֙ עַמּ֣וּדֵי שֵׁ֔שׁ מְיֻסָּדִ֖ים עַל אַדְנֵי פָ֑ז מַרְאֵ֨/הוּ֙ כַּ/לְּבָנ֔וֹן בָּח֖וּר כָּ/אֲרָזִֽים
verses.translit: shvqyv 'mvdy shsh mysdym 'l 'dny pz mr'hv khlbnvn bchvr kh'rzym
verses.translation: His legs are as pillars of marble, set upon sockets of fine gold: his countenance is as Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.

verses.original: חִכּ/וֹ֙ מַֽמְתַקִּ֔ים וְ/כֻלּ֖/וֹ מַחֲּמַדִּ֑ים זֶ֤ה דוֹדִ/י֙ וְ/זֶ֣ה רֵעִ֔/י בְּנ֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: chkhv mmtqym vkhlv mchmdym zh dvdy vzh r'y bnvt yrvshlm
verses.translation: His mouth is most sweet: yea, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.

verses.original: אָ֚נָה הָלַ֣ךְ דּוֹדֵ֔/ךְ הַ/יָּפָ֖ה בַּ/נָּשִׁ֑ים אָ֚נָה פָּנָ֣ה דוֹדֵ֔/ךְ וּ/נְבַקְשֶׁ֖/נּוּ עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'nh hlkh dvdkh hyph bnshym 'nh pnh dvdkh vnbqshnv 'mkh
verses.translation: Whither is thy beloved gone, O thou fairest among women? whither is thy beloved turned aside? that we may seek him with thee.

verses.original: דּוֹדִ/י֙ יָרַ֣ד לְ/גַנּ֔/וֹ לַ/עֲרוּג֖וֹת הַ/בֹּ֑שֶׂם לִ/רְעוֹת֙ בַּ/גַּנִּ֔ים וְ/לִ/לְקֹ֖ט שֽׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים
verses.translit: dvdy yrd lgnv l'rvgvt hbshm lr'vt bgnym vllqt shvshnym
verses.translation: My beloved is gone down into his garden, to the beds of spices, to feed in the gardens, and to gather lilies.

verses.original: אֲנִ֤י לְ/דוֹדִ/י֙ וְ/דוֹדִ֣/י לִ֔/י הָ/רֹעֶ֖ה בַּ/שׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים
verses.translit: 'ny ldvdy vdvdy ly hr'h bshvshnym
verses.translation: I am my beloved’s, and my beloved is mine: he feedeth among the lilies.

verses.original: יָפָ֨ה אַ֤תְּ רַעְיָתִ/י֙ כְּ/תִרְצָ֔ה נָאוָ֖ה כִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם אֲיֻמָּ֖ה כַּ/נִּדְגָּלֽוֹת
verses.translit: yph 't r'yty khtrtsh n'vh khyrvshlm 'ymh khndglvt
verses.translation: Thou art beautiful, O my love, as Tirzah, comely as Jerusalem, terrible as an army with banners.

verses.original: הָסֵ֤בִּי עֵינַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ מִ/נֶּגְדִּ֔/י שֶׁ֥/הֵ֖ם הִרְהִיבֻ֑/נִי שַׂעְרֵ/ךְ֙ כְּ/עֵ֣דֶר הָֽ/עִזִּ֔ים שֶׁ/גָּלְשׁ֖וּ מִן הַ/גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: hsby 'ynykh mngdy shhm hrhybny sh'rkh kh'dr h'zym shglshv mn hgl'd
verses.translation: Turn away thine eyes from me, for they have overcome me: thy hair is as a flock of goats that appear from Gilead.

verses.original: שִׁנַּ֨יִ/ךְ֙ כְּ/עֵ֣דֶר הָֽ/רְחֵלִ֔ים שֶׁ/עָל֖וּ מִן הָ/רַחְצָ֑ה שֶׁ/כֻּלָּ/ם֙ מַתְאִימ֔וֹת וְ/שַׁכֻּלָ֖ה אֵ֥ין בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: shnykh kh'dr hrchlym sh'lv mn hrchtsh shkhlm mt'ymvt vshkhlh 'yn bhm
verses.translation: Thy teeth are as a flock of sheep which go up from the washing, whereof every one beareth twins, and there is not one barren among them.

verses.translit: khplch hrmvn rqtkh mb'd ltsmtkh
verses.translation: As a piece of a pomegranate are thy temples within thy locks.

verses.original: שִׁשִּׁ֥ים הֵ֨מָּה֙ מְּלָכ֔וֹת וּ/שְׁמֹנִ֖ים פִּֽילַגְשִׁ֑ים וַ/עֲלָמ֖וֹת אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר
verses.translit: shshym hmh mlkhvt vshmnym pylgshym v'lmvt 'yn mspr
verses.translation: There are threescore queens, and fourscore concubines, and virgins without number.

verses.original: אַחַ֥ת הִיא֙ יוֹנָתִ֣/י תַמָּתִ֔/י אַחַ֥ת הִיא֙ לְ/אִמָּ֔/הּ בָּרָ֥ה הִ֖יא לְ/יֽוֹלַדְתָּ֑/הּ רָא֤וּ/הָ בָנוֹת֙ וַֽ/יְאַשְּׁר֔וּ/הָ מְלָכ֥וֹת וּ/פִֽילַגְשִׁ֖ים וַֽ/יְהַלְלֽוּ/הָ
verses.translit: 'cht hy' yvnty tmty 'cht hy' l'mh brh hy' lyvldth r'vh bnvt vy'shrvh mlkhvt vpylgshym vyhllvh
verses.translation: My dove, my undefiled is but one; she is the only one of her mother, she is the choice one of her that bare her. The daughters saw her, and blessed her; yea , the queens and the concubines, and they praised her.

verses.original: מִי זֹ֥את הַ/נִּשְׁקָפָ֖ה כְּמוֹ שָׁ֑חַר יָפָ֣ה כַ/לְּבָנָ֗ה בָּרָה֙ כַּֽ/חַמָּ֔ה אֲיֻמָּ֖ה כַּ/נִּדְגָּלֽוֹת
verses.translit: my z't hnshqph khmv shchr yph khlbnh brh khchmh 'ymh khndglvt
verses.translation: Who is she that looketh forth as the morning, fair as the moon, clear as the sun, and terrible as an army with banners?

verses.original: אֶל גִּנַּ֤ת אֱגוֹז֙ יָרַ֔דְתִּי לִ/רְא֖וֹת בְּ/אִבֵּ֣י הַ/נָּ֑חַל לִ/רְאוֹת֙ הֲ/פָֽרְחָ֣ה הַ/גֶּ֔פֶן הֵנֵ֖צוּ הָ/רִמֹּנִֽים
verses.translit: 'l gnt 'gvz yrdty lr'vt b'by hnchl lr'vt hprchh hgpn hntsv hrmnym
verses.translation: I went down into the garden of nuts to see the fruits of the valley, and to see whether the vine flourished, and the pomegranates budded.

verses.original: לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי נַפְשִׁ֣/י שָׂמַ֔תְ/נִי מַרְכְּב֖וֹת עַמִּ/י נָדִֽיב
verses.translit: l' yd'ty npshy shmtny mrkhbvt 'my ndyb
verses.translation: Or ever I was aware, my soul made me like the chariots of Amminadib.
Return, return, O Shulamite; return, return, that we may look upon thee. What will ye see in the Shulamite? As it were the company of two armies.

verses.original: שׁ֤וּבִי שׁ֨וּבִי֙ הַ/שּׁ֣וּלַמִּ֔ית שׁ֥וּבִי שׁ֖וּבִי וְ/נֶחֱזֶה בָּ֑/ךְ מַֽה תֶּחֱזוּ֙ בַּ/שּׁ֣וּלַמִּ֔ית כִּ/מְחֹלַ֖ת הַֽ/מַּחֲנָֽיִם
verses.translit: shvby shvby hshvlmyt shvby shvby vnchzh bkh mh tchzv bshvlmyt khmchlt hmchnym
verses.translation: How beautiful are thy feet with shoes, O prince’s daughter! the joints of thy thighs are like jewels, the work of the hands of a cunning workman.

verses.original: מַה יָּפ֧וּ פְעָמַ֛יִ/ךְ בַּ/נְּעָלִ֖ים בַּת נָדִ֑יב חַמּוּקֵ֣י יְרֵכַ֔יִ/ךְ כְּמ֣וֹ חֲלָאִ֔ים מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יְדֵ֥י אָמָּֽן
verses.translit: mh ypv p'mykh bn'lym bt ndyb chmvqy yrkhykh khmv chl'ym m'shh ydy 'mn
verses.translation: Thy navel is like a round goblet, which wanteth not liquor: thy belly is like an heap of wheat set about with lilies.

verses.original: שָׁרְרֵ/ךְ֙ אַגַּ֣ן הַ/סַּ֔הַר אַל יֶחְסַ֖ר הַ/מָּ֑זֶג בִּטְנֵ/ךְ֙ עֲרֵמַ֣ת חִטִּ֔ים סוּגָ֖ה בַּ/שּׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים
verses.translit: shrrkh 'gn hshr 'l ychsr hmzg btnkh 'rmt chtym svgh bshvshnym
verses.translation: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins.

verses.original: שְׁנֵ֥י שָׁדַ֛יִ/ךְ כִּ/שְׁנֵ֥י עֳפָרִ֖ים תָּאֳמֵ֥י צְבִיָּֽה
verses.translit: shny shdykh khshny 'prym t'my tsbyh
verses.translation: Thy neck is as a tower of ivory; thine eyes like the fishpools in Heshbon, by the gate of Bath-rabbim: thy nose is as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Damascus.

verses.original: צַוָּארֵ֖/ךְ כְּ/מִגְדַּ֣ל הַ/שֵּׁ֑ן עֵינַ֜יִ/ךְ בְּרֵכ֣וֹת בְּ/חֶשְׁבּ֗וֹן עַל שַׁ֨עַר֙ בַּת רַבִּ֔ים אַפֵּ/ךְ֙ כְּ/מִגְדַּ֣ל הַ/לְּבָנ֔וֹן צוֹפֶ֖ה פְּנֵ֥י דַמָּֽשֶׂק
verses.translit: tsv'rkh khmgdl hshn 'ynykh brkhvt bchshbvn 'l sh'r bt rbym 'pkh khmgdl hlbnvn tsvph pny dmshq
verses.translation: Thine head upon thee is like Carmel, and the hair of thine head like purple; the king is held in the galleries.

verses.original: רֹאשֵׁ֤/ךְ עָלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ כַּ/כַּרְמֶ֔ל וְ/דַלַּ֥ת רֹאשֵׁ֖/ךְ כָּ/אַרְגָּמָ֑ן מֶ֖לֶךְ אָס֥וּר בָּ/רְהָטִֽים
verses.translit: r'shkh 'lykh khkhrml vdlt r'shkh kh'rgmn mlkh 'svr brhtym
verses.translation: How fair and how pleasant art thou, O love, for delights!

verses.original: מַה יָּפִית֙ וּ/מַה נָּעַ֔מְתְּ אַהֲבָ֖ה בַּ/תַּֽעֲנוּגִֽים
verses.translit: mh ypyt vmh n'mt 'hbh bt'nvgym
verses.translation: This thy stature is like to a palm tree, and thy breasts to clusters of grapes .

verses.original: זֹ֤את קֽוֹמָתֵ/ךְ֙ דָּֽמְתָ֣ה לְ/תָמָ֔ר וְ/שָׁדַ֖יִ/ךְ לְ/אַשְׁכֹּלֽוֹת
verses.translit: z't qvmtkh dmth ltmr vshdykh l'shkhlvt
verses.translation: I said, I will go up to the palm tree, I will take hold of the boughs thereof: now also thy breasts shall be as clusters of the vine, and the smell of thy nose like apples;

verses.original: אָמַ֨רְתִּי֙ אֶעֱלֶ֣ה בְ/תָמָ֔ר אֹֽחֲזָ֖ה בְּ/סַנְסִנָּ֑י/ו וְ/יִֽהְיוּ נָ֤א שָׁדַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ כְּ/אֶשְׁכְּל֣וֹת הַ/גֶּ֔פֶן וְ/רֵ֥יחַ אַפֵּ֖/ךְ כַּ/תַּפּוּחִֽים
verses.translit: 'mrty ''lh btmr 'chzh bsnsnyv vyhyv n' shdykh kh'shkhlvt hgpn vrych 'pkh khtpvchym
verses.translation: And the roof of thy mouth like the best wine for my beloved, that goeth down sweetly, causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak.

verses.original: וְ/חִכֵּ֕/ךְ כְּ/יֵ֥ין הַ/טּ֛וֹב הוֹלֵ֥ךְ לְ/דוֹדִ֖/י לְ/מֵישָׁרִ֑ים דּוֹבֵ֖ב שִׂפְתֵ֥י יְשֵׁנִֽים
verses.translit: vchkhkh khyyn htvb hvlkh ldvdy lmyshrym dvbb shpty yshnym
verses.translation: I am my beloved’s, and his desire is toward me.

verses.original: אֲנִ֣י לְ/דוֹדִ֔/י וְ/עָלַ֖/י תְּשׁוּקָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'ny ldvdy v'ly tshvqtv
verses.translation: Come, my beloved, let us go forth into the field; let us lodge in the villages.

verses.original: לְכָ֤/ה דוֹדִ/י֙ נֵצֵ֣א הַ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה נָלִ֖ינָה בַּ/כְּפָרִֽים
verses.translit: lkhh dvdy nts' hshdh nlynh bkhprym
verses.translation: Let us get up early to the vineyards; let us see if the vine flourish, whether the tender grape appear, and the pomegranates bud forth: there will I give thee my loves.

verses.original: נַשְׁכִּ֨ימָה֙ לַ/כְּרָמִ֔ים נִרְאֶ֞ה אִם פָּֽרְחָ֤ה הַ/גֶּ֨פֶן֙ פִּתַּ֣ח הַ/סְּמָדַ֔ר הֵנֵ֖צוּ הָ/רִמּוֹנִ֑ים שָׁ֛ם אֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת דֹּדַ֖/י לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: nshkhymh lkhrmym nr'h 'm prchh hgpn ptch hsmdr hntsv hrmvnym shm 'tn 't ddy lkh
verses.translation: The mandrakes give a smell, and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits , new and old, which I have laid up for thee, O my beloved.

verses.original: מִ֤י יִתֶּנְ/ךָ֙ כְּ/אָ֣ח לִ֔/י יוֹנֵ֖ק שְׁדֵ֣י אִמִּ֑/י אֶֽמְצָאֲ/ךָ֤ בַ/חוּץ֙ אֶשָׁ֣קְ/ךָ֔ גַּ֖ם לֹא יָב֥וּזוּ לִֽ/י
verses.translit: my ytnkh kh'ch ly yvnq shdy 'my 'mts'kh bchvts 'shqkh gm l' ybvzv ly
verses.translation: O that thou wert as my brother, that sucked the breasts of my mother! when I should find thee without, I would kiss thee; yea, I should not be despised.

verses.original: אֶנְהָֽגֲ/ךָ֗ אֲבִֽיאֲ/ךָ֛ אֶל בֵּ֥ית אִמִּ֖/י תְּלַמְּדֵ֑/נִי אַשְׁקְ/ךָ֙ מִ/יַּ֣יִן הָ/רֶ֔קַח מֵ/עֲסִ֖יס רִמֹּנִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'nhgkh 'by'kh 'l byt 'my tlmdny 'shqkh myyn hrqch m'sys rmny
verses.translation: I would lead thee, and bring thee into my mother’s house, who would instruct me: I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.

verses.original: שְׂמֹאל/וֹ֙ תַּ֣חַת רֹאשִׁ֔/י וִֽ/ימִינ֖/וֹ תְּחַבְּקֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: shm'lv tcht r'shy vymynv tchbqny
verses.translation: His left hand should be under my head, and his right hand should embrace me.

verses.original: הִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם בְּנ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם מַה תָּעִ֧ירוּ וּֽ/מַה תְּעֹֽרְר֛וּ אֶת הָ/אַהֲבָ֖ה עַ֥ד שֶׁ/תֶּחְפָּֽץ
verses.translit: hshb'ty 'tkhm bnvt yrvshlm mh t'yrv vmh t'rrv 't h'hbh 'd shtchpts
verses.translation: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, until he please.

verses.original: מִ֣י זֹ֗את עֹלָה֙ מִן הַ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר מִתְרַפֶּ֖קֶת עַל דּוֹדָ֑/הּ תַּ֤חַת הַ/תַּפּ֨וּחַ֙ עֽוֹרַרְתִּ֔י/ךָ שָׁ֚מָּ/ה חִבְּלַ֣תְ/ךָ אִמֶּ֔/ךָ שָׁ֖מָּ/ה חִבְּלָ֥ה יְלָדַֽתְ/ךָ
verses.translit: my z't 'lh mn hmdbr mtrpqt 'l dvdh tcht htpvch 'vrrtykh shmh chbltkh 'mkh shmh chblh yldtkh
verses.translation: Who is this that cometh up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved? I raised thee up under the apple tree: there thy mother brought thee forth: there she brought thee forth that bare thee.

verses.original: שִׂימֵ֨/נִי כַֽ/חוֹתָ֜ם עַל לִבֶּ֗/ךָ כַּֽ/חוֹתָם֙ עַל זְרוֹעֶ֔/ךָ כִּֽי עַזָּ֤ה כַ/מָּ֨וֶת֙ אַהֲבָ֔ה קָשָׁ֥ה כִ/שְׁא֖וֹל קִנְאָ֑ה רְשָׁפֶ֕י/הָ רִשְׁפֵּ֕י אֵ֖שׁ שַׁלְהֶ֥בֶתְ יָֽה
verses.translit: shymny khchvtm 'l lbkh khchvtm 'l zrv'kh khy 'zh khmvt 'hbh qshh khsh'vl qn'h rshpyh rshpy 'sh shlhbt yh
verses.translation: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most vehement flame.

verses.original: מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֗ים לֹ֤א יֽוּכְלוּ֙ לְ/כַבּ֣וֹת אֶת הָֽ/אַהֲבָ֔ה וּ/נְהָר֖וֹת לֹ֣א יִשְׁטְפ֑וּ/הָ אִם יִתֵּ֨ן אִ֜ישׁ אֶת כָּל ה֤וֹן בֵּית/וֹ֙ בָּ/אַהֲבָ֔ה בּ֖וֹז יָב֥וּזוּ לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mym rbym l' yvkhlv lkhbvt 't h'hbh vnhrvt l' yshtpvh 'm ytn 'ysh 't khl hvn bytv b'hbh bvz ybvzv lv
verses.translation: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.

verses.original: אָח֥וֹת לָ֨/נוּ֙ קְטַנָּ֔ה וְ/שָׁדַ֖יִם אֵ֣ין לָ֑/הּ מַֽה נַּעֲשֶׂה֙ לַ/אֲחֹתֵ֔/נוּ בַּ/יּ֖וֹם שֶׁ/יְּדֻבַּר בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'chvt lnv qtnh vshdym 'yn lh mh n'shh l'chtnv byvm shydbr bh
verses.translation: We have a little sister, and she hath no breasts: what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?

verses.original: אִם חוֹמָ֣ה הִ֔יא נִבְנֶ֥ה עָלֶ֖י/הָ טִ֣ירַת כָּ֑סֶף וְ/אִם דֶּ֣לֶת הִ֔יא נָצ֥וּר עָלֶ֖י/הָ ל֥וּחַ אָֽרֶז
verses.translit: 'm chvmh hy' nbnh 'lyh tyrt khsf v'm dlt hy' ntsvr 'lyh lvch 'rz
verses.translation: If she be a wall, we will build upon her a palace of silver: and if she be a door, we will inclose her with boards of cedar.

verses.original: אֲנִ֣י חוֹמָ֔ה וְ/שָׁדַ֖/י כַּ/מִּגְדָּל֑וֹת אָ֛ז הָיִ֥יתִי בְ/עֵינָ֖י/ו כְּ/מוֹצְאֵ֥ת שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: 'ny chvmh vshdy khmgdlvt 'z hyyty b'ynyv khmvts't shlvm
verses.translation: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers: then was I in his eyes as one that found favour.

verses.original: כֶּ֣רֶם הָיָ֤ה לִ/שְׁלֹמֹה֙ בְּ/בַ֣עַל הָמ֔וֹן נָתַ֥ן אֶת הַ/כֶּ֖רֶם לַ/נֹּטְרִ֑ים אִ֛ישׁ יָבִ֥א בְּ/פִרְי֖/וֹ אֶ֥לֶף כָּֽסֶף
verses.translit: khrm hyh lshlmh bb'l hmvn ntn 't hkhrm lntrym 'ysh yb' bpryv 'lf khsf
verses.translation: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal-hamon; he let out the vineyard unto keepers; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand pieces of silver.

verses.original: כָּרְמִ֥/י שֶׁ/לִּ֖/י לְ/פָנָ֑/י הָ/אֶ֤לֶף לְ/ךָ֙ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וּ/מָאתַ֖יִם לְ/נֹטְרִ֥ים אֶת פִּרְיֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khrmy shly lpny h'lf lkh shlmh vm'tym lntrym 't pryv
verses.translation: My vineyard, which is mine, is before me: thou, O Solomon, must have a thousand, and those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred.

verses.original: הַ/יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת בַּ/גַּנִּ֗ים חֲבֵרִ֛ים מַקְשִׁיבִ֥ים לְ/קוֹלֵ֖/ךְ הַשְׁמִיעִֽי/נִי
verses.translit: hyvshbt bgnym chbrym mqshybym lqvlkh hshmy'yny
verses.translation: Thou that dwellest in the gardens, the companions hearken to thy voice: cause me to hear it .

verses.original: בְּרַ֣ח דּוֹדִ֗/י וּֽ/דְמֵה לְ/ךָ֤ לִ/צְבִי֙ א֚וֹ לְ/עֹ֣פֶר הָֽ/אַיָּלִ֔ים עַ֖ל הָרֵ֥י בְשָׂמִֽים
verses.translit: brch dvdy vdmh lkh ltsby 'v l'pr h'ylym 'l hry bshmym
verses.translation: Make haste, my beloved, and be thou like to a roe or to a young hart upon the mountains of spices.

verses.original: חֲזוֹן֙ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֣הוּ בֶן אָמ֔וֹץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָזָ֔ה עַל יְהוּדָ֖ה וִ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם בִּ/ימֵ֨י עֻזִּיָּ֧הוּ יוֹתָ֛ם אָחָ֥ז יְחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ מַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: chzvn ysh'yhv bn 'mvts 'shr chzh 'l yhvdh vyrvshlm bymy 'zyhv yvtm 'chz ychzqyhv mlkhy yhvdh
verses.translation: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ וְ/הַאֲזִ֣ינִי אֶ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּ֑ר בָּנִים֙ גִּדַּ֣לְתִּי וְ/רוֹמַ֔מְתִּי וְ/הֵ֖ם פָּ֥שְׁעוּ בִֽ/י
verses.translit: shm'v shmym vh'zyny 'rts khy yhvh dbr bnym gdlty vrvmmty vhm psh'v by
verses.translation: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the LORD hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.

verses.original: יָדַ֥ע שׁוֹר֙ קֹנֵ֔/הוּ וַ/חֲמ֖וֹר אֵב֣וּס בְּעָלָ֑י/ו יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔ע עַמִּ֖/י לֹ֥א הִתְבּוֹנָֽן
verses.translit: yd' shvr qnhv vchmvr 'bvs b'lyv yshr'l l' yd' 'my l' htbvnn
verses.translation: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master’s crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.

verses.original: ה֣וֹי גּ֣וֹי חֹטֵ֗א עַ֚ם כֶּ֣בֶד עָוֺ֔ן זֶ֣רַע מְרֵעִ֔ים בָּנִ֖ים מַשְׁחִיתִ֑ים עָזְב֣וּ אֶת יְהוָ֗ה נִֽאֲצ֛וּ אֶת קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נָזֹ֥רוּ אָחֽוֹר
verses.translit: hvy gvy cht' 'm khbd 'vn zr' mr'ym bnym mshchytym 'zbv 't yhvh n'tsv 't qdvsh yshr'l nzrv 'chvr
verses.translation: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the LORD , they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.

verses.original: עַ֣ל מֶ֥ה תֻכּ֛וּ ע֖וֹד תּוֹסִ֣יפוּ סָרָ֑ה כָּל רֹ֣אשׁ לָ/חֳלִ֔י וְ/כָל לֵבָ֖ב דַּוָּֽי
verses.translit: 'l mh tkhv 'vd tvsypv srh khl r'sh lchly vkhl lbb dvy
verses.translation: Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.

verses.original: מִ/כַּף רֶ֤גֶל וְ/עַד רֹאשׁ֙ אֵֽין בּ֣/וֹ מְתֹ֔ם פֶּ֥צַע וְ/חַבּוּרָ֖ה וּ/מַכָּ֣ה טְרִיָּ֑ה לֹא זֹ֨רוּ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א חֻבָּ֔שׁוּ וְ/לֹ֥א רֻכְּכָ֖ה בַּ/שָּֽׁמֶן
verses.translit: mkhf rgl v'd r'sh 'yn bv mtm pts' vchbvrh vmkhh tryh l' zrv vl' chbshv vl' rkhkhh bshmn
verses.translation: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.

verses.original: אַרְצְ/כֶ֣ם שְׁמָמָ֔ה עָרֵי/כֶ֖ם שְׂרֻפ֣וֹת אֵ֑שׁ אַדְמַתְ/כֶ֗ם לְ/נֶגְדְּ/כֶם֙ זָרִים֙ אֹכְלִ֣ים אֹתָ֔/הּ וּ/שְׁמָמָ֖ה כְּ/מַהְפֵּכַ֥ת זָרִֽים
verses.translit: 'rtskhm shmmh 'rykhm shrpvt 'sh 'dmtkhm lngdkhm zrym 'khlym 'th vshmmh khmhpkht zrym
verses.translation: Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.

verses.original: וְ/נוֹתְרָ֥ה בַת צִיּ֖וֹן כְּ/סֻכָּ֣ה בְ/כָ֑רֶם כִּ/מְלוּנָ֥ה בְ/מִקְשָׁ֖ה כְּ/עִ֥יר נְצוּרָֽה
verses.translit: vnvtrh bt tsyvn khskhh bkhrm khmlvnh bmqshh kh'yr ntsvrh
verses.translation: And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.

verses.original: לוּלֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הוֹתִ֥יר לָ֛/נוּ שָׂרִ֖יד כִּ/מְעָ֑ט כִּ/סְדֹ֣ם הָיִ֔ינוּ לַ/עֲמֹרָ֖ה דָּמִֽינוּ
verses.translit: lvly yhvh tsb'vt hvtyr lnv shryd khm't khsdm hyynv l'mrh dmynv
verses.translation: Except the LORD of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, and we should have been like unto Gomorrah.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה קְצִינֵ֣י סְדֹ֑ם הַאֲזִ֛ינוּ תּוֹרַ֥ת אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ עַ֥ם עֲמֹרָֽה
verses.translit: shm'v dbr yhvh qtsyny sdm h'zynv tvrt 'lhynv 'm 'mrh
verses.translation: Hear the word of the LORD , ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.

verses.original: לָ/מָּה לִּ֤/י רֹב זִבְחֵי/כֶם֙ יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שָׂבַ֛עְתִּי עֹל֥וֹת אֵילִ֖ים וְ/חֵ֣לֶב מְרִיאִ֑ים וְ/דַ֨ם פָּרִ֧ים וּ/כְבָשִׂ֛ים וְ/עַתּוּדִ֖ים לֹ֥א חָפָֽצְתִּי
verses.translit: lmh ly rb zbchykhm y'mr yhvh shb'ty 'lvt 'ylym vchlb mry'ym vdm prym vkhbshym v'tvdym l' chptsty
verses.translation: To what purpose is the multitude of your sacrifices unto me? saith the LORD : I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats.

verses.original: כִּ֣י תָבֹ֔אוּ לֵ/רָא֖וֹת פָּנָ֑/י מִי בִקֵּ֥שׁ זֹ֛את מִ/יֶּדְ/כֶ֖ם רְמֹ֥ס חֲצֵרָֽ/י
verses.translit: khy tb'v lr'vt pny my bqsh z't mydkhm rms chtsry
verses.translation: When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to tread my courts?

verses.original: לֹ֣א תוֹסִ֗יפוּ הָבִיא֙ מִנְחַת שָׁ֔וְא קְטֹ֧רֶת תּוֹעֵבָ֛ה הִ֖יא לִ֑/י חֹ֤דֶשׁ וְ/שַׁבָּת֙ קְרֹ֣א מִקְרָ֔א לֹא אוּכַ֥ל אָ֖וֶן וַ/עֲצָרָֽה
verses.translit: l' tvsypv hby' mncht shv' qtrt tv'bh hy' ly chdsh vshbt qr' mqr' l' 'vkhl 'vn v'tsrh
verses.translation: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; the new moons and sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting.

verses.original: חָדְשֵׁי/כֶ֤ם וּ/מוֹעֲדֵי/כֶם֙ שָׂנְאָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֔/י הָי֥וּ עָלַ֖/י לָ/טֹ֑רַח נִלְאֵ֖יתִי נְשֹֽׂא
verses.translit: chdshykhm vmv'dykhm shn'h npshy hyv 'ly ltrch nl'yty nsh'
verses.translation: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear them .

verses.original: וּ/בְ/פָרִשְׂ/כֶ֣ם כַּפֵּי/כֶ֗ם אַעְלִ֤ים עֵינַ/י֙ מִ/כֶּ֔ם גַּ֛ם כִּֽי תַרְבּ֥וּ תְפִלָּ֖ה אֵינֶ֣/נִּי שֹׁמֵ֑עַ יְדֵי/כֶ֖ם דָּמִ֥ים מָלֵֽאוּ
verses.translit: vbprshkhm khpykhm ''lym 'yny mkhm gm khy trbv tplh 'ynny shm' ydykhm dmym ml'v
verses.translation: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you: yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.

verses.original: רַחֲצוּ֙ הִזַּכּ֔וּ הָסִ֛ירוּ רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵי/כֶ֖ם מִ/נֶּ֣גֶד עֵינָ֑/י חִדְל֖וּ הָרֵֽעַ
verses.translit: rchtsv hzkhv hsyrv r' m'llykhm mngd 'yny chdlv hr'
verses.translation: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;

verses.original: לִמְד֥וּ הֵיטֵ֛ב דִּרְשׁ֥וּ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט אַשְּׁר֣וּ חָמ֑וֹץ שִׁפְט֣וּ יָת֔וֹם רִ֖יבוּ אַלְמָנָֽה
verses.translit: lmdv hytb drshv mshpt 'shrv chmvts shptv ytvm rybv 'lmnh
verses.translation: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.

verses.original: לְכוּ נָ֛א וְ/נִוָּֽכְחָ֖ה יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אִם יִֽהְי֨וּ חֲטָאֵי/כֶ֤ם כַּ/שָּׁנִים֙ כַּ/שֶּׁ֣לֶג יַלְבִּ֔ינוּ אִם יַאְדִּ֥ימוּ כַ/תּוֹלָ֖ע כַּ/צֶּ֥מֶר יִהְיֽוּ
verses.translit: lkhv n' vnvkhchh y'mr yhvh 'm yhyv cht'ykhm khshnym khshlg ylbynv 'm y'dymv khtvl' khtsmr yhyv
verses.translation: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the LORD : though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

verses.original: אִם תֹּאב֖וּ וּ/שְׁמַעְתֶּ֑ם ט֥וּב הָ/אָ֖רֶץ תֹּאכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: 'm t'bv vshm'tm tvb h'rts t'khlv
verses.translation: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:

verses.original: וְ/אִם תְּמָאֲנ֖וּ וּ/מְרִיתֶ֑ם חֶ֣רֶב תְּאֻכְּל֔וּ כִּ֛י פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר
verses.translit: v'm tm'nv vmrytm chrb t'khlv khy py yhvh dbr
verses.translation: But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it .

verses.original: אֵיכָה֙ הָיְתָ֣ה לְ/זוֹנָ֔ה קִרְיָ֖ה נֶאֱמָנָ֑ה מְלֵאֲתִ֣י מִשְׁפָּ֗ט צֶ֛דֶק יָלִ֥ין בָּ֖/הּ וְ/עַתָּ֥ה מְרַצְּחִֽים
verses.translit: 'ykhh hyth lzvnh qryh n'mnh ml'ty mshpt tsdq ylyn bh v'th mrtschym
verses.translation: How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.

verses.original: כַּסְפֵּ֖/ךְ הָיָ֣ה לְ/סִיגִ֑ים סָבְאֵ֖/ךְ מָה֥וּל בַּ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: khspkh hyh lsygym sb'kh mhvl bmym
verses.translation: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:

verses.original: שָׂרַ֣יִ/ךְ סוֹרְרִ֗ים וְ/חַבְרֵי֙ גַּנָּבִ֔ים כֻּלּ/וֹ֙ אֹהֵ֣ב שֹׁ֔חַד וְ/רֹדֵ֖ף שַׁלְמֹנִ֑ים יָתוֹם֙ לֹ֣א יִשְׁפֹּ֔טוּ וְ/רִ֥יב אַלְמָנָ֖ה לֹֽא יָב֥וֹא אֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: shrykh svrrym vchbry gnbym khlv 'hb shchd vrdf shlmnym ytvm l' yshptv vryb 'lmnh l' ybv' 'lyhm
verses.translation: Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loveth gifts, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן נְאֻ֤ם הָֽ/אָדוֹן֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲבִ֖יר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ה֚וֹי אֶנָּחֵ֣ם מִ/צָּרַ֔/י וְ/אִנָּקְמָ֖ה מֵ/אוֹיְבָֽ/י
verses.translit: lkhn n'm h'dvn yhvh tsb'vt 'byr yshr'l hvy 'nchm mtsry v'nqmh m'vyby
verses.translation: Therefore saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts, the mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies:

verses.original: וְ/אָשִׁ֤יבָה יָדִ/י֙ עָלַ֔יִ/ךְ וְ/אֶצְרֹ֥ף כַּ/בֹּ֖ר סִיגָ֑יִ/ךְ וְ/אָסִ֖ירָה כָּל בְּדִילָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: v'shybh ydy 'lykh v'tsrf khbr sygykh v'syrh khl bdylykh
verses.translation: And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:

verses.original: וְ/אָשִׁ֤יבָה שֹׁפְטַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ כְּ/בָ/רִ֣אשֹׁנָ֔ה וְ/יֹעֲצַ֖יִ/ךְ כְּ/בַ/תְּחִלָּ֑ה אַחֲרֵי כֵ֗ן יִקָּ֤רֵא לָ/ךְ֙ עִ֣יר הַ/צֶּ֔דֶק קִרְיָ֖ה נֶאֱמָנָֽה
verses.translit: v'shybh shptykh khbr'shnh vy'tsykh khbtchlh 'chry khn yqr' lkh 'yr htsdq qryh n'mnh
verses.translation: And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.

verses.original: צִיּ֖וֹן בְּ/מִשְׁפָּ֣ט תִּפָּדֶ֑ה וְ/שָׁבֶ֖י/הָ בִּ/צְדָקָֽה
verses.translit: tsyvn bmshpt tpdh vshbyh btsdqh
verses.translation: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.

verses.original: וְ/שֶׁ֧בֶר פֹּשְׁעִ֛ים וְ/חַטָּאִ֖ים יַחְדָּ֑ו וְ/עֹזְבֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה יִכְלֽוּ
verses.translit: vshbr psh'ym vcht'ym ychdv v'zby yhvh ykhlv
verses.translation: And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and they that forsake the LORD shall be consumed.

verses.original: כִּ֣י יֵבֹ֔שׁוּ מֵ/אֵילִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֲמַדְתֶּ֑ם וְ/תַ֨חְפְּר֔וּ מֵ/הַ/גַּנּ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּחַרְתֶּֽם
verses.translit: khy ybshv m'ylym 'shr chmdtm vtchprv mhgnvt 'shr bchrtm
verses.translation: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.

verses.original: כִּ֣י תִֽהְי֔וּ כְּ/אֵלָ֖ה נֹבֶ֣לֶת עָלֶ֑/הָ וּֽ/כְ/גַנָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר מַ֖יִם אֵ֥ין לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khy thyv kh'lh nblt 'lh vkhgnh 'shr mym 'yn lh
verses.translation: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֤ה הֶ/חָסֹן֙ לִ/נְעֹ֔רֶת וּ/פֹעֲל֖/וֹ לְ/נִיצ֑וֹץ וּ/בָעֲר֧וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶ֛ם יַחְדָּ֖ו וְ/אֵ֥ין מְכַבֶּֽה
verses.translit: vhyh hchsn ln'rt vp'lv lnytsvts vb'rv shnyhm ychdv v'yn mkhbh
verses.translation: And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them .

verses.original: הַ/דָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָזָ֔ה יְשַֽׁעְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן אָמ֑וֹץ עַל יְהוּדָ֖ה וִ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr chzh ysh'yhv bn 'mvts 'l yhvdh vyrvshlm
verses.translation: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה בְּ/אַחֲרִ֣ית הַ/יָּמִ֗ים נָכ֨וֹן יִֽהְיֶ֜ה הַ֤ר בֵּית יְהוָה֙ בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ הֶ/הָרִ֔ים וְ/נִשָּׂ֖א מִ/גְּבָע֑וֹת וְ/נָהֲר֥וּ אֵלָ֖י/ו כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: vhyh b'chryt hymym nkhvn yhyh hr byt yhvh br'sh hhrym vnsh' mgb'vt vnhrv 'lyv khl hgvym
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the LORD’s house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.

verses.original: וְֽ/הָלְכ֞וּ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים וְ/אָמְרוּ֙ לְכ֣וּ וְ/נַעֲלֶ֣ה אֶל הַר יְהוָ֗ה אֶל בֵּית֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/יֹרֵ֨/נוּ֙ מִ/דְּרָכָ֔י/ו וְ/נֵלְכָ֖ה בְּ/אֹרְחֹתָ֑י/ו כִּ֤י מִ/צִּיּוֹן֙ תֵּצֵ֣א תוֹרָ֔ה וּ/דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה מִ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vhlkhv 'mym rbym v'mrv lkhv vn'lh 'l hr yhvh 'l byt 'lhy y'qb vyrnv mdrkhyv vnlkhh b'rchtyv khy mtsyvn tts' tvrh vdbr yhvh myrvshlm
verses.translation: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD , to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁפַט֙ בֵּ֣ין הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/הוֹכִ֖יחַ לְ/עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְ/כִתְּת֨וּ חַרְבוֹתָ֜/ם לְ/אִתִּ֗ים וַ/חֲנִיתֽוֹתֵי/הֶם֙ לְ/מַזְמֵר֔וֹת לֹא יִשָּׂ֨א ג֤וֹי אֶל גּוֹי֙ חֶ֔רֶב וְ/לֹא יִלְמְד֥וּ ע֖וֹד מִלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: vshpt byn hgvym vhvkhych l'mym rbym vkhttv chrbvtm l'tym vchnytvtyhm lmzmrvt l' ysh' gvy 'l gvy chrb vl' ylmdv 'vd mlchmh
verses.translation: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

verses.original: בֵּ֖ית יַעֲקֹ֑ב לְכ֥וּ וְ/נֵלְכָ֖ה בְּ/א֥וֹר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: byt y'qb lkhv vnlkhh b'vr yhvh
verses.translation: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of the LORD .

verses.original: כִּ֣י נָטַ֗שְׁתָּה עַמְּ/ךָ֙ בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב כִּ֤י מָלְאוּ֙ מִ/קֶּ֔דֶם וְ/עֹֽנְנִ֖ים כַּ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וּ/בְ/יַלְדֵ֥י נָכְרִ֖ים יַשְׂפִּֽיקוּ
verses.translit: khy ntshth 'mkh byt y'qb khy ml'v mqdm v'nnym khplshtym vbyldy nkhrym yshpyqv
verses.translation: Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.

verses.original: וַ/תִּמָּלֵ֤א אַרְצ/וֹ֙ כֶּ֣סֶף וְ/זָהָ֔ב וְ/אֵ֥ין קֵ֖צֶה לְ/אֹצְרֹתָ֑י/ו וַ/תִּמָּלֵ֤א אַרְצ/וֹ֙ סוּסִ֔ים וְ/אֵ֥ין קֵ֖צֶה לְ/מַרְכְּבֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vtml' 'rtsv khsf vzhb v'yn qtsh l'tsrtyv vtml' 'rtsv svsym v'yn qtsh lmrkhbtyv
verses.translation: Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots:

verses.original: וַ/תִּמָּלֵ֥א אַרְצ֖/וֹ אֱלִילִ֑ים לְ/מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יָדָי/ו֙ יִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֔וּ לַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשׂ֖וּ אֶצְבְּעֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vtml' 'rtsv 'lylym lm'shh ydyv yshtchvv l'shr 'shv 'tsb'tyv
verses.translation: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:

verses.original: וַ/יִּשַּׁ֥ח אָדָ֖ם וַ/יִּשְׁפַּל אִ֑ישׁ וְ/אַל תִּשָּׂ֖א לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyshch 'dm vyshpl 'ysh v'l tsh' lhm
verses.translation: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.

verses.original: בּ֣וֹא בַ/צּ֔וּר וְ/הִטָּמֵ֖ן בֶּֽ/עָפָ֑ר מִ/פְּנֵי֙ פַּ֣חַד יְהוָ֔ה וּ/מֵ/הֲדַ֖ר גְּאֹנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: bv' btsvr vhtmn b'pr mpny pchd yhvh vmhdr g'nv
verses.translation: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the LORD , and for the glory of his majesty.

verses.original: עֵינֵ֞י גַּבְה֤וּת אָדָם֙ שָׁפֵ֔ל וְ/שַׁ֖ח ר֣וּם אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וְ/נִשְׂגַּ֧ב יְהוָ֛ה לְ/בַדּ֖/וֹ בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/הֽוּא
verses.translit: 'yny gbhvt 'dm shpl vshch rvm 'nshym vnshgb yhvh lbdv byvm hhv'
verses.translation: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.

verses.original: כִּ֣י י֞וֹם לַ/יהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת עַ֥ל כָּל גֵּאֶ֖ה וָ/רָ֑ם וְ/עַ֖ל כָּל נִשָּׂ֥א וְ/שָׁפֵֽל
verses.translit: khy yvm lyhvh tsb'vt 'l khl g'h vrm v'l khl nsh' vshpl
verses.translation: For the day of the LORD of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; and he shall be brought low:

verses.original: וְ/עַל֙ כָּל אַרְזֵ֣י הַ/לְּבָנ֔וֹן הָ/רָמִ֖ים וְ/הַ/נִּשָּׂאִ֑ים וְ/עַ֖ל כָּל אַלּוֹנֵ֥י הַ/בָּשָֽׁן
verses.translit: v'l khl 'rzy hlbnvn hrmym vhnsh'ym v'l khl 'lvny hbshn
verses.translation: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,

verses.original: וְ/עַ֖ל כָּל הֶ/הָרִ֣ים הָ/רָמִ֑ים וְ/עַ֖ל כָּל הַ/גְּבָע֥וֹת הַ/נִּשָּׂאֽוֹת
verses.translit: v'l khl hhrym hrmym v'l khl hgb'vt hnsh'vt
verses.translation: And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,

verses.original: וְ/עַ֖ל כָּל מִגְדָּ֣ל גָּבֹ֑הַ וְ/עַ֖ל כָּל חוֹמָ֥ה בְצוּרָֽה
verses.translit: v'l khl mgdl gbh v'l khl chvmh btsvrh
verses.translation: And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,

verses.original: וְ/עַ֖ל כָּל אֳנִיּ֣וֹת תַּרְשִׁ֑ישׁ וְ/עַ֖ל כָּל שְׂכִיּ֥וֹת הַ/חֶמְדָּֽה
verses.translit: v'l khl 'nyvt trshysh v'l khl shkhyvt hchmdh
verses.translation: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.

verses.original: וְ/שַׁח֙ גַּבְה֣וּת הָ/אָדָ֔ם וְ/שָׁפֵ֖ל ר֣וּם אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וְ/נִשְׂגַּ֧ב יְהוָ֛ה לְ/בַדּ֖/וֹ בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/הֽוּא
verses.translit: vshch gbhvt h'dm vshpl rvm 'nshym vnshgb yhvh lbdv byvm hhv'
verses.translation: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אֱלִילִ֖ים כָּלִ֥יל יַחֲלֹֽף
verses.translit: vh'lylym khlyl ychlf
verses.translation: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.

verses.original: וּ/בָ֨אוּ֙ בִּ/מְעָר֣וֹת צֻרִ֔ים וּ/בִ/מְחִלּ֖וֹת עָפָ֑ר מִ/פְּנֵ֞י פַּ֤חַד יְהוָה֙ וּ/מֵ/הֲדַ֣ר גְּאוֹנ֔/וֹ בְּ/קוּמ֖/וֹ לַ/עֲרֹ֥ץ הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vb'v bm'rvt tsrym vbmchlvt 'pr mpny pchd yhvh vmhdr g'vnv bqvmv l'rts h'rts
verses.translation: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the LORD , and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/הוּא֙ יַשְׁלִ֣יךְ הָ/אָדָ֔ם אֵ֚ת אֱלִילֵ֣י כַסְפּ֔/וֹ וְ/אֵ֖ת אֱלִילֵ֣י זְהָב֑/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָֽשׂוּ ל/וֹ֙ לְ/הִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֔ת לַ/חְפֹּ֥ר פֵּר֖וֹת וְ/לָ/עֲטַלֵּפִֽים
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yshlykh h'dm 't 'lyly khspv v't 'lyly zhbv 'shr 'shv lv lhshtchvt lchpr prvt vl'tlpym
verses.translation: In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;

verses.original: לָ/בוֹא֙ בְּ/נִקְר֣וֹת הַ/צֻּרִ֔ים וּ/בִ/סְעִפֵ֖י הַ/סְּלָעִ֑ים מִ/פְּנֵ֞י פַּ֤חַד יְהוָה֙ וּ/מֵ/הֲדַ֣ר גְּאוֹנ֔/וֹ בְּ/קוּמ֖/וֹ לַ/עֲרֹ֥ץ הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: lbv' bnqrvt htsrym vbs'py hsl'ym mpny pchd yhvh vmhdr g'vnv bqvmv l'rts h'rts
verses.translation: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the LORD , and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.

verses.original: חִדְל֤וּ לָ/כֶם֙ מִן הָ֣/אָדָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נְשָׁמָ֖ה בְּ/אַפּ֑/וֹ כִּֽי בַ/מֶּ֥ה נֶחְשָׁ֖ב הֽוּא
verses.translit: chdlv lkhm mn h'dm 'shr nshmh b'pv khy bmh nchshb hv'
verses.translation: Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of?

verses.original: כִּי֩ הִנֵּ֨ה הָ/אָד֜וֹן יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת מֵסִ֤יר מִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ וּ/מִ֣/יהוּדָ֔ה מַשְׁעֵ֖ן וּ/מַשְׁעֵנָ֑ה כֹּ֚ל מִשְׁעַן לֶ֔חֶם וְ/כֹ֖ל מִשְׁעַן מָֽיִם
verses.translit: khy hnh h'dvn yhvh tsb'vt msyr myrvshlm vmyhvdh msh'n vmsh'nh khl msh'n lchm vkhl msh'n mym
verses.translation: For, behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water,

verses.original: גִּבּ֖וֹר וְ/אִ֣ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֑ה שׁוֹפֵ֥ט וְ/נָבִ֖יא וְ/קֹסֵ֥ם וְ/זָקֵֽן
verses.translit: gbvr v'ysh mlchmh shvpt vnby' vqsm vzqn
verses.translation: The mighty man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the prudent, and the ancient,

verses.original: שַׂר חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים וּ/נְשׂ֣וּא פָנִ֑ים וְ/יוֹעֵ֛ץ וַ/חֲכַ֥ם חֲרָשִׁ֖ים וּ/נְב֥וֹן לָֽחַשׁ
verses.translit: shr chmshym vnshv' pnym vyv'ts vchkhm chrshym vnbvn lchsh
verses.translation: The captain of fifty, and the honourable man, and the counsellor, and the cunning artificer, and the eloquent orator.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י נְעָרִ֖ים שָׂרֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/תַעֲלוּלִ֖ים יִמְשְׁלוּ בָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vntty n'rym shryhm vt'lvlym ymshlv bm
verses.translation: And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.

verses.original: וְ/נִגַּ֣שׂ הָ/עָ֔ם אִ֥ישׁ בְּ/אִ֖ישׁ וְ/אִ֣ישׁ בְּ/רֵעֵ֑/הוּ יִרְהֲב֗וּ הַ/נַּ֨עַר֙ בַּ/זָּקֵ֔ן וְ/הַ/נִּקְלֶ֖ה בַּ/נִּכְבָּֽד
verses.translit: vngsh h'm 'ysh b'ysh v'ysh br'hv yrhbv hn'r bzqn vhnqlh bnkhbd
verses.translation: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honourable.

verses.original: כִּֽי יִתְפֹּ֨שׂ אִ֤ישׁ בְּ/אָחִי/ו֙ בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֔י/ו שִׂמְלָ֣ה לְ/כָ֔ה קָצִ֖ין תִּֽהְיֶה לָּ֑/נוּ וְ/הַ/מַּכְשֵׁלָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את תַּ֥חַת יָדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khy ytpsh 'ysh b'chyv byt 'byv shmlh lkhh qtsyn thyh lnv vhmkhshlh hz't tcht ydkh
verses.translation: When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father, saying , Thou hast clothing, be thou our ruler, and let this ruin be under thy hand:

verses.original: יִשָּׂא֩ בַ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/ה֤וּא לֵ/אמֹר֙ לֹא אֶהְיֶ֣ה חֹבֵ֔שׁ וּ/בְ/בֵיתִ֕/י אֵ֥ין לֶ֖חֶם וְ/אֵ֣ין שִׂמְלָ֑ה לֹ֥א תְשִׂימֻ֖/נִי קְצִ֥ין עָֽם
verses.translit: ysh' byvm hhv' l'mr l' 'hyh chbsh vbbyty 'yn lchm v'yn shmlh l' tshymny qtsyn 'm
verses.translation: In that day shall he swear, saying, I will not be an healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing: make me not a ruler of the people.

verses.original: כִּ֤י כָשְׁלָה֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וִ/יהוּדָ֖ה נָפָ֑ל כִּֽי לְשׁוֹנָ֤/ם וּ/מַֽעַלְלֵי/הֶם֙ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה לַ/מְר֖וֹת עֵנֵ֥י כְבוֹדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy khshlh yrvshlm vyhvdh npl khy lshvnm vm'llyhm 'l yhvh lmrvt 'ny khbvdv
verses.translation: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen: because their tongue and their doings are against the LORD , to provoke the eyes of his glory.

verses.original: הַכָּרַ֤ת פְּנֵי/הֶם֙ עָ֣נְתָה בָּ֔/ם וְ/חַטָּאתָ֛/ם כִּ/סְדֹ֥ם הִגִּ֖ידוּ לֹ֣א כִחֵ֑דוּ א֣וֹי לְ/נַפְשָׁ֔/ם כִּֽי גָמְל֥וּ לָ/הֶ֖ם רָעָֽה
verses.translit: hkhrt pnyhm 'nth bm vcht'tm khsdm hgydv l' khchdv 'vy lnpshm khy gmlv lhm r'h
verses.translation: The shew of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.

verses.original: אִמְר֥וּ צַדִּ֖יק כִּי ט֑וֹב כִּֽי פְרִ֥י מַעַלְלֵי/הֶ֖ם יֹאכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: 'mrv tsdyq khy tvb khy pry m'llyhm y'khlv
verses.translation: Say ye to the righteous, that it shall be well with him: for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.

verses.original: א֖וֹי לְ/רָשָׁ֣ע רָ֑ע כִּֽי גְמ֥וּל יָדָ֖י/ו יֵעָ֥שֶׂה לּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'vy lrsh' r' khy gmvl ydyv y'shh lv
verses.translation: Woe unto the wicked! it shall be ill with him: for the reward of his hands shall be given him.

verses.original: עַמִּ/י֙ נֹגְשָׂ֣י/ו מְעוֹלֵ֔ל וְ/נָשִׁ֖ים מָ֣שְׁלוּ ב֑/וֹ עַמִּ/י֙ מְאַשְּׁרֶ֣י/ךָ מַתְעִ֔ים וְ/דֶ֥רֶךְ אֹֽרְחֹתֶ֖י/ךָ בִּלֵּֽעוּ
verses.translit: 'my ngshyv m'vll vnshym mshlv bv 'my m'shrykh mt'ym vdrkh 'rchtykh bl'v
verses.translation: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.

verses.original: נִצָּ֥ב לָ/רִ֖יב יְהוָ֑ה וְ/עֹמֵ֖ד לָ/דִ֥ין עַמִּֽים
verses.translit: ntsb lryb yhvh v'md ldyn 'mym
verses.translation: The LORD standeth up to plead, and standeth to judge the people.

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ בְּ/מִשְׁפָּ֣ט יָב֔וֹא עִם זִקְנֵ֥י עַמּ֖/וֹ וְ/שָׂרָ֑י/ו וְ/אַתֶּם֙ בִּֽעַרְתֶּ֣ם הַ/כֶּ֔רֶם גְּזֵלַ֥ת הֶֽ/עָנִ֖י בְּ/בָתֵּי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: yhvh bmshpt ybv' 'm zqny 'mv vshryv v'tm b'rtm hkhrm gzlt h'ny bbtykhm
verses.translation: The LORD will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.

verses.original: מ/ל/כם מַה לָּ/כֶם֙ תְּדַכְּא֣וּ עַמִּ֔/י וּ/פְנֵ֥י עֲנִיִּ֖ים תִּטְחָ֑נוּ נְאֻם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִ֖ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: mlkhm mh lkhm tdkh'v 'my vpny 'nyym ttchnv n'm 'dny yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? saith the Lord GOD of hosts.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה יַ֚עַן כִּ֤י גָֽבְהוּ֙ בְּנ֣וֹת צִיּ֔וֹן וַ/תֵּלַ֨כְנָה֙ נטוות נְטוּי֣וֹת גָּר֔וֹן וּֽ/מְשַׂקְּר֖וֹת עֵינָ֑יִם הָל֤וֹךְ וְ/טָפֹף֙ תֵּלַ֔כְנָה וּ/בְ/רַגְלֵי/הֶ֖ם תְּעַכַּֽסְנָה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh y'n khy gbhv bnvt tsyvn vtlkhnh ntvvt ntvyvt grvn vmshqrvt 'ynym hlvkh vtpf tlkhnh vbrglyhm t'khsnh
verses.translation: Moreover the LORD saith, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet:

verses.original: וְ/שִׂפַּ֣ח אֲדֹנָ֔/י קָדְקֹ֖ד בְּנ֣וֹת צִיּ֑וֹן וַ/יהוָ֖ה פָּתְ/הֵ֥ן יְעָרֶֽה
verses.translit: vshpch 'dny qdqd bnvt tsyvn vyhvh pthn y'rh
verses.translation: Therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and the LORD will discover their secret parts.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/ה֜וּא יָסִ֣יר אֲדֹנָ֗/י אֵ֣ת תִּפְאֶ֧רֶת הָ/עֲכָסִ֛ים וְ/הַ/שְּׁבִיסִ֖ים וְ/הַ/שַּׂהֲרֹנִֽים
verses.translit: byvm hhv' ysyr 'dny 't tp'rt h'khsym vhshbysym vhshhrnym
verses.translation: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet , and their cauls, and their round tires like the moon,

verses.original: הַ/נְּטִיפ֥וֹת וְ/הַ/שֵּׁיר֖וֹת וְ/הָֽ/רְעָלֽוֹת
verses.translit: hntypvt vhshyrvt vhr'lvt
verses.translation: The chains, and the bracelets, and the mufflers,

verses.original: הַ/פְּאֵרִ֤ים וְ/הַ/צְּעָדוֹת֙ וְ/הַ/קִּשֻּׁרִ֔ים וּ/בָתֵּ֥י הַ/נֶּ֖פֶשׁ וְ/הַ/לְּחָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: hp'rym vhts'dvt vhqshrym vbty hnpsh vhlchshym
verses.translation: The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,

verses.original: הַ/טַּבָּע֖וֹת וְ/נִזְמֵ֥י הָ/אָֽף
verses.translit: htb'vt vnzmy h'f
verses.translation: The rings, and nose jewels,

verses.original: הַ/מַּֽחֲלָצוֹת֙ וְ/הַ/מַּ֣עֲטָפ֔וֹת וְ/הַ/מִּטְפָּח֖וֹת וְ/הָ/חֲרִיטִֽים
verses.translit: hmchltsvt vhm'tpvt vhmtpchvt vhchrytym
verses.translation: The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,

verses.original: וְ/הַ/גִּלְיֹנִים֙ וְ/הַ/סְּדִינִ֔ים וְ/הַ/צְּנִיפ֖וֹת וְ/הָ/רְדִידִֽים
verses.translit: vhglynym vhsdynym vhtsnypvt vhrdydym
verses.translation: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֩ תַ֨חַת בֹּ֜שֶׂם מַ֣ק יִֽהְיֶ֗ה וְ/תַ֨חַת חֲגוֹרָ֤ה נִקְפָּה֙ וְ/תַ֨חַת מַעֲשֶׂ֤ה מִקְשֶׁה֙ קָרְחָ֔ה וְ/תַ֥חַת פְּתִיגִ֖יל מַחֲגֹ֣רֶת שָׂ֑ק כִּי תַ֖חַת יֹֽפִי
verses.translit: vhyh tcht bshm mq yhyh vtcht chgvrh nqph vtcht m'shh mqshh qrchh vtcht ptygyl mchgrt shq khy tcht ypy
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; and instead of a girdle a rent; and instead of well set hair baldness; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth; and burning instead of beauty.

verses.original: מְתַ֖יִ/ךְ בַּ/חֶ֣רֶב יִפֹּ֑לוּ וּ/גְבוּרָתֵ֖/ךְ בַּ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: mtykh bchrb yplv vgbvrtkh bmlchmh
verses.translation: Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war.

verses.original: וְ/אָנ֥וּ וְ/אָבְל֖וּ פְּתָחֶ֑י/הָ וְ/נִקָּ֖תָה לָ/אָ֥רֶץ תֵּשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: v'nv v'blv ptchyh vnqth l'rts tshb
verses.translation: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground.

verses.original: וְ/הֶחֱזִיקוּ֩ שֶׁ֨בַע נָשִׁ֜ים בְּ/אִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֗ד בַּ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/הוּא֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לַחְמֵ֣/נוּ נֹאכֵ֔ל וְ/שִׂמְלָתֵ֖/נוּ נִלְבָּ֑שׁ רַ֗ק יִקָּרֵ֤א שִׁמְ/ךָ֙ עָלֵ֔י/נוּ אֱסֹ֖ף חֶרְפָּתֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vhchzyqv shb' nshym b'ysh 'chd byvm hhv' l'mr lchmnv n'khl vshmltnv nlbsh rq yqr' shmkh 'lynv 'sf chrptnv
verses.translation: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by thy name, to take away our reproach.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ צֶ֣מַח יְהוָ֔ה לִ/צְבִ֖י וּ/לְ/כָב֑וֹד וּ/פְרִ֤י הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ לְ/גָא֣וֹן וּ/לְ/תִפְאֶ֔רֶת לִ/פְלֵיטַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yhyh tsmch yhvh ltsby vlkhbvd vpry h'rts lg'vn vltp'rt lplytt yshr'l
verses.translation: In that day shall the branch of the LORD be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the earth shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה הַ/נִּשְׁאָ֣ר בְּ/צִיּ֗וֹן וְ/הַ/נּוֹתָר֙ בִּ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם קָד֖וֹשׁ יֵאָ֣מֶר ל֑/וֹ כָּל הַ/כָּת֥וּב לַ/חַיִּ֖ים בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vhyh hnsh'r btsyvn vhnvtr byrvshlm qdvsh y'mr lv khl hkhtvb lchyym byrvshlm
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Zion, and he that remaineth in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem:

verses.original: אִ֣ם רָחַ֣ץ אֲדֹנָ֗/י אֵ֚ת צֹאַ֣ת בְּנוֹת צִיּ֔וֹן וְ/אֶת דְּמֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם יָדִ֣יחַ מִ/קִּרְבָּ֑/הּ בְּ/ר֥וּחַ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּ/בְ/ר֥וּחַ בָּעֵֽר
verses.translit: 'm rchts 'dny 't ts't bnvt tsyvn v't dmy yrvshlm ydych mqrbh brvch mshpt vbrvch b'r
verses.translation: When the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof by the spirit of judgment, and by the spirit of burning.

verses.original: וּ/בָרָ֣א יְהוָ֡ה עַל֩ כָּל מְכ֨וֹן הַר צִיּ֜וֹן וְ/עַל מִקְרָאֶ֗/הָ עָנָ֤ן יוֹמָם֙ וְ/עָשָׁ֔ן וְ/נֹ֛גַהּ אֵ֥שׁ לֶהָבָ֖ה לָ֑יְלָה כִּ֥י עַל כָּל כָּב֖וֹד חֻפָּֽה
verses.translit: vbr' yhvh 'l khl mkhvn hr tsyvn v'l mqr'h 'nn yvmm v'shn vngh 'sh lhbh lylh khy 'l khl khbvd chph
verses.translation: And the LORD will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion, and upon her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night: for upon all the glory shall be a defence.

verses.original: וְ/סֻכָּ֛ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לְ/צֵל יוֹמָ֖ם מֵ/חֹ֑רֶב וּ/לְ/מַחְסֶה֙ וּ/לְ/מִסְתּ֔וֹר מִ/זֶּ֖רֶם וּ/מִ/מָּטָֽר
verses.translit: vskhh thyh ltsl yvmm mchrb vlmchsh vlmstvr mzrm vmmtr
verses.translation: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat, and for a place of refuge, and for a covert from storm and from rain.

verses.original: אָשִׁ֤ירָה נָּא֙ לִֽ/ידִידִ֔/י שִׁירַ֥ת דּוֹדִ֖/י לְ/כַרְמ֑/וֹ כֶּ֛רֶם הָיָ֥ה לִֽ/ידִידִ֖/י בְּ/קֶ֥רֶן בֶּן שָֽׁמֶן
verses.translit: 'shyrh n' lydydy shyrt dvdy lkhrmv khrm hyh lydydy bqrn bn shmn
verses.translation: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:

verses.original: וַֽ/יְעַזְּקֵ֣/הוּ וַֽ/יְסַקְּלֵ֗/הוּ וַ/יִּטָּעֵ֨/הוּ֙ שֹׂרֵ֔ק וַ/יִּ֤בֶן מִגְדָּל֙ בְּ/תוֹכ֔/וֹ וְ/גַם יֶ֖קֶב חָצֵ֣ב בּ֑/וֹ וַ/יְקַ֛ו לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת עֲנָבִ֖ים וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ בְּאֻשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vy'zqhv vysqlhv vyt'hv shrq vybn mgdl btvkhv vgm yqb chtsb bv vyqv l'shvt 'nbym vy'sh b'shym
verses.translation: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֛ה יוֹשֵׁ֥ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וְ/אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֑ה שִׁפְטוּ נָ֕א בֵּינִ֖/י וּ/בֵ֥ין כַּרְמִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th yvshb yrvshlm v'ysh yhvdh shptv n' byny vbyn khrmy
verses.translation: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.

verses.original: מַה לַּ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת עוֹד֙ לְ/כַרְמִ֔/י וְ/לֹ֥א עָשִׂ֖יתִי בּ֑/וֹ מַדּ֧וּעַ קִוֵּ֛יתִי לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת עֲנָבִ֖ים וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ בְּאֻשִֽׁים
verses.translit: mh l'shvt 'vd lkhrmy vl' 'shyty bv mdv' qvyty l'shvt 'nbym vy'sh b'shym
verses.translation: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ אוֹדִֽיעָה נָּ֣א אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶׂ֖ה לְ/כַרְמִ֑/י הָסֵ֤ר מְשׂוּכָּת/וֹ֙ וְ/הָיָ֣ה לְ/בָעֵ֔ר פָּרֹ֥ץ גְּדֵר֖/וֹ וְ/הָיָ֥ה לְ/מִרְמָֽס
verses.translit: v'th 'vdy'h n' 'tkhm 't 'shr 'ny 'shh lkhrmy hsr mshvkhtv vhyh lb'r prts gdrv vhyh lmrms
verses.translation: And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:

verses.original: וַ/אֲשִׁיתֵ֣/הוּ בָתָ֗ה לֹ֤א יִזָּמֵר֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יֵעָדֵ֔ר וְ/עָלָ֥ה שָׁמִ֖יר וָ/שָׁ֑יִת וְ/עַ֤ל הֶ/עָבִים֙ אֲצַוֶּ֔ה מֵ/הַמְטִ֥יר עָלָ֖י/ו מָטָֽר
verses.translit: v'shythv bth l' yzmr vl' y'dr v'lh shmyr vshyt v'l h'bym 'tsvh mhmtyr 'lyv mtr
verses.translation: And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֶ֜רֶם יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה נְטַ֖ע שַׁעֲשׁוּעָ֑י/ו וַ/יְקַ֤ו לְ/מִשְׁפָּט֙ וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה מִשְׂפָּ֔ח לִ/צְדָקָ֖ה וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה צְעָקָֽה
verses.translit: khy khrm yhvh tsb'vt byt yshr'l v'ysh yhvdh nt' sh'shv'yv vyqv lmshpt vhnh mshpch ltsdqh vhnh ts'qh
verses.translation: For the vineyard of the LORD of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.

verses.original: ה֗וֹי מַגִּיעֵ֥י בַ֨יִת֙ בְּ/בַ֔יִת שָׂדֶ֥ה בְ/שָׂדֶ֖ה יַקְרִ֑יבוּ עַ֚ד אֶ֣פֶס מָק֔וֹם וְ/הֽוּשַׁבְתֶּ֥ם לְ/בַדְּ/כֶ֖ם בְּ/קֶ֥רֶב הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: hvy mgy'y byt bbyt shdh bshdh yqrybv 'd 'ps mqvm vhvshbtm lbdkhm bqrb h'rts
verses.translation: Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!

verses.original: בְּ/אָזְנָ֖/י יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אִם לֹ֞א בָּתִּ֤ים רַבִּים֙ לְ/שַׁמָּ֣ה יִֽהְי֔וּ גְּדֹלִ֥ים וְ/טוֹבִ֖ים מֵ/אֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: b'zny yhvh tsb'vt 'm l' btym rbym lshmh yhyv gdlym vtvbym m'yn yvshb
verses.translation: In mine ears said the LORD of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great and fair, without inhabitant. , etc

verses.original: כִּ֗י עֲשֶׂ֨רֶת֙ צִמְדֵּי כֶ֔רֶם יַעֲשׂ֖וּ בַּ֣ת אֶחָ֑ת וְ/זֶ֥רַע חֹ֖מֶר יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֵיפָֽה
verses.translit: khy 'shrt tsmdy khrm y'shv bt 'cht vzr' chmr y'shh 'yph
verses.translation: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.

verses.original: ה֛וֹי מַשְׁכִּימֵ֥י בַ/בֹּ֖קֶר שֵׁכָ֣ר יִרְדֹּ֑פוּ מְאַחֲרֵ֣י בַ/נֶּ֔שֶׁף יַ֖יִן יַדְלִיקֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: hvy mshkhymy bbqr shkhr yrdpv m'chry bnshf yyn ydlyqm
verses.translation: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till wine inflame them!

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֨ה כִנּ֜וֹר וָ/נֶ֗בֶל תֹּ֧ף וְ/חָלִ֛יל וָ/יַ֖יִן מִשְׁתֵּי/הֶ֑ם וְ/אֵ֨ת פֹּ֤עַל יְהוָה֙ לֹ֣א יַבִּ֔יטוּ וּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדָ֖י/ו לֹ֥א רָאֽוּ
verses.translit: vhyh khnvr vnbl tf vchlyl vyyn mshtyhm v't p'l yhvh l' ybytv vm'shh ydyv l' r'v
verses.translation: And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of the LORD , neither consider the operation of his hands.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֛ן גָּלָ֥ה עַמִּ֖/י מִ/בְּלִי דָ֑עַת וּ/כְבוֹד/וֹ֙ מְתֵ֣י רָעָ֔ב וַ/הֲמוֹנ֖/וֹ צִחֵ֥ה צָמָֽא
verses.translit: lkhn glh 'my mbly d't vkhbvdv mty r'b vhmvnv tschh tsm'
verses.translation: Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge: and their honourable men are famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן הִרְחִ֤יבָה שְּׁאוֹל֙ נַפְשָׁ֔/הּ וּ/פָעֲרָ֥ה פִ֖י/הָ לִ/בְלִי חֹ֑ק וְ/יָרַ֨ד הֲדָרָ֧/הּ וַ/הֲמוֹנָ֛/הּ וּ/שְׁאוֹנָ֖/הּ וְ/עָלֵ֥ז בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: lkhn hrchybh sh'vl npshh vp'rh pyh lbly chq vyrd hdrh vhmvnh vsh'vnh v'lz bh
verses.translation: Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure: and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשַּׁ֥ח אָדָ֖ם וַ/יִּשְׁפַּל אִ֑ישׁ וְ/עֵינֵ֥י גְבֹהִ֖ים תִּשְׁפַּֽלְנָה
verses.translit: vyshch 'dm vyshpl 'ysh v'yny gbhym tshplnh
verses.translation: And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:

verses.original: וַ/יִּגְבַּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בַּ/מִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ/הָ/אֵל֙ הַ/קָּד֔וֹשׁ נִקְדָּ֖שׁ בִּ/צְדָקָֽה
verses.translit: vygbh yhvh tsb'vt bmshpt vh'l hqdvsh nqdsh btsdqh
verses.translation: But the LORD of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.

verses.original: וְ/רָע֥וּ כְבָשִׂ֖ים כְּ/דָבְרָ֑/ם וְ/חָרְב֥וֹת מֵחִ֖ים גָּרִ֥ים יֹאכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: vr'v khbshym khdbrm vchrbvt mchym grym y'khlv
verses.translation: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.

verses.original: ה֛וֹי מֹשְׁכֵ֥י הֶֽ/עָוֺ֖ן בְּ/חַבְלֵ֣י הַ/שָּׁ֑וְא וְ/כַ/עֲב֥וֹת הָ/עֲגָלָ֖ה חַטָּאָֽה
verses.translit: hvy mshkhy h'vn bchbly hshv' vkh'bvt h'glh cht'h
verses.translation: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope:

verses.original: הָ/אֹמְרִ֗ים יְמַהֵ֧ר יָחִ֛ישָׁ/ה מַעֲשֵׂ֖/הוּ לְמַ֣עַן נִרְאֶ֑ה וְ/תִקְרַ֣ב וְ/תָב֗וֹאָ/ה עֲצַ֛ת קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְ/נֵדָֽעָה
verses.translit: h'mrym ymhr ychyshh m'shhv lm'n nr'h vtqrb vtbv'h 'tst qdvsh yshr'l vnd'h
verses.translation: That say, Let him make speed, and hasten his work, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know it !

verses.original: ה֣וֹי הָ/אֹמְרִ֥ים לָ/רַ֛ע ט֖וֹב וְ/לַ/טּ֣וֹב רָ֑ע שָׂמִ֨ים חֹ֤שֶׁךְ לְ/אוֹר֙ וְ/א֣וֹר לְ/חֹ֔שֶׁךְ שָׂמִ֥ים מַ֛ר לְ/מָת֖וֹק וּ/מָת֥וֹק לְ/מָֽר
verses.translit: hvy h'mrym lr' tvb vltvb r' shmym chshkh l'vr v'vr lchshkh shmym mr lmtvq vmtvq lmr
verses.translation: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!

verses.original: ה֖וֹי חֲכָמִ֣ים בְּ/עֵֽינֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/נֶ֥גֶד פְּנֵי/הֶ֖ם נְבֹנִֽים
verses.translit: hvy chkhmym b'ynyhm vngd pnyhm nbnym
verses.translation: Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!

verses.original: ה֕וֹי גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים לִ/שְׁתּ֣וֹת יָ֑יִן וְ/אַנְשֵׁי חַ֖יִל לִ/מְסֹ֥ךְ שֵׁכָֽר
verses.translit: hvy gbvrym lshtvt yyn v'nshy chyl lmskh shkhr
verses.translation: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:

verses.original: מַצְדִּיקֵ֥י רָשָׁ֖ע עֵ֣קֶב שֹׁ֑חַד וְ/צִדְקַ֥ת צַדִּיקִ֖ים יָסִ֥ירוּ מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: mtsdyqy rsh' 'qb shchd vtsdqt tsdyqym ysyrv mmnv
verses.translation: Which justify the wicked for reward, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!

verses.original: לָ/כֵן֩ כֶּ/אֱכֹ֨ל קַ֜שׁ לְשׁ֣וֹן אֵ֗שׁ וַ/חֲשַׁ֤שׁ לֶֽהָבָה֙ יִרְפֶּ֔ה שָׁרְשָׁ/ם֙ כַּ/מָּ֣ק יִֽהְיֶ֔ה וּ/פִרְחָ֖/ם כָּ/אָבָ֣ק יַעֲלֶ֑ה כִּ֣י מָאֲס֗וּ אֵ֚ת תּוֹרַת֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְ/אֵ֛ת אִמְרַ֥ת קְדֽוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נִאֵֽצוּ
verses.translit: lkhn kh'khl qsh lshvn 'sh vchshsh lhbh yrph shrshm khmq yhyh vprchm kh'bq y'lh khy m'sv 't tvrt yhvh tsb'vt v't 'mrt qdvsh yshr'l n'tsv
verses.translation: Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble, and the flame consumeth the chaff, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust: because they have cast away the law of the LORD of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֡ן חָרָה֩ אַף יְהוָ֨ה בְּ/עַמּ֜/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֣ט יָד֧/וֹ עָלָ֣י/ו וַ/יַּכֵּ֗/הוּ וַֽ/יִּרְגְּזוּ֙ הֶֽ/הָרִ֔ים וַ/תְּהִ֧י נִבְלָתָ֛/ם כַּ/סּוּחָ֖ה בְּ/קֶ֣רֶב חוּצ֑וֹת בְּ/כָל זֹאת֙ לֹא שָׁ֣ב אַפּ֔/וֹ וְ/ע֖וֹד יָד֥/וֹ נְטוּיָֽה
verses.translit: 'l khn chrh 'f yhvh b'mv vyt ydv 'lyv vykhhv vyrgzv hhrym vthy nbltm khsvchh bqrb chvtsvt bkhl z't l' shb 'pv v'vd ydv ntvyh
verses.translation: Therefore is the anger of the LORD kindled against his people, and he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them: and the hills did tremble, and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

verses.original: וְ/נָֽשָׂא נֵ֤ס לַ/גּוֹיִם֙ מֵ/רָח֔וֹק וְ/שָׁ֥רַק ל֖/וֹ מִ/קְצֵ֣ה הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה מְהֵרָ֖ה קַ֥ל יָבֽוֹא
verses.translit: vnsh' ns lgvym mrchvq vshrq lv mqtsh h'rts vhnh mhrh ql ybv'
verses.translation: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:

verses.original: אֵין עָיֵ֤ף וְ/אֵין כּוֹשֵׁל֙ בּ֔/וֹ לֹ֥א יָנ֖וּם וְ/לֹ֣א יִישָׁ֑ן וְ/לֹ֤א נִפְתַּח֙ אֵז֣וֹר חֲלָצָ֔י/ו וְ/לֹ֥א נִתַּ֖ק שְׂר֥וֹךְ נְעָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'yn 'yf v'yn khvshl bv l' ynvm vl' yyshn vl' nptch 'zvr chltsyv vl' ntq shrvkh n'lyv
verses.translation: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר חִצָּי/ו֙ שְׁנוּנִ֔ים וְ/כָל קַשְּׁתֹתָ֖י/ו דְּרֻכ֑וֹת פַּרְס֤וֹת סוּסָי/ו֙ כַּ/צַּ֣ר נֶחְשָׁ֔בוּ וְ/גַלְגִּלָּ֖י/ו כַּ/סּוּפָֽה
verses.translit: 'shr chtsyv shnvnym vkhl qshttyv drkhvt prsvt svsyv khtsr nchshbv vglglyv khsvph
verses.translation: Whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent, their horses’ hoofs shall be counted like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind:

verses.original: שְׁאָגָ֥ה ל֖/וֹ כַּ/לָּבִ֑יא ו/שאג יִשְׁאַ֨ג כַּ/כְּפִירִ֤ים וְ/יִנְהֹם֙ וְ/יֹאחֵ֣ז טֶ֔רֶף וְ/יַפְלִ֖יט וְ/אֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל
verses.translit: sh'gh lv khlby' vsh'g ysh'g khkhpyrym vynhm vy'chz trf vyplyt v'yn mtsyl
verses.translation: Their roaring shall be like a lion, they shall roar like young lions: yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and shall carry it away safe, and none shall deliver it .

verses.original: וְ/יִנְהֹ֥ם עָלָ֛י/ו בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא כְּ/נַהֲמַת יָ֑ם וְ/נִבַּ֤ט לָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ וְ/הִנֵּה חֹ֔שֶׁךְ צַ֣ר וָ/א֔וֹר חָשַׁ֖ךְ בַּ/עֲרִיפֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vynhm 'lyv byvm hhv' khnhmt ym vnbt l'rts vhnh chshkh tsr v'vr chshkh b'rypyh
verses.translation: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold darkness and sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַת מוֹת֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ עֻזִּיָּ֔הוּ וָ/אֶרְאֶ֧ה אֶת אֲדֹנָ֛/י יֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל כִּסֵּ֖א רָ֣ם וְ/נִשָּׂ֑א וְ/שׁוּלָ֖י/ו מְלֵאִ֥ים אֶת הַ/הֵיכָֽל
verses.translit: bshnt mvt hmlkh 'zyhv v'r'h 't 'dny yshb 'l khs' rm vnsh' vshvlyv ml'ym 't hhykhl
verses.translation: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.

verses.original: שְׂרָפִ֨ים עֹמְדִ֤ים מִ/מַּ֨עַל֙ ל֔/וֹ שֵׁ֧שׁ כְּנָפַ֛יִם שֵׁ֥שׁ כְּנָפַ֖יִם לְ/אֶחָ֑ד בִּ/שְׁתַּ֣יִם יְכַסֶּ֣ה פָנָ֗י/ו וּ/בִ/שְׁתַּ֛יִם יְכַסֶּ֥ה רַגְלָ֖י/ו וּ/בִ/שְׁתַּ֥יִם יְעוֹפֵֽף
verses.translit: shrpym 'mdym mm'l lv shsh khnpym shsh khnpym l'chd bshtym ykhsh pnyv vbshtym ykhsh rglyv vbshtym y'vpf
verses.translation: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.

verses.original: וְ/קָרָ֨א זֶ֤ה אֶל זֶה֙ וְ/אָמַ֔ר קָד֧וֹשׁ קָד֛וֹשׁ קָד֖וֹשׁ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת מְלֹ֥א כָל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ כְּבוֹדֽ/וֹ
