verses.translit: vqr' zh 'l zh v'mr qdvsh qdvsh qdvsh yhvh tsb'vt ml' khl h'rts khbvdv
verses.translation: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.

verses.original: וַ/יָּנֻ֨עוּ֙ אַמּ֣וֹת הַ/סִּפִּ֔ים מִ/קּ֖וֹל הַ/קּוֹרֵ֑א וְ/הַ/בַּ֖יִת יִמָּלֵ֥א עָשָֽׁן
verses.translit: vyn'v 'mvt hspym mqvl hqvr' vhbyt yml' 'shn
verses.translation: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֞ר אֽוֹי לִ֣/י כִֽי נִדְמֵ֗יתִי כִּ֣י אִ֤ישׁ טְמֵֽא שְׂפָתַ֨יִם֙ אָנֹ֔כִי וּ/בְ/תוֹךְ֙ עַם טְמֵ֣א שְׂפָתַ֔יִם אָנֹכִ֖י יוֹשֵׁ֑ב כִּ֗י אֶת הַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת רָא֥וּ עֵינָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'mr 'vy ly khy ndmyty khy 'ysh tm' shptym 'nkhy vbtvkh 'm tm' shptym 'nkhy yvshb khy 't hmlkh yhvh tsb'vt r'v 'yny
verses.translation: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣עָף אֵלַ֗/י אֶחָד֙ מִן הַ/שְּׂרָפִ֔ים וּ/בְ/יָד֖/וֹ רִצְפָּ֑ה בְּ/מֶ֨לְקַחַ֔יִם לָקַ֖ח מֵ/עַ֥ל הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vy'f 'ly 'chd mn hshrpym vbydv rtsph bmlqchym lqch m'l hmzbch
verses.translation: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:

verses.original: וַ/יַּגַּ֣ע עַל פִּ֔/י וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּ֛ה נָגַ֥ע זֶ֖ה עַל שְׂפָתֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/סָ֣ר עֲוֺנֶ֔/ךָ וְ/חַטָּאתְ/ךָ֖ תְּכֻפָּֽר
verses.translit: vyg' 'l py vy'mr hnh ng' zh 'l shptykh vsr 'vnkh vcht'tkh tkhpr
verses.translation: And he laid it upon my mouth, and said, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin purged.

verses.original: וָ/אֶשְׁמַ֞ע אֶת ק֤וֹל אֲדֹנָ/י֙ אֹמֵ֔ר אֶת מִ֥י אֶשְׁלַ֖ח וּ/מִ֣י יֵֽלֶךְ לָ֑/נוּ וָ/אֹמַ֖ר הִנְ/נִ֥י שְׁלָחֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: v'shm' 't qvl 'dny 'mr 't my 'shlch vmy ylkh lnv v'mr hnny shlchny
verses.translation: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר לֵ֥ךְ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֖ לָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֑ה שִׁמְע֤וּ שָׁמ֨וֹעַ֙ וְ/אַל תָּבִ֔ינוּ וּ/רְא֥וּ רָא֖וֹ וְ/אַל תֵּדָֽעוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr lkh v'mrt l'm hzh shm'v shmv' v'l tbynv vr'v r'v v'l td'v
verses.translation: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.

verses.original: הַשְׁמֵן֙ לֵב הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/אָזְנָ֥י/ו הַכְבֵּ֖ד וְ/עֵינָ֣י/ו הָשַׁ֑ע פֶּן יִרְאֶ֨ה בְ/עֵינָ֜י/ו וּ/בְ/אָזְנָ֣י/ו יִשְׁמָ֗ע וּ/לְבָב֥/וֹ יָבִ֛ין וָ/שָׁ֖ב וְ/רָ֥פָא לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hshmn lb h'm hzh v'znyv hkhbd v'ynyv hsh' pn yr'h b'ynyv vb'znyv yshm' vlbbv ybyn vshb vrp' lv
verses.translation: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֕ר עַד מָתַ֖י אֲדֹנָ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֡אמֶר עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁר֩ אִם שָׁא֨וּ עָרִ֜ים מֵ/אֵ֣ין יוֹשֵׁ֗ב וּ/בָתִּים֙ מֵ/אֵ֣ין אָדָ֔ם וְ/הָ/אֲדָמָ֖ה תִּשָּׁאֶ֥ה שְׁמָמָֽה
verses.translit: v'mr 'd mty 'dny vy'mr 'd 'shr 'm sh'v 'rym m'yn yvshb vbtym m'yn 'dm vh'dmh tsh'h shmmh
verses.translation: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate,

verses.original: וְ/רִחַ֥ק יְהוָ֖ה אֶת הָ/אָדָ֑ם וְ/רַבָּ֥ה הָ/עֲזוּבָ֖ה בְּ/קֶ֥רֶב הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vrchq yhvh 't h'dm vrbh h'zvbh bqrb h'rts
verses.translation: And the LORD have removed men far away, and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land.

verses.original: וְ/ע֥וֹד בָּ/הּ֙ עֲשִׂ֣רִיָּ֔ה וְ/שָׁ֖בָה וְ/הָיְתָ֣ה לְ/בָעֵ֑ר כָּ/אֵלָ֣ה וְ/כָ/אַלּ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּ/שַׁלֶּ֨כֶת֙ מַצֶּ֣בֶת בָּ֔/ם זֶ֥רַע קֹ֖דֶשׁ מַצַּבְתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'vd bh 'shryh vshbh vhyth lb'r kh'lh vkh'lvn 'shr bshlkht mtsbt bm zr' qdsh mtsbth
verses.translation: But yet in it shall be a tenth, and it shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance is in them, when they cast their leaves: so the holy seed shall be the substance thereof.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֡י בִּ/ימֵ֣י אָ֠חָז בֶּן יוֹתָ֨ם בֶּן עֻזִּיָּ֜הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה עָלָ֣ה רְצִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ אֲ֠רָם וּ/פֶ֨קַח בֶּן רְמַלְיָ֤הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה עָלֶ֑י/הָ וְ/לֹ֥א יָכֹ֖ל לְ/הִלָּחֵ֥ם עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vyhy bymy 'chz bn yvtm bn 'zyhv mlkh yhvdh 'lh rtsyn mlkh 'rm vpqch bn rmlyhv mlkh yshr'l yrvshlm lmlchmh 'lyh vl' ykhl lhlchm 'lyh
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up toward Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.

verses.original: וַ/יֻּגַּ֗ד לְ/בֵ֤ית דָּוִד֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר נָ֥חָֽה אֲרָ֖ם עַל אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַ/יָּ֤נַע לְבָב/וֹ֙ וּ/לְבַ֣ב עַמּ֔/וֹ כְּ/נ֥וֹעַ עֲצֵי יַ֖עַר מִ/פְּנֵי רֽוּחַ
verses.translit: vygd lbyt dvd l'mr nchh 'rm 'l 'prym vyn' lbbv vlbb 'mv khnv' 'tsy y'r mpny rvch
verses.translation: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is confederate with Ephraim. And his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָה֮ אֶֽל יְשַׁעְיָהוּ֒ צֵא נָא֙ לִ/קְרַ֣את אָחָ֔ז אַתָּ֕ה וּ/שְׁאָ֖ר יָשׁ֣וּב בְּנֶ֑/ךָ אֶל קְצֵ֗ה תְּעָלַת֙ הַ/בְּרֵכָ֣ה הָ/עֶלְיוֹנָ֔ה אֶל מְסִלַּ֖ת שְׂדֵ֥ה כוֹבֵֽס
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l ysh'yhv ts' n' lqr't 'chz 'th vsh'r yshvb bnkh 'l qtsh t'lt hbrkhh h'lyvnh 'l mslt shdh khvbs
verses.translation: Then said the LORD unto Isaiah, Go forth now to meet Ahaz, thou, and Shear-jashub thy son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller’s field;

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵ֠לָי/ו הִשָּׁמֵ֨ר וְ/הַשְׁקֵ֜ט אַל תִּירָ֗א וּ/לְבָבְ/ךָ֙ אַל יֵרַ֔ךְ מִ/שְּׁנֵ֨י זַנְב֧וֹת הָ/אוּדִ֛ים הָ/עֲשֵׁנִ֖ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה בָּ/חֳרִי אַ֛ף רְצִ֥ין וַ/אֲרָ֖ם וּ/בֶן רְמַלְיָֽהוּ
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyv hshmr vhshqt 'l tyr' vlbbkh 'l yrkh mshny znbvt h'vdym h'shnym h'lh bchry 'f rtsyn v'rm vbn rmlyhv
verses.translation: And say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.

verses.original: יַ֗עַן כִּֽי יָעַ֥ץ עָלֶ֛י/ךָ אֲרָ֖ם רָעָ֑ה אֶפְרַ֥יִם וּ/בֶן רְמַלְיָ֖הוּ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: y'n khy y'ts 'lykh 'rm r'h 'prym vbn rmlyhv l'mr
verses.translation: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have taken evil counsel against thee, saying,

verses.original: נַעֲלֶ֤ה בִֽ/יהוּדָה֙ וּ/נְקִיצֶ֔/נָּה וְ/נַבְקִעֶ֖/נָּה אֵלֵ֑י/נוּ וְ/נַמְלִ֥יךְ מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ בְּ/תוֹכָ֔/הּ אֵ֖ת בֶּן טָֽבְאַֽל
verses.translit: n'lh byhvdh vnqytsnh vnbq'nh 'lynv vnmlykh mlkh btvkhh 't bn tb'l
verses.translation: Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeal:

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה לֹ֥א תָק֖וּם וְ/לֹ֥א תִֽהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh l' tqvm vl' thyh
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD , It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.

verses.original: כִּ֣י רֹ֤אשׁ אֲרָם֙ דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וְ/רֹ֥אשׁ דַּמֶּ֖שֶׂק רְצִ֑ין וּ/בְ/ע֗וֹד שִׁשִּׁ֤ים וְ/חָמֵשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה יֵחַ֥ת אֶפְרַ֖יִם מֵ/עָֽם
verses.translit: khy r'sh 'rm dmshq vr'sh dmshq rtsyn vb'vd shshym vchmsh shnh ycht 'prym m'm
verses.translation: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people.

verses.original: וְ/רֹ֤אשׁ אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ שֹׁמְר֔וֹן וְ/רֹ֥אשׁ שֹׁמְר֖וֹן בֶּן רְמַלְיָ֑הוּ אִ֚ם לֹ֣א תַאֲמִ֔ינוּ כִּ֖י לֹ֥א תֵאָמֵֽנוּ
verses.translit: vr'sh 'prym shmrvn vr'sh shmrvn bn rmlyhv 'm l' t'mynv khy l' t'mnv
verses.translation: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If ye will not believe, surely ye shall not be established.

verses.original: וַ/יּ֣וֹסֶף יְהוָ֔ה דַּבֵּ֥ר אֶל אָחָ֖ז לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyvsf yhvh dbr 'l 'chz l'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the LORD spake again unto Ahaz, saying, added to speak

verses.original: שְׁאַל לְ/ךָ֣ א֔וֹת מֵ/עִ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ הַעְמֵ֣ק שְׁאָ֔לָה א֖וֹ הַגְבֵּ֥הַּ לְ/מָֽעְלָ/ה
verses.translit: sh'l lkh 'vt m'm yhvh 'lhykh h'mq sh'lh 'v hgbh lm'lh
verses.translation: Ask thee a sign of the LORD thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אָחָ֑ז לֹא אֶשְׁאַ֥ל וְ/לֹֽא אֲנַסֶּ֖ה אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'chz l' 'sh'l vl' 'nsh 't yhvh
verses.translation: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר שִׁמְעוּ נָ֖א בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֑ד הַ/מְעַ֤ט מִ/כֶּם֙ הַלְא֣וֹת אֲנָשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י תַלְא֖וּ גַּ֥ם אֶת אֱלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr shm'v n' byt dvd hm't mkhm hl'vt 'nshym khy tl'v gm 't 'lhy
verses.translation: And he said, Hear ye now, O house of David; Is it a small thing for you to weary men, but will ye weary my God also?

verses.original: לָ֠/כֵן יִתֵּ֨ן אֲדֹנָ֥/י ה֛וּא לָ/כֶ֖ם א֑וֹת הִנֵּ֣ה הָ/עַלְמָ֗ה הָרָה֙ וְ/יֹלֶ֣דֶת בֵּ֔ן וְ/קָרָ֥את שְׁמ֖/וֹ עִמָּ֥נוּ אֵֽל
verses.translit: lkhn ytn 'dny hv' lkhm 'vt hnh h'lmh hrh vyldt bn vqr't shmv 'mnv 'l
verses.translation: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

verses.original: חֶמְאָ֥ה וּ/דְבַ֖שׁ יֹאכֵ֑ל לְ/דַעְתּ֛/וֹ מָא֥וֹס בָּ/רָ֖ע וּ/בָח֥וֹר בַּ/טּֽוֹב
verses.translit: chm'h vdbsh y'khl ld'tv m'vs br' vbchvr btvb
verses.translation: Butter and honey shall he eat, that he may know to refuse the evil, and choose the good.

verses.original: כִּ֠י בְּ/טֶ֨רֶם יֵדַ֥ע הַ/נַּ֛עַר מָאֹ֥ס בָּ/רָ֖ע וּ/בָחֹ֣ר בַּ/טּ֑וֹב תֵּעָזֵ֤ב הָ/אֲדָמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתָּ֣ה קָ֔ץ מִ/פְּנֵ֖י שְׁנֵ֥י מְלָכֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: khy btrm yd' hn'r m's br' vbchr btvb t'zb h'dmh 'shr 'th qts mpny shny mlkhyh
verses.translation: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land that thou abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings.

verses.original: יָבִ֨יא יְהוָ֜ה עָלֶ֗י/ךָ וְ/עַֽל עַמְּ/ךָ֮ וְ/עַל בֵּ֣ית אָבִי/ךָ֒ יָמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא בָ֔אוּ לְ/מִ/יּ֥וֹם סוּר אֶפְרַ֖יִם מֵ/עַ֣ל יְהוּדָ֑ה אֵ֖ת מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר
verses.translit: yby' yhvh 'lykh v'l 'mkh v'l byt 'bykh ymym 'shr l' b'v lmyvm svr 'prym m'l yhvdh 't mlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: The LORD shall bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon thy father’s house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah; even the king of Assyria.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא יִשְׁרֹ֤ק יְהוָה֙ לַ/זְּב֔וּב אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּ/קְצֵ֖ה יְאֹרֵ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/לַ֨/דְּבוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ אַשּֽׁוּר
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' yshrq yhvh lzbvb 'shr bqtsh y'ry mtsrym vldbvrh 'shr b'rts 'shvr
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.

verses.original: וּ/בָ֨אוּ וְ/נָח֤וּ כֻלָּ/ם֙ בְּ/נַחֲלֵ֣י הַ/בַּתּ֔וֹת וּ/בִ/נְקִיקֵ֖י הַ/סְּלָעִ֑ים וּ/בְ/כֹל֙ הַ/נַּ֣עֲצוּצִ֔ים וּ/בְ/כֹ֖ל הַ/נַּהֲלֹלִֽים
verses.translit: vb'v vnchv khlm bnchly hbtvt vbnqyqy hsl'ym vbkhl hn'tsvtsym vbkhl hnhllym
verses.translation: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all thorns, and upon all bushes.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֡וּא יְגַלַּ֣ח אֲדֹנָ/י֩ בְּ/תַ֨עַר הַ/שְּׂכִירָ֜ה בְּ/עֶבְרֵ֤י נָהָר֙ בְּ/מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר אֶת הָ/רֹ֖אשׁ וְ/שַׂ֣עַר הָ/רַגְלָ֑יִם וְ/גַ֥ם אֶת הַ/זָּקָ֖ן תִּסְפֶּֽה
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yglch 'dny bt'r hshkhyrh b'bry nhr bmlkh 'shvr 't hr'sh vsh'r hrglym vgm 't hzqn tsph
verses.translation: In the same day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired, namely , by them beyond the river, by the king of Assyria, the head, and the hair of the feet: and it shall also consume the beard.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֖ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא יְחַיֶּה אִ֛ישׁ עֶגְלַ֥ת בָּקָ֖ר וּ/שְׁתֵּי צֹֽאן
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' ychyh 'ysh 'glt bqr vshty ts'n
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה מֵ/רֹ֛ב עֲשׂ֥וֹת חָלָ֖ב יֹאכַ֣ל חֶמְאָ֑ה כִּֽי חֶמְאָ֤ה וּ/דְבַשׁ֙ יֹאכֵ֔ל כָּל הַ/נּוֹתָ֖ר בְּ/קֶ֥רֶב הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vhyh mrb 'shvt chlb y'khl chm'h khy chm'h vdbsh y'khl khl hnvtr bqrb h'rts
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, for the abundance of milk that they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא יִֽהְיֶ֣ה כָל מָק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֧ר יִֽהְיֶה שָּׁ֛ם אֶ֥לֶף גֶּ֖פֶן בְּ/אֶ֣לֶף כָּ֑סֶף לַ/שָּׁמִ֥יר וְ/לַ/שַּׁ֖יִת יִֽהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' yhyh khl mqvm 'shr yhyh shm 'lf gpn b'lf khsf lshmyr vlshyt yhyh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place shall be, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, it shall even be for briers and thorns.

verses.original: בַּ/חִצִּ֥ים וּ/בַ/קֶּ֖שֶׁת יָ֣בוֹא שָׁ֑מָּ/ה כִּי שָׁמִ֥יר וָ/שַׁ֖יִת תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה כָל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: bchtsym vbqsht ybv' shmh khy shmyr vshyt thyh khl h'rts
verses.translation: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither; because all the land shall become briers and thorns.

verses.original: וְ/כֹ֣ל הֶ/הָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּ/מַּעְדֵּר֙ יֵעָ֣דֵר֔וּ/ן לֹֽא תָב֣וֹא שָׁ֔מָּ/ה יִרְאַ֖ת שָׁמִ֣יר וָ/שָׁ֑יִת וְ/הָיָה֙ לְ/מִשְׁלַ֣ח שׁ֔וֹר וּ/לְ/מִרְמַ֖ס שֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vkhl hhrym 'shr bm'dr y'drvn l' tbv' shmh yr't shmyr vshyt vhyh lmshlch shvr vlmrms shh
verses.translation: And on all hills that shall be digged with the mattock, there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of lesser cattle.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔/י קַח לְ/ךָ֖ גִּלָּי֣וֹן גָּד֑וֹל וּ/כְתֹ֤ב עָלָי/ו֙ בְּ/חֶ֣רֶט אֱנ֔וֹשׁ לְ/מַהֵ֥ר שָׁלָ֖ל חָ֥שׁ בַּֽז
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly qch lkh glyvn gdvl vkhtb 'lyv bchrt 'nvsh lmhr shll chsh bz
verses.translation: Moreover the LORD said unto me, Take thee a great roll, and write in it with a man’s pen concerning Maher-shalal-hash-baz.

verses.original: וְ/אָעִ֣ידָה לִּ֔/י עֵדִ֖ים נֶאֱמָנִ֑ים אֵ֚ת אוּרִיָּ֣ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/אֶת זְכַרְיָ֖הוּ בֶּ֥ן יְבֶרֶכְיָֽהוּ
verses.translit: v''ydh ly 'dym n'mnym 't 'vryh hkhhn v't zkhryhv bn ybrkhyhv
verses.translation: And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.

verses.original: וָ/אֶקְרַב֙ אֶל הַ/נְּבִיאָ֔ה וַ/תַּ֖הַר וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד בֵּ֑ן וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔/י קְרָ֣א שְׁמ֔/וֹ מַהֵ֥ר שָׁלָ֖ל חָ֥שׁ בַּֽז
verses.translit: v'qrb 'l hnby'h vthr vtld bn vy'mr yhvh 'ly qr' shmv mhr shll chsh bz
verses.translation: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said the LORD to me, Call his name Maher-shalal-hash-baz.

verses.original: כִּ֗י בְּ/טֶ֨רֶם֙ יֵדַ֣ע הַ/נַּ֔עַר קְרֹ֖א אָבִ֣/י וְ/אִמִּ֑/י יִשָּׂ֣א אֶת חֵ֣יל דַּמֶּ֗שֶׂק וְ/אֵת֙ שְׁלַ֣ל שֹׁמְר֔וֹן לִ/פְנֵ֖י מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר
verses.translit: khy btrm yd' hn'r qr' 'by v'my ysh' 't chyl dmshq v't shll shmrvn lpny mlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and my mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣סֶף יְהוָ֔ה דַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֛/י ע֖וֹד לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vysf yhvh dbr 'ly 'vd l'mr
verses.translation: The LORD spake also unto me again, saying,

verses.original: יַ֗עַן כִּ֤י מָאַס֙ הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֵ֚ת מֵ֣י הַ/שִּׁלֹ֔חַ הַ/הֹלְכִ֖ים לְ/אַ֑ט וּ/מְשׂ֥וֹשׂ אֶת רְצִ֖ין וּ/בֶן רְמַלְיָֽהוּ
verses.translit: y'n khy m's h'm hzh 't my hshlch hhlkhym l't vmshvsh 't rtsyn vbn rmlyhv
verses.translation: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;

verses.original: וְ/לָ/כֵ֡ן הִנֵּ֣ה אֲדֹנָ/י֩ מַעֲלֶ֨ה עֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם אֶת מֵ֣י הַ/נָּהָ֗ר הָ/עֲצוּמִים֙ וְ/הָ֣/רַבִּ֔ים אֶת מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּׁ֖וּר וְ/אֶת כָּל כְּבוֹד֑/וֹ וְ/עָלָה֙ עַל כָּל אֲפִיקָ֔י/ו וְ/הָלַ֖ךְ עַל כָּל גְּדוֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vlkhn hnh 'dny m'lh 'lyhm 't my hnhr h'tsvmym vhrbym 't mlkh 'shvr v't khl khbvdv v'lh 'l khl 'pyqyv vhlkh 'l khl gdvtyv
verses.translation: Now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the river, strong and many, even the king of Assyria, and all his glory: and he shall come up over all his channels, and go over all his banks:

verses.original: וְ/חָלַ֤ף בִּֽ/יהוּדָה֙ שָׁטַ֣ף וְ/עָבַ֔ר עַד צַוָּ֖אר יַגִּ֑יעַ וְ/הָיָה֙ מֻטּ֣וֹת כְּנָפָ֔י/ו מְלֹ֥א רֹֽחַב אַרְצְ/ךָ֖ עִמָּ֥נוּ אֵֽל
verses.translit: vchlf byhvdh shtf v'br 'd tsv'r ygy' vhyh mtvt khnpyv ml' rchb 'rtskh 'mnv 'l
verses.translation: And he shall pass through Judah; he shall overflow and go over, he shall reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.

verses.original: רֹ֤עוּ עַמִּים֙ וָ/חֹ֔תּוּ וְ/הַֽאֲזִ֔ינוּ כֹּ֖ל מֶרְחַקֵּי אָ֑רֶץ הִתְאַזְּר֣וּ וָ/חֹ֔תּוּ הִֽתְאַזְּר֖וּ וָ/חֹֽתּוּ
verses.translit: r'v 'mym vchtv vh'zynv khl mrchqy 'rts ht'zrv vchtv ht'zrv vchtv
verses.translation: Associate yourselves, O ye people, and ye shall be broken in pieces; and give ear, all ye of far countries: gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces.

verses.original: עֻ֥צוּ עֵצָ֖ה וְ/תֻפָ֑ר דַּבְּר֤וּ דָבָר֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יָק֔וּם כִּ֥י עִמָּ֖/נוּ אֵֽל
verses.translit: 'tsv 'tsh vtpr dbrv dbr vl' yqvm khy 'mnv 'l
verses.translation: Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God is with us.

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖/י כְּ/חֶזְקַ֣ת הַ/יָּ֑ד וְ/יִסְּרֵ֕/נִי מִ/לֶּ֛כֶת בְּ/דֶ֥רֶךְ הָֽ/עָם הַ/זֶּ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh 'ly khchzqt hyd vysrny mlkht bdrkh h'm hzh l'mr
verses.translation: For the LORD spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying,

verses.original: לֹא תֹאמְר֣וּ/ן קֶ֔שֶׁר לְ/כֹ֧ל אֲשֶׁר יֹאמַ֛ר הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּ֖ה קָ֑שֶׁר וְ/אֶת מוֹרָא֥/וֹ לֹֽא תִֽירְא֖וּ וְ/לֹ֥א תַעֲרִֽיצוּ
verses.translit: l' t'mrvn qshr lkhl 'shr y'mr h'm hzh qshr v't mvr'v l' tyr'v vl' t'rytsv
verses.translation: Say ye not, A confederacy, to all them to whom this people shall say, A confederacy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be afraid.

verses.original: אֶת יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֹת֣/וֹ תַקְדִּ֑ישׁוּ וְ/ה֥וּא מוֹרַאֲ/כֶ֖ם וְ/ה֥וּא מַֽעֲרִֽצְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 't yhvh tsb'vt 'tv tqdyshv vhv' mvr'khm vhv' m'rtskhm
verses.translation: Sanctify the LORD of hosts himself; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֖ה לְ/מִקְדָּ֑שׁ וּ/לְ/אֶ֣בֶן נֶ֠גֶף וּ/לְ/צ֨וּר מִכְשׁ֜וֹל לִ/שְׁנֵ֨י בָתֵּ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְ/פַ֣ח וּ/לְ/מוֹקֵ֔שׁ לְ/יוֹשֵׁ֖ב יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vhyh lmqdsh vl'bn ngf vltsvr mkhshvl lshny bty yshr'l lpch vlmvqsh lyvshb yrvshlm
verses.translation: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel, for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

verses.original: וְ/כָ֥שְׁלוּ בָ֖/ם רַבִּ֑ים וְ/נָפְל֣וּ וְ/נִשְׁבָּ֔רוּ וְ/נוֹקְשׁ֖וּ וְ/נִלְכָּֽדוּ
verses.translit: vkhshlv bm rbym vnplv vnshbrv vnvqshv vnlkhdv
verses.translation: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.

verses.original: צ֖וֹר תְּעוּדָ֑ה חֲת֥וֹם תּוֹרָ֖ה בְּ/לִמֻּדָֽ/י
verses.translit: tsvr t'vdh chtvm tvrh blmdy
verses.translation: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.

verses.original: וְ/חִכִּ֨יתִי֙ לַ/יהוָ֔ה הַ/מַּסְתִּ֥יר פָּנָ֖י/ו מִ/בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְ/קִוֵּ֖יתִֽי לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vchkhyty lyhvh hmstyr pnyv mbyt y'qb vqvyty lv
verses.translation: And I will wait upon the LORD , that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִ֗י וְ/הַ/יְלָדִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָֽתַן לִ֣/י יְהוָ֔ה לְ/אֹת֥וֹת וּ/לְ/מוֹפְתִ֖ים בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מֵ/עִם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הַ/שֹּׁכֵ֖ן בְּ/הַ֥ר צִיּֽוֹן
verses.translit: hnh 'nkhy vhyldym 'shr ntn ly yhvh l'tvt vlmvptym byshr'l m'm yhvh tsb'vt hshkhn bhr tsyvn
verses.translation: Behold, I and the children whom the LORD hath given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of hosts, which dwelleth in mount Zion.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יֹאמְר֣וּ אֲלֵי/כֶ֗ם דִּרְשׁ֤וּ אֶל הָ/אֹבוֹת֙ וְ/אֶל הַ/יִּדְּעֹנִ֔ים הַֽ/מְצַפְצְפִ֖ים וְ/הַ/מַּהְגִּ֑ים הֲ/לוֹא עַם֙ אֶל אֱלֹהָ֣י/ו יִדְרֹ֔שׁ בְּעַ֥ד הַ/חַיִּ֖ים אֶל הַ/מֵּתִֽים
verses.translit: vkhy y'mrv 'lykhm drshv 'l h'bvt v'l hyd'nym hmtsptspym vhmhgym hlv' 'm 'l 'lhyv ydrsh b'd hchyym 'l hmtym
verses.translation: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? for the living to the dead?

verses.original: לְ/תוֹרָ֖ה וְ/לִ/תְעוּדָ֑ה אִם לֹ֤א יֹֽאמְרוּ֙ כַּ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵֽין ל֖/וֹ שָֽׁחַר
verses.translit: ltvrh vlt'vdh 'm l' y'mrv khdbr hzh 'shr 'yn lv shchr
verses.translation: To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.

verses.original: וְ/עָ֥בַר בָּ֖/הּ נִקְשֶׁ֣ה וְ/רָעֵ֑ב וְ/הָיָ֨ה כִֽי יִרְעַ֜ב וְ/הִתְקַצַּ֗ף וְ/קִלֵּ֧ל בְּ/מַלְכּ֛/וֹ וּ/בֵ/אלֹהָ֖י/ו וּ/פָנָ֥ה לְ/מָֽעְלָ/ה
verses.translit: v'br bh nqshh vr'b vhyh khy yr'b vhtqtsf vqll bmlkhv vb'lhyv vpnh lm'lh
verses.translation: And they shall pass through it, hardly bestead and hungry: and it shall come to pass, that when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse their king and their God, and look upward.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל אֶ֖רֶץ יַבִּ֑יט וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה צָרָ֤ה וַ/חֲשֵׁכָה֙ מְע֣וּף צוּקָ֔ה וַ/אֲפֵלָ֖ה מְנֻדָּֽח
verses.translit: v'l 'rts ybyt vhnh tsrh vchshkhh m'vf tsvqh v'plh mndch
verses.translation: And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and they shall be driven to darkness.

verses.original: הָ/עָם֙ הַ/הֹלְכִ֣ים בַּ/חֹ֔שֶׁךְ רָא֖וּ א֣וֹר גָּד֑וֹל יֹשְׁבֵי֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ צַלְמָ֔וֶת א֖וֹר נָגַ֥הּ עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: h'm hhlkhym bchshkh r'v 'vr gdvl yshby b'rts tslmvt 'vr ngh 'lyhm
verses.translation: Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.

verses.original: הִרְבִּ֣יתָ הַ/גּ֔וֹי לא ל֖/וֹ הִגְדַּ֣לְתָּ הַ/שִּׂמְחָ֑ה שָׂמְח֤וּ לְ/פָנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ כְּ/שִׂמְחַ֣ת בַּ/קָּצִ֔יר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָגִ֖ילוּ בְּ/חַלְּקָ֥/ם שָׁלָֽל
verses.translit: hrbyt hgvy l' lv hgdlt hshmchh shmchv lpnykh khshmcht bqtsyr kh'shr ygylv bchlqm shll
verses.translation: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֶת עֹ֣ל סֻבֳּל֗/וֹ וְ/אֵת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה שִׁכְמ֔/וֹ שֵׁ֖בֶט הַ/נֹּגֵ֣שׂ בּ֑/וֹ הַחִתֹּ֖תָ כְּ/י֥וֹם מִדְיָֽן
verses.translit: khy 't 'l sblv v't mth shkhmv shbt hngsh bv hchtt khyvm mdyn
verses.translation: Thou hast multiplied the nation, and not increased the joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest, and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.

verses.original: כִּ֤י כָל סְאוֹן֙ סֹאֵ֣ן בְּ/רַ֔עַשׁ וְ/שִׂמְלָ֖ה מְגוֹלָלָ֣ה בְ/דָמִ֑ים וְ/הָיְתָ֥ה לִ/שְׂרֵפָ֖ה מַאֲכֹ֥לֶת אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: khy khl s'vn s'n br'sh vshmlh mgvllh bdmym vhyth lshrph m'khlt 'sh
verses.translation: For thou hast broken the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, as in the day of Midian.

verses.original: כִּי יֶ֣לֶד יֻלַּד לָ֗/נוּ בֵּ֚ן נִתַּן לָ֔/נוּ וַ/תְּהִ֥י הַ/מִּשְׂרָ֖ה עַל שִׁכְמ֑/וֹ וַ/יִּקְרָ֨א שְׁמ֜/וֹ פֶּ֠לֶא יוֹעֵץ֙ אֵ֣ל גִּבּ֔וֹר אֲבִי עַ֖ד שַׂר שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: khy yld yld lnv bn ntn lnv vthy hmshrh 'l shkhmv vyqr' shmv pl' yv'ts 'l gbvr 'by 'd shr shlvm
verses.translation: For every battle of the warrior is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood; but this shall be with burning and fuel of fire.

verses.original: ל/םרבה לְ/מַרְבֵּ֨ה הַ/מִּשְׂרָ֜ה וּ/לְ/שָׁל֣וֹם אֵֽין קֵ֗ץ עַל כִּסֵּ֤א דָוִד֙ וְ/עַל מַמְלַכְתּ֔/וֹ לְ/הָכִ֤ין אֹתָ/הּ֙ וּֽ/לְ/סַעֲדָ֔/הּ בְּ/מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּ/בִ/צְדָקָ֑ה מֵ/עַתָּה֙ וְ/עַד עוֹלָ֔ם קִנְאַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת תַּעֲשֶׂה זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: lmrbh lmrbh hmshrh vlshlvm 'yn qts 'l khs' dvd v'l mmlkhtv lhkhyn 'th vls'dh bmshpt vbtsdqh m'th v'd 'vlm qn't yhvh tsb'vt t'shh z't
verses.translation: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

verses.original: דָּבָ֛ר שָׁלַ֥ח אֲדֹנָ֖/י בְּ/יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְ/נָפַ֖ל בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: dbr shlch 'dny by'qb vnpl byshr'l
verses.translation: Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the LORD of hosts will perform this.

verses.original: וְ/יָדְעוּ֙ הָ/עָ֣ם כֻּלּ֔/וֹ אֶפְרַ֖יִם וְ/יוֹשֵׁ֣ב שֹׁמְר֑וֹן בְּ/גַאֲוָ֛ה וּ/בְ/גֹ֥דֶל לֵבָ֖ב לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyd'v h'm khlv 'prym vyvshb shmrvn bg'vh vbgdl lbb l'mr
verses.translation: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.

verses.original: לְבֵנִ֥ים נָפָ֖לוּ וְ/גָזִ֣ית נִבְנֶ֑ה שִׁקְמִ֣ים גֻּדָּ֔עוּ וַ/אֲרָזִ֖ים נַחֲלִֽיף
verses.translit: lbnym nplv vgzyt nbnh shqmym gd'v v'rzym nchlyf
verses.translation: And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,

verses.original: וַ/יְשַׂגֵּ֧ב יְהוָ֛ה אֶת צָרֵ֥י רְצִ֖ין עָלָ֑י/ו וְ/אֶת אֹיְבָ֖י/ו יְסַכְסֵֽךְ
verses.translit: vyshgb yhvh 't tsry rtsyn 'lyv v't 'ybyv yskhskh
verses.translation: The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with hewn stones: the sycomores are cut down, but we will change them into cedars.

verses.original: אֲרָ֣ם מִ/קֶּ֗דֶם וּ/פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ מֵֽ/אָח֔וֹר וַ/יֹּאכְל֥וּ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/כָל פֶּ֑ה בְּ/כָל זֹאת֙ לֹא שָׁ֣ב אַפּ֔/וֹ וְ/ע֖וֹד יָד֥/וֹ נְטוּיָֽה
verses.translit: 'rm mqdm vplshtym m'chvr vy'khlv 't yshr'l bkhl ph bkhl z't l' shb 'pv v'vd ydv ntvyh
verses.translation: Therefore the LORD shall set up the adversaries of Rezin against him, and join his enemies together;

verses.original: וְ/הָ/עָ֥ם לֹא שָׁ֖ב עַד הַ/מַּכֵּ֑/הוּ וְ/אֶת יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֹ֥א דָרָֽשׁוּ
verses.translit: vh'm l' shb 'd hmkhhv v't yhvh tsb'vt l' drshv
verses.translation: The Syrians before, and the Philistines behind; and they shall devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכְרֵ֨ת יְהוָ֜ה מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֗ל רֹ֧אשׁ וְ/זָנָ֛ב כִּפָּ֥ה וְ/אַגְמ֖וֹן י֥וֹם אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vykhrt yhvh myshr'l r'sh vznb khph v'gmvn yvm 'chd
verses.translation: For the people turneth not unto him that smiteth them, neither do they seek the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: זָקֵ֥ן וּ/נְשׂוּא פָנִ֖ים ה֣וּא הָ/רֹ֑אשׁ וְ/נָבִ֥יא מֽוֹרֶה שֶּׁ֖קֶר ה֥וּא הַ/זָּנָֽב
verses.translit: zqn vnshv' pnym hv' hr'sh vnby' mvrh shqr hv' hznb
verses.translation: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, branch and rush, in one day.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְי֛וּ מְאַשְּׁרֵ֥י הָֽ/עָם הַ/זֶּ֖ה מַתְעִ֑ים וּ/מְאֻשָּׁרָ֖י/ו מְבֻלָּעִֽים
verses.translit: vyhyv m'shry h'm hzh mt'ym vm'shryv mbl'ym
verses.translation: The ancient and honourable, he is the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he is the tail.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֨ן עַל בַּחוּרָ֜י/ו לֹֽא יִשְׂמַ֣ח אֲדֹנָ֗/י וְ/אֶת יְתֹמָ֤י/ו וְ/אֶת אַלְמְנֹתָי/ו֙ לֹ֣א יְרַחֵ֔ם כִּ֤י כֻלּ/וֹ֙ חָנֵ֣ף וּ/מֵרַ֔ע וְ/כָל פֶּ֖ה דֹּבֵ֣ר נְבָלָ֑ה בְּ/כָל זֹאת֙ לֹא שָׁ֣ב אַפּ֔/וֹ וְ/ע֖וֹד יָד֥/וֹ נְטוּיָֽה
verses.translit: 'l khn 'l bchvryv l' yshmch 'dny v't ytmyv v't 'lmntyv l' yrchm khy khlv chnf vmr' vkhl ph dbr nblh bkhl z't l' shb 'pv v'vd ydv ntvyh
verses.translation: For the leaders of this people cause them to err; and they that are led of them are destroyed.

verses.original: כִּֽי בָעֲרָ֤ה כָ/אֵשׁ֙ רִשְׁעָ֔ה שָׁמִ֥יר וָ/שַׁ֖יִת תֹּאכֵ֑ל וַ/תִּצַּת֙ בְּ/סִֽבְכֵ֣י הַ/יַּ֔עַר וַ/יִּֽתְאַבְּכ֖וּ גֵּא֥וּת עָשָֽׁן
verses.translit: khy b'rh kh'sh rsh'h shmyr vshyt t'khl vttst bsbkhy hy'r vyt'bkhv g'vt 'shn
verses.translation: Therefore the Lord shall have no joy in their young men, neither shall have mercy on their fatherless and widows: for every one is an hypocrite and an evildoer, and every mouth speaketh folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

verses.original: בְּ/עֶבְרַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת נֶעְתַּ֣ם אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יְהִ֤י הָ/עָם֙ כְּ/מַאֲכֹ֣לֶת אֵ֔שׁ אִ֥ישׁ אֶל אָחִ֖י/ו לֹ֥א יַחְמֹֽלוּ
verses.translit: b'brt yhvh tsb'vt n'tm 'rts vyhy h'm khm'khlt 'sh 'ysh 'l 'chyv l' ychmlv
verses.translation: For wickedness burneth as the fire: it shall devour the briers and thorns, and shall kindle in the thickets of the forest, and they shall mount up like the lifting up of smoke.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגְזֹ֤ר עַל יָמִין֙ וְ/רָעֵ֔ב וַ/יֹּ֥אכַל עַל שְׂמֹ֖אול וְ/לֹ֣א שָׂבֵ֑עוּ אִ֥ישׁ בְּשַׂר זְרֹע֖/וֹ יֹאכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: vygzr 'l ymyn vr'b vy'khl 'l shm'vl vl' shb'v 'ysh bshr zr'v y'khlv
verses.translation: Through the wrath of the LORD of hosts is the land darkened, and the people shall be as the fuel of the fire: no man shall spare his brother.

verses.original: מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה אֶת אֶפְרַ֗יִם וְ/אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ אֶת מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה יַחְדָּ֥ו הֵ֖מָּה עַל יְהוּדָ֑ה בְּ/כָל זֹאת֙ לֹא שָׁ֣ב אַפּ֔/וֹ וְ/ע֖וֹד יָד֥/וֹ נְטוּיָֽה
verses.translit: mnshh 't 'prym v'prym 't mnshh ychdv hmh 'l yhvdh bkhl z't l' shb 'pv v'vd ydv ntvyh
verses.translation: And he shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left hand, and they shall not be satisfied: they shall eat every man the flesh of his own arm:
Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh: and they together shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

verses.original: ה֥וֹי הַ/חֹֽקְקִ֖ים חִקְקֵי אָ֑וֶן וּֽ/מְכַתְּבִ֥ים עָמָ֖ל כִּתֵּֽבוּ
verses.translit: hvy hchqqym chqqy 'vn vmkhtbym 'ml khtbv
verses.translation: Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness which they have prescribed;

verses.original: לְ/הַטּ֤וֹת מִ/דִּין֙ דַּלִּ֔ים וְ/לִ/גְזֹ֕ל מִשְׁפַּ֖ט עֲנִיֵּ֣י עַמִּ֑/י לִ/הְי֤וֹת אַלְמָנוֹת֙ שְׁלָלָ֔/ם וְ/אֶת יְתוֹמִ֖ים יָבֹֽזּוּ
verses.translit: lhtvt mdyn dlym vlgzl mshpt 'nyy 'my lhyvt 'lmnvt shllm v't ytvmym ybzv
verses.translation: To turn aside the needy from judgment, and to take away the right from the poor of my people, that widows may be their prey, and that they may rob the fatherless!

verses.original: וּ/מַֽה תַּעֲשׂוּ֙ לְ/י֣וֹם פְּקֻדָּ֔ה וּ/לְ/שׁוֹאָ֖ה מִ/מֶּרְחָ֣ק תָּב֑וֹא עַל מִי֙ תָּנ֣וּסוּ לְ/עֶזְרָ֔ה וְ/אָ֥נָה תַעַזְב֖וּ כְּבוֹדְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vmh t'shv lyvm pqdh vlshv'h mmrchq tbv' 'l my tnvsv l'zrh v'nh t'zbv khbvdkhm
verses.translation: And what will ye do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which shall come from far? to whom will ye flee for help? and where will ye leave your glory?

verses.original: בִּלְתִּ֤י כָרַע֙ תַּ֣חַת אַסִּ֔יר וְ/תַ֥חַת הֲרוּגִ֖ים יִפֹּ֑לוּ בְּ/כָל זֹאת֙ לֹא שָׁ֣ב אַפּ֔/וֹ וְ/ע֖וֹד יָד֥/וֹ נְטוּיָֽה
verses.translit: blty khr' tcht 'syr vtcht hrvgym yplv bkhl z't l' shb 'pv v'vd ydv ntvyh
verses.translation: Without me they shall bow down under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

verses.original: ה֥וֹי אַשּׁ֖וּר שֵׁ֣בֶט אַפִּ֑/י וּ/מַטֶּה ה֥וּא בְ/יָדָ֖/ם זַעְמִֽ/י
verses.translit: hvy 'shvr shbt 'py vmth hv' bydm z'my
verses.translation: O Assyrian, the rod of mine anger, and the staff in their hand is mine indignation.

verses.original: בְּ/ג֤וֹי חָנֵף֙ אֲשַׁלְּחֶ֔/נּוּ וְ/עַל עַ֥ם עֶבְרָתִ֖/י אֲצַוֶּ֑/נּוּ לִ/שְׁלֹ֤ל שָׁלָל֙ וְ/לָ/בֹ֣ז בַּ֔ז ו/ל/שימ/ו וּ/לְ/שׂוּמ֥/וֹ מִרְמָ֖ס כְּ/חֹ֥מֶר חוּצֽוֹת
verses.translit: bgvy chnf 'shlchnv v'l 'm 'brty 'tsvnv lshll shll vlbz bz vlshymv vlshvmv mrms khchmr chvtsvt
verses.translation: I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

verses.original: וְ/הוּא֙ לֹא כֵ֣ן יְדַמֶּ֔ה וּ/לְבָב֖/וֹ לֹא כֵ֣ן יַחְשֹׁ֑ב כִּ֚י לְ/הַשְׁמִ֣יד בִּ/לְבָב֔/וֹ וּ/לְ/הַכְרִ֥ית גּוֹיִ֖ם לֹ֥א מְעָֽט
verses.translit: vhv' l' khn ydmh vlbbv l' khn ychshb khy lhshmyd blbbv vlhkhryt gvym l' m't
verses.translation: Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy and cut off nations not a few.

verses.original: כִּ֖י יֹאמַ֑ר הֲ/לֹ֥א שָׂרַ֛/י יַחְדָּ֖ו מְלָכִֽים
verses.translit: khy y'mr hl' shry ychdv mlkhym
verses.translation: For he saith, Are not my princes altogether kings?

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֥א כְּ/כַרְכְּמִ֖ישׁ כַּלְנ֑וֹ אִם לֹ֤א כְ/אַרְפַּד֙ חֲמָ֔ת אִם לֹ֥א כְ/דַמֶּ֖שֶׂק שֹׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: hl' khkhrkhmysh khlnv 'm l' kh'rpd chmt 'm l' khdmshq shmrvn
verses.translation: Is not Calno as Carchemish? is not Hamath as Arpad? is not Samaria as Damascus?

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֙ מָצְאָ֣ה יָדִ֔/י לְ/מַמְלְכֹ֖ת הָ/אֱלִ֑יל וּ/פְסִ֣ילֵי/הֶ֔ם מִ/ירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וּ/מִ/שֹּׁמְרֽוֹן
verses.translit: kh'shr mts'h ydy lmmlkht h'lyl vpsylyhm myrvshlm vmshmrvn
verses.translation: As my hand hath found the kingdoms of the idols, and whose graven images did excel them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;

verses.original: הֲ/לֹ֗א כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֛יתִי לְ/שֹׁמְר֖וֹן וְ/לֶ/אֱלִילֶ֑י/הָ כֵּ֛ן אֶעֱשֶׂ֥ה לִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וְ/לַ/עֲצַבֶּֽי/הָ
verses.translit: hl' kh'shr 'shyty lshmrvn vl'lylyh khn ''shh lyrvshlm vl'tsbyh
verses.translation: Shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כִּֽי יְבַצַּ֤ע אֲדֹנָ/י֙ אֶת כָּל מַֽעֲשֵׂ֔/הוּ בְּ/הַ֥ר צִיּ֖וֹן וּ/בִ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם אֶפְקֹ֗ד עַל פְּרִי גֹ֨דֶל֙ לְבַ֣ב מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר וְ/עַל תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת ר֥וּם עֵינָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vhyh khy ybts' 'dny 't khl m'shhv bhr tsyvn vbyrvshlm 'pqd 'l pry gdl lbb mlkh 'shvr v'l tp'rt rvm 'ynyv
verses.translation: Wherefore it shall come to pass, that when the Lord hath performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אָמַ֗ר בְּ/כֹ֤חַ יָדִ/י֙ עָשִׂ֔יתִי וּ/בְ/חָכְמָתִ֖/י כִּ֣י נְבֻנ֑וֹתִי וְ/אָסִ֣יר גְּבוּלֹ֣ת עַמִּ֗ים ו/עתידתי/הם וַ/עֲתוּדֽוֹתֵי/הֶם֙ שׁוֹשֵׂ֔תִי וְ/אוֹרִ֥יד כַּ/אבִּ֖יר יוֹשְׁבִֽים
verses.translit: khy 'mr bkhch ydy 'shyty vbchkhmty khy nbnvty v'syr gbvlt 'mym v'tydtyhm v'tvdvtyhm shvshty v'vryd kh'byr yvshbym
verses.translation: For he saith, By the strength of my hand I have done it , and by my wisdom; for I am prudent: and I have removed the bounds of the people, and have robbed their treasures, and I have put down the inhabitants like a valiant man:

verses.original: וַ/תִּמְצָ֨א כַ/קֵּ֤ן יָדִ/י֙ לְ/חֵ֣יל הָֽ/עַמִּ֔ים וְ/כֶ/אֱסֹף֙ בֵּיצִ֣ים עֲזֻב֔וֹת כָּל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אֲנִ֣י אָסָ֑פְתִּי וְ/לֹ֤א הָיָה֙ נֹדֵ֣ד כָּנָ֔ף וּ/פֹצֶ֥ה פֶ֖ה וּ/מְצַפְצֵֽף
verses.translit: vtmts' khqn ydy lchyl h'mym vkh'sf bytsym 'zbvt khl h'rts 'ny 'spty vl' hyh ndd khnf vptsh ph vmtsptsf
verses.translation: And my hand hath found as a nest the riches of the people: and as one gathereth eggs that are left, have I gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or peeped.

verses.original: הֲ/יִתְפָּאֵר֙ הַ/גַּרְזֶ֔ן עַ֖ל הַ/חֹצֵ֣ב בּ֑/וֹ אִם יִתְגַּדֵּ֤ל הַ/מַּשּׂוֹר֙ עַל מְנִיפ֔/וֹ כְּ/הָנִ֥יף שֵׁ֨בֶט֙ וְ/אֶת מְרִימָ֔י/ו כְּ/הָרִ֥ים מַטֶּ֖ה לֹא עֵֽץ
verses.translit: hytp'r hgrzn 'l hchtsb bv 'm ytgdl hmshvr 'l mnypv khhnyf shbt v't mrymyv khhrym mth l' 'ts
verses.translation: Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? or shall the saw magnify itself against him that shaketh it? as if the rod should shake itself against them that lift it up, or as if the staff should lift up itself, as if it were no wood.

verses.original: לָ֠/כֵן יְשַׁלַּ֨ח הָ/אָד֜וֹן יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת בְּ/מִשְׁמַנָּ֖י/ו רָז֑וֹן וְ/תַ֧חַת כְּבֹד֛/וֹ יֵקַ֥ד יְקֹ֖ד כִּ/יק֥וֹד אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: lkhn yshlch h'dvn yhvh tsb'vt bmshmnyv rzvn vtcht khbdv yqd yqd khyqvd 'sh
verses.translation: Therefore shall the Lord, the Lord of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֤ה אֽוֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְ/אֵ֔שׁ וּ/קְדוֹשׁ֖/וֹ לְ/לֶהָבָ֑ה וּ/בָעֲרָ֗ה וְ/אָֽכְלָ֛ה שִׁית֥/וֹ וּ/שְׁמִיר֖/וֹ בְּ/י֥וֹם אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vhyh 'vr yshr'l l'sh vqdvshv llhbh vb'rh v'khlh shytv vshmyrv byvm 'chd
verses.translation: And the light of Israel shall be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day;

verses.original: וּ/כְב֤וֹד יַעְר/וֹ֙ וְ/כַרְמִלּ֔/וֹ מִ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ וְ/עַד בָּשָׂ֖ר יְכַלֶּ֑ה וְ/הָיָ֖ה כִּ/מְסֹ֥ס נֹסֵֽס
verses.translit: vkhbvd y'rv vkhrmlv mnpsh v'd bshr ykhlh vhyh khmss nss
verses.translation: And shall consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and they shall be as when a standardbearer fainteth.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁאָ֥ר עֵ֛ץ יַעְר֖/וֹ מִסְפָּ֣ר יִֽהְי֑וּ וְ/נַ֖עַר יִכְתְּבֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: vsh'r 'ts y'rv mspr yhyv vn'r ykhtbm
verses.translation: And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, that a child may write them.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא לֹֽא יוֹסִ֨יף ע֜וֹד שְׁאָ֤ר יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וּ/פְלֵיטַ֣ת בֵּֽית יַעֲקֹ֔ב לְ/הִשָּׁעֵ֖ן עַל מַכֵּ֑/הוּ וְ/נִשְׁעַ֗ן עַל יְהוָ֛ה קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֶּ/אֱמֶֽת
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' l' yvsyf 'vd sh'r yshr'l vplytt byt y'qb lhsh'n 'l mkhhv vnsh'n 'l yhvh qdvsh yshr'l b'mt
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the remnant of Israel, and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; but shall stay upon the LORD , the Holy One of Israel, in truth.

verses.original: שְׁאָ֥ר יָשׁ֖וּב שְׁאָ֣ר יַעֲקֹ֑ב אֶל אֵ֖ל גִּבּֽוֹר
verses.translit: sh'r yshvb sh'r y'qb 'l 'l gbvr
verses.translation: The remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם יִהְיֶ֞ה עַמְּ/ךָ֤ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כְּ/ח֣וֹל הַ/יָּ֔ם שְׁאָ֖ר יָשׁ֣וּב בּ֑/וֹ כִּלָּי֥וֹן חָר֖וּץ שׁוֹטֵ֥ף צְדָקָֽה
verses.translit: khy 'm yhyh 'mkh yshr'l khchvl hym sh'r yshvb bv khlyvn chrvts shvtf tsdqh
verses.translation: For though thy people Israel be as the sand of the sea, yet a remnant of them shall return: the consumption decreed shall overflow with righteousness.

verses.original: כִּ֥י כָלָ֖ה וְ/נֶחֱרָצָ֑ה אֲדֹנָ֤/י יְהוִה֙ צְבָא֔וֹת עֹשֶׂ֖ה בְּ/קֶ֥רֶב כָּל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: khy khlh vnchrtsh 'dny yhvh tsb'vt 'shh bqrb khl h'rts
verses.translation: For the Lord GOD of hosts shall make a consumption, even determined, in the midst of all the land.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֤/י יְהוִה֙ צְבָא֔וֹת אַל תִּירָ֥א עַמִּ֛/י יֹשֵׁ֥ב צִיּ֖וֹן מֵֽ/אַשּׁ֑וּר בַּ/שֵּׁ֣בֶט יַכֶּ֔/כָּה וּ/מַטֵּ֥/הוּ יִשָּֽׂא עָלֶ֖י/ךָ בְּ/דֶ֥רֶךְ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh tsb'vt 'l tyr' 'my yshb tsyvn m'shvr bshbt ykhkhh vmthv ysh' 'lykh bdrkh mtsrym
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite thee with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt.

verses.original: כִּי ע֖וֹד מְעַ֣ט מִזְעָ֑ר וְ/כָ֣לָה זַ֔עַם וְ/אַפִּ֖/י עַל תַּבְלִיתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy 'vd m't mz'r vkhlh z'm v'py 'l tblytm
verses.translation: For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and mine anger in their destruction.

verses.original: וְ/עוֹרֵ֨ר עָלָ֜י/ו יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ שׁ֔וֹט כְּ/מַכַּ֥ת מִדְיָ֖ן בְּ/צ֣וּר עוֹרֵ֑ב וּ/מַטֵּ֨/הוּ֙ עַל הַ/יָּ֔ם וּ/נְשָׂא֖/וֹ בְּ/דֶ֥רֶךְ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'vrr 'lyv yhvh tsb'vt shvt khmkht mdyn btsvr 'vrb vmthv 'l hym vnsh'v bdrkh mtsrym
verses.translation: And the LORD of hosts shall stir up a scourge for him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb: and as his rod was upon the sea, so shall he lift it up after the manner of Egypt.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא יָס֤וּר סֻבֳּל/וֹ֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל שִׁכְמֶ֔/ךָ וְ/עֻלּ֖/וֹ מֵ/עַ֣ל צַוָּארֶ֑/ךָ וְ/חֻבַּ֥ל עֹ֖ל מִ/פְּנֵי שָֽׁמֶן
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' ysvr sblv m'l shkhmkh v'lv m'l tsv'rkh vchbl 'l mpny shmn
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.

verses.original: בָּ֥א עַל עַיַּ֖ת עָבַ֣ר בְּ/מִגְר֑וֹן לְ/מִכְמָ֖שׂ יַפְקִ֥יד כֵּלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: b' 'l 'yt 'br bmgrvn lmkhmsh ypqyd khlyv
verses.translation: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he hath laid up his carriages:

verses.original: עָֽבְרוּ֙ מַעְבָּרָ֔ה גֶּ֖בַע מָל֣וֹן לָ֑/נוּ חָֽרְדָה֙ הָֽ/רָמָ֔ה גִּבְעַ֥ת שָׁא֖וּל נָֽסָה
verses.translit: 'brv m'brh gb' mlvn lnv chrdh hrmh gb't sh'vl nsh
verses.translation: They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.

verses.original: צַהֲלִ֥י קוֹלֵ֖/ךְ בַּת גַּלִּ֑ים הַקְשִׁ֥יבִי לַ֖יְשָׁה עֲנִיָּ֥ה עֲנָתֽוֹת
verses.translit: tshly qvlkh bt glym hqshyby lyshh 'nyh 'ntvt
verses.translation: Lift up thy voice, O daughter of Gallim: cause it to be heard unto Laish, O poor Anathoth.

verses.original: נָדְדָ֖ה מַדְמֵנָ֑ה יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הַ/גֵּבִ֖ים הֵעִֽיזוּ
verses.translit: nddh mdmnh yshby hgbym h'yzv
verses.translation: Madmenah is removed; the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.

verses.original: ע֥וֹד הַ/יּ֖וֹם בְּ/נֹ֣ב לַֽ/עֲמֹ֑ד יְנֹפֵ֤ף יָד/וֹ֙ הַ֣ר בית בַּת צִיּ֔וֹן גִּבְעַ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: 'vd hyvm bnb l'md ynpf ydv hr byt bt tsyvn gb't yrvshlm
verses.translation: As yet shall he remain at Nob that day: he shall shake his hand against the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה הָ/אָדוֹן֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת מְסָעֵ֥ף פֻּארָ֖ה בְּ/מַעֲרָצָ֑ה וְ/רָמֵ֤י הַ/קּוֹמָה֙ גְּדוּעִ֔ים וְ/הַ/גְּבֹהִ֖ים יִשְׁפָּֽלוּ
verses.translit: hnh h'dvn yhvh tsb'vt ms'f p'rh bm'rtsh vrmy hqvmh gdv'ym vhgbhym yshplv
verses.translation: Behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, shall lop the bough with terror: and the high ones of stature shall be hewn down, and the haughty shall be humbled.

verses.original: וְ/נִקַּ֛ף סִֽבְכֵ֥י הַ/יַּ֖עַר בַּ/בַּרְזֶ֑ל וְ/הַ/לְּבָנ֖וֹן בְּ/אַדִּ֥יר יִפּֽוֹל
verses.translit: vnqf sbkhy hy'r bbrzl vhlbnvn b'dyr ypvl
verses.translation: And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.

verses.original: וְ/יָצָ֥א חֹ֖טֶר מִ/גֵּ֣זַע יִשָׁ֑י וְ/נֵ֖צֶר מִ/שָּׁרָשָׁ֥י/ו יִפְרֶֽה
verses.translit: vyts' chtr mgz' yshy vntsr mshrshyv yprh
verses.translation: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:

verses.original: וְ/נָחָ֥ה עָלָ֖י/ו ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֑ה ר֧וּחַ חָכְמָ֣ה וּ/בִינָ֗ה ר֤וּחַ עֵצָה֙ וּ/גְבוּרָ֔ה ר֥וּחַ דַּ֖עַת וְ/יִרְאַ֥ת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vnchh 'lyv rvch yhvh rvch chkhmh vbynh rvch 'tsh vgbvrh rvch d't vyr't yhvh
verses.translation: And the spirit of the LORD shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD ;

verses.original: וַ/הֲרִיח֖/וֹ בְּ/יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְ/לֹֽא לְ/מַרְאֵ֤ה עֵינָי/ו֙ יִשְׁפּ֔וֹט וְ/לֹֽא לְ/מִשְׁמַ֥ע אָזְנָ֖י/ו יוֹכִֽיחַ
verses.translit: vhrychv byr't yhvh vl' lmr'h 'ynyv yshpvt vl' lmshm' 'znyv yvkhych
verses.translation: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the LORD : and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears:

verses.original: וְ/שָׁפַ֤ט בְּ/צֶ֨דֶק֙ דַּלִּ֔ים וְ/הוֹכִ֥יחַ בְּ/מִישׁ֖וֹר לְ/עַנְוֵי אָ֑רֶץ וְ/הִֽכָּה אֶ֨רֶץ֙ בְּ/שֵׁ֣בֶט פִּ֔י/ו וּ/בְ/ר֥וּחַ שְׂפָתָ֖י/ו יָמִ֥ית רָשָֽׁע
verses.translit: vshpt btsdq dlym vhvkhych bmyshvr l'nvy 'rts vhkhh 'rts bshbt pyv vbrvch shptyv ymyt rsh'
verses.translation: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.

verses.original: וְ/הָ֥יָה צֶ֖דֶק אֵז֣וֹר מָתְנָ֑י/ו וְ/הָ/אֱמוּנָ֖ה אֵז֥וֹר חֲלָצָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vhyh tsdq 'zvr mtnyv vh'mvnh 'zvr chltsyv
verses.translation: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and faithfulness the girdle of his reins.

verses.original: וְ/גָ֤ר זְאֵב֙ עִם כֶּ֔בֶשׂ וְ/נָמֵ֖ר עִם גְּדִ֣י יִרְבָּ֑ץ וְ/עֵ֨גֶל וּ/כְפִ֤יר וּ/מְרִיא֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו וְ/נַ֥עַר קָטֹ֖ן נֹהֵ֥ג בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vgr z'b 'm khbsh vnmr 'm gdy yrbts v'gl vkhpyr vmry' ychdv vn'r qtn nhg bm
verses.translation: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.

verses.original: וּ/פָרָ֤ה וָ/דֹב֙ תִּרְעֶ֔ינָה יַחְדָּ֖ו יִרְבְּצ֣וּ יַלְדֵי/הֶ֑ן וְ/אַרְיֵ֖ה כַּ/בָּקָ֥ר יֹֽאכַל תֶּֽבֶן
verses.translit: vprh vdb tr'ynh ychdv yrbtsv yldyhn v'ryh khbqr y'khl tbn
verses.translation: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.

verses.original: וְ/שִֽׁעֲשַׁ֥ע יוֹנֵ֖ק עַל חֻ֣ר פָּ֑תֶן וְ/עַל֙ מְאוּרַ֣ת צִפְעוֹנִ֔י גָּמ֖וּל יָד֥/וֹ הָדָֽה
verses.translit: vsh'sh' yvnq 'l chr ptn v'l m'vrt tsp'vny gmvl ydv hdh
verses.translation: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice’ den.

verses.original: לֹֽא יָרֵ֥עוּ וְ/לֹֽא יַשְׁחִ֖יתוּ בְּ/כָל הַ֣ר קָדְשִׁ֑/י כִּֽי מָלְאָ֣ה הָ/אָ֗רֶץ דֵּעָה֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה כַּ/מַּ֖יִם לַ/יָּ֥ם מְכַסִּֽים
verses.translit: l' yr'v vl' yshchytv bkhl hr qdshy khy ml'h h'rts d'h 't yhvh khmym lym mkhsym
verses.translation: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the LORD , as the waters cover the sea.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא שֹׁ֣רֶשׁ יִשַׁ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֹמֵד֙ לְ/נֵ֣ס עַמִּ֔ים אֵלָ֖י/ו גּוֹיִ֣ם יִדְרֹ֑שׁוּ וְ/הָיְתָ֥ה מְנֻחָת֖/וֹ כָּבֽוֹד
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' shrsh yshy 'shr 'md lns 'mym 'lyv gvym ydrshv vhyth mnchtv khbvd
verses.translation: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא יוֹסִ֨יף אֲדֹנָ֤/י שֵׁנִית֙ יָד֔/וֹ לִ/קְנ֖וֹת אֶת שְׁאָ֣ר עַמּ֑/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשָּׁאֵר֩ מֵ/אַשּׁ֨וּר וּ/מִ/מִּצְרַ֜יִם וּ/מִ/פַּתְר֣וֹס וּ/מִ/כּ֗וּשׁ וּ/מֵ/עֵילָ֤ם וּ/מִ/שִּׁנְעָר֙ וּ/מֵ֣/חֲמָ֔ת וּ/מֵ/אִיֵּ֖י הַ/יָּֽם
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' yvsyf 'dny shnyt ydv lqnvt 't sh'r 'mv 'shr ysh'r m'shvr vmmtsrym vmptrvs vmkhvsh vm'ylm vmshn'r vmchmt vm'yy hym
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

verses.original: וְ/נָשָׂ֥א נֵס֙ לַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/אָסַ֖ף נִדְחֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ/נְפֻצ֤וֹת יְהוּדָה֙ יְקַבֵּ֔ץ מֵ/אַרְבַּ֖ע כַּנְפ֥וֹת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vnsh' ns lgvym v'sf ndchy yshr'l vnptsvt yhvdh yqbts m'rb' khnpvt h'rts
verses.translation: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

verses.original: וְ/סָ֨רָה֙ קִנְאַ֣ת אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְ/צֹרְרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה יִכָּרֵ֑תוּ אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ לֹֽא יְקַנֵּ֣א אֶת יְהוּדָ֔ה וִֽ/יהוּדָ֖ה לֹֽא יָצֹ֥ר אֶת אֶפְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vsrh qn't 'prym vtsrry yhvdh ykhrtv 'prym l' yqn' 't yhvdh vyhvdh l' ytsr 't 'prym
verses.translation: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim.

verses.original: וְ/עָפ֨וּ בְ/כָתֵ֤ף פְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ יָ֔מָּ/ה יַחְדָּ֖ו יָבֹ֣זּוּ אֶת בְּנֵי קֶ֑דֶם אֱד֤וֹם וּ/מוֹאָב֙ מִשְׁל֣וֹח יָדָ֔/ם וּ/בְנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן מִשְׁמַעְתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'pv bkhtf plshtym ymh ychdv ybzv 't bny qdm 'dvm vmv'b mshlvch ydm vbny 'mvn mshm'tm
verses.translation: But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.

verses.original: וְ/הֶחֱרִ֣ים יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֚ת לְשׁ֣וֹן יָם מִצְרַ֔יִם וְ/הֵנִ֥יף יָד֛/וֹ עַל הַ/נָּהָ֖ר בַּ/עְיָ֣ם רוּח֑/וֹ וְ/הִכָּ֨/הוּ֙ לְ/שִׁבְעָ֣ה נְחָלִ֔ים וְ/הִדְרִ֖יךְ בַּ/נְּעָלִֽים
verses.translit: vhchrym yhvh 't lshvn ym mtsrym vhnyf ydv 'l hnhr b'ym rvchv vhkhhv lshb'h nchlym vhdrykh bn'lym
verses.translation: And the LORD shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind shall he shake his hand over the river, and shall smite it in the seven streams, and make men go over dryshod.

verses.original: וְ/הָיְתָ֣ה מְסִלָּ֔ה לִ/שְׁאָ֣ר עַמּ֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשָּׁאֵ֖ר מֵֽ/אַשּׁ֑וּר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָֽיְתָה֙ לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּ/י֥וֹם עֲלֹת֖/וֹ מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vhyth mslh lsh'r 'mv 'shr ysh'r m'shvr kh'shr hyth lyshr'l byvm 'ltv m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וְ/אָֽמַרְתָּ֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא אוֹדְ/ךָ֣ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י אָנַ֖פְתָּ בִּ֑/י יָשֹׁ֥ב אַפְּ/ךָ֖ וּֽ/תְנַחֲמֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: v'mrt byvm hhv' 'vdkh yhvh khy 'npt by yshb 'pkh vtnchmny
verses.translation: And in that day thou shalt say, O LORD , I will praise thee: though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away, and thou comfortedst me.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה אֵ֧ל יְשׁוּעָתִ֛/י אֶבְטַ֖ח וְ/לֹ֣א אֶפְחָ֑ד כִּֽי עָזִּ֤/י וְ/זִמְרָת֙ יָ֣הּ יְהוָ֔ה וַֽ/יְהִי לִ֖/י לִֽ/ישׁוּעָֽה
verses.translit: hnh 'l yshv'ty 'btch vl' 'pchd khy 'zy vzmrt yh yhvh vyhy ly lyshv'h
verses.translation: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁאַבְתֶּם מַ֖יִם בְּ/שָׂשׂ֑וֹן מִ/מַּעַיְנֵ֖י הַ/יְשׁוּעָֽה
verses.translit: vsh'btm mym bshshvn mm'yny hyshv'h
verses.translation: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.

verses.original: וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֞ם בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא הוֹד֤וּ לַֽ/יהוָה֙ קִרְא֣וּ בִ/שְׁמ֔/וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָֽ/עַמִּ֖ים עֲלִֽילֹתָ֑י/ו הַזְכִּ֕ירוּ כִּ֥י נִשְׂגָּ֖ב שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'mrtm byvm hhv' hvdv lyhvh qr'v bshmv hvdy'v b'mym 'lyltyv hzkhyrv khy nshgb shmv
verses.translation: And in that day shall ye say, Praise the LORD , call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.

verses.original: זַמְּר֣וּ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י גֵא֖וּת עָשָׂ֑ה מידעת מוּדַ֥עַת זֹ֖את בְּ/כָל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: zmrv yhvh khy g'vt 'shh myd't mvd't z't bkhl h'rts
verses.translation: Sing unto the LORD ; for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.

verses.original: צַהֲלִ֥י וָ/רֹ֖נִּי יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת צִיּ֑וֹן כִּֽי גָד֥וֹל בְּ/קִרְבֵּ֖/ךְ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: tshly vrny yvshbt tsyvn khy gdvl bqrbkh qdvsh yshr'l
verses.translation: Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א בָּבֶ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָזָ֔ה יְשַׁעְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן אָמֽוֹץ
verses.translit: msh' bbl 'shr chzh ysh'yhv bn 'mvts
verses.translation: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.

verses.original: עַ֤ל הַר נִשְׁפֶּה֙ שְֽׂאוּ נֵ֔ס הָרִ֥ימוּ ק֖וֹל לָ/הֶ֑ם הָנִ֣יפוּ יָ֔ד וְ/יָבֹ֖אוּ פִּתְחֵ֥י נְדִיבִֽים
verses.translit: 'l hr nshph sh'v ns hrymv qvl lhm hnypv yd vyb'v ptchy ndybym
verses.translation: Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י צִוֵּ֖יתִי לִ/מְקֻדָּשָׁ֑/י גַּ֣ם קָרָ֤אתִי גִבּוֹרַ/י֙ לְ/אַפִּ֔/י עַלִּיזֵ֖י גַּאֲוָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'ny tsvyty lmqdshy gm qr'ty gbvry l'py 'lyzy g'vty
verses.translation: I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger, even them that rejoice in my highness.

verses.original: ק֥וֹל הָמ֛וֹן בֶּֽ/הָרִ֖ים דְּמ֣וּת עַם רָ֑ב ק֠וֹל שְׁא֞וֹן מַמְלְכ֤וֹת גּוֹיִם֙ נֶֽאֱסָפִ֔ים יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת מְפַקֵּ֖ד צְבָ֥א מִלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: qvl hmvn bhrym dmvt 'm rb qvl sh'vn mmlkhvt gvym n'spym yhvh tsb'vt mpqd tsb' mlchmh
verses.translation: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the LORD of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.

verses.original: בָּאִ֛ים מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מֶרְחָ֖ק מִ/קְצֵ֣ה הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם יְהוָה֙ וּ/כְלֵ֣י זַעְמ֔/וֹ לְ/חַבֵּ֖ל כָּל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: b'ym m'rts mrchq mqtsh hshmym yhvh vkhly z'mv lchbl khl h'rts
verses.translation: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, even the LORD , and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.

verses.original: הֵילִ֕ילוּ כִּ֥י קָר֖וֹב י֣וֹם יְהוָ֑ה כְּ/שֹׁ֖ד מִ/שַּׁדַּ֥י יָבֽוֹא
verses.translit: hylylv khy qrvb yvm yhvh khshd mshdy ybv'
verses.translation: Howl ye; for the day of the LORD is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֖ן כָּל יָדַ֣יִם תִּרְפֶּ֑ינָה וְ/כָל לְבַ֥ב אֱנ֖וֹשׁ יִמָּס
verses.translit: 'l khn khl ydym trpynh vkhl lbb 'nvsh yms
verses.translation: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man’s heart shall melt:

verses.original: וְֽ/נִבְהָ֓לוּ צִירִ֤ים וַֽ/חֲבָלִים֙ יֹֽאחֵז֔וּ/ן כַּ/יּוֹלֵדָ֖ה יְחִיל֑וּ/ן אִ֤ישׁ אֶל רֵעֵ֨/הוּ֙ יִתְמָ֔הוּ פְּנֵ֥י לְהָבִ֖ים פְּנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vnbhlv tsyrym vchblym y'chzvn khyvldh ychylvn 'ysh 'l r'hv ytmhv pny lhbym pnyhm
verses.translation: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces shall be as flames.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה יוֹם יְהוָה֙ בָּ֔א אַכְזָרִ֥י וְ/עֶבְרָ֖ה וַ/חֲר֣וֹן אָ֑ף לָ/שׂ֤וּם הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ לְ/שַׁמָּ֔ה וְ/חַטָּאֶ֖י/הָ יַשְׁמִ֥יד מִמֶּֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: hnh yvm yhvh b' 'khzry v'brh vchrvn 'f lshvm h'rts lshmh vcht'yh yshmyd mmnh
verses.translation: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.

verses.original: כִּֽי כוֹכְבֵ֤י הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ וּ/כְסִ֣ילֵי/הֶ֔ם לֹ֥א יָהֵ֖לּוּ אוֹרָ֑/ם חָשַׁ֤ךְ הַ/שֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ בְּ/צֵאת֔/וֹ וְ/יָרֵ֖חַ לֹֽא יַגִּ֥יהַ אוֹרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy khvkhby hshmym vkhsylyhm l' yhlv 'vrm chshkh hshmsh bts'tv vyrch l' ygyh 'vrv
verses.translation: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.

verses.original: וּ/פָקַדְתִּ֤י עַל תֵּבֵל֙ רָעָ֔ה וְ/עַל רְשָׁעִ֖ים עֲוֺנָ֑/ם וְ/הִשְׁבַּתִּי֙ גְּא֣וֹן זֵדִ֔ים וְ/גַאֲוַ֥ת עָרִיצִ֖ים אַשְׁפִּֽיל
verses.translit: vpqdty 'l tbl r'h v'l rsh'ym 'vnm vhshbty g'vn zdym vg'vt 'rytsym 'shpyl
verses.translation: And I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.

verses.original: אוֹקִ֥יר אֱנ֖וֹשׁ מִ/פָּ֑ז וְ/אָדָ֖ם מִ/כֶּ֥תֶם אוֹפִֽיר
verses.translit: 'vqyr 'nvsh mpz v'dm mkhtm 'vpyr
verses.translation: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.

verses.original: עַל כֵּן֙ שָׁמַ֣יִם אַרְגִּ֔יז וְ/תִרְעַ֥שׁ הָ/אָ֖רֶץ מִ/מְּקוֹמָ֑/הּ בְּ/עֶבְרַת֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּ/בְ/י֖וֹם חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'l khn shmym 'rgyz vtr'sh h'rts mmqvmh b'brt yhvh tsb'vt vbyvm chrvn 'pv
verses.translation: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the LORD of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ כִּ/צְבִ֣י מֻדָּ֔ח וּ/כְ/צֹ֖אן וְ/אֵ֣ין מְקַבֵּ֑ץ אִ֤ישׁ אֶל עַמּ/וֹ֙ יִפְנ֔וּ וְ/אִ֥ישׁ אֶל אַרְצ֖/וֹ יָנֽוּסוּ
verses.translit: vhyh khtsby mdch vkhts'n v'yn mqbts 'ysh 'l 'mv ypnv v'ysh 'l 'rtsv ynvsv
verses.translation: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man taketh up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.

verses.original: כָּל הַ/נִּמְצָ֖א יִדָּקֵ֑ר וְ/כָל הַ/נִּסְפֶּ֖ה יִפּ֥וֹל בֶּ/חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: khl hnmts' ydqr vkhl hnsph ypvl bchrb
verses.translation: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.

verses.original: וְ/עֹלְלֵי/הֶ֥ם יְרֻטְּשׁ֖וּ לְ/עֵֽינֵי/הֶ֑ם יִשַּׁ֨סּוּ֙ בָּֽתֵּי/הֶ֔ם וּ/נְשֵׁי/הֶ֖ם תשגלנה תִּשָּׁכַֽבְנָה
verses.translit: v'llyhm yrtshv l'ynyhm yshsv btyhm vnshyhm tshglnh tshkhbnh
verses.translation: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֛י מֵעִ֥יר עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם אֶת מָדָ֑י אֲשֶׁר כֶּ֨סֶף֙ לֹ֣א יַחְשֹׁ֔בוּ וְ/זָהָ֖ב לֹ֥א יַחְפְּצוּ בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hnny m'yr 'lyhm 't mdy 'shr khsf l' ychshbv vzhb l' ychptsv bv
verses.translation: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.

verses.original: וּ/קְשָׁת֖וֹת נְעָרִ֣ים תְּרַטַּ֑שְׁנָה וּ/פְרִי בֶ֨טֶן֙ לֹ֣א יְרַחֵ֔מוּ עַל בָּנִ֖ים לֹֽא תָח֥וּס עֵינָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vqshtvt n'rym trtshnh vpry btn l' yrchmv 'l bnym l' tchvs 'ynm
verses.translation: Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.

verses.original: וְ/הָיְתָ֤ה בָבֶל֙ צְבִ֣י מַמְלָכ֔וֹת תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת גְּא֣וֹן כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים כְּ/מַהְפֵּכַ֣ת אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת סְדֹ֖ם וְ/אֶת עֲמֹרָֽה
verses.translit: vhyth bbl tsby mmlkhvt tp'rt g'vn khshdym khmhpkht 'lhym 't sdm v't 'mrh
verses.translation: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

verses.original: לֹֽא תֵשֵׁ֣ב לָ/נֶ֔צַח וְ/לֹ֥א תִשְׁכֹּ֖ן עַד דּ֣וֹר וָ/ד֑וֹר וְ/לֹֽא יַהֵ֥ל שָׁם֙ עֲרָבִ֔י וְ/רֹעִ֖ים לֹא יַרְבִּ֥צוּ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: l' tshb lntsch vl' tshkhn 'd dvr vdvr vl' yhl shm 'rby vr'ym l' yrbtsv shm
verses.translation: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.

verses.original: וְ/רָבְצוּ שָׁ֣ם צִיִּ֔ים וּ/מָלְא֥וּ בָתֵּי/הֶ֖ם אֹחִ֑ים וְ/שָׁ֤כְנוּ שָׁם֙ בְּנ֣וֹת יַֽעֲנָ֔ה וּ/שְׂעִירִ֖ים יְרַקְּדוּ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vrbtsv shm tsyym vml'v btyhm 'chym vshkhnv shm bnvt y'nh vsh'yrym yrqdv shm
verses.translation: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.

verses.original: וְ/עָנָ֤ה אִיִּים֙ בְּ/אַלְמנוֹתָ֔י/ו וְ/תַנִּ֖ים בְּ/הֵ֣יכְלֵי עֹ֑נֶג וְ/קָר֤וֹב לָ/בוֹא֙ עִתָּ֔/הּ וְ/יָמֶ֖י/הָ לֹ֥א יִמָּשֵֽׁכוּ
verses.translit: v'nh 'yym b'lmnvtyv vtnym bhykhly 'ng vqrvb lbv' 'th vymyh l' ymshkhv
verses.translation: And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in their pleasant palaces: and her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.

verses.original: כִּי֩ יְרַחֵ֨ם יְהוָ֜ה אֶֽת יַעֲקֹ֗ב וּ/בָחַ֥ר עוֹד֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/הִנִּיחָ֖/ם עַל אַדְמָתָ֑/ם וְ/נִלְוָ֤ה הַ/גֵּר֙ עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/נִסְפְּח֖וּ עַל בֵּ֥ית יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: khy yrchm yhvh 't y'qb vbchr 'vd byshr'l vhnychm 'l 'dmtm vnlvh hgr 'lyhm vnspchv 'l byt y'qb
verses.translation: For the LORD will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.

verses.original: וּ/לְקָח֣וּ/ם עַמִּים֮ וֶ/הֱבִיא֣וּ/ם אֶל מְקוֹמָ/ם֒ וְ/הִֽתְנַחֲל֣וּ/ם בֵּֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עַ֚ל אַדְמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לַ/עֲבָדִ֖ים וְ/לִ/שְׁפָח֑וֹת וְ/הָיוּ֙ שֹׁבִ֣ים לְ/שֹֽׁבֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/רָד֖וּ בְּ/נֹגְשֵׂי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vlqchvm 'mym vhby'vm 'l mqvmm vhtnchlvm byt yshr'l 'l 'dmt yhvh l'bdym vlshpchvt vhyv shbym lshbyhm vrdv bngshyhm
verses.translation: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the LORD for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה בְּ/י֨וֹם הָנִ֤יחַ יְהוָה֙ לְ/ךָ֔ מֵֽ/עָצְבְּ/ךָ֖ וּ/מֵ/רָגְזֶ֑/ךָ וּ/מִן הָ/עֲבֹדָ֥ה הַ/קָּשָׁ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֻבַּד בָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hnych yhvh lkh m'tsbkh vmrgzkh vmn h'bdh hqshh 'shr 'bd bkh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in the day that the LORD shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,

verses.original: וְ/נָשָׂ֜אתָ הַ/מָּשָׁ֥ל הַ/זֶּ֛ה עַל מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וְ/אָמָ֑רְתָּ אֵ֚יךְ שָׁבַ֣ת נֹגֵ֔שׂ שָׁבְתָ֖ה מַדְהֵבָֽה
verses.translit: vnsh't hmshl hzh 'l mlkh bbl v'mrt 'ykh shbt ngsh shbth mdhbh
verses.translation: That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!

verses.original: שָׁבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה מַטֵּ֣ה רְשָׁעִ֑ים שֵׁ֖בֶט מֹשְׁלִֽים
verses.translit: shbr yhvh mth rsh'ym shbt mshlym
verses.translation: The LORD hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.

verses.original: מַכֶּ֤ה עַמִּים֙ בְּ/עֶבְרָ֔ה מַכַּ֖ת בִּלְתִּ֣י סָרָ֑ה רֹדֶ֤ה בָ/אַף֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם מֻרְדָּ֖ף בְּלִ֥י חָשָֽׂךְ
verses.translit: mkhh 'mym b'brh mkht blty srh rdh b'f gvym mrdf bly chshkh
verses.translation: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth.

verses.original: נָ֥חָה שָׁקְטָ֖ה כָּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ פָּצְח֖וּ רִנָּֽה
verses.translit: nchh shqth khl h'rts ptschv rnh
verses.translation: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.

verses.original: גַּם בְּרוֹשִׁ֛ים שָׂמְח֥וּ לְ/ךָ֖ אַרְזֵ֣י לְבָנ֑וֹן מֵ/אָ֣ז שָׁכַ֔בְתָּ לֹֽא יַעֲלֶ֥ה הַ/כֹּרֵ֖ת עָלֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: gm brvshym shmchv lkh 'rzy lbnvn m'z shkhbt l' y'lh hkhrt 'lynv
verses.translation: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying , Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.

verses.original: שְׁא֗וֹל מִ/תַּ֛חַת רָגְזָ֥ה לְ/ךָ֖ לִ/קְרַ֣את בּוֹאֶ֑/ךָ עוֹרֵ֨ר לְ/ךָ֤ רְפָאִים֙ כָּל עַתּ֣וּדֵי אָ֔רֶץ הֵקִים֙ מִ/כִּסְאוֹתָ֔/ם כֹּ֖ל מַלְכֵ֥י גוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: sh'vl mtcht rgzh lkh lqr't bv'kh 'vrr lkh rp'ym khl 'tvdy 'rts hqym mkhs'vtm khl mlkhy gvym
verses.translation: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֣/ם יַֽעֲנ֔וּ וְ/יֹאמְר֖וּ אֵלֶ֑י/ךָ גַּם אַתָּ֛ה חֻלֵּ֥יתָ כָמ֖וֹ/נוּ אֵלֵ֥י/נוּ נִמְשָֽׁלְתָּ
verses.translit: khlm y'nv vy'mrv 'lykh gm 'th chlyt khmvnv 'lynv nmshlt
verses.translation: All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?

verses.original: הוּרַ֥ד שְׁא֛וֹל גְּאוֹנֶ֖/ךָ הֶמְיַ֣ת נְבָלֶ֑י/ךָ תַּחְתֶּ֨י/ךָ֙ יֻצַּ֣ע רִמָּ֔ה וּ/מְכַסֶּ֖י/ךָ תּוֹלֵעָֽה
verses.translit: hvrd sh'vl g'vnkh hmyt nblykh tchtykh yts' rmh vmkhsykh tvl'h
verses.translation: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, and the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.

verses.original: אֵ֛יךְ נָפַ֥לְתָּ מִ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם הֵילֵ֣ל בֶּן שָׁ֑חַר נִגְדַּ֣עְתָּ לָ/אָ֔רֶץ חוֹלֵ֖שׁ עַל גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: 'ykh nplt mshmym hyll bn shchr ngd't l'rts chvlsh 'l gvym
verses.translation: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֞ה אָמַ֤רְתָּ בִֽ/לְבָבְ/ךָ֙ הַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם אֶֽעֱלֶ֔ה מִ/מַּ֥עַל לְ/כֽוֹכְבֵי אֵ֖ל אָרִ֣ים כִּסְאִ֑/י וְ/אֵשֵׁ֥ב בְּ/הַר מוֹעֵ֖ד בְּ/יַרְכְּתֵ֥י צָפֽוֹן
verses.translit: v'th 'mrt blbbkh hshmym ''lh mm'l lkhvkhby 'l 'rym khs'y v'shb bhr mv'd byrkhty tspvn
verses.translation: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:

verses.original: אֶעֱלֶ֖ה עַל בָּ֣מֳתֵי עָ֑ב אֶדַּמֶּ֖ה לְ/עֶלְיֽוֹן
verses.translit: ''lh 'l bmty 'b 'dmh l'lyvn
verses.translation: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.

verses.original: אַ֧ךְ אֶל שְׁא֛וֹל תּוּרָ֖ד אֶל יַרְכְּתֵי בֽוֹר
verses.translit: 'kh 'l sh'vl tvrd 'l yrkhty bvr
verses.translation: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.

verses.original: רֹאֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֵלֶ֣י/ךָ יַשְׁגִּ֔יחוּ אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ יִתְבּוֹנָ֑נוּ הֲ/זֶ֤ה הָ/אִישׁ֙ מַרְגִּ֣יז הָ/אָ֔רֶץ מַרְעִ֖ישׁ מַמְלָכֽוֹת
verses.translit: r'ykh 'lykh yshgychv 'lykh ytbvnnv hzh h'ysh mrgyz h'rts mr'ysh mmlkhvt
verses.translation: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;

verses.original: שָׂ֥ם תֵּבֵ֛ל כַּ/מִּדְבָּ֖ר וְ/עָרָ֣י/ו הָרָ֑ס אֲסִירָ֖י/ו לֹא פָ֥תַח בָּֽיְתָ/ה
verses.translit: shm tbl khmdbr v'ryv hrs 'syryv l' ptch byth
verses.translation: That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners?

verses.original: כָּל מַלְכֵ֥י גוֹיִ֖ם כֻּלָּ֑/ם שָׁכְב֥וּ בְ/כָב֖וֹד אִ֥ישׁ בְּ/בֵיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khl mlkhy gvym khlm shkhbv bkhbvd 'ysh bbytv
verses.translation: All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֞ה הָשְׁלַ֤כְתָּ מִֽ/קִּבְרְ/ךָ֙ כְּ/נֵ֣צֶר נִתְעָ֔ב לְב֥וּשׁ הֲרֻגִ֖ים מְטֹ֣עֲנֵי חָ֑רֶב יוֹרְדֵ֥י אֶל אַבְנֵי ב֖וֹר כְּ/פֶ֥גֶר מוּבָֽס
verses.translit: v'th hshlkht mqbrkh khntsr nt'b lbvsh hrgym mt'ny chrb yvrdy 'l 'bny bvr khpgr mvbs
verses.translation: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.

verses.original: לֹֽא תֵחַ֤ד אִתָּ/ם֙ בִּ/קְבוּרָ֔ה כִּֽי אַרְצְ/ךָ֥ שִׁחַ֖תָּ עַמְּ/ךָ֣ הָרָ֑גְתָּ לֹֽא יִקָּרֵ֥א לְ/עוֹלָ֖ם זֶ֥רַע מְרֵעִֽים
verses.translit: l' tchd 'tm bqbvrh khy 'rtskh shcht 'mkh hrgt l' yqr' l'vlm zr' mr'ym
verses.translation: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, and slain thy people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.

verses.original: הָכִ֧ינוּ לְ/בָנָ֛י/ו מַטְבֵּ֖חַ בַּ/עֲוֺ֣ן אֲבוֹתָ֑/ם בַּל יָקֻ֨מוּ֙ וְ/יָ֣רְשׁוּ אָ֔רֶץ וּ/מָלְא֥וּ פְנֵֽי תֵבֵ֖ל עָרִֽים
verses.translit: hkhynv lbnyv mtbch b'vn 'bvtm bl yqmv vyrshv 'rts vml'v pny tbl 'rym
verses.translation: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.

verses.original: וְ/קַמְתִּ֣י עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֨י לְ/בָבֶ֜ל שֵׁ֥ם וּ/שְׁאָ֛ר וְ/נִ֥ין וָ/נֶ֖כֶד נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vqmty 'lyhm n'm yhvh tsb'vt vhkhrty lbbl shm vsh'r vnyn vnkhd n'm yhvh
verses.translation: For I will rise up against them, saith the LORD of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֛י/הָ לְ/מוֹרַ֥שׁ קִפֹּ֖ד וְ/אַגְמֵי מָ֑יִם וְ/טֵֽאטֵאתִ֨י/הָ֙ בְּ/מַטְאֲטֵ֣א הַשְׁמֵ֔ד נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vshmtyh lmvrsh qpd v'gmy mym vt't'tyh bmt't' hshmd n'm yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּ֛ע יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אִם לֹ֞א כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּמִּ֨יתִי֙ כֵּ֣ן הָיָ֔תָה וְ/כַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָעַ֖צְתִּי הִ֥יא תָקֽוּם
verses.translit: nshb' yhvh tsb'vt l'mr 'm l' kh'shr dmyty khn hyth vkh'shr y'tsty hy' tqvm
verses.translation: The LORD of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:

verses.original: לִ/שְׁבֹּ֤ר אַשּׁוּר֙ בְּ/אַרְצִ֔/י וְ/עַל הָרַ֖/י אֲבוּסֶ֑/נּוּ וְ/סָ֤ר מֵֽ/עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ עֻלּ֔/וֹ וְ/סֻ֨בֳּל֔/וֹ מֵ/עַ֥ל שִׁכְמ֖/וֹ יָסֽוּר
verses.translit: lshbr 'shvr b'rtsy v'l hry 'bvsnv vsr m'lyhm 'lv vsblv m'l shkhmv ysvr
verses.translation: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.

verses.original: זֹ֛את הָ/עֵצָ֥ה הַ/יְּעוּצָ֖ה עַל כָּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/זֹ֛את הַ/יָּ֥ד הַ/נְּטוּיָ֖ה עַל כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: z't h'tsh hy'vtsh 'l khl h'rts vz't hyd hntvyh 'l khl hgvym
verses.translation: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.

verses.original: כִּֽי יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת יָעָ֖ץ וּ/מִ֣י יָפֵ֑ר וְ/יָד֥/וֹ הַ/נְּטוּיָ֖ה וּֽ/מִ֥י יְשִׁיבֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: khy yhvh tsb'vt y'ts vmy ypr vydv hntvyh vmy yshybnh
verses.translation: For the LORD of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it ? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַת מ֖וֹת הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אָחָ֑ז הָיָ֖ה הַ/מַּשָּׂ֥א הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: bshnt mvt hmlkh 'chz hyh hmsh' hzh
verses.translation: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.

verses.original: אַֽל תִּשְׂמְחִ֤י פְלֶ֨שֶׁת֙ כֻּלֵּ֔/ךְ כִּ֥י נִשְׁבַּ֖ר שֵׁ֣בֶט מַכֵּ֑/ךְ כִּֽי מִ/שֹּׁ֤רֶשׁ נָחָשׁ֙ יֵ֣צֵא צֶ֔פַע וּ/פִרְי֖/וֹ שָׂרָ֥ף מְעוֹפֵֽף
verses.translit: 'l tshmchy plsht khlkh khy nshbr shbt mkhkh khy mshrsh nchsh yts' tsp' vpryv shrf m'vpf
verses.translation: Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken: for out of the serpent’s root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.

verses.original: וְ/רָעוּ֙ בְּכוֹרֵ֣י דַלִּ֔ים וְ/אֶבְיוֹנִ֖ים לָ/בֶ֣טַח יִרְבָּ֑צוּ וְ/הֵמַתִּ֤י בָֽ/רָעָב֙ שָׁרְשֵׁ֔/ךְ וּ/שְׁאֵרִיתֵ֖/ךְ יַהֲרֹֽג
verses.translit: vr'v bkhvry dlym v'byvnym lbtch yrbtsv vhmty br'b shrshkh vsh'rytkh yhrg
verses.translation: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.

verses.original: הֵילִ֤ילִֽי שַׁ֨עַר֙ זַֽעֲקִי עִ֔יר נָמ֖וֹג פְּלֶ֣שֶׁת כֻּלֵּ֑/ךְ כִּ֤י מִ/צָּפוֹן֙ עָשָׁ֣ן בָּ֔א וְ/אֵ֥ין בּוֹדֵ֖ד בְּ/מוֹעָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hylyly sh'r z'qy 'yr nmvg plsht khlkh khy mtspvn 'shn b' v'yn bvdd bmv'dyv
verses.translation: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, art dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none shall be alone in his appointed times.

verses.original: וּ/מַֽה יַּעֲנֶ֖ה מַלְאֲכֵי ג֑וֹי כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ יִסַּ֣ד צִיּ֔וֹן וּ/בָ֥/הּ יֶחֱס֖וּ עֲנִיֵּ֥י עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vmh y'nh ml'khy gvy khy yhvh ysd tsyvn vbh ychsv 'nyy 'mv
verses.translation: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א מוֹאָ֑ב כִּ֠י בְּ/לֵ֞יל שֻׁדַּ֨ד עָ֤ר מוֹאָב֙ נִדְמָ֔ה כִּ֗י בְּ/לֵ֛יל שֻׁדַּ֥ד קִיר מוֹאָ֖ב נִדְמָֽה
verses.translit: msh' mv'b khy blyl shdd 'r mv'b ndmh khy blyl shdd qyr mv'b ndmh
verses.translation: The burden of Moab. Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence;

verses.original: עָלָ֨ה הַ/בַּ֧יִת וְ/דִיבֹ֛ן הַ/בָּמ֖וֹת לְ/בֶ֑כִי עַל נְב֞וֹ וְ/עַ֤ל מֵֽידְבָא֙ מוֹאָ֣ב יְיֵלִ֔יל בְּ/כָל רֹאשָׁ֣י/ו קָרְחָ֔ה כָּל זָקָ֖ן גְּרוּעָֽה
verses.translit: 'lh hbyt vdybn hbmvt lbkhy 'l nbv v'l mydb' mv'b yylyl bkhl r'shyv qrchh khl zqn grv'h
verses.translation: He is gone up to Bajith, and to Dibon, the high places, to weep: Moab shall howl over Nebo, and over Medeba: on all their heads shall be baldness, and every beard cut off.

verses.original: בְּ/חוּצֹתָ֖י/ו חָ֣גְרוּ שָׂ֑ק עַ֣ל גַּגּוֹתֶ֧י/הָ וּ/בִ/רְחֹבֹתֶ֛י/הָ כֻּלֹּ֥/ה יְיֵלִ֖יל יֹרֵ֥ד בַּ/בֶּֽכִי
verses.translit: bchvtstyv chgrv shq 'l ggvtyh vbrchbtyh khlh yylyl yrd bbkhy
verses.translation: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, every one shall howl, weeping abundantly.

verses.original: וַ/תִּזְעַ֤ק חֶשְׁבּוֹן֙ וְ/אֶלְעָלֵ֔ה עַד יַ֖הַץ נִשְׁמַ֣ע קוֹלָ֑/ם עַל כֵּ֗ן חֲלֻצֵ֤י מוֹאָב֙ יָרִ֔יעוּ נַפְשׁ֖/וֹ יָ֥רְעָה לּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vtz'q chshbvn v'l'lh 'd yhts nshm' qvlm 'l khn chltsy mv'b yry'v npshv yr'h lv
verses.translation: And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh: their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life shall be grievous unto him.

verses.original: לִבִּ/י֙ לְ/מוֹאָ֣ב יִזְעָ֔ק בְּרִיחֶ֕/הָ עַד צֹ֖עַר עֶגְלַ֣ת שְׁלִשִׁיָּ֑ה כִּ֣י מַעֲלֵ֣ה הַ/לּוּחִ֗ית בִּ/בְכִי֙ יַֽעֲלֶה בּ֔/וֹ כִּ֚י דֶּ֣רֶךְ חוֹרֹנַ֔יִם זַעֲקַת שֶׁ֖בֶר יְעֹעֵֽרוּ
verses.translit: lby lmv'b yz'q brychh 'd ts'r 'glt shlshyh khy m'lh hlvchyt bbkhy y'lh bv khy drkh chvrnym z'qt shbr y''rv
verses.translation: My heart shall cry out for Moab; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar, an heifer of three years old: for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction.

verses.original: כִּֽי מֵ֥י נִמְרִ֖ים מְשַׁמּ֣וֹת יִֽהְי֑וּ כִּֽי יָבֵ֤שׁ חָצִיר֙ כָּ֣לָה דֶ֔שֶׁא יֶ֖רֶק לֹ֥א הָיָֽה
verses.translit: khy my nmrym mshmvt yhyv khy ybsh chtsyr khlh dsh' yrq l' hyh
verses.translation: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass faileth, there is no green thing.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֖ן יִתְרָ֣ה עָשָׂ֑ה וּ/פְקֻדָּתָ֔/ם עַ֛ל נַ֥חַל הָ/עֲרָבִ֖ים יִשָּׂאֽוּ/ם
verses.translit: 'l khn ytrh 'shh vpqdtm 'l nchl h'rbym ysh'vm
verses.translation: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away to the brook of the willows.

verses.original: כִּֽי הִקִּ֥יפָה הַ/זְּעָקָ֖ה אֶת גְּב֣וּל מוֹאָ֑ב עַד אֶגְלַ֨יִם֙ יִלְלָתָ֔/הּ וּ/בְאֵ֥ר אֵילִ֖ים יִלְלָתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khy hqyph hz'qh 't gbvl mv'b 'd 'glym yllth vb'r 'ylym yllth
verses.translation: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beer-elim.

verses.original: כִּ֣י מֵ֤י דִימוֹן֙ מָ֣לְאוּ דָ֔ם כִּֽי אָשִׁ֥ית עַל דִּימ֖וֹן נוֹסָפ֑וֹת לִ/פְלֵיטַ֤ת מוֹאָב֙ אַרְיֵ֔ה וְ/לִ/שְׁאֵרִ֖ית אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: khy my dymvn ml'v dm khy 'shyt 'l dymvn nvspvt lplytt mv'b 'ryh vlsh'ryt 'dmh
verses.translation: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood: for I will bring more upon Dimon, lions upon him that escapeth of Moab, and upon the remnant of the land.

verses.original: שִׁלְחוּ כַ֥ר מֹשֵֽׁל אֶ֖רֶץ מִ/סֶּ֣לַע מִדְבָּ֑רָ/ה אֶל הַ֖ר בַּת צִיּֽוֹן
verses.translit: shlchv khr mshl 'rts msl' mdbrh 'l hr bt tsyvn
verses.translation: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֥ה כְ/עוֹף נוֹדֵ֖ד קֵ֣ן מְשֻׁלָּ֑ח תִּֽהְיֶ֨ינָה֙ בְּנ֣וֹת מוֹאָ֔ב מַעְבָּרֹ֖ת לְ/אַרְנֽוֹן
verses.translit: vhyh kh'vf nvdd qn mshlch thyynh bnvt mv'b m'brt l'rnvn
verses.translation: For it shall be, that , as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.

verses.original: הביאו הָבִ֤יאִי עֵצָה֙ עֲשׂ֣וּ פְלִילָ֔ה שִׁ֧יתִי כַ/לַּ֛יִל צִלֵּ֖/ךְ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ צָהֳרָ֑יִם סַתְּרִי֙ נִדָּחִ֔ים נֹדֵ֖ד אַל תְּגַלִּֽי
verses.translit: hby'v hby'y 'tsh 'shv plylh shyty khlyl tslkh btvkh tshrym stry ndchym ndd 'l tgly
verses.translation: Take counsel, execute judgment; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth.

verses.original: יָג֤וּרוּ בָ/ךְ֙ נִדָּחַ֔/י מוֹאָ֛ב הֱוִי סֵ֥תֶר לָ֖/מוֹ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י שׁוֹדֵ֑ד כִּֽי אָפֵ֤ס הַ/מֵּץ֙ כָּ֣לָה שֹׁ֔ד תַּ֥מּוּ רֹמֵ֖ס מִן הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: ygvrv bkh ndchy mv'b hvy str lmv mpny shvdd khy 'ps hmts khlh shd tmv rms mn h'rts
verses.translation: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.

verses.original: וְ/הוּכַ֤ן בַּ/חֶ֨סֶד֙ כִּסֵּ֔א וְ/יָשַׁ֥ב עָלָ֛י/ו בֶּ/אֱמֶ֖ת בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל דָּוִ֑ד שֹׁפֵ֛ט וְ/דֹרֵ֥שׁ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּ/מְהִ֥ר צֶֽדֶק
verses.translit: vhvkhn bchsd khs' vyshb 'lyv b'mt b'hl dvd shpt vdrsh mshpt vmhr tsdq
verses.translation: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness.

verses.original: שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ גְאוֹן מוֹאָ֖ב גֵּ֣א מְאֹ֑ד גַּאֲוָת֧/וֹ וּ/גְאוֹנ֛/וֹ וְ/עֶבְרָת֖/וֹ לֹא כֵ֥ן בַּדָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: shm'nv g'vn mv'b g' m'd g'vtv vg'vnv v'brtv l' khn bdyv
verses.translation: We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies shall not be so.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן יְיֵלִ֥יל מוֹאָ֛ב לְ/מוֹאָ֖ב כֻּלֹּ֣/ה יְיֵלִ֑יל לַ/אֲשִׁישֵׁ֧י קִיר חֲרֶ֛שֶׂת תֶּהְגּ֖וּ אַךְ נְכָאִֽים
verses.translit: lkhn yylyl mv'b lmv'b khlh yylyl l'shyshy qyr chrsht thgv 'kh nkh'ym
verses.translation: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kir-hareseth shall ye mourn; surely they are stricken.

verses.original: כִּ֣י שַׁדְמוֹת֩ חֶשְׁבּ֨וֹן אֻמְלָ֜ל גֶּ֣פֶן שִׂבְמָ֗ה בַּעֲלֵ֤י גוֹיִם֙ הָלְמ֣וּ שְׂרוּקֶּ֔י/הָ עַד יַעְזֵ֥ר נָגָ֖עוּ תָּ֣עוּ מִדְבָּ֑ר שְׁלֻ֣חוֹתֶ֔י/הָ נִטְּשׁ֖וּ עָ֥בְרוּ יָֽם
verses.translit: khy shdmvt chshbvn 'mll gpn shbmh b'ly gvym hlmv shrvqyh 'd y'zr ng'v t'v mdbr shlchvtyh ntshv 'brv ym
verses.translation: For the fields of Heshbon languish, and the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come even unto Jazer, they wandered through the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֡ן אֶבְכֶּ֞ה בִּ/בְכִ֤י יַעְזֵר֙ גֶּ֣פֶן שִׂבְמָ֔ה אֲרַיָּ֨וֶ/ךְ֙ דִּמְעָתִ֔/י חֶשְׁבּ֖וֹן וְ/אֶלְעָלֵ֑ה כִּ֧י עַל קֵיצֵ֛/ךְ וְ/עַל קְצִירֵ֖/ךְ הֵידָ֥ד נָפָֽל
verses.translit: 'l khn 'bkhh bbkhy y'zr gpn shbmh 'ryvkh dm'ty chshbvn v'l'lh khy 'l qytskh v'l qtsyrkh hydd npl
verses.translation: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen.

verses.original: וְ/נֶאֱסַ֨ף שִׂמְחָ֤ה וָ/גִיל֙ מִן הַ/כַּרְמֶ֔ל וּ/בַ/כְּרָמִ֥ים לֹֽא יְרֻנָּ֖ן לֹ֣א יְרֹעָ֑ע יַ֗יִן בַּ/יְקָבִ֛ים לֹֽא יִדְרֹ֥ךְ הַ/דֹּרֵ֖ךְ הֵידָ֥ד הִשְׁבַּֽתִּי
