verses.translit: vn'sf shmchh vgyl mn hkhrml vbkhrmym l' yrnn l' yr'' yyn byqbym l' ydrkh hdrkh hydd hshbty
verses.translation: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses; I have made their vintage shouting to cease.

verses.original: עַל כֵּן֙ מֵעַ֣/י לְ/מוֹאָ֔ב כַּ/כִּנּ֖וֹר יֶֽהֱמ֑וּ וְ/קִרְבִּ֖/י לְ/קִ֥יר חָֽרֶשׂ
verses.translit: 'l khn m'y lmv'b khkhnvr yhmv vqrby lqyr chrsh
verses.translation: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kir-haresh.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֧ה כִֽי נִרְאָ֛ה כִּֽי נִלְאָ֥ה מוֹאָ֖ב עַל הַ/בָּמָ֑ה וּ/בָ֧א אֶל מִקְדָּשׁ֛/וֹ לְ/הִתְפַּלֵּ֖ל וְ/לֹ֥א יוּכָֽל
verses.translit: vhyh khy nr'h khy nl'h mv'b 'l hbmh vb' 'l mqdshv lhtpll vl' yvkhl
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.

verses.original: זֶ֣ה הַ/דָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל מוֹאָ֖ב מֵ/אָֽז
verses.translit: zh hdbr 'shr dbr yhvh 'l mv'b m'z
verses.translation: This is the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning Moab since that time.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָה֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ בְּ/שָׁלֹ֤שׁ שָׁנִים֙ כִּ/שְׁנֵ֣י שָׂכִ֔יר וְ/נִקְלָה֙ כְּב֣וֹד מוֹאָ֔ב בְּ/כֹ֖ל הֶ/הָמ֣וֹן הָ/רָ֑ב וּ/שְׁאָ֥ר מְעַ֛ט מִזְעָ֖ר ל֥וֹא כַבִּֽיר
verses.translit: v'th dbr yhvh l'mr bshlsh shnym khshny shkhyr vnqlh khbvd mv'b bkhl hhmvn hrb vsh'r m't mz'r lv' khbyr
verses.translation: But now the LORD hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble.

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א דַּמָּ֑שֶׂק הִנֵּ֤ה דַמֶּ֨שֶׂק֙ מוּסָ֣ר מֵ/עִ֔יר וְ/הָיְתָ֖ה מְעִ֥י מַפָּלָֽה
verses.translit: msh' dmshq hnh dmshq mvsr m'yr vhyth m'y mplh
verses.translation: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.

verses.original: עֲזֻב֖וֹת עָרֵ֣י עֲרֹעֵ֑ר לַ/עֲדָרִ֣ים תִּֽהְיֶ֔ינָה וְ/רָבְצ֖וּ וְ/אֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד
verses.translit: 'zbvt 'ry 'r'r l'drym thyynh vrbtsv v'yn mchryd
verses.translation: The cities of Aroer are forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

verses.original: וְ/נִשְׁבַּ֤ת מִבְצָר֙ מֵֽ/אֶפְרַ֔יִם וּ/מַמְלָכָ֥ה מִ/דַּמֶּ֖שֶׂק וּ/שְׁאָ֣ר אֲרָ֑ם כִּ/כְב֤וֹד בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יִֽהְי֔וּ נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vnshbt mbtsr m'prym vmmlkhh mdmshq vsh'r 'rm khkhbvd bny yshr'l yhyv n'm yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא יִדַּ֖ל כְּב֣וֹד יַעֲקֹ֑ב וּ/מִשְׁמַ֥ן בְּשָׂר֖/וֹ יֵרָזֶֽה
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' ydl khbvd y'qb vmshmn bshrv yrzh
verses.translation: And in that day it shall come to pass, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כֶּֽ/אֱסֹף֙ קָצִ֣יר קָמָ֔ה וּ/זְרֹע֖/וֹ שִׁבֳּלִ֣ים יִקְצ֑וֹר וְ/הָיָ֛ה כִּ/מְלַקֵּ֥ט שִׁבֳּלִ֖ים בְּ/עֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים
verses.translit: vhyh kh'sf qtsyr qmh vzr'v shblym yqtsvr vhyh khmlqt shblym b'mq rp'ym
verses.translation: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the corn, and reapeth the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.original: וְ/נִשְׁאַר בּ֤/וֹ עֽוֹלֵלֹת֙ כְּ/נֹ֣קֶף זַ֔יִת שְׁנַ֧יִם שְׁלֹשָׁ֛ה גַּרְגְּרִ֖ים בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ אָמִ֑יר אַרְבָּעָ֣ה חֲמִשָּׁ֗ה בִּ/סְעִפֶ֨י/הָ֙ פֹּֽרִיָּ֔ה נְאֻם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vnsh'r bv 'vllt khnqf zyt shnym shlshh grgrym br'sh 'myr 'rb'h chmshh bs'pyh pryh n'm yhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, saith the LORD God of Israel.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא יִשְׁעֶ֥ה הָ/אָדָ֖ם עַל עֹשֵׂ֑/הוּ וְ/עֵינָ֕י/ו אֶל קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תִּרְאֶֽינָה
verses.translit: byvm hhv' ysh'h h'dm 'l 'shhv v'ynyv 'l qdvsh yshr'l tr'ynh
verses.translation: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֣א יִשְׁעֶ֔ה אֶל הַֽ/מִּזְבְּח֖וֹת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדָ֑י/ו וַ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשׂ֤וּ אֶצְבְּעֹתָי/ו֙ לֹ֣א יִרְאֶ֔ה וְ/הָ/אֲשֵׁרִ֖ים וְ/הָ/חַמָּנִֽים
verses.translit: vl' ysh'h 'l hmzbchvt m'shh ydyv v'shr 'shv 'tsb'tyv l' yr'h vh'shrym vhchmnym
verses.translation: And he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, neither shall respect that which his fingers have made, either the groves, or the images.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/ה֜וּא יִהְי֣וּ עָרֵ֣י מָעֻזּ֗/וֹ כַּ/עֲזוּבַ֤ת הַ/חֹ֨רֶשׁ֙ וְ/הָ֣/אָמִ֔יר אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָזְב֔וּ מִ/פְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/הָיְתָ֖ה שְׁמָמָֽה
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yhyv 'ry m'zv kh'zvbt hchrsh vh'myr 'shr 'zbv mpny bny yshr'l vhyth shmmh
verses.translation: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Israel: and there shall be desolation.

verses.original: כִּ֤י שָׁכַ֨חַתְּ֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֔/ךְ וְ/צ֥וּר מָעֻזֵּ֖/ךְ לֹ֣א זָכָ֑רְתְּ עַל כֵּ֗ן תִּטְּעִי֙ נִטְעֵ֣י נַעֲמָנִ֔ים וּ/זְמֹ֥רַת זָ֖ר תִּזְרָעֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: khy shkhcht 'lhy ysh'kh vtsvr m'zkh l' zkhrt 'l khn tt'y nt'y n'mnym vzmrt zr tzr'nv
verses.translation: Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength, therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants, and shalt set it with strange slips:

verses.original: בְּ/י֤וֹם נִטְעֵ/ךְ֙ תְּשַׂגְשֵׂ֔גִי וּ/בַ/בֹּ֖קֶר זַרְעֵ֣/ךְ תַּפְרִ֑יחִי נֵ֥ד קָצִ֛יר בְּ/י֥וֹם נַחֲלָ֖ה וּ/כְאֵ֥ב אָנֽוּשׁ
verses.translit: byvm nt'kh tshgshgy vbbqr zr'kh tprychy nd qtsyr byvm nchlh vkh'b 'nvsh
verses.translation: In the day shalt thou make thy plant to grow, and in the morning shalt thou make thy seed to flourish: but the harvest shall be a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.

verses.original: ה֗וֹי הֲמוֹן֙ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים כַּ/הֲמ֥וֹת יַמִּ֖ים יֶהֱמָי֑וּ/ן וּ/שְׁא֣וֹן לְאֻמִּ֔ים כִּ/שְׁא֛וֹן מַ֥יִם כַּבִּירִ֖ים יִשָּׁאֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: hvy hmvn 'mym rbym khhmvt ymym yhmyvn vsh'vn l'mym khsh'vn mym khbyrym ysh'vn
verses.translation: Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!

verses.original: לְאֻמִּ֗ים כִּ/שְׁא֞וֹן מַ֤יִם רַבִּים֙ יִשָּׁא֔וּ/ן וְ/גָ֥עַר בּ֖/וֹ וְ/נָ֣ס מִ/מֶּרְחָ֑ק וְ/רֻדַּ֗ף כְּ/מֹ֤ץ הָרִים֙ לִ/פְנֵי ר֔וּחַ וּ/כְ/גַלְגַּ֖ל לִ/פְנֵ֥י סוּפָֽה
verses.translit: l'mym khsh'vn mym rbym ysh'vn vg'r bv vns mmrchq vrdf khmts hrym lpny rvch vkhglgl lpny svph
verses.translation: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.

verses.original: לְ/עֵ֥ת עֶ֨רֶב֙ וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה בַלָּהָ֔ה בְּ/טֶ֥רֶם בֹּ֖קֶר אֵינֶ֑/נּוּ זֶ֚ה חֵ֣לֶק שׁוֹסֵ֔י/נוּ וְ/גוֹרָ֖ל לְ/בֹזְזֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: l't 'rb vhnh blhh btrm bqr 'ynnv zh chlq shvsynv vgvrl lbzzynv
verses.translation: And behold at eveningtide trouble; and before the morning he is not. This is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.

verses.original: ה֥וֹי אֶ֖רֶץ צִלְצַ֣ל כְּנָפָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר מֵ/עֵ֖בֶר לְ/נַֽהֲרֵי כֽוּשׁ
verses.translit: hvy 'rts tsltsl khnpym 'shr m'br lnhry khvsh
verses.translation: Woe to the land shadowing with wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia:

verses.original: הַ/שֹּׁלֵ֨חַ בַּ/יָּ֜ם צִירִ֗ים וּ/בִ/כְלֵי גֹמֶא֮ עַל פְּנֵי מַיִם֒ לְכ֣וּ מַלְאָכִ֣ים קַלִּ֗ים אֶל גּוֹי֙ מְמֻשָּׁ֣ךְ וּ/מוֹרָ֔ט אֶל עַ֥ם נוֹרָ֖א מִן ה֣וּא וָ/הָ֑לְאָה גּ֚וֹי קַו קָ֣ו וּ/מְבוּסָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר בָּזְא֥וּ נְהָרִ֖ים אַרְצֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hshlch bym tsyrym vbkhly gm' 'l pny mym lkhv ml'khym qlym 'l gvy mmshkh vmvrt 'l 'm nvr' mn hv' vhl'h gvy qv qv vmbvsh 'shr bz'v nhrym 'rtsv
verses.translation: That sendeth ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters, saying , Go, ye swift messengers, to a nation scattered and peeled, to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden down, whose land the rivers have spoiled!

verses.original: כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵ֖ל וְ/שֹׁ֣כְנֵי אָ֑רֶץ כִּ/נְשֹׂא נֵ֤ס הָרִים֙ תִּרְא֔וּ וְ/כִ/תְקֹ֥עַ שׁוֹפָ֖ר תִּשְׁמָֽעוּ
verses.translit: khl yshby tbl vshkhny 'rts khnsh' ns hrym tr'v vkhtq' shvpr tshm'v
verses.translation: All ye inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see ye, when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains; and when he bloweth a trumpet, hear ye.

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔/י אשקוטה אֶשְׁקֳטָ֖ה וְ/אַבִּ֣יטָה בִ/מְכוֹנִ֑/י כְּ/חֹ֥ם צַח֙ עֲלֵי א֔וֹר כְּ/עָ֥ב טַ֖ל בְּ/חֹ֥ם קָצִֽיר
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh 'ly 'shqvth 'shqth v'byth bmkhvny khchm tsch 'ly 'vr kh'b tl bchm qtsyr
verses.translation: For so the LORD said unto me, I will take my rest, and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs, and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.

verses.original: כִּֽי לִ/פְנֵ֤י קָצִיר֙ כְּ/תָם פֶּ֔רַח וּ/בֹ֥סֶר גֹּמֵ֖ל יִֽהְיֶ֣ה נִצָּ֑ה וְ/כָרַ֤ת הַ/זַּלְזַלִּים֙ בַּ/מַּזְמֵר֔וֹת וְ/אֶת הַ/נְּטִישׁ֖וֹת הֵסִ֥יר הֵתַֽז
verses.translit: khy lpny qtsyr khtm prch vbsr gml yhyh ntsh vkhrt hzlzlym bmzmrvt v't hntyshvt hsyr htz
verses.translation: For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and take away and cut down the branches.

verses.original: יֵעָזְב֤וּ יַחְדָּו֙ לְ/עֵ֣יט הָרִ֔ים וּֽ/לְ/בֶהֱמַ֖ת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/קָ֤ץ עָלָי/ו֙ הָ/עַ֔יִט וְ/כָל בֶּהֱמַ֥ת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ עָלָ֥י/ו תֶּחֱרָֽף
verses.translit: y'zbv ychdv l'yt hrym vlbhmt h'rts vqts 'lyv h'yt vkhl bhmt h'rts 'lyv tchrf
verses.translation: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.

verses.original: בָּ/עֵת֩ הַ/הִ֨יא יֽוּבַל שַׁ֜י לַ/יהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת עַ֚ם מְמֻשָּׁ֣ךְ וּ/מוֹרָ֔ט וּ/מֵ/עַ֥ם נוֹרָ֖א מִן ה֣וּא וָ/הָ֑לְאָה גּ֣וֹי קַו קָ֣ו וּ/מְבוּסָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּזְא֤וּ נְהָרִים֙ אַרְצ֔/וֹ אֶל מְק֛וֹם שֵׁם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת הַר צִיּֽוֹן
verses.translit: b't hhy' yvbl shy lyhvh tsb'vt 'm mmshkh vmvrt vm'm nvr' mn hv' vhl'h gvy qv qv vmbvsh 'shr bz'v nhrym 'rtsv 'l mqvm shm yhvh tsb'vt hr tsyvn
verses.translation: In that time shall the present be brought unto the LORD of hosts of a people scattered and peeled, and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden under foot, whose land the rivers have spoiled, to the place of the name of the LORD of hosts, the mount Zion.

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א מִצְרָ֑יִם הִנֵּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה רֹכֵ֨ב עַל עָ֥ב קַל֙ וּ/בָ֣א מִצְרַ֔יִם וְ/נָע֞וּ אֱלִילֵ֤י מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ מִ/פָּנָ֔י/ו וּ/לְבַ֥ב מִצְרַ֖יִם יִמַּ֥ס בְּ/קִרְבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: msh' mtsrym hnh yhvh rkhb 'l 'b ql vb' mtsrym vn'v 'lyly mtsrym mpnyv vlbb mtsrym yms bqrbv
verses.translation: The burden of Egypt. Behold, the LORD rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.

verses.original: וְ/סִכְסַכְתִּ֤י מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ בְּ/מִצְרַ֔יִם וְ/נִלְחֲמ֥וּ אִישׁ בְּ/אָחִ֖י/ו וְ/אִ֣ישׁ בְּ/רֵעֵ֑/הוּ עִ֣יר בְּ/עִ֔יר מַמְלָכָ֖ה בְּ/מַמְלָכָֽה
verses.translit: vskhskhty mtsrym bmtsrym vnlchmv 'ysh b'chyv v'ysh br'hv 'yr b'yr mmlkhh bmmlkhh
verses.translation: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.

verses.original: וְ/נָבְקָ֤ה רֽוּחַ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ בְּ/קִרְבּ֔/וֹ וַ/עֲצָת֖/וֹ אֲבַלֵּ֑עַ וְ/דָרְשׁ֤וּ אֶל הָֽ/אֱלִילִים֙ וְ/אֶל הָ֣/אִטִּ֔ים וְ/אֶל הָ/אֹב֖וֹת וְ/אֶל הַ/יִּדְּעֹנִֽים
verses.translit: vnbqh rvch mtsrym bqrbv v'tstv 'bl' vdrshv 'l h'lylym v'l h'tym v'l h'bvt v'l hyd'nym
verses.translation: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.

verses.original: וְ/סִכַּרְתִּי֙ אֶת מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּ/יַ֖ד אֲדֹנִ֣ים קָשֶׁ֑ה וּ/מֶ֤לֶךְ עַז֙ יִמְשָׁל בָּ֔/ם נְאֻ֥ם הָ/אָד֖וֹן יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vskhrty 't mtsrym byd 'dnym qshh vmlkh 'z ymshl bm n'm h'dvn yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: וְ/נִשְּׁתוּ מַ֖יִם מֵֽ/הַ/יָּ֑ם וְ/נָהָ֖ר יֶחֱרַ֥ב וְ/יָבֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vnshtv mym mhym vnhr ychrb vybsh
verses.translation: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.

verses.original: וְ/הֶאֶזְנִ֣יחוּ נְהָר֔וֹת דָּלֲל֥וּ וְ/חָרְב֖וּ יְאֹרֵ֣י מָצ֑וֹר קָנֶ֥ה וָ/ס֖וּף קָמֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: vh'znychv nhrvt dllv vchrbv y'ry mtsvr qnh vsvf qmlv
verses.translation: And they shall turn the rivers far away; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.

verses.original: עָר֥וֹת עַל יְא֖וֹר עַל פִּ֣י יְא֑וֹר וְ/כֹל֙ מִזְרַ֣ע יְא֔וֹר יִיבַ֥שׁ נִדַּ֖ף וְ/אֵינֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: 'rvt 'l y'vr 'l py y'vr vkhl mzr' y'vr yybsh ndf v'ynnv
verses.translation: The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more .

verses.original: וְ/אָנוּ֙ הַ/דַּיָּגִ֔ים וְ/אָ֣בְל֔וּ כָּל מַשְׁלִיכֵ֥י בַ/יְא֖וֹר חַכָּ֑ה וּ/פֹרְשֵׂ֥י מִכְמֹ֛רֶת עַל פְּנֵי מַ֖יִם אֻמְלָֽלוּ
verses.translit: v'nv hdygym v'blv khl mshlykhy by'vr chkhh vprshy mkhmrt 'l pny mym 'mllv
verses.translation: The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.

verses.original: וּ/בֹ֛שׁוּ עֹבְדֵ֥י פִשְׁתִּ֖ים שְׂרִיק֑וֹת וְ/אֹרְגִ֖ים חוֹרָֽי
verses.translit: vbshv 'bdy pshtym shryqvt v'rgym chvry
verses.translation: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.

verses.original: וְ/הָי֥וּ שָׁתֹתֶ֖י/הָ מְדֻכָּאִ֑ים כָּל עֹ֥שֵׂי שֶׂ֖כֶר אַגְמֵי נָֽפֶשׁ
verses.translit: vhyv shttyh mdkh'ym khl 'shy shkhr 'gmy npsh
verses.translation: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices and ponds for fish.

verses.original: אַךְ אֱוִלִים֙ שָׂ֣רֵי צֹ֔עַן חַכְמֵי֙ יֹעֲצֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה עֵצָ֖ה נִבְעָרָ֑ה אֵ֚יךְ תֹּאמְר֣וּ אֶל פַּרְעֹ֔ה בֶּן חֲכָמִ֥ים אֲנִ֖י בֶּן מַלְכֵי קֶֽדֶם
verses.translit: 'kh 'vlym shry ts'n chkhmy y'tsy pr'h 'tsh nb'rh 'ykh t'mrv 'l pr'h bn chkhmym 'ny bn mlkhy qdm
verses.translation: Surely the princes of Zoan are fools, the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say ye unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?

verses.original: אַיָּ/ם֙ אֵפ֣וֹא חֲכָמֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/יַגִּ֥ידוּ נָ֖א לָ֑/ךְ וְ/יֵ֣דְע֔וּ מַה יָּעַ֛ץ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת עַל מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: 'ym 'pv' chkhmykh vygydv n' lkh vyd'v mh y'ts yhvh tsb'vt 'l mtsrym
verses.translation: Where are they? where are thy wise men ? and let them tell thee now, and let them know what the LORD of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt.

verses.original: נֽוֹאֲלוּ֙ שָׂ֣רֵי צֹ֔עַן נִשְּׁא֖וּ שָׂ֣רֵי נֹ֑ף הִתְע֥וּ אֶת מִצְרַ֖יִם פִּנַּ֥ת שְׁבָטֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: nv'lv shry ts'n nsh'v shry nf ht'v 't mtsrym pnt shbtyh
verses.translation: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof.

verses.original: יְהוָ֛ה מָסַ֥ךְ בְּ/קִרְבָּ֖/הּ ר֣וּחַ עִוְעִ֑ים וְ/הִתְע֤וּ אֶת מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ בְּ/כָֽל מַעֲשֵׂ֔/הוּ כְּ/הִתָּע֥וֹת שִׁכּ֖וֹר בְּ/קִיאֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: yhvh mskh bqrbh rvch 'v'ym vht'v 't mtsrym bkhl m'shhv khht'vt shkhvr bqy'v
verses.translation: The LORD hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֥ה לְ/מִצְרַ֖יִם מַֽעֲשֶׂ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר יַעֲשֶׂ֛ה רֹ֥אשׁ וְ/זָנָ֖ב כִּפָּ֥ה וְ/אַגְמֽוֹן
verses.translit: vl' yhyh lmtsrym m'shh 'shr y'shh r'sh vznb khph v'gmvn
verses.translation: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא יִֽהְיֶ֥ה מִצְרַ֖יִם כַּ/נָּשִׁ֑ים וְ/חָרַ֣ד וּ/פָחַ֗ד מִ/פְּנֵי֙ תְּנוּפַת֙ יַד יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר ה֖וּא מֵנִ֥יף עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yhyh mtsrym khnshym vchrd vpchd mpny tnvpt yd yhvh tsb'vt 'shr hv' mnyf 'lyv
verses.translation: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the LORD of hosts, which he shaketh over it.

verses.original: וְ֠/הָיְתָה אַדְמַ֨ת יְהוּדָ֤ה לְ/מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ לְ/חָגָּ֔א כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַזְכִּ֥יר אֹתָ֛/הּ אֵלָ֖י/ו יִפְחָ֑ד מִ/פְּנֵ֗י עֲצַת֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר ה֖וּא יוֹעֵ֥ץ עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vhyth 'dmt yhvdh lmtsrym lchg' khl 'shr yzkhyr 'th 'lyv ypchd mpny 'tst yhvh tsb'vt 'shr hv' yv'ts 'lyv
verses.translation: And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the LORD of hosts, which he hath determined against it.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֡וּא יִהְיוּ֩ חָמֵ֨שׁ עָרִ֜ים בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם מְדַבְּרוֹת֙ שְׂפַ֣ת כְּנַ֔עַן וְ/נִשְׁבָּע֖וֹת לַ/יהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת עִ֣יר הַ/הֶ֔רֶס יֵאָמֵ֖ר לְ/אֶחָֽת
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yhyv chmsh 'rym b'rts mtsrym mdbrvt shpt khn'n vnshb'vt lyhvh tsb'vt 'yr hhrs y'mr l'cht
verses.translation: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of hosts; one shall be called, The city of destruction.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶ֤ה מִזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וּ/מַצֵּבָ֥ה אֵֽצֶל גְּבוּלָ֖/הּ לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yhyh mzbch lyhvh btvkh 'rts mtsrym vmtsbh 'tsl gbvlh lyhvh
verses.translation: In that day shall there be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֨ה לְ/א֥וֹת וּ/לְ/עֵ֛ד לַֽ/יהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם כִּֽי יִצְעֲק֤וּ אֶל יְהוָה֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י לֹֽחֲצִ֔ים וְ/יִשְׁלַ֥ח לָ/הֶ֛ם מוֹשִׁ֥יעַ וָ/רָ֖ב וְ/הִצִּילָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhyh l'vt vl'd lyhvh tsb'vt b'rts mtsrym khy yts'qv 'l yhvh mpny lchtsym vyshlch lhm mvshy' vrb vhtsylm
verses.translation: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the LORD of hosts in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto the LORD because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.

verses.original: וְ/נוֹדַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ לְ/מִצְרַ֔יִם וְ/יָדְע֥וּ מִצְרַ֛יִם אֶת יְהוָ֖ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא וְ/עָֽבְדוּ֙ זֶ֣בַח וּ/מִנְחָ֔ה וְ/נָדְרוּ נֵ֥דֶר לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה וְ/שִׁלֵּֽמוּ
verses.translit: vnvd' yhvh lmtsrym vyd'v mtsrym 't yhvh byvm hhv' v'bdv zbch vmnchh vndrv ndr lyhvh vshlmv
verses.translation: And the LORD shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the LORD in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto the LORD , and perform it .

verses.original: וְ/נָגַ֧ף יְהוָ֛ה אֶת מִצְרַ֖יִם נָגֹ֣ף וְ/רָפ֑וֹא וְ/שָׁ֨בוּ֙ עַד יְהוָ֔ה וְ/נֶעְתַּ֥ר לָ/הֶ֖ם וּ/רְפָאָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vngf yhvh 't mtsrym ngf vrpv' vshbv 'd yhvh vn'tr lhm vrp'm
verses.translation: And the LORD shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal it: and they shall return even to the LORD , and he shall be intreated of them, and shall heal them.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא תִּהְיֶ֨ה מְסִלָּ֤ה מִ/מִּצְרַ֨יִם֙ אַשּׁ֔וּרָ/ה וּ/בָֽא אַשּׁ֥וּר בְּ/מִצְרַ֖יִם וּ/מִצְרַ֣יִם בְּ/אַשּׁ֑וּר וְ/עָבְד֥וּ מִצְרַ֖יִם אֶת אַשּֽׁוּר
verses.translit: byvm hhv' thyh mslh mmtsrym 'shvrh vb' 'shvr bmtsrym vmtsrym b'shvr v'bdv mtsrym 't 'shvr
verses.translation: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא יִהְיֶ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ שְׁלִ֣ישִׁיָּ֔ה לְ/מִצְרַ֖יִם וּ/לְ/אַשּׁ֑וּר בְּרָכָ֖ה בְּ/קֶ֥רֶב הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yhyh yshr'l shlyshyh lmtsrym vl'shvr brkhh bqrb h'rts
verses.translation: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, even a blessing in the midst of the land:

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֧ר בֵּרֲכ֛/וֹ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵ/אמֹ֑ר בָּר֨וּךְ עַמִּ֜/י מִצְרַ֗יִם וּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יָדַ/י֙ אַשּׁ֔וּר וְ/נַחֲלָתִ֖/י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 'shr brkhv yhvh tsb'vt l'mr brvkh 'my mtsrym vm'shh ydy 'shvr vnchlty yshr'l
verses.translation: Whom the LORD of hosts shall bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel mine inheritance.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֨ת בֹּ֤א תַרְתָּן֙ אַשְׁדּ֔וֹדָ/ה בִּ/שְׁלֹ֣ח אֹת֔/וֹ סַֽרְג֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר וַ/יִּלָּ֥חֶם בְּ/אַשְׁדּ֖וֹד וַֽ/יִּלְכְּדָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: bshnt b' trtn 'shdvdh bshlch 'tv srgvn mlkh 'shvr vylchm b'shdvd vylkhdh
verses.translation: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;

verses.original: בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֗יא דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָה֮ בְּ/יַ֣ד יְשַׁעְיָ֣הוּ בֶן אָמוֹץ֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ לֵ֗ךְ וּ/פִתַּחְתָּ֤ הַ/שַּׂק֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל מָתְנֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/נַעַלְ/ךָ֥ תַחֲלֹ֖ץ מֵ/עַ֣ל רַגְלֶ֑י/ךָ וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ כֵּ֔ן הָלֹ֖ךְ עָר֥וֹם וְ/יָחֵֽף
verses.translit: b't hhy' dbr yhvh byd ysh'yhv bn 'mvts l'mr lkh vptcht hshq m'l mtnykh vn'lkh tchlts m'l rglykh vy'sh khn hlkh 'rvm vychf
verses.translation: At the same time spake the LORD by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins, and put off thy shoe from thy foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלַ֛ךְ עַבְדִּ֥/י יְשַׁעְיָ֖הוּ עָר֣וֹם וְ/יָחֵ֑ף שָׁלֹ֤שׁ שָׁנִים֙ א֣וֹת וּ/מוֹפֵ֔ת עַל מִצְרַ֖יִם וְ/עַל כּֽוּשׁ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh kh'shr hlkh 'bdy ysh'yhv 'rvm vychf shlsh shnym 'vt vmvpt 'l mtsrym v'l khvsh
verses.translation: And the LORD said, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia;

verses.original: כֵּ֣ן יִנְהַ֣ג מֶֽלֶךְ אַ֠שּׁוּר אֶת שְׁבִ֨י מִצְרַ֜יִם וְ/אֶת גָּל֥וּת כּ֛וּשׁ נְעָרִ֥ים וּ/זְקֵנִ֖ים עָר֣וֹם וְ/יָחֵ֑ף וַ/חֲשׂוּפַ֥י שֵׁ֖ת עֶרְוַ֥ת מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: khn ynhg mlkh 'shvr 't shby mtsrym v't glvt khvsh n'rym vzqnym 'rvm vychf vchshvpy sht 'rvt mtsrym
verses.translation: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners, and the Ethiopians captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with their buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.

verses.original: וְ/חַתּ֖וּ וָ/בֹ֑שׁוּ מִ/כּוּשׁ֙ מַבָּטָ֔/ם וּ/מִן מִצְרַ֖יִם תִּפְאַרְתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vchtv vbshv mkhvsh mbtm vmn mtsrym tp'rtm
verses.translation: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.

verses.original: וְ֠/אָמַר יֹשֵׁ֨ב הָ/אִ֣י הַ/זֶּה֮ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/הוּא֒ הִנֵּה כֹ֣ה מַבָּטֵ֗/נוּ אֲשֶׁר נַ֤סְנוּ שָׁם֙ לְ/עֶזְרָ֔ה לְ/הִ֨נָּצֵ֔ל מִ/פְּנֵ֖י מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר וְ/אֵ֖יךְ נִמָּלֵ֥ט אֲנָֽחְנוּ
verses.translit: v'mr yshb h'y hzh byvm hhv' hnh khh mbtnv 'shr nsnv shm l'zrh lhntsl mpny mlkh 'shvr v'ykh nmlt 'nchnv
verses.translation: And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day, Behold, such is our expectation, whither we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and how shall we escape?

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א מִדְבַּר יָ֑ם כְּ/סוּפ֤וֹת בַּ/נֶּ֨גֶב֙ לַֽ/חֲלֹ֔ף מִ/מִּדְבָּ֣ר בָּ֔א מֵ/אֶ֖רֶץ נוֹרָאָֽה
verses.translit: msh' mdbr ym khsvpvt bngb lchlf mmdbr b' m'rts nvr'h
verses.translation: The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through; so it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.

verses.original: חָז֥וּת קָשָׁ֖ה הֻגַּד לִ֑/י הַ/בּוֹגֵ֤ד בּוֹגֵד֙ וְ/הַ/שּׁוֹדֵ֣ד שׁוֹדֵ֔ד עֲלִ֤י עֵילָם֙ צוּרִ֣י מָדַ֔י כָּל אַנְחָתָ֖/ה הִשְׁבַּֽתִּי
verses.translit: chzvt qshh hgd ly hbvgd bvgd vhshvdd shvdd 'ly 'ylm tsvry mdy khl 'nchth hshbty
verses.translation: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֗ן מָלְא֤וּ מָתְנַ/י֙ חַלְחָלָ֔ה צִירִ֣ים אֲחָז֔וּ/נִי כְּ/צִירֵ֖י יֽוֹלֵדָ֑ה נַעֲוֵ֣יתִי מִ/שְּׁמֹ֔עַ נִבְהַ֖לְתִּי מֵ/רְאֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'l khn ml'v mtny chlchlh tsyrym 'chzvny khtsyry yvldh n'vyty mshm' nbhlty mr'vt
verses.translation: Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing of it; I was dismayed at the seeing of it .

verses.original: תָּעָ֣ה לְבָבִ֔/י פַּלָּצ֖וּת בִּֽעֲתָ֑תְ/נִי אֵ֚ת נֶ֣שֶׁף חִשְׁקִ֔/י שָׂ֥ם לִ֖/י לַ/חֲרָדָֽה
verses.translit: t'h lbby pltsvt b'ttny 't nshf chshqy shm ly lchrdh
verses.translation: My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me.

verses.original: עָרֹ֧ךְ הַ/שֻּׁלְחָ֛ן צָפֹ֥ה הַ/צָּפִ֖ית אָכ֣וֹל שָׁתֹ֑ה ק֥וּמוּ הַ/שָּׂרִ֖ים מִשְׁח֥וּ מָגֵֽן
verses.translit: 'rkh hshlchn tsph htspyt 'khvl shth qvmv hshrym mshchv mgn
verses.translation: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, and anoint the shield.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר אֵלַ֖/י אֲדֹנָ֑/י לֵ֚ךְ הַעֲמֵ֣ד הַֽ/מְצַפֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִרְאֶ֖ה יַגִּֽיד
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'ly 'dny lkh h'md hmtsph 'shr yr'h ygyd
verses.translation: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.

verses.original: וְ/רָ֣אָה רֶ֗כֶב צֶ֚מֶד פָּֽרָשִׁ֔ים רֶ֥כֶב חֲמ֖וֹר רֶ֣כֶב גָּמָ֑ל וְ/הִקְשִׁ֥יב קֶ֖שֶׁב רַב קָֽשֶׁב
verses.translit: vr'h rkhb tsmd prshym rkhb chmvr rkhb gml vhqshyb qshb rb qshb
verses.translation: And he saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, and a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֖א אַרְיֵ֑ה עַל מִצְפֶּ֣ה אֲדֹנָ֗/י אָנֹכִ֞י עֹמֵ֤ד תָּמִיד֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וְ/עַל מִ֨שְׁמַרְתִּ֔/י אָנֹכִ֥י נִצָּ֖ב כָּל הַ/לֵּילֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyqr' 'ryh 'l mtsph 'dny 'nkhy 'md tmyd yvmm v'l mshmrty 'nkhy ntsb khl hlylvt
verses.translation: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּה זֶ֥ה בָא֙ רֶ֣כֶב אִ֔ישׁ צֶ֖מֶד פָּֽרָשִׁ֑ים וַ/יַּ֣עַן וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר נָפְלָ֤ה נָֽפְלָה֙ בָּבֶ֔ל וְ/כָל פְּסִילֵ֥י אֱלֹהֶ֖י/הָ שִׁבַּ֥ר לָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vhnh zh b' rkhb 'ysh tsmd prshym vy'n vy'mr nplh nplh bbl vkhl psyly 'lhyh shbr l'rts
verses.translation: And, behold, here cometh a chariot of men, with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.

verses.original: מְדֻשָׁתִ֖/י וּ/בֶן גָּרְנִ֑/י אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי מֵ/אֵ֨ת יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הִגַּ֥דְתִּי לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: mdshty vbn grny 'shr shm'ty m't yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hgdty lkhm
verses.translation: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א דּוּמָ֑ה אֵלַ/י֙ קֹרֵ֣א מִ/שֵּׂעִ֔יר שֹׁמֵר֙ מַה מִ/לַּ֔יְלָה שֹׁמֵ֖ר מַה מִ/לֵּֽיל
verses.translit: msh' dvmh 'ly qr' msh'yr shmr mh mlylh shmr mh mlyl
verses.translation: The burden of Dumah. He calleth to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?

verses.original: אָמַ֣ר שֹׁמֵ֔ר אָתָ֥ה בֹ֖קֶר וְ/גַם לָ֑יְלָה אִם תִּבְעָי֥וּ/ן בְּעָ֖יוּ שֻׁ֥בוּ אֵתָֽיוּ
verses.translit: 'mr shmr 'th bqr vgm lylh 'm tb'yvn b'yv shbv 'tyv
verses.translation: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, come.

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א בַּ/עְרָ֑ב בַּ/יַּ֤עַר בַּ/עְרַב֙ תָּלִ֔ינוּ אֹֽרְח֖וֹת דְּדָנִֽים
verses.translit: msh' b'rb by'r b'rb tlynv 'rchvt ddnym
verses.translation: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim.

verses.original: לִ/קְרַ֥את צָמֵ֖א הֵתָ֣יוּ מָ֑יִם יֹשְׁבֵי֙ אֶ֣רֶץ תֵּימָ֔א בְּ/לַחְמ֖/וֹ קִדְּמ֥וּ נֹדֵֽד
verses.translit: lqr't tsm' htyv mym yshby 'rts tym' blchmv qdmv ndd
verses.translation: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.

verses.original: כִּֽי מִ/פְּנֵ֥י חֲרָב֖וֹת נָדָ֑דוּ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י חֶ֣רֶב נְטוּשָׁ֗ה וּ/מִ/פְּנֵי֙ קֶ֣שֶׁת דְּרוּכָ֔ה וּ/מִ/פְּנֵ֖י כֹּ֥בֶד מִלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: khy mpny chrbvt nddv mpny chrb ntvshh vmpny qsht drvkhh vmpny khbd mlchmh
verses.translation: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.

verses.original: כִּי כֹ֛ה אָמַ֥ר אֲדֹנָ֖/י אֵלָ֑/י בְּ/ע֤וֹד שָׁנָה֙ כִּ/שְׁנֵ֣י שָׂכִ֔יר וְ/כָלָ֖ה כָּל כְּב֥וֹד קֵדָֽר
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'dny 'ly b'vd shnh khshny shkhyr vkhlh khl khbvd qdr
verses.translation: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:

verses.original: וּ/שְׁאָ֧ר מִסְפַּר קֶ֛שֶׁת גִּבּוֹרֵ֥י בְנֵֽי קֵדָ֖ר יִמְעָ֑טוּ כִּ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל דִּבֵּֽר
verses.translit: vsh'r mspr qsht gbvry bny qdr ym'tv khy yhvh 'lhy yshr'l dbr
verses.translation: And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the LORD God of Israel hath spoken it .

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א גֵּ֣יא חִזָּי֑וֹן מַה לָּ֣/ךְ אֵפ֔וֹא כִּֽי עָלִ֥ית כֻּלָּ֖/ךְ לַ/גַּגּֽוֹת
verses.translit: msh' gy' chzyvn mh lkh 'pv' khy 'lyt khlkh lggvt
verses.translation: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops?

verses.original: תְּשֻׁא֣וֹת מְלֵאָ֗ה עִ֚יר הֽוֹמִיָּ֔ה קִרְיָ֖ה עַלִּיזָ֑ה חֲלָלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ לֹ֣א חַלְלֵי חֶ֔רֶב וְ/לֹ֖א מֵתֵ֥י מִלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: tsh'vt ml'h 'yr hvmyh qryh 'lyzh chllykh l' chlly chrb vl' mty mlchmh
verses.translation: Thou that art full of stirs, a tumultuous city, a joyous city: thy slain men are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.

verses.original: כָּל קְצִינַ֥יִ/ךְ נָֽדְדוּ יַ֖חַד מִ/קֶּ֣שֶׁת אֻסָּ֑רוּ כָּל נִמְצָאַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ אֻסְּר֣וּ יַחְדָּ֔ו מֵ/רָח֖וֹק בָּרָֽחוּ
verses.translit: khl qtsynykh nddv ychd mqsht 'srv khl nmts'ykh 'srv ychdv mrchvq brchv
verses.translation: All thy rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in thee are bound together, which have fled from far.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֥ן אָמַ֛רְתִּי שְׁע֥וּ מִ/נִּ֖י אֲמָרֵ֣ר בַּ/בֶּ֑כִי אַל תָּאִ֣יצוּ לְ/נַֽחֲמֵ֔/נִי עַל שֹׁ֖ד בַּת עַמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: 'l khn 'mrty sh'v mny 'mrr bbkhy 'l t'ytsv lnchmny 'l shd bt 'my
verses.translation: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labour not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people.

verses.original: כִּ֣י יוֹם֩ מְהוּמָ֨ה וּ/מְבוּסָ֜ה וּ/מְבוּכָ֗ה לַֽ/אדֹנָ֧/י יְהוִ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת בְּ/גֵ֣יא חִזָּי֑וֹן מְקַרְקַ֥ר קִ֖ר וְ/שׁ֥וֹעַ אֶל הָ/הָֽר
verses.translit: khy yvm mhvmh vmbvsh vmbvkhh l'dny yhvh tsb'vt bgy' chzyvn mqrqr qr vshv' 'l hhr
verses.translation: For it is a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity by the Lord GOD of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountains.

verses.original: וְ/עֵילָם֙ נָשָׂ֣א אַשְׁפָּ֔ה בְּ/רֶ֥כֶב אָדָ֖ם פָּֽרָשִׁ֑ים וְ/קִ֥יר עֵרָ֖ה מָגֵֽן
verses.translit: v'ylm nsh' 'shph brkhb 'dm prshym vqyr 'rh mgn
verses.translation: And Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י מִבְחַר עֲמָקַ֖יִ/ךְ מָ֣לְאוּ רָ֑כֶב וְ/הַ/פָּ֣רָשִׁ֔ים שֹׁ֖ת שָׁ֥תוּ הַ/שָּֽׁעְרָ/ה
verses.translit: vyhy mbchr 'mqykh ml'v rkhb vhprshym sht shtv hsh'rh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.

verses.original: וַ/יְגַ֕ל אֵ֖ת מָסַ֣ךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַ/תַּבֵּט֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא אֶל נֶ֖שֶׁק בֵּ֥ית הַ/יָּֽעַר
verses.translit: vygl 't mskh yhvdh vtbt byvm hhv' 'l nshq byt hy'r
verses.translation: And he discovered the covering of Judah, and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨ת בְּקִיעֵ֧י עִיר דָּוִ֛ד רְאִיתֶ֖ם כִּי רָ֑בּוּ וַֽ/תְּקַבְּצ֔וּ אֶת מֵ֥י הַ/בְּרֵכָ֖ה הַ/תַּחְתּוֹנָֽה
verses.translit: v't bqy'y 'yr dvd r'ytm khy rbv vtqbtsv 't my hbrkhh htchtvnh
verses.translation: Ye have seen also the breaches of the city of David, that they are many: and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת בָּתֵּ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם סְפַרְתֶּ֑ם וַ/תִּתְֿצוּ֙ הַ/בָּ֣תִּ֔ים לְ/בַצֵּ֖ר הַ/חוֹמָֽה
verses.translit: v't bty yrvshlm sprtm vtttsv hbtym lbtsr hchvmh
verses.translation: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall.

verses.original: וּ/מִקְוָ֣ה עֲשִׂיתֶ֗ם בֵּ֚ין הַ/חֹ֣מֹתַ֔יִם לְ/מֵ֖י הַ/בְּרֵכָ֣ה הַ/יְשָׁנָ֑ה וְ/לֹ֤א הִבַּטְתֶּם֙ אֶל עֹשֶׂ֔י/הָ וְ/יֹצְרָ֥/הּ מֵֽ/רָח֖וֹק לֹ֥א רְאִיתֶֽם
verses.translit: vmqvh 'shytm byn hchmtym lmy hbrkhh hyshnh vl' hbttm 'l 'shyh vytsrh mrchvq l' r'ytm
verses.translation: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֗א אֲדֹנָ֧/י יְהוִ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא לִ/בְכִי֙ וּ/לְ/מִסְפֵּ֔ד וּ/לְ/קָרְחָ֖ה וְ/לַ/חֲגֹ֥ר שָֽׂק
verses.translit: vyqr' 'dny yhvh tsb'vt byvm hhv' lbkhy vlmspd vlqrchh vlchgr shq
verses.translation: And in that day did the Lord GOD of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה שָׂשׂ֣וֹן וְ/שִׂמְחָ֗ה הָרֹ֤ג בָּקָר֙ וְ/שָׁחֹ֣ט צֹ֔אן אָכֹ֥ל בָּשָׂ֖ר וְ/שָׁת֣וֹת יָ֑יִן אָכ֣וֹל וְ/שָׁת֔וֹ כִּ֥י מָחָ֖ר נָמֽוּת
verses.translit: vhnh shshvn vshmchh hrg bqr vshcht ts'n 'khl bshr vshtvt yyn 'khvl vshtv khy mchr nmvt
verses.translation: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.

verses.original: וְ/נִגְלָ֥ה בְ/אָזְנָ֖/י יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אִם יְ֠כֻפַּר הֶ/עָוֺ֨ן הַ/זֶּ֤ה לָ/כֶם֙ עַד תְּמֻת֔וּ/ן אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִ֖ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vnglh b'zny yhvh tsb'vt 'm ykhpr h'vn hzh lkhm 'd tmtvn 'mr 'dny yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: And it was revealed in mine ears by the LORD of hosts, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, saith the Lord GOD of hosts.

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִ֖ה צְבָא֑וֹת לֶךְ בֹּא֙ אֶל הַ/סֹּכֵ֣ן הַ/זֶּ֔ה עַל שֶׁבְנָ֖א אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh tsb'vt lkh b' 'l hskhn hzh 'l shbn' 'shr 'l hbyt
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, which is over the house, and say ,

verses.original: מַה לְּ/ךָ֥ פֹה֙ וּ/מִ֣י לְ/ךָ֣ פֹ֔ה כִּֽי חָצַ֧בְתָּ לְּ/ךָ֛ פֹּ֖ה קָ֑בֶר חֹצְבִ֤י מָרוֹם֙ קִבְר֔/וֹ חֹקְקִ֥י בַ/סֶּ֖לַע מִשְׁכָּ֥ן לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mh lkh ph vmy lkh ph khy chtsbt lkh ph qbr chtsby mrvm qbrv chqqy bsl' mshkhn lv
verses.translation: What hast thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out a sepulchre here, as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high, and that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock?

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ מְטַלְטֶלְ/ךָ֔ טַלְטֵלָ֖ה גָּ֑בֶר וְ/עֹטְ/ךָ֖ עָטֹֽה
verses.translit: hnh yhvh mtltlkh tltlh gbr v'tkh 'th
verses.translation: Behold, the LORD will carry thee away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover thee.

verses.original: צָנ֤וֹף יִצְנָפְ/ךָ֙ צְנֵפָ֔ה כַּדּ֕וּר אֶל אֶ֖רֶץ רַחֲבַ֣ת יָדָ֑יִם שָׁ֣מָּ/ה תָמ֗וּת וְ/שָׁ֨מָּ/ה֙ מַרְכְּב֣וֹת כְּבוֹדֶ֔/ךָ קְל֖וֹן בֵּ֥ית אֲדֹנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: tsnvf ytsnpkh tsnph khdvr 'l 'rts rchbt ydym shmh tmvt vshmh mrkhbvt khbvdkh qlvn byt 'dnykh
verses.translation: He will surely violently turn and toss thee like a ball into a large country: there shalt thou die, and there the chariots of thy glory shall be the shame of thy lord’s house.

verses.translit: vhdptykh mmtsbkh vmm'mdkh yhrskh
verses.translation: And I will drive thee from thy station, and from thy state shall he pull thee down.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֖ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא וְ/קָרָ֣אתִי לְ/עַבְדִּ֔/י לְ/אֶלְיָקִ֖ים בֶּן חִלְקִיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' vqr'ty l'bdy l'lyqym bn chlqyhv
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:

verses.original: וְ/הִלְבַּשְׁתִּ֣י/ו כֻּתָּנְתֶּ֗/ךָ וְ/אַבְנֵֽטְ/ךָ֙ אֲחַזְּקֶ֔/נּוּ וּ/מֶֽמְשֶׁלְתְּ/ךָ֖ אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּ/יָד֑/וֹ וְ/הָיָ֥ה לְ/אָ֛ב לְ/יוֹשֵׁ֥ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וּ/לְ/בֵ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vhlbshtyv khtntkh v'bntkh 'chzqnv vmmshltkh 'tn bydv vhyh l'b lyvshb yrvshlm vlbyt yhvdh
verses.translation: And I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand: and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֛י מַפְתֵּ֥חַ בֵּית דָּוִ֖ד עַל שִׁכְמ֑/וֹ וּ/פָתַח֙ וְ/אֵ֣ין סֹגֵ֔ר וְ/סָגַ֖ר וְ/אֵ֥ין פֹּתֵֽחַ
verses.translit: vntty mptch byt dvd 'l shkhmv vptch v'yn sgr vsgr v'yn ptch
verses.translation: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.

verses.original: וּ/תְקַעְתִּ֥י/ו יָתֵ֖ד בְּ/מָק֣וֹם נֶאֱמָ֑ן וְ/הָיָ֛ה לְ/כִסֵּ֥א כָב֖וֹד לְ/בֵ֥ית אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vtq'tyv ytd bmqvm n'mn vhyh lkhs' khbvd lbyt 'byv
verses.translation: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father’s house.

verses.original: וְ/תָל֨וּ עָלָ֜י/ו כֹּ֣ל כְּב֣וֹד בֵּית אָבִ֗י/ו הַ/צֶּֽאֱצָאִים֙ וְ/הַ/צְּפִע֔וֹת כֹּ֖ל כְּלֵ֣י הַ/קָּטָ֑ן מִ/כְּלֵי֙ הָֽ/אַגָּנ֔וֹת וְ/עַ֖ד כָּל כְּלֵ֥י הַ/נְּבָלִֽים
verses.translit: vtlv 'lyv khl khbvd byt 'byv hts'ts'ym vhtsp'vt khl khly hqtn mkhly h'gnvt v'd khl khly hnblym
verses.translation: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת תָּמוּשׁ֙ הַ/יָּתֵ֔ד הַ/תְּקוּעָ֖ה בְּ/מָק֣וֹם נֶאֱמָ֑ן וְ/נִגְדְּעָ֣ה וְ/נָפְלָ֗ה וְ/נִכְרַת֙ הַ/מַּשָּׂ֣א אֲשֶׁר עָלֶ֔י/הָ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר
verses.translit: byvm hhv' n'm yhvh tsb'vt tmvsh hytd htqv'h bmqvm n'mn vngd'h vnplh vnkhrt hmsh' 'shr 'lyh khy yhvh dbr
verses.translation: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed, and be cut down, and fall; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off: for the LORD hath spoken it .

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א צֹ֑ר הֵילִ֣ילוּ אֳנִיּ֣וֹת תַּרְשִׁ֗ישׁ כִּֽי שֻׁדַּ֤ד מִ/בַּ֨יִת֙ מִ/בּ֔וֹא מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ כִּתִּ֖ים נִגְלָה לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: msh' tsr hylylv 'nyvt trshysh khy shdd mbyt mbv' m'rts khtym nglh lmv
verses.translation: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.

verses.original: דֹּ֖מּוּ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי אִ֑י סֹחֵ֥ר צִיד֛וֹן עֹבֵ֥ר יָ֖ם מִלְאֽוּ/ךְ
verses.translit: dmv yshby 'y schr tsydvn 'br ym ml'vkh
verses.translation: Be still, ye inhabitants of the isle; thou whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/מַ֤יִם רַבִּים֙ זֶ֣רַע שִׁחֹ֔ר קְצִ֥יר יְא֖וֹר תְּבֽוּאָתָ֑/הּ וַ/תְּהִ֖י סְחַ֥ר גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: vbmym rbym zr' shchr qtsyr y'vr tbv'th vthy schr gvym
verses.translation: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, is her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.

verses.original: בּ֣וֹשִׁי צִיד֔וֹן כִּֽי אָמַ֣ר יָ֔ם מָע֥וֹז הַ/יָּ֖ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לֹֽא חַ֣לְתִּי וְ/לֹֽא יָלַ֗דְתִּי וְ/לֹ֥א גִדַּ֛לְתִּי בַּחוּרִ֖ים רוֹמַ֥מְתִּי בְתוּלֽוֹת
verses.translit: bvshy tsydvn khy 'mr ym m'vz hym l'mr l' chlty vl' yldty vl' gdlty bchvrym rvmmty btvlvt
verses.translation: Be thou ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea hath spoken, even the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, nor bring up virgins.

verses.original: כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁר שֵׁ֖מַע לְ/מִצְרָ֑יִם יָחִ֖ילוּ כְּ/שֵׁ֥מַע צֹֽר
verses.translit: kh'shr shm' lmtsrym ychylv khshm' tsr
verses.translation: As at the report concerning Egypt, so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.

verses.original: עִבְר֖וּ תַּרְשִׁ֑ישָׁ/ה הֵילִ֖ילוּ יֹ֥שְׁבֵי אִֽי
verses.translit: 'brv trshyshh hylylv yshby 'y
verses.translation: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.

verses.original: הֲ/זֹ֥את לָ/כֶ֖ם עַלִּיזָ֑ה מִֽ/ימֵי קֶ֤דֶם קַדְמָתָ/הּ֙ יֹבִל֣וּ/הָ רַגְלֶ֔י/הָ מֵֽ/רָח֖וֹק לָ/גֽוּר
verses.translit: hz't lkhm 'lyzh mymy qdm qdmth yblvh rglyh mrchvq lgvr
verses.translation: Is this your joyous city , whose antiquity is of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.

verses.original: מִ֚י יָעַ֣ץ זֹ֔את עַל צֹ֖ר הַ/מַּֽעֲטִירָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר סֹחֲרֶ֨י/ה֙ שָׂרִ֔ים כִּנְעָנֶ֖י/הָ נִכְבַּדֵּי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: my y'ts z't 'l tsr hm'tyrh 'shr schryh shrym khn'nyh nkhbdy 'rts
verses.translation: Who hath taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning city , whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honourable of the earth?

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת יְעָצָ֑/הּ לְ/חַלֵּל֙ גְּא֣וֹן כָּל צְבִ֔י לְ/הָקֵ֖ל כָּל נִכְבַּדֵּי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: yhvh tsb'vt y'tsh lchll g'vn khl tsby lhql khl nkhbdy 'rts
verses.translation: The LORD of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, and to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth.

verses.original: עִבְרִ֥י אַרְצֵ֖/ךְ כַּ/יְאֹ֑ר בַּת תַּרְשִׁ֕ישׁ אֵ֖ין מֵ֥זַח עֽוֹד
verses.translit: 'bry 'rtskh khy'r bt trshysh 'yn mzch 'vd
verses.translation: Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: there is no more strength.

verses.original: יָד/וֹ֙ נָטָ֣ה עַל הַ/יָּ֔ם הִרְגִּ֖יז מַמְלָכ֑וֹת יְהוָה֙ צִוָּ֣ה אֶל כְּנַ֔עַן לַ/שְׁמִ֖ד מָעֻזְנֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: ydv nth 'l hym hrgyz mmlkhvt yhvh tsvh 'l khn'n lshmd m'znyh
verses.translation: He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: the LORD hath given a commandment against the merchant city , to destroy the strong holds thereof.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר לֹֽא תוֹסִ֥יפִי ע֖וֹד לַ/עְל֑וֹז הַֽ/מְעֻשָּׁקָ֞ה בְּתוּלַ֣ת בַּת צִיד֗וֹן כתיים כִּתִּים֙ ק֣וּמִי עֲבֹ֔רִי גַּם שָׁ֖ם לֹא יָנ֥וּחַֽ לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr l' tvsypy 'vd l'lvz hm'shqh btvlt bt tsydvn khtyym khtym qvmy 'bry gm shm l' ynvch lkh
verses.translation: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim; there also shalt thou have no rest.

verses.original: הֵ֣ן אֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֗ים זֶ֤ה הָ/עָם֙ לֹ֣א הָיָ֔ה אַשּׁ֖וּר יְסָדָ֣/הּ לְ/צִיִּ֑ים הֵקִ֣ימוּ בחיני/ו בַחוּנָ֗י/ו עֹרְרוּ֙ אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֔י/הָ שָׂמָ֖/הּ לְ/מַפֵּלָֽה
verses.translit: hn 'rts khshdym zh h'm l' hyh 'shvr ysdh ltsyym hqymv bchynyv bchvnyv 'rrv 'rmnvtyh shmh lmplh
verses.translation: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, till the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; and he brought it to ruin.

verses.original: הֵילִ֖ילוּ אֳנִיּ֣וֹת תַּרְשִׁ֑ישׁ כִּ֥י שֻׁדַּ֖ד מָעֻזְּ/כֶֽן
verses.translit: hylylv 'nyvt trshysh khy shdd m'zkhn
verses.translation: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא וְ/נִשְׁכַּ֤חַת צֹר֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה כִּ/ימֵ֖י מֶ֣לֶךְ אֶחָ֑ד מִ/קֵּ֞ץ שִׁבְעִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לְ/צֹ֔ר כְּ/שִׁירַ֖ת הַ/זּוֹנָֽה
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' vnshkhcht tsr shb'ym shnh khymy mlkh 'chd mqts shb'ym shnh yhyh ltsr khshyrt hzvnh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.

verses.original: קְחִ֥י כִנּ֛וֹר סֹ֥בִּי עִ֖יר זוֹנָ֣ה נִשְׁכָּחָ֑ה הֵיטִ֤יבִי נַגֵּן֙ הַרְבִּי שִׁ֔יר לְמַ֖עַן תִּזָּכֵֽרִי
verses.translit: qchy khnvr sby 'yr zvnh nshkhchh hytyby ngn hrby shyr lm'n tzkhry
verses.translation: Take an harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֞ה מִ/קֵּ֣ץ שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה יִפְקֹ֤ד יְהוָה֙ אֶת צֹ֔ר וְ/שָׁבָ֖ה לְ/אֶתְנַנָּ֑/ה וְ/זָֽנְתָ֛ה אֶת כָּל מַמְלְכ֥וֹת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: vhyh mqts shb'ym shnh ypqd yhvh 't tsr vshbh l'tnnh vznth 't khl mmlkhvt h'rts 'l pny h'dmh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the LORD will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֨ה סַחְרָ֜/הּ וְ/אֶתְנַנָּ֗/הּ קֹ֚דֶשׁ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה לֹ֥א יֵֽאָצֵ֖ר וְ/לֹ֣א יֵֽחָסֵ֑ן כִּ֣י לַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֞ים לִ/פְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ יִֽהְיֶ֣ה סַחְרָ֔/הּ לֶ/אֱכֹ֥ל לְ/שָׂבְעָ֖ה וְ/לִ/מְכַסֶּ֥ה עָתִֽיק
verses.translit: vhyh schrh v'tnnh qdsh lyhvh l' y'tsr vl' ychsn khy lyshbym lpny yhvh yhyh schrh l'khl lshb'h vlmkhsh 'tyq
verses.translation: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the LORD : it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the LORD , to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בּוֹקֵ֥ק הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וּ/בֽוֹלְקָ֑/הּ וְ/עִוָּ֣ה פָנֶ֔י/הָ וְ/הֵפִ֖יץ יֹשְׁבֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: hnh yhvh bvqq h'rts vbvlqh v'vh pnyh vhpyts yshbyh
verses.translation: Behold, the LORD maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.

verses.translit: vhyh kh'm khkhhn kh'bd kh'dnyv khshpchh khgbrth khqvnh khmvkhr khmlvh khlvh khnshh kh'shr nsh' bv
verses.translation: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.

verses.original: הִבּ֧וֹק תִּבּ֛וֹק הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וְ/הִבּ֣וֹז תִּבּ֑וֹז כִּ֣י יְהוָ֔ה דִּבֶּ֖ר אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: hbvq tbvq h'rts vhbvz tbvz khy yhvh dbr 't hdbr hzh
verses.translation: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the LORD hath spoken this word.

verses.original: אָבְלָ֤ה נָֽבְלָה֙ הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֻמְלְלָ֥ה נָבְלָ֖ה תֵּבֵ֑ל אֻמְלָ֖לוּ מְר֥וֹם עַם הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: 'blh nblh h'rts 'mllh nblh tbl 'mllv mrvm 'm h'rts
verses.translation: The earth mourneth and fadeth away, the world languisheth and fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אָ֥רֶץ חָנְפָ֖ה תַּ֣חַת יֹשְׁבֶ֑י/הָ כִּֽי עָבְר֤וּ תוֹרֹת֙ חָ֣לְפוּ חֹ֔ק הֵפֵ֖רוּ בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vh'rts chnph tcht yshbyh khy 'brv tvrt chlpv chq hprv bryt 'vlm
verses.translation: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֗ן אָלָה֙ אָ֣כְלָה אֶ֔רֶץ וַֽ/יֶּאְשְׁמ֖וּ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָ֑/הּ עַל כֵּ֗ן חָרוּ֙ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי אֶ֔רֶץ וְ/נִשְׁאַ֥ר אֱנ֖וֹשׁ מִזְעָֽר
verses.translit: 'l khn 'lh 'khlh 'rts vy'shmv yshby bh 'l khn chrv yshby 'rts vnsh'r 'nvsh mz'r
verses.translation: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.

verses.original: אָבַ֥ל תִּיר֖וֹשׁ אֻמְלְלָה גָ֑פֶן נֶאֶנְח֖וּ כָּל שִׂמְחֵי לֵֽב
verses.translit: 'bl tyrvsh 'mllh gpn n'nchv khl shmchy lb
verses.translation: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.

verses.original: שָׁבַת֙ מְשׂ֣וֹשׂ תֻּפִּ֔ים חָדַ֖ל שְׁא֣וֹן עַלִּיזִ֑ים שָׁבַ֖ת מְשׂ֥וֹשׂ כִּנּֽוֹר
verses.translit: shbt mshvsh tpym chdl sh'vn 'lyzym shbt mshvsh khnvr
verses.translation: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.

verses.original: בַּ/שִּׁ֖יר לֹ֣א יִשְׁתּוּ יָ֑יִן יֵמַ֥ר שֵׁכָ֖ר לְ/שֹׁתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: bshyr l' yshtv yyn ymr shkhr lshtyv
verses.translation: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.

verses.original: נִשְׁבְּרָ֖ה קִרְיַת תֹּ֑הוּ סֻגַּ֥ר כָּל בַּ֖יִת מִ/בּֽוֹא
verses.translit: nshbrh qryt thv sgr khl byt mbv'
verses.translation: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

verses.original: צְוָחָ֥ה עַל הַ/יַּ֖יִן בַּֽ/חוּצ֑וֹת עָֽרְבָה֙ כָּל שִׂמְחָ֔ה גָּלָ֖ה מְשׂ֥וֹשׂ הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: tsvchh 'l hyyn bchvtsvt 'rbh khl shmchh glh mshvsh h'rts
verses.translation: There is a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.

verses.original: נִשְׁאַ֥ר בָּ/עִ֖יר שַׁמָּ֑ה וּ/שְׁאִיָּ֖ה יֻכַּת שָֽׁעַר
verses.translit: nsh'r b'yr shmh vsh'yh ykht sh'r
verses.translation: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה יִהְיֶ֛ה בְּ/קֶ֥רֶב הָ/אָ֖רֶץ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הָֽ/עַמִּ֑ים כְּ/נֹ֣קֶף זַ֔יִת כְּ/עוֹלֵלֹ֖ת אִם כָּלָ֥ה בָצִֽיר
verses.translit: khy khh yhyh bqrb h'rts btvkh h'mym khnqf zyt kh'vllt 'm khlh btsyr
verses.translation: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree, and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.

verses.original: הֵ֛מָּה יִשְׂא֥וּ קוֹלָ֖/ם יָרֹ֑נּוּ בִּ/גְא֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה צָהֲל֖וּ מִ/יָּֽם
verses.translit: hmh ysh'v qvlm yrnv bg'vn yhvh tshlv mym
verses.translation: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the LORD , they shall cry aloud from the sea.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֥ן בָּ/אֻרִ֖ים כַּבְּד֣וּ יְהוָ֑ה בְּ/אִיֵּ֣י הַ/יָּ֔ם שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 'l khn b'rym khbdv yhvh b'yy hym shm yhvh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Wherefore glorify ye the LORD in the fires, even the name of the LORD God of Israel in the isles of the sea.

verses.original: מִ/כְּנַ֨ף הָ/אָ֜רֶץ זְמִרֹ֤ת שָׁמַ֨עְנוּ֙ צְבִ֣י לַ/צַּדִּ֔יק וָ/אֹמַ֛ר רָזִי לִ֥/י רָֽזִי לִ֖/י א֣וֹי לִ֑/י בֹּגְדִ֣ים בָּגָ֔דוּ וּ/בֶ֥גֶד בּוֹגְדִ֖ים בָּגָֽדוּ
verses.translit: mkhnf h'rts zmrt shm'nv tsby ltsdyq v'mr rzy ly rzy ly 'vy ly bgdym bgdv vbgd bvgdym bgdv
verses.translation: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, even glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.

verses.original: פַּ֥חַד וָ/פַ֖חַת וָ/פָ֑ח עָלֶ֖י/ךָ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: pchd vpcht vpch 'lykh yvshb h'rts
verses.translation: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.

verses.original: וְֽ֠/הָיָה הַ/נָּ֞ס מִ/קּ֤וֹל הַ/פַּ֨חַד֙ יִפֹּ֣ל אֶל הַ/פַּ֔חַת וְ/הָֽ/עוֹלֶה֙ מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ הַ/פַּ֔חַת יִלָּכֵ֖ד בַּ/פָּ֑ח כִּֽי אֲרֻבּ֤וֹת מִ/מָּרוֹם֙ נִפְתָּ֔חוּ וַֽ/יִּרְעֲשׁ֖וּ מ֥וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vhyh hns mqvl hpchd ypl 'l hpcht vh'vlh mtvkh hpcht ylkhd bpch khy 'rbvt mmrvm nptchv vyr'shv mvsdy 'rts
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.

verses.original: רֹ֥עָה הִֽתְרֹעֲעָ֖ה הָ/אָ֑רֶץ פּ֤וֹר הִֽתְפּוֹרְרָה֙ אֶ֔רֶץ מ֥וֹט הִֽתְמוֹטְטָ֖ה אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: r'h htr''h h'rts pvr htpvrrh 'rts mvt htmvtth 'rts
verses.translation: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.

verses.original: נ֣וֹעַ תָּנ֤וּעַ אֶ֨רֶץ֙ כַּ/שִּׁכּ֔וֹר וְ/הִֽתְנוֹדְדָ֖ה כַּ/מְּלוּנָ֑ה וְ/כָבַ֤ד עָלֶ֨י/הָ֙ פִּשְׁעָ֔/הּ וְ/נָפְלָ֖ה וְ/לֹא תֹסִ֥יף קֽוּם
verses.translit: nv' tnv' 'rts khshkhvr vhtnvddh khmlvnh vkhbd 'lyh psh'h vnplh vl' tsyf qvm
verses.translation: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא יִפְקֹ֧ד יְהוָ֛ה עַל צְבָ֥א הַ/מָּר֖וֹם בַּ/מָּר֑וֹם וְ/עַל מַלְכֵ֥י הָ/אֲדָמָ֖ה עַל הָ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' ypqd yhvh 'l tsb' hmrvm bmrvm v'l mlkhy h'dmh 'l h'dmh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.

verses.original: וְ/אֻסְּפ֨וּ אֲסֵפָ֤ה אַסִּיר֙ עַל בּ֔וֹר וְ/סֻגְּר֖וּ עַל מַסְגֵּ֑ר וּ/מֵ/רֹ֥ב יָמִ֖ים יִפָּקֵֽדוּ
verses.translit: v'spv 'sph 'syr 'l bvr vsgrv 'l msgr vmrb ymym ypqdv
verses.translation: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.

verses.original: וְ/חָֽפְרָה֙ הַ/לְּבָנָ֔ה וּ/בוֹשָׁ֖ה הַֽ/חַמָּ֑ה כִּֽי מָלַ֞ךְ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת בְּ/הַ֤ר צִיּוֹן֙ וּ/בִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ/נֶ֥גֶד זְקֵנָ֖י/ו כָּבֽוֹד
verses.translit: vchprh hlbnh vbvshh hchmh khy mlkh yhvh tsb'vt bhr tsyvn vbyrvshlm vngd zqnyv khbvd
verses.translation: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the LORD of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהַ/י֙ אַתָּ֔ה אֲרֽוֹמִמְ/ךָ֙ אוֹדֶ֣ה שִׁמְ/ךָ֔ כִּ֥י עָשִׂ֖יתָ פֶּ֑לֶא עֵצ֥וֹת מֵֽ/רָח֖וֹק אֱמ֥וּנָה אֹֽמֶן
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhy 'th 'rvmmkh 'vdh shmkh khy 'shyt pl' 'tsvt mrchvq 'mvnh 'mn
verses.translation: O LORD , thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.

verses.original: כִּ֣י שַׂ֤מְתָּ מֵ/עִיר֙ לַ/גָּ֔ל קִרְיָ֥ה בְצוּרָ֖ה לְ/מַפֵּלָ֑ה אַרְמ֤וֹן זָרִים֙ מֵ/עִ֔יר לְ/עוֹלָ֖ם לֹ֥א יִבָּנֶֽה
verses.translit: khy shmt m'yr lgl qryh btsvrh lmplh 'rmvn zrym m'yr l'vlm l' ybnh
verses.translation: For thou hast made of a city an heap; of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֖ן יְכַבְּד֣וּ/ךָ עַם עָ֑ז קִרְיַ֛ת גּוֹיִ֥ם עָרִיצִ֖ים יִירָאֽוּ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'l khn ykhbdvkh 'm 'z qryt gvym 'rytsym yyr'vkh
verses.translation: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee, the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee.

verses.original: כִּֽי הָיִ֨יתָ מָע֥וֹז לַ/דָּ֛ל מָע֥וֹז לָ/אֶבְי֖וֹן בַּ/צַּר ל֑/וֹ מַחְסֶ֤ה מִ/זֶּ֨רֶם֙ צֵ֣ל מֵ/חֹ֔רֶב כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ עָרִיצִ֖ים כְּ/זֶ֥רֶם קִֽיר
verses.translit: khy hyyt m'vz ldl m'vz l'byvn btsr lv mchsh mzrm tsl mchrb khy rvch 'rytsym khzrm qyr
verses.translation: For thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.

verses.original: כְּ/חֹ֣רֶב בְּ/צָי֔וֹן שְׁא֥וֹן זָרִ֖ים תַּכְנִ֑יעַ חֹ֚רֶב בְּ/צֵ֣ל עָ֔ב זְמִ֥יר עָֽרִיצִ֖ים יַעֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: khchrb btsyvn sh'vn zrym tkhny' chrb btsl 'b zmyr 'rytsym y'nh
verses.translation: Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place; even the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.

verses.original: וְ/עָשָׂה֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת לְ/כָל הָֽ/עַמִּים֙ בָּ/הָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה מִשְׁתֵּ֥ה שְׁמָנִ֖ים מִשְׁתֵּ֣ה שְׁמָרִ֑ים שְׁמָנִים֙ מְמֻ֣חָיִ֔ם שְׁמָרִ֖ים מְזֻקָּקִֽים
verses.translit: v'shh yhvh tsb'vt lkhl h'mym bhr hzh mshth shmnym mshth shmrym shmnym mmchym shmrym mzqqym
verses.translation: And in this mountain shall the LORD of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.

verses.original: וּ/בִלַּע֙ בָּ/הָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה פְּנֵֽי הַ/לּ֥וֹט הַ/לּ֖וֹט עַל כָּל הָֽ/עַמִּ֑ים וְ/הַ/מַּסֵּכָ֥ה הַ/נְּסוּכָ֖ה עַל כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: vbl' bhr hzh pny hlvt hlvt 'l khl h'mym vhmskhh hnsvkhh 'l khl hgvym
verses.translation: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations.

verses.original: בִּלַּ֤ע הַ/מָּ֨וֶת֙ לָ/נֶ֔צַח וּ/מָחָ֨ה אֲדֹנָ֧/י יְהוִ֛ה דִּמְעָ֖ה מֵ/עַ֣ל כָּל פָּנִ֑ים וְ/חֶרְפַּ֣ת עַמּ֗/וֹ יָסִיר֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל כָּל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר
verses.translit: bl' hmvt lntsch vmchh 'dny yhvh dm'h m'l khl pnym vchrpt 'mv ysyr m'l khl h'rts khy yhvh dbr
verses.translation: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the LORD hath spoken it .

verses.original: וְ/אָמַר֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא הִנֵּ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י/נוּ זֶ֛ה קִוִּ֥ינוּ ל֖/וֹ וְ/יֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֑/נוּ זֶ֤ה יְהוָה֙ קִוִּ֣ינוּ ל֔/וֹ נָגִ֥ילָה וְ/נִשְׂמְחָ֖ה בִּ/ישׁוּעָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'mr byvm hhv' hnh 'lhynv zh qvynv lv vyvshy'nv zh yhvh qvynv lv ngylh vnshmchh byshv'tv
verses.translation: And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this is the LORD ; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.

verses.original: כִּֽי תָנ֥וּחַ יַד יְהוָ֖ה בָּ/הָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/נָ֤דוֹשׁ מוֹאָב֙ תַּחְתָּ֔י/ו כְּ/הִדּ֥וּשׁ מַתְבֵּ֖ן ב/מי בְּמ֥וֹ מַדְמֵנָֽה
verses.translit: khy tnvch yd yhvh bhr hzh vndvsh mv'b tchtyv khhdvsh mtbn bmy bmv mdmnh
verses.translation: For in this mountain shall the hand of the LORD rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him, even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill.

verses.original: וּ/פֵרַ֤שׂ יָדָי/ו֙ בְּ/קִרְבּ֔/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר יְפָרֵ֥שׂ הַ/שֹּׂחֶ֖ה לִ/שְׂח֑וֹת וְ/הִשְׁפִּיל֙ גַּֽאֲוָת֔/וֹ עִ֖ם אָרְבּ֥וֹת יָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vprsh ydyv bqrbv kh'shr yprsh hshchh lshchvt vhshpyl g'vtv 'm 'rbvt ydyv
verses.translation: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them, as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth his hands to swim: and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands.

verses.original: וּ/מִבְצַ֞ר מִשְׂגַּ֣ב חוֹמֹתֶ֗י/ךָ הֵשַׁ֥ח הִשְׁפִּ֛יל הִגִּ֥יעַ לָ/אָ֖רֶץ עַד עָפָֽר
verses.translit: vmbtsr mshgb chvmtykh hshch hshpyl hgy' l'rts 'd 'pr
verses.translation: And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down, lay low, and bring to the ground, even to the dust.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא יוּשַׁ֥ר הַ/שִּׁיר הַ/זֶּ֖ה בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֑ה עִ֣יר עָז לָ֔/נוּ יְשׁוּעָ֥ה יָשִׁ֖ית חוֹמ֥וֹת וָ/חֵֽל
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yvshr hshyr hzh b'rts yhvdh 'yr 'z lnv yshv'h yshyt chvmvt vchl
verses.translation: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks.

verses.original: פִּתְח֖וּ שְׁעָרִ֑ים וְ/יָבֹ֥א גוֹי צַדִּ֖יק שֹׁמֵ֥ר אֱמֻנִֽים
verses.translit: ptchv sh'rym vyb' gvy tsdyq shmr 'mnym
verses.translation: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.

verses.original: יֵ֣צֶר סָמ֔וּךְ תִּצֹּ֖ר שָׁל֣וֹם שָׁל֑וֹם כִּ֥י בְ/ךָ֖ בָּטֽוּחַ
verses.translit: ytsr smvkh ttsr shlvm shlvm khy bkh btvch
verses.translation: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

verses.original: בִּטְח֥וּ בַֽ/יהוָ֖ה עֲדֵי עַ֑ד כִּ֚י בְּ/יָ֣הּ יְהוָ֔ה צ֖וּר עוֹלָמִֽים
verses.translit: btchv byhvh 'dy 'd khy byh yhvh tsvr 'vlmym
verses.translation: Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH is everlasting strength:

verses.original: כִּ֤י הֵשַׁח֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י מָר֔וֹם קִרְיָ֖ה נִשְׂגָּבָ֑ה יַשְׁפִּילֶ֤/נָּה יַשְׁפִּילָ/הּ֙ עַד אֶ֔רֶץ יַגִּיעֶ֖/נָּה עַד עָפָֽר
verses.translit: khy hshch yshby mrvm qryh nshgbh yshpylnh yshpylh 'd 'rts ygy'nh 'd 'pr
verses.translation: For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low; he layeth it low, even to the ground; he bringeth it even to the dust.

verses.original: תִּרְמְסֶ֖/נָּה רָ֑גֶל רַגְלֵ֥י עָנִ֖י פַּעֲמֵ֥י דַלִּֽים
verses.translit: trmsnh rgl rgly 'ny p'my dlym
verses.translation: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.

verses.original: אֹ֥רַח לַ/צַּדִּ֖יק מֵֽישָׁרִ֑ים יָשָׁ֕ר מַעְגַּ֥ל צַדִּ֖יק תְּפַלֵּֽס
verses.translit: 'rch ltsdyq myshrym yshr m'gl tsdyq tpls
verses.translation: The way of the just is uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.

verses.original: אַ֣ף אֹ֧רַח מִשְׁפָּטֶ֛י/ךָ יְהוָ֖ה קִוִּינ֑וּ/ךָ לְ/שִׁמְ/ךָ֥ וּֽ/לְ/זִכְרְ/ךָ֖ תַּאֲוַת נָֽפֶשׁ
verses.translit: 'f 'rch mshptykh yhvh qvynvkh lshmkh vlzkhrkh t'vt npsh
verses.translation: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O LORD , have we waited for thee; the desire of our soul is to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.

verses.original: נַפְשִׁ֤/י אִוִּיתִ֨י/ךָ֙ בַּ/לַּ֔יְלָה אַף רוּחִ֥/י בְ/קִרְבִּ֖/י אֲשַֽׁחֲרֶ֑/ךָּ כִּ֞י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִשְׁפָּטֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לָ/אָ֔רֶץ צֶ֥דֶק לָמְד֖וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵֽל
verses.translit: npshy 'vytykh blylh 'f rvchy bqrby 'shchrkh khy kh'shr mshptykh l'rts tsdq lmdv yshby tbl
verses.translation: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.

verses.original: יֻחַ֤ן רָשָׁע֙ בַּל לָמַ֣ד צֶ֔דֶק בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ נְכֹח֖וֹת יְעַוֵּ֑ל וּ/בַל יִרְאֶ֖ה גֵּא֥וּת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: ychn rsh' bl lmd tsdq b'rts nkhchvt y'vl vbl yr'h g'vt yhvh
verses.translation: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the LORD .

verses.original: יְהוָ֛ה רָ֥מָה יָדְ/ךָ֖ בַּל יֶחֱזָי֑וּ/ן יֶחֱז֤וּ וְ/יֵבֹ֨שׁוּ֙ קִנְאַת עָ֔ם אַף אֵ֖שׁ צָרֶ֥י/ךָ תֹאכְלֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: yhvh rmh ydkh bl ychzyvn ychzv vybshv qn't 'm 'f 'sh tsrykh t'khlm
verses.translation: LORD , when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.

verses.original: יְהוָ֕ה תִּשְׁפֹּ֥ת שָׁל֖וֹם לָ֑/נוּ כִּ֛י גַּ֥ם כָּֽל מַעֲשֵׂ֖י/נוּ פָּעַ֥לְתָּ לָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: yhvh tshpt shlvm lnv khy gm khl m'shynv p'lt lnv
verses.translation: LORD , thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ בְּעָל֥וּ/נוּ אֲדֹנִ֖ים זֽוּלָתֶ֑/ךָ לְ/בַד בְּ/ךָ֖ נַזְכִּ֥יר שְׁמֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhynv b'lvnv 'dnym zvltkh lbd bkh nzkhyr shmkh
verses.translation: O LORD our God, other lords beside thee have had dominion over us: but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.

verses.original: מֵתִים֙ בַּל יִחְי֔וּ רְפָאִ֖ים בַּל יָקֻ֑מוּ לָ/כֵ֤ן פָּקַ֨דְתָּ֙ וַ/תַּשְׁמִידֵ֔/ם וַ/תְּאַבֵּ֥ד כָּל זֵ֖כֶר לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: mtym bl ychyv rp'ym bl yqmv lkhn pqdt vtshmydm vt'bd khl zkhr lmv
verses.translation: They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.

verses.original: יָסַ֤פְתָּ לַ/גּוֹי֙ יְהוָ֔ה יָסַ֥פְתָּ לַ/גּ֖וֹי נִכְבָּ֑דְתָּ רִחַ֖קְתָּ כָּל קַצְוֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: yspt lgvy yhvh yspt lgvy nkhbdt rchqt khl qtsvy 'rts
verses.translation: Thou hast increased the nation, O LORD , thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth.

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה בַּ/צַּ֣ר פְּקָד֑וּ/ךָ צָק֣וּ/ן לַ֔חַשׁ מוּסָרְ/ךָ֖ לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: yhvh btsr pqdvkh tsqvn lchsh mvsrkh lmv
verses.translation: LORD , in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them.

verses.original: כְּמ֤וֹ הָרָה֙ תַּקְרִ֣יב לָ/לֶ֔דֶת תָּחִ֥יל תִּזְעַ֖ק בַּ/חֲבָלֶ֑י/הָ כֵּ֛ן הָיִ֥ינוּ מִ/פָּנֶ֖י/ךָ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khmv hrh tqryb lldt tchyl tz'q bchblyh khn hyynv mpnykh yhvh
verses.translation: Like as a woman with child, that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, and crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O LORD .

verses.original: הָרִ֣ינוּ חַ֔לְנוּ כְּמ֖וֹ יָלַ֣דְנוּ ר֑וּחַ יְשׁוּעֹת֙ בַּל נַ֣עֲשֶׂה אֶ֔רֶץ וּ/בַֽל יִפְּל֖וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵֽל
verses.translit: hrynv chlnv khmv yldnv rvch yshv't bl n'shh 'rts vbl yplv yshby tbl
verses.translation: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

verses.original: יִֽחְי֣וּ מֵתֶ֔י/ךָ נְבֵלָתִ֖/י יְקוּמ֑וּ/ן הָקִ֨יצוּ וְ/רַנְּנ֜וּ שֹׁכְנֵ֣י עָפָ֗ר כִּ֣י טַ֤ל אוֹרֹת֙ טַלֶּ֔/ךָ וָ/אָ֖רֶץ רְפָאִ֥ים תַּפִּֽיל
verses.translit: ychyv mtykh nblty yqvmvn hqytsv vrnnv shkhny 'pr khy tl 'vrt tlkh v'rts rp'ym tpyl
verses.translation: Thy dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.

verses.original: לֵ֤ךְ עַמִּ/י֙ בֹּ֣א בַ/חֲדָרֶ֔י/ךָ וּֽ/סְגֹ֥ר דלתי/ך דְּלָתְ/ךָ֖ בַּעֲדֶ֑/ךָ חֲבִ֥י כִ/מְעַט רֶ֖גַע עַד יעבור יַעֲבָר זָֽעַם
verses.translit: lkh 'my b' bchdrykh vsgr dltykh dltkh b'dkh chby khm't rg' 'd y'bvr y'br z'm
verses.translation: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.

verses.original: כִּֽי הִנֵּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ יֹצֵ֣א מִ/מְּקוֹמ֔/וֹ לִ/פְקֹ֛ד עֲוֺ֥ן יֹֽשֵׁב הָ/אָ֖רֶץ עָלָ֑י/ו וְ/גִלְּתָ֤ה הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ אֶת דָּמֶ֔י/הָ וְ/לֹֽא תְכַסֶּ֥ה ע֖וֹד עַל הֲרוּגֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: khy hnh yhvh yts' mmqvmv lpqd 'vn yshb h'rts 'lyv vglth h'rts 't dmyh vl' tkhsh 'vd 'l hrvgyh
verses.translation: For, behold, the LORD cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֡וּא יִפְקֹ֣ד יְהוָה֩ בְּ/חַרְב֨/וֹ הַ/קָּשָׁ֜ה וְ/הַ/גְּדוֹלָ֣ה וְ/הַֽ/חֲזָקָ֗ה עַ֤ל לִוְיָתָן֙ נָחָ֣שׁ בָּרִ֔חַ וְ/עַל֙ לִוְיָתָ֔ן נָחָ֖שׁ עֲקַלָּת֑וֹן וְ/הָרַ֥ג אֶת הַ/תַּנִּ֖ין אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּ/יָּֽם
verses.translit: byvm hhv' ypqd yhvh bchrbv hqshh vhgdvlh vhchzqh 'l lvytn nchsh brch v'l lvytn nchsh 'qltvn vhrg 't htnyn 'shr bym
verses.translation: In that day the LORD with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֖וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא כֶּ֥רֶם חֶ֖מֶד עַנּוּ לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: byvm hhv' khrm chmd 'nv lh
verses.translation: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.

verses.original: אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ נֹֽצְרָ֔/הּ לִ/רְגָעִ֖ים אַשְׁקֶ֑/נָּה פֶּ֚ן יִפְקֹ֣ד עָלֶ֔י/הָ לַ֥יְלָה וָ/י֖וֹם אֶצֳּרֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: 'ny yhvh ntsrh lrg'ym 'shqnh pn ypqd 'lyh lylh vyvm 'tsrnh
verses.translation: I the LORD do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.

verses.original: חֵמָ֖ה אֵ֣ין לִ֑/י מִֽי יִתְּנֵ֜/נִי שָׁמִ֥יר שַׁ֨יִת֙ בַּ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה אֶפְשְׂעָ֥ה בָ֖/הּ אֲצִיתֶ֥/נָּה יָּֽחַד
verses.translit: chmh 'yn ly my ytnny shmyr shyt bmlchmh 'psh'h bh 'tsytnh ychd
verses.translation: Fury is not in me: who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.

verses.original: א֚וֹ יַחֲזֵ֣ק בְּ/מָעוּזִּ֔/י יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה שָׁל֖וֹם לִ֑/י שָׁל֖וֹם יַֽעֲשֶׂה לִּֽ/י
verses.translit: 'v ychzq bm'vzy y'shh shlvm ly shlvm y'shh ly
verses.translation: Or let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me; and he shall make peace with me.

verses.original: הַ/בָּאִים֙ יַשְׁרֵ֣שׁ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב יָצִ֥יץ וּ/פָרַ֖ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ/מָלְא֥וּ פְנֵי תֵבֵ֖ל תְּנוּבָֽה
verses.translit: hb'ym yshrsh y'qb ytsyts vprch yshr'l vml'v pny tbl tnvbh
verses.translation: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.

verses.original: הַ/כְּ/מַכַּ֥ת מַכֵּ֖/הוּ הִכָּ֑/הוּ אִם כְּ/הֶ֥רֶג הֲרֻגָ֖י/ו הֹרָֽג
verses.translit: hkhmkht mkhhv hkhhv 'm khhrg hrgyv hrg
verses.translation: Hath he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him? or is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him?

verses.original: בְּ/סַּאסְּאָ֖ה בְּ/שַׁלְחָ֣/הּ תְּרִיבֶ֑/נָּה הָגָ֛ה בְּ/רוּח֥/וֹ הַ/קָּשָׁ֖ה בְּ/י֥וֹם קָדִֽים
verses.translit: bs's'h bshlchh trybnh hgh brvchv hqshh byvm qdym
verses.translation: In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן בְּ/זֹאת֙ יְכֻפַּ֣ר עֲוֺֽן יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/זֶ֕ה כָּל פְּרִ֖י הָסִ֣ר חַטָּאת֑/וֹ בְּ/שׂוּמ֣/וֹ כָּל אַבְנֵ֣י מִזְבֵּ֗חַ כְּ/אַבְנֵי גִר֙ מְנֻפָּצ֔וֹת לֹֽא יָקֻ֥מוּ אֲשֵׁרִ֖ים וְ/חַמָּנִֽים
verses.translit: lkhn bz't ykhpr 'vn y'qb vzh khl pry hsr cht'tv bshvmv khl 'bny mzbch kh'bny gr mnptsvt l' yqmv 'shrym vchmnym
verses.translation: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this is all the fruit to take away his sin; when he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, the groves and images shall not stand up.

verses.original: כִּ֣י עִ֤יר בְּצוּרָה֙ בָּדָ֔ד נָוֶ֕ה מְשֻׁלָּ֥ח וְ/נֶעֱזָ֖ב כַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר שָׁ֣ם יִרְעֶ֥ה עֵ֛גֶל וְ/שָׁ֥ם יִרְבָּ֖ץ וְ/כִלָּ֥ה סְעִפֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: khy 'yr btsvrh bdd nvh mshlch vn'zb khmdbr shm yr'h 'gl vshm yrbts vkhlh s'pyh
verses.translation: Yet the defenced city shall be desolate, and the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.

verses.original: בִּ/יבֹ֤שׁ קְצִירָ/הּ֙ תִּשָּׁבַ֔רְנָה נָשִׁ֕ים בָּא֖וֹת מְאִיר֣וֹת אוֹתָ֑/הּ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א עַם בִּינוֹת֙ ה֔וּא עַל כֵּן֙ לֹֽא יְרַחֲמֶ֣/נּוּ עֹשֵׂ֔/הוּ וְ/יֹצְר֖/וֹ לֹ֥א יְחֻנֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: bybsh qtsyrh tshbrnh nshym b'vt m'yrvt 'vth khy l' 'm bynvt hv' 'l khn l' yrchmnv 'shhv vytsrv l' ychnnv
verses.translation: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come, and set them on fire: for it is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will shew them no favour.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא יַחְבֹּ֧ט יְהוָ֛ה מִ/שִּׁבֹּ֥לֶת הַ/נָּהָ֖ר עַד נַ֣חַל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/אַתֶּ֧ם תְּלֻקְּט֛וּ לְ/אַחַ֥ד אֶחָ֖ד בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' ychbt yhvh mshblt hnhr 'd nchl mtsrym v'tm tlqtv l'chd 'chd bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt, and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא יִתָּקַע֮ בְּ/שׁוֹפָ֣ר גָּדוֹל֒ וּ/בָ֗אוּ הָ/אֹֽבְדִים֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ אַשּׁ֔וּר וְ/הַ/נִּדָּחִ֖ים בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/הִשְׁתַּחֲו֧וּ לַ/יהוָ֛ה בְּ/הַ֥ר הַ/קֹּ֖דֶשׁ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' ytq' bshvpr gdvl vb'v h'bdym b'rts 'shvr vhndchym b'rts mtsrym vhshtchvv lyhvh bhr hqdsh byrvshlm
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the great trumpet shall be blown, and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and shall worship the LORD in the holy mount at Jerusalem.

verses.original: ה֗וֹי עֲטֶ֤רֶת גֵּאוּת֙ שִׁכֹּרֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְ/צִ֥יץ נֹבֵ֖ל צְבִ֣י תִפְאַרְתּ֑/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֛ר עַל רֹ֥אשׁ גֵּֽיא שְׁמָנִ֖ים הֲל֥וּמֵי יָֽיִן
verses.translit: hvy 'trt g'vt shkhry 'prym vtsyts nbl tsby tp'rtv 'shr 'l r'sh gy' shmnym hlvmy yyn
verses.translation: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty is a fading flower, which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine!

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה חָזָ֤ק וְ/אַמִּץ֙ לַֽ/אדֹנָ֔/י כְּ/זֶ֥רֶם בָּרָ֖ד שַׂ֣עַר קָ֑טֶב כְּ֠/זֶרֶם מַ֣יִם כַּבִּירִ֥ים שֹׁטְפִ֛ים הִנִּ֥יחַ לָ/אָ֖רֶץ בְּ/יָֽד
verses.translit: hnh chzq v'mts l'dny khzrm brd sh'r qtb khzrm mym khbyrym shtpym hnych l'rts byd
verses.translation: Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one, which as a tempest of hail and a destroying storm, as a flood of mighty waters overflowing, shall cast down to the earth with the hand.

verses.original: בְּ/רַגְלַ֖יִם תֵּֽרָמַ֑סְנָה עֲטֶ֥רֶת גֵּא֖וּת שִׁכּוֹרֵ֥י אֶפְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: brglym trmsnh 'trt g'vt shkhvry 'prym
verses.translation: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trodden under feet:

verses.original: וְֽ/הָ֨יְתָ֜ה צִיצַ֤ת נֹבֵל֙ צְבִ֣י תִפְאַרְתּ֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל רֹ֖אשׁ גֵּ֣יא שְׁמָנִ֑ים כְּ/בִכּוּרָהּ֙ בְּ/טֶ֣רֶם קַ֔יִץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִרְאֶ֤ה הָֽ/רֹאֶה֙ אוֹתָ֔/הּ בְּ/עוֹדָ֥/הּ בְּ/כַפּ֖/וֹ יִבְלָעֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: vhyth tsytst nbl tsby tp'rtv 'shr 'l r'sh gy' shmnym khbkhvrh btrm qyts 'shr yr'h hr'h 'vth b'vdh bkhpv ybl'nh
verses.translation: And the glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower, and as the hasty fruit before the summer; which when he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת לַ/עֲטֶ֣רֶת צְבִ֔י וְ/לִ/צְפִירַ֖ת תִּפְאָרָ֑ה לִ/שְׁאָ֖ר עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yhyh yhvh tsb'vt l'trt tsby vltspyrt tp'rh lsh'r 'mv
verses.translation: In that day shall the LORD of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people,

verses.original: וּ/לְ/ר֖וּחַ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט לַ/יּוֹשֵׁב֙ עַל הַ/מִּשְׁפָּ֔ט וְ/לִ֨/גְבוּרָ֔ה מְשִׁיבֵ֥י מִלְחָמָ֖ה שָֽׁעְרָ/ה
verses.translit: vlrvch mshpt lyvshb 'l hmshpt vlgbvrh mshyby mlchmh sh'rh
verses.translation: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment, and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate.

verses.original: וְ/גַם אֵ֨לֶּה֙ בַּ/יַּ֣יִן שָׁג֔וּ וּ/בַ/שֵּׁכָ֖ר תָּע֑וּ כֹּהֵ֣ן וְ/נָבִיא֩ שָׁג֨וּ בַ/שֵּׁכָ֜ר נִבְלְע֣וּ מִן הַ/יַּ֗יִן תָּעוּ֙ מִן הַ/שֵּׁכָ֔ר שָׁגוּ֙ בָּֽ/רֹאֶ֔ה פָּק֖וּ פְּלִילִיָּֽה
verses.translit: vgm 'lh byyn shgv vbshkhr t'v khhn vnby' shgv bshkhr nbl'v mn hyyn t'v mn hshkhr shgv br'h pqv plylyh
verses.translation: But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble in judgment.

verses.original: כִּ֚י כָּל שֻׁלְחָנ֔וֹת מָלְא֖וּ קִ֣יא צֹאָ֑ה בְּלִ֖י מָקֽוֹם
verses.translit: khy khl shlchnvt ml'v qy' ts'h bly mqvm
verses.translation: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness, so that there is no place clean .

verses.original: אֶת מִי֙ יוֹרֶ֣ה דֵעָ֔ה וְ/אֶת מִ֖י יָבִ֣ין שְׁמוּעָ֑ה גְּמוּלֵי֙ מֵֽ/חָלָ֔ב עַתִּיקֵ֖י מִ/שָּׁדָֽיִם
verses.translit: 't my yvrh d'h v't my ybyn shmv'h gmvly mchlb 'tyqy mshdym
verses.translation: Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine? them that are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts.

verses.original: כִּ֣י צַ֤ו לָ/צָו֙ צַ֣ו לָ/צָ֔ו קַ֥ו לָ/קָ֖ו קַ֣ו לָ/קָ֑ו זְעֵ֥יר שָׁ֖ם זְעֵ֥יר שָֽׁם
verses.translit: khy tsv ltsv tsv ltsv qv lqv qv lqv z'yr shm z'yr shm
verses.translation: For precept must be upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little:

verses.original: כִּ֚י בְּ/לַעֲגֵ֣י שָׂפָ֔ה וּ/בְ/לָשׁ֖וֹן אַחֶ֑רֶת יְדַבֵּ֖ר אֶל הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: khy bl'gy shph vblshvn 'chrt ydbr 'l h'm hzh
verses.translation: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֣ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם זֹ֤את הַ/מְּנוּחָה֙ הָנִ֣יחוּ לֶֽ/עָיֵ֔ף וְ/זֹ֖את הַ/מַּרְגֵּעָ֑ה וְ/לֹ֥א אָב֖וּא שְׁמֽוֹעַ
verses.translit: 'shr 'mr 'lyhm z't hmnvchh hnychv l'yf vz't hmrg'h vl' 'bv' shmv'
verses.translation: To whom he said, This is the rest wherewith ye may cause the weary to rest; and this is the refreshing: yet they would not hear.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֨ה לָ/הֶ֜ם דְּבַר יְהוָ֗ה צַ֣ו לָ/צָ֞ו צַ֤ו לָ/צָו֙ קַ֤ו לָ/קָו֙ קַ֣ו לָ/קָ֔ו זְעֵ֥יר שָׁ֖ם זְעֵ֣יר שָׁ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן יֵלְכ֜וּ וְ/כָשְׁל֤וּ אָחוֹר֙ וְ/נִשְׁבָּ֔רוּ וְ/נוֹקְשׁ֖וּ וְ/נִלְכָּֽדוּ
verses.translit: vhyh lhm dbr yhvh tsv ltsv tsv ltsv qv lqv qv lqv z'yr shm z'yr shm lm'n ylkhv vkhshlv 'chvr vnshbrv vnvqshv vnlkhdv
verses.translation: But the word of the LORD was unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little; that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֛ן שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אַנְשֵׁ֣י לָצ֑וֹן מֹֽשְׁלֵי֙ הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: lkhn shm'v dbr yhvh 'nshy ltsvn mshly h'm hzh 'shr byrvshlm
verses.translation: Wherefore hear the word of the LORD , ye scornful men, that rule this people which is in Jerusalem.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֲמַרְתֶּ֗ם כָּרַ֤תְנֽוּ בְרִית֙ אֶת מָ֔וֶת וְ/עִם שְׁא֖וֹל עָשִׂ֣ינוּ חֹזֶ֑ה שיט שׁ֣וֹט שׁוֹטֵ֤ף כִּֽי עבר יַֽעֲבֹר֙ לֹ֣א יְבוֹאֵ֔/נוּ כִּ֣י שַׂ֧מְנוּ כָזָ֛ב מַחְסֵ֖/נוּ וּ/בַ/שֶּׁ֥קֶר נִסְתָּֽרְנוּ
verses.translit: khy 'mrtm khrtnv bryt 't mvt v'm sh'vl 'shynv chzh shyt shvt shvtf khy 'br y'br l' ybv'nv khy shmnv khzb mchsnv vbshqr nstrnv
verses.translation: Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves:

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְ/נִ֛י יִסַּ֥ד בְּ/צִיּ֖וֹן אָ֑בֶן אֶ֣בֶן בֹּ֜חַן פִּנַּ֤ת יִקְרַת֙ מוּסָ֣ד מוּסָּ֔ד הַֽ/מַּאֲמִ֖ין לֹ֥א יָחִֽישׁ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny ysd btsyvn 'bn 'bn bchn pnt yqrt mvsd mvsd hm'myn l' ychysh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD , Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone , a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֤י מִשְׁפָּט֙ לְ/קָ֔ו וּ/צְדָקָ֖ה לְ/מִשְׁקָ֑לֶת וְ/יָעָ֤ה בָרָד֙ מַחְסֵ֣ה כָזָ֔ב וְ/סֵ֥תֶר מַ֖יִם יִשְׁטֹֽפוּ
verses.translit: vshmty mshpt lqv vtsdqh lmshqlt vy'h brd mchsh khzb vstr mym yshtpv
verses.translation: Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.

verses.original: וְ/כֻפַּ֤ר בְּרִֽיתְ/כֶם֙ אֶת מָ֔וֶת וְ/חָזוּתְ/כֶ֥ם אֶת שְׁא֖וֹל לֹ֣א תָק֑וּם שׁ֤וֹט שׁוֹטֵף֙ כִּ֣י יַֽעֲבֹ֔ר וִ/הְיִ֥יתֶם ל֖/וֹ לְ/מִרְמָֽס
verses.translit: vkhpr brytkhm 't mvt vchzvtkhm 't sh'vl l' tqvm shvt shvtf khy y'br vhyytm lv lmrms
verses.translation: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it.

verses.original: מִ/דֵּ֤י עָבְר/וֹ֙ יִקַּ֣ח אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם כִּֽי בַ/בֹּ֧קֶר בַּ/בֹּ֛קֶר יַעֲבֹ֖ר בַּ/יּ֣וֹם וּ/בַ/לָּ֑יְלָה וְ/הָיָ֥ה רַק זְוָעָ֖ה הָבִ֥ין שְׁמוּעָֽה
verses.translit: mdy 'brv yqch 'tkhm khy bbqr bbqr y'br byvm vblylh vhyh rq zv'h hbyn shmv'h
