verses.translation: From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you: for morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night: and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report.

verses.translit: khy qtsr hmts' mhshtr' vhmskhh tsrh khhtkhns
verses.translation: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it .

verses.original: כִּ֤י כְ/הַר פְּרָצִים֙ יָק֣וּם יְהוָ֔ה כְּ/עֵ֖מֶק בְּ/גִבְע֣וֹן יִרְגָּ֑ז לַ/עֲשׂ֤וֹת מַעֲשֵׂ֨/הוּ֙ זָ֣ר מַעֲשֵׂ֔/הוּ וְ/לַֽ/עֲבֹד֙ עֲבֹ֣דָת֔/וֹ נָכְרִיָּ֖ה עֲבֹדָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy khhr prtsym yqvm yhvh kh'mq bgb'vn yrgz l'shvt m'shhv zr m'shhv vl'bd 'bdtv nkhryh 'bdtv
verses.translation: For the LORD shall rise up as in mount Perazim, he shall be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon, that he may do his work, his strange work; and bring to pass his act, his strange act.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ אַל תִּתְלוֹצָ֔צוּ פֶּֽן יֶחְזְק֖וּ מֽוֹסְרֵי/כֶ֑ם כִּֽי כָלָ֨ה וְ/נֶחֱרָצָ֜ה שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי מֵ/אֵ֨ת אֲדֹנָ֧/י יְהוִ֛ה צְבָא֖וֹת עַל כָּל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: v'th 'l ttlvtstsv pn ychzqv mvsrykhm khy khlh vnchrtsh shm'ty m't 'dny yhvh tsb'vt 'l khl h'rts
verses.translation: Now therefore be ye not mockers, lest your bands be made strong: for I have heard from the Lord GOD of hosts a consumption, even determined upon the whole earth.

verses.original: הַאֲזִ֥ינוּ וְ/שִׁמְע֖וּ קוֹלִ֑/י הַקְשִׁ֥יבוּ וְ/שִׁמְע֖וּ אִמְרָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: h'zynv vshm'v qvly hqshybv vshm'v 'mrty
verses.translation: Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.

verses.original: הֲ/כֹ֣ל הַ/יּ֔וֹם יַחֲרֹ֥שׁ הַ/חֹרֵ֖שׁ לִ/זְרֹ֑עַ יְפַתַּ֥ח וִֽ/ישַׂדֵּ֖ד אַדְמָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hkhl hyvm ychrsh hchrsh lzr' yptch vyshdd 'dmtv
verses.translation: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow? doth he open and break the clods of his ground?

verses.original: הֲ/לוֹא֙ אִם שִׁוָּ֣ה פָנֶ֔י/הָ וְ/הֵפִ֥יץ קֶ֖צַח וְ/כַמֹּ֣ן יִזְרֹ֑ק וְ/שָׂ֨ם חִטָּ֤ה שׂוֹרָה֙ וּ/שְׂעֹרָ֣ה נִסְמָ֔ן וְ/כֻסֶּ֖מֶת גְּבֻלָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hlv' 'm shvh pnyh vhpyts qtsch vkhmn yzrq vshm chth shvrh vsh'rh nsmn vkhsmt gbltv
verses.translation: When he hath made plain the face thereof, doth he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and the rie in their place?

verses.original: וְ/יִסְּר֥/וֹ לַ/מִּשְׁפָּ֖ט אֱלֹהָ֥י/ו יוֹרֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: vysrv lmshpt 'lhyv yvrnv
verses.translation: For his God doth instruct him to discretion, and doth teach him.

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א בֶֽ/חָרוּץ֙ י֣וּדַשׁ קֶ֔צַח וְ/אוֹפַ֣ן עֲגָלָ֔ה עַל כַּמֹּ֖ן יוּסָּ֑ב כִּ֧י בַ/מַּטֶּ֛ה יֵחָ֥בֶט קֶ֖צַח וְ/כַמֹּ֥ן בַּ/שָּֽׁבֶט
verses.translit: khy l' bchrvts yvdsh qtsch v'vpn 'glh 'l khmn yvsb khy bmth ychbt qtsch vkhmn bshbt
verses.translation: For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.

verses.original: לֶ֣חֶם יוּדָ֔ק כִּ֛י לֹ֥א לָ/נֶ֖צַח אָד֣וֹשׁ יְדוּשֶׁ֑/נּוּ וְ֠/הָמַם גִּלְגַּ֧ל עֶגְלָת֛/וֹ וּ/פָרָשָׁ֖י/ו לֹֽא יְדֻקֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: lchm yvdq khy l' lntsch 'dvsh ydvshnv vhmm glgl 'gltv vprshyv l' ydqnv
verses.translation: Bread corn is bruised; because he will not ever be threshing it, nor break it with the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it with his horsemen.

verses.original: גַּם זֹ֕את מֵ/עִ֛ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת יָצָ֑אָה הִפְלִ֣יא עֵצָ֔ה הִגְדִּ֖יל תּוּשִׁיָּֽה
verses.translit: gm z't m'm yhvh tsb'vt yts'h hply' 'tsh hgdyl tvshyh
verses.translation: This also cometh forth from the LORD of hosts, which is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in working.

verses.original: ה֚וֹי אֲרִיאֵ֣ל אֲרִיאֵ֔ל קִרְיַ֖ת חָנָ֣ה דָוִ֑ד סְפ֥וּ שָׁנָ֛ה עַל שָׁנָ֖ה חַגִּ֥ים יִנְקֹֽפוּ
verses.translit: hvy 'ry'l 'ry'l qryt chnh dvd spv shnh 'l shnh chgym ynqpv
verses.translation: Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city where David dwelt! add ye year to year; let them kill sacrifices.

verses.original: וַ/הֲצִיק֖וֹתִי לַֽ/אֲרִיאֵ֑ל וְ/הָיְתָ֤ה תַֽאֲנִיָּה֙ וַֽ/אֲנִיָּ֔ה וְ/הָ֥יְתָה לִּ֖/י כַּ/אֲרִיאֵֽל
verses.translit: vhtsyqvty l'ry'l vhyth t'nyh v'nyh vhyth ly kh'ry'l
verses.translation: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be unto me as Ariel.

verses.original: וְ/חָנִ֥יתִי כַ/דּ֖וּר עָלָ֑יִ/ךְ וְ/צַרְתִּ֤י עָלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ מֻצָּ֔ב וַ/הֲקִֽימֹתִ֥י עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ מְצֻרֹֽת
verses.translit: vchnyty khdvr 'lykh vtsrty 'lykh mtsb vhqymty 'lykh mtsrt
verses.translation: And I will camp against thee round about, and will lay siege against thee with a mount, and I will raise forts against thee.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁפַלְתְּ֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ תְּדַבֵּ֔רִי וּ/מֵֽ/עָפָ֖ר תִּשַּׁ֣ח אִמְרָתֵ֑/ךְ וְֽ֠/הָיָה כְּ/א֤וֹב מֵ/אֶ֨רֶץ֙ קוֹלֵ֔/ךְ וּ/מֵ/עָפָ֖ר אִמְרָתֵ֥/ךְ תְּצַפְצֵֽף
verses.translit: vshplt m'rts tdbry vm'pr tshch 'mrtkh vhyh kh'vb m'rts qvlkh vm'pr 'mrtkh ttsptsf
verses.translation: And thou shalt be brought down, and shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall be low out of the dust, and thy voice shall be, as of one that hath a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֛ה כְּ/אָבָ֥ק דַּ֖ק הֲמ֣וֹן זָרָ֑יִ/ךְ וּ/כְ/מֹ֤ץ עֹבֵר֙ הֲמ֣וֹן עָֽרִיצִ֔ים וְ/הָיָ֖ה לְ/פֶ֥תַע פִּתְאֹֽם
verses.translit: vhyh kh'bq dq hmvn zrykh vkhmts 'br hmvn 'rytsym vhyh lpt' pt'm
verses.translation: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.

verses.original: מֵ/עִ֨ם יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ תִּפָּקֵ֔ד בְּ/רַ֥עַם וּ/בְ/רַ֖עַשׁ וְ/ק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל סוּפָה֙ וּ/סְעָרָ֔ה וְ/לַ֖הַב אֵ֥שׁ אוֹכֵלָֽה
verses.translit: m'm yhvh tsb'vt tpqd br'm vbr'sh vqvl gdvl svph vs'rh vlhb 'sh 'vkhlh
verses.translation: Thou shalt be visited of the LORD of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כַּֽ/חֲלוֹם֙ חֲז֣וֹן לַ֔יְלָה הֲמוֹן֙ כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם הַ/צֹּבְאִ֖ים עַל אֲרִיאֵ֑ל וְ/כָל צֹבֶ֨י/הָ֙ וּ/מְצֹ֣דָתָ֔/הּ וְ/הַ/מְּצִיקִ֖ים לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vhyh khchlvm chzvn lylh hmvn khl hgvym htsb'ym 'l 'ry'l vkhl tsbyh vmtsdth vhmtsyqym lh
verses.translation: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her munition, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֡ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֩ יַחֲלֹ֨ם הָ/רָעֵ֜ב וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה אוֹכֵ֗ל וְ/הֵקִיץ֮ וְ/רֵיקָ֣ה נַפְשׁ/וֹ֒ וְ/כַ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַחֲלֹ֤ם הַ/צָּמֵא֙ וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה שֹׁתֶ֔ה וְ/הֵקִיץ֙ וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה עָיֵ֔ף וְ/נַפְשׁ֖/וֹ שׁוֹקֵקָ֑ה כֵּ֣ן יִֽהְיֶ֗ה הֲמוֹן֙ כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם הַ/צֹּבְאִ֖ים עַל הַ֥ר צִיּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vhyh kh'shr ychlm hr'b vhnh 'vkhl vhqyts vryqh npshv vkh'shr ychlm htsm' vhnh shth vhqyts vhnh 'yf vnpshv shvqqh khn yhyh hmvn khl hgvym htsb'ym 'l hr tsyvn
verses.translation: It shall even be as when an hungry man dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; but he awaketh, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh; but he awaketh, and, behold, he is faint, and his soul hath appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.

verses.original: הִתְמַהְמְה֣וּ וּ/תְמָ֔הוּ הִשְׁתַּֽעַשְׁע֖וּ וָ/שֹׁ֑עוּ שָֽׁכְר֣וּ וְ/לֹא יַ֔יִן נָע֖וּ וְ/לֹ֥א שֵׁכָֽר
verses.translit: htmhmhv vtmhv hsht'sh'v vsh'v shkhrv vl' yyn n'v vl' shkhr
verses.translation: Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.

verses.original: כִּֽי נָסַ֨ךְ עֲלֵי/כֶ֤ם יְהוָה֙ ר֣וּחַ תַּרְדֵּמָ֔ה וַ/יְעַצֵּ֖ם אֶת עֵֽינֵי/כֶ֑ם אֶת הַ/נְּבִיאִ֛ים וְ/אֶת רָאשֵׁי/כֶ֥ם הַ/חֹזִ֖ים כִּסָּֽה
verses.translit: khy nskh 'lykhm yhvh rvch trdmh vy'tsm 't 'ynykhm 't hnby'ym v't r'shykhm hchzym khsh
verses.translation: For the LORD hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִ֨י לָ/כֶ֜ם חָז֣וּת הַ/כֹּ֗ל כְּ/דִבְרֵי֮ הַ/סֵּ֣פֶר הֶֽ/חָתוּם֒ אֲשֶֽׁר יִתְּנ֣וּ אֹת֗/וֹ אֶל יוֹדֵ֥עַ ה/ספר סֵ֛פֶר לֵ/אמֹ֖ר קְרָ֣א נָא זֶ֑ה וְ/אָמַר֙ לֹ֣א אוּכַ֔ל כִּ֥י חָת֖וּם הֽוּא
verses.translit: vthy lkhm chzvt hkhl khdbry hspr hchtvm 'shr ytnv 'tv 'l yvd' hspr spr l'mr qr' n' zh v'mr l' 'vkhl khy chtvm hv'
verses.translation: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it is sealed:

verses.original: וְ/נִתַּ֣ן הַ/סֵּ֗פֶר עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא יָדַ֥ע סֵ֛פֶר לֵ/אמֹ֖ר קְרָ֣א נָא זֶ֑ה וְ/אָמַ֕ר לֹ֥א יָדַ֖עְתִּי סֵֽפֶר
verses.translit: vntn hspr 'l 'shr l' yd' spr l'mr qr' n' zh v'mr l' yd'ty spr
verses.translation: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I am not learned.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲדֹנָ֗/י יַ֚עַן כִּ֤י נִגַּשׁ֙ הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה בְּ/פִ֤י/ו וּ/בִ/שְׂפָתָי/ו֙ כִּבְּד֔וּ/נִי וְ/לִבּ֖/וֹ רִחַ֣ק מִמֶּ֑/נִּי וַ/תְּהִ֤י יִרְאָתָ/ם֙ אֹתִ֔/י מִצְוַ֥ת אֲנָשִׁ֖ים מְלֻמָּדָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'dny y'n khy ngsh h'm hzh bpyv vbshptyv khbdvny vlbv rchq mmny vthy yr'tm 'ty mtsvt 'nshym mlmdh
verses.translation: Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן הִנְ/נִ֥י יוֹסִ֛ף לְ/הַפְלִ֥יא אֶת הָֽ/עָם הַ/זֶּ֖ה הַפְלֵ֣א וָ/פֶ֑לֶא וְ/אָֽבְדָה֙ חָכְמַ֣ת חֲכָמָ֔י/ו וּ/בִינַ֥ת נְבֹנָ֖י/ו תִּסְתַּתָּֽר
verses.translit: lkhn hnny yvsf lhply' 't h'm hzh hpl' vpl' v'bdh chkhmt chkhmyv vbynt nbnyv tsttr
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid.

verses.original: ה֛וֹי הַ/מַּעֲמִיקִ֥ים מֵֽ/יהוָ֖ה לַ/סְתִּ֣ר עֵצָ֑ה וְ/הָיָ֤ה בְ/מַחְשָׁךְ֙ מַֽעֲשֵׂי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מִ֥י רֹאֵ֖/נוּ וּ/מִ֥י יוֹדְעֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: hvy hm'myqym myhvh lstr 'tsh vhyh bmchshkh m'shyhm vy'mrv my r'nv vmy yvd'nv
verses.translation: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the LORD , and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?

verses.original: הַ֨פְכְּ/כֶ֔ם אִם כְּ/חֹ֥מֶר הַ/יֹּצֵ֖ר יֵֽחָשֵׁ֑ב כִּֽי יֹאמַ֨ר מַעֲשֶׂ֤ה לְ/עֹשֵׂ֨/הוּ֙ לֹ֣א עָשָׂ֔/נִי וְ/יֵ֛צֶר אָמַ֥ר לְ/יוֹצְר֖/וֹ לֹ֥א הֵבִֽין
verses.translit: hpkhkhm 'm khchmr hytsr ychshb khy y'mr m'shh l'shhv l' 'shny vytsr 'mr lyvtsrv l' hbyn
verses.translation: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter’s clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?

verses.original: הֲ/לוֹא עוֹד֙ מְעַ֣ט מִזְעָ֔ר וְ/שָׁ֥ב לְבָנ֖וֹן לַ/כַּרְמֶ֑ל וְ/הַ/כַּרְמֶ֖ל לַ/יַּ֥עַר יֵחָשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: hlv' 'vd m't mz'r vshb lbnvn lkhrml vhkhrml ly'r ychshb
verses.translation: Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?

verses.original: וְ/שָׁמְע֧וּ בַ/יּוֹם הַ/ה֛וּא הַ/חֵרְשִׁ֖ים דִּבְרֵי סֵ֑פֶר וּ/מֵ/אֹ֣פֶל וּ/מֵ/חֹ֔שֶׁךְ עֵינֵ֥י עִוְרִ֖ים תִּרְאֶֽינָה
verses.translit: vshm'v byvm hhv' hchrshym dbry spr vm'pl vmchshkh 'yny 'vrym tr'ynh
verses.translation: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.

verses.original: וְ/יָסְפ֧וּ עֲנָוִ֛ים בַּֽ/יהוָ֖ה שִׂמְחָ֑ה וְ/אֶבְיוֹנֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם בִּ/קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יָגִֽילוּ
verses.translit: vyspv 'nvym byhvh shmchh v'byvny 'dm bqdvsh yshr'l ygylv
verses.translation: The meek also shall increase their joy in the LORD , and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

verses.original: כִּֽי אָפֵ֥ס עָרִ֖יץ וְ/כָ֣לָה לֵ֑ץ וְ/נִכְרְת֖וּ כָּל שֹׁ֥קְדֵי אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: khy 'ps 'ryts vkhlh lts vnkhrtv khl shqdy 'vn
verses.translation: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:

verses.original: מַחֲטִיאֵ֤י אָדָם֙ בְּ/דָבָ֔ר וְ/לַ/מּוֹכִ֥יחַ בַּ/שַּׁ֖עַר יְקֹשׁ֑וּ/ן וַ/יַּטּ֥וּ בַ/תֹּ֖הוּ צַדִּֽיק
verses.translit: mchty'y 'dm bdbr vlmvkhych bsh'r yqshvn vytv bthv tsdyq
verses.translation: That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּדָ֖ה אֶת אַבְרָהָ֑ם לֹֽא עַתָּ֤ה יֵבוֹשׁ֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/לֹ֥א עַתָּ֖ה פָּנָ֥י/ו יֶחֱוָֽרוּ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh 'l byt y'qb 'shr pdh 't 'brhm l' 'th ybvsh y'qb vl' 'th pnyv ychvrv
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD , who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.

verses.original: כִּ֣י בִ֠/רְאֹת/וֹ יְלָדָ֞י/ו מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדַ֛/י בְּ/קִרְבּ֖/וֹ יַקְדִּ֣ישֽׁוּ שְׁמִ֑/י וְ/הִקְדִּ֨ישׁוּ֙ אֶת קְד֣וֹשׁ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/אֶת אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יַעֲרִֽיצוּ
verses.translit: khy br'tv yldyv m'shh ydy bqrbv yqdyshv shmy vhqdyshv 't qdvsh y'qb v't 'lhy yshr'l y'rytsv
verses.translation: But when he seeth his children, the work of mine hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/יָדְע֥וּ תֹֽעֵי ר֖וּחַ בִּינָ֑ה וְ/רוֹגְנִ֖ים יִלְמְדוּ לֶֽקַח
verses.translit: vyd'v t'y rvch bynh vrvgnym ylmdv lqch
verses.translation: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.

verses.original: ה֣וֹי בָּנִ֤ים סֽוֹרְרִים֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה לַ/עֲשׂ֤וֹת עֵצָה֙ וְ/לֹ֣א מִ/נִּ֔י וְ/לִ/נְסֹ֥ךְ מַסֵּכָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֣א רוּחִ֑/י לְמַ֛עַן סְפ֥וֹת חַטָּ֖את עַל חַטָּֽאת
verses.translit: hvy bnym svrrym n'm yhvh l'shvt 'tsh vl' mny vlnskh mskhh vl' rvchy lm'n spvt cht't 'l cht't
verses.translation: Woe to the rebellious children, saith the LORD , that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin:

verses.original: הַ/הֹלְכִים֙ לָ/רֶ֣דֶת מִצְרַ֔יִם וּ/פִ֖/י לֹ֣א שָׁאָ֑לוּ לָ/עוֹז֙ בְּ/מָע֣וֹז פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְ/לַ/חְס֖וֹת בְּ/צֵ֥ל מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: hhlkhym lrdt mtsrym vpy l' sh'lv l'vz bm'vz pr'h vlchsvt btsl mtsrym
verses.translation: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֥ה לָ/כֶ֛ם מָע֥וֹז פַּרְעֹ֖ה לְ/בֹ֑שֶׁת וְ/הֶ/חָס֥וּת בְּ/צֵל מִצְרַ֖יִם לִ/כְלִמָּֽה
verses.translit: vhyh lkhm m'vz pr'h lbsht vhchsvt btsl mtsrym lkhlmh
verses.translation: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.

verses.original: כִּֽי הָי֥וּ בְ/צֹ֖עַן שָׂרָ֑י/ו וּ/מַלְאָכָ֖י/ו חָנֵ֥ס יַגִּֽיעוּ
verses.translit: khy hyv bts'n shryv vml'khyv chns ygy'v
verses.translation: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ל הבאיש הֹבִ֔ישׁ עַל עַ֖ם לֹא יוֹעִ֣ילוּ לָ֑/מוֹ לֹ֤א לְ/עֵ֨זֶר֙ וְ/לֹ֣א לְ/הוֹעִ֔יל כִּ֥י לְ/בֹ֖שֶׁת וְ/גַם לְ/חֶרְפָּֽה
verses.translit: khl hb'ysh hbysh 'l 'm l' yv'ylv lmv l' l'zr vl' lhv'yl khy lbsht vgm lchrph
verses.translation: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א בַּהֲמ֣וֹת נֶ֑גֶב בְּ/אֶרֶץ֩ צָרָ֨ה וְ/צוּקָ֜ה לָבִ֧יא וָ/לַ֣יִשׁ מֵ/הֶ֗ם אֶפְעֶה֙ וְ/שָׂרָ֣ף מְעוֹפֵ֔ף יִשְׂאוּ֩ עַל כֶּ֨תֶף עֲיָרִ֜ים חֵֽילֵ/הֶ֗ם וְ/עַל דַּבֶּ֤שֶׁת גְּמַלִּים֙ אֽוֹצְרֹתָ֔/ם עַל עַ֖ם לֹ֥א יוֹעִֽילוּ
verses.translit: msh' bhmvt ngb b'rts tsrh vtsvqh lby' vlysh mhm 'p'h vshrf m'vpf ysh'v 'l khtf 'yrym chylhm v'l dbsht gmlym 'vtsrtm 'l 'm l' yv'ylv
verses.translation: The burden of the beasts of the south: into the land of trouble and anguish, from whence come the young and old lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels, to a people that shall not profit them .

verses.original: וּ/מִצְרַ֕יִם הֶ֥בֶל וָ/רִ֖יק יַעְזֹ֑רוּ לָ/כֵן֙ קָרָ֣אתִי לָ/זֹ֔את רַ֥הַב הֵ֖ם שָֽׁבֶת
verses.translit: vmtsrym hbl vryq y'zrv lkhn qr'ty lz't rhb hm shbt
verses.translation: For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I cried concerning this, Their strength is to sit still.

verses.original: עַתָּ֗ה בּ֣וֹא כָתְבָ֥/הּ עַל ל֛וּחַ אִתָּ֖/ם וְ/עַל סֵ֣פֶר חֻקָּ֑/הּ וּ/תְהִי֙ לְ/י֣וֹם אַחֲר֔וֹן לָ/עַ֖ד עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: 'th bv' khtbh 'l lvch 'tm v'l spr chqh vthy lyvm 'chrvn l'd 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever:

verses.original: כִּ֣י עַ֤ם מְרִי֙ ה֔וּא בָּנִ֖ים כֶּחָשִׁ֑ים בָּנִ֕ים לֹֽא אָב֥וּ שְׁמ֖וֹעַ תּוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy 'm mry hv' bnym khchshym bnym l' 'bv shmv' tvrt yhvh
verses.translation: That this is a rebellious people, lying children, children that will not hear the law of the LORD :

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמְר֤וּ לָֽ/רֹאִים֙ לֹ֣א תִרְא֔וּ וְ/לַ֣/חֹזִ֔ים לֹ֥א תֶחֱזוּ לָ֖/נוּ נְכֹח֑וֹת דַּבְּרוּ לָ֣/נוּ חֲלָק֔וֹת חֲז֖וּ מַהֲתַלּֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'shr 'mrv lr'ym l' tr'v vlchzym l' tchzv lnv nkhchvt dbrv lnv chlqvt chzv mhtlvt
verses.translation: Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits:

verses.original: ס֚וּרוּ מִנֵּי דֶ֔רֶךְ הַטּ֖וּ מִנֵּי אֹ֑רַח הַשְׁבִּ֥יתוּ מִ/פָּנֵ֖י/נוּ אֶת קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: svrv mny drkh htv mny 'rch hshbytv mpnynv 't qdvsh yshr'l
verses.translation: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יַ֥עַן מָֽאָסְ/כֶ֖ם בַּ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וַֽ/תִּבְטְחוּ֙ בְּ/עֹ֣שֶׁק וְ/נָל֔וֹז וַ/תִּֽשָּׁעֲנ֖וּ עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr qdvsh yshr'l y'n m'skhm bdbr hzh vtbtchv b'shq vnlvz vtsh'nv 'lyv
verses.translation: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon:

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן יִֽהְיֶ֤ה לָ/כֶם֙ הֶ/עָוֺ֣ן הַ/זֶּ֔ה כְּ/פֶ֣רֶץ נֹפֵ֔ל נִבְעֶ֖ה בְּ/חוֹמָ֣ה נִשְׂגָּבָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר פִּתְאֹ֥ם לְ/פֶ֖תַע יָב֥וֹא שִׁבְרָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: lkhn yhyh lkhm h'vn hzh khprts npl nb'h bchvmh nshgbh 'shr pt'm lpt' ybv' shbrh
verses.translation: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.

verses.original: וּ֠/שְׁבָרָ/הּ כְּ/שֵׁ֨בֶר נֵ֧בֶל יוֹצְרִ֛ים כָּת֖וּת לֹ֣א יַחְמֹ֑ל וְ/לֹֽא יִמָּצֵ֤א בִ/מְכִתָּת/וֹ֙ חֶ֔רֶשׂ לַ/חְתּ֥וֹת אֵשׁ֙ מִ/יָּק֔וּד וְ/לַ/חְשֹׂ֥ף מַ֖יִם מִ/גֶּֽבֶא
verses.translit: vshbrh khshbr nbl yvtsrym khtvt l' ychml vl' ymts' bmkhttv chrsh lchtvt 'sh myqvd vlchshf mym mgb'
verses.translation: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters’ vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water withal out of the pit.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹֽה אָמַר֩ אֲדֹנָ֨/י יְהוִ֜ה קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בְּ/שׁוּבָ֤ה וָ/נַ֨חַת֙ תִּוָּ֣שֵׁע֔וּ/ן בְּ/הַשְׁקֵט֙ וּ/בְ/בִטְחָ֔ה תִּהְיֶ֖ה גְּבֽוּרַתְ/כֶ֑ם וְ/לֹ֖א אֲבִיתֶֽם
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'dny yhvh qdvsh yshr'l bshvbh vncht tvsh'vn bhshqt vbbtchh thyh gbvrtkhm vl' 'bytm
verses.translation: For thus saith the Lord GOD , the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמְר֥וּ לֹא כִ֛י עַל ס֥וּס נָנ֖וּס עַל כֵּ֣ן תְּנוּס֑וּ/ן וְ/עַל קַ֣ל נִרְכָּ֔ב עַל כֵּ֖ן יִקַּ֥לּוּ רֹדְפֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vt'mrv l' khy 'l svs nnvs 'l khn tnvsvn v'l ql nrkhb 'l khn yqlv rdpykhm
verses.translation: But ye said, No; for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall ye flee: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.

verses.original: אֶ֣לֶף אֶחָ֗ד מִ/פְּנֵי֙ גַּעֲרַ֣ת אֶחָ֔ד מִ/פְּנֵ֛י גַּעֲרַ֥ת חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה תָּנֻ֑סוּ עַ֣ד אִם נוֹתַרְתֶּ֗ם כַּ/תֹּ֨רֶן֙ עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הָ/הָ֔ר וְ/כַ/נֵּ֖ס עַל הַ/גִּבְעָֽה
verses.translit: 'lf 'chd mpny g'rt 'chd mpny g'rt chmshh tnsv 'd 'm nvtrtm khtrn 'l r'sh hhr vkhns 'l hgb'h
verses.translation: One thousand shall flee at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee: till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, and as an ensign on an hill.

verses.original: וְ/לָ/כֵ֞ן יְחַכֶּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לַֽ/חֲנַנְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/לָ/כֵ֥ן יָר֖וּם לְ/רַֽחֶמְ/כֶ֑ם כִּֽי אֱלֹהֵ֤י מִשְׁפָּט֙ יְהוָ֔ה אַשְׁרֵ֖י כָּל ח֥וֹכֵי לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vlkhn ychkhh yhvh lchnnkhm vlkhn yrvm lrchmkhm khy 'lhy mshpt yhvh 'shry khl chvkhy lv
verses.translation: And therefore will the LORD wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for the LORD is a God of judgment: blessed are all they that wait for him.

verses.original: כִּי עַ֛ם בְּ/צִיּ֥וֹן יֵשֵׁ֖ב בִּ/ירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם בָּכ֣וֹ לֹֽא תִבְכֶּ֗ה חָנ֤וֹן יָחְנְ/ךָ֙ לְ/ק֣וֹל זַעֲקֶ֔/ךָ כְּ/שָׁמְעָת֖/וֹ עָנָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khy 'm btsyvn yshb byrvshlm bkhv l' tbkhh chnvn ychnkh lqvl z'qkh khshm'tv 'nkh
verses.translation: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem: thou shalt weep no more: he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry; when he shall hear it, he will answer thee.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַ֨ן לָ/כֶ֧ם אֲדֹנָ֛/י לֶ֥חֶם צָ֖ר וּ/מַ֣יִם לָ֑חַץ וְ/לֹֽא יִכָּנֵ֥ף עוֹד֙ מוֹרֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/הָי֥וּ עֵינֶ֖י/ךָ רֹא֥וֹת אֶת מוֹרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vntn lkhm 'dny lchm tsr vmym lchts vl' ykhnf 'vd mvrykh vhyv 'ynykh r'vt 't mvrykh
verses.translation: And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers:

verses.original: וְ/אָזְנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ תִּשְׁמַ֣עְנָה דָבָ֔ר מֵֽ/אַחֲרֶ֖י/ךָ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר זֶ֤ה הַ/דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ לְכ֣וּ ב֔/וֹ כִּ֥י תַאֲמִ֖ינוּ וְ/כִ֥י תַשְׂמְאִֽילוּ
verses.translit: v'znykh tshm'nh dbr m'chrykh l'mr zh hdrkh lkhv bv khy t'mynv vkhy tshm'ylv
verses.translation: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.

verses.original: וְ/טִמֵּאתֶ֗ם אֶת צִפּוּי֙ פְּסִילֵ֣י כַסְפֶּ֔/ךָ וְ/אֶת אֲפֻדַּ֖ת מַסֵּכַ֣ת זְהָבֶ֑/ךָ תִּזְרֵ/ם֙ כְּמ֣וֹ דָוָ֔ה צֵ֖א תֹּ֥אמַר לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vtm'tm 't tspvy psyly khspkh v't 'pdt mskht zhbkh tzrm khmv dvh ts' t'mr lv
verses.translation: Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver, and the ornament of thy molten images of gold: thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth; thou shalt say unto it, Get thee hence.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַן֩ מְטַ֨ר זַרְעֲ/ךָ֜ אֲשֶׁר תִּזְרַ֣ע אֶת הָ/אֲדָמָ֗ה וְ/לֶ֨חֶם֙ תְּבוּאַ֣ת הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֔ה וְ/הָיָ֥ה דָשֵׁ֖ן וְ/שָׁמֵ֑ן יִרְעֶ֥ה מִקְנֶ֛י/ךָ בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא כַּ֥ר נִרְחָֽב
verses.translit: vntn mtr zr'kh 'shr tzr' 't h'dmh vlchm tbv't h'dmh vhyh dshn vshmn yr'h mqnykh byvm hhv' khr nrchb
verses.translation: Then shall he give the rain of thy seed, that thou shalt sow the ground withal; and bread of the increase of the earth, and it shall be fat and plenteous: in that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אֲלָפִ֣ים וְ/הָ/עֲיָרִ֗ים עֹֽבְדֵי֙ הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֔ה בְּלִ֥יל חָמִ֖יץ יֹאכֵ֑לוּ אֲשֶׁר זֹרֶ֥ה בָ/רַ֖חַת וּ/בַ/מִּזְרֶֽה
verses.translit: vh'lpym vh'yrym 'bdy h'dmh blyl chmyts y'khlv 'shr zrh brcht vbmzrh
verses.translation: The oxen likewise and the young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean provender, which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה עַל כָּל הַ֣ר גָּבֹ֗הַ וְ/עַל֙ כָּל גִּבְעָ֣ה נִשָּׂאָ֔ה פְּלָגִ֖ים יִבְלֵי מָ֑יִם בְּ/יוֹם֙ הֶ֣רֶג רָ֔ב בִּ/נְפֹ֖ל מִגְדָּלִֽים
verses.translit: vhyh 'l khl hr gbh v'l khl gb'h nsh'h plgym ybly mym byvm hrg rb bnpl mgdlym
verses.translation: And there shall be upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill, rivers and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֤ה אֽוֹר הַ/לְּבָנָה֙ כְּ/א֣וֹר הַֽ/חַמָּ֔ה וְ/א֤וֹר הַֽ/חַמָּה֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה שִׁבְעָתַ֔יִם כְּ/א֖וֹר שִׁבְעַ֣ת הַ/יָּמִ֑ים בְּ/י֗וֹם חֲבֹ֤שׁ יְהוָה֙ אֶת שֶׁ֣בֶר עַמּ֔/וֹ וּ/מַ֥חַץ מַכָּת֖/וֹ יִרְפָּֽא
verses.translit: vhyh 'vr hlbnh kh'vr hchmh v'vr hchmh yhyh shb'tym kh'vr shb't hymym byvm chbsh yhvh 't shbr 'mv vmchts mkhtv yrp'
verses.translation: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that the LORD bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה שֵׁם יְהוָה֙ בָּ֣א מִ/מֶּרְחָ֔ק בֹּעֵ֣ר אַפּ֔/וֹ וְ/כֹ֖בֶד מַשָּׂאָ֑ה שְׂפָתָי/ו֙ מָ֣לְאוּ זַ֔עַם וּ/לְשׁוֹנ֖/וֹ כְּ/אֵ֥שׁ אֹכָֽלֶת
verses.translit: hnh shm yhvh b' mmrchq b'r 'pv vkhbd msh'h shptyv ml'v z'm vlshvnv kh'sh 'khlt
verses.translation: Behold, the name of the LORD cometh from far, burning with his anger, and the burden thereof is heavy: his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue as a devouring fire:

verses.original: וְ/רוּח֞/וֹ כְּ/נַ֤חַל שׁוֹטֵף֙ עַד צַוָּ֣אר יֶֽחֱצֶ֔ה לַ/הֲנָפָ֥ה גוֹיִ֖ם בְּ/נָ֣פַת שָׁ֑וְא וְ/רֶ֣סֶן מַתְעֶ֔ה עַ֖ל לְחָיֵ֥י עַמִּֽים
verses.translit: vrvchv khnchl shvtf 'd tsv'r ychtsh lhnph gvym bnpt shv' vrsn mt'h 'l lchyy 'mym
verses.translation: And his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity: and there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing them to err.

verses.original: הַ/שִּׁיר֙ יִֽהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֔ם כְּ/לֵ֖יל הִתְקַדֶּשׁ חָ֑ג וְ/שִׂמְחַ֣ת לֵבָ֗ב כַּֽ/הוֹלֵךְ֙ בֶּֽ/חָלִ֔יל לָ/ב֥וֹא בְ/הַר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל צ֥וּר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: hshyr yhyh lkhm khlyl htqdsh chg vshmcht lbb khhvlkh bchlyl lbv' bhr yhvh 'l tsvr yshr'l
verses.translation: Ye shall have a song, as in the night when a holy solemnity is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the LORD , to the mighty One of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁמִ֨יעַ יְהוָ֜ה אֶת ה֣וֹד קוֹל֗/וֹ וְ/נַ֤חַת זְרוֹע/וֹ֙ יַרְאֶ֔ה בְּ/זַ֣עַף אַ֔ף וְ/לַ֖הַב אֵ֣שׁ אוֹכֵלָ֑ה נֶ֥פֶץ וָ/זֶ֖רֶם וְ/אֶ֥בֶן בָּרָֽד
verses.translit: vhshmy' yhvh 't hvd qvlv vncht zrv'v yr'h bz'f 'f vlhb 'sh 'vkhlh npts vzrm v'bn brd
verses.translation: And the LORD shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall shew the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and with the flame of a devouring fire, with scattering, and tempest, and hailstones.

verses.original: כִּֽי מִ/קּ֥וֹל יְהוָ֖ה יֵחַ֣ת אַשּׁ֑וּר בַּ/שֵּׁ֖בֶט יַכֶּֽה
verses.translit: khy mqvl yhvh ycht 'shvr bshbt ykhh
verses.translation: For through the voice of the LORD shall the Assyrian be beaten down, which smote with a rod.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כֹּ֤ל מַֽעֲבַר֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מֽוּסָדָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָנִ֤יחַ יְהוָה֙ עָלָ֔י/ו בְּ/תֻפִּ֖ים וּ/בְ/כִנֹּר֑וֹת וּ/בְ/מִלְחֲמ֥וֹת תְּנוּפָ֖ה נִלְחַם ב/ה בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhyh khl m'br mth mvsdh 'shr ynych yhvh 'lyv btpym vbkhnrvt vbmlchmvt tnvph nlchm bh bm
verses.translation: And in every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which the LORD shall lay upon him, it shall be with tabrets and harps: and in battles of shaking will he fight with it.

verses.original: כִּֽי עָר֤וּךְ מֵֽ/אֶתְמוּל֙ תָּפְתֶּ֔ה גַּם הוא הִ֛יא לַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ הוּכָ֖ן הֶעְמִ֣יק הִרְחִ֑ב מְדֻרָתָ֗/הּ אֵ֤שׁ וְ/עֵצִים֙ הַרְבֵּ֔ה נִשְׁמַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ כְּ/נַ֣חַל גָּפְרִ֔ית בֹּעֲרָ֖ה בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khy 'rvkh m'tmvl tpth gm hv' hy' lmlkh hvkhn h'myq hrchb mdrth 'sh v'tsym hrbh nshmt yhvh khnchl gpryt b'rh bh
verses.translation: For Tophet is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made it deep and large: the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of the LORD , like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.

verses.original: ה֣וֹי הַ/יֹּרְדִ֤ים מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ לְ/עֶזְרָ֔ה עַל סוּסִ֖ים יִשָּׁעֵ֑נוּ וַ/יִּבְטְח֨וּ עַל רֶ֜כֶב כִּ֣י רָ֗ב וְ/עַ֤ל פָּֽרָשִׁים֙ כִּֽי עָצְמ֣וּ מְאֹ֔ד וְ/לֹ֤א שָׁעוּ֙ עַל קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אֶת יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֥א דָרָֽשׁוּ
verses.translit: hvy hyrdym mtsrym l'zrh 'l svsym ysh'nv vybtchv 'l rkhb khy rb v'l prshym khy 'tsmv m'd vl' sh'v 'l qdvsh yshr'l v't yhvh l' drshv
verses.translation: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the LORD !

verses.original: וְ/גַם ה֤וּא חָכָם֙ וַ/יָּ֣בֵא רָ֔ע וְ/אֶת דְּבָרָ֖י/ו לֹ֣א הֵסִ֑יר וְ/קָם֙ עַל בֵּ֣ית מְרֵעִ֔ים וְ/עַל עֶזְרַ֖ת פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: vgm hv' chkhm vyb' r' v't dbryv l' hsyr vqm 'l byt mr'ym v'l 'zrt p'ly 'vn
verses.translation: Yet he also is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.

verses.original: וּ/מִצְרַ֤יִם אָדָם֙ וְֽ/לֹא אֵ֔ל וְ/סוּסֵי/הֶ֥ם בָּשָׂ֖ר וְ/לֹא ר֑וּחַ וַֽ/יהוָ֞ה יַטֶּ֣ה יָד֗/וֹ וְ/כָשַׁ֤ל עוֹזֵר֙ וְ/נָפַ֣ל עָזֻ֔ר וְ/יַחְדָּ֖ו כֻּלָּ֥/ם יִכְלָיֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: vmtsrym 'dm vl' 'l vsvsyhm bshr vl' rvch vyhvh yth ydv vkhshl 'vzr vnpl 'zr vychdv khlm ykhlyvn
verses.translation: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the LORD shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָֽמַר יְהוָ֣ה אֵלַ֡/י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶהְגֶּה֩ הָ/אַרְיֵ֨ה וְ/הַ/כְּפִ֜יר עַל טַרְפּ֗/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִקָּרֵ֤א עָלָי/ו֙ מְלֹ֣א רֹעִ֔ים מִ/קּוֹלָ/ם֙ לֹ֣א יֵחָ֔ת וּ/מֵֽ/הֲמוֹנָ֖/ם לֹ֣א יַֽעֲנֶ֑ה כֵּ֗ן יֵרֵד֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת לִ/צְבֹּ֥א עַל הַר צִיּ֖וֹן וְ/עַל גִּבְעָתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh 'ly kh'shr yhgh h'ryh vhkhpyr 'l trpv 'shr yqr' 'lyv ml' r'ym mqvlm l' ycht vmhmvnm l' y'nh khn yrd yhvh tsb'vt ltsb' 'l hr tsyvn v'l gb'th
verses.translation: For thus hath the LORD spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, he will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the LORD of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.

verses.original: כְּ/צִפֳּרִ֣ים עָפ֔וֹת כֵּ֗ן יָגֵ֛ן יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת עַל יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם גָּנ֥וֹן וְ/הִצִּ֖יל פָּסֹ֥חַ וְ/הִמְלִֽיט
verses.translit: khtsprym 'pvt khn ygn yhvh tsb'vt 'l yrvshlm gnvn vhtsyl psch vhmlyt
verses.translation: As birds flying, so will the LORD of hosts defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver it; and passing over he will preserve it.

verses.original: שׁ֗וּבוּ לַ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֶעְמִ֥יקוּ סָרָ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: shvbv l'shr h'myqv srh bny yshr'l
verses.translation: Turn ye unto him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.

verses.original: כִּ֚י בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא יִמְאָס֗וּ/ן אִ֚ישׁ אֱלִילֵ֣י כַסְפּ֔/וֹ וֶ/אֱלִילֵ֖י זְהָב֑/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשׂ֥וּ לָ/כֶ֛ם יְדֵי/כֶ֖ם חֵֽטְא
verses.translit: khy byvm hhv' ym'svn 'ysh 'lyly khspv v'lyly zhbv 'shr 'shv lkhm ydykhm cht'
verses.translation: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you for a sin.

verses.original: וְ/נָפַ֤ל אַשּׁוּר֙ בְּ/חֶ֣רֶב לֹא אִ֔ישׁ וְ/חֶ֥רֶב לֹֽא אָדָ֖ם תֹּֽאכֲלֶ֑/נּוּ וְ/נָ֥ס ל/וֹ֙ מִ/פְּנֵי חֶ֔רֶב וּ/בַחוּרָ֖י/ו לָ/מַ֥ס יִהְיֽוּ
verses.translit: vnpl 'shvr bchrb l' 'ysh vchrb l' 'dm t'khlnv vns lv mpny chrb vbchvryv lms yhyv
verses.translation: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited.

verses.original: וְ/סַלְע/וֹ֙ מִ/מָּג֣וֹר יַֽעֲב֔וֹר וְ/חַתּ֥וּ מִ/נֵּ֖ס שָׂרָ֑י/ו נְאֻם יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁר א֥וּר ל/וֹ֙ בְּ/צִיּ֔וֹן וְ/תַנּ֥וּר ל֖/וֹ בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vsl'v mmgvr y'bvr vchtv mns shryv n'm yhvh 'shr 'vr lv btsyvn vtnvr lv byrvshlm
verses.translation: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, saith the LORD , whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.

verses.original: הֵ֥ן לְ/צֶ֖דֶק יִמְלָךְ מֶ֑לֶךְ וּ/לְ/שָׂרִ֖ים לְ/מִשְׁפָּ֥ט יָשֹֽׂרוּ
verses.translit: hn ltsdq ymlkh mlkh vlshrym lmshpt yshrv
verses.translation: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה אִ֥ישׁ כְּ/מַֽחֲבֵא ר֖וּחַ וְ/סֵ֣תֶר זָ֑רֶם כְּ/פַלְגֵי מַ֣יִם בְּ/צָי֔וֹן כְּ/צֵ֥ל סֶֽלַע כָּבֵ֖ד בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ עֲיֵפָֽה
verses.translit: vhyh 'ysh khmchb' rvch vstr zrm khplgy mym btsyvn khtsl sl' khbd b'rts 'yph
verses.translation: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֥א תִשְׁעֶ֖ינָה עֵינֵ֣י רֹאִ֑ים וְ/אָזְנֵ֥י שֹׁמְעִ֖ים תִּקְשַֽׁבְנָה
verses.translit: vl' tsh'ynh 'yny r'ym v'zny shm'ym tqshbnh
verses.translation: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.

verses.original: וּ/לְבַ֥ב נִמְהָרִ֖ים יָבִ֣ין לָ/דָ֑עַת וּ/לְשׁ֣וֹן עִלְּגִ֔ים תְּמַהֵ֖ר לְ/דַבֵּ֥ר צָחֽוֹת
verses.translit: vlbb nmhrym ybyn ld't vlshvn 'lgym tmhr ldbr tschvt
verses.translation: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.

verses.original: לֹֽא יִקָּרֵ֥א ע֛וֹד לְ/נָבָ֖ל נָדִ֑יב וּ/לְ/כִילַ֕י לֹ֥א יֵֽאָמֵ֖ר שֽׁוֹעַ
verses.translit: l' yqr' 'vd lnbl ndyb vlkhyly l' y'mr shv'
verses.translation: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said to be bountiful.

verses.original: כִּ֤י נָבָל֙ נְבָלָ֣ה יְדַבֵּ֔ר וְ/לִבּ֖/וֹ יַעֲשֶׂה אָ֑וֶן לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת חֹ֗נֶף וּ/לְ/דַבֵּ֤ר אֶל יְהוָה֙ תּוֹעָ֔ה לְ/הָרִיק֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ רָעֵ֔ב וּ/מַשְׁקֶ֥ה צָמֵ֖א יַחְסִֽיר
verses.translit: khy nbl nblh ydbr vlbv y'shh 'vn l'shvt chnf vldbr 'l yhvh tv'h lhryq npsh r'b vmshqh tsm' ychsyr
verses.translation: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the LORD , to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.

verses.original: וְ/כֵלַ֖י כֵּלָ֣י/ו רָעִ֑ים ה֚וּא זִמּ֣וֹת יָעָ֔ץ לְ/חַבֵּ֤ל ענוים עֲנִיִּים֙ בְּ/אִמְרֵי שֶׁ֔קֶר וּ/בְ/דַבֵּ֥ר אֶבְי֖וֹן מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: vkhly khlyv r'ym hv' zmvt y'ts lchbl 'nvym 'nyym b'mry shqr vbdbr 'byvn mshpt
verses.translation: The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.

verses.original: וְ/נָדִ֖יב נְדִיב֣וֹת יָעָ֑ץ וְ/ה֖וּא עַל נְדִיב֥וֹת יָקֽוּם
verses.translit: vndyb ndybvt y'ts vhv' 'l ndybvt yqvm
verses.translation: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.

verses.original: נָשִׁים֙ שַֽׁאֲנַנּ֔וֹת קֹ֖מְנָה שְׁמַ֣עְנָה קוֹלִ֑/י בָּנוֹת֙ בֹּֽטח֔וֹת הַאְזֵ֖נָּה אִמְרָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: nshym sh'nnvt qmnh shm'nh qvly bnvt btchvt h'znh 'mrty
verses.translation: Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.

verses.original: יָמִים֙ עַל שָׁנָ֔ה תִּרְגַּ֖זְנָה בֹּֽטְח֑וֹת כִּ֚י כָּלָ֣ה בָצִ֔יר אֹ֖סֶף בְּלִ֥י יָבֽוֹא
verses.translit: ymym 'l shnh trgznh btchvt khy khlh btsyr 'sf bly ybv'
verses.translation: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.

verses.original: חִרְדוּ֙ שַֽׁאֲנַנּ֔וֹת רְגָ֖זָה בֹּֽטְח֑וֹת פְּשֹׁ֣טָֽה וְ/עֹ֔רָה וַ/חֲג֖וֹרָה עַל חֲלָצָֽיִם
verses.translit: chrdv sh'nnvt rgzh btchvt pshth v'rh vchgvrh 'l chltsym
verses.translation: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird sackcloth upon your loins.

verses.original: עַל שָׁדַ֖יִם סֹֽפְדִ֑ים עַל שְׂדֵי חֶ֕מֶד עַל גֶּ֖פֶן פֹּרִיָּֽה
verses.translit: 'l shdym spdym 'l shdy chmd 'l gpn pryh
verses.translation: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.

verses.original: עַ֚ל אַדְמַ֣ת עַמִּ֔/י ק֥וֹץ שָׁמִ֖יר תַּֽעֲלֶ֑ה כִּ֚י עַל כָּל בָּתֵּ֣י מָשׂ֔וֹשׂ קִרְיָ֖ה עַלִּיזָֽה
verses.translit: 'l 'dmt 'my qvts shmyr t'lh khy 'l khl bty mshvsh qryh 'lyzh
verses.translation: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city:

verses.original: כִּֽי אַרְמ֣וֹן נֻטָּ֔שׁ הֲמ֥וֹן עִ֖יר עֻזָּ֑ב עֹ֣פֶל וָ/בַ֜חַן הָיָ֨ה בְעַ֤ד מְעָרוֹת֙ עַד עוֹלָ֔ם מְשׂ֥וֹשׂ פְּרָאִ֖ים מִרְעֵ֥ה עֲדָרִֽים
verses.translit: khy 'rmvn ntsh hmvn 'yr 'zb 'pl vbchn hyh b'd m'rvt 'd 'vlm mshvsh pr'ym mr'h 'drym
verses.translation: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;

verses.original: עַד יֵ֨עָרֶ֥ה עָלֵ֛י/נוּ ר֖וּחַ מִ/מָּר֑וֹם וְ/הָיָ֤ה מִדְבָּר֙ לַ/כַּרְמֶ֔ל ו/כרמל וְ/הַ/כַּרְמֶ֖ל לַ/יַּ֥עַר יֵחָשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: 'd y'rh 'lynv rvch mmrvm vhyh mdbr lkhrml vkhrml vhkhrml ly'r ychshb
verses.translation: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.

verses.translit: vshkhn bmdbr mshpt vtsdqh bkhrml tshb
verses.translation: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֛ה מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הַ/צְּדָקָ֖ה שָׁל֑וֹם וַֽ/עֲבֹדַת֙ הַ/צְּדָקָ֔ה הַשְׁקֵ֥ט וָ/בֶ֖טַח עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vhyh m'shh htsdqh shlvm v'bdt htsdqh hshqt vbtch 'd 'vlm
verses.translation: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.

verses.original: וְ/יָשַׁ֥ב עַמִּ֖/י בִּ/נְוֵ֣ה שָׁל֑וֹם וּֽ/בְ/מִשְׁכְּנוֹת֙ מִבְטַחִ֔ים וּ/בִ/מְנוּחֹ֖ת שַׁאֲנַנּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyshb 'my bnvh shlvm vbmshkhnvt mbtchym vbmnvcht sh'nnvt
verses.translation: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;

verses.original: וּ/בָרַ֖ד בְּ/רֶ֣דֶת הַ/יָּ֑עַר וּ/בַ/שִּׁפְלָ֖ה תִּשְׁפַּ֥ל הָ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vbrd brdt hy'r vbshplh tshpl h'yr
verses.translation: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵי/כֶ֕ם זֹרְעֵ֖י עַל כָּל מָ֑יִם מְשַׁלְּחֵ֥י רֶֽגֶל הַ/שּׁ֖וֹר וְ/הַ/חֲמֽוֹר
verses.translit: 'shrykhm zr'y 'l khl mym mshlchy rgl hshvr vhchmvr
verses.translation: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass.

verses.original: ה֣וֹי שׁוֹדֵ֗ד וְ/אַתָּה֙ לֹ֣א שָׁד֔וּד וּ/בוֹגֵ֖ד וְ/לֹא בָ֣גְדוּ ב֑/וֹ כַּ/הֲתִֽמְ/ךָ֤ שׁוֹדֵד֙ תּוּשַּׁ֔ד כַּ/נְּלֹתְ/ךָ֥ לִ/בְגֹּ֖ד יִבְגְּדוּ בָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: hvy shvdd v'th l' shdvd vbvgd vl' bgdv bv khhtmkh shvdd tvshd khnltkh lbgd ybgdv bkh
verses.translation: Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou wast not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה חָנֵּ֖/נוּ לְ/ךָ֣ קִוִּ֑ינוּ הֱיֵ֤ה זְרֹעָ/ם֙ לַ/בְּקָרִ֔ים אַף יְשׁוּעָתֵ֖/נוּ בְּ/עֵ֥ת צָרָֽה
verses.translit: yhvh chnnv lkh qvynv hyh zr'm lbqrym 'f yshv'tnv b't tsrh
verses.translation: O LORD , be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

verses.original: מִ/קּ֣וֹל הָמ֔וֹן נָדְד֖וּ עַמִּ֑ים מֵ/ר֣וֹמְמֻתֶ֔/ךָ נָפְצ֖וּ גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: mqvl hmvn nddv 'mym mrvmmtkh nptsv gvym
verses.translation: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.

verses.original: וְ/אֻסַּ֣ף שְׁלַלְ/כֶ֔ם אֹ֖סֶף הֶֽ/חָסִ֑יל כְּ/מַשַּׁ֥ק גֵּבִ֖ים שׁוֹקֵ֥ק בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'sf shllkhm 'sf hchsyl khmshq gbym shvqq bv
verses.translation: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.

verses.original: נִשְׂגָּ֣ב יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י שֹׁכֵ֖ן מָר֑וֹם מִלֵּ֣א צִיּ֔וֹן מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּ/צְדָקָֽה
verses.translit: nshgb yhvh khy shkhn mrvm ml' tsyvn mshpt vtsdqh
verses.translation: The LORD is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ אֱמוּנַ֣ת עִתֶּ֔י/ךָ חֹ֥סֶן יְשׁוּעֹ֖ת חָכְמַ֣ת וָ/דָ֑עַת יִרְאַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה הִ֥יא אוֹצָרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhyh 'mvnt 'tykh chsn yshv't chkhmt vd't yr't yhvh hy' 'vtsrv
verses.translation: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, and strength of salvation: the fear of the LORD is his treasure.

verses.original: הֵ֚ן אֶרְאֶלָּ֔ם צָעֲק֖וּ חֻ֑צָ/ה מַלְאֲכֵ֣י שָׁל֔וֹם מַ֖ר יִבְכָּיֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: hn 'r'lm ts'qv chtsh ml'khy shlvm mr ybkhyvn
verses.translation: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.

verses.original: נָשַׁ֣מּוּ מְסִלּ֔וֹת שָׁבַ֖ת עֹבֵ֣ר אֹ֑רַח הֵפֵ֤ר בְּרִית֙ מָאַ֣ס עָרִ֔ים לֹ֥א חָשַׁ֖ב אֱנֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: nshmv mslvt shbt 'br 'rch hpr bryt m's 'rym l' chshb 'nvsh
verses.translation: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.

verses.original: אָבַ֤ל אֻמְלְלָה֙ אָ֔רֶץ הֶחְפִּ֥יר לְבָנ֖וֹן קָמַ֑ל הָיָ֤ה הַ/שָּׁרוֹן֙ כָּֽ/עֲרָבָ֔ה וְ/נֹעֵ֥ר בָּשָׁ֖ן וְ/כַרְמֶֽל
verses.translit: 'bl 'mllh 'rts hchpyr lbnvn qml hyh hshrvn kh'rbh vn'r bshn vkhrml
verses.translation: The earth mourneth and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits .

verses.original: עַתָּ֥ה אָק֖וּם יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה עַתָּה֙ אֵֽרוֹמָ֔ם עַתָּ֖ה אֶנָּשֵֽׂא
verses.translit: 'th 'qvm y'mr yhvh 'th 'rvmm 'th 'nsh'
verses.translation: Now will I rise, saith the LORD ; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.

verses.original: תַּהֲר֥וּ חֲשַׁ֖שׁ תֵּ֣לְדוּ קַ֑שׁ רוּחֲ/כֶ֕ם אֵ֖שׁ תֹּאכַלְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: thrv chshsh tldv qsh rvchkhm 'sh t'khlkhm
verses.translation: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath, as fire, shall devour you.

verses.original: וְ/הָי֥וּ עַמִּ֖ים מִשְׂרְפ֣וֹת שִׂ֑יד קוֹצִ֥ים כְּסוּחִ֖ים בָּ/אֵ֥שׁ יִצַּֽתּוּ
verses.translit: vhyv 'mym mshrpvt shyd qvtsym khsvchym b'sh ytstv
verses.translation: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ רְחוֹקִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑יתִי וּ/דְע֥וּ קְרוֹבִ֖ים גְּבֻרָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: shm'v rchvqym 'shr 'shyty vd'v qrvbym gbrty
verses.translation: Hear, ye that are far off, what I have done; and, ye that are near, acknowledge my might.

verses.original: פָּחֲד֤וּ בְ/צִיּוֹן֙ חַטָּאִ֔ים אָחֲזָ֥ה רְעָדָ֖ה חֲנֵפִ֑ים מִ֣י יָג֣וּר לָ֗/נוּ אֵ֚שׁ אוֹכֵלָ֔ה מִי יָג֥וּר לָ֖/נוּ מוֹקְדֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: pchdv btsyvn cht'ym 'chzh r'dh chnpym my ygvr lnv 'sh 'vkhlh my ygvr lnv mvqdy 'vlm
verses.translation: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?

verses.original: הֹלֵ֣ךְ צְדָק֔וֹת וְ/דֹבֵ֖ר מֵֽישָׁרִ֑ים מֹאֵ֞ס בְּ/בֶ֣צַע מַעֲשַׁקּ֗וֹת נֹעֵ֤ר כַּפָּי/ו֙ מִ/תְּמֹ֣ךְ בַּ/שֹּׁ֔חַד אֹטֵ֤ם אָזְנ/וֹ֙ מִ/שְּׁמֹ֣עַ דָּמִ֔ים וְ/עֹצֵ֥ם עֵינָ֖י/ו מֵ/רְא֥וֹת בְּ/רָֽע
verses.translit: hlkh tsdqvt vdbr myshrym m's bbts' m'shqvt n'r khpyv mtmkh bshchd 'tm 'znv mshm' dmym v'tsm 'ynyv mr'vt br'
verses.translation: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil;

verses.original: ה֚וּא מְרוֹמִ֣ים יִשְׁכֹּ֔ן מְצָד֥וֹת סְלָעִ֖ים מִשְׂגַּבּ֑/וֹ לַחְמ֣/וֹ נִתָּ֔ן מֵימָ֖י/ו נֶאֱמָנִֽים
verses.translit: hv' mrvmym yshkhn mtsdvt sl'ym mshgbv lchmv ntn mymyv n'mnym
verses.translation: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.

verses.original: מֶ֥לֶךְ בְּ/יָפְי֖/וֹ תֶּחֱזֶ֣ינָה עֵינֶ֑י/ךָ תִּרְאֶ֖ינָה אֶ֥רֶץ מַרְחַקִּֽים
verses.translit: mlkh bypyv tchzynh 'ynykh tr'ynh 'rts mrchqym
verses.translation: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.

verses.original: לִבְּ/ךָ֖ יֶהְגֶּ֣ה אֵימָ֑ה אַיֵּ֤ה סֹפֵר֙ אַיֵּ֣ה שֹׁקֵ֔ל אַיֵּ֖ה סֹפֵ֥ר אֶת הַ/מִּגְדָּלִֽים
verses.translit: lbkh yhgh 'ymh 'yh spr 'yh shql 'yh spr 't hmgdlym
verses.translation: Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?

verses.original: אֶת עַ֥ם נוֹעָ֖ז לֹ֣א תִרְאֶ֑ה עַ֣ם עִמְקֵ֤י שָׂפָה֙ מִ/שְּׁמ֔וֹעַ נִלְעַ֥ג לָשׁ֖וֹן אֵ֥ין בִּינָֽה
verses.translit: 't 'm nv'z l' tr'h 'm 'mqy shph mshmv' nl'g lshvn 'yn bynh
verses.translation: Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue, that thou canst not understand.

verses.original: חֲזֵ֣ה צִיּ֔וֹן קִרְיַ֖ת מֽוֹעֲדֵ֑/נוּ עֵינֶי/ךָ֩ תִרְאֶ֨ינָה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם נָוֶ֣ה שַׁאֲנָ֗ן אֹ֤הֶל בַּל יִצְעָן֙ בַּל יִסַּ֤ע יְתֵֽדֹתָי/ו֙ לָ/נֶ֔צַח וְ/כָל חֲבָלָ֖י/ו בַּל יִנָּתֵֽקוּ
verses.translit: chzh tsyvn qryt mv'dnv 'ynykh tr'ynh yrvshlm nvh sh'nn 'hl bl yts'n bl ys' ytdtyv lntsch vkhl chblyv bl yntqv
verses.translation: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם שָׁ֞ם אַדִּ֤יר יְהוָה֙ לָ֔/נוּ מְקוֹם נְהָרִ֥ים יְאֹרִ֖ים רַחֲבֵ֣י יָדָ֑יִם בַּל תֵּ֤לֶךְ בּ/וֹ֙ אֳנִי שַׁ֔יִט וְ/צִ֥י אַדִּ֖יר לֹ֥א יַעַבְרֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: khy 'm shm 'dyr yhvh lnv mqvm nhrym y'rym rchby ydym bl tlkh bv 'ny shyt vtsy 'dyr l' y'brnv
verses.translation: But there the glorious LORD will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.

verses.original: כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ שֹׁפְטֵ֔/נוּ יְהוָ֖ה מְחֹקְקֵ֑/נוּ יְהוָ֥ה מַלְכֵּ֖/נוּ ה֥וּא יוֹשִׁיעֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: khy yhvh shptnv yhvh mchqqnv yhvh mlkhnv hv' yvshy'nv
verses.translation: For the LORD is our judge, the LORD is our lawgiver, the LORD is our king; he will save us.

verses.original: נִטְּשׁ֖וּ חֲבָלָ֑יִ/ךְ בַּל יְחַזְּק֤וּ כֵן תָּרְנָ/ם֙ בַּל פָּ֣רְשׂוּ נֵ֔ס אָ֣ז חֻלַּ֤ק עַֽד שָׁלָל֙ מַרְבֶּ֔ה פִּסְחִ֖ים בָּ֥זְזוּ בַֽז
verses.translit: ntshv chblykh bl ychzqv khn trnm bl prshv ns 'z chlq 'd shll mrbh pschym bzzv bz
verses.translation: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.

verses.original: וּ/בַל יֹאמַ֥ר שָׁכֵ֖ן חָלִ֑יתִי הָ/עָ֛ם הַ/יֹּשֵׁ֥ב בָּ֖/הּ נְשֻׂ֥א עָוֺֽן
verses.translit: vbl y'mr shkhn chlyty h'm hyshb bh nsh' 'vn
verses.translation: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.

verses.original: קִרְב֤וּ גוֹיִם֙ לִ/שְׁמֹ֔עַ וּ/לְאֻמִּ֖ים הַקְשִׁ֑יבוּ תִּשְׁמַ֤ע הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ וּ/מְלֹאָ֔/הּ תֵּבֵ֖ל וְ/כָל צֶאֱצָאֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: qrbv gvym lshm' vl'mym hqshybv tshm' h'rts vml'h tbl vkhl ts'ts'yh
verses.translation: Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.

verses.original: כִּ֣י קֶ֤צֶף לַֽ/יהוָה֙ עַל כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/חֵמָ֖ה עַל כָּל צְבָאָ֑/ם הֶחֱרִימָ֖/ם נְתָנָ֥/ם לַ/טָּֽבַח
verses.translit: khy qtsf lyhvh 'l khl hgvym vchmh 'l khl tsb'm hchrymm ntnm ltbch
verses.translation: For the indignation of the LORD is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.

verses.original: וְ/חַלְלֵי/הֶ֣ם יֻשְׁלָ֔כוּ וּ/פִגְרֵי/הֶ֖ם יַעֲלֶ֣ה בָאְשָׁ֑/ם וְ/נָמַ֥סּוּ הָרִ֖ים מִ/דָּמָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vchllyhm yshlkhv vpgryhm y'lh b'shm vnmsv hrym mdmm
verses.translation: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.

verses.original: וְ/נָמַ֨קּוּ֙ כָּל צְבָ֣א הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/נָגֹ֥לּוּ כַ/סֵּ֖פֶר הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ/כָל צְבָאָ֣/ם יִבּ֔וֹל כִּ/נְבֹ֤ל עָלֶה֙ מִ/גֶּ֔פֶן וּ/כְ/נֹבֶ֖לֶת מִ/תְּאֵנָֽה
verses.translit: vnmqv khl tsb' hshmym vnglv khspr hshmym vkhl tsb'm ybvl khnbl 'lh mgpn vkhnblt mt'nh
verses.translation: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.

verses.original: כִּֽי רִוְּתָ֥ה בַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם חַרְבִּ֑/י הִנֵּה֙ עַל אֱד֣וֹם תֵּרֵ֔ד וְ/עַל עַ֥ם חֶרְמִ֖/י לְ/מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: khy rvth bshmym chrby hnh 'l 'dvm trd v'l 'm chrmy lmshpt
verses.translation: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.

verses.original: חֶ֣רֶב לַ/יהוָ֞ה מָלְאָ֥ה דָם֙ הֻדַּ֣שְׁנָה מֵ/חֵ֔לֶב מִ/דַּ֤ם כָּרִים֙ וְ/עַתּוּדִ֔ים מֵ/חֵ֖לֶב כִּלְי֣וֹת אֵילִ֑ים כִּ֣י זֶ֤בַח לַֽ/יהוָה֙ בְּ/בָצְרָ֔ה וְ/טֶ֥בַח גָּד֖וֹל בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם
verses.translit: chrb lyhvh ml'h dm hdshnh mchlb mdm khrym v'tvdym mchlb khlyvt 'ylym khy zbch lyhvh bbtsrh vtbch gdvl b'rts 'dvm
verses.translation: The sword of the LORD is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the LORD hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.

verses.original: וְ/יָרְד֤וּ רְאֵמִים֙ עִמָּ֔/ם וּ/פָרִ֖ים עִם אַבִּירִ֑ים וְ/רִוְּתָ֤ה אַרְצָ/ם֙ מִ/דָּ֔ם וַ/עֲפָרָ֖/ם מֵ/חֵ֥לֶב יְדֻשָּֽׁן
verses.translit: vyrdv r'mym 'mm vprym 'm 'byrym vrvth 'rtsm mdm v'prm mchlb ydshn
verses.translation: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.

verses.original: כִּ֛י י֥וֹם נָקָ֖ם לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה שְׁנַ֥ת שִׁלּוּמִ֖ים לְ/רִ֥יב צִיּֽוֹן
verses.translit: khy yvm nqm lyhvh shnt shlvmym lryb tsyvn
verses.translation: For it is the day of the LORD’s vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.

verses.original: וְ/נֶהֶפְכ֤וּ נְחָלֶ֨י/הָ֙ לְ/זֶ֔פֶת וַ/עֲפָרָ֖/הּ לְ/גָפְרִ֑ית וְ/הָיְתָ֣ה אַרְצָ֔/הּ לְ/זֶ֖פֶת בֹּעֵרָֽה
verses.translit: vnhpkhv nchlyh lzpt v'prh lgpryt vhyth 'rtsh lzpt b'rh
verses.translation: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.

verses.original: לַ֤יְלָה וְ/יוֹמָם֙ לֹ֣א תִכְבֶּ֔ה לְ/עוֹלָ֖ם יַעֲלֶ֣ה עֲשָׁנָ֑/הּ מִ/דּ֤וֹר לָ/דוֹר֙ תֶּחֱרָ֔ב לְ/נֵ֣צַח נְצָחִ֔ים אֵ֥ין עֹבֵ֖ר בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: lylh vyvmm l' tkhbh l'vlm y'lh 'shnh mdvr ldvr tchrb lntsch ntschym 'yn 'br bh
verses.translation: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.

verses.original: וִ/ירֵשׁ֨וּ/הָ֙ קָאַ֣ת וְ/קִפּ֔וֹד וְ/יַנְשׁ֥וֹף וְ/עֹרֵ֖ב יִשְׁכְּנוּ בָ֑/הּ וְ/נָטָ֥ה עָלֶ֛י/הָ קַֽו תֹ֖הוּ וְ/אַבְנֵי בֹֽהוּ
verses.translit: vyrshvh q't vqpvd vynshvf v'rb yshkhnv bh vnth 'lyh qv thv v'bny bhv
verses.translation: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.

verses.original: חֹרֶ֥י/הָ וְ/אֵֽין שָׁ֖ם מְלוּכָ֣ה יִקְרָ֑אוּ וְ/כָל שָׂרֶ֖י/הָ יִ֥הְיוּ אָֽפֶס
verses.translit: chryh v'yn shm mlvkhh yqr'v vkhl shryh yhyv 'ps
verses.translation: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.

verses.original: וְ/עָלְתָ֤ה אַרְמְנֹתֶ֨י/הָ֙ סִירִ֔ים קִמּ֥וֹשׂ וָ/ח֖וֹחַ בְּ/מִבְצָרֶ֑י/הָ וְ/הָיְתָה֙ נְוֵ֣ה תַנִּ֔ים חָצִ֖יר לִ/בְנ֥וֹת יַעֲנָֽה
verses.translit: v'lth 'rmntyh syrym qmvsh vchvch bmbtsryh vhyth nvh tnym chtsyr lbnvt y'nh
verses.translation: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, and a court for owls.

verses.original: וּ/פָגְשׁ֤וּ צִיִּים֙ אֶת אִיִּ֔ים וְ/שָׂעִ֖יר עַל רֵעֵ֣/הוּ יִקְרָ֑א אַךְ שָׁם֙ הִרְגִּ֣יעָה לִּילִ֔ית וּ/מָצְאָ֥ה לָ֖/הּ מָנֽוֹחַ
verses.translit: vpgshv tsyym 't 'yym vsh'yr 'l r'hv yqr' 'kh shm hrgy'h lylyt vmts'h lh mnvch
verses.translation: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.

verses.original: שָׁ֣מָּ/ה קִנְּנָ֤ה קִפּוֹז֙ וַ/תְּמַלֵּ֔ט וּ/בָקְעָ֖ה וְ/דָגְרָ֣ה בְ/צִלָּ֑/הּ אַךְ שָׁ֛ם נִקְבְּצ֥וּ דַיּ֖וֹת אִשָּׁ֥ה רְעוּתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: shmh qnnh qpvz vtmlt vbq'h vdgrh btslh 'kh shm nqbtsv dyvt 'shh r'vth
verses.translation: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.

verses.original: דִּרְשׁ֨וּ מֵֽ/עַל סֵ֤פֶר יְהוָה֙ וּֽ/קְרָ֔אוּ אַחַ֤ת מֵ/הֵ֨נָּה֙ לֹ֣א נֶעְדָּ֔רָה אִשָּׁ֥ה רְעוּתָ֖/הּ לֹ֣א פָקָ֑דוּ כִּֽי פִ/י֙ ה֣וּא צִוָּ֔ה וְ/רוּח֖/וֹ ה֥וּא קִבְּצָֽ/ן
verses.translit: drshv m'l spr yhvh vqr'v 'cht mhnh l' n'drh 'shh r'vth l' pqdv khy py hv' tsvh vrvchv hv' qbtsn
verses.translation: Seek ye out of the book of the LORD , and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.

verses.original: וְ/הֽוּא הִפִּ֤יל לָ/הֶן֙ גּוֹרָ֔ל וְ/יָד֛/וֹ חִלְּקַ֥תָּ/ה לָ/הֶ֖ם בַּ/קָּ֑ו עַד עוֹלָם֙ יִֽירָשׁ֔וּ/הָ לְ/ד֥וֹר וָ/ד֖וֹר יִשְׁכְּנוּ בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vhv' hpyl lhn gvrl vydv chlqth lhm bqv 'd 'vlm yyrshvh ldvr vdvr yshkhnv bh
verses.translation: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.

verses.original: יְשֻׂשׂ֥וּ/ם מִדְבָּ֖ר וְ/צִיָּ֑ה וְ/תָגֵ֧ל עֲרָבָ֛ה וְ/תִפְרַ֖ח כַּ/חֲבַצָּֽלֶת
verses.translit: yshshvm mdbr vtsyh vtgl 'rbh vtprch khchbtslt
verses.translation: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.

verses.original: פָּרֹ֨חַ תִּפְרַ֜ח וְ/תָגֵ֗ל אַ֚ף גִּילַ֣ת וְ/רַנֵּ֔ן כְּב֤וֹד הַ/לְּבָנוֹן֙ נִתַּן לָ֔/הּ הֲדַ֥ר הַ/כַּרְמֶ֖ל וְ/הַ/שָּׁר֑וֹן הֵ֛מָּה יִרְא֥וּ כְבוֹד יְהוָ֖ה הֲדַ֥ר אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: prch tprch vtgl 'f gylt vrnn khbvd hlbnvn ntn lh hdr hkhrml vhshrvn hmh yr'v khbvd yhvh hdr 'lhynv
verses.translation: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the LORD , and the excellency of our God.

verses.original: חַזְּק֖וּ יָדַ֣יִם רָפ֑וֹת וּ/בִרְכַּ֥יִם כֹּשְׁל֖וֹת אַמֵּֽצוּ
verses.translit: chzqv ydym rpvt vbrkhym khshlvt 'mtsv
verses.translation: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.

verses.original: אִמְרוּ֙ לְ/נִמְהֲרֵי לֵ֔ב חִזְק֖וּ אַל תִּירָ֑אוּ הִנֵּ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶם֙ נָקָ֣ם יָב֔וֹא גְּמ֣וּל אֱלֹהִ֔ים ה֥וּא יָב֖וֹא וְ/יֹשַׁעֲ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'mrv lnmhry lb chzqv 'l tyr'v hnh 'lhykhm nqm ybv' gmvl 'lhym hv' ybv' vysh'khm
verses.translation: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompence; he will come and save you.

verses.original: אָ֥ז תִּפָּקַ֖חְנָה עֵינֵ֣י עִוְרִ֑ים וְ/אָזְנֵ֥י חֵרְשִׁ֖ים תִּפָּתַֽחְנָה
verses.translit: 'z tpqchnh 'yny 'vrym v'zny chrshym tptchnh
verses.translation: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.

verses.original: אָ֣ז יְדַלֵּ֤ג כָּֽ/אַיָּל֙ פִּסֵּ֔חַ וְ/תָרֹ֖ן לְשׁ֣וֹן אִלֵּ֑ם כִּֽי נִבְקְע֤וּ בַ/מִּדְבָּר֙ מַ֔יִם וּ/נְחָלִ֖ים בָּ/עֲרָבָֽה
verses.translit: 'z ydlg kh'yl psch vtrn lshvn 'lm khy nbq'v bmdbr mym vnchlym b'rbh
verses.translation: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֤ה הַ/שָּׁרָב֙ לַ/אֲגַ֔ם וְ/צִמָּא֖וֹן לְ/מַבּ֣וּעֵי מָ֑יִם בִּ/נְוֵ֤ה תַנִּים֙ רִבְצָ֔/הּ חָצִ֖יר לְ/קָנֶ֥ה וָ/גֹֽמֶא
verses.translit: vhyh hshrb l'gm vtsm'vn lmbv'y mym bnvh tnym rbtsh chtsyr lqnh vgm'
verses.translation: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, shall be grass with reeds and rushes.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה שָׁ֞ם מַסְל֣וּל וָ/דֶ֗רֶךְ וְ/דֶ֤רֶךְ הַ/קֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ יִקָּ֣רֵא לָ֔/הּ לֹֽא יַעַבְרֶ֥/נּוּ טָמֵ֖א וְ/הוּא לָ֑/מוֹ הֹלֵ֥ךְ דֶּ֛רֶךְ וֶ/אֱוִילִ֖ים לֹ֥א יִתְעֽוּ
verses.translit: vhyh shm mslvl vdrkh vdrkh hqdsh yqr' lh l' y'brnv tm' vhv' lmv hlkh drkh v'vylym l' yt'v
verses.translation: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein .

verses.original: לֹא יִהְיֶ֨ה שָׁ֜ם אַרְיֵ֗ה וּ/פְרִ֤יץ חַיּוֹת֙ בַּֽל יַעֲלֶ֔/נָּה לֹ֥א תִמָּצֵ֖א שָׁ֑ם וְ/הָלְכ֖וּ גְּאוּלִֽים
verses.translit: l' yhyh shm 'ryh vpryts chyvt bl y'lnh l' tmts' shm vhlkhv g'vlym
verses.translation: No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there:

verses.original: וּ/פְדוּיֵ֨י יְהוָ֜ה יְשֻׁב֗וּ/ן וּ/בָ֤אוּ צִיּוֹן֙ בְּ/רִנָּ֔ה וְ/שִׂמְחַ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם עַל רֹאשָׁ֑/ם שָׂשׂ֤וֹן וְ/שִׂמְחָה֙ יַשִּׂ֔יגוּ וְ/נָ֖סוּ יָג֥וֹן וַ/אֲנָחָֽה
verses.translit: vpdvyy yhvh yshbvn vb'v tsyvn brnh vshmcht 'vlm 'l r'shm shshvn vshmchh yshygv vnsv ygvn v'nchh
verses.translation: And the ransomed of the LORD shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֡י בְּ/אַרְבַּע֩ עֶשְׂרֵ֨ה שָׁנָ֜ה לַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ עָלָ֞ה סַנְחֵרִ֤יב מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר֙ עַ֣ל כָּל עָרֵ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה הַ/בְּצֻר֖וֹת וַֽ/יִּתְפְּשֵֽׂ/ם
verses.translit: vyhy b'rb' 'shrh shnh lmlkh chzqyhv 'lh snchryb mlkh 'shvr 'l khl 'ry yhvdh hbtsrvt vytpshm
verses.translation: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Judah, and took them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֣וּר אֶת רַב שָׁקֵ֨ה מִ/לָּכִ֧ישׁ יְרוּשָׁלְַ֛מָ/ה אֶל הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּ/חֵ֣יל כָּבֵ֑ד וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹ֗ד בִּ/תְעָלַת֙ הַ/בְּרֵכָ֣ה הָ/עֶלְיוֹנָ֔ה בִּ/מְסִלַּ֖ת שְׂדֵ֥ה כוֹבֵֽס
verses.translit: vyshlch mlkh 'shvr 't rb shqh mlkhysh yrvshlmh 'l hmlkh chzqyhv bchyl khbd vy'md bt'lt hbrkhh h'lyvnh bmslt shdh khvbs
verses.translation: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller’s field.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֥א אֵלָ֛י/ו אֶלְיָקִ֥ים בֶּן חִלְקִיָּ֖הוּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הַ/בָּ֑יִת וְ/שֶׁבְנָא֙ הַ/סֹּפֵ֔ר וְ/יוֹאָ֥ח בֶּן אָסָ֖ף הַ/מַּזְכִּֽיר
verses.translit: vyts' 'lyv 'lyqym bn chlqyhv 'shr 'l hbyt vshbn' hspr vyv'ch bn 'sf hmzkhyr
verses.translation: Then came forth unto him Eliakim, Hilkiah’s son, which was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph’s son, the recorder.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ רַב שָׁקֵ֔ה אִמְרוּ נָ֖א אֶל חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר הַ/מֶּ֤לֶךְ הַ/גָּדוֹל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר מָ֧ה הַ/בִּטָּח֛וֹן הַ/זֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּטָֽחְתָּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm rb shqh 'mrv n' 'l chzqyhv khh 'mr hmlkh hgdvl mlkh 'shvr mh hbtchvn hzh 'shr btcht
verses.translation: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?

verses.original: אָמַ֨רְתִּי֙ אַךְ דְּבַר שְׂפָתַ֔יִם עֵצָ֥ה וּ/גְבוּרָ֖ה לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה עַתָּה֙ עַל מִ֣י בָטַ֔חְתָּ כִּ֥י מָרַ֖דְתָּ בִּֽ/י
verses.translit: 'mrty 'kh dbr shptym 'tsh vgbvrh lmlchmh 'th 'l my btcht khy mrdt by
verses.translation: I say, sayest thou , (but they are but vain words) I have counsel and strength for war: now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה בָטַ֡חְתָּ עַל מִשְׁעֶנֶת֩ הַ/קָּנֶ֨ה הָ/רָצ֤וּץ הַ/זֶּה֙ עַל מִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִסָּמֵ֥ךְ אִישׁ֙ עָלָ֔י/ו וּ/בָ֥א בְ/כַפּ֖/וֹ וּ/נְקָבָ֑/הּ כֵּ֚ן פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם לְ/כָֽל הַ/בֹּטְחִ֖ים עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hnh btcht 'l msh'nt hqnh hrtsvts hzh 'l mtsrym 'shr ysmkh 'ysh 'lyv vb' bkhpv vnqbh khn pr'h mlkh mtsrym lkhl hbtchym 'lyv
verses.translation: Lo, thou trustest in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.

verses.original: וְ/כִי תֹאמַ֣ר אֵלַ֔/י אֶל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ בָּטָ֑חְנוּ הֲ/לוֹא ה֗וּא אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵסִ֤יר חִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ אֶת בָּמֹתָ֣י/ו וְ/אֶת מִזְבְּחֹתָ֔י/ו וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לִֽ/יהוּדָה֙ וְ/לִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לִ/פְנֵ֛י הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֥חַ הַ/זֶּ֖ה תִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֽוּ
verses.translit: vkhy t'mr 'ly 'l yhvh 'lhynv btchnv hlv' hv' 'shr hsyr chzqyhv 't bmtyv v't mzbchtyv vy'mr lyhvdh vlyrvshlm lpny hmzbch hzh tshtchvv
verses.translation: But if thou say to me, We trust in the LORD our God: is it not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar?

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ הִתְעָ֣רֶב נָ֔א אֶת אֲדֹנִ֖/י הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר וְ/אֶתְּנָ֤ה לְ/ךָ֙ אַלְפַּ֣יִם סוּסִ֔ים אִם תּוּכַ֕ל לָ֥/תֶת לְ/ךָ֖ רֹכְבִ֥ים עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th ht'rb n' 't 'dny hmlkh 'shvr v'tnh lkh 'lpym svsym 'm tvkhl ltt lkh rkhbym 'lyhm
verses.translation: Now therefore give pledges, I pray thee, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣יךְ תָּשִׁ֗יב אֵ֠ת פְּנֵ֨י פַחַ֥ת אַחַ֛ד עַבְדֵ֥י אֲדֹנִ֖/י הַ/קְטַנִּ֑ים וַ/תִּבְטַ֤ח לְ/ךָ֙ עַל מִצְרַ֔יִם לְ/רֶ֖כֶב וּ/לְ/פָרָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: v'ykh tshyb 't pny pcht 'chd 'bdy 'dny hqtnym vtbtch lkh 'l mtsrym lrkhb vlprshym
verses.translation: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ הֲ/מִ/בַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה עָלִ֛יתִי עַל הָ/אָ֥רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֖את לְ/הַשְׁחִיתָ֑/הּ יְהוָה֙ אָמַ֣ר אֵלַ֔/י עֲלֵ֛ה אֶל הָ/אָ֥רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֖את וְ/הַשְׁחִיתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'th hmbl'dy yhvh 'lyty 'l h'rts hz't lhshchyth yhvh 'mr 'ly 'lh 'l h'rts hz't vhshchyth
verses.translation: And am I now come up without the LORD against this land to destroy it? the LORD said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶלְיָקִים֩ וְ/שֶׁבְנָ֨א וְ/יוֹאָ֜ח אֶל רַב שָׁקֵ֗ה דַּבֶּר נָ֤א אֶל עֲבָדֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֲרָמִ֔ית כִּ֥י שֹׁמְעִ֖ים אֲנָ֑חְנוּ וְ/אַל תְּדַבֵּ֤ר אֵלֵ֨י/נוּ֙ יְהוּדִ֔ית בְּ/אָזְנֵ֣י הָ/עָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל הַ/חוֹמָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyqym vshbn' vyv'ch 'l rb shqh dbr n' 'l 'bdykh 'rmyt khy shm'ym 'nchnv v'l tdbr 'lynv yhvdyt b'zny h'm 'shr 'l hchvmh
verses.translation: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, unto thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and speak not to us in the Jews’ language, in the ears of the people that are on the wall.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר רַב שָׁקֵ֗ה הַ/אֶ֨ל אֲדֹנֶ֤י/ךָ וְ/אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ שְׁלָחַ֣/נִי אֲדֹנִ֔/י לְ/דַבֵּ֖ר אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה הֲ/לֹ֣א עַל הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֗ים הַ/יֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ עַל הַ֣/חוֹמָ֔ה לֶ/אֱכֹ֣ל אֶת חראי/הם צוֹאָתָ֗/ם וְ/לִ/שְׁתּ֛וֹת אֶת שיני/הם מֵימֵ֥י רַגְלֵי/הֶ֖ם עִמָּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr rb shqh h'l 'dnykh v'lykh shlchny 'dny ldbr 't hdbrym h'lh hl' 'l h'nshym hyshbym 'l hchvmh l'khl 't chr'yhm tsv'tm vlshtvt 't shynyhm mymy rglyhm 'mkhm
verses.translation: But Rabshakeh said, Hath my master sent me to thy master and to thee to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹד֙ רַב שָׁקֵ֔ה וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א בְ/קוֹל גָּד֖וֹל יְהוּדִ֑ית וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר שִׁמְע֗וּ אֶת דִּבְרֵ֛י הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ הַ/גָּד֖וֹל מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר
verses.translit: vy'md rb shqh vyqr' bqvl gdvl yhvdyt vy'mr shm'v 't dbry hmlkh hgdvl mlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and said, Hear ye the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ אַל יַשִּׁ֥א לָ/כֶ֖ם חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ כִּ֥י לֹֽא יוּכַ֖ל לְ/הַצִּ֥יל אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khh 'mr hmlkh 'l ysh' lkhm chzqyhv khy l' yvkhl lhtsyl 'tkhm
verses.translation: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.

verses.original: וְ/אַל יַבְטַ֨ח אֶתְ/כֶ֤ם חִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ אֶל יְהוָ֣ה לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הַצֵּ֥ל יַצִּילֵ֖/נוּ יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֤א תִנָּתֵן֙ הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את בְּ/יַ֖ד מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר
verses.translit: v'l ybtch 'tkhm chzqyhv 'l yhvh l'mr htsl ytsylnv yhvh l' tntn h'yr hz't byd mlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD , saying, The LORD will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

verses.original: אַֽל תִּשְׁמְע֖וּ אֶל חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֗וּר עֲשֽׂוּ אִתִּ֤/י בְרָכָה֙ וּ/צְא֣וּ אֵלַ֔/י וְ/אִכְל֤וּ אִישׁ גַּפְנ/וֹ֙ וְ/אִ֣ישׁ תְּאֵנָת֔/וֹ וּ/שְׁת֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ מֵי בוֹרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'l tshm'v 'l chzqyhv khy khh 'mr hmlkh 'shvr 'shv 'ty brkhh vts'v 'ly v'khlv 'ysh gpnv v'ysh t'ntv vshtv 'ysh my bvrv
verses.translation: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me: and eat ye every one of his vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern;

verses.original: עַד בֹּאִ֕/י וְ/לָקַחְתִּ֥י אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ כְּ/אַרְצְ/כֶ֑ם אֶ֤רֶץ דָּגָן֙ וְ/תִיר֔וֹשׁ אֶ֥רֶץ לֶ֖חֶם וּ/כְרָמִֽים
verses.translit: 'd b'y vlqchty 'tkhm 'l 'rts kh'rtskhm 'rts dgn vtyrvsh 'rts lchm vkhrmym
verses.translation: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

verses.original: פֶּן יַסִּ֨ית אֶתְ/כֶ֤ם חִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר יְהוָ֖ה יַצִּילֵ֑/נוּ הַ/הִצִּ֜ילוּ אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַ/גּוֹיִם֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת אַרְצ֔/וֹ מִ/יַּ֖ד מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר
verses.translit: pn ysyt 'tkhm chzqyhv l'mr yhvh ytsylnv hhtsylv 'lhy hgvym 'ysh 't 'rtsv myd mlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, The LORD will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

verses.original: אַיֵּ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י חֲמָת֙ וְ/אַרְפָּ֔ד אַיֵּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י סְפַרְוָ֑יִם וְ/כִֽי הִצִּ֥ילוּ אֶת שֹׁמְר֖וֹן מִ/יָּדִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'yh 'lhy chmt v'rpd 'yh 'lhy sprvym vkhy htsylv 't shmrvn mydy
verses.translation: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arphad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?

verses.original: מִ֗י בְּ/כָל אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָֽ/אֲרָצוֹת֙ הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר הִצִּ֥ילוּ אֶת אַרְצָ֖/ם מִ/יָּדִ֑/י כִּֽי יַצִּ֧יל יְהוָ֛ה אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם מִ/יָּדִֽ/י
verses.translit: my bkhl 'lhy h'rtsvt h'lh 'shr htsylv 't 'rtsm mydy khy ytsyl yhvh 't yrvshlm mydy
verses.translation: Who are they among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּחֲרִ֔ישׁוּ וְ/לֹֽא עָנ֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ דָּבָ֑ר כִּֽי מִצְוַ֨ת הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ הִ֛יא לֵ/אמֹ֖ר לֹ֥א תַעֲנֻֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vychryshv vl' 'nv 'tv dbr khy mtsvt hmlkh hy' l'mr l' t'nhv
verses.translation: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king’s commandment was, saying, Answer him not.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣א אֶלְיָקִ֣ים בֶּן חִלְקִיָּ֣הוּ אֲשֶׁר עַל הַ֠/בַּיִת וְ/שֶׁבְנָ֨א הַ/סּוֹפֵ֜ר וְ/יוֹאָ֨ח בֶּן אָסָ֧ף הַ/מַּזְכִּ֛יר אֶל חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ קְרוּעֵ֣י בְגָדִ֑ים וַ/יַּגִּ֣ידוּ ל֔/וֹ אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֥י רַב שָׁקֵֽה
verses.translit: vyb' 'lyqym bn chlqyhv 'shr 'l hbyt vshbn' hsvpr vyv'ch bn 'sf hmzkhyr 'l chzqyhv qrv'y bgdym vygydv lv 't dbry rb shqh
verses.translation: Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כִּ/שְׁמֹ֨עַ֙ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ וַ/יִּקְרַ֖ע אֶת בְּגָדָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּתְכַּ֣ס בַּ/שָּׂ֔ק וַ/יָּבֹ֖א בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy khshm' hmlkh chzqyhv vyqr' 't bgdyv vytkhs bshq vyb' byt yhvh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it , that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ֠/יִּשְׁלַח אֶת אֶלְיָקִ֨ים אֲשֶׁר עַל הַ/בַּ֜יִת וְ/אֵ֣ת שֶׁבְנָ֣א הַ/סּוֹפֵ֗ר וְ/אֵת֙ זִקְנֵ֣י הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֔ים מִתְכַּסִּ֖ים בַּ/שַּׂקִּ֑ים אֶל יְשַֽׁעְיָ֥הוּ בֶן אָמ֖וֹץ הַ/נָּבִֽיא
verses.translit: vyshlch 't 'lyqym 'shr 'l hbyt v't shbn' hsvpr v't zqny hkhhnym mtkhsym bshqym 'l ysh'yhv bn 'mvts hnby'
verses.translation: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗י/ו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ יוֹם צָרָ֧ה וְ/תוֹכֵחָ֛ה וּ/נְאָצָ֖ה הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה כִּ֣י בָ֤אוּ בָנִים֙ עַד מַשְׁבֵּ֔ר וְ/כֹ֥חַ אַ֖יִן לְ/לֵדָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv khh 'mr chzqyhv yvm tsrh vtvkhchh vn'tsh hyvm hzh khy b'v bnym 'd mshbr vkhch 'yn lldh
verses.translation: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.

verses.original: אוּלַ֡י יִשְׁמַע֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜י/ךָ אֵ֣ת דִּבְרֵ֣י רַב שָׁקֵ֗ה אֲשֶׁר֩ שְׁלָח֨/וֹ מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֤וּר אֲדֹנָי/ו֙ לְ/חָרֵף֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים חַ֔י וְ/הוֹכִ֨יחַ֙ בַּ/דְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמַ֖ע יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/נָשָׂ֣אתָ תְפִלָּ֔ה בְּעַ֥ד הַ/שְּׁאֵרִ֖ית הַ/נִּמְצָאָֽה
verses.translit: 'vly yshm' yhvh 'lhykh 't dbry rb shqh 'shr shlchv mlkh 'shvr 'dnyv lchrf 'lhym chy vhvkhych bdbrym 'shr shm' yhvh 'lhykh vnsh't tplh b'd hsh'ryt hnmts'h
verses.translation: It may be the LORD thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God, and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֗אוּ עַבְדֵ֛י הַ/מֶּ֥לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ אֶל יְשַׁעְיָֽהוּ
verses.translit: vyb'v 'bdy hmlkh chzqyhv 'l ysh'yhv
verses.translation: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֔הוּ כֹּ֥ה תֹאמְר֖וּ/ן אֶל אֲדֹנֵי/כֶ֑ם כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אַל תִּירָא֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֤י הַ/דְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֔עְתָּ אֲשֶׁ֧ר גִּדְּפ֛וּ נַעֲרֵ֥י מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁ֖וּר אוֹתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm ysh'yhv khh t'mrvn 'l 'dnykhm khh 'mr yhvh 'l tyr' mpny hdbrym 'shr shm't 'shr gdpv n'ry mlkh 'shvr 'vty
verses.translation: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say unto your master, Thus saith the LORD , Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֨י נוֹתֵ֥ן בּ/וֹ֙ ר֔וּחַ וְ/שָׁמַ֥ע שְׁמוּעָ֖ה וְ/שָׁ֣ב אֶל אַרְצ֑/וֹ וְ/הִפַּלְתִּ֥י/ו בַּ/חֶ֖רֶב בְּ/אַרְצֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hnny nvtn bv rvch vshm' shmv'h vshb 'l 'rtsv vhpltyv bchrb b'rtsv
verses.translation: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨שָׁב֙ רַב שָׁקֵ֔ה וַ/יִּמְצָא֙ אֶת מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר נִלְחָ֖ם עַל לִבְנָ֑ה כִּ֣י שָׁמַ֔ע כִּ֥י נָסַ֖ע מִ/לָּכִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vyshb rb shqh vymts' 't mlkh 'shvr nlchm 'l lbnh khy shm' khy ns' mlkhysh
verses.translation: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֗ע עַל תִּרְהָ֤קָה מֶֽלֶךְ כּוּשׁ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר יָצָ֖א לְ/הִלָּחֵ֣ם אִתָּ֑/ךְ וַ/יִּשְׁמַע֙ וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyshm' 'l trhqh mlkh khvsh l'mr yts' lhlchm 'tkh vyshm' vyshlch ml'khym 'l chzqyhv l'mr
verses.translation: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, He is come forth to make war with thee. And when he heard it , he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה תֹאמְר֗וּ/ן אֶל חִזְקִיָּ֤הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אַל יַשִּֽׁאֲ/ךָ֣ אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֛ה בּוֹטֵ֥חַ בּ֖/וֹ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לֹ֤א תִנָּתֵן֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בְּ/יַ֖ד מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר
verses.translit: khh t'mrvn 'l chzqyhv mlkh yhvdh l'mr 'l ysh'kh 'lhykh 'shr 'th bvtch bv l'mr l' tntn yrvshlm byd mlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God, in whom thou trustest, deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה אַתָּ֣ה שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשׂ֜וּ מַלְכֵ֥י אַשּׁ֛וּר לְ/כָל הָ/אֲרָצ֖וֹת לְ/הַחֲרִימָ֑/ם וְ/אַתָּ֖ה תִּנָּצֵֽל
verses.translit: hnh 'th shm't 'shr 'shv mlkhy 'shvr lkhl h'rtsvt lhchrymm v'th tntsl
verses.translation: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly; and shalt thou be delivered?

verses.original: הַ/הִצִּ֨ילוּ אוֹתָ֜/ם אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַ/גּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִשְׁחִ֣יתוּ אֲבוֹתַ֔/י אֶת גּוֹזָ֖ן וְ/אֶת חָרָ֑ן וְ/רֶ֥צֶף וּ/בְנֵי עֶ֖דֶן אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּ/תְלַשָּֽׂר
verses.translit: hhtsylv 'vtm 'lhy hgvym 'shr hshchytv 'bvty 't gvzn v't chrn vrtsf vbny 'dn 'shr btlshr
verses.translation: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed, as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Telassar?

verses.original: אַיֵּ֤ה מֶֽלֶךְ חֲמָת֙ וּ/מֶ֣לֶךְ אַרְפָּ֔ד וּ/מֶ֖לֶךְ לָעִ֣יר סְפַרְוָ֑יִם הֵנַ֖ע וְ/עִוָּֽה
verses.translit: 'yh mlkh chmt vmlkh 'rpd vmlkh l'yr sprvym hn' v'vh
verses.translation: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח חִזְקִיָּ֧הוּ אֶת הַ/סְּפָרִ֛ים מִ/יַּ֥ד הַ/מַּלְאָכִ֖ים וַ/יִּקְרָאֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יַּ֨עַל֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יִּפְרְשֵׂ֥/הוּ חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqch chzqyhv 't hsprym myd hml'khym vyqr'hv vy'l byt yhvh vyprshhv chzqyhv lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the LORD , and spread it before the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְפַּלֵּל֙ חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ אֶל יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vytpll chzqyhv 'l yhvh l'mr
verses.translation: And Hezekiah prayed unto the LORD , saying,

verses.original: יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב הַ/כְּרֻבִ֔ים אַתָּה ה֤וּא הָֽ/אֱלֹהִים֙ לְ/בַדְּ/ךָ֔ לְ/כֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ אַתָּ֣ה עָשִׂ֔יתָ אֶת הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וְ/אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l yshb hkhrbym 'th hv' h'lhym lbdkh lkhl mmlkhvt h'rts 'th 'shyt 't hshmym v't h'rts
verses.translation: O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, that dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: thou hast made heaven and earth.

verses.original: הַטֵּ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אָזְנְ/ךָ֙ וּֽ/שְׁמָ֔ע פְּקַ֧ח יְהוָ֛ה עֵינֶ֖/ךָ וּ/רְאֵ֑ה וּ/שְׁמַ֗ע אֵ֚ת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֣י סַנְחֵרִ֔יב אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁלַ֔ח לְ/חָרֵ֖ף אֱלֹהִ֥ים חָֽי
verses.translit: hth yhvh 'znkh vshm' pqch yhvh 'ynkh vr'h vshm' 't khl dbry snchryb 'shr shlch lchrf 'lhym chy
verses.translation: Incline thine ear, O LORD , and hear; open thine eyes, O LORD , and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent to reproach the living God.

verses.original: אָמְנָ֖ם יְהוָ֑ה הֶחֱרִ֜יבוּ מַלְכֵ֥י אַשּׁ֛וּר אֶת כָּל הָ/אֲרָצ֖וֹת וְ/אֶת אַרְצָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'mnm yhvh hchrybv mlkhy 'shvr 't khl h'rtsvt v't 'rtsm
verses.translation: Of a truth, LORD , the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,

verses.original: וְ/נָתֹ֥ן אֶת אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֖ם בָּ/אֵ֑שׁ כִּי֩ לֹ֨א אֱלֹהִ֜ים הֵ֗מָּה כִּ֣י אִם מַעֲשֵׂ֧ה יְדֵֽי אָדָ֛ם עֵ֥ץ וָ/אֶ֖בֶן וַֽ/יְאַבְּדֽוּ/ם
verses.translit: vntn 't 'lhyhm b'sh khy l' 'lhym hmh khy 'm m'shh ydy 'dm 'ts v'bn vy'bdvm
verses.translation: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֖/נוּ מִ/יָד֑/וֹ וְ/יֵֽדְעוּ֙ כָּל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ כִּֽי אַתָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לְ/בַדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'th yhvh 'lhynv hvshy'nv mydv vyd'v khl mmlkhvt h'rts khy 'th yhvh lbdkh
verses.translation: Now therefore, O LORD our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the LORD , even thou only.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַח֙ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֣הוּ בֶן אָמ֔וֹץ אֶל חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר֙ הִתְפַּלַּ֣לְתָּ אֵלַ֔/י אֶל סַנְחֵרִ֖יב מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר
verses.translit: vyshlch ysh'yhv bn 'mvts 'l chzqyhv l'mr khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'shr htpllt 'ly 'l snchryb mlkh 'shvr
verses.translation: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria:

verses.original: זֶ֣ה הַ/דָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה עָלָ֑י/ו בָּזָ֨ה לְ/ךָ֜ לָעֲגָ֣ה לְ/ךָ֗ בְּתוּלַת֙ בַּת צִיּ֔וֹן אַחֲרֶ֨י/ךָ֙ רֹ֣אשׁ הֵנִ֔יעָה בַּ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: zh hdbr 'shr dbr yhvh 'lyv bzh lkh l'gh lkh btvlt bt tsyvn 'chrykh r'sh hny'h bt yrvshlm
verses.translation: This is the word which the LORD hath spoken concerning him; The virgin, the daughter of Zion, hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.

verses.original: אֶת מִ֤י חֵרַ֨פְתָּ֙ וְ/גִדַּ֔פְתָּ וְ/עַל מִ֖י הֲרִימ֣וֹתָה קּ֑וֹל וַ/תִּשָּׂ֥א מָר֛וֹם עֵינֶ֖י/ךָ אֶל קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 't my chrpt vgdpt v'l my hrymvth qvl vtsh' mrvm 'ynykh 'l qdvsh yshr'l
verses.translation: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.

verses.original: בְּ/יַ֣ד עֲבָדֶי/ךָ֮ חֵרַ֣פְתָּ אֲדֹנָ/י֒ וַ/תֹּ֗אמֶר בְּ/רֹ֥ב רִכְבִּ֛/י אֲנִ֥י עָלִ֛יתִי מְר֥וֹם הָרִ֖ים יַרְכְּתֵ֣י לְבָנ֑וֹן וְ/אֶכְרֹ֞ת קוֹמַ֤ת אֲרָזָי/ו֙ מִבְחַ֣ר בְּרֹשָׁ֔י/ו וְ/אָבוֹא֙ מְר֣וֹם קִצּ֔/וֹ יַ֖עַר כַּרְמִלּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: byd 'bdykh chrpt 'dny vt'mr brb rkhby 'ny 'lyty mrvm hrym yrkhty lbnvn v'khrt qvmt 'rzyv mbchr brshyv v'bv' mrvm qtsv y'r khrmlv
verses.translation: By thy servants hast thou reproached the Lord, and hast said, By the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the height of his border, and the forest of his Carmel.
