verses.original: אֲנִ֥י קַ֖רְתִּי וְ/שָׁתִ֣יתִי מָ֑יִם וְ/אַחְרִב֙ בְּ/כַף פְּעָמַ֔/י כֹּ֖ל יְאֹרֵ֥י מָצֽוֹר
verses.translit: 'ny qrty vshtyty mym v'chrb bkhf p'my khl y'ry mtsvr
verses.translation: I have digged, and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places.

verses.original: הֲ/לֽוֹא שָׁמַ֤עְתָּ לְ/מֵֽ/רָחוֹק֙ אוֹתָ֣/הּ עָשִׂ֔יתִי מִ֥/ימֵי קֶ֖דֶם וִ/יצַרְתִּ֑י/הָ עַתָּ֣ה הֲבֵאתִ֔י/הָ וּ/תְהִ֗י לְ/הַשְׁא֛וֹת גַּלִּ֥ים נִצִּ֖ים עָרִ֥ים בְּצֻרֽוֹת
verses.translit: hlv' shm't lmrchvq 'vth 'shyty mymy qdm vytsrtyh 'th hb'tyh vthy lhsh'vt glym ntsym 'rym btsrvt
verses.translation: Hast thou not heard long ago, how I have done it; and of ancient times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities into ruinous heaps.

verses.original: וְ/יֹֽשְׁבֵי/הֶן֙ קִצְרֵי יָ֔ד חַ֖תּוּ וָ/בֹ֑שׁוּ הָי֞וּ עֵ֤שֶׂב שָׂדֶה֙ וִ֣/ירַק דֶּ֔שֶׁא חֲצִ֣יר גַּגּ֔וֹת וּ/שְׁדֵמָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י קָמָֽה
verses.translit: vyshbyhn qtsry yd chtv vbshv hyv 'shb shdh vyrq dsh' chtsyr ggvt vshdmh lpny qmh
verses.translation: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded: they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.

verses.original: וְ/שִׁבְתְּ/ךָ֛ וְ/צֵאתְ/ךָ֥ וּ/בוֹאֲ/ךָ֖ יָדָ֑עְתִּי וְ/אֵ֖ת הִֽתְרַגֶּזְ/ךָ֥ אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vshbtkh vts'tkh vbv'kh yd'ty v't htrgzkh 'ly
verses.translation: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.

verses.translit: y'n htrgzkh 'ly vsh'nnkh 'lh b'zny vshmty chchy b'pkh vmtgy bshptykh vhshybtykh bdrkh 'shr b't bh
verses.translation: Because thy rage against me, and thy tumult, is come up into mine ears, therefore will I put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.

verses.original: וְ/זֶה לְּ/ךָ֣ הָ/א֔וֹת אָכ֤וֹל הַ/שָּׁנָה֙ סָפִ֔יחַ וּ/בַ/שָּׁנָ֥ה הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖ית שָׁחִ֑יס וּ/בַ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֗ית זִרְע֧וּ וְ/קִצְר֛וּ וְ/נִטְע֥וּ כְרָמִ֖ים ו/אכול וְ/אִכְל֥וּ פִרְיָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vzh lkh h'vt 'khvl hshnh spych vbshnh hshnyt shchys vbshnh hshlyshyt zr'v vqtsrv vnt'v khrmym v'khvl v'khlv prym
verses.translation: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such as groweth of itself; and the second year that which springeth of the same: and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.

verses.original: וְ/יָ֨סְפָ֜ה פְּלֵיטַ֧ת בֵּית יְהוּדָ֛ה הַ/נִּשְׁאָרָ֖ה שֹׁ֣רֶשׁ לְ/מָ֑טָּה וְ/עָשָׂ֥ה פְרִ֖י לְ/מָֽעְלָ/ה
verses.translit: vysph plytt byt yhvdh hnsh'rh shrsh lmth v'shh pry lm'lh
verses.translation: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward:

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִ/ירֽוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ תֵּצֵ֣א שְׁאֵרִ֔ית וּ/פְלֵיטָ֖ה מֵ/הַ֣ר צִיּ֑וֹן קִנְאַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת תַּֽעֲשֶׂה זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: khy myrvshlm tts' sh'ryt vplyth mhr tsyvn qn't yhvh tsb'vt t'shh z't
verses.translation: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the LORD of hosts shall do this.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר לֹ֤א יָבוֹא֙ אֶל הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את וְ/לֹֽא יוֹרֶ֥ה שָׁ֖ם חֵ֑ץ וְ/לֹֽא יְקַדְּמֶ֣/נָּה מָגֵ֔ן וְ/לֹֽא יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ עֳלֶ֖י/הָ סֹלְלָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh 'l mlkh 'shvr l' ybv' 'l h'yr hz't vl' yvrh shm chts vl' yqdmnh mgn vl' yshpkh 'lyh sllh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shields, nor cast a bank against it.

verses.original: בַּ/דֶּ֥רֶךְ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֖א בָּ֣/הּ יָשׁ֑וּב וְ/אֶל הָ/עִ֥יר הַ/זֹּ֛את לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: bdrkh 'shr b' bh yshvb v'l h'yr hz't l' ybv' n'm yhvh
verses.translation: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/גַנּוֹתִ֛י עַל הָ/עִ֥יר הַ/זֹּ֖את לְ/הֽוֹשִׁיעָ֑/הּ לְמַֽעֲנִ֔/י וּ/לְמַ֖עַן דָּוִ֥ד עַבְדִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vgnvty 'l h'yr hz't lhvshy'h lm'ny vlm'n dvd 'bdy
verses.translation: For I will defend this city to save it for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֗ה וַ/יַּכֶּה֙ בְּ/מַחֲנֵ֣ה אַשּׁ֔וּר מֵאָ֛ה וּ/שְׁמֹנִ֥ים וַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אָ֑לֶף וַ/יַּשְׁכִּ֣ימוּ בַ/בֹּ֔קֶר וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה כֻלָּ֖/ם פְּגָרִ֥ים מֵתִֽים
verses.translit: vyts' ml'kh yhvh vykhh bmchnh 'shvr m'h vshmnym vchmshh 'lf vyshkhymv bbqr vhnh khlm pgrym mtym
verses.translation: Then the angel of the LORD went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסַּ֣ע וַ/יֵּ֔לֶךְ וַ/יָּ֖שָׁב סַנְחֵרִ֣יב מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁ֑וּר וַ/יֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּ/נִֽינְוֵֽה
verses.translit: vys' vylkh vyshb snchryb mlkh 'shvr vyshb bnynvh
verses.translation: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ ה֨וּא מִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֜ה בֵּ֣ית נִסְרֹ֣ךְ אֱלֹהָ֗י/ו וְֽ/אַדְרַמֶּ֨לֶךְ וְ/שַׂרְאֶ֤צֶר בָּנָי/ו֙ הִכֻּ֣/הוּ בַ/חֶ֔רֶב וְ/הֵ֥מָּה נִמְלְט֖וּ אֶ֣רֶץ אֲרָרָ֑ט וַ/יִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֵֽסַר חַדֹּ֥ן בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyhy hv' mshtchvh byt nsrkh 'lhyv v'drmlkh vshr'tsr bnyv hkhhv bchrb vhmh nmltv 'rts 'rrt vymlkh 'sr chdn bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Armenia: and Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.

verses.original: בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֔ם חָלָ֥ה חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ לָ/מ֑וּת וַ/יָּב֣וֹא אֵ֠לָי/ו יְשַׁעְיָ֨הוּ בֶן אָמ֜וֹץ הַ/נָּבִ֗יא וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜י/ו כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ צַ֣ו לְ/בֵיתֶ֔/ךָ כִּ֛י מֵ֥ת אַתָּ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א תִֽחְיֶֽה
verses.translit: bymym hhm chlh chzqyhv lmvt vybv' 'lyv ysh'yhv bn 'mvts hnby' vy'mr 'lyv khh 'mr yhvh tsv lbytkh khy mt 'th vl' tchyh
verses.translation: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him, and said unto him, Thus saith the LORD , Set thine house in order: for thou shalt die, and not live.

verses.original: וַ/יַּסֵּ֧ב חִזְקִיָּ֛הוּ פָּנָ֖י/ו אֶל הַ/קִּ֑יר וַ/יִּתְפַּלֵּ֖ל אֶל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vysb chzqyhv pnyv 'l hqyr vytpll 'l yhvh
verses.translation: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed unto the LORD ,

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמַ֗ר אָנָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ זְכָר נָ֞א אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר הִתְהַלַּ֣כְתִּי לְ/פָנֶ֗י/ךָ בֶּֽ/אֱמֶת֙ וּ/בְ/לֵ֣ב שָׁלֵ֔ם וְ/הַ/טּ֥וֹב בְּ/עֵינֶ֖י/ךָ עָשִׂ֑יתִי וַ/יֵּ֥בְךְּ חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּכִ֥י גָדֽוֹל
verses.translit: vy'mr 'nh yhvh zkhr n' 't 'shr hthlkhty lpnykh b'mt vblb shlm vhtvb b'ynykh 'shyty vybkh chzqyhv bkhy gdvl
verses.translation: And said, Remember now, O LORD , I beseech thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל יְשַׁעְיָ֖הוּ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'l ysh'yhv l'mr
verses.translation: Then came the word of the LORD to Isaiah, saying,

verses.original: הָל֞וֹךְ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֶל חִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵי֙ דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֔י/ךָ שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי֙ אֶת תְּפִלָּתֶ֔/ךָ רָאִ֖יתִי אֶת דִּמְעָתֶ֑/ךָ הִנְ/נִי֙ יוֹסִ֣ף עַל יָמֶ֔י/ךָ חֲמֵ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: hlvkh v'mrt 'l chzqyhv khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy dvd 'bykh shm'ty 't tpltkh r'yty 't dm'tkh hnny yvsf 'l ymykh chmsh 'shrh shnh
verses.translation: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus saith the LORD , the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/כַּ֤ף מֶֽלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר֙ אַצִּ֣ילְ/ךָ֔ וְ/אֵ֖ת הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֑את וְ/גַנּוֹתִ֖י עַל הָ/עִ֥יר הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: vmkhf mlkh 'shvr 'tsylkh v't h'yr hz't vgnvty 'l h'yr hz't
verses.translation: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria: and I will defend this city.

verses.original: וְ/זֶה לְּ/ךָ֥ הָ/א֖וֹת מֵ/אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר
verses.translit: vzh lkh h'vt m't yhvh 'shr y'shh yhvh 't hdbr hzh 'shr dbr
verses.translation: And this shall be a sign unto thee from the LORD , that the LORD will do this thing that he hath spoken;

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֣י מֵשִׁ֣יב אֶת צֵ֣ל הַֽ/מַּעֲל֡וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָרְדָה֩ בְ/מַעֲל֨וֹת אָחָ֥ז בַּ/שֶּׁ֛מֶשׁ אֲחֹרַנִּ֖ית עֶ֣שֶׂר מַעֲל֑וֹת וַ/תָּ֤שָׁב הַ/שֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ עֶ֣שֶׂר מַעֲל֔וֹת בַּֽ/מַּעֲל֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָרָֽדָה
verses.translit: hnny mshyb 't tsl hm'lvt 'shr yrdh bm'lvt 'chz bshmsh 'chrnyt 'shr m'lvt vtshb hshmsh 'shr m'lvt bm'lvt 'shr yrdh
verses.translation: Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.

verses.original: מִכְתָּ֖ב לְ/חִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה בַּ/חֲלֹת֕/וֹ וַ/יְחִ֖י מֵ/חָלְיֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mkhtb lchzqyhv mlkh yhvdh bchltv vychy mchlyv
verses.translation: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness:

verses.original: אֲנִ֣י אָמַ֗רְתִּי בִּ/דְמִ֥י יָמַ֛/י אֵלֵ֖כָה בְּ/שַׁעֲרֵ֣י שְׁא֑וֹל פֻּקַּ֖דְתִּי יֶ֥תֶר שְׁנוֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'ny 'mrty bdmy ymy 'lkhh bsh'ry sh'vl pqdty ytr shnvty
verses.translation: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.

verses.original: אָמַ֨רְתִּי֙ לֹא אֶרְאֶ֣ה יָ֔הּ יָ֖הּ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ הַ/חַיִּ֑ים לֹא אַבִּ֥יט אָדָ֛ם ע֖וֹד עִם י֥וֹשְׁבֵי חָֽדֶל
verses.translit: 'mrty l' 'r'h yh yh b'rts hchyym l' 'byt 'dm 'vd 'm yvshby chdl
verses.translation: I said, I shall not see the LORD , even the LORD , in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.

verses.original: דּוֹרִ֗/י נִסַּ֧ע וְ/נִגְלָ֛ה מִ/נִּ֖י כְּ/אֹ֣הֶל רֹעִ֑/י קִפַּ֨דְתִּי כָ/אֹרֵ֤ג חַיַּ/י֙ מִ/דַּלָּ֣ה יְבַצְּעֵ֔/נִי מִ/יּ֥וֹם עַד לַ֖יְלָה תַּשְׁלִימֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: dvry ns' vnglh mny kh'hl r'y qpdty kh'rg chyy mdlh ybts'ny myvm 'd lylh tshlymny
verses.translation: Mine age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd’s tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.

verses.original: שִׁוִּ֤יתִי עַד בֹּ֨קֶר֙ כָּֽ/אֲרִ֔י כֵּ֥ן יְשַׁבֵּ֖ר כָּל עַצְמוֹתָ֑/י מִ/יּ֥וֹם עַד לַ֖יְלָה תַּשְׁלִימֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: shvyty 'd bqr kh'ry khn yshbr khl 'tsmvty myvm 'd lylh tshlymny
verses.translation: I reckoned till morning, that , as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.

verses.original: כְּ/ס֤וּס עָגוּר֙ כֵּ֣ן אֲצַפְצֵ֔ף אֶהְגֶּ֖ה כַּ/יּוֹנָ֑ה דַּלּ֤וּ עֵינַ/י֙ לַ/מָּר֔וֹם אֲדֹנָ֖/י עָֽשְׁקָה לִּ֥/י עָרְבֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: khsvs 'gvr khn 'tsptsf 'hgh khyvnh dlv 'yny lmrvm 'dny 'shqh ly 'rbny
verses.translation: Like a crane or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: mine eyes fail with looking upward: O LORD , I am oppressed; undertake for me.

verses.original: מָֽה אֲדַבֵּ֥ר וְ/אָֽמַר לִ֖/י וְ/ה֣וּא עָשָׂ֑ה אֶדַּדֶּ֥ה כָל שְׁנוֹתַ֖/י עַל מַ֥ר נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: mh 'dbr v'mr ly vhv' 'shh 'ddh khl shnvty 'l mr npshy
verses.translation: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done it: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֖/י עֲלֵי/הֶ֣ם יִֽחְי֑וּ וּ/לְ/כָל בָּ/הֶן֙ חַיֵּ֣י רוּחִ֔/י וְ/תַחֲלִימֵ֖/נִי וְ/הַחֲיֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'dny 'lyhm ychyv vlkhl bhn chyy rvchy vtchlymny vhchyny
verses.translation: O Lord, by these things men live, and in all these things is the life of my spirit: so wilt thou recover me, and make me to live.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה לְ/שָׁל֖וֹם מַר לִ֣/י מָ֑ר וְ/אַתָּ֞ה חָשַׁ֤קְתָּ נַפְשִׁ/י֙ מִ/שַּׁ֣חַת בְּלִ֔י כִּ֥י הִשְׁלַ֛כְתָּ אַחֲרֵ֥י גֵוְ/ךָ֖ כָּל חֲטָאָֽ/י
verses.translit: hnh lshlvm mr ly mr v'th chshqt npshy mshcht bly khy hshlkht 'chry gvkh khl cht'y
verses.translation: Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption: for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֥א שְׁא֛וֹל תּוֹדֶ֖/ךָּ מָ֣וֶת יְהַלְלֶ֑/ךָּ לֹֽא יְשַׂבְּר֥וּ יֽוֹרְדֵי ב֖וֹר אֶל אֲמִתֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khy l' sh'vl tvdkh mvt yhllkh l' yshbrv yvrdy bvr 'l 'mtkh
verses.translation: For the grave cannot praise thee, death can not celebrate thee: they that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.

verses.original: חַ֥י חַ֛י ה֥וּא יוֹדֶ֖/ךָ כָּמ֣וֹ/נִי הַ/יּ֑וֹם אָ֣ב לְ/בָנִ֔ים יוֹדִ֖יעַ אֶל אֲמִתֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: chy chy hv' yvdkh khmvny hyvm 'b lbnym yvdy' 'l 'mtkh
verses.translation: The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I do this day: the father to the children shall make known thy truth.

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה לְ/הוֹשִׁיעֵ֑/נִי וּ/נְגִנוֹתַ֧י נְנַגֵּ֛ן כָּל יְמֵ֥י חַיֵּ֖י/נוּ עַל בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: yhvh lhvshy'ny vngnvty nngn khl ymy chyynv 'l byt yhvh
verses.translation: The LORD was ready to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְשַׁעְיָ֔הוּ יִשְׂא֖וּ דְּבֶ֣לֶת תְּאֵנִ֑ים וְ/יִמְרְח֥וּ עַֽל הַ/שְּׁחִ֖ין וְ/יֶֽחִי
verses.translit: vy'mr ysh'yhv ysh'v dblt t'nym vymrchv 'l hshchyn vychy
verses.translation: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay it for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ מָ֣ה א֑וֹת כִּ֥י אֶעֱלֶ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr chzqyhv mh 'vt khy ''lh byt yhvh
verses.translation: Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the LORD ?

verses.original: בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֡וא שָׁלַ֡ח מְרֹדַ֣ךְ בַּ֠לְאֲדָן בֶּֽן בַּלְאֲדָ֧ן מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֛ל סְפָרִ֥ים וּ/מִנְחָ֖ה אֶל חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֕ע כִּ֥י חָלָ֖ה וַֽ/יֶּחֱזָֽק
verses.translit: b't hhv' shlch mrdkh bl'dn bn bl'dn mlkh bbl sprym vmnchh 'l chzqyhv vyshm' khy chlh vychzq
verses.translation: At that time Merodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah: for he had heard that he had been sick, and was recovered.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׂמַ֣ח עֲלֵי/הֶם֮ חִזְקִיָּהוּ֒ וַ/יַּרְאֵ֣/ם אֶת בֵּ֣ית נכת/ה נְכֹת֡/וֹ אֶת הַ/כֶּסֶף֩ וְ/אֶת הַ/זָּהָ֨ב וְ/אֶת הַ/בְּשָׂמִ֜ים וְ/אֵ֣ת הַ/שֶּׁ֣מֶן הַ/טּ֗וֹב וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל בֵּ֣ית כֵּלָ֔י/ו וְ/אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִמְצָ֖א בְּ/אֹֽצְרֹתָ֑י/ו לֹֽא הָיָ֣ה דָבָ֗ר אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹֽא הֶרְאָ֧/ם חִזְקִיָּ֛הוּ בְּ/בֵית֖/וֹ וּ/בְ/כָל מֶמְשַׁלְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshmch 'lyhm chzqyhv vyr'm 't byt nkhth nkhtv 't hkhsf v't hzhb v't hbshmym v't hshmn htvb v't khl byt khlyv v't khl 'shr nmts' b'tsrtyv l' hyh dbr 'shr l' hr'm chzqyhv bbytv vbkhl mmshltv
verses.translation: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא֙ יְשַׁעְיָ֣הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֔יא אֶל הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜י/ו מָ֥ה אָמְר֣וּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה וּ/מֵ/אַ֨יִן֙ יָבֹ֣אוּ אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ מֵ/אֶ֧רֶץ רְחוֹקָ֛ה בָּ֥אוּ אֵלַ֖/י מִ/בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: vyb' ysh'yhv hnby' 'l hmlkh chzqyhv vy'mr 'lyv mh 'mrv h'nshym h'lh vm'yn yb'v 'lykh vy'mr chzqyhv m'rts rchvqh b'v 'ly mbbl
verses.translation: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me, even from Babylon.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר מָ֥ה רָא֖וּ בְּ/בֵיתֶ֑/ךָ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר חִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ אֵ֣ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּ/בֵיתִ/י֙ רָא֔וּ לֹֽא הָיָ֥ה דָבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא הִרְאִיתִ֖י/ם בְּ/אוֹצְרֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr mh r'v bbytkh vy'mr chzqyhv 't khl 'shr bbyty r'v l' hyh dbr 'shr l' hr'ytym b'vtsrty
verses.translation: Then said he, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All that is in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְשַׁעְיָ֖הוּ אֶל חִזְקִיָּ֑הוּ שְׁמַ֖ע דְּבַר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vy'mr ysh'yhv 'l chzqyhv shm' dbr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD of hosts:

verses.original: הִנֵּה֮ יָמִ֣ים בָּאִים֒ וְ/נִשָּׂ֣א כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/בֵיתֶ֗/ךָ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָצְר֧וּ אֲבֹתֶ֛י/ךָ עַד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֖ה בָּבֶ֑ל לֹֽא יִוָּתֵ֥ר דָּבָ֖ר אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hnh ymym b'ym vnsh' khl 'shr bbytkh v'shr 'tsrv 'btykh 'd hyvm hzh bbl l' yvtr dbr 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בָּנֶ֜י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵצְא֧וּ מִמְּ/ךָ֛ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תּוֹלִ֖יד יִקָּ֑חוּ וְ/הָיוּ֙ סָרִיסִ֔ים בְּ/הֵיכַ֖ל מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל
verses.translit: vmbnykh 'shr yts'v mmkh 'shr tvlyd yqchv vhyv srysym bhykhl mlkh bbl
verses.translation: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר חִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ אֶֽל יְשַׁעְיָ֔הוּ ט֥וֹב דְּבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבַּ֑רְתָּ וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר כִּ֥י יִהְיֶ֛ה שָׁל֥וֹם וֶ/אֱמֶ֖ת בְּ/יָמָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr chzqyhv 'l ysh'yhv tvb dbr yhvh 'shr dbrt vy'mr khy yhyh shlvm v'mt bymy
verses.translation: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good is the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.

verses.original: נַחֲמ֥וּ נַחֲמ֖וּ עַמִּ֑/י יֹאמַ֖ר אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: nchmv nchmv 'my y'mr 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.

verses.original: דַּבְּר֞וּ עַל לֵ֤ב יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ וְ/קִרְא֣וּ אֵלֶ֔י/הָ כִּ֤י מָֽלְאָה֙ צְבָאָ֔/הּ כִּ֥י נִרְצָ֖ה עֲוֺנָ֑/הּ כִּ֤י לָקְחָה֙ מִ/יַּ֣ד יְהוָ֔ה כִּפְלַ֖יִם בְּ/כָל חַטֹּאתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: dbrv 'l lb yrvshlm vqr'v 'lyh khy ml'h tsb'h khy nrtsh 'vnh khy lqchh myd yhvh khplym bkhl cht'tyh
verses.translation: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem, and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she hath received of the LORD’s hand double for all her sins.

verses.original: ק֣וֹל קוֹרֵ֔א בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֕ר פַּנּ֖וּ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהוָ֑ה יַשְּׁרוּ֙ בָּ/עֲרָבָ֔ה מְסִלָּ֖ה לֵ/אלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: qvl qvr' bmdbr pnv drkh yhvh yshrv b'rbh mslh l'lhynv
verses.translation: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the LORD , make straight in the desert a highway for our God.

verses.original: כָּל גֶּיא֙ יִנָּשֵׂ֔א וְ/כָל הַ֥ר וְ/גִבְעָ֖ה יִשְׁפָּ֑לוּ וְ/הָיָ֤ה הֶֽ/עָקֹב֙ לְ/מִישׁ֔וֹר וְ/הָ/רְכָסִ֖ים לְ/בִקְעָֽה
verses.translit: khl gy' ynsh' vkhl hr vgb'h yshplv vhyh h'qb lmyshvr vhrkhsym lbq'h
verses.translation: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:

verses.original: וְ/נִגְלָ֖ה כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֑ה וְ/רָא֤וּ כָל בָּשָׂר֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו כִּ֛י פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר
verses.translit: vnglh khbvd yhvh vr'v khl bshr ychdv khy py yhvh dbr
verses.translation: And the glory of the LORD shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it .

verses.original: ק֚וֹל אֹמֵ֣ר קְרָ֔א וְ/אָמַ֖ר מָ֣ה אֶקְרָ֑א כָּל הַ/בָּשָׂ֣ר חָצִ֔יר וְ/כָל חַסְדּ֖/וֹ כְּ/צִ֥יץ הַ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: qvl 'mr qr' v'mr mh 'qr' khl hbshr chtsyr vkhl chsdv khtsyts hshdh
verses.translation: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field:

verses.original: יָבֵ֤שׁ חָצִיר֙ נָ֣בֵֽל צִ֔יץ כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ יְהוָ֖ה נָ֣שְׁבָה בּ֑/וֹ אָכֵ֥ן חָצִ֖יר הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: ybsh chtsyr nbl tsyts khy rvch yhvh nshbh bv 'khn chtsyr h'm
verses.translation: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the LORD bloweth upon it: surely the people is grass.

verses.original: יָבֵ֥שׁ חָצִ֖יר נָ֣בֵֽל צִ֑יץ וּ/דְבַר אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ יָק֥וּם לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: ybsh chtsyr nbl tsyts vdbr 'lhynv yqvm l'vlm
verses.translation: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.

verses.original: עַ֣ל הַר גָּבֹ֤הַ עֲלִי לָ/ךְ֙ מְבַשֶּׂ֣רֶת צִיּ֔וֹן הָרִ֤ימִי בַ/כֹּ֨חַ֙ קוֹלֵ֔/ךְ מְבַשֶּׂ֖רֶת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הָרִ֨ימִי֙ אַל תִּירָ֔אִי אִמְרִי֙ לְ/עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה הִנֵּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'l hr gbh 'ly lkh mbshrt tsyvn hrymy bkhch qvlkh mbshrt yrvshlm hrymy 'l tyr'y 'mry l'ry yhvdh hnh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God!

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה אֲדֹנָ֤/י יְהוִה֙ בְּ/חָזָ֣ק יָב֔וֹא וּ/זְרֹע֖/וֹ מֹ֣שְׁלָה ל֑/וֹ הִנֵּ֤ה שְׂכָר/וֹ֙ אִתּ֔/וֹ וּ/פְעֻלָּת֖/וֹ לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hnh 'dny yhvh bchzq ybv' vzr'v mshlh lv hnh shkhrv 'tv vp'ltv lpnyv
verses.translation: Behold, the Lord GOD will come with strong hand , and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.

verses.original: כְּ/רֹעֶה֙ עֶדְר֣/וֹ יִרְעֶ֔ה בִּ/זְרֹע/וֹ֙ יְקַבֵּ֣ץ טְלָאִ֔ים וּ/בְ/חֵיק֖/וֹ יִשָּׂ֑א עָל֖וֹת יְנַהֵֽל
verses.translit: khr'h 'drv yr'h bzr'v yqbts tl'ym vbchyqv ysh' 'lvt ynhl
verses.translation: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.

verses.original: מִֽי מָדַ֨ד בְּ/שָׁעֳל֜/וֹ מַ֗יִם וְ/שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ בַּ/זֶּ֣רֶת תִּכֵּ֔ן וְ/כָ֥ל בַּ/שָּׁלִ֖שׁ עֲפַ֣ר הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/שָׁקַ֤ל בַּ/פֶּ֨לֶס֙ הָרִ֔ים וּ/גְבָע֖וֹת בְּ/מֹאזְנָֽיִם
verses.translit: my mdd bsh'lv mym vshmym bzrt tkhn vkhl bshlsh 'pr h'rts vshql bpls hrym vgb'vt bm'znym
verses.translation: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?

verses.original: מִֽי תִכֵּ֥ן אֶת ר֖וּחַ יְהוָ֑ה וְ/אִ֥ישׁ עֲצָת֖/וֹ יוֹדִיעֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: my tkhn 't rvch yhvh v'ysh 'tstv yvdy'nv
verses.translation: Who hath directed the Spirit of the LORD , or being his counsellor hath taught him?

verses.original: אֶת מִ֤י נוֹעָץ֙ וַ/יְבִינֵ֔/הוּ וַֽ/יְלַמְּדֵ֖/הוּ בְּ/אֹ֣רַח מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וַ/יְלַמְּדֵ֣/הוּ דַ֔עַת וְ/דֶ֥רֶךְ תְּבוּנ֖וֹת יוֹדִיעֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: 't my nv'ts vybynhv vylmdhv b'rch mshpt vylmdhv d't vdrkh tbvnvt yvdy'nv
verses.translation: With whom took he counsel, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?

verses.original: הֵ֤ן גּוֹיִם֙ כְּ/מַ֣ר מִ/דְּלִ֔י וּ/כְ/שַׁ֥חַק מֹאזְנַ֖יִם נֶחְשָׁ֑בוּ הֵ֥ן אִיִּ֖ים כַּ/דַּ֥ק יִטּֽוֹל
verses.translit: hn gvym khmr mdly vkhshchq m'znym nchshbv hn 'yym khdq ytvl
verses.translation: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.

verses.original: וּ/לְבָנ֕וֹן אֵ֥ין דֵּ֖י בָּעֵ֑ר וְ/חַיָּת֔/וֹ אֵ֥ין דֵּ֖י עוֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vlbnvn 'yn dy b'r vchytv 'yn dy 'vlh
verses.translation: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.

verses.original: כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם כְּ/אַ֣יִן נֶגְדּ֑/וֹ מֵ/אֶ֥פֶס וָ/תֹ֖הוּ נֶחְשְׁבוּ לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khl hgvym kh'yn ngdv m'ps vthv nchshbv lv
verses.translation: All nations before him are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל מִ֖י תְּדַמְּי֣וּ/ן אֵ֑ל וּ/מַה דְּמ֖וּת תַּ֥עַרְכוּ לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'l my tdmyvn 'l vmh dmvt t'rkhv lv
verses.translation: To whom then will ye liken God? or what likeness will ye compare unto him?

verses.original: הַ/פֶּ֨סֶל֙ נָסַ֣ךְ חָרָ֔שׁ וְ/צֹרֵ֖ף בַּ/זָּהָ֣ב יְרַקְּעֶ֑/נּוּ וּ/רְתֻק֥וֹת כֶּ֖סֶף צוֹרֵֽף
verses.translit: hpsl nskh chrsh vtsrf bzhb yrq'nv vrtqvt khsf tsvrf
verses.translation: The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold, and casteth silver chains.

verses.original: הַֽ/מְסֻכָּ֣ן תְּרוּמָ֔ה עֵ֥ץ לֹֽא יִרְקַ֖ב יִבְחָ֑ר חָרָ֤שׁ חָכָם֙ יְבַקֶּשׁ ל֔/וֹ לְ/הָכִ֥ין פֶּ֖סֶל לֹ֥א יִמּֽוֹט
verses.translit: hmskhn trvmh 'ts l' yrqb ybchr chrsh chkhm ybqsh lv lhkhyn psl l' ymvt
verses.translation: He that is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image, that shall not be moved.

verses.original: הֲ/ל֤וֹא תֵֽדְעוּ֙ הֲ/ל֣וֹא תִשְׁמָ֔עוּ הֲ/ל֛וֹא הֻגַּ֥ד מֵ/רֹ֖אשׁ לָ/כֶ֑ם הֲ/לוֹא֙ הֲבִ֣ינֹתֶ֔ם מוֹסְד֖וֹת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: hlv' td'v hlv' tshm'v hlv' hgd mr'sh lkhm hlv' hbyntm mvsdvt h'rts
verses.translation: Have ye not known? have ye not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth?

verses.original: הַ/יֹּשֵׁב֙ עַל ח֣וּג הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/יֹשְׁבֶ֖י/הָ כַּ/חֲגָבִ֑ים הַ/נּוֹטֶ֤ה כַ/דֹּק֙ שָׁמַ֔יִם וַ/יִּמְתָּחֵ֥/ם כָּ/אֹ֖הֶל לָ/שָֽׁבֶת
verses.translit: hyshb 'l chvg h'rts vyshbyh khchgbym hnvth khdq shmym vymtchm kh'hl lshbt
verses.translation: It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:

verses.original: הַ/נּוֹתֵ֥ן רוֹזְנִ֖ים לְ/אָ֑יִן שֹׁ֥פְטֵי אֶ֖רֶץ כַּ/תֹּ֥הוּ עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: hnvtn rvznym l'yn shpty 'rts khthv 'shh
verses.translation: That bringeth the princes to nothing; he maketh the judges of the earth as vanity.

verses.original: אַ֣ף בַּל נִטָּ֗עוּ אַ֚ף בַּל זֹרָ֔עוּ אַ֛ף בַּל שֹׁרֵ֥שׁ בָּ/אָ֖רֶץ גִּזְעָ֑/ם וְ/גַם נָשַׁ֤ף בָּ/הֶם֙ וַ/יִּבָ֔שׁוּ וּ/סְעָרָ֖ה כַּ/קַּ֥שׁ תִּשָּׂאֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'f bl nt'v 'f bl zr'v 'f bl shrsh b'rts gz'm vgm nshf bhm vybshv vs'rh khqsh tsh'm
verses.translation: Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in the earth: and he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל מִ֥י תְדַמְּי֖וּ/נִי וְ/אֶשְׁוֶ֑ה יֹאמַ֖ר קָדֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: v'l my tdmyvny v'shvh y'mr qdvsh
verses.translation: To whom then will ye liken me, or shall I be equal? saith the Holy One.

verses.original: שְׂאוּ מָר֨וֹם עֵינֵי/כֶ֤ם וּ/רְאוּ֙ מִי בָרָ֣א אֵ֔לֶּה הַ/מּוֹצִ֥יא בְ/מִסְפָּ֖ר צְבָאָ֑/ם לְ/כֻלָּ/ם֙ בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם יִקְרָ֔א מֵ/רֹ֤ב אוֹנִים֙ וְ/אַמִּ֣יץ כֹּ֔חַ אִ֖ישׁ לֹ֥א נֶעְדָּֽר
verses.translit: sh'v mrvm 'ynykhm vr'v my br' 'lh hmvtsy' bmspr tsb'm lkhlm bshm yqr' mrb 'vnym v'myts khch 'ysh l' n'dr
verses.translation: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who hath created these things , that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that he is strong in power; not one faileth.

verses.original: לָ֤/מָּה תֹאמַר֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וּ/תְדַבֵּ֖ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל נִסְתְּרָ֤ה דַרְכִּ/י֙ מֵֽ/יְהוָ֔ה וּ/מֵ/אֱלֹהַ֖/י מִשְׁפָּטִ֥/י יַעֲבֽוֹר
verses.translit: lmh t'mr y'qb vtdbr yshr'l nstrh drkhy myhvh vm'lhy mshpty y'bvr
verses.translation: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid from the LORD , and my judgment is passed over from my God?

verses.original: הֲ/ל֨וֹא יָדַ֜עְתָּ אִם לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ אֱלֹהֵ֨י עוֹלָ֤ם יְהוָה֙ בּוֹרֵא֙ קְצ֣וֹת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ לֹ֥א יִיעַ֖ף וְ/לֹ֣א יִיגָ֑ע אֵ֥ין חֵ֖קֶר לִ/תְבוּנָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hlv' yd't 'm l' shm't 'lhy 'vlm yhvh bvr' qtsvt h'rts l' yy'f vl' yyg' 'yn chqr ltbvntv
verses.translation: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the LORD , the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.

verses.original: נֹתֵ֥ן לַ/יָּעֵ֖ף כֹּ֑חַ וּ/לְ/אֵ֥ין אוֹנִ֖ים עָצְמָ֥ה יַרְבֶּֽה
verses.translit: ntn ly'f khch vl'yn 'vnym 'tsmh yrbh
verses.translation: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.

verses.original: וְ/יִֽעֲפ֥וּ נְעָרִ֖ים וְ/יִגָ֑עוּ וּ/בַחוּרִ֖ים כָּשׁ֥וֹל יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ
verses.translit: vy'pv n'rym vyg'v vbchvrym khshvl ykhshlv
verses.translation: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:

verses.original: וְ/קוֹיֵ֤ יְהוָה֙ יַחֲלִ֣יפוּ כֹ֔חַ יַעֲל֥וּ אֵ֖בֶר כַּ/נְּשָׁרִ֑ים יָר֨וּצוּ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יִיגָ֔עוּ יֵלְכ֖וּ וְ/לֹ֥א יִיעָֽפוּ
verses.translit: vqvy yhvh ychlypv khch y'lv 'br khnshrym yrvtsv vl' yyg'v ylkhv vl' yy'pv
verses.translation: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

verses.original: הַחֲרִ֤ישׁוּ אֵלַ/י֙ אִיִּ֔ים וּ/לְאֻמִּ֖ים יַחֲלִ֣יפוּ כֹ֑חַ יִגְּשׁוּ֙ אָ֣ז יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ יַחְדָּ֖ו לַ/מִּשְׁפָּ֥ט נִקְרָֽבָה
verses.translit: hchryshv 'ly 'yym vl'mym ychlypv khch ygshv 'z ydbrv ychdv lmshpt nqrbh
verses.translation: Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the people renew their strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.

verses.original: מִ֤י הֵעִיר֙ מִ/מִּזְרָ֔ח צֶ֖דֶק יִקְרָאֵ֣/הוּ לְ/רַגְל֑/וֹ יִתֵּ֨ן לְ/פָנָ֤י/ו גּוֹיִם֙ וּ/מְלָכִ֣ים יַ֔רְדְּ יִתֵּ֤ן כֶּֽ/עָפָר֙ חַרְבּ֔/וֹ כְּ/קַ֥שׁ נִדָּ֖ף קַשְׁתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: my h'yr mmzrch tsdq yqr'hv lrglv ytn lpnyv gvym vmlkhym yrd ytn kh'pr chrbv khqsh ndf qshtv
verses.translation: Who raised up the righteous man from the east, called him to his foot, gave the nations before him, and made him rule over kings? he gave them as the dust to his sword, and as driven stubble to his bow.

verses.original: יִרְדְּפֵ֖/ם יַעֲב֣וֹר שָׁל֑וֹם אֹ֥רַח בְּ/רַגְלָ֖י/ו לֹ֥א יָבֽוֹא
verses.translit: yrdpm y'bvr shlvm 'rch brglyv l' ybv'
verses.translation: He pursued them, and passed safely; even by the way that he had not gone with his feet.

verses.original: מִֽי פָעַ֣ל וְ/עָשָׂ֔ה קֹרֵ֥א הַ/דֹּר֖וֹת מֵ/רֹ֑אשׁ אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ רִאשׁ֔וֹן וְ/אֶת אַחֲרֹנִ֖ים אֲנִי הֽוּא
verses.translit: my p'l v'shh qr' hdrvt mr'sh 'ny yhvh r'shvn v't 'chrnym 'ny hv'
verses.translation: Who hath wrought and done it , calling the generations from the beginning? I the LORD , the first, and with the last; I am he.

verses.original: רָא֤וּ אִיִּים֙ וְ/יִירָ֔אוּ קְצ֥וֹת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ יֶחֱרָ֑דוּ קָרְב֖וּ וַ/יֶּאֱתָיֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: r'v 'yym vyyr'v qtsvt h'rts ychrdv qrbv vy'tyvn
verses.translation: The isles saw it , and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, drew near, and came.

verses.original: אִ֥ישׁ אֶת רֵעֵ֖/הוּ יַעְזֹ֑רוּ וּ/לְ/אָחִ֖י/ו יֹאמַ֥ר חֲזָֽק
verses.translit: 'ysh 't r'hv y'zrv vl'chyv y'mr chzq
verses.translation: They helped every one his neighbour; and every one said to his brother, Be of good courage.

verses.original: וַ/יְחַזֵּ֤ק חָרָשׁ֙ אֶת צֹרֵ֔ף מַחֲלִ֥יק פַּטִּ֖ישׁ אֶת ה֣וֹלֶם פָּ֑עַם אֹמֵ֤ר לַ/דֶּ֨בֶק֙ ט֣וֹב ה֔וּא וַ/יְחַזְּקֵ֥/הוּ בְ/מַסְמְרִ֖ים לֹ֥א יִמּֽוֹט
verses.translit: vychzq chrsh 't tsrf mchlyq ptysh 't hvlm p'm 'mr ldbq tvb hv' vychzqhv bmsmrym l' ymvt
verses.translation: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, and he that smootheth with the hammer him that smote the anvil, saying, It is ready for the sodering: and he fastened it with nails, that it should not be moved.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּה֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עַבְדִּ֔/י יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּחַרְתִּ֑י/ךָ זֶ֖רַע אַבְרָהָ֥ם אֹהֲבִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th yshr'l 'bdy y'qb 'shr bchrtykh zr' 'brhm 'hby
verses.translation: But thou, Israel, art my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֶחֱזַקְתִּ֨י/ךָ֙ מִ/קְצ֣וֹת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וּ/מֵ/אֲצִילֶ֖י/הָ קְרָאתִ֑י/ךָ וָ/אֹ֤מַר לְ/ךָ֙ עַבְדִּ/י אַ֔תָּה בְּחַרְתִּ֖י/ךָ וְ/לֹ֥א מְאַסְתִּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'shr hchzqtykh mqtsvt h'rts vm'tsylyh qr'tykh v'mr lkh 'bdy 'th bchrtykh vl' m'stykh
verses.translation: Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called thee from the chief men thereof, and said unto thee, Thou art my servant; I have chosen thee, and not cast thee away.

verses.original: אַל תִּירָא֙ כִּ֣י עִמְּ/ךָ אָ֔נִי אַל תִּשְׁתָּ֖ע כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ אִמַּצְתִּ֨י/ךָ֙ אַף עֲזַרְתִּ֔י/ךָ אַף תְּמַכְתִּ֖י/ךָ בִּ/ימִ֥ין צִדְקִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'l tyr' khy 'mkh 'ny 'l tsht' khy 'ny 'lhykh 'mtstykh 'f 'zrtykh 'f tmkhtykh bymyn tsdqy
verses.translation: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.

verses.original: הֵ֤ן יֵבֹ֨שׁוּ֙ וְ/יִכָּ֣לְמ֔וּ כֹּ֖ל הַ/נֶּחֱרִ֣ים בָּ֑/ךְ יִֽהְי֥וּ כְ/אַ֛יִן וְ/יֹאבְד֖וּ אַנְשֵׁ֥י רִיבֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: hn ybshv vykhlmv khl hnchrym bkh yhyv kh'yn vy'bdv 'nshy rybkh
verses.translation: Behold, all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with thee shall perish.

verses.original: תְּבַקְשֵׁ/ם֙ וְ/לֹ֣א תִמְצָאֵ֔/ם אַנְשֵׁ֖י מַצֻּתֶ֑/ךָ יִהְי֥וּ כְ/אַ֛יִן וּ/כְ/אֶ֖פֶס אַנְשֵׁ֥י מִלְחַמְתֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: tbqshm vl' tmts'm 'nshy mtstkh yhyv kh'yn vkh'ps 'nshy mlchmtkh
verses.translation: Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, even them that contended with thee: they that war against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.

verses.original: כִּ֗י אֲנִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ מַחֲזִ֣יק יְמִינֶ֑/ךָ הָ/אֹמֵ֥ר לְ/ךָ֛ אַל תִּירָ֖א אֲנִ֥י עֲזַרְתִּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: khy 'ny yhvh 'lhykh mchzyq ymynkh h'mr lkh 'l tyr' 'ny 'zrtykh
verses.translation: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.

verses.original: אַל תִּֽירְאִי֙ תּוֹלַ֣עַת יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב מְתֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲנִ֤י עֲזַרְתִּי/ךְ֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וְ/גֹאֲלֵ֖/ךְ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 'l tyr'y tvl't y'qb mty yshr'l 'ny 'zrtykh n'm yhvh vg'lkh qdvsh yshr'l
verses.translation: Fear not, thou worm Jacob, and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the LORD , and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה שַׂמְתִּ֗י/ךְ לְ/מוֹרַג֙ חָר֣וּץ חָדָ֔שׁ בַּ֖עַל פִּֽיפִיּ֑וֹת תָּד֤וּשׁ הָרִים֙ וְ/תָדֹ֔ק וּ/גְבָע֖וֹת כַּ/מֹּ֥ץ תָּשִֽׂים
verses.translit: hnh shmtykh lmvrg chrvts chdsh b'l pypyvt tdvsh hrym vtdq vgb'vt khmts tshym
verses.translation: Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shalt make the hills as chaff.

verses.original: תִּזְרֵ/ם֙ וְ/ר֣וּחַ תִּשָּׂאֵ֔/ם וּ/סְעָרָ֖ה תָּפִ֣יץ אוֹתָ֑/ם וְ/אַתָּה֙ תָּגִ֣יל בַּֽ/יהוָ֔ה בִּ/קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תִּתְהַלָּֽל
verses.translit: tzrm vrvch tsh'm vs'rh tpyts 'vtm v'th tgyl byhvh bqdvsh yshr'l tthll
verses.translation: Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and thou shalt rejoice in the LORD , and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.

verses.original: הָ/עֲנִיִּ֨ים וְ/הָ/אֶבְיוֹנִ֜ים מְבַקְשִׁ֥ים מַ֨יִם֙ וָ/אַ֔יִן לְשׁוֹנָ֖/ם בַּ/צָּמָ֣א נָשָׁ֑תָּה אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֶעֱנֵ֔/ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֥א אֶעֶזְבֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: h'nyym vh'byvnym mbqshym mym v'yn lshvnm btsm' nshth 'ny yhvh ''nm 'lhy yshr'l l' ''zbm
verses.translation: When the poor and needy seek water, and there is none, and their tongue faileth for thirst, I the LORD will hear them, I the God of Israel will not forsake them.

verses.original: אֶפְתַּ֤ח עַל שְׁפָיִים֙ נְהָר֔וֹת וּ/בְ/ת֥וֹךְ בְּקָע֖וֹת מַעְיָנ֑וֹת אָשִׂ֤ים מִדְבָּר֙ לַ/אֲגַם מַ֔יִם וְ/אֶ֥רֶץ צִיָּ֖ה לְ/מוֹצָ֥אֵי מָֽיִם
verses.translit: 'ptch 'l shpyym nhrvt vbtvkh bq'vt m'ynvt 'shym mdbr l'gm mym v'rts tsyh lmvts'y mym
verses.translation: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.

verses.original: אֶתֵּ֤ן בַּ/מִּדְבָּר֙ אֶ֣רֶז שִׁטָּ֔ה וַ/הֲדַ֖ס וְ/עֵ֣ץ שָׁ֑מֶן אָשִׂ֣ים בָּ/עֲרָבָ֗ה בְּר֛וֹשׁ תִּדְהָ֥ר וּ/תְאַשּׁ֖וּר יַחְדָּֽו
verses.translit: 'tn bmdbr 'rz shth vhds v'ts shmn 'shym b'rbh brvsh tdhr vt'shvr ychdv
verses.translation: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree, and the pine, and the box tree together:

verses.original: לְמַ֧עַן יִרְא֣וּ וְ/יֵדְע֗וּ וְ/יָשִׂ֤ימוּ וְ/יַשְׂכִּ֨ילוּ֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו כִּ֥י יַד יְהוָ֖ה עָ֣שְׂתָה זֹּ֑את וּ/קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּרָאָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: lm'n yr'v vyd'v vyshymv vyshkhylv ychdv khy yd yhvh 'shth z't vqdvsh yshr'l br'h
verses.translation: That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of the LORD hath done this, and the Holy One of Israel hath created it.

verses.original: קָרְב֥וּ רִֽיבְ/כֶ֖ם יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה הַגִּ֨ישׁוּ֙ עֲצֻמ֣וֹתֵי/כֶ֔ם יֹאמַ֖ר מֶ֥לֶךְ יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: qrbv rybkhm y'mr yhvh hgyshv 'tsmvtykhm y'mr mlkh y'qb
verses.translation: Produce your cause, saith the LORD ; bring forth your strong reasons , saith the King of Jacob.

verses.original: יַגִּ֨ישׁוּ֙ וְ/יַגִּ֣ידוּ לָ֔/נוּ אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּקְרֶ֑ינָה הָ/רִאשֹׁנ֣וֹת מָ֣ה הֵ֗נָּה הַגִּ֜ידוּ וְ/נָשִׂ֤ימָה לִבֵּ֨/נוּ֙ וְ/נֵדְעָ֣ה אַחֲרִיתָ֔/ן א֥וֹ הַ/בָּא֖וֹת הַשְׁמִיעֻֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: ygyshv vygydv lnv 't 'shr tqrynh hr'shnvt mh hnh hgydv vnshymh lbnv vnd'h 'chrytn 'v hb'vt hshmy'nv
verses.translation: Let them bring them forth, and shew us what shall happen: let them shew the former things, what they be , that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come.

verses.original: הַגִּ֨ידוּ֙ הָ/אֹתִיּ֣וֹת לְ/אָח֔וֹר וְ/נֵ֣דְעָ֔ה כִּ֥י אֱלֹהִ֖ים אַתֶּ֑ם אַף תֵּיטִ֣יבוּ וְ/תָרֵ֔עוּ וְ/נִשְׁתָּ֖עָה ו/נרא וְ/נִרְאֶ֥ה יַחְדָּֽו
verses.translit: hgydv h'tyvt l'chvr vnd'h khy 'lhym 'tm 'f tytybv vtr'v vnsht'h vnr' vnr'h ychdv
verses.translation: Shew the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that ye are gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and behold it together.

verses.original: הֵן אַתֶּ֣ם מֵ/אַ֔יִן וּ/פָעָלְ/כֶ֖ם מֵ/אָ֑פַע תּוֹעֵבָ֖ה יִבְחַ֥ר בָּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: hn 'tm m'yn vp'lkhm m'p' tv'bh ybchr bkhm
verses.translation: Behold, ye are of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination is he that chooseth you.

verses.original: הַעִיר֤וֹתִי מִ/צָּפוֹן֙ וַ/יַּ֔את מִ/מִּזְרַח שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ יִקְרָ֣א בִ/שְׁמִ֑/י וְ/יָבֹ֤א סְגָנִים֙ כְּמוֹ חֹ֔מֶר וּ/כְמ֥וֹ יוֹצֵ֖ר יִרְמָס טִֽיט
verses.translit: h'yrvty mtspvn vy't mmzrch shmsh yqr' bshmy vyb' sgnym khmv chmr vkhmv yvtsr yrms tyt
verses.translation: I have raised up one from the north, and he shall come: from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name: and he shall come upon princes as upon morter, and as the potter treadeth clay.

verses.original: מִֽי הִגִּ֤יד מֵ/רֹאשׁ֙ וְ/נֵדָ֔עָה וּ/מִ/לְּ/פָנִ֖ים וְ/נֹאמַ֣ר צַדִּ֑יק אַ֣ף אֵין מַגִּ֗יד אַ֚ף אֵ֣ין מַשְׁמִ֔יעַ אַ֥ף אֵין שֹׁמֵ֖עַ אִמְרֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: my hgyd mr'sh vnd'h vmlpnym vn'mr tsdyq 'f 'yn mgyd 'f 'yn mshmy' 'f 'yn shm' 'mrykhm
verses.translation: Who hath declared from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, He is righteous? yea, there is none that sheweth, yea, there is none that declareth, yea, there is none that heareth your words.

verses.original: רִאשׁ֥וֹן לְ/צִיּ֖וֹן הִנֵּ֣ה הִנָּ֑/ם וְ/לִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם מְבַשֵּׂ֥ר אֶתֵּֽן
verses.translit: r'shvn ltsyvn hnh hnm vlyrvshlm mbshr 'tn
verses.translation: The first shall say to Zion, Behold, behold them: and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨רֶא֙ וְ/אֵ֣ין אִ֔ישׁ וּ/מֵ/אֵ֖לֶּה וְ/אֵ֣ין יוֹעֵ֑ץ וְ/אֶשְׁאָלֵ֖/ם וְ/יָשִׁ֥יבוּ דָבָֽר
verses.translit: v'r' v'yn 'ysh vm'lh v'yn yv'ts v'sh'lm vyshybv dbr
verses.translation: For I beheld, and there was no man; even among them, and there was no counsellor, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.

verses.original: הֵ֣ן כֻּלָּ֔/ם אָ֥וֶן אֶ֖פֶס מַעֲשֵׂי/הֶ֑ם ר֥וּחַ וָ/תֹ֖הוּ נִסְכֵּי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: hn khlm 'vn 'ps m'shyhm rvch vthv nskhyhm
verses.translation: Behold, they are all vanity; their works are nothing: their molten images are wind and confusion.

verses.original: הֵ֤ן עַבְדִּ/י֙ אֶתְמָךְ בּ֔/וֹ בְּחִירִ֖/י רָצְתָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑/י נָתַ֤תִּי רוּחִ/י֙ עָלָ֔י/ו מִשְׁפָּ֖ט לַ/גּוֹיִ֥ם יוֹצִֽיא
verses.translit: hn 'bdy 'tmkh bv bchyry rtsth npshy ntty rvchy 'lyv mshpt lgvym yvtsy'
verses.translation: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.

verses.original: לֹ֥א יִצְעַ֖ק וְ/לֹ֣א יִשָּׂ֑א וְ/לֹֽא יַשְׁמִ֥יעַ בַּ/ח֖וּץ קוֹלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: l' yts'q vl' ysh' vl' yshmy' bchvts qvlv
verses.translation: He shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.

verses.original: קָנֶ֤ה רָצוּץ֙ לֹ֣א יִשְׁבּ֔וֹר וּ/פִשְׁתָּ֥ה כֵהָ֖ה לֹ֣א יְכַבֶּ֑/נָּה לֶ/אֱמֶ֖ת יוֹצִ֥יא מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: qnh rtsvts l' yshbvr vpshth khhh l' ykhbnh l'mt yvtsy' mshpt
verses.translation: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.

verses.original: לֹ֤א יִכְהֶה֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יָר֔וּץ עַד יָשִׂ֥ים בָּ/אָ֖רֶץ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ/לְ/תוֹרָת֖/וֹ אִיִּ֥ים יְיַחֵֽילוּ
verses.translit: l' ykhhh vl' yrvts 'd yshym b'rts mshpt vltvrtv 'yym yychylv
verses.translation: He shall not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in the earth: and the isles shall wait for his law.

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר הָ/אֵ֣ל יְהוָ֗ה בּוֹרֵ֤א הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ וְ/נ֣וֹטֵי/הֶ֔ם רֹקַ֥ע הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וְ/צֶאֱצָאֶ֑י/הָ נֹתֵ֤ן נְשָׁמָה֙ לָ/עָ֣ם עָלֶ֔י/הָ וְ/ר֖וּחַ לַ/הֹלְכִ֥ים בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khh 'mr h'l yhvh bvr' hshmym vnvtyhm rq' h'rts vts'ts'yh ntn nshmh l'm 'lyh vrvch lhlkhym bh
verses.translation: Thus saith God the LORD , he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:

verses.original: אֲנִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה קְרָאתִ֥י/ךָֽ בְ/צֶ֖דֶק וְ/אַחְזֵ֣ק בְּ/יָדֶ֑/ךָ וְ/אֶצָּרְ/ךָ֗ וְ/אֶתֶּנְ/ךָ֛ לִ/בְרִ֥ית עָ֖ם לְ/א֥וֹר גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: 'ny yhvh qr'tykh btsdq v'chzq bydkh v'tsrkh v'tnkh lbryt 'm l'vr gvym
verses.translation: I the LORD have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thine hand, and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;

verses.original: לִ/פְקֹ֖חַ עֵינַ֣יִם עִוְר֑וֹת לְ/הוֹצִ֤יא מִ/מַּסְגֵּר֙ אַסִּ֔יר מִ/בֵּ֥ית כֶּ֖לֶא יֹ֥שְׁבֵי חֹֽשֶׁךְ
verses.translit: lpqch 'ynym 'vrvt lhvtsy' mmsgr 'syr mbyt khl' yshby chshkh
verses.translation: To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison, and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה ה֣וּא שְׁמִ֑/י וּ/כְבוֹדִ/י֙ לְ/אַחֵ֣ר לֹֽא אֶתֵּ֔ן וּ/תְהִלָּתִ֖/י לַ/פְּסִילִֽים
verses.translit: 'ny yhvh hv' shmy vkhbvdy l'chr l' 'tn vthlty lpsylym
verses.translation: I am the LORD : that is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.

verses.original: הָ/רִֽאשֹׁנ֖וֹת הִנֵּה בָ֑אוּ וַֽ/חֲדָשׁוֹת֙ אֲנִ֣י מַגִּ֔יד בְּ/טֶ֥רֶם תִּצְמַ֖חְנָה אַשְׁמִ֥יע אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: hr'shnvt hnh b'v vchdshvt 'ny mgyd btrm ttsmchnh 'shmy' 'tkhm
verses.translation: Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.

verses.original: שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽ/יהוָה֙ שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֔שׁ תְּהִלָּת֖/וֹ מִ/קְצֵ֣ה הָ/אָ֑רֶץ יוֹרְדֵ֤י הַ/יָּם֙ וּ/מְלֹא֔/וֹ אִיִּ֖ים וְ/יֹשְׁבֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: shyrv lyhvh shyr chdsh thltv mqtsh h'rts yvrdy hym vml'v 'yym vyshbyhm
verses.translation: Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.

verses.original: יִשְׂא֤וּ מִדְבָּר֙ וְ/עָרָ֔י/ו חֲצֵרִ֖ים תֵּשֵׁ֣ב קֵדָ֑ר יָרֹ֨נּוּ֙ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי סֶ֔לַע מֵ/רֹ֥אשׁ הָרִ֖ים יִצְוָֽחוּ
verses.translit: ysh'v mdbr v'ryv chtsrym tshb qdr yrnv yshby sl' mr'sh hrym ytsvchv
verses.translation: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice , the villages that Kedar doth inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.

verses.original: יָשִׂ֥ימוּ לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה כָּב֑וֹד וּ/תְהִלָּת֖/וֹ בָּ/אִיִּ֥ים יַגִּֽידוּ
verses.translit: yshymv lyhvh khbvd vthltv b'yym ygydv
verses.translation: Let them give glory unto the LORD , and declare his praise in the islands.

verses.original: יְהוָה֙ כַּ/גִּבּ֣וֹר יֵצֵ֔א כְּ/אִ֥ישׁ מִלְחָמ֖וֹת יָעִ֣יר קִנְאָ֑ה יָרִ֨יעַ֙ אַף יַצְרִ֔יחַ עַל אֹיְבָ֖י/ו יִתְגַּבָּֽר
verses.translit: yhvh khgbvr yts' kh'ysh mlchmvt y'yr qn'h yry' 'f ytsrych 'l 'ybyv ytgbr
verses.translation: The LORD shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.

verses.original: הֶחֱשֵׁ֨יתִי֙ מֵֽ/עוֹלָ֔ם אַחֲרִ֖ישׁ אֶתְאַפָּ֑ק כַּ/יּוֹלֵדָ֣ה אֶפְעֶ֔ה אֶשֹּׁ֥ם וְ/אֶשְׁאַ֖ף יָֽחַד
verses.translit: hchshyty m'vlm 'chrysh 't'pq khyvldh 'p'h 'shm v'sh'f ychd
verses.translation: I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained myself: now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.

verses.original: אַחֲרִ֤יב הָרִים֙ וּ/גְבָע֔וֹת וְ/כָל עֶשְׂבָּ֖/ם אוֹבִ֑ישׁ וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֤י נְהָרוֹת֙ לָֽ/אִיִּ֔ים וַ/אֲגַמִּ֖ים אוֹבִֽישׁ
verses.translit: 'chryb hrym vgb'vt vkhl 'shbm 'vbysh vshmty nhrvt l'yym v'gmym 'vbysh
verses.translation: I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and I will dry up the pools.

verses.original: וְ/הוֹלַכְתִּ֣י עִוְרִ֗ים בְּ/דֶ֨רֶךְ֙ לֹ֣א יָדָ֔עוּ בִּ/נְתִיב֥וֹת לֹֽא יָדְע֖וּ אַדְרִיכֵ֑/ם אָשִׂים֩ מַחְשָׁ֨ךְ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֜ם לָ/א֗וֹר וּ/מַֽעֲקַשִּׁים֙ לְ/מִישׁ֔וֹר אֵ֚לֶּה הַ/דְּבָרִ֔ים עֲשִׂיתִ֖/ם וְ/לֹ֥א עֲזַבְתִּֽי/ם
verses.translit: vhvlkhty 'vrym bdrkh l' yd'v bntybvt l' yd'v 'drykhm 'shym mchshkh lpnyhm l'vr vm'qshym lmyshvr 'lh hdbrym 'shytm vl' 'zbtym
verses.translation: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not; I will lead them in paths that they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them.

verses.original: נָסֹ֤גוּ אָחוֹר֙ יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ בֹ֔שֶׁת הַ/בֹּטְחִ֖ים בַּ/פָּ֑סֶל הָ/אֹמְרִ֥ים לְ/מַסֵּכָ֖ה אַתֶּ֥ם אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: nsgv 'chvr ybshv bsht hbtchym bpsl h'mrym lmskhh 'tm 'lhynv
verses.translation: They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, Ye are our gods.

verses.original: הַ/חֵרְשִׁ֖ים שְׁמָ֑עוּ וְ/הַ/עִוְרִ֖ים הַבִּ֥יטוּ לִ/רְאֽוֹת
verses.translit: hchrshym shm'v vh'vrym hbytv lr'vt
verses.translation: Hear, ye deaf; and look, ye blind, that ye may see.

verses.original: מִ֤י עִוֵּר֙ כִּ֣י אִם עַבְדִּ֔/י וְ/חֵרֵ֖שׁ כְּ/מַלְאָכִ֣/י אֶשְׁלָ֑ח מִ֤י עִוֵּר֙ כִּ/מְשֻׁלָּ֔ם וְ/עִוֵּ֖ר כְּ/עֶ֥בֶד יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: my 'vr khy 'm 'bdy vchrsh khml'khy 'shlch my 'vr khmshlm v'vr kh'bd yhvh
verses.translation: Who is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I sent? who is blind as he that is perfect, and blind as the LORD’s servant?

verses.original: ראית רָא֥וֹת רַבּ֖וֹת וְ/לֹ֣א תִשְׁמֹ֑ר פָּק֥וֹחַ אָזְנַ֖יִם וְ/לֹ֥א יִשְׁמָֽע
verses.translit: r'yt r'vt rbvt vl' tshmr pqvch 'znym vl' yshm'
verses.translation: Seeing many things, but thou observest not; opening the ears, but he heareth not.

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה חָפֵ֖ץ לְמַ֣עַן צִדְק֑/וֹ יַגְדִּ֥יל תּוֹרָ֖ה וְ/יַאְדִּֽיר
verses.translit: yhvh chpts lm'n tsdqv ygdyl tvrh vy'dyr
verses.translation: The LORD is well pleased for his righteousness’ sake; he will magnify the law, and make it honourable.

verses.original: וְ/הוּא֮ עַם בָּז֣וּז וְ/שָׁסוּי֒ הָפֵ֤חַ בַּֽ/חוּרִים֙ כֻּלָּ֔/ם וּ/בְ/בָתֵּ֥י כְלָאִ֖ים הָחְבָּ֑אוּ הָי֤וּ לָ/בַז֙ וְ/אֵ֣ין מַצִּ֔יל מְשִׁסָּ֖ה וְ/אֵין אֹמֵ֥ר הָשַֽׁב
verses.translit: vhv' 'm bzvz vshsvy hpch bchvrym khlm vbbty khl'ym hchb'v hyv lbz v'yn mtsyl mshsh v'yn 'mr hshb
verses.translation: But this is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.

verses.original: מִ֥י בָ/כֶ֖ם יַאֲזִ֣ין זֹ֑את יַקְשִׁ֥ב וְ/יִשְׁמַ֖ע לְ/אָחֽוֹר
verses.translit: my bkhm y'zyn z't yqshb vyshm' l'chvr
verses.translation: Who among you will give ear to this? who will hearken and hear for the time to come?

verses.original: מִֽי נָתַ֨ן ל/משוסה לִ/מְשִׁסָּ֧ה יַעֲקֹ֛ב וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל לְ/בֹזְזִ֖ים הֲ/ל֣וֹא יְהוָ֑ה ז֚וּ חָטָ֣אנוּ ל֔/וֹ וְ/לֹֽא אָב֤וּ בִ/דְרָכָי/ו֙ הָל֔וֹךְ וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ בְּ/תוֹרָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: my ntn lmshvsh lmshsh y'qb vyshr'l lbzzym hlv' yhvh zv cht'nv lv vl' 'bv bdrkhyv hlvkh vl' shm'v btvrtv
verses.translation: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not the LORD , he against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁפֹּ֤ךְ עָלָי/ו֙ חֵמָ֣ה אַפּ֔/וֹ וֶ/עֱז֖וּז מִלְחָמָ֑ה וַ/תְּלַהֲטֵ֤/הוּ מִ/סָּבִיב֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יָדָ֔ע וַ/תִּבְעַר בּ֖/וֹ וְ/לֹא יָשִׂ֥ים עַל לֵֽב
verses.translit: vyshpkh 'lyv chmh 'pv v'zvz mlchmh vtlhthv msbyb vl' yd' vtb'r bv vl' yshym 'l lb
verses.translation: Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle: and it hath set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֞ה כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ בֹּרַאֲ/ךָ֣ יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/יֹצֶרְ/ךָ֖ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אַל תִּירָא֙ כִּ֣י גְאַלְתִּ֔י/ךָ קָרָ֥אתִי בְ/שִׁמְ/ךָ֖ לִ/י אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: v'th khh 'mr yhvh br'kh y'qb vytsrkh yshr'l 'l tyr' khy g'ltykh qr'ty bshmkh ly 'th
verses.translation: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.

verses.original: כִּֽי תַעֲבֹ֤ר בַּ/מַּ֨יִם֙ אִתְּ/ךָ אָ֔נִי וּ/בַ/נְּהָר֖וֹת לֹ֣א יִשְׁטְפ֑וּ/ךָ כִּֽי תֵלֵ֤ךְ בְּמוֹ אֵשׁ֙ לֹ֣א תִכָּוֶ֔ה וְ/לֶהָבָ֖ה לֹ֥א תִבְעַר בָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khy t'br bmym 'tkh 'ny vbnhrvt l' yshtpvkh khy tlkh bmv 'sh l' tkhvh vlhbh l' tb'r bkh
verses.translation: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.

verses.original: כִּ֗י אֲנִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מוֹשִׁיעֶ֑/ךָ נָתַ֤תִּי כָפְרְ/ךָ֙ מִצְרַ֔יִם כּ֥וּשׁ וּ/סְבָ֖א תַּחְתֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: khy 'ny yhvh 'lhykh qdvsh yshr'l mvshy'kh ntty khprkh mtsrym khvsh vsb' tchtykh
verses.translation: For I am the LORD thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.

verses.original: מֵ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָקַ֧רְתָּ בְ/עֵינַ֛/י נִכְבַּ֖דְתָּ וַ/אֲנִ֣י אֲהַבְתִּ֑י/ךָ וְ/אֶתֵּ֤ן אָדָם֙ תַּחְתֶּ֔י/ךָ וּ/לְאֻמִּ֖ים תַּ֥חַת נַפְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: m'shr yqrt b'yny nkhbdt v'ny 'hbtykh v'tn 'dm tchtykh vl'mym tcht npshkh
verses.translation: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.

verses.original: אַל תִּירָ֖א כִּ֣י אִתְּ/ךָ אָ֑נִי מִ/מִּזְרָח֙ אָבִ֣יא זַרְעֶ֔/ךָ וּ/מִֽ/מַּעֲרָ֖ב אֲקַבְּצֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: 'l tyr' khy 'tkh 'ny mmzrch 'by' zr'kh vmm'rb 'qbtskh
verses.translation: Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;

verses.original: אֹמַ֤ר לַ/צָּפוֹן֙ תֵּ֔נִי וּ/לְ/תֵימָ֖ן אַל תִּכְלָ֑אִי הָבִ֤יאִי בָנַ/י֙ מֵ/רָח֔וֹק וּ/בְנוֹתַ֖/י מִ/קְצֵ֥ה הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: 'mr ltspvn tny vltymn 'l tkhl'y hby'y bny mrchvq vbnvty mqtsh h'rts
verses.translation: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;

verses.original: כֹּ֚ל הַ/נִּקְרָ֣א בִ/שְׁמִ֔/י וְ/לִ/כְבוֹדִ֖/י בְּרָאתִ֑י/ו יְצַרְתִּ֖י/ו אַף עֲשִׂיתִֽי/ו
verses.translit: khl hnqr' bshmy vlkhbvdy br'tyv ytsrtyv 'f 'shytyv
verses.translation: Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.

verses.original: הוֹצִ֥יא עַם עִוֵּ֖ר וְ/עֵינַ֣יִם יֵ֑שׁ וְ/חֵרְשִׁ֖ים וְ/אָזְנַ֥יִם לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: hvtsy' 'm 'vr v'ynym ysh vchrshym v'znym lmv
verses.translation: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.

verses.original: כָּֽל הַ/גּוֹיִ֞ם נִקְבְּצ֣וּ יַחְדָּ֗ו וְ/יֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ לְאֻמִּ֔ים מִ֤י בָ/הֶם֙ יַגִּ֣יד זֹ֔את וְ/רִֽאשֹׁנ֖וֹת יַשְׁמִיעֻ֑/נוּ יִתְּנ֤וּ עֵֽדֵי/הֶם֙ וְ/יִצְדָּ֔קוּ וְ/יִשְׁמְע֖וּ וְ/יֹאמְר֥וּ אֱמֶֽת
verses.translit: khl hgvym nqbtsv ychdv vy'spv l'mym my bhm ygyd z't vr'shnvt yshmy'nv ytnv 'dyhm vytsdqv vyshm'v vy'mrv 'mt
verses.translation: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say, It is truth.

verses.original: אַתֶּ֤ם עֵדַ/י֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וְ/עַבְדִּ֖/י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחָ֑רְתִּי לְמַ֣עַן תֵּ֠דְעוּ וְ/תַאֲמִ֨ינוּ לִ֤/י וְ/תָבִ֨ינוּ֙ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י ה֔וּא לְ/פָנַ/י֙ לֹא נ֣וֹצַר אֵ֔ל וְ/אַחֲרַ֖/י לֹ֥א יִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: 'tm 'dy n'm yhvh v'bdy 'shr bchrty lm'n td'v vt'mynv ly vtbynv khy 'ny hv' lpny l' nvtsr 'l v'chry l' yhyh
verses.translation: Ye are my witnesses, saith the LORD , and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֥י אָנֹכִ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/אֵ֥ין מִ/בַּלְעָדַ֖/י מוֹשִֽׁיעַ
verses.translit: 'nkhy 'nkhy yhvh v'yn mbl'dy mvshy'
verses.translation: I, even I, am the LORD ; and beside me there is no saviour.

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֞י הִגַּ֤דְתִּי וְ/הוֹשַׁ֨עְתִּי֙ וְ/הִשְׁמַ֔עְתִּי וְ/אֵ֥ין בָּ/כֶ֖ם זָ֑ר וְ/אַתֶּ֥ם עֵדַ֛/י נְאֻם יְהוָ֖ה וַֽ/אֲנִי אֵֽל
verses.translit: 'nkhy hgdty vhvsh'ty vhshm'ty v'yn bkhm zr v'tm 'dy n'm yhvh v'ny 'l
verses.translation: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when there was no strange god among you: therefore ye are my witnesses, saith the LORD , that I am God.

verses.original: גַּם מִ/יּוֹם֙ אֲנִ֣י ה֔וּא וְ/אֵ֥ין מִ/יָּדִ֖/י מַצִּ֑יל אֶפְעַ֖ל וּ/מִ֥י יְשִׁיבֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: gm myvm 'ny hv' v'yn mydy mtsyl 'p'l vmy yshybnh
verses.translation: Yea, before the day was I am he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה גֹּאַלְ/כֶ֖ם קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְמַעַנְ/כֶ֞ם שִׁלַּ֣חְתִּי בָבֶ֗לָ/ה וְ/הוֹרַדְתִּ֤י בָֽ/רִיחִים֙ כֻּלָּ֔/ם וְ/כַשְׂדִּ֖ים בָּ/אֳנִיּ֥וֹת רִנָּתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh g'lkhm qdvsh yshr'l lm'nkhm shlchty bblh vhvrdty brychym khlm vkhshdym b'nyvt rntm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry is in the ships.

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה קְדֽוֹשְׁ/כֶ֑ם בּוֹרֵ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מַלְכְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'ny yhvh qdvshkhm bvr' yshr'l mlkhkhm
verses.translation: I am the LORD , your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הַ/נּוֹתֵ֥ן בַּ/יָּ֖ם דָּ֑רֶךְ וּ/בְ/מַ֥יִם עַזִּ֖ים נְתִיבָֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh hnvtn bym drkh vbmym 'zym ntybh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;

verses.original: הַ/מּוֹצִ֥יא רֶֽכֶב וָ/ס֖וּס חַ֣יִל וְ/עִזּ֑וּז יַחְדָּ֤ו יִשְׁכְּבוּ֙ בַּל יָק֔וּמוּ דָּעֲכ֖וּ כַּ/פִּשְׁתָּ֥ה כָבֽוּ
verses.translit: hmvtsy' rkhb vsvs chyl v'zvz ychdv yshkhbv bl yqvmv d'khv khpshth khbv
verses.translation: Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.

verses.original: אַֽל תִּזְכְּר֖וּ רִֽאשֹׁנ֑וֹת וְ/קַדְמֹנִיּ֖וֹת אַל תִּתְבֹּנָֽנוּ
verses.translit: 'l tzkhrv r'shnvt vqdmnyvt 'l ttbnnv
verses.translation: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֨י עֹשֶׂ֤ה חֲדָשָׁה֙ עַתָּ֣ה תִצְמָ֔ח הֲ/ל֖וֹא תֵֽדָע֑וּ/הָ אַ֣ף אָשִׂ֤ים בַּ/מִּדְבָּר֙ דֶּ֔רֶךְ בִּֽ/ישִׁמ֖וֹן נְהָרֽוֹת
verses.translit: hnny 'shh chdshh 'th ttsmch hlv' td'vh 'f 'shym bmdbr drkh byshmvn nhrvt
verses.translation: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

verses.original: תְּכַבְּדֵ֨/נִי֙ חַיַּ֣ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה תַּנִּ֖ים וּ/בְנ֣וֹת יַֽעֲנָ֑ה כִּֽי נָתַ֨תִּי בַ/מִּדְבָּ֜ר מַ֗יִם נְהָרוֹת֙ בִּֽ/ישִׁימֹ֔ן לְ/הַשְׁק֖וֹת עַמִּ֥/י בְחִירִֽ/י
verses.translit: tkhbdny chyt hshdh tnym vbnvt y'nh khy ntty bmdbr mym nhrvt byshymn lhshqvt 'my bchyry
verses.translation: The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen.

verses.original: עַם זוּ֙ יָצַ֣רְתִּי לִ֔/י תְּהִלָּתִ֖/י יְסַפֵּֽרוּ
verses.translit: 'm zv ytsrty ly thlty ysprv
verses.translation: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא אֹתִ֥/י קָרָ֖אתָ יַֽעֲקֹ֑ב כִּֽי יָגַ֥עְתָּ בִּ֖/י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vl' 'ty qr't y'qb khy yg't by yshr'l
verses.translation: But thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.

verses.original: לֹֽא הֵבֵ֤יאתָ לִּ/י֙ שֵׂ֣ה עֹלֹתֶ֔י/ךָ וּ/זְבָחֶ֖י/ךָ לֹ֣א כִבַּדְתָּ֑/נִי לֹ֤א הֶעֱבַדְתִּ֨י/ךָ֙ בְּ/מִנְחָ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א הוֹגַעְתִּ֖י/ךָ בִּ/לְבוֹנָֽה
verses.translit: l' hby't ly shh 'ltykh vzbchykh l' khbdtny l' h'bdtykh bmnchh vl' hvg'tykh blbvnh
verses.translation: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices. I have not caused thee to serve with an offering, nor wearied thee with incense.

verses.original: לֹא קָנִ֨יתָ לִּ֤/י בַ/כֶּ֨סֶף֙ קָנֶ֔ה וְ/חֵ֥לֶב זְבָחֶ֖י/ךָ לֹ֣א הִרְוִיתָ֑/נִי אַ֗ךְ הֶעֱבַדְתַּ֨/נִי֙ בְּ/חַטֹּאותֶ֔י/ךָ הוֹגַעְתַּ֖/נִי בַּ/עֲוֺנֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: l' qnyt ly bkhsf qnh vchlb zbchykh l' hrvytny 'kh h'bdtny bcht'vtykh hvg'tny b'vntykh
verses.translation: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices: but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֨י אָנֹכִ֥י ה֛וּא מֹחֶ֥ה פְשָׁעֶ֖י/ךָ לְמַעֲנִ֑/י וְ/חַטֹּאתֶ֖י/ךָ לֹ֥א אֶזְכֹּֽר
verses.translit: 'nkhy 'nkhy hv' mchh psh'ykh lm'ny vcht'tykh l' 'zkhr
verses.translation: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.

verses.original: הַזְכִּירֵ֕/נִי נִשָּׁפְטָ֖ה יָ֑חַד סַפֵּ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה לְמַ֥עַן תִּצְדָּֽק
verses.translit: hzkhyrny nshpth ychd spr 'th lm'n ttsdq
verses.translation: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.

verses.original: אָבִ֥י/ךָ הָ/רִאשׁ֖וֹן חָטָ֑א וּ/מְלִיצֶ֖י/ךָ פָּ֥שְׁעוּ בִֽ/י
verses.translit: 'bykh hr'shvn cht' vmlytsykh psh'v by
verses.translation: Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.

verses.original: וַ/אֲחַלֵּ֖ל שָׂ֣רֵי קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְ/אֶתְּנָ֤ה לַ/חֵ֨רֶם֙ יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/גִדּוּפִֽים
verses.translit: v'chll shry qdsh v'tnh lchrm y'qb vyshr'l lgdvpym
verses.translation: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֥ה שְׁמַ֖ע יַעֲקֹ֣ב עַבְדִּ֑/י וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּחַ֥רְתִּי בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'th shm' y'qb 'bdy vyshr'l bchrty bv
verses.translation: Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant; and Israel, whom I have chosen:

verses.original: כֹּה אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֥ה עֹשֶׂ֛/ךָ וְ/יֹצֶרְ/ךָ֥ מִ/בֶּ֖טֶן יַעְזְרֶ֑/ךָּ אַל תִּירָא֙ עַבְדִּ֣/י יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וִ/ישֻׁר֖וּן בָּחַ֥רְתִּי בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'shkh vytsrkh mbtn y'zrkh 'l tyr' 'bdy y'qb vyshrvn bchrty bv
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD that made thee, and formed thee from the womb, which will help thee; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and thou, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֶצָּק מַ֨יִם֙ עַל צָמֵ֔א וְ/נֹזְלִ֖ים עַל יַבָּשָׁ֑ה אֶצֹּ֤ק רוּחִ/י֙ עַל זַרְעֶ֔/ךָ וּ/בִרְכָתִ֖/י עַל צֶאֱצָאֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: khy 'tsq mym 'l tsm' vnzlym 'l ybshh 'tsq rvchy 'l zr'kh vbrkhty 'l ts'ts'ykh
verses.translation: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:

verses.original: וְ/צָמְח֖וּ בְּ/בֵ֣ין חָצִ֑יר כַּ/עֲרָבִ֖ים עַל יִבְלֵי מָֽיִם
verses.translit: vtsmchv bbyn chtsyr kh'rbym 'l ybly mym
verses.translation: And they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.

verses.original: זֶ֤ה יֹאמַר֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֣ה אָ֔נִי וְ/זֶ֖ה יִקְרָ֣א בְ/שֵֽׁם יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְ/זֶ֗ה יִכְתֹּ֤ב יָד/וֹ֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה וּ/בְ/שֵׁ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יְכַנֶּֽה
verses.translit: zh y'mr lyhvh 'ny vzh yqr' bshm y'qb vzh ykhtb ydv lyhvh vbshm yshr'l ykhnh
verses.translation: One shall say, I am the LORD’s ; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the LORD , and surname himself by the name of Israel.

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה מֶֽלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וְ/גֹאֲל֖/וֹ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אֲנִ֤י רִאשׁוֹן֙ וַ/אֲנִ֣י אַחֲר֔וֹן וּ/מִ/בַּלְעָדַ֖/י אֵ֥ין אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh mlkh yshr'l vg'lv yhvh tsb'vt 'ny r'shvn v'ny 'chrvn vmbl'dy 'yn 'lhym
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD the King of Israel, and his redeemer the LORD of hosts; I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no God.

verses.original: וּ/מִֽי כָמ֣וֹ/נִי יִקְרָ֗א וְ/יַגִּידֶ֤/הָ וְ/יַעְרְכֶ֨/הָ֙ לִ֔/י מִ/שּׂוּמִ֖/י עַם עוֹלָ֑ם וְ/אֹתִיּ֛וֹת וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּבֹ֖אנָה יַגִּ֥ידוּ לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: vmy khmvny yqr' vygydh vy'rkhh ly mshvmy 'm 'vlm v'tyvt v'shr tb'nh ygydv lmv
verses.translation: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them.

verses.original: אַֽל תִּפְחֲדוּ֙ וְ/אַל תִּרְה֔וּ הֲ/לֹ֥א מֵ/אָ֛ז הִשְׁמַעְתִּ֥י/ךָ וְ/הִגַּ֖דְתִּי וְ/אַתֶּ֣ם עֵדָ֑/י הֲ/יֵ֤שׁ אֱל֨וֹהַּ֙ מִ/בַּלְעָדַ֔/י וְ/אֵ֥ין צ֖וּר בַּל יָדָֽעְתִּי
verses.translit: 'l tpchdv v'l trhv hl' m'z hshm'tykh vhgdty v'tm 'dy hysh 'lvh mbl'dy v'yn tsvr bl yd'ty
verses.translation: Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have not I told thee from that time, and have declared it ? ye are even my witnesses. Is there a God beside me? yea, there is no God; I know not any .

verses.original: יֹֽצְרֵי פֶ֤סֶל כֻּלָּ/ם֙ תֹּ֔הוּ וַ/חֲמוּדֵי/הֶ֖ם בַּל יוֹעִ֑ילוּ וְ/עֵדֵי/הֶ֣ם הֵׄ֗מָּׄהׄ בַּל יִרְא֛וּ וּ/בַל יֵדְע֖וּ לְמַ֥עַן יֵבֹֽשׁוּ
verses.translit: ytsry psl khlm thv vchmvdyhm bl yv'ylv v'dyhm hmh bl yr'v vbl yd'v lm'n ybshv
verses.translation: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.

verses.original: מִֽי יָצַ֥ר אֵ֖ל וּ/פֶ֣סֶל נָסָ֑ךְ לְ/בִלְתִּ֖י הוֹעִֽיל
verses.translit: my ytsr 'l vpsl nskh lblty hv'yl
verses.translation: Who hath formed a god, or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing?

verses.original: הֵ֤ן כָּל חֲבֵרָי/ו֙ יֵבֹ֔שׁוּ וְ/חָרָשִׁ֥ים הֵ֖מָּה מֵֽ/אָדָ֑ם יִֽתְקַבְּצ֤וּ כֻלָּ/ם֙ יַֽעֲמֹ֔דוּ יִפְחֲד֖וּ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ יָֽחַד
verses.translit: hn khl chbryv ybshv vchrshym hmh m'dm ytqbtsv khlm y'mdv ypchdv ybshv ychd
verses.translation: Behold, all his fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; yet they shall fear, and they shall be ashamed together.

verses.original: חָרַ֤שׁ בַּרְזֶל֙ מַֽעֲצָ֔ד וּ/פָעַל֙ בַּ/פֶּחָ֔ם וּ/בַ/מַּקָּב֖וֹת יִצְּרֵ֑/הוּ וַ/יִּפְעָלֵ֨/הוּ֙ בִּ/זְר֣וֹעַ כֹּח֔/וֹ גַּם רָעֵב֙ וְ/אֵ֣ין כֹּ֔חַ לֹא שָׁ֥תָה מַ֖יִם וַ/יִּיעָֽף
verses.translit: chrsh brzl m'tsd vp'l bpchm vbmqbvt ytsrhv vyp'lhv bzrv' khchv gm r'b v'yn khch l' shth mym vyy'f
verses.translation: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth: he drinketh no water, and is faint.

verses.original: חָרַ֣שׁ עֵצִים֮ נָ֣טָה קָו֒ יְתָאֲרֵ֣/הוּ בַ/שֶּׂ֔רֶד יַעֲשֵׂ֨/הוּ֙ בַּ/מַּקְצֻע֔וֹת וּ/בַ/מְּחוּגָ֖ה יְתָאֳרֵ֑/הוּ וַֽ/יַּעֲשֵׂ֨/הוּ֙ כְּ/תַבְנִ֣ית אִ֔ישׁ כְּ/תִפְאֶ֥רֶת אָדָ֖ם לָ/שֶׁ֥בֶת בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: chrsh 'tsym nth qv yt'rhv bshrd y'shhv bmqts'vt vbmchvgh yt'rhv vy'shhv khtbnyt 'ysh khtp'rt 'dm lshbt byt
verses.translation: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.

verses.original: לִ/כְרָת ל֣/וֹ אֲרָזִ֔ים וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח תִּרְזָה֙ וְ/אַלּ֔וֹן וַ/יְאַמֶּץ ל֖/וֹ בַּ/עֲצֵי יָ֑עַר נָטַ֥ע אֹ֖רֶן וְ/גֶ֥שֶׁם יְגַדֵּֽל
verses.translit: lkhrt lv 'rzym vyqch trzh v'lvn vy'mts lv b'tsy y'r nt' 'rn vgshm ygdl
verses.translation: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish it .

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֤ה לְ/אָדָם֙ לְ/בָעֵ֔ר וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח מֵ/הֶם֙ וַ/יָּ֔חָם אַף יַשִּׂ֖יק וְ/אָ֣פָה לָ֑חֶם אַף יִפְעַל אֵל֙ וַ/יִּשְׁתָּ֔חוּ עָשָׂ֥/הוּ פֶ֖סֶל וַ/יִּסְגָּד לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: vhyh l'dm lb'r vyqch mhm vychm 'f yshyq v'ph lchm 'f yp'l 'l vyshtchv 'shhv psl vysgd lmv
verses.translation: Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it , and baketh bread; yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth it; he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.

verses.original: חֶצְי/וֹ֙ שָׂרַ֣ף בְּמוֹ אֵ֔שׁ עַל חֶצְי/וֹ֙ בָּשָׂ֣ר יֹאכֵ֔ל יִצְלֶ֥ה צָלִ֖י וְ/יִשְׂבָּ֑ע אַף יָחֹם֙ וְ/יֹאמַ֣ר הֶאָ֔ח חַמּוֹתִ֖י רָאִ֥יתִי אֽוּר
verses.translit: chtsyv shrf bmv 'sh 'l chtsyv bshr y'khl ytslh tsly vyshb' 'f ychm vy'mr h'ch chmvty r'yty 'vr
verses.translation: He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth himself , and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:

verses.original: וּ/שְׁאֵ֣רִית֔/וֹ לְ/אֵ֥ל עָשָׂ֖ה לְ/פִסְל֑/וֹ יסגוד יִסְגָּד ל֤/וֹ וְ/יִשְׁתַּ֨חוּ֙ וְ/יִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל אֵלָ֔י/ו וְ/יֹאמַר֙ הַצִּילֵ֔/נִי כִּ֥י אֵלִ֖/י אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: vsh'rytv l'l 'shh lpslv ysgvd ysgd lv vyshtchv vytpll 'lyv vy'mr htsylny khy 'ly 'th
verses.translation: And the residue thereof he maketh a god, even his graven image: he falleth down unto it, and worshippeth it , and prayeth unto it, and saith, Deliver me; for thou art my god.

verses.original: לֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּ וְ/לֹ֣א יָבִ֑ינוּ כִּ֣י טַ֤ח מֵֽ/רְאוֹת֙ עֵֽינֵי/הֶ֔ם מֵ/הַשְׂכִּ֖יל לִבֹּתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: l' yd'v vl' ybynv khy tch mr'vt 'ynyhm mhshkhyl lbtm
verses.translation: They have not known nor understood: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא יָשִׁ֣יב אֶל לִבּ֗/וֹ וְ/לֹ֨א דַ֥עַת וְ/לֹֽא תְבוּנָה֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ חֶצְי֞/וֹ שָׂרַ֣פְתִּי בְמוֹ אֵ֗שׁ וְ֠/אַף אָפִ֤יתִי עַל גֶּחָלָי/ו֙ לֶ֔חֶם אֶצְלֶ֥ה בָשָׂ֖ר וְ/אֹכֵ֑ל וְ/יִתְר/וֹ֙ לְ/תוֹעֵבָ֣ה אֶעֱשֶׂ֔ה לְ/ב֥וּל עֵ֖ץ אֶסְגּֽוֹד
verses.translit: vl' yshyb 'l lbv vl' d't vl' tbvnh l'mr chtsyv shrpty bmv 'sh v'f 'pyty 'l gchlyv lchm 'tslh bshr v'khl vytrv ltv'bh ''shh lbvl 'ts 'sgvd
verses.translation: And none considereth in his heart, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, and eaten it: and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?

verses.original: רֹעֶ֣ה אֵ֔פֶר לֵ֥ב הוּתַ֖ל הִטָּ֑/הוּ וְ/לֹֽא יַצִּ֤יל אֶת נַפְשׁ/וֹ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יֹאמַ֔ר הֲ/ל֥וֹא שֶׁ֖קֶר בִּ/ימִינִֽ/י
verses.translit: r'h 'pr lb hvtl hthv vl' ytsyl 't npshv vl' y'mr hlv' shqr bymyny
verses.translation: He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart hath turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?

verses.original: זְכָר אֵ֣לֶּה יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כִּ֣י עַבְדִּ/י אָ֑תָּה יְצַרְתִּ֤י/ךָ עֶֽבֶד לִ/י֙ אַ֔תָּה יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֥א תִנָּשֵֽׁ/נִי
verses.translit: zkhr 'lh y'qb vyshr'l khy 'bdy 'th ytsrtykh 'bd ly 'th yshr'l l' tnshny
verses.translation: Remember these, O Jacob and Israel; for thou art my servant: I have formed thee; thou art my servant: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.

verses.original: מָחִ֤יתִי כָ/עָב֙ פְּשָׁעֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/כֶ/עָנָ֖ן חַטֹּאותֶ֑י/ךָ שׁוּבָ֥/ה אֵלַ֖/י כִּ֥י גְאַלְתִּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: mchyty kh'b psh'ykh vkh'nn cht'vtykh shvbh 'ly khy g'ltykh
verses.translation: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.

verses.original: רָנּ֨וּ שָׁמַ֜יִם כִּֽי עָשָׂ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה הָרִ֨יעוּ֙ תַּחְתִּיּ֣וֹת אָ֔רֶץ פִּצְח֤וּ הָרִים֙ רִנָּ֔ה יַ֖עַר וְ/כָל עֵ֣ץ בּ֑/וֹ כִּֽי גָאַ֤ל יְהוָה֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וּ/בְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִתְפָּאָֽר
verses.translit: rnv shmym khy 'shh yhvh hry'v tchtyvt 'rts ptschv hrym rnh y'r vkhl 'ts bv khy g'l yhvh y'qb vbyshr'l ytp'r
verses.translation: Sing, O ye heavens; for the LORD hath done it: shout, ye lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for the LORD hath redeemed Jacob, and glorified himself in Israel.

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ גֹּאֲלֶ֔/ךָ וְ/יֹצֶרְ/ךָ֖ מִ/בָּ֑טֶן אָנֹכִ֤י יְהוָה֙ עֹ֣שֶׂה כֹּ֔ל נֹטֶ֤ה שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ לְ/בַדִּ֔/י רֹקַ֥ע הָ/אָ֖רֶץ מי את/י מֵ/אִתִּֽ/י
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh g'lkh vytsrkh mbtn 'nkhy yhvh 'shh khl nth shmym lbdy rq' h'rts my 'ty m'ty
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , thy redeemer, and he that formed thee from the womb, I am the LORD that maketh all things; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreadeth abroad the earth by myself;

verses.original: מֵפֵר֙ אֹת֣וֹת בַּדִּ֔ים וְ/קֹסְמִ֖ים יְהוֹלֵ֑ל מֵשִׁ֧יב חֲכָמִ֛ים אָח֖וֹר וְ/דַעְתָּ֥/ם יְשַׂכֵּֽל
verses.translit: mpr 'tvt bdym vqsmym yhvll mshyb chkhmym 'chvr vd'tm yshkhl
verses.translation: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;

verses.original: מֵקִים֙ דְּבַ֣ר עַבְדּ֔/וֹ וַ/עֲצַ֥ת מַלְאָכָ֖י/ו יַשְׁלִ֑ים הָ/אֹמֵ֨ר לִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֜ם תּוּשָׁ֗ב וּ/לְ/עָרֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ תִּבָּנֶ֔ינָה וְ/חָרְבוֹתֶ֖י/הָ אֲקוֹמֵֽם
verses.translit: mqym dbr 'bdv v'tst ml'khyv yshlym h'mr lyrvshlm tvshb vl'ry yhvdh tbnynh vchrbvtyh 'qvmm
verses.translation: That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers; that saith to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Judah, Ye shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof:

verses.original: הָ/אֹמֵ֥ר לַ/צּוּלָ֖ה חֳרָ֑בִי וְ/נַהֲרֹתַ֖יִ/ךְ אוֹבִֽישׁ
verses.translit: h'mr ltsvlh chrby vnhrtykh 'vbysh
verses.translation: That saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers:

verses.original: הָ/אֹמֵ֤ר לְ/כ֨וֹרֶשׁ֙ רֹעִ֔/י וְ/כָל חֶפְצִ֖/י יַשְׁלִ֑ם וְ/לֵ/אמֹ֤ר לִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ תִּבָּנֶ֔ה וְ/הֵיכָ֖ל תִּוָּסֵֽד
verses.translit: h'mr lkhvrsh r'y vkhl chptsy yshlm vl'mr lyrvshlm tbnh vhykhl tvsd
verses.translation: That saith of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.

verses.original: כֹּה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֮ לִ/מְשִׁיח/וֹ֮ לְ/כ֣וֹרֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר הֶחֱזַ֣קְתִּי בִֽ/ימִינ֗/וֹ לְ/רַד לְ/פָנָי/ו֙ גּוֹיִ֔ם וּ/מָתְנֵ֥י מְלָכִ֖ים אֲפַתֵּ֑חַ לִ/פְתֹּ֤חַ לְ/פָנָי/ו֙ דְּלָתַ֔יִם וּ/שְׁעָרִ֖ים לֹ֥א יִסָּגֵֽרוּ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh lmshychv lkhvrsh 'shr hchzqty bymynv lrd lpnyv gvym vmtny mlkhym 'ptch lptch lpnyv dltym vsh'rym l' ysgrv
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;

verses.original: אֲנִי֙ לְ/פָנֶ֣י/ךָ אֵלֵ֔ךְ וַ/הֲדוּרִ֖ים אושר אֲיַשֵּׁ֑ר דַּלְת֤וֹת נְחוּשָׁה֙ אֲשַׁבֵּ֔ר וּ/בְרִיחֵ֥י בַרְזֶ֖ל אֲגַדֵּֽעַ
verses.translit: 'ny lpnykh 'lkh vhdvrym 'vshr 'yshr dltvt nchvshh 'shbr vbrychy brzl 'gd'
verses.translation: I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י לְ/ךָ֙ אוֹצְר֣וֹת חֹ֔שֶׁךְ וּ/מַטְמֻנֵ֖י מִסְתָּרִ֑ים לְמַ֣עַן תֵּדַ֗ע כִּֽי אֲנִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה הַ/קּוֹרֵ֥א בְ/שִׁמְ/ךָ֖ אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vntty lkh 'vtsrvt chshkh vmtmny mstrym lm'n td' khy 'ny yhvh hqvr' bshmkh 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I, the LORD , which call thee by thy name, am the God of Israel.

verses.original: לְמַ֨עַן֙ עַבְדִּ֣/י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּחִירִ֑/י וָ/אֶקְרָ֤א לְ/ךָ֙ בִּ/שְׁמֶ֔/ךָ אֲכַנְּ/ךָ֖ וְ/לֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: lm'n 'bdy y'qb vyshr'l bchyry v'qr' lkh bshmkh 'khnkh vl' yd'tny
verses.translation: For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.

verses.original: אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְ/אֵ֣ין ע֔וֹד זוּלָתִ֖/י אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲאַזֶּרְ/ךָ֖ וְ/לֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'ny yhvh v'yn 'vd zvlty 'yn 'lhym ''zrkh vl' yd'tny
verses.translation: I am the LORD , and there is none else, there is no God beside me: I girded thee, though thou hast not known me:

verses.original: לְמַ֣עַן יֵדְע֗וּ מִ/מִּזְרַח שֶׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ וּ/מִ/מַּ֣עֲרָבָ֔/הּ כִּי אֶ֖פֶס בִּלְעָדָ֑/י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וְ/אֵ֥ין עֽוֹד
verses.translit: lm'n yd'v mmzrch shmsh vmm'rbh khy 'ps bl'dy 'ny yhvh v'yn 'vd
verses.translation: That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is none beside me. I am the LORD , and there is none else.

verses.original: יוֹצֵ֥ר אוֹר֙ וּ/בוֹרֵ֣א חֹ֔שֶׁךְ עֹשֶׂ֥ה שָׁל֖וֹם וּ/ב֣וֹרֵא רָ֑ע אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עֹשֶׂ֥ה כָל אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: yvtsr 'vr vbvr' chshkh 'shh shlvm vbvr' r' 'ny yhvh 'shh khl 'lh
verses.translation: I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the LORD do all these things .

verses.original: הַרְעִ֤יפוּ שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ מִ/מַּ֔עַל וּ/שְׁחָקִ֖ים יִזְּלוּ צֶ֑דֶק תִּפְתַּח אֶ֣רֶץ וְ/יִפְרוּ יֶ֗שַׁע וּ/צְדָקָ֤ה תַצְמִ֨יחַ֙ יַ֔חַד אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּרָאתִֽי/ו
verses.translit: hr'ypv shmym mm'l vshchqym yzlv tsdq tptch 'rts vyprv ysh' vtsdqh ttsmych ychd 'ny yhvh br'tyv
verses.translation: Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation, and let righteousness spring up together; I the LORD have created it.

verses.original: ה֗וֹי רָ֚ב אֶת יֹ֣צְר֔/וֹ חֶ֖רֶשׂ אֶת חַרְשֵׂ֣י אֲדָמָ֑ה הֲ/יֹאמַ֨ר חֹ֤מֶר לְ/יֹֽצְר/וֹ֙ מַֽה תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה וּ/פָעָלְ/ךָ֖ אֵין יָדַ֥יִם לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hvy rb 't ytsrv chrsh 't chrshy 'dmh hy'mr chmr lytsrv mh t'shh vp'lkh 'yn ydym lv
verses.translation: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?

verses.original: ה֛וֹי אֹמֵ֥ר לְ/אָ֖ב מַה תּוֹלִ֑יד וּ/לְ/אִשָּׁ֖ה מַה תְּחִילִֽי/ן
verses.translit: hvy 'mr l'b mh tvlyd vl'shh mh tchylyn
verses.translation: Woe unto him that saith unto his father, What begettest thou? or to the woman, What hast thou brought forth?

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְ/יֹצְר֑/וֹ הָ/אֹתִיּ֣וֹת שְׁאָל֔וּ/נִי עַל בָּנַ֛/י וְ/עַל פֹּ֥עַל יָדַ֖/י תְּצַוֻּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh qdvsh yshr'l vytsrv h'tyvt sh'lvny 'l bny v'l p'l ydy ttsvny
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker, Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands command ye me.

verses.original: אָֽנֹכִי֙ עָשִׂ֣יתִי אֶ֔רֶץ וְ/אָדָ֖ם עָלֶ֣י/הָ בָרָ֑אתִי אֲנִ֗י יָדַ/י֙ נָט֣וּ שָׁמַ֔יִם וְ/כָל צְבָאָ֖/ם צִוֵּֽיתִי
verses.translit: 'nkhy 'shyty 'rts v'dm 'lyh br'ty 'ny ydy ntv shmym vkhl tsb'm tsvyty
verses.translation: I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded.

verses.original: אָנֹכִי֙ הַעִירֹתִ֣/הֽוּ בְ/צֶ֔דֶק וְ/כָל דְּרָכָ֖י/ו אֲיַשֵּׁ֑ר הֽוּא יִבְנֶ֤ה עִירִ/י֙ וְ/גָלוּתִ֣/י יְשַׁלֵּ֔חַ לֹ֤א בִ/מְחִיר֙ וְ/לֹ֣א בְ/שֹׁ֔חַד אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'nkhy h'yrthv btsdq vkhl drkhyv 'yshr hv' ybnh 'yry vglvty yshlch l' bmchyr vl' bshchd 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let go my captives, not for price nor reward, saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה יְגִ֨יעַ מִצְרַ֥יִם וּֽ/סְחַר כּוּשׁ֮ וּ/סְבָאִים֮ אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִדָּה֒ עָלַ֤יִ/ךְ יַעֲבֹ֨רוּ֙ וְ/לָ֣/ךְ יִֽהְי֔וּ אַחֲרַ֣יִ/ךְ יֵלֵ֔כוּ בַּ/זִּקִּ֖ים יַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְ/אֵלַ֤יִ/ךְ יִֽשְׁתַּחֲוּוּ֙ אֵלַ֣יִ/ךְ יִתְפַּלָּ֔לוּ אַ֣ךְ בָּ֥/ךְ אֵ֛ל וְ/אֵ֥ין ע֖וֹד אֶ֥פֶס אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh ygy' mtsrym vschr khvsh vsb'ym 'nshy mdh 'lykh y'brv vlkh yhyv 'chrykh ylkhv bzqym y'brv v'lykh yshtchvv 'lykh ytpllv 'kh bkh 'l v'yn 'vd 'ps 'lhym
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall come after thee; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication unto thee, saying , Surely God is in thee; and there is none else, there is no God.

verses.original: אָכֵ֕ן אַתָּ֖ה אֵ֣ל מִסְתַּתֵּ֑ר אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מוֹשִֽׁיעַ
verses.translit: 'khn 'th 'l msttr 'lhy yshr'l mvshy'
verses.translation: Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour.

verses.original: בּ֥וֹשׁוּ וְ/גַֽם נִכְלְמ֖וּ כֻּלָּ֑/ם יַחְדָּו֙ הָלְכ֣וּ בַ/כְּלִמָּ֔ה חָרָשֵׁ֖י צִירִֽים
verses.translit: bvshv vgm nkhlmv khlm ychdv hlkhv bkhlmh chrshy tsyrym
verses.translation: They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols.

verses.original: יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נוֹשַׁ֣ע בַּ/יהוָ֔ה תְּשׁוּעַ֖ת עוֹלָמִ֑ים לֹא תֵבֹ֥שׁוּ וְ/לֹא תִכָּלְמ֖וּ עַד ע֥וֹלְמֵי עַֽד
verses.translit: yshr'l nvsh' byhvh tshv't 'vlmym l' tbshv vl' tkhlmv 'd 'vlmy 'd
verses.translation: But Israel shall be saved in the LORD with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָֽמַר יְ֠הוָה בּוֹרֵ֨א הַ/שָּׁמַ֜יִם ה֣וּא הָ/אֱלֹהִ֗ים יֹצֵ֨ר הָ/אָ֤רֶץ וְ/עֹשָׂ/הּ֙ ה֣וּא כֽוֹנְנָ֔/הּ לֹא תֹ֥הוּ בְרָאָ֖/הּ לָ/שֶׁ֣בֶת יְצָרָ֑/הּ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וְ/אֵ֥ין עֽוֹד
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh bvr' hshmym hv' h'lhym ytsr h'rts v'shh hv' khvnnh l' thv br'h lshbt ytsrh 'ny yhvh v'yn 'vd
