verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD that created the heavens; God himself that formed the earth and made it; he hath established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I am the LORD ; and there is none else.

verses.original: לֹ֧א בַ/סֵּ֣תֶר דִּבַּ֗רְתִּי בִּ/מְקוֹם֙ אֶ֣רֶץ חֹ֔שֶׁךְ לֹ֥א אָמַ֛רְתִּי לְ/זֶ֥רַע יַעֲקֹ֖ב תֹּ֣הוּ בַקְּשׁ֑וּ/נִי אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ דֹּבֵ֣ר צֶ֔דֶק מַגִּ֖יד מֵישָׁרִֽים
verses.translit: l' bstr dbrty bmqvm 'rts chshkh l' 'mrty lzr' y'qb thv bqshvny 'ny yhvh dbr tsdq mgyd myshrym
verses.translation: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain: I the LORD speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.

verses.original: הִקָּבְצ֥וּ וָ/בֹ֛אוּ הִֽתְנַגְּשׁ֥וּ יַחְדָּ֖ו פְּלִיטֵ֣י הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם לֹ֣א יָדְע֗וּ הַ/נֹּֽשְׂאִים֙ אֶת עֵ֣ץ פִּסְלָ֔/ם וּ/מִתְפַּלְלִ֔ים אֶל אֵ֖ל לֹ֥א יוֹשִֽׁיעַ
verses.translit: hqbtsv vb'v htngshv ychdv plyty hgvym l' yd'v hnsh'ym 't 'ts pslm vmtpllym 'l 'l l' yvshy'
verses.translation: Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, ye that are escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god that cannot save.

verses.original: הַגִּ֣ידוּ וְ/הַגִּ֔ישׁוּ אַ֥ף יִֽוָּעֲצ֖וּ יַחְדָּ֑ו מִ֣י הִשְׁמִיעַ֩ זֹ֨את מִ/קֶּ֜דֶם מֵ/אָ֣ז הִגִּידָ֗/הּ הֲ/ל֨וֹא אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְ/אֵֽין ע֤וֹד אֱלֹהִים֙ מִ/בַּלְעָדַ֔/י אֵֽל צַדִּ֣יק וּ/מוֹשִׁ֔יעַ אַ֖יִן זוּלָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: hgydv vhgyshv 'f yv'tsv ychdv my hshmy' z't mqdm m'z hgydh hlv' 'ny yhvh v'yn 'vd 'lhym mbl'dy 'l tsdyq vmvshy' 'yn zvlty
verses.translation: Tell ye, and bring them near; yea, let them take counsel together: who hath declared this from ancient time? who hath told it from that time? have not I the LORD ? and there is no God else beside me; a just God and a Saviour; there is none beside me.

verses.original: פְּנוּ אֵלַ֥/י וְ/הִוָּשְׁע֖וּ כָּל אַפְסֵי אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י אֲנִי אֵ֖ל וְ/אֵ֥ין עֽוֹד
verses.translit: pnv 'ly vhvsh'v khl 'psy 'rts khy 'ny 'l v'yn 'vd
verses.translation: Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth: for I am God, and there is none else.

verses.original: בִּ֣/י נִשְׁבַּ֔עְתִּי יָצָ֨א מִ/פִּ֧/י צְדָקָ֛ה דָּבָ֖ר וְ/לֹ֣א יָשׁ֑וּב כִּי לִ/י֙ תִּכְרַ֣ע כָּל בֶּ֔רֶךְ תִּשָּׁבַ֖ע כָּל לָשֽׁוֹן
verses.translit: by nshb'ty yts' mpy tsdqh dbr vl' yshvb khy ly tkhr' khl brkh tshb' khl lshvn
verses.translation: I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.

verses.original: אַ֧ךְ בַּ/יהוָ֛ה לִ֥/י אָמַ֖ר צְדָק֣וֹת וָ/עֹ֑ז עָדָי/ו֙ יָב֣וֹא וְ/יֵבֹ֔שׁוּ כֹּ֖ל הַ/נֶּחֱרִ֥ים בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'kh byhvh ly 'mr tsdqvt v'z 'dyv ybv' vybshv khl hnchrym bv
verses.translation: Surely, shall one say, in the LORD have I righteousness and strength: even to him shall men come; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed. is all righteousness and strength

verses.original: בַּ/יהוָ֛ה יִצְדְּק֥וּ וְ/יִֽתְהַלְל֖וּ כָּל זֶ֥רַע יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: byhvh ytsdqv vythllv khl zr' yshr'l
verses.translation: In the LORD shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.

verses.original: כָּרַ֥ע בֵּל֙ קֹרֵ֣ס נְב֔וֹ הָיוּ֙ עֲצַבֵּי/הֶ֔ם לַ/חַיָּ֖ה וְ/לַ/בְּהֵמָ֑ה נְשֻׂאֹתֵי/כֶ֣ם עֲמוּס֔וֹת מַשָּׂ֖א לַ/עֲיֵפָֽה
verses.translit: khr' bl qrs nbv hyv 'tsbyhm lchyh vlbhmh nsh'tykhm 'mvsvt msh' l'yph
verses.translation: Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts, and upon the cattle: your carriages were heavy loaden; they are a burden to the weary beast .

verses.original: קָרְס֤וּ כָֽרְעוּ֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו לֹ֥א יָכְל֖וּ מַלֵּ֣ט מַשָּׂ֑א וְ/נַפְשָׁ֖/ם בַּ/שְּׁבִ֥י הָלָֽכָה
verses.translit: qrsv khr'v ychdv l' ykhlv mlt msh' vnpshm bshby hlkhh
verses.translation: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ אֵלַ/י֙ בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/כָל שְׁאֵרִ֖ית בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הַֽ/עֲמֻסִים֙ מִנִּי בֶ֔טֶן הַ/נְּשֻׂאִ֖ים מִנִּי רָֽחַם
verses.translit: shm'v 'ly byt y'qb vkhl sh'ryt byt yshr'l h'msym mny btn hnsh'ym mny rchm
verses.translation: Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, which are borne by me from the belly, which are carried from the womb:

verses.original: וְ/עַד זִקְנָה֙ אֲנִ֣י ה֔וּא וְ/עַד שֵיבָ֖ה אֲנִ֣י אֶסְבֹּ֑ל אֲנִ֤י עָשִׂ֨יתִי֙ וַ/אֲנִ֣י אֶשָּׂ֔א וַ/אֲנִ֥י אֶסְבֹּ֖ל וַ/אֲמַלֵּֽט
verses.translit: v'd zqnh 'ny hv' v'd shybh 'ny 'sbl 'ny 'shyty v'ny 'sh' v'ny 'sbl v'mlt
verses.translation: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you .

verses.original: לְ/מִ֥י תְדַמְי֖וּ/נִי וְ/תַשְׁו֑וּ וְ/תַמְשִׁל֖וּ/נִי וְ/נִדְמֶֽה
verses.translit: lmy tdmyvny vtshvv vtmshlvny vndmh
verses.translation: To whom will ye liken me, and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be like?

verses.original: הַ/זָּלִ֤ים זָהָב֙ מִ/כִּ֔יס וְ/כֶ֖סֶף בַּ/קָּנֶ֣ה יִשְׁקֹ֑לוּ יִשְׂכְּר֤וּ צוֹרֵף֙ וְ/יַעֲשֵׂ֣/הוּ אֵ֔ל יִסְגְּד֖וּ אַף יִֽשְׁתַּחֲוּֽוּ
verses.translit: hzlym zhb mkhys vkhsf bqnh yshqlv yshkhrv tsvrf vy'shhv 'l ysgdv 'f yshtchvv
verses.translation: They lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance, and hire a goldsmith; and he maketh it a god: they fall down, yea, they worship.

verses.original: יִ֠שָּׂאֻ/הוּ עַל כָּתֵ֨ף יִסְבְּלֻ֜/הוּ וְ/יַנִּיחֻ֤/הוּ תַחְתָּי/ו֙ וְ/יַֽעֲמֹ֔ד מִ/מְּקוֹמ֖/וֹ לֹ֣א יָמִ֑ישׁ אַף יִצְעַ֤ק אֵלָי/ו֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֔ה מִ/צָּרָת֖/וֹ לֹ֥א יוֹשִׁיעֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: ysh'hv 'l khtf ysblhv vynychhv tchtyv vy'md mmqvmv l' ymysh 'f yts'q 'lyv vl' y'nh mtsrtv l' yvshy'nv
verses.translation: They bear him upon the shoulder, they carry him, and set him in his place, and he standeth; from his place shall he not remove: yea, one shall cry unto him, yet can he not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.

verses.original: זִכְרוּ זֹ֖את וְ/הִתְאֹשָׁ֑שׁוּ הָשִׁ֥יבוּ פוֹשְׁעִ֖ים עַל לֵֽב
verses.translit: zkhrv z't vht'shshv hshybv pvsh'ym 'l lb
verses.translation: Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.

verses.original: זִכְר֥וּ רִאשֹׁנ֖וֹת מֵ/עוֹלָ֑ם כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֥י אֵל֙ וְ/אֵ֣ין ע֔וֹד אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְ/אֶ֥פֶס כָּמֽוֹ/נִי
verses.translit: zkhrv r'shnvt m'vlm khy 'nkhy 'l v'yn 'vd 'lhym v'ps khmvny
verses.translation: Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me,

verses.original: מַגִּ֤יד מֵֽ/רֵאשִׁית֙ אַחֲרִ֔ית וּ/מִ/קֶּ֖דֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא נַעֲשׂ֑וּ אֹמֵר֙ עֲצָתִ֣/י תָק֔וּם וְ/כָל חֶפְצִ֖/י אֶעֱשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: mgyd mr'shyt 'chryt vmqdm 'shr l' n'shv 'mr 'tsty tqvm vkhl chptsy ''shh
verses.translation: Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure:

verses.original: קֹרֵ֤א מִ/מִּזְרָח֙ עַ֔יִט מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מֶרְחָ֖ק אִ֣ישׁ עצת/ו עֲצָתִ֑/י אַף דִּבַּ֨רְתִּי֙ אַף אֲבִיאֶ֔/נָּה יָצַ֖רְתִּי אַף אֶעֱשֶֽׂ/נָּה
verses.translit: qr' mmzrch 'yt m'rts mrchq 'ysh 'tstv 'tsty 'f dbrty 'f 'by'nh ytsrty 'f ''shnh
verses.translation: Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country: yea, I have spoken it , I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed it , I will also do it.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ אֵלַ֖/י אַבִּ֣ירֵי לֵ֑ב הָ/רְחוֹקִ֖ים מִ/צְּדָקָֽה
verses.translit: shm'v 'ly 'byry lb hrchvqym mtsdqh
verses.translation: Hearken unto me, ye stouthearted, that are far from righteousness:

verses.original: קֵרַ֤בְתִּי צִדְקָתִ/י֙ לֹ֣א תִרְחָ֔ק וּ/תְשׁוּעָתִ֖/י לֹ֣א תְאַחֵ֑ר וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י בְ/צִיּוֹן֙ תְּשׁוּעָ֔ה לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תִּפְאַרְתִּֽ/י
verses.translit: qrbty tsdqty l' trchq vtshv'ty l' t'chr vntty btsyvn tshv'h lyshr'l tp'rty
verses.translation: I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.

verses.original: רְדִ֣י וּ/שְׁבִ֣י עַל עָפָ֗ר בְּתוּלַת֙ בַּת בָּבֶ֔ל שְׁבִי לָ/אָ֥רֶץ אֵין כִּסֵּ֖א בַּת כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים כִּ֣י לֹ֤א תוֹסִ֨יפִי֙ יִקְרְאוּ לָ֔/ךְ רַכָּ֖ה וַ/עֲנֻגָּֽה
verses.translit: rdy vshby 'l 'pr btvlt bt bbl shby l'rts 'yn khs' bt khshdym khy l' tvsypy yqr'v lkh rkhh v'ngh
verses.translation: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.

verses.original: קְחִ֥י רֵחַ֖יִם וְ/טַ֣חֲנִי קָ֑מַח גַּלִּ֨י צַמָּתֵ֧/ךְ חֶשְׂפִּי שֹׁ֛בֶל גַּלִּי שׁ֖וֹק עִבְרִ֥י נְהָרֽוֹת
verses.translit: qchy rchym vtchny qmch gly tsmtkh chshpy shbl gly shvq 'bry nhrvt
verses.translation: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.

verses.original: תִּגָּל֙ עֶרְוָתֵ֔/ךְ גַּ֥ם תֵּרָאֶ֖ה חֶרְפָּתֵ֑/ךְ נָקָ֣ם אֶקָּ֔ח וְ/לֹ֥א אֶפְגַּ֖ע אָדָֽם
verses.translit: tgl 'rvtkh gm tr'h chrptkh nqm 'qch vl' 'pg' 'dm
verses.translation: Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.

verses.original: גֹּאֲלֵ֕/נוּ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑/וֹ קְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: g'lnv yhvh tsb'vt shmv qdvsh yshr'l
verses.translation: As for our redeemer, the LORD of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.

verses.original: שְׁבִ֥י דוּמָ֛ם וּ/בֹ֥אִי בַ/חֹ֖שֶׁךְ בַּת כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים כִּ֣י לֹ֤א תוֹסִ֨יפִי֙ יִקְרְאוּ לָ֔/ךְ גְּבֶ֖רֶת מַמְלָכֽוֹת
verses.translit: shby dvmm vb'y bchshkh bt khshdym khy l' tvsypy yqr'v lkh gbrt mmlkhvt
verses.translation: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.

verses.original: קָצַ֣פְתִּי עַל עַמִּ֗/י חִלַּ֨לְתִּי֙ נַחֲלָתִ֔/י וָ/אֶתְּנֵ֖/ם בְּ/יָדֵ֑/ךְ לֹא שַׂ֤מְתְּ לָ/הֶם֙ רַחֲמִ֔ים עַל זָקֵ֕ן הִכְבַּ֥דְתְּ עֻלֵּ֖/ךְ מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: qtspty 'l 'my chllty nchlty v'tnm bydkh l' shmt lhm rchmym 'l zqn hkhbdt 'lkh m'd
verses.translation: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֣אמְרִ֔י לְ/עוֹלָ֖ם אֶהְיֶ֣ה גְבָ֑רֶת עַ֣ד לֹא שַׂ֥מְתְּ אֵ֨לֶּה֙ עַל לִבֵּ֔/ךְ לֹ֥א זָכַ֖רְתְּ אַחֲרִיתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vt'mry l'vlm 'hyh gbrt 'd l' shmt 'lh 'l lbkh l' zkhrt 'chryth
verses.translation: And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֞ה שִׁמְעִי זֹ֤את עֲדִינָה֙ הַ/יּוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת לָ/בֶ֔טַח הָ/אֹֽמְרָה֙ בִּ/לְבָ֔בָ/הּ אֲנִ֖י וְ/אַפְסִ֣/י ע֑וֹד לֹ֤א אֵשֵׁב֙ אַלְמָנָ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א אֵדַ֖ע שְׁכֽוֹל
verses.translit: v'th shm'y z't 'dynh hyvshbt lbtch h'mrh blbbh 'ny v'psy 'vd l' 'shb 'lmnh vl' 'd' shkhvl
verses.translation: Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am , and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:

verses.original: וְ/תָבֹאנָה֩ לָּ֨/ךְ שְׁתֵּי אֵ֥לֶּה רֶ֛גַע בְּ/י֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד שְׁכ֣וֹל וְ/אַלְמֹ֑ן כְּ/תֻמָּ/ם֙ בָּ֣אוּ עָלַ֔יִ/ךְ בְּ/רֹ֣ב כְּשָׁפַ֔יִ/ךְ בְּ/עָצְמַ֥ת חֲבָרַ֖יִ/ךְ מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vtb'nh lkh shty 'lh rg' byvm 'chd shkhvl v'lmn khtmm b'v 'lykh brb khshpykh b'tsmt chbrykh m'd
verses.translation: But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.

verses.original: וַ/תִּבְטְחִ֣י בְ/רָעָתֵ֗/ךְ אָמַרְתְּ֙ אֵ֣ין רֹאָ֔/נִי חָכְמָתֵ֥/ךְ וְ/דַעְתֵּ֖/ךְ הִ֣יא שׁוֹבְבָ֑תֶ/ךְ וַ/תֹּאמְרִ֣י בְ/לִבֵּ֔/ךְ אֲנִ֖י וְ/אַפְסִ֥/י עֽוֹד
verses.translit: vtbtchy br'tkh 'mrt 'yn r'ny chkhmtkh vd'tkh hy' shvbbtkh vt'mry blbkh 'ny v'psy 'vd
verses.translation: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee; and thou hast said in thine heart, I am , and none else beside me.

verses.original: וּ/בָ֧א עָלַ֣יִ/ךְ רָעָ֗ה לֹ֤א תֵדְעִי֙ שַׁחְרָ֔/הּ וְ/תִפֹּ֤ל עָלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ הֹוָ֔ה לֹ֥א תוּכְלִ֖י כַּפְּרָ֑/הּ וְ/תָבֹ֨א עָלַ֧יִ/ךְ פִּתְאֹ֛ם שׁוֹאָ֖ה לֹ֥א תֵדָֽעִי
verses.translit: vb' 'lykh r'h l' td'y shchrh vtpl 'lykh hvh l' tvkhly khprh vtb' 'lykh pt'm shv'h l' td'y
verses.translation: Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it off: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou shalt not know.

verses.original: עִמְדִי נָ֤א בַ/חֲבָרַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ וּ/בְ/רֹ֣ב כְּשָׁפַ֔יִ/ךְ בַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָגַ֖עַתְּ מִ/נְּעוּרָ֑יִ/ךְ אוּלַ֛י תּוּכְלִ֥י הוֹעִ֖יל אוּלַ֥י תַּעֲרֽוֹצִי
verses.translit: 'mdy n' bchbrykh vbrb khshpykh b'shr yg't mn'vrykh 'vly tvkhly hv'yl 'vly t'rvtsy
verses.translation: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.

verses.original: נִלְאֵ֖ית בְּ/רֹ֣ב עֲצָתָ֑יִ/ךְ יַעַמְדוּ נָ֨א וְ/יוֹשִׁיעֻ֜/ךְ הברו הֹבְרֵ֣י שָׁמַ֗יִם הַֽ/חֹזִים֙ בַּ/כּ֣וֹכָבִ֔ים מֽוֹדִיעִם֙ לֶ/חֳדָשִׁ֔ים מֵ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָבֹ֖אוּ עָלָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: nl'yt brb 'tstykh y'mdv n' vyvshy'kh hbrv hbry shmym hchzym bkhvkhbym mvdy'm lchdshym m'shr yb'v 'lykh
verses.translation: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה הָי֤וּ כְ/קַשׁ֙ אֵ֣שׁ שְׂרָפָ֔תַ/ם לֹֽא יַצִּ֥ילוּ אֶת נַפְשָׁ֖/ם מִ/יַּ֣ד לֶֽהָבָ֑ה אֵין גַּחֶ֣לֶת לַ/חְמָ֔ם א֖וּר לָ/שֶׁ֥בֶת נֶגְדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hnh hyv khqsh 'sh shrptm l' ytsylv 't npshm myd lhbh 'yn gchlt lchmm 'vr lshbt ngdv
verses.translation: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: there shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it.

verses.original: כֵּ֥ן הָיוּ לָ֖/ךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָגָ֑עַתְּ סֹחֲרַ֣יִ/ךְ מִ/נְּעוּרַ֗יִ/ךְ אִ֤ישׁ לְ/עֶבְר/וֹ֙ תָּע֔וּ אֵ֖ין מוֹשִׁיעֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khn hyv lkh 'shr yg't schrykh mn'vrykh 'ysh l'brv t'v 'yn mvshy'kh
verses.translation: Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured, even thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee.

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ זֹ֣את בֵּֽית יַעֲקֹ֗ב הַ/נִּקְרָאִים֙ בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּ/מִ/מֵּ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה יָצָ֑אוּ הַֽ/נִּשְׁבָּעִ֣ים בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֗ה וּ/בֵ/אלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יַזְכִּ֔ירוּ לֹ֥א בֶ/אֱמֶ֖ת וְ/לֹ֥א בִ/צְדָקָֽה
verses.translit: shm'v z't byt y'qb hnqr'ym bshm yshr'l vmmy yhvdh yts'v hnshb'ym bshm yhvh vb'lhy yshr'l yzkhyrv l' b'mt vl' btsdqh
verses.translation: Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by the name of the LORD , and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness.

verses.original: כִּֽי מֵ/עִ֤יר הַ/קֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ נִקְרָ֔אוּ וְ/עַל אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נִסְמָ֑כוּ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy m'yr hqdsh nqr'v v'l 'lhy yshr'l nsmkhv yhvh tsb'vt shmv
verses.translation: For they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the God of Israel; The LORD of hosts is his name.

verses.original: הָ/רִֽאשֹׁנוֹת֙ מֵ/אָ֣ז הִגַּ֔דְתִּי וּ/מִ/פִּ֥/י יָצְא֖וּ וְ/אַשְׁמִיעֵ֑/ם פִּתְאֹ֥ם עָשִׂ֖יתִי וַ/תָּבֹֽאנָה
verses.translit: hr'shnvt m'z hgdty vmpy yts'v v'shmy'm pt'm 'shyty vtb'nh
verses.translation: I have declared the former things from the beginning; and they went forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did them suddenly, and they came to pass.

verses.original: מִ/דַּעְתִּ֕/י כִּ֥י קָשֶׁ֖ה אָ֑תָּה וְ/גִ֤יד בַּרְזֶל֙ עָרְפֶּ֔/ךָ וּ/מִצְחֲ/ךָ֖ נְחוּשָֽׁה
verses.translit: md'ty khy qshh 'th vgyd brzl 'rpkh vmtschkh nchvshh
verses.translation: Because I knew that thou art obstinate, and thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy brow brass;

verses.original: וָ/אַגִּ֤יד לְ/ךָ֙ מֵ/אָ֔ז בְּ/טֶ֥רֶם תָּב֖וֹא הִשְׁמַעְתִּ֑י/ךָ פֶּן תֹּאמַר֙ עָצְבִּ֣/י עָשָׂ֔/ם וּ/פִסְלִ֥/י וְ/נִסְכִּ֖/י צִוָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'gyd lkh m'z btrm tbv' hshm'tykh pn t'mr 'tsby 'shm vpsly vnskhy tsvm
verses.translation: I have even from the beginning declared it to thee; before it came to pass I shewed it thee: lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.

verses.original: שָׁמַ֤עְתָּֽ חֲזֵה֙ כֻּלָּ֔/הּ וְ/אַתֶּ֖ם הֲ/ל֣וֹא תַגִּ֑ידוּ הִשְׁמַעְתִּ֤י/ךָ חֲדָשׁוֹת֙ מֵ/עַ֔תָּה וּ/נְצֻר֖וֹת וְ/לֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: shm't chzh khlh v'tm hlv' tgydv hshm'tykh chdshvt m'th vntsrvt vl' yd'tm
verses.translation: Thou hast heard, see all this; and will not ye declare it ? I have shewed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, and thou didst not know them.

verses.original: עַתָּ֤ה נִבְרְאוּ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א מֵ/אָ֔ז וְ/לִ/פְנֵי י֖וֹם וְ/לֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתָּ֑/ם פֶּן תֹּאמַ֖ר הִנֵּ֥ה יְדַעְתִּֽי/ן
verses.translit: 'th nbr'v vl' m'z vlpny yvm vl' shm'tm pn t'mr hnh yd'tyn
verses.translation: They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם לֹֽא שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ גַּ֚ם לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתָּ גַּ֕ם מֵ/אָ֖ז לֹא פִתְּחָ֣ה אָזְנֶ֑/ךָ כִּ֤י יָדַ֨עְתִּי֙ בָּג֣וֹד תִּבְגּ֔וֹד וּ/פֹשֵׁ֥עַ מִ/בֶּ֖טֶן קֹ֥רָא לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: gm l' shm't gm l' yd't gm m'z l' ptchh 'znkh khy yd'ty bgvd tbgvd vpsh' mbtn qr' lkh
verses.translation: Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from that time that thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן שְׁמִ/י֙ אַאֲרִ֣יךְ אַפִּ֔/י וּ/תְהִלָּתִ֖/י אֶחֱטָם לָ֑/ךְ לְ/בִלְתִּ֖י הַכְרִיתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: lm'n shmy ''rykh 'py vthlty 'chtm lkh lblty hkhrytkh
verses.translation: For my name’s sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה צְרַפְתִּ֖י/ךָ וְ/לֹ֣א בְ/כָ֑סֶף בְּחַרְתִּ֖י/ךָ בְּ/כ֥וּר עֹֽנִי
verses.translit: hnh tsrptykh vl' bkhsf bchrtykh bkhvr 'ny
verses.translation: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.

verses.original: לְמַעֲנִ֧/י לְמַעֲנִ֛/י אֶעֱשֶׂ֖ה כִּ֣י אֵ֣יךְ יֵחָ֑ל וּ/כְבוֹדִ֖/י לְ/אַחֵ֥ר לֹֽא אֶתֵּֽן
verses.translit: lm'ny lm'ny ''shh khy 'ykh ychl vkhbvdy l'chr l' 'tn
verses.translation: For mine own sake, even for mine own sake, will I do it: for how should my name be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.

verses.original: שְׁמַ֤ע אֵלַ/י֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מְקֹרָאִ֑/י אֲנִי הוּא֙ אֲנִ֣י רִאשׁ֔וֹן אַ֖ף אֲנִ֥י אַחֲרֽוֹן
verses.translit: shm' 'ly y'qb vyshr'l mqr'y 'ny hv' 'ny r'shvn 'f 'ny 'chrvn
verses.translation: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.

verses.original: אַף יָדִ/י֙ יָ֣סְדָה אֶ֔רֶץ וִֽ/ימִינִ֖/י טִפְּחָ֣ה שָׁמָ֑יִם קֹרֵ֥א אֲנִ֛י אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם יַעַמְד֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו
verses.translit: 'f ydy ysdh 'rts vymyny tpchh shmym qr' 'ny 'lyhm y'mdv ychdv
verses.translation: Mine hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spanned the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up together.

verses.original: הִקָּבְצ֤וּ כֻלְּ/כֶם֙ וּֽ/שֲׁמָ֔עוּ מִ֥י בָ/הֶ֖ם הִגִּ֣יד אֶת אֵ֑לֶּה יְהוָ֣ה אֲהֵב֔/וֹ יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה חֶפְצ/וֹ֙ בְּ/בָבֶ֔ל וּ/זְרֹע֖/וֹ כַּשְׂדִּֽים
verses.translit: hqbtsv khlkhm vshm'v my bhm hgyd 't 'lh yhvh 'hbv y'shh chptsv bbbl vzr'v khshdym
verses.translation: All ye, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them hath declared these things ? The LORD hath loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י אֲנִ֛י דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אַף קְרָאתִ֑י/ו הֲבִיאֹתִ֖י/ו וְ/הִצְלִ֥יחַ דַּרְכּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'ny 'ny dbrty 'f qr'tyv hby'tyv vhtslych drkhv
verses.translation: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.

verses.original: קִרְב֧וּ אֵלַ֣/י שִׁמְעוּ זֹ֗את לֹ֤א מֵ/רֹאשׁ֙ בַּ/סֵּ֣תֶר דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי מֵ/עֵ֥ת הֱיוֹתָ֖/הּ שָׁ֣ם אָ֑נִי וְ/עַתָּ֗ה אֲדֹנָ֧/י יְהוִ֛ה שְׁלָחַ֖/נִי וְ/רוּחֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: qrbv 'ly shm'v z't l' mr'sh bstr dbrty m't hyvth shm 'ny v'th 'dny yhvh shlchny vrvchv
verses.translation: Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there am I: and now the Lord GOD , and his Spirit, hath sent me.

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה גֹּאַלְ/ךָ֖ קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲנִ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ מְלַמֶּדְ/ךָ֣ לְ/הוֹעִ֔יל מַדְרִֽיכֲ/ךָ֖ בְּ/דֶ֥רֶךְ תֵּלֵֽךְ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh g'lkh qdvsh yshr'l 'ny yhvh 'lhykh mlmdkh lhv'yl mdrykhkh bdrkh tlkh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I am the LORD thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go.

verses.original: ל֥וּא הִקְשַׁ֖בְתָּ לְ/מִצְוֺתָ֑/י וַ/יְהִ֤י כַ/נָּהָר֙ שְׁלוֹמֶ֔/ךָ וְ/צִדְקָתְ/ךָ֖ כְּ/גַלֵּ֥י הַ/יָּֽם
verses.translit: lv' hqshbt lmtsvty vyhy khnhr shlvmkh vtsdqtkh khgly hym
verses.translation: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י כַ/חוֹל֙ זַרְעֶ֔/ךָ וְ/צֶאֱצָאֵ֥י מֵעֶ֖י/ךָ כִּ/מְעֹתָ֑י/ו לֹֽא יִכָּרֵ֧ת וְֽ/לֹא יִשָּׁמֵ֛ד שְׁמ֖/וֹ מִ/לְּ/פָנָֽ/י
verses.translit: vyhy khchvl zr'kh vts'ts'y m'ykh khm'tyv l' ykhrt vl' yshmd shmv mlpny
verses.translation: Thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.

verses.original: צְא֣וּ מִ/בָּבֶל֮ בִּרְח֣וּ מִ/כַּשְׂדִּים֒ בְּ/ק֣וֹל רִנָּ֗ה הַגִּ֤ידוּ הַשְׁמִ֨יעוּ֙ זֹ֔את הוֹצִיא֖וּ/הָ עַד קְצֵ֣ה הָ/אָ֑רֶץ אִמְר֕וּ גָּאַ֥ל יְהוָ֖ה עַבְדּ֥/וֹ יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: ts'v mbbl brchv mkhshdym bqvl rnh hgydv hshmy'v z't hvtsy'vh 'd qtsh h'rts 'mrv g'l yhvh 'bdv y'qb
verses.translation: Go ye forth of Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth; say ye, The LORD hath redeemed his servant Jacob.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֣א צָמְא֗וּ בָּ/חֳרָבוֹת֙ הֽוֹלִיכָ֔/ם מַ֥יִם מִ/צּ֖וּר הִזִּ֣יל לָ֑/מוֹ וַ/יִּ֨בְקַע צ֔וּר וַ/יָּזֻ֖בוּ מָֽיִם
verses.translit: vl' tsm'v bchrbvt hvlykhm mym mtsvr hzyl lmv vybq' tsvr vyzbv mym
verses.translation: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.

verses.original: אֵ֣ין שָׁל֔וֹם אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה לָ/רְשָׁעִֽים
verses.translit: 'yn shlvm 'mr yhvh lrsh'ym
verses.translation: There is no peace, saith the LORD , unto the wicked.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ אִיִּים֙ אֵלַ֔/י וְ/הַקְשִׁ֥יבוּ לְאֻמִּ֖ים מֵ/רָח֑וֹק יְהוָה֙ מִ/בֶּ֣טֶן קְרָאָ֔/נִי מִ/מְּעֵ֥י אִמִּ֖/י הִזְכִּ֥יר שְׁמִֽ/י
verses.translit: shm'v 'yym 'ly vhqshybv l'mym mrchvq yhvh mbtn qr'ny mm'y 'my hzkhyr shmy
verses.translation: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye people, from far; The LORD hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤שֶׂם פִּ/י֙ כְּ/חֶ֣רֶב חַדָּ֔ה בְּ/צֵ֥ל יָד֖/וֹ הֶחְבִּיאָ֑/נִי וַ/יְשִׂימֵ֨/נִי֙ לְ/חֵ֣ץ בָּר֔וּר בְּ/אַשְׁפָּת֖/וֹ הִסְתִּירָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vyshm py khchrb chdh btsl ydv hchby'ny vyshymny lchts brvr b'shptv hstyrny
verses.translation: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me;

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר לִ֖/י עַבְדִּ/י אָ֑תָּה יִשְׂרָאֵ֕ל אֲשֶׁר בְּ/ךָ֖ אֶתְפָּאָֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr ly 'bdy 'th yshr'l 'shr bkh 'tp'r
verses.translation: And said unto me, Thou art my servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֤י אָמַ֨רְתִּי֙ לְ/רִ֣יק יָגַ֔עְתִּי לְ/תֹ֥הוּ וְ/הֶ֖בֶל כֹּחִ֣/י כִלֵּ֑יתִי אָכֵן֙ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣/י אֶת יְהוָ֔ה וּ/פְעֻלָּתִ֖/י אֶת אֱלֹהָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'ny 'mrty lryq yg'ty lthv vhbl khchy khlyty 'khn mshpty 't yhvh vp'lty 't 'lhy
verses.translation: Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nought, and in vain: yet surely my judgment is with the LORD , and my work with my God.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה יֹצְרִ֤/י מִ/בֶּ֨טֶן֙ לְ/עֶ֣בֶד ל֔/וֹ לְ/שׁוֹבֵ֤ב יַֽעֲקֹב֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לא ל֣/וֹ יֵאָסֵ֑ף וְ/אֶכָּבֵד֙ בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וֵ/אלֹהַ֖/י הָיָ֥ה עֻזִּֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th 'mr yhvh ytsry mbtn l'bd lv lshvbb y'qb 'lyv vyshr'l l' lv y'sf v'khbd b'yny yhvh v'lhy hyh 'zy
verses.translation: And now, saith the LORD that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, Though Israel be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the LORD , and my God shall be my strength.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר נָקֵ֨ל מִֽ/הְיוֹתְ/ךָ֥ לִ/י֙ עֶ֔בֶד לְ/הָקִים֙ אֶת שִׁבְטֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב ו/נצירי וּ/נְצוּרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/הָשִׁ֑יב וּ/נְתַתִּ֨י/ךָ֙ לְ/א֣וֹר גּוֹיִ֔ם לִֽ/הְי֥וֹת יְשׁוּעָתִ֖/י עַד קְצֵ֥ה הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vy'mr nql mhyvtkh ly 'bd lhqym 't shbty y'qb vntsyry vntsvry yshr'l lhshyb vnttykh l'vr gvym lhyvt yshv'ty 'd qtsh h'rts
verses.translation: And he said, It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָֽמַר יְהוָה֩ גֹּאֵ֨ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל קְדוֹשׁ֗/וֹ לִ/בְזֹה נֶ֜פֶשׁ לִ/מְתָ֤עֵֽב גּוֹי֙ לְ/עֶ֣בֶד מֹשְׁלִ֔ים מְלָכִים֙ יִרְא֣וּ וָ/קָ֔מוּ שָׂרִ֖ים וְ/יִֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֑וּ לְמַ֤עַן יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נֶאֱמָ֔ן קְדֹ֥שׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַ/יִּבְחָרֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh g'l yshr'l qdvshv lbzh npsh lmt'b gvy l'bd mshlym mlkhym yr'v vqmv shrym vyshtchvv lm'n yhvh 'shr n'mn qdsh yshr'l vybchrkh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of the LORD that is faithful, and the Holy One of Israel, and he shall choose thee.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה בְּ/עֵ֤ת רָצוֹן֙ עֲנִיתִ֔י/ךָ וּ/בְ/י֥וֹם יְשׁוּעָ֖ה עֲזַרְתִּ֑י/ךָ וְ/אֶצָּרְ/ךָ֗ וְ/אֶתֶּנְ/ךָ֙ לִ/בְרִ֣ית עָ֔ם לְ/הָקִ֣ים אֶ֔רֶץ לְ/הַנְחִ֖יל נְחָל֥וֹת שֹׁמֵמֽוֹת
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh b't rtsvn 'nytykh vbyvm yshv'h 'zrtykh v'tsrkh v'tnkh lbryt 'm lhqym 'rts lhnchyl nchlvt shmmvt
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , In an acceptable time have I heard thee, and in a day of salvation have I helped thee: and I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause to inherit the desolate heritages;

verses.original: לֵ/אמֹ֤ר לַֽ/אֲסוּרִים֙ צֵ֔אוּ לַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּ/חֹ֖שֶׁךְ הִגָּל֑וּ עַל דְּרָכִ֣ים יִרְע֔וּ וּ/בְ/כָל שְׁפָיִ֖ים מַרְעִיתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: l'mr l'svrym ts'v l'shr bchshkh hglv 'l drkhym yr'v vbkhl shpyym mr'ytm
verses.translation: That thou mayest say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that are in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures shall be in all high places.

verses.original: לֹ֤א יִרְעָ֨בוּ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יִצְמָ֔אוּ וְ/לֹא יַכֵּ֥/ם שָׁרָ֖ב וָ/שָׁ֑מֶשׁ כִּי מְרַחֲמָ֣/ם יְנַהֲגֵ֔/ם וְ/עַל מַבּ֥וּעֵי מַ֖יִם יְנַהֲלֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: l' yr'bv vl' ytsm'v vl' ykhm shrb vshmsh khy mrchmm ynhgm v'l mbv'y mym ynhlm
verses.translation: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֥י כָל הָרַ֖/י לַ/דָּ֑רֶךְ וּ/מְסִלֹּתַ֖/י יְרֻמֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: vshmty khl hry ldrkh vmslty yrmvn
verses.translation: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.

verses.original: הִנֵּה אֵ֕לֶּה מֵ/רָח֖וֹק יָבֹ֑אוּ וְ/הִֽנֵּה אֵ֨לֶּה֙ מִ/צָּפ֣וֹן וּ/מִ/יָּ֔ם וְ/אֵ֖לֶּה מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ סִינִֽים
verses.translit: hnh 'lh mrchvq yb'v vhnh 'lh mtspvn vmym v'lh m'rts synym
verses.translation: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.

verses.original: רָנּ֤וּ שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ וְ/גִ֣ילִי אָ֔רֶץ יפצחו וּ/פִצְח֥וּ הָרִ֖ים רִנָּ֑ה כִּֽי נִחַ֤ם יְהוָה֙ עַמּ֔/וֹ וַ/עֲנִיָּ֖/ו יְרַחֵֽם
verses.translit: rnv shmym vgyly 'rts yptschv vptschv hrym rnh khy nchm yhvh 'mv v'nyv yrchm
verses.translation: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for the LORD hath comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֥אמֶר צִיּ֖וֹן עֲזָבַ֣/נִי יְהוָ֑ה וַ/אדֹנָ֖/י שְׁכֵחָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: vt'mr tsyvn 'zbny yhvh v'dny shkhchny
verses.translation: But Zion said, The LORD hath forsaken me, and my Lord hath forgotten me.

verses.original: הֲ/תִשְׁכַּ֤ח אִשָּׁה֙ עוּלָ֔/הּ מֵ/רַחֵ֖ם בֶּן בִּטְנָ֑/הּ גַּם אֵ֣לֶּה תִשְׁכַּ֔חְנָה וְ/אָנֹכִ֖י לֹ֥א אֶשְׁכָּחֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: htshkhch 'shh 'vlh mrchm bn btnh gm 'lh tshkhchnh v'nkhy l' 'shkhchkh
verses.translation: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.

verses.original: הֵ֥ן עַל כַּפַּ֖יִם חַקֹּתִ֑י/ךְ חוֹמֹתַ֥יִ/ךְ נֶגְדִּ֖/י תָּמִֽיד
verses.translit: hn 'l khpym chqtykh chvmtykh ngdy tmyd
verses.translation: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.

verses.original: מִֽהֲר֖וּ בָּנָ֑יִ/ךְ מְהָֽרְסַ֥יִ/ךְ וּ/מַחֲרִבַ֖יִ/ךְ מִמֵּ֥/ךְ יֵצֵֽאוּ
verses.translit: mhrv bnykh mhrsykh vmchrbykh mmkh yts'v
verses.translation: Thy children shall make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee.

verses.original: שְׂאִֽי סָבִ֤יב עֵינַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ וּ/רְאִ֔י כֻּלָּ֖/ם נִקְבְּצ֣וּ בָֽאוּ לָ֑/ךְ חַי אָ֣נִי נְאֻם יְהוָ֗ה כִּ֤י כֻלָּ/ם֙ כָּ/עֲדִ֣י תִלְבָּ֔שִׁי וּֽ/תְקַשְּׁרִ֖י/ם כַּ/כַּלָּֽה
verses.translit: sh'y sbyb 'ynykh vr'y khlm nqbtsv b'v lkh chy 'ny n'm yhvh khy khlm kh'dy tlbshy vtqshrym khkhlh
verses.translation: Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, and come to thee. As I live, saith the LORD , thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all, as with an ornament, and bind them on thee , as a bride doeth .

verses.original: כִּ֤י חָרְבֹתַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ וְ/שֹׁ֣מְמֹתַ֔יִ/ךְ וְ/אֶ֖רֶץ הֲרִֽסֻתֵ֑י/ךְ כִּ֤י עַתָּה֙ תֵּצְרִ֣י מִ/יּוֹשֵׁ֔ב וְ/רָחֲק֖וּ מְבַלְּעָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: khy chrbtykh vshmmtykh v'rts hrstykh khy 'th ttsry myvshb vrchqv mbl'ykh
verses.translation: For thy waste and thy desolate places, and the land of thy destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.

verses.original: ע֚וֹד יֹאמְר֣וּ בְ/אָזְנַ֔יִ/ךְ בְּנֵ֖י שִׁכֻּלָ֑יִ/ךְ צַר לִ֥/י הַ/מָּק֖וֹם גְּשָׁ/ה לִּ֥/י וְ/אֵשֵֽׁבָה
verses.translit: 'vd y'mrv b'znykh bny shkhlykh tsr ly hmqvm gshh ly v'shbh
verses.translation: The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other, shall say again in thine ears, The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.

verses.original: וְ/אָמַ֣רְתְּ בִּ/לְבָבֵ֗/ךְ מִ֤י יָֽלַד לִ/י֙ אֶת אֵ֔לֶּה וַ/אֲנִ֥י שְׁכוּלָ֖ה וְ/גַלְמוּדָ֑ה גֹּלָ֣ה וְ/סוּרָ֗ה וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ מִ֣י גִדֵּ֔ל הֵ֤ן אֲנִי֙ נִשְׁאַ֣רְתִּי לְ/בַדִּ֔/י אֵ֖לֶּה אֵיפֹ֥ה הֵֽם
verses.translit: v'mrt blbbkh my yld ly 't 'lh v'ny shkhvlh vglmvdh glh vsvrh v'lh my gdl hn 'ny nsh'rty lbdy 'lh 'yph hm
verses.translation: Then shalt thou say in thine heart, Who hath begotten me these, seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and removing to and fro? and who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where had they been ?

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה אֶשָּׂ֤א אֶל גּוֹיִם֙ יָדִ֔/י וְ/אֶל עַמִּ֖ים אָרִ֣ים נִסִּ֑/י וְ/הֵבִ֤יאוּ בָנַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ בְּ/חֹ֔צֶן וּ/בְנֹתַ֖יִ/ךְ עַל כָּתֵ֥ף תִּנָּשֶֽׂאנָה
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnh 'sh' 'l gvym ydy v'l 'mym 'rym nsy vhby'v bnykh bchtsn vbntykh 'l khtf tnsh'nh
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD , Behold, I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring thy sons in their arms, and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.

verses.original: וְ/הָי֨וּ מְלָכִ֜ים אֹֽמְנַ֗יִ/ךְ וְ/שָׂרֽוֹתֵי/הֶם֙ מֵינִ֣יקֹתַ֔יִ/ךְ אַפַּ֗יִם אֶ֚רֶץ יִשְׁתַּ֣חֲווּ לָ֔/ךְ וַ/עֲפַ֥ר רַגְלַ֖יִ/ךְ יְלַחֵ֑כוּ וְ/יָדַ֨עַתְּ֙ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא יֵבֹ֖שׁוּ קוָֹֽ/י
verses.translit: vhyv mlkhym 'mnykh vshrvtyhm mynyqtykh 'pym 'rts yshtchvv lkh v'pr rglykh ylchkhv vyd't khy 'ny yhvh 'shr l' ybshv qvy
verses.translation: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD : for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.

verses.original: הֲ/יֻקַּ֥ח מִ/גִּבּ֖וֹר מַלְק֑וֹחַ וְ/אִם שְׁבִ֥י צַדִּ֖יק יִמָּלֵֽט
verses.translit: hyqch mgbvr mlqvch v'm shby tsdyq ymlt
verses.translation: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered?

verses.original: כִּי כֹ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה גַּם שְׁבִ֤י גִבּוֹר֙ יֻקָּ֔ח וּ/מַלְק֥וֹחַ עָרִ֖יץ יִמָּלֵ֑ט וְ/אֶת יְרִיבֵ/ךְ֙ אָנֹכִ֣י אָרִ֔יב וְ/אֶת בָּנַ֖יִ/ךְ אָנֹכִ֥י אוֹשִֽׁיעַ
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh gm shby gbvr yqch vmlqvch 'ryts ymlt v't yrybkh 'nkhy 'ryb v't bnykh 'nkhy 'vshy'
verses.translation: But thus saith the LORD , Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.

verses.original: וְ/הַאֲכַלְתִּ֤י אֶת מוֹנַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ אֶת בְּשָׂרָ֔/ם וְ/כֶ/עָסִ֖יס דָּמָ֣/ם יִשְׁכָּר֑וּ/ן וְ/יָדְע֣וּ כָל בָּשָׂ֗ר כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ מֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֔/ךְ וְ/גֹאֲלֵ֖/ךְ אֲבִ֥יר יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: vh'khlty 't mvnykh 't bshrm vkh'sys dmm yshkhrvn vyd'v khl bshr khy 'ny yhvh mvshy'kh vg'lkh 'byr y'qb
verses.translation: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I the LORD am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֣י זֶ֠ה סֵ֣פֶר כְּרִית֤וּת אִמְּ/כֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שִׁלַּחְתִּ֔י/הָ א֚וֹ מִ֣י מִ/נּוֹשַׁ֔/י אֲשֶׁר מָכַ֥רְתִּי אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם ל֑/וֹ הֵ֤ן בַּ/עֲוֺנֹֽתֵי/כֶם֙ נִמְכַּרְתֶּ֔ם וּ/בְ/פִשְׁעֵי/כֶ֖ם שֻׁלְּחָ֥ה אִמְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'y zh spr khrytvt 'mkhm 'shr shlchtyh 'v my mnvshy 'shr mkhrty 'tkhm lv hn b'vntykhm nmkhrtm vbpsh'ykhm shlchh 'mkhm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , Where is the bill of your mother’s divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.

verses.original: מַדּ֨וּעַ בָּ֜אתִי וְ/אֵ֣ין אִ֗ישׁ קָרָֽאתִי֮ וְ/אֵ֣ין עוֹנֶה֒ הֲ/קָצ֨וֹר קָצְרָ֤ה יָדִ/י֙ מִ/פְּד֔וּת וְ/אִם אֵֽין בִּ֥/י כֹ֖חַ לְ/הַצִּ֑יל הֵ֣ן בְּ/גַעֲרָתִ֞/י אַחֲרִ֣יב יָ֗ם אָשִׂ֤ים נְהָרוֹת֙ מִדְבָּ֔ר תִּבְאַ֤שׁ דְּגָתָ/ם֙ מֵ/אֵ֣ין מַ֔יִם וְ/תָמֹ֖ת בַּ/צָּמָֽא
verses.translit: mdv' b'ty v'yn 'ysh qr'ty v'yn 'vnh hqtsvr qtsrh ydy mpdvt v'm 'yn by khch lhtsyl hn bg'rty 'chryb ym 'shym nhrvt mdbr tb'sh dgtm m'yn mym vtmt btsm'
verses.translation: Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because there is no water, and dieth for thirst.

verses.original: אַלְבִּ֥ישׁ שָׁמַ֖יִם קַדְר֑וּת וְ/שַׂ֖ק אָשִׂ֥ים כְּסוּתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'lbysh shmym qdrvt vshq 'shym khsvtm
verses.translation: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהֹוִ֗ה נָ֤תַן לִ/י֙ לְשׁ֣וֹן לִמּוּדִ֔ים לָ/דַ֛עַת לָ/ע֥וּת אֶת יָעֵ֖ף דָּבָ֑ר יָעִ֣יר בַּ/בֹּ֣קֶר בַּ/בֹּ֗קֶר יָעִ֥יר לִ/י֙ אֹ֔זֶן לִ/שְׁמֹ֖עַ כַּ/לִּמּוּדִֽים
verses.translit: 'dny yhvh ntn ly lshvn lmvdym ld't l'vt 't y'f dbr y'yr bbqr bbqr y'yr ly 'zn lshm' khlmvdym
verses.translation: The Lord GOD hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֤/י יְהוִה֙ פָּתַֽח לִ֣/י אֹ֔זֶן וְ/אָנֹכִ֖י לֹ֣א מָרִ֑יתִי אָח֖וֹר לֹ֥א נְסוּגֹֽתִי
verses.translit: 'dny yhvh ptch ly 'zn v'nkhy l' mryty 'chvr l' nsvgty
verses.translation: The Lord GOD hath opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away back.

verses.original: גֵּוִ/י֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לְ/מַכִּ֔ים וּ/לְחָיַ֖/י לְ/מֹֽרְטִ֑ים פָּנַ/י֙ לֹ֣א הִסְתַּ֔רְתִּי מִ/כְּלִמּ֖וֹת וָ/רֹֽק
verses.translit: gvy ntty lmkhym vlchyy lmrtym pny l' hstrty mkhlmvt vrq
verses.translation: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.

verses.original: וַ/אדֹנָ֤/י יְהוִה֙ יַֽעֲזָר לִ֔/י עַל כֵּ֖ן לֹ֣א נִכְלָ֑מְתִּי עַל כֵּ֞ן שַׂ֤מְתִּי פָנַ/י֙ כַּֽ/חַלָּמִ֔ישׁ וָ/אֵדַ֖ע כִּי לֹ֥א אֵבֽוֹשׁ
verses.translit: v'dny yhvh y'zr ly 'l khn l' nkhlmty 'l khn shmty pny khchlmysh v'd' khy l' 'bvsh
verses.translation: For the Lord GOD will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.

verses.original: קָרוֹב֙ מַצְדִּיקִ֔/י מִֽי יָרִ֥יב אִתִּ֖/י נַ֣עַמְדָה יָּ֑חַד מִֽי בַ֥עַל מִשְׁפָּטִ֖/י יִגַּ֥שׁ אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: qrvb mtsdyqy my yryb 'ty n'mdh ychd my b'l mshpty ygsh 'ly
verses.translation: He is near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who is mine adversary? let him come near to me.

verses.original: הֵ֣ן אֲדֹנָ֤/י יְהוִה֙ יַֽעֲזָר לִ֔/י מִי ה֖וּא יַרְשִׁיעֵ֑/נִי הֵ֤ן כֻּלָּ/ם֙ כַּ/בֶּ֣גֶד יִבְל֔וּ עָ֖שׁ יֹאכְלֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: hn 'dny yhvh y'zr ly my hv' yrshy'ny hn khlm khbgd yblv 'sh y'khlm
verses.translation: Behold, the Lord GOD will help me; who is he that shall condemn me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.

verses.original: מִ֤י בָ/כֶם֙ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֔ה שֹׁמֵ֖עַ בְּ/ק֣וֹל עַבְדּ֑/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלַ֣ךְ חֲשֵׁכִ֗ים וְ/אֵ֥ין נֹ֨גַהּ֙ ל֔/וֹ יִבְטַח֙ בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה וְ/יִשָּׁעֵ֖ן בֵּ/אלֹהָֽי/ו
verses.translit: my bkhm yr' yhvh shm' bqvl 'bdv 'shr hlkh chshkhym v'yn ngh lv ybtch bshm yhvh vysh'n b'lhyv
verses.translation: Who is among you that feareth the LORD , that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walketh in darkness, and hath no light? let him trust in the name of the LORD , and stay upon his God.

verses.original: הֵ֧ן כֻּלְּ/כֶ֛ם קֹ֥דְחֵי אֵ֖שׁ מְאַזְּרֵ֣י זִיק֑וֹת לְכ֣וּ בְּ/א֣וּר אֶשְׁ/כֶ֗ם וּ/בְ/זִיקוֹת֙ בִּֽעַרְתֶּ֔ם מִ/יָּדִ/י֙ הָיְתָה זֹּ֣את לָ/כֶ֔ם לְ/מַעֲצֵבָ֖ה תִּשְׁכָּבֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: hn khlkhm qdchy 'sh m'zry zyqvt lkhv b'vr 'shkhm vbzyqvt b'rtm mydy hyth z't lkhm lm'tsbh tshkhbvn
verses.translation: Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, that compass yourselves about with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks that ye have kindled. This shall ye have of mine hand; ye shall lie down in sorrow.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ אֵלַ֛/י רֹ֥דְפֵי צֶ֖דֶק מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הַבִּ֨יטוּ֙ אֶל צ֣וּר חֻצַּבְתֶּ֔ם וְ/אֶל מַקֶּ֥בֶת בּ֖וֹר נֻקַּרְתֶּֽם
verses.translit: shm'v 'ly rdpy tsdq mbqshy yhvh hbytv 'l tsvr chtsbtm v'l mqbt bvr nqrtm
verses.translation: Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, ye that seek the LORD : look unto the rock whence ye are hewn, and to the hole of the pit whence ye are digged.

verses.original: הַבִּ֨יטוּ֙ אֶל אַבְרָהָ֣ם אֲבִי/כֶ֔ם וְ/אֶל שָׂרָ֖ה תְּחוֹלֶלְ/כֶ֑ם כִּי אֶחָ֣ד קְרָאתִ֔י/ו וַ/אֲבָרְכֵ֖/הוּ וְ/אַרְבֵּֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: hbytv 'l 'brhm 'bykhm v'l shrh tchvllkhm khy 'chd qr'tyv v'brkhhv v'rbhv
verses.translation: Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah that bare you: for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased him.

verses.original: כִּֽי נִחַ֨ם יְהוָ֜ה צִיּ֗וֹן נִחַם֙ כָּל חָרְבֹתֶ֔י/הָ וַ/יָּ֤שֶׂם מִדְבָּרָ/הּ֙ כְּ/עֵ֔דֶן וְ/עַרְבָתָ֖/הּ כְּ/גַן יְהוָ֑ה שָׂשׂ֤וֹן וְ/שִׂמְחָה֙ יִמָּ֣צֵא בָ֔/הּ תּוֹדָ֖ה וְ/ק֥וֹל זִמְרָֽה
verses.translit: khy nchm yhvh tsyvn nchm khl chrbtyh vyshm mdbrh kh'dn v'rbth khgn yhvh shshvn vshmchh ymts' bh tvdh vqvl zmrh
verses.translation: For the LORD shall comfort Zion: he will comfort all her waste places; and he will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the LORD ; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.

verses.original: הַקְשִׁ֤יבוּ אֵלַ/י֙ עַמִּ֔/י וּ/לְאוּמִּ֖/י אֵלַ֣/י הַאֲזִ֑ינוּ כִּ֤י תוֹרָה֙ מֵ/אִתִּ֣/י תֵצֵ֔א וּ/מִשְׁפָּטִ֔/י לְ/א֥וֹר עַמִּ֖ים אַרְגִּֽיעַ
verses.translit: hqshybv 'ly 'my vl'vmy 'ly h'zynv khy tvrh m'ty tts' vmshpty l'vr 'mym 'rgy'
verses.translation: Hearken unto me, my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light of the people.

verses.original: קָר֤וֹב צִדְקִ/י֙ יָצָ֣א יִשְׁעִ֔/י וּ/זְרֹעַ֖/י עַמִּ֣ים יִשְׁפֹּ֑טוּ אֵלַ/י֙ אִיִּ֣ים יְקַוּ֔וּ וְ/אֶל זְרֹעִ֖/י יְיַחֵלֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: qrvb tsdqy yts' ysh'y vzr'y 'mym yshptv 'ly 'yym yqvv v'l zr'y yychlvn
verses.translation: My righteousness is near; my salvation is gone forth, and mine arms shall judge the people; the isles shall wait upon me, and on mine arm shall they trust.

verses.original: שְׂאוּ֩ לַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם עֵֽינֵי/כֶ֜ם וְֽ/הַבִּ֧יטוּ אֶל הָ/אָ֣רֶץ מִ/תַּ֗חַת כִּֽי שָׁמַ֜יִם כֶּ/עָשָׁ֤ן נִמְלָ֨חוּ֙ וְ/הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ כַּ/בֶּ֣גֶד תִּבְלֶ֔ה וְ/יֹשְׁבֶ֖י/הָ כְּמוֹ כֵ֣ן יְמוּת֑וּ/ן וִ/ישֽׁוּעָתִ/י֙ לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וְ/צִדְקָתִ֖/י לֹ֥א תֵחָֽת
verses.translit: sh'v lshmym 'ynykhm vhbytv 'l h'rts mtcht khy shmym kh'shn nmlchv vh'rts khbgd tblh vyshbyh khmv khn ymvtvn vyshv'ty l'vlm thyh vtsdqty l' tcht
verses.translation: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ אֵלַ/י֙ יֹ֣דְעֵי צֶ֔דֶק עַ֖ם תּוֹרָתִ֣/י בְ/לִבָּ֑/ם אַל תִּֽירְאוּ֙ חֶרְפַּ֣ת אֱנ֔וֹשׁ וּ/מִ/גִּדֻּפֹתָ֖/ם אַל תֵּחָֽתּוּ
verses.translit: shm'v 'ly yd'y tsdq 'm tvrty blbm 'l tyr'v chrpt 'nvsh vmgdptm 'l tchtv
verses.translation: Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings.

verses.original: כִּ֤י כַ/בֶּ֨גֶד֙ יֹאכְלֵ֣/ם עָ֔שׁ וְ/כַ/צֶּ֖מֶר יֹאכְלֵ֣/ם סָ֑ס וְ/צִדְקָתִ/י֙ לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וִ/ישׁוּעָתִ֖/י לְ/ד֥וֹר דּוֹרִֽים
verses.translit: khy khbgd y'khlm 'sh vkhtsmr y'khlm ss vtsdqty l'vlm thyh vyshv'ty ldvr dvrym
verses.translation: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation.

verses.original: עוּרִ֨י עוּרִ֤י לִבְשִׁי עֹז֙ זְר֣וֹעַ יְהוָ֔ה ע֚וּרִי כִּ֣/ימֵי קֶ֔דֶם דֹּר֖וֹת עוֹלָמִ֑ים הֲ/ל֥וֹא אַתְּ הִ֛יא הַ/מַּחְצֶ֥בֶת רַ֖הַב מְחוֹלֶ֥לֶת תַּנִּֽין
verses.translit: 'vry 'vry lbshy 'z zrv' yhvh 'vry khymy qdm drvt 'vlmym hlv' 't hy' hmchtsbt rhb mchvllt tnyn
verses.translation: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD ; awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. Art thou not it that hath cut Rahab, and wounded the dragon?

verses.original: הֲ/ל֤וֹא אַתְּ הִיא֙ הַ/מַּחֲרֶ֣בֶת יָ֔ם מֵ֖י תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֑ה הַ/שָּׂ֨מָה֙ מַֽעֲמַקֵּי יָ֔ם דֶּ֖רֶךְ לַ/עֲבֹ֥ר גְּאוּלִֽים
verses.translit: hlv' 't hy' hmchrbt ym my thvm rbh hshmh m'mqy ym drkh l'br g'vlym
verses.translation: Art thou not it which hath dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that hath made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?

verses.original: וּ/פְדוּיֵ֨י יְהוָ֜ה יְשׁוּב֗וּ/ן וּ/בָ֤אוּ צִיּוֹן֙ בְּ/רִנָּ֔ה וְ/שִׂמְחַ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם עַל רֹאשָׁ֑/ם שָׂשׂ֤וֹן וְ/שִׂמְחָה֙ יַשִּׂיג֔וּ/ן נָ֖סוּ יָג֥וֹן וַ/אֲנָחָֽה
verses.translit: vpdvyy yhvh yshvbvn vb'v tsyvn brnh vshmcht 'vlm 'l r'shm shshvn vshmchh yshygvn nsv ygvn v'nchh
verses.translation: Therefore the redeemed of the LORD shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy shall be upon their head: they shall obtain gladness and joy; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away.

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֧י אָנֹכִ֛י ה֖וּא מְנַחֶמְ/כֶ֑ם מִֽי אַ֤תְּ וַ/תִּֽירְאִי֙ מֵ/אֱנ֣וֹשׁ יָמ֔וּת וּ/מִ/בֶּן אָדָ֖ם חָצִ֥יר יִנָּתֵֽן
verses.translit: 'nkhy 'nkhy hv' mnchmkhm my 't vtyr'y m'nvsh ymvt vmbn 'dm chtsyr yntn
verses.translation: I, even I, am he that comforteth you: who art thou, that thou shouldest be afraid of a man that shall die, and of the son of man which shall be made as grass;

verses.original: וַ/תִּשְׁכַּ֞ח יְהוָ֣ה עֹשֶׂ֗/ךָ נוֹטֶ֣ה שָׁמַיִם֮ וְ/יֹסֵ֣ד אָרֶץ֒ וַ/תְּפַחֵ֨ד תָּמִ֜יד כָּל הַ/יּ֗וֹם מִ/פְּנֵי֙ חֲמַ֣ת הַ/מֵּצִ֔יק כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר כּוֹנֵ֖ן לְ/הַשְׁחִ֑ית וְ/אַיֵּ֖ה חֲמַ֥ת הַ/מֵּצִֽיק
verses.translit: vtshkhch yhvh 'shkh nvth shmym vysd 'rts vtpchd tmyd khl hyvm mpny chmt hmtsyq kh'shr khvnn lhshchyt v'yh chmt hmtsyq
verses.translation: And forgettest the LORD thy maker, that hath stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and hast feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where is the fury of the oppressor?

verses.original: מִהַ֥ר צֹעֶ֖ה לְ/הִפָּתֵ֑חַ וְ/לֹא יָמ֣וּת לַ/שַּׁ֔חַת וְ/לֹ֥א יֶחְסַ֖ר לַחְמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: mhr ts'h lhptch vl' ymvt lshcht vl' ychsr lchmv
verses.translation: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed, and that he should not die in the pit, nor that his bread should fail.

verses.original: וְ/אָֽנֹכִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ רֹגַ֣ע הַ/יָּ֔ם וַ/יֶּהֱמ֖וּ גַּלָּ֑י/ו יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'nkhy yhvh 'lhykh rg' hym vyhmv glyv yhvh tsb'vt shmv
verses.translation: But I am the LORD thy God, that divided the sea, whose waves roared: The LORD of hosts is his name.

verses.original: וָ/אָשִׂ֤ים דְּבָרַ/י֙ בְּ/פִ֔י/ךָ וּ/בְ/צֵ֥ל יָדִ֖/י כִּסִּיתִ֑י/ךָ לִ/נְטֹ֤עַ שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ וְ/לִ/יסֹ֣ד אָ֔רֶץ וְ/לֵ/אמֹ֥ר לְ/צִיּ֖וֹן עַמִּ/י אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: v'shym dbry bpykh vbtsl ydy khsytykh lnt' shmym vlysd 'rts vl'mr ltsyvn 'my 'th
verses.translation: And I have put my words in thy mouth, and I have covered thee in the shadow of mine hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, Thou art my people.

verses.original: הִתְעוֹרְרִ֣י הִֽתְעוֹרְרִ֗י ק֚וּמִי יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁתִ֛ית מִ/יַּ֥ד יְהוָ֖ה אֶת כּ֣וֹס חֲמָת֑/וֹ אֶת קֻבַּ֜עַת כּ֧וֹס הַ/תַּרְעֵלָ֛ה שָׁתִ֖ית מָצִֽית
verses.translit: ht'vrry ht'vrry qvmy yrvshlm 'shr shtyt myd yhvh 't khvs chmtv 't qb't khvs htr'lh shtyt mtsyt
verses.translation: Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which hast drunk at the hand of the LORD the cup of his fury; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling, and wrung them out.

verses.original: אֵין מְנַהֵ֣ל לָ֔/הּ מִ/כָּל בָּנִ֖ים יָלָ֑דָה וְ/אֵ֤ין מַחֲזִיק֙ בְּ/יָדָ֔/הּ מִ/כָּל בָּנִ֖ים גִּדֵּֽלָה
verses.translit: 'yn mnhl lh mkhl bnym yldh v'yn mchzyq bydh mkhl bnym gdlh
verses.translation: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she hath brought forth; neither is there any that taketh her by the hand of all the sons that she hath brought up.

verses.original: שְׁתַּ֤יִם הֵ֨נָּה֙ קֹֽרְאֹתַ֔יִ/ךְ מִ֖י יָנ֣וּד לָ֑/ךְ הַ/שֹּׁ֧ד וְ/הַ/שֶּׁ֛בֶר וְ/הָ/רָעָ֥ב וְ/הַ/חֶ֖רֶב מִ֥י אֲנַחֲמֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: shtym hnh qr'tykh my ynvd lkh hshd vhshbr vhr'b vhchrb my 'nchmkh
verses.translation: These two things are come unto thee; who shall be sorry for thee? desolation, and destruction, and the famine, and the sword: by whom shall I comfort thee?

verses.original: בָּנַ֜יִ/ךְ עֻלְּפ֥וּ שָׁכְב֛וּ בְּ/רֹ֥אשׁ כָּל חוּצ֖וֹת כְּ/ת֣וֹא מִכְמָ֑ר הַֽ/מְלֵאִ֥ים חֲמַת יְהוָ֖ה גַּעֲרַ֥ת אֱלֹהָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: bnykh 'lpv shkhbv br'sh khl chvtsvt khtv' mkhmr hml'ym chmt yhvh g'rt 'lhykh
verses.translation: Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of the LORD , the rebuke of thy God.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֛ן שִׁמְעִי נָ֥א זֹ֖את עֲנִיָּ֑ה וּ/שְׁכֻרַ֖ת וְ/לֹ֥א מִ/יָּֽיִן
verses.translit: lkhn shm'y n' z't 'nyh vshkhrt vl' myyn
verses.translation: Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנַ֣יִ/ךְ יְהוָ֗ה וֵ/אלֹהַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ יָרִ֣יב עַמּ֔/וֹ הִנֵּ֥ה לָקַ֛חְתִּי מִ/יָּדֵ֖/ךְ אֶת כּ֣וֹס הַ/תַּרְעֵלָ֑ה אֶת קֻבַּ֨עַת֙ כּ֣וֹס חֲמָתִ֔/י לֹא תוֹסִ֥יפִי לִ/שְׁתּוֹתָ֖/הּ עֽוֹד
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dnykh yhvh v'lhykh yryb 'mv hnh lqchty mydkh 't khvs htr'lh 't qb't khvs chmty l' tvsypy lshtvth 'vd
verses.translation: Thus saith thy Lord the LORD , and thy God that pleadeth the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling, even the dregs of the cup of my fury; thou shalt no more drink it again:

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֨י/הָ֙ בְּ/יַד מוֹגַ֔יִ/ךְ אֲשֶׁר אָמְר֥וּ לְ/נַפְשֵׁ֖/ךְ שְׁחִ֣י וְ/נַעֲבֹ֑רָה וַ/תָּשִׂ֤ימִי כָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ גֵּוֵ֔/ךְ וְ/כַ/ח֖וּץ לַ/עֹבְרִֽים
verses.translit: vshmtyh byd mvgykh 'shr 'mrv lnpshkh shchy vn'brh vtshymy kh'rts gvkh vkhchvts l'brym
verses.translation: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee; which have said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and thou hast laid thy body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over.

verses.original: עוּרִ֥י עוּרִ֛י לִבְשִׁ֥י עֻזֵּ֖/ךְ צִיּ֑וֹן לִבְשִׁ֣י בִּגְדֵ֣י תִפְאַרְתֵּ֗/ךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ עִ֣יר הַ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ כִּ֣י לֹ֥א יוֹסִ֛יף יָבֹא בָ֥/ךְ ע֖וֹד עָרֵ֥ל וְ/טָמֵֽא
verses.translit: 'vry 'vry lbshy 'zkh tsyvn lbshy bgdy tp'rtkh yrvshlm 'yr hqdsh khy l' yvsyf yb' bkh 'vd 'rl vtm'
verses.translation: Awake, awake; put on thy strength, O Zion; put on thy beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean.

verses.original: הִתְנַעֲרִ֧י מֵ/עָפָ֛ר ק֥וּמִי שְּׁבִ֖י יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם התפתחו הִֽתְפַּתְּחִי֙ מוֹסְרֵ֣י צַוָּארֵ֔/ךְ שְׁבִיָּ֖ה בַּת צִיּֽוֹן
verses.translit: htn'ry m'pr qvmy shby yrvshlm htptchv htptchy mvsry tsv'rkh shbyh bt tsyvn
verses.translation: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, and sit down, O Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion.

verses.original: כִּֽי כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה חִנָּ֖ם נִמְכַּרְתֶּ֑ם וְ/לֹ֥א בְ/כֶ֖סֶף תִּגָּאֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh chnm nmkhrtm vl' bkhsf tg'lv
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD , Ye have sold yourselves for nought; and ye shall be redeemed without money.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה מִצְרַ֛יִם יָֽרַד עַמִּ֥/י בָ/רִֽאשֹׁנָ֖ה לָ/ג֣וּר שָׁ֑ם וְ/אַשּׁ֖וּר בְּ/אֶ֥פֶס עֲשָׁקֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'dny yhvh mtsrym yrd 'my br'shnh lgvr shm v'shvr b'ps 'shqv
verses.translation: For thus saith the Lord GOD , My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֤ה מי ל/י מַה לִּ/י פֹה֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי לֻקַּ֥ח עַמִּ֖/י חִנָּ֑ם משל/ו מֹשְׁלָ֤י/ו יְהֵילִ֨ילוּ֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וְ/תָמִ֥יד כָּל הַ/יּ֖וֹם שְׁמִ֥/י מִנֹּאָֽץ
verses.translit: v'th my ly mh ly ph n'm yhvh khy lqch 'my chnm mshlv mshlyv yhylylv n'm yhvh vtmyd khl hyvm shmy mn'ts
verses.translation: Now therefore, what have I here, saith the LORD , that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them make them to howl, saith the LORD ; and my name continually every day is blasphemed.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֛ן יֵדַ֥ע עַמִּ֖/י שְׁמִ֑/י לָ/כֵן֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא כִּֽי אֲנִי ה֥וּא הַֽ/מְדַבֵּ֖ר הִנֵּֽ/נִי
verses.translit: lkhn yd' 'my shmy lkhn byvm hhv' khy 'ny hv' hmdbr hnny
verses.translation: Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore they shall know in that day that I am he that doth speak: behold, it is I.

verses.original: מַה נָּאו֨וּ עַל הֶ/הָרִ֜ים רַגְלֵ֣י מְבַשֵּׂ֗ר מַשְׁמִ֧יעַ שָׁל֛וֹם מְבַשֵּׂ֥ר ט֖וֹב מַשְׁמִ֣יעַ יְשׁוּעָ֑ה אֹמֵ֥ר לְ/צִיּ֖וֹן מָלַ֥ךְ אֱלֹהָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: mh n'vv 'l hhrym rgly mbshr mshmy' shlvm mbshr tvb mshmy' yshv'h 'mr ltsyvn mlkh 'lhykh
verses.translation: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!

verses.original: ק֥וֹל צֹפַ֛יִ/ךְ נָ֥שְׂאוּ ק֖וֹל יַחְדָּ֣ו יְרַנֵּ֑נוּ כִּ֣י עַ֤יִן בְּ/עַ֨יִן֙ יִרְא֔וּ בְּ/שׁ֥וּב יְהוָ֖ה צִיּֽוֹן
verses.translit: qvl tspykh nsh'v qvl ychdv yrnnv khy 'yn b'yn yr'v bshvb yhvh tsyvn
verses.translation: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when the LORD shall bring again Zion.

verses.original: פִּצְח֤וּ רַנְּנוּ֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו חָרְב֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּֽי נִחַ֤ם יְהוָה֙ עַמּ֔/וֹ גָּאַ֖ל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: ptschv rnnv ychdv chrbvt yrvshlm khy nchm yhvh 'mv g'l yrvshlm
verses.translation: Break forth into joy, sing together, ye waste places of Jerusalem: for the LORD hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem.

verses.original: חָשַׂ֤ף יְהוָה֙ אֶת זְר֣וֹעַ קָדְשׁ֔/וֹ לְ/עֵינֵ֖י כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם וְ/רָאוּ֙ כָּל אַפְסֵי אָ֔רֶץ אֵ֖ת יְשׁוּעַ֥ת אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: chshf yhvh 't zrv' qdshv l'yny khl hgvym vr'v khl 'psy 'rts 't yshv't 'lhynv
verses.translation: The LORD hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.

verses.original: ס֤וּרוּ ס֨וּרוּ֙ צְא֣וּ מִ/שָּׁ֔ם טָמֵ֖א אַל תִּגָּ֑עוּ צְא֣וּ מִ/תּוֹכָ֔/הּ הִבָּ֕רוּ נֹשְׂאֵ֖י כְּלֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: svrv svrv ts'v mshm tm' 'l tg'v ts'v mtvkhh hbrv nsh'y khly yhvh
verses.translation: Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence, touch no unclean thing; go ye out of the midst of her; be ye clean, that bear the vessels of the LORD .

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א בְ/חִפָּזוֹן֙ תֵּצֵ֔אוּ וּ/בִ/מְנוּסָ֖ה לֹ֣א תֵלֵכ֑וּ/ן כִּֽי הֹלֵ֤ךְ לִ/פְנֵי/כֶם֙ יְהוָ֔ה וּ/מְאַסִּפְ/כֶ֖ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: khy l' bchpzvn tts'v vbmnvsh l' tlkhvn khy hlkh lpnykhm yhvh vm'spkhm 'lhy yshr'l
verses.translation: For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the LORD will go before you; and the God of Israel will be your rereward.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה יַשְׂכִּ֖יל עַבְדִּ֑/י יָר֧וּם וְ/נִשָּׂ֛א וְ/גָבַ֖הּ מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: hnh yshkhyl 'bdy yrvm vnsh' vgbh m'd
verses.translation: Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁמְמ֤וּ עָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ רַבִּ֔ים כֵּן מִשְׁחַ֥ת מֵ/אִ֖ישׁ מַרְאֵ֑/הוּ וְ/תֹאֲר֖/וֹ מִ/בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם
verses.translit: kh'shr shmmv 'lykh rbym khn mshcht m'ysh mr'hv vt'rv mbny 'dm
verses.translation: As many were astonied at thee; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:

verses.original: כֵּ֤ן יַזֶּה֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים עָלָ֛י/ו יִקְפְּצ֥וּ מְלָכִ֖ים פִּי/הֶ֑ם כִּ֠י אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא סֻפַּ֤ר לָ/הֶם֙ רָא֔וּ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא שָׁמְע֖וּ הִתְבּוֹנָֽנוּ
verses.translit: khn yzh gvym rbym 'lyv yqptsv mlkhym pyhm khy 'shr l' spr lhm r'v v'shr l' shm'v htbvnnv
verses.translation: So shall he sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at him: for that which had not been told them shall they see; and that which they had not heard shall they consider.

verses.original: מִ֥י הֶאֱמִ֖ין לִ/שְׁמֻעָתֵ֑/נוּ וּ/זְר֥וֹעַ יְהוָ֖ה עַל מִ֥י נִגְלָֽתָה
verses.translit: my h'myn lshm'tnv vzrv' yhvh 'l my nglth
verses.translation: Who hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the LORD revealed?

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַל כַּ/יּוֹנֵ֜ק לְ/פָנָ֗י/ו וְ/כַ/שֹּׁ֨רֶשׁ֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ צִיָּ֔ה לֹא תֹ֥אַר ל֖/וֹ וְ/לֹ֣א הָדָ֑ר וְ/נִרְאֵ֥/הוּ וְ/לֹֽא מַרְאֶ֖ה וְ/נֶחְמְדֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vy'l khyvnq lpnyv vkhshrsh m'rts tsyh l' t'r lv vl' hdr vnr'hv vl' mr'h vnchmdhv
verses.translation: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.

verses.original: נִבְזֶה֙ וַ/חֲדַ֣ל אִישִׁ֔ים אִ֥ישׁ מַכְאֹב֖וֹת וִ/יד֣וּעַ חֹ֑לִי וּ/כְ/מַסְתֵּ֤ר פָּנִים֙ מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ נִבְזֶ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א חֲשַׁבְנֻֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: nbzh vchdl 'yshym 'ysh mkh'bvt vydv' chly vkhmstr pnym mmnv nbzh vl' chshbnhv
verses.translation: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.

verses.original: אָכֵ֤ן חֳלָיֵ֨/נוּ֙ ה֣וּא נָשָׂ֔א וּ/מַכְאֹבֵ֖י/נוּ סְבָלָ֑/ם וַ/אֲנַ֣חְנוּ חֲשַׁבְנֻ֔/הוּ נָג֛וּעַ מֻכֵּ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים וּ/מְעֻנֶּֽה
verses.translit: 'khn chlynv hv' nsh' vmkh'bynv sblm v'nchnv chshbnhv ngv' mkhh 'lhym vm'nh
verses.translation: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.

verses.original: וְ/הוּא֙ מְחֹלָ֣ל מִ/פְּשָׁעֵ֔/נוּ מְדֻכָּ֖א מֵ/עֲוֺנֹתֵ֑י/נוּ מוּסַ֤ר שְׁלוֹמֵ֨/נוּ֙ עָלָ֔י/ו וּ/בַ/חֲבֻרָת֖/וֹ נִרְפָּא לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vhv' mchll mpsh'nv mdkh' m'vntynv mvsr shlvmnv 'lyv vbchbrtv nrp' lnv
verses.translation: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֨/נוּ֙ כַּ/צֹּ֣אן תָּעִ֔ינוּ אִ֥ישׁ לְ/דַרְכּ֖/וֹ פָּנִ֑ינוּ וַֽ/יהוָה֙ הִפְגִּ֣יעַ בּ֔/וֹ אֵ֖ת עֲוֺ֥ן כֻּלָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: khlnv khts'n t'ynv 'ysh ldrkhv pnynv vyhvh hpgy' bv 't 'vn khlnv
verses.translation: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the LORD hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.

verses.original: נִגַּ֨שׂ וְ/ה֣וּא נַעֲנֶה֮ וְ/לֹ֣א יִפְתַּח פִּי/ו֒ כַּ/שֶּׂה֙ לַ/טֶּ֣בַח יוּבָ֔ל וּ/כְ/רָחֵ֕ל לִ/פְנֵ֥י גֹזְזֶ֖י/הָ נֶאֱלָ֑מָה וְ/לֹ֥א יִפְתַּ֖ח פִּֽי/ו
verses.translit: ngsh vhv' n'nh vl' yptch pyv khshh ltbch yvbl vkhrchl lpny gzzyh n'lmh vl' yptch pyv
verses.translation: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.

verses.original: מֵ/עֹ֤צֶר וּ/מִ/מִּשְׁפָּט֙ לֻקָּ֔ח וְ/אֶת דּוֹר֖/וֹ מִ֣י יְשׂוֹחֵ֑חַ כִּ֤י נִגְזַר֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּ֔ים מִ/פֶּ֥שַׁע עַמִּ֖/י נֶ֥גַע לָֽ/מוֹ
verses.translit: m'tsr vmmshpt lqch v't dvrv my yshvchch khy ngzr m'rts chyym mpsh' 'my ng' lmv
verses.translation: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֤ן אֶת רְשָׁעִים֙ קִבְר֔/וֹ וְ/אֶת עָשִׁ֖יר בְּ/מֹתָ֑י/ו עַ֚ל לֹא חָמָ֣ס עָשָׂ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א מִרְמָ֖ה בְּ/פִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vytn 't rsh'ym qbrv v't 'shyr bmtyv 'l l' chms 'shh vl' mrmh bpyv
verses.translation: And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither was any deceit in his mouth.

verses.original: וַ/יהוָ֞ה חָפֵ֤ץ דַּכְּא/וֹ֙ הֶֽחֱלִ֔י אִם תָּשִׂ֤ים אָשָׁם֙ נַפְשׁ֔/וֹ יִרְאֶ֥ה זֶ֖רַע יַאֲרִ֣יךְ יָמִ֑ים וְ/חֵ֥פֶץ יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יָד֥/וֹ יִצְלָֽח
verses.translit: vyhvh chpts dkh'v hchly 'm tshym 'shm npshv yr'h zr' y'rykh ymym vchpts yhvh bydv ytslch
verses.translation: Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him; he hath put him to grief: when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see his seed, he shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of the LORD shall prosper in his hand.

verses.original: מֵ/עֲמַ֤ל נַפְשׁ/וֹ֙ יִרְאֶ֣ה יִשְׂבָּ֔ע בְּ/דַעְתּ֗/וֹ יַצְדִּ֥יק צַדִּ֛יק עַבְדִּ֖/י לָֽ/רַבִּ֑ים וַ/עֲוֺנֹתָ֖/ם ה֥וּא יִסְבֹּֽל
verses.translit: m'ml npshv yr'h yshb' bd'tv ytsdyq tsdyq 'bdy lrbym v'vntm hv' ysbl
verses.translation: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן אֲחַלֶּק ל֣/וֹ בָ/רַבִּ֗ים וְ/אֶת עֲצוּמִים֮ יְחַלֵּ֣ק שָׁלָל֒ תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶעֱרָ֤ה לַ/מָּ֨וֶת֙ נַפְשׁ֔/וֹ וְ/אֶת פֹּשְׁעִ֖ים נִמְנָ֑ה וְ/הוּא֙ חֵטְא רַבִּ֣ים נָשָׂ֔א וְ/לַ/פֹּשְׁעִ֖ים יַפְגִּֽיעַ
verses.translit: lkhn 'chlq lv brbym v't 'tsvmym ychlq shll tcht 'shr h'rh lmvt npshv v't psh'ym nmnh vhv' cht' rbym nsh' vlpsh'ym ypgy'
verses.translation: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.

verses.original: רָנִּ֥י עֲקָרָ֖ה לֹ֣א יָלָ֑דָה פִּצְחִ֨י רִנָּ֤ה וְ/צַהֲלִי֙ לֹא חָ֔לָה כִּֽי רַבִּ֧ים בְּֽנֵי שׁוֹמֵמָ֛ה מִ/בְּנֵ֥י בְעוּלָ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: rny 'qrh l' yldh ptschy rnh vtshly l' chlh khy rbym bny shvmmh mbny b'vlh 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: Sing, O barren, thou that didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou that didst not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith the LORD .

verses.original: הַרְחִ֣יבִי מְק֣וֹם אָהֳלֵ֗/ךְ וִ/ירִיע֧וֹת מִשְׁכְּנוֹתַ֛יִ/ךְ יַטּ֖וּ אַל תַּחְשֹׂ֑כִי הַאֲרִ֨יכִי֙ מֵֽיתָרַ֔יִ/ךְ וִ/יתֵדֹתַ֖יִ/ךְ חַזֵּֽקִי
verses.translit: hrchyby mqvm 'hlkh vyry'vt mshkhnvtykh ytv 'l tchshkhy h'rykhy mytrykh vytdtykh chzqy
verses.translation: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;

verses.original: כִּי יָמִ֥ין וּ/שְׂמֹ֖אול תִּפְרֹ֑צִי וְ/זַרְעֵ/ךְ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם יִירָ֔שׁ וְ/עָרִ֥ים נְשַׁמּ֖וֹת יוֹשִֽׁיבוּ
verses.translit: khy ymyn vshm'vl tprtsy vzr'kh gvym yyrsh v'rym nshmvt yvshybv
verses.translation: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.

verses.original: אַל תִּֽירְאִי֙ כִּי לֹ֣א תֵב֔וֹשִׁי וְ/אַל תִּכָּלְמִ֖י כִּ֣י לֹ֣א תַחְפִּ֑ירִי כִּ֣י בֹ֤שֶׁת עֲלוּמַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ תִּשְׁכָּ֔חִי וְ/חֶרְפַּ֥ת אַלְמְנוּתַ֖יִ/ךְ לֹ֥א תִזְכְּרִי עֽוֹד
verses.translit: 'l tyr'y khy l' tbvshy v'l tkhlmy khy l' tchpyry khy bsht 'lvmykh tshkhchy vchrpt 'lmnvtykh l' tzkhry 'vd
verses.translation: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.

verses.original: כִּ֤י בֹעֲלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ עֹשַׂ֔יִ/ךְ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑/וֹ וְ/גֹֽאֲלֵ/ךְ֙ קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֱלֹהֵ֥י כָל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ יִקָּרֵֽא
verses.translit: khy b'lykh 'shykh yhvh tsb'vt shmv vg'lkh qdvsh yshr'l 'lhy khl h'rts yqr'
verses.translation: For thy Maker is thine husband; the LORD of hosts is his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.

verses.original: כִּֽי כְ/אִשָּׁ֧ה עֲזוּבָ֛ה וַ/עֲצ֥וּבַת ר֖וּחַ קְרָאָ֣/ךְ יְהוָ֑ה וְ/אֵ֧שֶׁת נְעוּרִ֛ים כִּ֥י תִמָּאֵ֖ס אָמַ֥ר אֱלֹהָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: khy kh'shh 'zvbh v'tsvbt rvch qr'kh yhvh v'sht n'vrym khy tm's 'mr 'lhykh
verses.translation: For the LORD hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God.

verses.original: בְּ/רֶ֥גַע קָטֹ֖ן עֲזַבְתִּ֑י/ךְ וּ/בְ/רַחֲמִ֥ים גְּדֹלִ֖ים אֲקַבְּצֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: brg' qtn 'zbtykh vbrchmym gdlym 'qbtskh
verses.translation: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.

verses.original: בְּ/שֶׁ֣צֶף קֶ֗צֶף הִסְתַּ֨רְתִּי פָנַ֥/י רֶ֨גַע֙ מִמֵּ֔/ךְ וּ/בְ/חֶ֥סֶד עוֹלָ֖ם רִֽחַמְתִּ֑י/ךְ אָמַ֥ר גֹּאֲלֵ֖/ךְ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: bshtsf qtsf hstrty pny rg' mmkh vbchsd 'vlm rchmtykh 'mr g'lkh yhvh
verses.translation: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith the LORD thy Redeemer.

verses.original: כִּי מֵ֥י נֹ֨חַ֙ זֹ֣את לִ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבַּ֗עְתִּי מֵ/עֲבֹ֥ר מֵי נֹ֛חַ ע֖וֹד עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ כֵּ֥ן נִשְׁבַּ֛עְתִּי מִ/קְּצֹ֥ף עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ וּ/מִ/גְּעָר בָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khy my nch z't ly 'shr nshb'ty m'br my nch 'vd 'l h'rts khn nshb'ty mqtsf 'lykh vmg'r bkh
verses.translation: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me: for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.

verses.original: כִּ֤י הֶֽ/הָרִים֙ יָמ֔וּשׁוּ וְ/הַ/גְּבָע֖וֹת תְּמוּטֶ֑נָה וְ/חַסְדִּ֞/י מֵ/אִתֵּ֣/ךְ לֹֽא יָמ֗וּשׁ וּ/בְרִ֤ית שְׁלוֹמִ/י֙ לֹ֣א תָמ֔וּט אָמַ֥ר מְרַחֲמֵ֖/ךְ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy hhrym ymvshv vhgb'vt tmvtnh vchsdy m'tkh l' ymvsh vbryt shlvmy l' tmvt 'mr mrchmkh yhvh
verses.translation: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.

verses.original: עֲנִיָּ֥ה סֹעֲרָ֖ה לֹ֣א נֻחָ֑מָה הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י מַרְבִּ֤יץ בַּ/פּוּךְ֙ אֲבָנַ֔יִ/ךְ וִ/יסַדְתִּ֖י/ךְ בַּ/סַּפִּירִֽים
verses.translit: 'nyh s'rh l' nchmh hnh 'nkhy mrbyts bpvkh 'bnykh vysdtykh bspyrym
verses.translation: O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colours, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֤י כַּֽדְכֹד֙ שִׁמְשֹׁתַ֔יִ/ךְ וּ/שְׁעָרַ֖יִ/ךְ לְ/אַבְנֵ֣י אֶקְדָּ֑ח וְ/כָל גְּבוּלֵ֖/ךְ לְ/אַבְנֵי חֵֽפֶץ
verses.translit: vshmty khdkhd shmshtykh vsh'rykh l'bny 'qdch vkhl gbvlkh l'bny chpts
verses.translation: And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.

verses.original: וְ/כָל בָּנַ֖יִ/ךְ לִמּוּדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/רַ֖ב שְׁל֥וֹם בָּנָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: vkhl bnykh lmvdy yhvh vrb shlvm bnykh
verses.translation: And all thy children shall be taught of the LORD ; and great shall be the peace of thy children.

verses.original: בִּ/צְדָקָ֖ה תִּכּוֹנָ֑נִי רַחֲקִ֤י מֵ/עֹ֨שֶׁק֙ כִּֽי לֹ֣א תִירָ֔אִי וּ/מִ֨/מְּחִתָּ֔ה כִּ֥י לֹֽא תִקְרַ֖ב אֵלָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: btsdqh tkhvnny rchqy m'shq khy l' tyr'y vmmchth khy l' tqrb 'lykh
verses.translation: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee.

verses.original: הֵ֣ן גּ֥וֹר יָג֛וּר אֶ֖פֶס מֵֽ/אוֹתִ֑/י מִי גָ֥ר אִתָּ֖/ךְ עָלַ֥יִ/ךְ יִפּֽוֹל
verses.translit: hn gvr ygvr 'ps m'vty my gr 'tkh 'lykh ypvl
verses.translation: Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake.

verses.original: הן הִנֵּ֤ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ בָּרָ֣אתִי חָרָ֔שׁ נֹפֵ֨חַ֙ בְּ/אֵ֣שׁ פֶּחָ֔ם וּ/מוֹצִ֥יא כְלִ֖י לְ/מַעֲשֵׂ֑/הוּ וְ/אָנֹכִ֛י בָּרָ֥אתִי מַשְׁחִ֖ית לְ/חַבֵּֽל
verses.translit: hn hnh 'nkhy br'ty chrsh npch b'sh pchm vmvtsy' khly lm'shhv v'nkhy br'ty mshchyt lchbl
verses.translation: Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.

verses.original: כָּל כְּלִ֞י יוּצַ֤ר עָלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ לֹ֣א יִצְלָ֔ח וְ/כָל לָשׁ֛וֹן תָּֽקוּם אִתָּ֥/ךְ לַ/מִּשְׁפָּ֖ט תַּרְשִׁ֑יעִי זֹ֡את נַחֲלַת֩ עַבְדֵ֨י יְהוָ֧ה וְ/צִדְקָתָ֛/ם מֵ/אִתִּ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khl khly yvtsr 'lykh l' ytslch vkhl lshvn tqvm 'tkh lmshpt trshy'y z't nchlt 'bdy yhvh vtsdqtm m'ty n'm yhvh
verses.translation: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD , and their righteousness is of me, saith the LORD .

verses.original: ה֤וֹי כָּל צָמֵא֙ לְכ֣וּ לַ/מַּ֔יִם וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵֽין ל֖/וֹ כָּ֑סֶף לְכ֤וּ שִׁבְרוּ֙ וֶֽ/אֱכֹ֔לוּ וּ/לְכ֣וּ שִׁבְר֗וּ בְּ/לוֹא כֶ֛סֶף וּ/בְ/ל֥וֹא מְחִ֖יר יַ֥יִן וְ/חָלָֽב
verses.translit: hvy khl tsm' lkhv lmym v'shr 'yn lv khsf lkhv shbrv v'khlv vlkhv shbrv blv' khsf vblv' mchyr yyn vchlb
verses.translation: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

verses.original: לָ֤/מָּה תִשְׁקְלוּ כֶ֨סֶף֙ בְּֽ/לוֹא לֶ֔חֶם וִ/יגִיעֲ/כֶ֖ם בְּ/ל֣וֹא לְ/שָׂבְעָ֑ה שִׁמְע֨וּ שָׁמ֤וֹעַ אֵלַ/י֙ וְ/אִכְלוּ ט֔וֹב וְ/תִתְעַנַּ֥ג בַּ/דֶּ֖שֶׁן נַפְשְׁ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: lmh tshqlv khsf blv' lchm vygy'khm blv' lshb'h shm'v shmv' 'ly v'khlv tvb vtt'ng bdshn npshkhm
verses.translation: Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread? and your labour for that which satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.

verses.original: הַטּ֤וּ אָזְנְ/כֶם֙ וּ/לְכ֣וּ אֵלַ֔/י שִׁמְע֖וּ וּ/תְחִ֣י נַפְשְׁ/כֶ֑ם וְ/אֶכְרְתָ֤ה לָ/כֶם֙ בְּרִ֣ית עוֹלָ֔ם חַֽסְדֵ֥י דָוִ֖ד הַ/נֶּאֱמָנִֽים
verses.translit: htv 'znkhm vlkhv 'ly shm'v vtchy npshkhm v'khrth lkhm bryt 'vlm chsdy dvd hn'mnym
verses.translation: Incline your ear, and come unto me: hear, and your soul shall live; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.

verses.original: הֵ֛ן עֵ֥ד לְאוּמִּ֖ים נְתַתִּ֑י/ו נָגִ֥יד וּ/מְצַוֵּ֖ה לְאֻמִּֽים
verses.translit: hn 'd l'vmym nttyv ngyd vmtsvh l'mym
verses.translation: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.

verses.original: הֵ֣ן גּ֤וֹי לֹֽא תֵדַע֙ תִּקְרָ֔א וְ/ג֥וֹי לֹֽא יְדָע֖וּ/ךָ אֵלֶ֣י/ךָ יָר֑וּצוּ לְמַ֨עַן֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/לִ/קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כִּ֥י פֵאֲרָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: hn gvy l' td' tqr' vgvy l' yd'vkh 'lykh yrvtsv lm'n yhvh 'lhykh vlqdvsh yshr'l khy p'rkh
verses.translation: Behold, thou shalt call a nation that thou knowest not, and nations that knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the LORD thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he hath glorified thee.

verses.original: דִּרְשׁ֥וּ יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/הִמָּצְא֑/וֹ קְרָאֻ֖/הוּ בִּֽ/הְיוֹת֥/וֹ קָרֽוֹב
verses.translit: drshv yhvh bhmts'v qr'hv bhyvtv qrvb
verses.translation: Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:

verses.original: יַעֲזֹ֤ב רָשָׁע֙ דַּרְכּ֔/וֹ וְ/אִ֥ישׁ אָ֖וֶן מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֑י/ו וְ/יָשֹׁ֤ב אֶל יְהוָה֙ וִֽ/ירַחֲמֵ֔/הוּ וְ/אֶל אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ כִּֽי יַרְבֶּ֥ה לִ/סְלֽוֹחַ
verses.translit: y'zb rsh' drkhv v'ysh 'vn mchshbtyv vyshb 'l yhvh vyrchmhv v'l 'lhynv khy yrbh lslvch
verses.translation: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto the LORD , and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א מַחְשְׁבוֹתַ/י֙ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹתֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/לֹ֥א דַרְכֵי/כֶ֖ם דְּרָכָ֑/י נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy l' mchshbvty mchshbvtykhm vl' drkhykhm drkhy n'm yhvh
verses.translation: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD .

verses.original: כִּֽי גָבְה֥וּ שָׁמַ֖יִם מֵ/אָ֑רֶץ כֵּ֣ן גָּבְה֤וּ דְרָכַ/י֙ מִ/דַּרְכֵי/כֶ֔ם וּ/מַחְשְׁבֹתַ֖/י מִ/מַּחְשְׁבֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khy gbhv shmym m'rts khn gbhv drkhy mdrkhykhm vmchshbty mmchshbtykhm
verses.translation: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

verses.original: כִּ֡י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵרֵד֩ הַ/גֶּ֨שֶׁם וְ/הַ/שֶּׁ֜לֶג מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֗יִם וְ/שָׁ֨מָּ/ה֙ לֹ֣א יָשׁ֔וּב כִּ֚י אִם הִרְוָ֣ה אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/הוֹלִידָ֖/הּ וְ/הִצְמִיחָ֑/הּ וְ/נָ֤תַן זֶ֨רַע֙ לַ/זֹּרֵ֔עַ וְ/לֶ֖חֶם לָ/אֹכֵֽל
verses.translit: khy kh'shr yrd hgshm vhshlg mn hshmym vshmh l' yshvb khy 'm hrvh 't h'rts vhvlydh vhtsmychh vntn zr' lzr' vlchm l'khl
verses.translation: For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater:

verses.original: כֵּ֣ן יִֽהְיֶ֤ה דְבָרִ/י֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵצֵ֣א מִ/פִּ֔/י לֹֽא יָשׁ֥וּב אֵלַ֖/י רֵיקָ֑ם כִּ֤י אִם עָשָׂה֙ אֶת אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָפַ֔צְתִּי וְ/הִצְלִ֖יחַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁלַחְתִּֽי/ו
verses.translit: khn yhyh dbry 'shr yts' mpy l' yshvb 'ly ryqm khy 'm 'shh 't 'shr chptsty vhtslych 'shr shlchtyv
verses.translation: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.

verses.original: כִּֽי בְ/שִׂמְחָ֣ה תֵצֵ֔אוּ וּ/בְ/שָׁל֖וֹם תּֽוּבָל֑וּ/ן הֶ/הָרִ֣ים וְ/הַ/גְּבָע֗וֹת יִפְצְח֤וּ לִ/פְנֵי/כֶם֙ רִנָּ֔ה וְ/כָל עֲצֵ֥י הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה יִמְחֲאוּ כָֽף
verses.translit: khy bshmchh tts'v vbshlvm tvblvn hhrym vhgb'vt yptschv lpnykhm rnh vkhl 'tsy hshdh ymch'v khf
verses.translation: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.

verses.original: תַּ֤חַת הַֽ/נַּעֲצוּץ֙ יַעֲלֶ֣ה בְר֔וֹשׁ תחת וְ/תַ֥חַת הַ/סִּרְפַּ֖ד יַעֲלֶ֣ה הֲדַ֑ס וְ/הָיָ֤ה לַֽ/יהוָה֙ לְ/שֵׁ֔ם לְ/א֥וֹת עוֹלָ֖ם לֹ֥א יִכָּרֵֽת
verses.translit: tcht hn'tsvts y'lh brvsh tcht vtcht hsrpd y'lh hds vhyh lyhvh lshm l'vt 'vlm l' ykhrt
verses.translation: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to the LORD for a name, for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שִׁמְר֥וּ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וַ/עֲשׂ֣וּ צְדָקָ֑ה כִּֽי קְרוֹבָ֤ה יְשֽׁוּעָתִ/י֙ לָ/ב֔וֹא וְ/צִדְקָתִ֖/י לְ/הִגָּלֽוֹת
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh shmrv mshpt v'shv tsdqh khy qrvbh yshv'ty lbv' vtsdqty lhglvt
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , Keep ye judgment, and do justice: for my salvation is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.

verses.original: אַשְׁרֵ֤י אֱנוֹשׁ֙ יַעֲשֶׂה זֹּ֔את וּ/בֶן אָדָ֖ם יַחֲזִ֣יק בָּ֑/הּ שֹׁמֵ֤ר שַׁבָּת֙ מֵֽ/חַלְּל֔/וֹ וְ/שֹׁמֵ֥ר יָד֖/וֹ מֵ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת כָּל רָֽע
verses.translit: 'shry 'nvsh y'shh z't vbn 'dm ychzyq bh shmr shbt mchllv vshmr ydv m'shvt khl r'
verses.translation: Blessed is the man that doeth this, and the son of man that layeth hold on it; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and keepeth his hand from doing any evil.

verses.original: וְ/אַל יֹאמַ֣ר בֶּן הַ/נֵּכָ֗ר הַ/נִּלְוָ֤ה אֶל יְהוָה֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הַבְדֵּ֧ל יַבְדִּילַ֛/נִי יְהוָ֖ה מֵ/עַ֣ל עַמּ֑/וֹ וְ/אַל יֹאמַר֙ הַ/סָּרִ֔יס הֵ֥ן אֲנִ֖י עֵ֥ץ יָבֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: v'l y'mr bn hnkhr hnlvh 'l yhvh l'mr hbdl ybdylny yhvh m'l 'mv v'l y'mr hsrys hn 'ny 'ts ybsh
verses.translation: Neither let the son of the stranger, that hath joined himself to the LORD , speak, saying, The LORD hath utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree.

verses.original: כִּי כֹ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה לַ/סָּֽרִיסִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁמְרוּ֙ אֶת שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֔/י וּ/בָֽחֲר֖וּ בַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָפָ֑צְתִּי וּ/מַחֲזִיקִ֖ים בִּ/בְרִיתִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh lsrysym 'shr yshmrv 't shbtvty vbchrv b'shr chptsty vmchzyqym bbryty
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose the things that please me, and take hold of my covenant;

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֨י לָ/הֶ֜ם בְּ/בֵיתִ֤/י וּ/בְ/חֽוֹמֹתַ/י֙ יָ֣ד וָ/שֵׁ֔ם ט֖וֹב מִ/בָּנִ֣ים וּ/מִ/בָּנ֑וֹת שֵׁ֤ם עוֹלָם֙ אֶתֶּן ל֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א יִכָּרֵֽת
verses.translit: vntty lhm bbyty vbchvmty yd vshm tvb mbnym vmbnvt shm 'vlm 'tn lv 'shr l' ykhrt
verses.translation: Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י הַ/נֵּכָ֗ר הַ/נִּלְוִ֤ים עַל יְהוָה֙ לְ/שָׁ֣רְת֔/וֹ וּֽ/לְ/אַהֲבָה֙ אֶת שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה לִ/הְי֥וֹת ל֖/וֹ לַ/עֲבָדִ֑ים כָּל שֹׁמֵ֤ר שַׁבָּת֙ מֵֽ/חַלְּל֔/וֹ וּ/מַחֲזִיקִ֖ים בִּ/בְרִיתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vbny hnkhr hnlvym 'l yhvh lshrtv vl'hbh 't shm yhvh lhyvt lv l'bdym khl shmr shbt mchllv vmchzyqym bbryty
verses.translation: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to the LORD , to serve him, and to love the name of the LORD , to be his servants, every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and taketh hold of my covenant;

verses.original: וַ/הֲבִיאוֹתִ֞י/ם אֶל הַ֣ר קָדְשִׁ֗/י וְ/שִׂמַּחְתִּי/ם֙ בְּ/בֵ֣ית תְּפִלָּתִ֔/י עוֹלֹתֵי/הֶ֧ם וְ/זִבְחֵי/הֶ֛ם לְ/רָצ֖וֹן עַֽל מִזְבְּחִ֑/י כִּ֣י בֵיתִ֔/י בֵּית תְּפִלָּ֥ה יִקָּרֵ֖א לְ/כָל הָ/עַמִּֽים
verses.translit: vhby'vtym 'l hr qdshy vshmchtym bbyt tplty 'vltyhm vzbchyhm lrtsvn 'l mzbchy khy byty byt tplh yqr' lkhl h'mym
verses.translation: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.

verses.original: נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֔ה מְקַבֵּ֖ץ נִדְחֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ע֛וֹד אֲקַבֵּ֥ץ עָלָ֖י/ו לְ/נִקְבָּצָֽי/ו
verses.translit: n'm 'dny yhvh mqbts ndchy yshr'l 'vd 'qbts 'lyv lnqbtsyv
verses.translation: The Lord GOD which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith, Yet will I gather others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.

verses.original: כֹּ֖ל חַיְת֣וֹ שָׂדָ֑י אֵתָ֕יוּ לֶ/אֱכֹ֥ל כָּל חַיְת֖וֹ בַּ/יָּֽעַר
verses.translit: khl chytv shdy 'tyv l'khl khl chytv by'r
verses.translation: All ye beasts of the field, come to devour, yea , all ye beasts in the forest.

verses.original: צפו צֹפָ֞י/ו עִוְרִ֤ים כֻּלָּ/ם֙ לֹ֣א יָדָ֔עוּ כֻּלָּ/ם֙ כְּלָבִ֣ים אִלְּמִ֔ים לֹ֥א יוּכְל֖וּ לִ/נְבֹּ֑חַ הֹזִים֙ שֹֽׁכְבִ֔ים אֹהֲבֵ֖י לָ/נֽוּם
verses.translit: tspv tspyv 'vrym khlm l' yd'v khlm khlbym 'lmym l' yvkhlv lnbch hzym shkhbym 'hby lnvm
verses.translation: His watchmen are blind: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/כְּלָבִ֣ים עַזֵּי נֶ֗פֶשׁ לֹ֤א יָֽדְעוּ֙ שָׂבְעָ֔ה וְ/הֵ֣מָּה רֹעִ֔ים לֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּ הָבִ֑ין כֻּלָּ/ם֙ לְ/דַרְכָּ֣/ם פָּנ֔וּ אִ֥ישׁ לְ/בִצְע֖/וֹ מִ/קָּצֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vhkhlbym 'zy npsh l' yd'v shb'h vhmh r'ym l' yd'v hbyn khlm ldrkhm pnv 'ysh lbts'v mqtshv
verses.translation: Yea, they are greedy dogs which can never have enough, and they are shepherds that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.

verses.original: אֵתָ֥יוּ אֶקְחָה יַ֖יִן וְ/נִסְבְּאָ֣ה שֵׁכָ֑ר וְ/הָיָ֤ה כָ/זֶה֙ י֣וֹם מָחָ֔ר גָּד֖וֹל יֶ֥תֶר מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: 'tyv 'qchh yyn vnsb'h shkhr vhyh khzh yvm mchr gdvl ytr m'd
verses.translation: Come ye, say they , I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day, and much more abundant.

verses.original: הַ/צַּדִּ֣יק אָבָ֔ד וְ/אֵ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ שָׂ֣ם עַל לֵ֑ב וְ/אַנְשֵׁי חֶ֤סֶד נֶֽאֱסָפִים֙ בְּ/אֵ֣ין מֵבִ֔ין כִּֽי מִ/פְּנֵ֥י הָ/רָעָ֖ה נֶאֱסַ֥ף הַ/צַּדִּֽיק
verses.translit: htsdyq 'bd v'yn 'ysh shm 'l lb v'nshy chsd n'spym b'yn mbyn khy mpny hr'h n'sf htsdyq
verses.translation: The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth it to heart: and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come .

verses.original: יָב֣וֹא שָׁל֔וֹם יָנ֖וּחוּ עַל מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָ֑/ם הֹלֵ֖ךְ נְכֹחֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: ybv' shlvm ynvchv 'l mshkhbvtm hlkh nkhchv
verses.translation: He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, each one walking in his uprightness.

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּ֥ם קִרְבוּ הֵ֖נָּה בְּנֵ֣י עֹנְנָ֑ה זֶ֥רַע מְנָאֵ֖ף וַ/תִּזְנֶֽה
