verses.translit: v'tm qrbv hnh bny 'nnh zr' mn'f vtznh
verses.translation: But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.

verses.original: עַל מִי֙ תִּתְעַנָּ֔גוּ עַל מִ֛י תַּרְחִ֥יבוּ פֶ֖ה תַּאֲרִ֣יכוּ לָשׁ֑וֹן הֲ/לֽוֹא אַתֶּ֥ם יִלְדֵי פֶ֖שַׁע זֶ֥רַע שָֽׁקֶר
verses.translit: 'l my tt'ngv 'l my trchybv ph t'rykhv lshvn hlv' 'tm yldy psh' zr' shqr
verses.translation: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, and draw out the tongue? are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,

verses.original: הַ/נֵּֽחָמִים֙ בָּֽ/אֵלִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת כָּל עֵ֣ץ רַעֲנָ֑ן שֹׁחֲטֵ֤י הַ/יְלָדִים֙ בַּ/נְּחָלִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת סְעִפֵ֥י הַ/סְּלָעִֽים
verses.translit: hnchmym b'lym tcht khl 'ts r'nn shchty hyldym bnchlym tcht s'py hsl'ym
verses.translation: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?

verses.original: בְּ/חַלְּקֵי נַ֣חַל חֶלְקֵ֔/ךְ הֵ֥ם הֵ֖ם גּוֹרָלֵ֑/ךְ גַּם לָ/הֶ֞ם שָׁפַ֥כְתְּ נֶ֨סֶךְ֙ הֶעֱלִ֣ית מִנְחָ֔ה הַ֥/עַל אֵ֖לֶּה אֶנָּחֵֽם
verses.translit: bchlqy nchl chlqkh hm hm gvrlkh gm lhm shpkht nskh h'lyt mnchh h'l 'lh 'nchm
verses.translation: Among the smooth stones of the stream is thy portion; they, they are thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?

verses.original: עַ֤ל הַר גָּבֹ֨הַּ֙ וְ/נִשָּׂ֔א שַׂ֖מְתְּ מִשְׁכָּבֵ֑/ךְ גַּם שָׁ֥ם עָלִ֖ית לִ/זְבֹּ֥חַ זָֽבַח
verses.translit: 'l hr gbh vnsh' shmt mshkhbkh gm shm 'lyt lzbch zbch
verses.translation: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.

verses.original: וְ/אַחַ֤ר הַ/דֶּ֨לֶת֙ וְ/הַ/מְּזוּזָ֔ה שַׂ֖מְתְּ זִכְרוֹנֵ֑/ךְ כִּ֣י מֵ/אִתִּ֞/י גִּלִּ֣ית וַֽ/תַּעֲלִ֗י הִרְחַ֤בְתְּ מִשְׁכָּבֵ/ךְ֙ וַ/תִּכְרָת לָ֣/ךְ מֵ/הֶ֔ם אָהַ֥בְתְּ מִשְׁכָּבָ֖/ם יָ֥ד חָזִֽית
verses.translit: v'chr hdlt vhmzvzh shmt zkhrvnkh khy m'ty glyt vt'ly hrchbt mshkhbkh vtkhrt lkh mhm 'hbt mshkhbm yd chzyt
verses.translation: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for thou hast discovered thyself to another than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee a covenant with them; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it .

verses.translit: vtshry lmlkh bshmn vtrby rqchykh vtshlchy tsrykh 'd mrchq vtshpyly 'd sh'vl
verses.translation: And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase thyself even unto hell.

verses.original: בְּ/רֹ֤ב דַּרְכֵּ/ךְ֙ יָגַ֔עַתְּ לֹ֥א אָמַ֖רְתְּ נוֹאָ֑שׁ חַיַּ֤ת יָדֵ/ךְ֙ מָצָ֔את עַל כֵּ֖ן לֹ֥א חָלִֽית
verses.translit: brb drkhkh yg't l' 'mrt nv'sh chyt ydkh mts't 'l khn l' chlyt
verses.translation: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way; yet saidst thou not, There is no hope: thou hast found the life of thine hand; therefore thou wast not grieved.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת מִ֞י דָּאַ֤גְתְּ וַ/תִּֽירְאִי֙ כִּ֣י תְכַזֵּ֔בִי וְ/אוֹתִ/י֙ לֹ֣א זָכַ֔רְתְּ לֹא שַׂ֖מְתְּ עַל לִבֵּ֑/ךְ הֲ/לֹ֨א אֲנִ֤י מַחְשֶׁה֙ וּ/מֵ֣/עֹלָ֔ם וְ/אוֹתִ֖/י לֹ֥א תִירָֽאִי
verses.translit: v't my d'gt vtyr'y khy tkhzby v'vty l' zkhrt l' shmt 'l lbkh hl' 'ny mchshh vm'lm v'vty l' tyr'y
verses.translation: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י אַגִּ֖יד צִדְקָתֵ֑/ךְ וְ/אֶֽת מַעֲשַׂ֖יִ/ךְ וְ/לֹ֥א יוֹעִילֽוּ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'ny 'gyd tsdqtkh v't m'shykh vl' yv'ylvkh
verses.translation: I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; for they shall not profit thee.

verses.original: בְּ/זַֽעֲקֵ/ךְ֙ יַצִּילֻ֣/ךְ קִבּוּצַ֔יִ/ךְ וְ/אֶת כֻּלָּ֥/ם יִשָּׂא ר֖וּחַ יִקַּח הָ֑בֶל וְ/הַ/חוֹסֶ֥ה בִ/י֙ יִנְחַל אֶ֔רֶץ וְ/יִירַ֖שׁ הַר קָדְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: bz'qkh ytsylkh qbvtsykh v't khlm ysh' rvch yqch hbl vhchvsh by ynchl 'rts vyyrsh hr qdshy
verses.translation: When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take them: but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;

verses.original: וְ/אָמַ֥ר סֹֽלּוּ סֹ֖לּוּ פַּנּוּ דָ֑רֶךְ הָרִ֥ימוּ מִכְשׁ֖וֹל מִ/דֶּ֥רֶךְ עַמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: v'mr slv slv pnv drkh hrymv mkhshvl mdrkh 'my
verses.translation: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר רָ֣ם וְ/נִשָּׂ֗א שֹׁכֵ֥ן עַד֙ וְ/קָד֣וֹשׁ שְׁמ֔/וֹ מָר֥וֹם וְ/קָד֖וֹשׁ אֶשְׁכּ֑וֹן וְ/אֶת דַּכָּא֙ וּ/שְׁפַל ר֔וּחַ לְ/הַחֲיוֹת֙ ר֣וּחַ שְׁפָלִ֔ים וּֽ/לְ/הַחֲי֖וֹת לֵ֥ב נִדְכָּאִֽים
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr rm vnsh' shkhn 'd vqdvsh shmv mrvm vqdvsh 'shkhvn v't dkh' vshpl rvch lhchyvt rvch shplym vlhchyvt lb ndkh'ym
verses.translation: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place , with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א לְ/עוֹלָם֙ אָרִ֔יב וְ/לֹ֥א לָ/נֶ֖צַח אֶקְּצ֑וֹף כִּי ר֨וּחַ֙ מִ/לְּ/פָנַ֣/י יַֽעֲט֔וֹף וּ/נְשָׁמ֖וֹת אֲנִ֥י עָשִֽׂיתִי
verses.translit: khy l' l'vlm 'ryb vl' lntsch 'qtsvf khy rvch mlpny y'tvf vnshmvt 'ny 'shyty
verses.translation: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls which I have made.

verses.original: בַּ/עֲוֺ֥ן בִּצְע֛/וֹ קָצַ֥פְתִּי וְ/אַכֵּ֖/הוּ הַסְתֵּ֣ר וְ/אֶקְצֹ֑ף וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ שׁוֹבָ֖ב בְּ/דֶ֥רֶךְ לִבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: b'vn bts'v qtspty v'khhv hstr v'qtsf vylkh shvbb bdrkh lbv
verses.translation: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.

verses.original: דְּרָכָ֥י/ו רָאִ֖יתִי וְ/אֶרְפָּאֵ֑/הוּ וְ/אַנְחֵ֕/הוּ וַ/אֲשַׁלֵּ֧ם נִֽחֻמִ֛ים ל֖/וֹ וְ/לַ/אֲבֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: drkhyv r'yty v'rp'hv v'nchhv v'shlm nchmym lv vl'blyv
verses.translation: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.

verses.original: בּוֹרֵ֖א נוב נִ֣יב שְׂפָתָ֑יִם שָׁל֨וֹם שָׁל֜וֹם לָ/רָח֧וֹק וְ/לַ/קָּר֛וֹב אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה וּ/רְפָאתִֽי/ו
verses.translit: bvr' nvb nyb shptym shlvm shlvm lrchvq vlqrvb 'mr yhvh vrp'tyv
verses.translation: I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to him that is far off, and to him that is near, saith the LORD ; and I will heal him.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/רְשָׁעִ֖ים כַּ/יָּ֣ם נִגְרָ֑שׁ כִּ֤י הַשְׁקֵט֙ לֹ֣א יוּכָ֔ל וַ/יִּגְרְשׁ֥וּ מֵימָ֖י/ו רֶ֥פֶשׁ וָ/טִֽיט
verses.translit: vhrsh'ym khym ngrsh khy hshqt l' yvkhl vygrshv mymyv rpsh vtyt
verses.translation: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.

verses.original: אֵ֣ין שָׁל֔וֹם אָמַ֥ר אֱלֹהַ֖/י לָ/רְשָׁעִֽים
verses.translit: 'yn shlvm 'mr 'lhy lrsh'ym
verses.translation: There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.

verses.original: קְרָ֤א בְ/גָרוֹן֙ אַל תַּחְשֹׂ֔ךְ כַּ/שּׁוֹפָ֖ר הָרֵ֣ם קוֹלֶ֑/ךָ וְ/הַגֵּ֤ד לְ/עַמִּ/י֙ פִּשְׁעָ֔/ם וּ/לְ/בֵ֥ית יַעֲקֹ֖ב חַטֹּאתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: qr' bgrvn 'l tchshkh khshvpr hrm qvlkh vhgd l'my psh'm vlbyt y'qb cht'tm
verses.translation: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.

verses.original: וְ/אוֹתִ֗/י י֥וֹם יוֹם֙ יִדְרֹשׁ֔וּ/ן וְ/דַ֥עַת דְּרָכַ֖/י יֶחְפָּצ֑וּ/ן כְּ/ג֞וֹי אֲשֶׁר צְדָקָ֣ה עָשָׂ֗ה וּ/מִשְׁפַּ֤ט אֱלֹהָי/ו֙ לֹ֣א עָזָ֔ב יִשְׁאָל֨וּ/נִי֙ מִשְׁפְּטֵי צֶ֔דֶק קִרְבַ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֖ים יֶחְפָּצֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: v'vty yvm yvm ydrshvn vd't drkhy ychptsvn khgvy 'shr tsdqh 'shh vmshpt 'lhyv l' 'zb ysh'lvny mshpty tsdq qrbt 'lhym ychptsvn
verses.translation: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their God: they ask of me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in approaching to God.

verses.original: לָ֤/מָּה צַּ֨מְנוּ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א רָאִ֔יתָ עִנִּ֥ינוּ נַפְשֵׁ֖/נוּ וְ/לֹ֣א תֵדָ֑ע הֵ֣ן בְּ/י֤וֹם צֹֽמְ/כֶם֙ תִּמְצְאוּ חֵ֔פֶץ וְ/כָל עַצְּבֵי/כֶ֖ם תִּנְגֹּֽשׂוּ
verses.translit: lmh tsmnv vl' r'yt 'nynv npshnv vl' td' hn byvm tsmkhm tmts'v chpts vkhl 'tsbykhm tngshv
verses.translation: Wherefore have we fasted, say they , and thou seest not? wherefore have we afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find pleasure, and exact all your labours.

verses.original: הֵ֣ן לְ/רִ֤יב וּ/מַצָּה֙ תָּצ֔וּמוּ וּ/לְ/הַכּ֖וֹת בְּ/אֶגְרֹ֣ף רֶ֑שַׁע לֹא תָצ֣וּמוּ כַ/יּ֔וֹם לְ/הַשְׁמִ֥יעַ בַּ/מָּר֖וֹם קוֹלְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: hn lryb vmtsh ttsvmv vlhkhvt b'grf rsh' l' ttsvmv khyvm lhshmy' bmrvm qvlkhm
verses.translation: Behold, ye fast for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: ye shall not fast as ye do this day, to make your voice to be heard on high.

verses.original: הֲ/כָ/זֶ֗ה יִֽהְיֶה֙ צ֣וֹם אֶבְחָרֵ֔/הוּ י֛וֹם עַנּ֥וֹת אָדָ֖ם נַפְשׁ֑/וֹ הֲ/לָ/כֹ֨ף כְּ/אַגְמֹ֜ן רֹאשׁ֗/וֹ וְ/שַׂ֤ק וָ/אֵ֨פֶר֙ יַצִּ֔יעַ הֲ/לָ/זֶה֙ תִּקְרָא צ֔וֹם וְ/י֥וֹם רָצ֖וֹן לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: hkhzh yhyh tsvm 'bchrhv yvm 'nvt 'dm npshv hlkhf kh'gmn r'shv vshq v'pr ytsy' hlzh tqr' tsvm vyvm rtsvn lyhvh
verses.translation: Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul? is it to bow down his head as a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him ? wilt thou call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the LORD ?

verses.original: הֲ/ל֣וֹא זֶה֮ צ֣וֹם אֶבְחָרֵ/הוּ֒ פַּתֵּ֨חַ֙ חַרְצֻבּ֣וֹת רֶ֔שַׁע הַתֵּ֖ר אֲגֻדּ֣וֹת מוֹטָ֑ה וְ/שַׁלַּ֤ח רְצוּצִים֙ חָפְשִׁ֔ים וְ/כָל מוֹטָ֖ה תְּנַתֵּֽקוּ
verses.translit: hlv' zh tsvm 'bchrhv ptch chrtsbvt rsh' htr 'gdvt mvth vshlch rtsvtsym chpshym vkhl mvth tntqv
verses.translation: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?

verses.original: הֲ/ל֨וֹא פָרֹ֤ס לָֽ/רָעֵב֙ לַחְמֶ֔/ךָ וַ/עֲנִיִּ֥ים מְרוּדִ֖ים תָּ֣בִיא בָ֑יִת כִּֽי תִרְאֶ֤ה עָרֹם֙ וְ/כִסִּית֔/וֹ וּ/מִ/בְּשָׂרְ/ךָ֖ לֹ֥א תִתְעַלָּֽם
verses.translit: hlv' prs lr'b lchmkh v'nyym mrvdym tby' byt khy tr'h 'rm vkhsytv vmbshrkh l' tt'lm
verses.translation: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?

verses.original: אָ֣ז יִבָּקַ֤ע כַּ/שַּׁ֨חַר֙ אוֹרֶ֔/ךָ וַ/אֲרֻכָתְ/ךָ֖ מְהֵרָ֣ה תִצְמָ֑ח וְ/הָלַ֤ךְ לְ/פָנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ צִדְקֶ֔/ךָ כְּב֥וֹד יְהוָ֖ה יַאַסְפֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'z ybq' khshchr 'vrkh v'rkhtkh mhrh ttsmch vhlkh lpnykh tsdqkh khbvd yhvh y'spkh
verses.translation: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thine health shall spring forth speedily: and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of the LORD shall be thy rereward.

verses.original: אָ֤ז תִּקְרָא֙ וַ/יהוָ֣ה יַעֲנֶ֔ה תְּשַׁוַּ֖ע וְ/יֹאמַ֣ר הִנֵּ֑/נִי אִם תָּסִ֤יר מִ/תּֽוֹכְ/ךָ֙ מוֹטָ֔ה שְׁלַ֥ח אֶצְבַּ֖ע וְ/דַבֶּר אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: 'z tqr' vyhvh y'nh tshv' vy'mr hnny 'm tsyr mtvkhkh mvth shlch 'tsb' vdbr 'vn
verses.translation: Then shalt thou call, and the LORD shall answer; thou shalt cry, and he shall say, Here I am . If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking vanity;

verses.translit: vtpq lr'b npshkh vnpsh n'nh tshby' vzrch bchshkh 'vrkh v'pltkh khtshrym
verses.translation: And if thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light rise in obscurity, and thy darkness be as the noonday:

verses.original: וְ/נָחֲ/ךָ֣ יְהוָה֮ תָּמִיד֒ וְ/הִשְׂבִּ֤יעַ בְּ/צַחְצָחוֹת֙ נַפְשֶׁ֔/ךָ וְ/עַצְמֹתֶ֖י/ךָ יַחֲלִ֑יץ וְ/הָיִ֨יתָ֙ כְּ/גַ֣ן רָוֶ֔ה וּ/כְ/מוֹצָ֣א מַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא יְכַזְּב֖וּ מֵימָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vnchkh yhvh tmyd vhshby' btschtschvt npshkh v'tsmtykh ychlyts vhyyt khgn rvh vkhmvts' mym 'shr l' ykhzbv mymyv
verses.translation: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.

verses.original: וּ/בָנ֤וּ מִמְּ/ךָ֙ חָרְב֣וֹת עוֹלָ֔ם מוֹסְדֵ֥י דוֹר וָ/ד֖וֹר תְּקוֹמֵ֑ם וְ/קֹרָ֤א לְ/ךָ֙ גֹּדֵ֣ר פֶּ֔רֶץ מְשֹׁבֵ֥ב נְתִיב֖וֹת לָ/שָֽׁבֶת
verses.translit: vbnv mmkh chrbvt 'vlm mvsdy dvr vdvr tqvmm vqr' lkh gdr prts mshbb ntybvt lshbt
verses.translation: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.

verses.original: אִם תָּשִׁ֤יב מִ/שַּׁבָּת֙ רַגְלֶ֔/ךָ עֲשׂ֥וֹת חֲפָצֶ֖י/ךָ בְּ/י֣וֹם קָדְשִׁ֑/י וְ/קָרָ֨אתָ לַ/שַּׁבָּ֜ת עֹ֗נֶג לִ/קְד֤וֹשׁ יְהוָה֙ מְכֻבָּ֔ד וְ/כִבַּדְתּ/וֹ֙ מֵ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת דְּרָכֶ֔י/ךָ מִ/מְּצ֥וֹא חֶפְצְ/ךָ֖ וְ/דַבֵּ֥ר דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: 'm tshyb mshbt rglkh 'shvt chptsykh byvm qdshy vqr't lshbt 'ng lqdvsh yhvh mkhbd vkhbdtv m'shvt drkhykh mmtsv' chptskh vdbr dbr
verses.translation: If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath, from doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of the LORD , honourable; and shalt honour him, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking thine own words:

verses.original: אָ֗ז תִּתְעַנַּג֙ עַל יְהוָ֔ה וְ/הִרְכַּבְתִּ֖י/ךָ עַל בָּ֣מֳותֵי אָ֑רֶץ וְ/הַאֲכַלְתִּ֗י/ךָ נַחֲלַת֙ יַעֲקֹ֣ב אָבִ֔י/ךָ כִּ֛י פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר
verses.translit: 'z tt'ng 'l yhvh vhrkhbtykh 'l bmvty 'rts vh'khltykh nchlt y'qb 'bykh khy py yhvh dbr
verses.translation: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the LORD ; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it .

verses.original: הֵ֛ן לֹֽא קָצְרָ֥ה יַד יְהוָ֖ה מֵֽ/הוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְ/לֹא כָבְדָ֥ה אָזְנ֖/וֹ מִ/שְּׁמֽוֹעַ
verses.translit: hn l' qtsrh yd yhvh mhvshy' vl' khbdh 'znv mshmv'
verses.translation: Behold, the LORD’s hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִם עֲוֺנֹֽתֵי/כֶם֙ הָי֣וּ מַבְדִּלִ֔ים בֵּינֵ/כֶ֕ם לְ/בֵ֖ין אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/חַטֹּֽאותֵי/כֶ֗ם הִסְתִּ֧ירוּ פָנִ֛ים מִ/כֶּ֖ם מִ/שְּׁמֽוֹעַ
verses.translit: khy 'm 'vntykhm hyv mbdlym bynkhm lbyn 'lhykhm vcht'vtykhm hstyrv pnym mkhm mshmv'
verses.translation: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.

verses.original: כִּ֤י כַפֵּי/כֶם֙ נְגֹאֲל֣וּ בַ/דָּ֔ם וְ/אֶצְבְּעוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם בֶּֽ/עָוֺ֑ן שִׂפְתֽוֹתֵי/כֶם֙ דִּבְּרוּ שֶׁ֔קֶר לְשׁוֹנְ/כֶ֖ם עַוְלָ֥ה תֶהְגֶּֽה
verses.translit: khy khpykhm ng'lv bdm v'tsb'vtykhm b'vn shptvtykhm dbrv shqr lshvnkhm 'vlh thgh
verses.translation: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.

verses.original: אֵין קֹרֵ֣א בְ/צֶ֔דֶק וְ/אֵ֥ין נִשְׁפָּ֖ט בֶּ/אֱמוּנָ֑ה בָּט֤וֹחַ עַל תֹּ֨הוּ֙ וְ/דַבֶּר שָׁ֔וְא הָר֥וֹ עָמָ֖ל וְ/הוֹלֵ֥יד אָֽוֶן
verses.translit: 'yn qr' btsdq v'yn nshpt b'mvnh btvch 'l thv vdbr shv' hrv 'ml vhvlyd 'vn
verses.translation: None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.

verses.original: בֵּיצֵ֤י צִפְעוֹנִי֙ בִּקֵּ֔עוּ וְ/קוּרֵ֥י עַכָּבִ֖ישׁ יֶאֱרֹ֑גוּ הָ/אֹכֵ֤ל מִ/בֵּֽיצֵי/הֶם֙ יָמ֔וּת וְ/הַ/זּוּרֶ֖ה תִּבָּקַ֥ע אֶפְעֶֽה
verses.translit: bytsy tsp'vny bq'v vqvry 'khbysh y'rgv h'khl mbytsyhm ymvt vhzvrh tbq' 'p'h
verses.translation: They hatch cockatrice’ eggs, and weave the spider’s web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.

verses.original: קֽוּרֵי/הֶם֙ לֹא יִהְי֣וּ לְ/בֶ֔גֶד וְ/לֹ֥א יִתְכַּסּ֖וּ בְּ/מַֽעֲשֵׂי/הֶ֑ם מַֽעֲשֵׂי/הֶם֙ מַֽעֲשֵׂי אָ֔וֶן וּ/פֹ֥עַל חָמָ֖ס בְּ/כַפֵּי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: qvryhm l' yhyv lbgd vl' ytkhsv bm'shyhm m'shyhm m'shy 'vn vp'l chms bkhpyhm
verses.translation: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.

verses.original: רַגְלֵי/הֶם֙ לָ/רַ֣ע יָרֻ֔צוּ וִֽ/ימַהֲר֔וּ לִ/שְׁפֹּ֖ךְ דָּ֣ם נָקִ֑י מַחְשְׁבֽוֹתֵי/הֶם֙ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת אָ֔וֶן שֹׁ֥ד וָ/שֶׁ֖בֶר בִּ/מְסִלּוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: rglyhm lr' yrtsv vymhrv lshpkh dm nqy mchshbvtyhm mchshbvt 'vn shd vshbr bmslvtm
verses.translation: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction are in their paths.

verses.original: דֶּ֤רֶךְ שָׁלוֹם֙ לֹ֣א יָדָ֔עוּ וְ/אֵ֥ין מִשְׁפָּ֖ט בְּ/מַעְגְּלוֹתָ֑/ם נְתִיבֽוֹתֵי/הֶם֙ עִקְּשׁ֣וּ לָ/הֶ֔ם כֹּ֚ל דֹּרֵ֣ךְ בָּ֔/הּ לֹ֥א יָדַ֖ע שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: drkh shlvm l' yd'v v'yn mshpt bm'glvtm ntybvtyhm 'qshv lhm khl drkh bh l' yd' shlvm
verses.translation: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֗ן רָחַ֤ק מִשְׁפָּט֙ מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ וְ/לֹ֥א תַשִּׂיגֵ֖/נוּ צְדָקָ֑ה נְקַוֶּ֤ה לָ/אוֹר֙ וְ/הִנֵּה חֹ֔שֶׁךְ לִ/נְגֹה֖וֹת בָּ/אֲפֵל֥וֹת נְהַלֵּֽךְ
verses.translit: 'l khn rchq mshpt mmnv vl' tshygnv tsdqh nqvh l'vr vhnh chshkh lnghvt b'plvt nhlkh
verses.translation: Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.

verses.original: נְגַֽשְׁשָׁ֤ה כַֽ/עִוְרִים֙ קִ֔יר וּ/כְ/אֵ֥ין עֵינַ֖יִם נְגַשֵּׁ֑שָׁה כָּשַׁ֤לְנוּ בַֽ/צָּהֳרַ֨יִם֙ כַּ/נֶּ֔שֶׁף בָּ/אַשְׁמַנִּ֖ים כַּ/מֵּתִֽים
verses.translit: ngshshh kh'vrym qyr vkh'yn 'ynym ngshshh khshlnv btshrym khnshf b'shmnym khmtym
verses.translation: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men .

verses.original: נֶהֱמֶ֤ה כַ/דֻּבִּים֙ כֻּלָּ֔/נוּ וְ/כַ/יּוֹנִ֖ים הָגֹ֣ה נֶהְגֶּ֑ה נְקַוֶּ֤ה לַ/מִּשְׁפָּט֙ וָ/אַ֔יִן לִֽ/ישׁוּעָ֖ה רָחֲקָ֥ה מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: nhmh khdbym khlnv vkhyvnym hgh nhgh nqvh lmshpt v'yn lyshv'h rchqh mmnv
verses.translation: We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.

verses.original: כִּֽי רַבּ֤וּ פְשָׁעֵ֨י/נוּ֙ נֶגְדֶּ֔/ךָ וְ/חַטֹּאותֵ֖י/נוּ עָ֣נְתָה בָּ֑/נוּ כִּֽי פְשָׁעֵ֣י/נוּ אִתָּ֔/נוּ וַ/עֲוֺנֹתֵ֖י/נוּ יְדַֽעֲנֽוּ/ם
verses.translit: khy rbv psh'ynv ngdkh vcht'vtynv 'nth bnv khy psh'ynv 'tnv v'vntynv yd'nvm
verses.translation: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions are with us; and as for our iniquities, we know them;

verses.original: פָּשֹׁ֤עַ וְ/כַחֵשׁ֙ בַּֽ/יהוָ֔ה וְ/נָס֖וֹג מֵ/אַחַ֣ר אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ דַּבֶּר עֹ֣שֶׁק וְ/סָרָ֔ה הֹר֧וֹ וְ/הֹג֛וֹ מִ/לֵּ֖ב דִּבְרֵי שָֽׁקֶר
verses.translit: psh' vkhchsh byhvh vnsvg m'chr 'lhynv dbr 'shq vsrh hrv vhgv mlb dbry shqr
verses.translation: In transgressing and lying against the LORD , and departing away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.

verses.original: וְ/הֻסַּ֤ג אָחוֹר֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וּ/צְדָקָ֖ה מֵ/רָח֣וֹק תַּעֲמֹ֑ד כִּֽי כָשְׁלָ֤ה בָֽ/רְחוֹב֙ אֱמֶ֔ת וּ/נְכֹחָ֖ה לֹא תוּכַ֥ל לָ/בֽוֹא
verses.translit: vhsg 'chvr mshpt vtsdqh mrchvq t'md khy khshlh brchvb 'mt vnkhchh l' tvkhl lbv'
verses.translation: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִ֤י הָֽ/אֱמֶת֙ נֶעְדֶּ֔רֶת וְ/סָ֥ר מֵ/רָ֖ע מִשְׁתּוֹלֵ֑ל וַ/יַּ֧רְא יְהוָ֛ה וַ/יֵּ֥רַע בְּ/עֵינָ֖י/ו כִּֽי אֵ֥ין מִשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: vthy h'mt n'drt vsr mr' mshtvll vyr' yhvh vyr' b'ynyv khy 'yn mshpt
verses.translation: Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: and the LORD saw it , and it displeased him that there was no judgment.

verses.original: וַ/יַּרְא֙ כִּֽי אֵ֣ין אִ֔ישׁ וַ/יִּשְׁתּוֹמֵ֖ם כִּ֣י אֵ֣ין מַפְגִּ֑יעַ וַ/תּ֤וֹשַֽׁע ל/וֹ֙ זְרֹע֔/וֹ וְ/צִדְקָת֖/וֹ הִ֥יא סְמָכָֽתְ/הוּ
verses.translit: vyr' khy 'yn 'ysh vyshtvmm khy 'yn mpgy' vtvsh' lv zr'v vtsdqtv hy' smkhthv
verses.translation: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּלְבַּ֤שׁ צְדָקָה֙ כַּ/שִּׁרְיָ֔ן וְ/כ֥וֹבַע יְשׁוּעָ֖ה בְּ/רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ וַ/יִּלְבַּ֞שׁ בִּגְדֵ֤י נָקָם֙ תִּלְבֹּ֔שֶׁת וַ/יַּ֥עַט כַּ/מְעִ֖יל קִנְאָֽה
verses.translit: vylbsh tsdqh khshryn vkhvb' yshv'h br'shv vylbsh bgdy nqm tlbsht vy't khm'yl qn'h
verses.translation: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloke.

verses.original: כְּ/עַ֤ל גְּמֻלוֹת֙ כְּ/עַ֣ל יְשַׁלֵּ֔ם חֵמָ֣ה לְ/צָרָ֔י/ו גְּמ֖וּל לְ/אֹֽיְבָ֑י/ו לָ/אִיִּ֖ים גְּמ֥וּל יְשַׁלֵּֽם
verses.translit: kh'l gmlvt kh'l yshlm chmh ltsryv gmvl l'ybyv l'yym gmvl yshlm
verses.translation: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.

verses.original: וְ/יִֽירְא֤וּ מִֽ/מַּעֲרָב֙ אֶת שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה וּ/מִ/מִּזְרַח שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ אֶת כְּבוֹד֑/וֹ כִּֽי יָב֤וֹא כַ/נָּהָר֙ צָ֔ר ר֥וּחַ יְהוָ֖ה נֹ֥סְסָה בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyyr'v mm'rb 't shm yhvh vmmzrch shmsh 't khbvdv khy ybv' khnhr tsr rvch yhvh nssh bv
verses.translation: So shall they fear the name of the LORD from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD shall lift up a standard against him.

verses.original: וּ/בָ֤א לְ/צִיּוֹן֙ גּוֹאֵ֔ל וּ/לְ/שָׁבֵ֥י פֶ֖שַׁע בְּ/יַֽעֲקֹ֑ב נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vb' ltsyvn gv'l vlshby psh' by'qb n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֗י זֹ֣את בְּרִיתִ֤/י אוֹתָ/ם֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה רוּחִ/י֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלֶ֔י/ךָ וּ/דְבָרַ֖/י אֲשֶׁר שַׂ֣מְתִּי בְּ/פִ֑י/ךָ לֹֽא יָמ֡וּשׁוּ מִ/פִּי/ךָ֩ וּ/מִ/פִּ֨י זַרְעֲ/ךָ֜ וּ/מִ/פִּ֨י זֶ֤רַע זַרְעֲ/ךָ֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה מֵ/עַתָּ֖ה וְ/עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: v'ny z't bryty 'vtm 'mr yhvh rvchy 'shr 'lykh vdbry 'shr shmty bpykh l' ymvshv mpykh vmpy zr'kh vmpy zr' zr'kh 'mr yhvh m'th v'd 'vlm
verses.translation: As for me, this is my covenant with them, saith the LORD ; My spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed’s seed, saith the LORD , from henceforth and for ever.

verses.original: ק֥וּמִי א֖וֹרִי כִּ֣י בָ֣א אוֹרֵ֑/ךְ וּ/כְב֥וֹד יְהוָ֖ה עָלַ֥יִ/ךְ זָרָֽח
verses.translit: qvmy 'vry khy b' 'vrkh vkhbvd yhvh 'lykh zrch
verses.translation: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.

verses.original: כִּֽי הִנֵּ֤ה הַ/חֹ֨שֶׁךְ֙ יְכַסֶּה אֶ֔רֶץ וַ/עֲרָפֶ֖ל לְאֻמִּ֑ים וְ/עָלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ יִזְרַ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה וּ/כְבוֹד֖/וֹ עָלַ֥יִ/ךְ יֵרָאֶֽה
verses.translit: khy hnh hchshkh ykhsh 'rts v'rpl l'mym v'lykh yzrch yhvh vkhbvdv 'lykh yr'h
verses.translation: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the LORD shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.

verses.original: וְ/הָלְכ֥וּ גוֹיִ֖ם לְ/אוֹרֵ֑/ךְ וּ/מְלָכִ֖ים לְ/נֹ֥גַהּ זַרְחֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vhlkhv gvym l'vrkh vmlkhym lngh zrchkh
verses.translation: And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.

verses.original: שְׂאִֽי סָבִ֤יב עֵינַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ וּ/רְאִ֔י כֻּלָּ֖/ם נִקְבְּצ֣וּ בָֽאוּ לָ֑/ךְ בָּנַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ מֵ/רָח֣וֹק יָבֹ֔אוּ וּ/בְנֹתַ֖יִ/ךְ עַל צַ֥ד תֵּאָמַֽנָה
verses.translit: sh'y sbyb 'ynykh vr'y khlm nqbtsv b'v lkh bnykh mrchvq yb'v vbntykh 'l tsd t'mnh
verses.translation: Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to thee: thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be nursed at thy side.

verses.original: אָ֤ז תִּרְאִי֙ וְ/נָהַ֔רְתְּ וּ/פָחַ֥ד וְ/רָחַ֖ב לְבָבֵ֑/ךְ כִּֽי יֵהָפֵ֤ךְ עָלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ הֲמ֣וֹן יָ֔ם חֵ֥יל גּוֹיִ֖ם יָבֹ֥אוּ לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'z tr'y vnhrt vpchd vrchb lbbkh khy yhpkh 'lykh hmvn ym chyl gvym yb'v lkh
verses.translation: Then thou shalt see, and flow together, and thine heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee.

verses.original: שִֽׁפְעַ֨ת גְּמַלִּ֜ים תְּכַסֵּ֗/ךְ בִּכְרֵ֤י מִדְיָן֙ וְ/עֵיפָ֔ה כֻּלָּ֖/ם מִ/שְּׁבָ֣א יָבֹ֑אוּ זָהָ֤ב וּ/לְבוֹנָה֙ יִשָּׂ֔אוּ וּ/תְהִלֹּ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה יְבַשֵּֽׂרוּ
verses.translit: shp't gmlym tkhskh bkhry mdyn v'yph khlm mshb' yb'v zhb vlbvnh ysh'v vthlt yhvh ybshrv
verses.translation: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of the LORD .

verses.original: כָּל צֹ֤אן קֵדָר֙ יִקָּ֣בְצוּ לָ֔/ךְ אֵילֵ֥י נְבָי֖וֹת יְשָׁרְת֑וּ/נֶךְ יַעֲל֤וּ עַל רָצוֹן֙ מִזְבְּחִ֔/י וּ/בֵ֥ית תִּפְאַרְתִּ֖/י אֲפָאֵֽר
verses.translit: khl ts'n qdr yqbtsv lkh 'yly nbyvt yshrtvnkh y'lv 'l rtsvn mzbchy vbyt tp'rty 'p'r
verses.translation: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee: they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.

verses.original: מִי אֵ֖לֶּה כָּ/עָ֣ב תְּעוּפֶ֑ינָה וְ/כַ/יּוֹנִ֖ים אֶל אֲרֻבֹּתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: my 'lh kh'b t'vpynh vkhyvnym 'l 'rbtyhm
verses.translation: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?

verses.original: כִּֽי לִ֣/י אִיִּ֣ים יְקַוּ֗וּ וָ/אֳנִיּ֤וֹת תַּרְשִׁישׁ֙ בָּ/רִ֣אשֹׁנָ֔ה לְ/הָבִ֤יא בָנַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ מֵֽ/רָח֔וֹק כַּסְפָּ֥/ם וּ/זְהָבָ֖/ם אִתָּ֑/ם לְ/שֵׁם֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֔יִ/ךְ וְ/לִ/קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כִּ֥י פֵאֲרָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khy ly 'yym yqvv v'nyvt trshysh br'shnh lhby' bnykh mrchvq khspm vzhbm 'tm lshm yhvh 'lhykh vlqdvsh yshr'l khy p'rkh
verses.translation: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, unto the name of the LORD thy God, and to the Holy One of Israel, because he hath glorified thee.

verses.original: וּ/בָנ֤וּ בְנֵֽי נֵכָר֙ חֹמֹתַ֔יִ/ךְ וּ/מַלְכֵי/הֶ֖ם יְשָׁרְת֑וּ/נֶךְ כִּ֤י בְ/קִצְפִּ/י֙ הִכִּיתִ֔י/ךְ וּ/בִ/רְצוֹנִ֖/י רִֽחַמְתִּֽי/ךְ
verses.translit: vbnv bny nkhr chmtykh vmlkhyhm yshrtvnkh khy bqtspy hkhytykh vbrtsvny rchmtykh
verses.translation: And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.

verses.original: וּ/פִתְּח֨וּ שְׁעָרַ֧יִ/ךְ תָּמִ֛יד יוֹמָ֥ם וָ/לַ֖יְלָה לֹ֣א יִסָּגֵ֑רוּ לְ/הָבִ֤יא אֵלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ חֵ֣יל גּוֹיִ֔ם וּ/מַלְכֵי/הֶ֖ם נְהוּגִֽים
verses.translit: vptchv sh'rykh tmyd yvmm vlylh l' ysgrv lhby' 'lykh chyl gvym vmlkhyhm nhvgym
verses.translation: Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.

verses.original: כִּֽי הַ/גּ֧וֹי וְ/הַ/מַּמְלָכָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא יַעַבְד֖וּ/ךְ יֹאבֵ֑דוּ וְ/הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם חָרֹ֥ב יֶחֱרָֽבוּ
verses.translit: khy hgvy vhmmlkhh 'shr l' y'bdvkh y'bdv vhgvym chrb ychrbv
verses.translation: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.

verses.original: כְּב֤וֹד הַ/לְּבָנוֹן֙ אֵלַ֣יִ/ךְ יָב֔וֹא בְּר֛וֹשׁ תִּדְהָ֥ר וּ/תְאַשּׁ֖וּר יַחְדָּ֑ו לְ/פָאֵר֙ מְק֣וֹם מִקְדָּשִׁ֔/י וּ/מְק֥וֹם רַגְלַ֖/י אֲכַבֵּֽד
verses.translit: khbvd hlbnvn 'lykh ybv' brvsh tdhr vt'shvr ychdv lp'r mqvm mqdshy vmqvm rgly 'khbd
verses.translation: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.

verses.original: וְ/הָלְכ֨וּ אֵלַ֤יִ/ךְ שְׁח֨וֹחַ֙ בְּנֵ֣י מְעַנַּ֔יִ/ךְ וְ/הִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֛וּ עַל כַּפּ֥וֹת רַגְלַ֖יִ/ךְ כָּל מְנַֽאֲצָ֑יִ/ךְ וְ/קָ֤רְאוּ לָ/ךְ֙ עִ֣יר יְהוָ֔ה צִיּ֖וֹן קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vhlkhv 'lykh shchvch bny m'nykh vhshtchvv 'l khpvt rglykh khl mn'tsykh vqr'v lkh 'yr yhvh tsyvn qdvsh yshr'l
verses.translation: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of the LORD , The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

verses.original: תַּ֧חַת הֱיוֹתֵ֛/ךְ עֲזוּבָ֥ה וּ/שְׂנוּאָ֖ה וְ/אֵ֣ין עוֹבֵ֑ר וְ/שַׂמְתִּי/ךְ֙ לִ/גְא֣וֹן עוֹלָ֔ם מְשׂ֖וֹשׂ דּ֥וֹר וָ/דֽוֹר
verses.translit: tcht hyvtkh 'zvbh vshnv'h v'yn 'vbr vshmtykh lg'vn 'vlm mshvsh dvr vdvr
verses.translation: Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through thee , I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.

verses.original: וְ/יָנַקְתְּ֙ חֲלֵ֣ב גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ/שֹׁ֥ד מְלָכִ֖ים תִּינָ֑קִי וְ/יָדַ֗עַתְּ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ מֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֔/ךְ וְ/גֹאֲלֵ֖/ךְ אֲבִ֥יר יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: vynqt chlb gvym vshd mlkhym tynqy vyd't khy 'ny yhvh mvshy'kh vg'lkh 'byr y'qb
verses.translation: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shalt suck the breast of kings: and thou shalt know that I the LORD am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.

verses.original: תַּ֣חַת הַ/נְּחֹ֜שֶׁת אָבִ֣יא זָהָ֗ב וְ/תַ֤חַת הַ/בַּרְזֶל֙ אָ֣בִיא כֶ֔סֶף וְ/תַ֤חַת הָֽ/עֵצִים֙ נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וְ/תַ֥חַת הָ/אֲבָנִ֖ים בַּרְזֶ֑ל וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֤י פְקֻדָּתֵ/ךְ֙ שָׁל֔וֹם וְ/נֹגְשַׂ֖יִ/ךְ צְדָקָֽה
verses.translit: tcht hnchsht 'by' zhb vtcht hbrzl 'by' khsf vtcht h'tsym nchsht vtcht h'bnym brzl vshmty pqdtkh shlvm vngshykh tsdqh
verses.translation: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make thy officers peace, and thine exactors righteousness.

verses.original: לֹא יִשָּׁמַ֨ע ע֤וֹד חָמָס֙ בְּ/אַרְצֵ֔/ךְ שֹׁ֥ד וָ/שֶׁ֖בֶר בִּ/גְבוּלָ֑יִ/ךְ וְ/קָרָ֤את יְשׁוּעָה֙ חוֹמֹתַ֔יִ/ךְ וּ/שְׁעָרַ֖יִ/ךְ תְּהִלָּֽה
verses.translit: l' yshm' 'vd chms b'rtskh shd vshbr bgbvlykh vqr't yshv'h chvmtykh vsh'rykh thlh
verses.translation: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.

verses.original: לֹא יִֽהְיֶה לָּ֨/ךְ ע֤וֹד הַ/שֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ לְ/א֣וֹר יוֹמָ֔ם וּ/לְ/נֹ֕גַהּ הַ/יָּרֵ֖חַ לֹא יָאִ֣יר לָ֑/ךְ וְ/הָיָה לָ֤/ךְ יְהוָה֙ לְ/א֣וֹר עוֹלָ֔ם וֵ/אלֹהַ֖יִ/ךְ לְ/תִפְאַרְתֵּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: l' yhyh lkh 'vd hshmsh l'vr yvmm vlngh hyrch l' y'yr lkh vhyh lkh yhvh l'vr 'vlm v'lhykh ltp'rtkh
verses.translation: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but the LORD shall be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.

verses.original: לֹא יָב֥וֹא עוֹד֙ שִׁמְשֵׁ֔/ךְ וִ/ירֵחֵ֖/ךְ לֹ֣א יֵאָסֵ֑ף כִּ֣י יְהוָ֗ה יִֽהְיֶה לָּ/ךְ֙ לְ/א֣וֹר עוֹלָ֔ם וְ/שָׁלְמ֖וּ יְמֵ֥י אֶבְלֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: l' ybv' 'vd shmshkh vyrchkh l' y'sf khy yhvh yhyh lkh l'vr 'vlm vshlmv ymy 'blkh
verses.translation: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the LORD shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.

verses.original: וְ/עַמֵּ/ךְ֙ כֻּלָּ֣/ם צַדִּיקִ֔ים לְ/עוֹלָ֖ם יִ֣ירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ נֵ֧צֶר מטע/ו מַטָּעַ֛/י מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדַ֖/י לְ/הִתְפָּאֵֽר
verses.translit: v'mkh khlm tsdyqym l'vlm yyrshv 'rts ntsr mt'v mt'y m'shh ydy lhtp'r
verses.translation: Thy people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.

verses.original: הַ/קָּטֹן֙ יִֽהְיֶ֣ה לָ/אֶ֔לֶף וְ/הַ/צָּעִ֖יר לְ/ג֣וֹי עָצ֑וּם אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/עִתָּ֥/הּ אֲחִישֶֽׁ/נָּה
verses.translit: hqtn yhyh l'lf vhts'yr lgvy 'tsvm 'ny yhvh b'th 'chyshnh
verses.translation: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the LORD will hasten it in his time.

verses.original: ר֛וּחַ אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִ֖ה עָלָ֑/י יַ֡עַן מָשַׁח֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֹתִ֜/י לְ/בַשֵּׂ֣ר עֲנָוִ֗ים שְׁלָחַ֨/נִי֙ לַ/חֲבֹ֣שׁ לְ/נִשְׁבְּרֵי לֵ֔ב לִ/קְרֹ֤א לִ/שְׁבוּיִם֙ דְּר֔וֹר וְ/לַ/אֲסוּרִ֖ים פְּקַח קֽוֹחַ
verses.translit: rvch 'dny yhvh 'ly y'n mshch yhvh 'ty lbshr 'nvym shlchny lchbsh lnshbry lb lqr' lshbvym drvr vl'svrym pqch qvch
verses.translation: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;

verses.original: לִ/קְרֹ֤א שְׁנַת רָצוֹן֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה וְ/י֥וֹם נָקָ֖ם לֵ/אלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ לְ/נַחֵ֖ם כָּל אֲבֵלִֽים
verses.translit: lqr' shnt rtsvn lyhvh vyvm nqm l'lhynv lnchm khl 'blym
verses.translation: To proclaim the acceptable year of the LORD , and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;

verses.original: לָ/שׂ֣וּם לַ/אֲבֵלֵ֣י צִיּ֗וֹן לָ/תֵת֩ לָ/הֶ֨ם פְּאֵ֜ר תַּ֣חַת אֵ֗פֶר שֶׁ֤מֶן שָׂשׂוֹן֙ תַּ֣חַת אֵ֔בֶל מַעֲטֵ֣ה תְהִלָּ֔ה תַּ֖חַת ר֣וּחַ כֵּהָ֑ה וְ/קֹרָ֤א לָ/הֶם֙ אֵילֵ֣י הַ/צֶּ֔דֶק מַטַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה לְ/הִתְפָּאֵֽר
verses.translit: lshvm l'bly tsyvn ltt lhm p'r tcht 'pr shmn shshvn tcht 'bl m'th thlh tcht rvch khhh vqr' lhm 'yly htsdq mt' yhvh lhtp'r
verses.translation: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD , that he might be glorified.

verses.original: וּ/בָנוּ֙ חָרְב֣וֹת עוֹלָ֔ם שֹׁמְמ֥וֹת רִֽאשֹׁנִ֖ים יְקוֹמֵ֑מוּ וְ/חִדְּשׁוּ֙ עָ֣רֵי חֹ֔רֶב שֹׁמְמ֖וֹת דּ֥וֹר וָ/דֽוֹר
verses.translit: vbnv chrbvt 'vlm shmmvt r'shnym yqvmmv vchdshv 'ry chrb shmmvt dvr vdvr
verses.translation: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.

verses.original: וְ/עָמְד֣וּ זָרִ֔ים וְ/רָע֖וּ צֹאנְ/כֶ֑ם וּ/בְנֵ֣י נֵכָ֔ר אִכָּרֵי/כֶ֖ם וְ/כֹרְמֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'mdv zrym vr'v ts'nkhm vbny nkhr 'khrykhm vkhrmykhm
verses.translation: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּ֗ם כֹּהֲנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ תִּקָּרֵ֔אוּ מְשָׁרְתֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ יֵאָמֵ֖ר לָ/כֶ֑ם חֵ֤יל גּוֹיִם֙ תֹּאכֵ֔לוּ וּ/בִ/כְבוֹדָ֖/ם תִּתְיַמָּֽרוּ
verses.translit: v'tm khhny yhvh tqr'v mshrty 'lhynv y'mr lkhm chyl gvym t'khlv vbkhbvdm ttymrv
verses.translation: But ye shall be named the Priests of the LORD : men shall call you the Ministers of our God: ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.

verses.original: תַּ֤חַת בָּשְׁתְּ/כֶם֙ מִשְׁנֶ֔ה וּ/כְלִמָּ֖ה יָרֹ֣נּוּ חֶלְקָ֑/ם לָ/כֵ֤ן בְּ/אַרְצָ/ם֙ מִשְׁנֶ֣ה יִירָ֔שׁוּ שִׂמְחַ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם תִּֽהְיֶ֥ה לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: tcht bshtkhm mshnh vkhlmh yrnv chlqm lkhn b'rtsm mshnh yyrshv shmcht 'vlm thyh lhm
verses.translation: For your shame ye shall have double; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֹהֵ֣ב מִשְׁפָּ֔ט שֹׂנֵ֥א גָזֵ֖ל בְּ/עוֹלָ֑ה וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י פְעֻלָּתָ/ם֙ בֶּ/אֱמֶ֔ת וּ/בְרִ֥ית עוֹלָ֖ם אֶכְר֥וֹת לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khy 'ny yhvh 'hb mshpt shn' gzl b'vlh vntty p'ltm b'mt vbryt 'vlm 'khrvt lhm
verses.translation: For I the LORD love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.

verses.original: וְ/נוֹדַ֤ע בַּ/גּוֹיִם֙ זַרְעָ֔/ם וְ/צֶאֱצָאֵי/הֶ֖ם בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הָ/עַמִּ֑ים כָּל רֹֽאֵי/הֶם֙ יַכִּיר֔וּ/ם כִּ֛י הֵ֥ם זֶ֖רַע בֵּרַ֥ךְ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vnvd' bgvym zr'm vts'ts'yhm btvkh h'mym khl r'yhm ykhyrvm khy hm zr' brkh yhvh
verses.translation: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which the LORD hath blessed.

verses.original: שׂ֧וֹשׂ אָשִׂ֣ישׂ בַּֽ/יהוָ֗ה תָּגֵ֤ל נַפְשִׁ/י֙ בֵּֽ/אלֹהַ֔/י כִּ֤י הִלְבִּישַׁ֨/נִי֙ בִּגְדֵי יֶ֔שַׁע מְעִ֥יל צְדָקָ֖ה יְעָטָ֑/נִי כֶּֽ/חָתָן֙ יְכַהֵ֣ן פְּאֵ֔ר וְ/כַ/כַּלָּ֖ה תַּעְדֶּ֥ה כֵלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: shvsh 'shysh byhvh tgl npshy b'lhy khy hlbyshny bgdy ysh' m'yl tsdqh y'tny khchtn ykhhn p'r vkhkhlh t'dh khlyh
verses.translation: I will greatly rejoice in the LORD , my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.

verses.original: כִּ֤י כָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ תּוֹצִ֣יא צִמְחָ֔/הּ וּ/כְ/גַנָּ֖ה זֵרוּעֶ֣י/הָ תַצְמִ֑יחַ כֵּ֣ן אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה יַצְמִ֤יחַ צְדָקָה֙ וּ/תְהִלָּ֔ה נֶ֖גֶד כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: khy kh'rts tvtsy' tsmchh vkhgnh zrv'yh ttsmych khn 'dny yhvh ytsmych tsdqh vthlh ngd khl hgvym
verses.translation: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן צִיּוֹן֙ לֹ֣א אֶחֱשֶׁ֔ה וּ/לְמַ֥עַן יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לֹ֣א אֶשְׁק֑וֹט עַד יֵצֵ֤א כַ/נֹּ֨גַהּ֙ צִדְקָ֔/הּ וִ/ישׁוּעָתָ֖/הּ כְּ/לַפִּ֥יד יִבְעָֽר
verses.translit: lm'n tsyvn l' 'chshh vlm'n yrvshlm l' 'shqvt 'd yts' khngh tsdqh vyshv'th khlpyd yb'r
verses.translation: For Zion’s sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burneth.

verses.original: וְ/רָא֤וּ גוֹיִם֙ צִדְקֵ֔/ךְ וְ/כָל מְלָכִ֖ים כְּבוֹדֵ֑/ךְ וְ/קֹ֤רָא לָ/ךְ֙ שֵׁ֣ם חָדָ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁ֛ר פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה יִקֳּבֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: vr'v gvym tsdqkh vkhl mlkhym khbvdkh vqr' lkh shm chdsh 'shr py yhvh yqbnv
verses.translation: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the LORD shall name.

verses.original: וְ/הָיִ֛יתְ עֲטֶ֥רֶת תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת בְּ/יַד יְהוָ֑ה ו/צנוף וּ/צְנִ֥יף מְלוּכָ֖ה בְּ/כַף אֱלֹהָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: vhyyt 'trt tp'rt byd yhvh vtsnvf vtsnyf mlvkhh bkhf 'lhykh
verses.translation: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD , and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.

verses.original: לֹֽא יֵאָמֵר֩ לָ֨/ךְ ע֜וֹד עֲזוּבָ֗ה וּ/לְ/אַרְצֵ/ךְ֙ לֹא יֵאָמֵ֥ר עוֹד֙ שְׁמָמָ֔ה כִּ֣י לָ֗/ךְ יִקָּרֵא֙ חֶפְצִי בָ֔הּ וּ/לְ/אַרְצֵ֖/ךְ בְּעוּלָ֑ה כִּֽי חָפֵ֤ץ יְהוָה֙ בָּ֔/ךְ וְ/אַרְצֵ֖/ךְ תִּבָּעֵֽל
verses.translit: l' y'mr lkh 'vd 'zvbh vl'rtskh l' y'mr 'vd shmmh khy lkh yqr' chptsy bh vl'rtskh b'vlh khy chpts yhvh bkh v'rtskh tb'l
verses.translation: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzi-bah, and thy land Beulah: for the LORD delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.

verses.original: כִּֽי יִבְעַ֤ל בָּחוּר֙ בְּתוּלָ֔ה יִבְעָל֖וּ/ךְ בָּנָ֑יִ/ךְ וּ/מְשׂ֤וֹשׂ חָתָן֙ עַל כַּלָּ֔ה יָשִׂ֥ישׂ עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ אֱלֹהָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: khy yb'l bchvr btvlh yb'lvkh bnykh vmshvsh chtn 'l khlh yshysh 'lykh 'lhykh
verses.translation: For as a young man marrieth a virgin, so shall thy sons marry thee: and as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, so shall thy God rejoice over thee.

verses.original: עַל חוֹמֹתַ֣יִ/ךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם הִפְקַ֨דְתִּי֙ שֹֽׁמְרִ֔ים כָּל הַ/יּ֧וֹם וְ/כָל הַ/לַּ֛יְלָה תָּמִ֖יד לֹ֣א יֶחֱשׁ֑וּ הַ/מַּזְכִּרִים֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה אַל דֳּמִ֖י לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'l chvmtykh yrvshlm hpqdty shmrym khl hyvm vkhl hlylh tmyd l' ychshv hmzkhrym 't yhvh 'l dmy lkhm
verses.translation: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the LORD , keep not silence, remembrancers

verses.original: וְ/אַֽל תִּתְּנ֥וּ דֳמִ֖י ל֑/וֹ עַד יְכוֹנֵ֞ן וְ/עַד יָשִׂ֧ים אֶת יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֛ם תְּהִלָּ֖ה בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: v'l ttnv dmy lv 'd ykhvnn v'd yshym 't yrvshlm thlh b'rts
verses.translation: And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה בִּֽ/ימִינ֖/וֹ וּ/בִ/זְר֣וֹעַ עֻזּ֑/וֹ אִם אֶתֵּן֩ אֶת דְּגָנֵ֨/ךְ ע֤וֹד מַֽאֲכָל֙ לְ/אֹ֣יְבַ֔יִ/ךְ וְ/אִם יִשְׁתּ֤וּ בְנֵֽי נֵכָר֙ תִּֽירוֹשֵׁ֔/ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָגַ֖עַתְּ בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: nshb' yhvh bymynv vbzrv' 'zv 'm 'tn 't dgnkh 'vd m'khl l'ybykh v'm yshtv bny nkhr tyrvshkh 'shr yg't bv
verses.translation: The LORD hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn to be meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:

verses.original: כִּ֤י מְאַסְפָי/ו֙ יֹאכְלֻ֔/הוּ וְ/הִֽלְל֖וּ אֶת יְהוָ֑ה וּֽ/מְקַבְּצָ֥י/ו יִשְׁתֻּ֖/הוּ בְּ/חַצְר֥וֹת קָדְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: khy m'spyv y'khlhv vhllv 't yhvh vmqbtsyv yshthv bchtsrvt qdshy
verses.translation: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise the LORD ; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.

verses.original: עִבְר֤וּ עִבְרוּ֙ בַּ/שְּׁעָרִ֔ים פַּנּ֖וּ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הָ/עָ֑ם סֹ֣לּוּ סֹ֤לּוּ הַֽ/מְסִלָּה֙ סַקְּל֣וּ מֵ/אֶ֔בֶן הָרִ֥ימוּ נֵ֖ס עַל הָ/עַמִּֽים
verses.translit: 'brv 'brv bsh'rym pnv drkh h'm slv slv hmslh sqlv m'bn hrymv ns 'l h'mym
verses.translation: Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה הִשְׁמִ֨יעַ֙ אֶל קְצֵ֣ה הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אִמְרוּ֙ לְ/בַת צִיּ֔וֹן הִנֵּ֥ה יִשְׁעֵ֖/ךְ בָּ֑א הִנֵּ֤ה שְׂכָר/וֹ֙ אִתּ֔/וֹ וּ/פְעֻלָּת֖/וֹ לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: hnh yhvh hshmy' 'l qtsh h'rts 'mrv lbt tsyvn hnh ysh'kh b' hnh shkhrv 'tv vp'ltv lpnyv
verses.translation: Behold, the LORD hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.

verses.original: וְ/קָרְא֥וּ לָ/הֶ֛ם עַם הַ/קֹּ֖דֶשׁ גְּאוּלֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/לָ/ךְ֙ יִקָּרֵ֣א דְרוּשָׁ֔ה עִ֖יר לֹ֥א נֶעֱזָֽבָה
verses.translit: vqr'v lhm 'm hqdsh g'vly yhvh vlkh yqr' drvshh 'yr l' n'zbh
verses.translation: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of the LORD : and thou shalt be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.

verses.original: מִי זֶ֣ה בָּ֣א מֵ/אֱד֗וֹם חֲמ֤וּץ בְּגָדִים֙ מִ/בָּצְרָ֔ה זֶ֚ה הָד֣וּר בִּ/לְבוּשׁ֔/וֹ צֹעֶ֖ה בְּ/רֹ֣ב כֹּח֑/וֹ אֲנִ֛י מְדַבֵּ֥ר בִּ/צְדָקָ֖ה רַ֥ב לְ/הוֹשִֽׁיעַ
verses.translit: my zh b' m'dvm chmvts bgdym mbtsrh zh hdvr blbvshv ts'h brb khchv 'ny mdbr btsdqh rb lhvshy'
verses.translation: Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.

verses.original: מַדּ֥וּעַ אָדֹ֖ם לִ/לְבוּשֶׁ֑/ךָ וּ/בְגָדֶ֖י/ךָ כְּ/דֹרֵ֥ךְ בְּ/גַֽת
verses.translit: mdv' 'dm llbvshkh vbgdykh khdrkh bgt
verses.translation: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?

verses.original: פּוּרָ֣ה דָּרַ֣כְתִּי לְ/בַדִּ֗/י וּ/מֵֽ/עַמִּים֙ אֵֽין אִ֣ישׁ אִתִּ֔/י וְ/אֶדְרְכֵ֣/ם בְּ/אַפִּ֔/י וְ/אֶרְמְסֵ֖/ם בַּ/חֲמָתִ֑/י וְ/יֵ֤ז נִצְחָ/ם֙ עַל בְּגָדַ֔/י וְ/כָל מַלְבּוּשַׁ֖/י אֶגְאָֽלְתִּי
verses.translit: pvrh drkhty lbdy vm'mym 'yn 'ysh 'ty v'drkhm b'py v'rmsm bchmty vyz ntschm 'l bgdy vkhl mlbvshy 'g'lty
verses.translation: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.

verses.original: כִּ֛י י֥וֹם נָקָ֖ם בְּ/לִבִּ֑/י וּ/שְׁנַ֥ת גְּאוּלַ֖/י בָּֽאָה
verses.translit: khy yvm nqm blby vshnt g'vly b'h
verses.translation: For the day of vengeance is in mine heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.

verses.original: וְ/אַבִּיט֙ וְ/אֵ֣ין עֹזֵ֔ר וְ/אֶשְׁתּוֹמֵ֖ם וְ/אֵ֣ין סוֹמֵ֑ךְ וַ/תּ֤וֹשַֽׁע לִ/י֙ זְרֹעִ֔/י וַ/חֲמָתִ֖/י הִ֥יא סְמָכָֽתְ/נִי
verses.translit: v'byt v'yn 'zr v'shtvmm v'yn svmkh vtvsh' ly zr'y vchmty hy' smkhtny
verses.translation: And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.

verses.original: וְ/אָב֤וּס עַמִּים֙ בְּ/אַפִּ֔/י וַ/אֲשַׁכְּרֵ֖/ם בַּ/חֲמָתִ֑/י וְ/אוֹרִ֥יד לָ/אָ֖רֶץ נִצְחָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'bvs 'mym b'py v'shkhrm bchmty v'vryd l'rts ntschm
verses.translation: And I will tread down the people in mine anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.

verses.original: חַֽסְדֵ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אַזְכִּיר֙ תְּהִלֹּ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה כְּ/עַ֕ל כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר גְּמָלָ֖/נוּ יְהוָ֑ה וְ/רַב טוּב֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר גְּמָלָ֥/ם כְּֽ/רַחֲמָ֖י/ו וּ/כְ/רֹ֥ב חֲסָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: chsdy yhvh 'zkhyr thlt yhvh kh'l khl 'shr gmlnv yhvh vrb tvb lbyt yshr'l 'shr gmlm khrchmyv vkhrb chsdyv
verses.translation: I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the LORD , and the praises of the LORD , according to all that the LORD hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אַךְ עַמִּ֣/י הֵ֔מָּה בָּנִ֖ים לֹ֣א יְשַׁקֵּ֑רוּ וַ/יְהִ֥י לָ/הֶ֖ם לְ/מוֹשִֽׁיעַ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'kh 'my hmh bnym l' yshqrv vyhy lhm lmvshy'
verses.translation: For he said, Surely they are my people, children that will not lie: so he was their Saviour.

verses.original: בְּֽ/כָל צָרָתָ֣/ם לא ל֣/וֹ צָ֗ר וּ/מַלְאַ֤ךְ פָּנָי/ו֙ הֽוֹשִׁיעָ֔/ם בְּ/אַהֲבָת֥/וֹ וּ/בְ/חֶמְלָת֖/וֹ ה֣וּא גְאָלָ֑/ם וַֽ/יְנַטְּלֵ֥/ם וַֽ/יְנַשְּׂאֵ֖/ם כָּל יְמֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: bkhl tsrtm l' lv tsr vml'kh pnyv hvshy'm b'hbtv vbchmltv hv' g'lm vyntlm vynsh'm khl ymy 'vlm
verses.translation: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.

verses.original: וְ/הֵ֛מָּה מָר֥וּ וְ/עִצְּב֖וּ אֶת ר֣וּחַ קָדְשׁ֑/וֹ וַ/יֵּהָפֵ֥ךְ לָ/הֶ֛ם לְ/אוֹיֵ֖ב ה֥וּא נִלְחַם בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhmh mrv v'tsbv 't rvch qdshv vyhpkh lhm l'vyb hv' nlchm bm
verses.translation: But they rebelled, and vexed his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, and he fought against them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְכֹּ֥ר יְמֵֽי עוֹלָ֖ם מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַמּ֑/וֹ אַיֵּ֣ה הַֽ/מַּעֲלֵ֣/ם מִ/יָּ֗ם אֵ֚ת רֹעֵ֣י צֹאנ֔/וֹ אַיֵּ֛ה הַ/שָּׂ֥ם בְּ/קִרְבּ֖/וֹ אֶת ר֥וּחַ קָדְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyzkhr ymy 'vlm mshh 'mv 'yh hm'lm mym 't r'y ts'nv 'yh hshm bqrbv 't rvch qdshv
verses.translation: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses, and his people, saying , Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him?

verses.original: מוֹלִיךְ֙ לִ/ימִ֣ין מֹשֶׁ֔ה זְר֖וֹעַ תִּפְאַרְתּ֑/וֹ בּ֤וֹקֵֽעַ מַ֨יִם֙ מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֔ם לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת ל֖/וֹ שֵׁ֥ם עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: mvlykh lymyn mshh zrv' tp'rtv bvq' mym mpnyhm l'shvt lv shm 'vlm
verses.translation: That led them by the right hand of Moses with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?

verses.original: מוֹלִיכָ֖/ם בַּ/תְּהֹמ֑וֹת כַּ/סּ֥וּס בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֖ר לֹ֥א יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ
verses.translit: mvlykhm bthmvt khsvs bmdbr l' ykhshlv
verses.translation: That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness, that they should not stumble?

verses.original: כַּ/בְּהֵמָה֙ בַּ/בִּקְעָ֣ה תֵרֵ֔ד ר֥וּחַ יְהוָ֖ה תְּנִיחֶ֑/נּוּ כֵּ֚ן נִהַ֣גְתָּ עַמְּ/ךָ֔ לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת לְ/ךָ֖ שֵׁ֥ם תִּפְאָֽרֶת
verses.translit: khbhmh bbq'h trd rvch yhvh tnychnv khn nhgt 'mkh l'shvt lkh shm tp'rt
verses.translation: As a beast goeth down into the valley, the Spirit of the LORD caused him to rest: so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.

verses.original: הַבֵּ֤ט מִ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ וּ/רְאֵ֔ה מִ/זְּבֻ֥ל קָדְשְׁ/ךָ֖ וְ/תִפְאַרְתֶּ֑/ךָ אַיֵּ֤ה קִנְאָֽתְ/ךָ֙ וּ/גְב֣וּרֹתֶ֔/ךָ הֲמ֥וֹן מֵעֶ֛י/ךָ וְֽ/רַחֲמֶ֖י/ךָ אֵלַ֥/י הִתְאַפָּֽקוּ
verses.translit: hbt mshmym vr'h mzbl qdshkh vtp'rtkh 'yh qn'tkh vgbvrtkh hmvn m'ykh vrchmykh 'ly ht'pqv
verses.translation: Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where is thy zeal and thy strength, the sounding of thy bowels and of thy mercies toward me? are they restrained?

verses.original: כִּֽי אַתָּ֣ה אָבִ֔י/נוּ כִּ֤י אַבְרָהָם֙ לֹ֣א יְדָעָ֔/נוּ וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֣א יַכִּירָ֑/נוּ אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אָבִ֔י/נוּ גֹּאֲלֵ֥/נוּ מֵֽ/עוֹלָ֖ם שְׁמֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khy 'th 'bynv khy 'brhm l' yd'nv vyshr'l l' ykhyrnv 'th yhvh 'bynv g'lnv m'vlm shmkh
verses.translation: Doubtless thou art our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Israel acknowledge us not: thou, O LORD , art our father, our redeemer; thy name is from everlasting.

verses.original: לָ֣/מָּה תַתְעֵ֤/נוּ יְהוָה֙ מִ/דְּרָכֶ֔י/ךָ תַּקְשִׁ֥יחַ לִבֵּ֖/נוּ מִ/יִּרְאָתֶ֑/ךָ שׁ֚וּב לְמַ֣עַן עֲבָדֶ֔י/ךָ שִׁבְטֵ֖י נַחֲלָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: lmh tt'nv yhvh mdrkhykh tqshych lbnv myr'tkh shvb lm'n 'bdykh shbty nchltkh
verses.translation: O LORD , why hast thou made us to err from thy ways, and hardened our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants’ sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.

verses.original: לַ/מִּצְעָ֕ר יָרְשׁ֖וּ עַם קָדְשֶׁ֑/ךָ צָרֵ֕י/נוּ בּוֹסְס֖וּ מִקְדָּשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: lmts'r yrshv 'm qdshkh tsrynv bvssv mqdshkh
verses.translation: The people of thy holiness have possessed it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.

verses.original: הָיִ֗ינוּ מֵֽ/עוֹלָם֙ לֹֽא מָשַׁ֣לְתָּ בָּ֔/ם לֹֽא נִקְרָ֥א שִׁמְ/ךָ֖ עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם לוּא קָרַ֤עְתָּ שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ יָרַ֔דְתָּ מִ/פָּנֶ֖י/ךָ הָרִ֥ים נָזֹֽלּוּ
verses.translit: hyynv m'vlm l' mshlt bm l' nqr' shmkh 'lyhm lv' qr't shmym yrdt mpnykh hrym nzlv
verses.translation: We are thine: thou never barest rule over them; they were not called by thy name.

verses.original: כִּ/קְדֹ֧חַ אֵ֣שׁ הֲמָסִ֗ים מַ֚יִם תִּבְעֶה אֵ֔שׁ לְ/הוֹדִ֥יעַ שִׁמְ/ךָ֖ לְ/צָרֶ֑י/ךָ מִ/פָּנֶ֖י/ךָ גּוֹיִ֥ם יִרְגָּֽזוּ
verses.translit: khqdch 'sh hmsym mym tb'h 'sh lhvdy' shmkh ltsrykh mpnykh gvym yrgzv
verses.translation: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence,

verses.original: בַּ/עֲשׂוֹתְ/ךָ֥ נוֹרָא֖וֹת לֹ֣א נְקַוֶּ֑ה יָרַ֕דְתָּ מִ/פָּנֶ֖י/ךָ הָרִ֥ים נָזֹֽלּוּ
verses.translit: b'shvtkh nvr'vt l' nqvh yrdt mpnykh hrym nzlv
verses.translation: As when the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, to make thy name known to thine adversaries, that the nations may tremble at thy presence!

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/עוֹלָ֥ם לֹא שָׁמְע֖וּ לֹ֣א הֶאֱזִ֑ינוּ עַ֣יִן לֹֽא רָאָ֗תָה אֱלֹהִים֙ זוּלָ֣תְ/ךָ֔ יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִ/מְחַכֵּה לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vm'vlm l' shm'v l' h'zynv 'yn l' r'th 'lhym zvltkh y'shh lmchkhh lv
verses.translation: When thou didst terrible things which we looked not for, thou camest down, the mountains flowed down at thy presence.

verses.original: פָּגַ֤עְתָּ אֶת שָׂשׂ֙ וְ/עֹ֣שֵׂה צֶ֔דֶק בִּ/דְרָכֶ֖י/ךָ יִזְכְּר֑וּ/ךָ הֵן אַתָּ֤ה קָצַ֨פְתָּ֙ וַֽ/נֶּחֱטָ֔א בָּ/הֶ֥ם עוֹלָ֖ם וְ/נִוָּשֵֽׁעַ
verses.translit: pg't 't shsh v'shh tsdq bdrkhykh yzkhrvkh hn 'th qtspt vncht' bhm 'vlm vnvsh'
verses.translation: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee, what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.

verses.original: וַ/נְּהִ֤י כַ/טָּמֵא֙ כֻּלָּ֔/נוּ וּ/כְ/בֶ֥גֶד עִדִּ֖ים כָּל צִדְקֹתֵ֑י/נוּ וַ/נָּ֤בֶל כֶּֽ/עָלֶה֙ כֻּלָּ֔/נוּ וַ/עֲוֺנֵ֖/נוּ כָּ/ר֥וּחַ יִשָּׂאֻֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vnhy khtm' khlnv vkhbgd 'dym khl tsdqtynv vnbl kh'lh khlnv v'vnnv khrvch ysh'nv
verses.translation: Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness, those that remember thee in thy ways: behold, thou art wroth; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved.

verses.original: וְ/אֵין קוֹרֵ֣א בְ/שִׁמְ/ךָ֔ מִתְעוֹרֵ֖ר לְ/הַחֲזִ֣יק בָּ֑/ךְ כִּֽי הִסְתַּ֤רְתָּ פָנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ וַ/תְּמוּגֵ֖/נוּ בְּ/יַד עֲוֺנֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: v'yn qvr' bshmkh mt'vrr lhchzyq bkh khy hstrt pnykh mmnv vtmvgnv byd 'vnnv
verses.translation: But we are all as an unclean thing , and all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אָבִ֣י/נוּ אָ֑תָּה אֲנַ֤חְנוּ הַ/חֹ֨מֶר֙ וְ/אַתָּ֣ה יֹצְרֵ֔/נוּ וּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדְ/ךָ֖ כֻּלָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: v'th yhvh 'bynv 'th 'nchnv hchmr v'th ytsrnv vm'shh ydkh khlnv
verses.translation: And there is none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee: for thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us, because of our iniquities.

verses.original: אַל תִּקְצֹ֤ף יְהוָה֙ עַד מְאֹ֔ד וְ/אַל לָ/עַ֖ד תִּזְכֹּ֣ר עָוֺ֑ן הֵ֥ן הַבֶּט נָ֖א עַמְּ/ךָ֥ כֻלָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: 'l tqtsf yhvh 'd m'd v'l l'd tzkhr 'vn hn hbt n' 'mkh khlnv
verses.translation: But now, O LORD , thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.

verses.original: עָרֵ֥י קָדְשְׁ/ךָ֖ הָי֣וּ מִדְבָּ֑ר צִיּוֹן֙ מִדְבָּ֣ר הָיָ֔תָה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם שְׁמָמָֽה
verses.translit: 'ry qdshkh hyv mdbr tsyvn mdbr hyth yrvshlm shmmh
verses.translation: Be not wroth very sore, O LORD , neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.

verses.original: בֵּ֧ית קָדְשֵׁ֣/נוּ וְ/תִפְאַרְתֵּ֗/נוּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִֽלְל֨וּ/ךָ֙ אֲבֹתֵ֔י/נוּ הָיָ֖ה לִ/שְׂרֵ֣פַת אֵ֑שׁ וְ/כָל מַחֲמַדֵּ֖י/נוּ הָיָ֥ה לְ/חָרְבָּֽה
verses.translit: byt qdshnv vtp'rtnv 'shr hllvkh 'btynv hyh lshrpt 'sh vkhl mchmdynv hyh lchrbh
verses.translation: Thy holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.

verses.original: הַ/עַל אֵ֥לֶּה תִתְאַפַּ֖ק יְהוָ֑ה תֶּחֱשֶׁ֥ה וּ/תְעַנֵּ֖/נוּ עַד מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: h'l 'lh tt'pq yhvh tchshh vt'nnv 'd m'd
verses.translation: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.
Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things , O LORD ? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?

verses.original: נִדְרַ֨שְׁתִּי֙ לְ/ל֣וֹא שָׁאָ֔לוּ נִמְצֵ֖אתִי לְ/לֹ֣א בִקְשֻׁ֑/נִי אָמַ֨רְתִּי֙ הִנֵּ֣/נִי הִנֵּ֔/נִי אֶל גּ֖וֹי לֹֽא קֹרָ֥א בִ/שְׁמִֽ/י
verses.translit: ndrshty llv' sh'lv nmts'ty ll' bqshny 'mrty hnny hnny 'l gvy l' qr' bshmy
verses.translation: I am sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.

verses.original: פֵּרַ֧שְׂתִּי יָדַ֛/י כָּל הַ/יּ֖וֹם אֶל עַ֣ם סוֹרֵ֑ר הַ/הֹלְכִים֙ הַ/דֶּ֣רֶךְ לֹא ט֔וֹב אַחַ֖ר מַחְשְׁבֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: prshty ydy khl hyvm 'l 'm svrr hhlkhym hdrkh l' tvb 'chr mchshbtyhm
verses.translation: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts;

verses.original: הָ/עָ֗ם הַ/מַּכְעִיסִ֥ים אוֹתִ֛/י עַל פָּנַ֖/י תָּמִ֑יד זֹֽבְחִים֙ בַּ/גַּנּ֔וֹת וּֽ/מְקַטְּרִ֖ים עַל הַ/לְּבֵנִֽים
verses.translit: h'm hmkh'ysym 'vty 'l pny tmyd zbchym bgnvt vmqtrym 'l hlbnym
verses.translation: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick;

verses.original: הַ/יֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בַּ/קְּבָרִ֔ים וּ/בַ/נְּצוּרִ֖ים יָלִ֑ינוּ הָ/אֹֽכְלִים֙ בְּשַׂ֣ר הַ/חֲזִ֔יר ו/פרק וּ/מְרַ֥ק פִּגֻּלִ֖ים כְּלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: hyshbym bqbrym vbntsvrym ylynv h'khlym bshr hchzyr vprq vmrq pglym khlyhm
verses.translation: Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine’s flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;

verses.original: הָ/אֹֽמְרִים֙ קְרַ֣ב אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ אַל תִּגַּשׁ בִּ֖/י כִּ֣י קְדַשְׁתִּ֑י/ךָ אֵ֚לֶּה עָשָׁ֣ן בְּ/אַפִּ֔/י אֵ֥שׁ יֹקֶ֖דֶת כָּל הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: h'mrym qrb 'lykh 'l tgsh by khy qdshtykh 'lh 'shn b'py 'sh yqdt khl hyvm
verses.translation: Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou. These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה כְתוּבָ֖ה לְ/פָנָ֑/י לֹ֤א אֶחֱשֶׂה֙ כִּ֣י אִם שִׁלַּ֔מְתִּי וְ/שִׁלַּמְתִּ֖י עַל חֵיקָֽ/ם
verses.translit: hnh khtvbh lpny l' 'chshh khy 'm shlmty vshlmty 'l chyqm
verses.translation: Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,

verses.original: עֲ֠וֺנֹתֵי/כֶם וַ/עֲוֺנֹ֨ת אֲבוֹתֵי/כֶ֤ם יַחְדָּו֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר קִטְּרוּ֙ עַל הֶ֣/הָרִ֔ים וְ/עַל הַ/גְּבָע֖וֹת חֵרְפ֑וּ/נִי וּ/מַדֹּתִ֧י פְעֻלָּתָ֛/ם רִֽאשֹׁנָ֖ה על אֶל חֵיקָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'vntykhm v'vnt 'bvtykhm ychdv 'mr yhvh 'shr qtrv 'l hhrym v'l hgb'vt chrpvny vmdty p'ltm r'shnh 'l 'l chyqm
verses.translation: Your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, saith the LORD , which have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִמָּצֵ֤א הַ/תִּירוֹשׁ֙ בָּֽ/אֶשְׁכּ֔וֹל וְ/אָמַר֙ אַל תַּשְׁחִיתֵ֔/הוּ כִּ֥י בְרָכָ֖ה בּ֑/וֹ כֵּ֤ן אֶֽעֱשֶׂה֙ לְמַ֣עַן עֲבָדַ֔/י לְ/בִלְתִּ֖י הַֽשְׁחִ֥ית הַ/כֹּֽל
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh kh'shr ymts' htyrvsh b'shkhvl v'mr 'l tshchythv khy brkhh bv khn ''shh lm'n 'bdy lblty hshchyt hkhl
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one saith, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for my servants’ sakes, that I may not destroy them all.

verses.original: וְ/הוֹצֵאתִ֤י מִֽ/יַּעֲקֹב֙ זֶ֔רַע וּ/מִ/יהוּדָ֖ה יוֹרֵ֣שׁ הָרָ֑/י וִ/ירֵשׁ֣וּ/הָ בְחִירַ֔/י וַ/עֲבָדַ֖/י יִשְׁכְּנוּ שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vhvts'ty my'qb zr' vmyhvdh yvrsh hry vyrshvh bchyry v'bdy yshkhnv shmh
verses.translation: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains: and mine elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֤ה הַ/שָּׁרוֹן֙ לִ/נְוֵה צֹ֔אן וְ/עֵ֥מֶק עָכ֖וֹר לְ/רֵ֣בֶץ בָּקָ֑ר לְ/עַמִּ֖/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר דְּרָשֽׁוּ/נִי
verses.translit: vhyh hshrvn lnvh ts'n v'mq 'khvr lrbts bqr l'my 'shr drshvny
verses.translation: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּם֙ עֹזְבֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה הַ/שְּׁכֵחִ֖ים אֶת הַ֣ר קָדְשִׁ֑/י הַֽ/עֹרְכִ֤ים לַ/גַּד֙ שֻׁלְחָ֔ן וְ/הַֽ/מְמַלְאִ֖ים לַ/מְנִ֥י מִמְסָֽךְ
verses.translit: v'tm 'zby yhvh hshkhchym 't hr qdshy h'rkhym lgd shlchn vhmml'ym lmny mmskh
verses.translation: But ye are they that forsake the LORD , that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering unto that number.

verses.original: וּ/מָנִ֨יתִי אֶתְ/כֶ֜ם לַ/חֶ֗רֶב וְ/כֻלְּ/כֶם֙ לַ/טֶּ֣בַח תִּכְרָ֔עוּ יַ֤עַן קָרָ֨אתִי֙ וְ/לֹ֣א עֲנִיתֶ֔ם דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי וְ/לֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֑ם וַ/תַּעֲשׂ֤וּ הָ/רַע֙ בְּ/עֵינַ֔/י וּ/בַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא חָפַ֖צְתִּי בְּחַרְתֶּֽם
verses.translit: vmnyty 'tkhm lchrb vkhlkhm ltbch tkhr'v y'n qr'ty vl' 'nytm dbrty vl' shm'tm vt'shv hr' b'yny vb'shr l' chptsty bchrtm
verses.translation: Therefore will I number you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, ye did not answer; when I spake, ye did not hear; but did evil before mine eyes, and did choose that wherein I delighted not.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן כֹּה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה עֲבָדַ֤/י יֹאכֵ֨לוּ֙ וְ/אַתֶּ֣ם תִּרְעָ֔בוּ הִנֵּ֧ה עֲבָדַ֛/י יִשְׁתּ֖וּ וְ/אַתֶּ֣ם תִּצְמָ֑אוּ הִנֵּ֧ה עֲבָדַ֛/י יִשְׂמָ֖חוּ וְ/אַתֶּ֥ם תֵּבֹֽשׁוּ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnh 'bdy y'khlv v'tm tr'bv hnh 'bdy yshtv v'tm ttsm'v hnh 'bdy yshmchv v'tm tbshv
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD , Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:

verses.original: הִנֵּ֧ה עֲבָדַ֛/י יָרֹ֖נּוּ מִ/טּ֣וּב לֵ֑ב וְ/אַתֶּ֤ם תִּצְעֲקוּ֙ מִ/כְּאֵ֣ב לֵ֔ב וּ/מִ/שֵּׁ֥בֶר ר֖וּחַ תְּיֵלִֽילוּ
verses.translit: hnh 'bdy yrnv mtvb lb v'tm tts'qv mkh'b lb vmshbr rvch tylylv
verses.translation: Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall howl for vexation of spirit.

verses.original: וְ/הִנַּחְתֶּ֨ם שִׁמְ/כֶ֤ם לִ/שְׁבוּעָה֙ לִ/בְחִירַ֔/י וֶ/הֱמִיתְ/ךָ֖ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֑ה וְ/לַ/עֲבָדָ֥י/ו יִקְרָ֖א שֵׁ֥ם אַחֵֽר
verses.translit: vhnchtm shmkhm lshbv'h lbchyry vhmytkh 'dny yhvh vl'bdyv yqr' shm 'chr
verses.translation: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for the Lord GOD shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name:

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הַ/מִּתְבָּרֵ֜ךְ בָּ/אָ֗רֶץ יִתְבָּרֵךְ֙ בֵּ/אלֹהֵ֣י אָמֵ֔ן וְ/הַ/נִּשְׁבָּ֣ע בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ יִשָּׁבַ֖ע בֵּ/אלֹהֵ֣י אָמֵ֑ן כִּ֣י נִשְׁכְּח֗וּ הַ/צָּרוֹת֙ הָ/רִ֣אשֹׁנ֔וֹת וְ/כִ֥י נִסְתְּר֖וּ מֵ/עֵינָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'shr hmtbrkh b'rts ytbrkh b'lhy 'mn vhnshb' b'rts yshb' b'lhy 'mn khy nshkhchv htsrvt hr'shnvt vkhy nstrv m'yny
verses.translation: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from mine eyes.

verses.original: כִּֽי הִנְ/נִ֥י בוֹרֵ֛א שָׁמַ֥יִם חֲדָשִׁ֖ים וָ/אָ֣רֶץ חֲדָשָׁ֑ה וְ/לֹ֤א תִזָּכַ֨רְנָה֙ הָ/רִ֣אשֹׁנ֔וֹת וְ/לֹ֥א תַעֲלֶ֖ינָה עַל לֵֽב
verses.translit: khy hnny bvr' shmym chdshym v'rts chdshh vl' tzkhrnh hr'shnvt vl' t'lynh 'l lb
verses.translation: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.

verses.original: כִּֽי אִם שִׂ֤ישׂוּ וְ/גִ֨ילוּ֙ עֲדֵי עַ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲנִ֣י בוֹרֵ֑א כִּי֩ הִנְ/נִ֨י בוֹרֵ֧א אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֛ם גִּילָ֖ה וְ/עַמָּ֥/הּ מָשֽׂוֹשׂ
verses.translit: khy 'm shyshv vgylv 'dy 'd 'shr 'ny bvr' khy hnny bvr' 't yrvshlm gylh v'mh mshvsh
verses.translation: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.

verses.original: וְ/גַלְתִּ֥י בִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וְ/שַׂשְׂתִּ֣י בְ/עַמִּ֑/י וְ/לֹֽא יִשָּׁמַ֥ע בָּ/הּ֙ ע֔וֹד ק֥וֹל בְּכִ֖י וְ/ק֥וֹל זְעָקָֽה
verses.translit: vglty byrvshlm vshshty b'my vl' yshm' bh 'vd qvl bkhy vqvl z'qh
verses.translation: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.

verses.original: לֹא יִֽהְיֶ֨ה מִ/שָּׁ֜ם ע֗וֹד ע֤וּל יָמִים֙ וְ/זָקֵ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא יְמַלֵּ֖א אֶת יָמָ֑י/ו כִּ֣י הַ/נַּ֗עַר בֶּן מֵאָ֤ה שָׁנָה֙ יָמ֔וּת וְ/הַ֣/חוֹטֶ֔א בֶּן מֵאָ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה יְקֻלָּֽל
verses.translit: l' yhyh mshm 'vd 'vl ymym vzqn 'shr l' yml' 't ymyv khy hn'r bn m'h shnh ymvt vhchvt' bn m'h shnh yqll
verses.translation: There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed.

verses.original: וּ/בָנ֥וּ בָתִּ֖ים וְ/יָשָׁ֑בוּ וְ/נָטְע֣וּ כְרָמִ֔ים וְ/אָכְל֖וּ פִּרְיָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vbnv btym vyshbv vnt'v khrmym v'khlv prym
verses.translation: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.

verses.original: לֹ֤א יִבְנוּ֙ וְ/אַחֵ֣ר יֵשֵׁ֔ב לֹ֥א יִטְּע֖וּ וְ/אַחֵ֣ר יֹאכֵ֑ל כִּֽי כִ/ימֵ֤י הָ/עֵץ֙ יְמֵ֣י עַמִּ֔/י וּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵי/הֶ֖ם יְבַלּ֥וּ בְחִירָֽ/י
verses.translit: l' ybnv v'chr yshb l' yt'v v'chr y'khl khy khymy h'ts ymy 'my vm'shh ydyhm yblv bchyry
verses.translation: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree are the days of my people, and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.

verses.original: לֹ֤א יִֽיגְעוּ֙ לָ/רִ֔יק וְ/לֹ֥א יֵלְד֖וּ לַ/בֶּהָלָ֑ה כִּ֣י זֶ֜רַע בְּרוּכֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ הֵ֔מָּה וְ/צֶאֱצָאֵי/הֶ֖ם אִתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: l' yyg'v lryq vl' yldv lbhlh khy zr' brvkhy yhvh hmh vts'ts'yhm 'tm
verses.translation: They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they are the seed of the blessed of the LORD , and their offspring with them.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֥ה טֶֽרֶם יִקְרָ֖אוּ וַ/אֲנִ֣י אֶעֱנֶ֑ה ע֛וֹד הֵ֥ם מְדַבְּרִ֖ים וַ/אֲנִ֥י אֶשְׁמָֽע
verses.translit: vhyh trm yqr'v v'ny ''nh 'vd hm mdbrym v'ny 'shm'
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.

verses.original: זְאֵ֨ב וְ/טָלֶ֜ה יִרְע֣וּ כְ/אֶחָ֗ד וְ/אַרְיֵה֙ כַּ/בָּקָ֣ר יֹֽאכַל תֶּ֔בֶן וְ/נָחָ֖שׁ עָפָ֣ר לַחְמ֑/וֹ לֹֽא יָרֵ֧עוּ וְ/לֹֽא יַשְׁחִ֛יתוּ בְּ/כָל הַ֥ר קָדְשִׁ֖/י אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: z'b vtlh yr'v kh'chd v'ryh khbqr y'khl tbn vnchsh 'pr lchmv l' yr'v vl' yshchytv bkhl hr qdshy 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust shall be the serpent’s meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith the LORD .

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם כִּסְאִ֔/י וְ/הָ/אָ֖רֶץ הֲדֹ֣ם רַגְלָ֑/י אֵי זֶ֥ה בַ֨יִת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּבְנוּ לִ֔/י וְ/אֵי זֶ֥ה מָק֖וֹם מְנוּחָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh hshmym khs'y vh'rts hdm rgly 'y zh byt 'shr tbnv ly v'y zh mqvm mnvchty
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , The heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool: where is the house that ye build unto me? and where is the place of my rest?

verses.original: וְ/אֶת כָּל אֵ֨לֶּה֙ יָדִ֣/י עָשָׂ֔תָה וַ/יִּהְי֥וּ כָל אֵ֖לֶּה נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וְ/אֶל זֶ֣ה אַבִּ֔יט אֶל עָנִי֙ וּ/נְכֵה ר֔וּחַ וְ/חָרֵ֖ד עַל דְּבָרִֽ/י
verses.translit: v't khl 'lh ydy 'shth vyhyv khl 'lh n'm yhvh v'l zh 'byt 'l 'ny vnkhh rvch vchrd 'l dbry
verses.translation: For all those things hath mine hand made, and all those things have been, saith the LORD : but to this man will I look, even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembleth at my word.

verses.original: שׁוֹחֵ֨ט הַ/שּׁ֜וֹר מַכֵּה אִ֗ישׁ זוֹבֵ֤חַ הַ/שֶּׂה֙ עֹ֣רֵֽף כֶּ֔לֶב מַעֲלֵ֤ה מִנְחָה֙ דַּם חֲזִ֔יר מַזְכִּ֥יר לְבֹנָ֖ה מְבָ֣רֵֽךְ אָ֑וֶן גַּם הֵ֗מָּה בָּֽחֲרוּ֙ בְּ/דַרְכֵי/הֶ֔ם וּ/בְ/שִׁקּוּצֵי/הֶ֖ם נַפְשָׁ֥/ם חָפֵֽצָה
verses.translit: shvcht hshvr mkhh 'ysh zvbch hshh 'rf khlb m'lh mnchh dm chzyr mzkhyr lbnh mbrkh 'vn gm hmh bchrv bdrkhyhm vbshqvtsyhm npshm chptsh
verses.translation: He that killeth an ox is as if he slew a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, as if he cut off a dog’s neck; he that offereth an oblation, as if he offered swine’s blood; he that burneth incense, as if he blessed an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delighteth in their abominations.

verses.original: גַּם אֲנִ֞י אֶבְחַ֣ר בְּ/תַעֲלֻלֵי/הֶ֗ם וּ/מְגֽוּרֹתָ/ם֙ אָבִ֣יא לָ/הֶ֔ם יַ֤עַן קָרָ֨אתִי֙ וְ/אֵ֣ין עוֹנֶ֔ה דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי וְ/לֹ֣א שָׁמֵ֑עוּ וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֤וּ הָ/רַע֙ בְּ/עֵינַ֔/י וּ/בַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא חָפַ֖צְתִּי בָּחָֽרוּ
verses.translit: gm 'ny 'bchr bt'llyhm vmgvrtm 'by' lhm y'n qr'ty v'yn 'vnh dbrty vl' shm'v vy'shv hr' b'yny vb'shr l' chptsty bchrv
verses.translation: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before mine eyes, and chose that in which I delighted not.

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה הַ/חֲרֵדִ֖ים אֶל דְּבָר֑/וֹ אָמְרוּ֩ אֲחֵי/כֶ֨ם שֹׂנְאֵי/כֶ֜ם מְנַדֵּי/כֶ֗ם לְמַ֤עַן שְׁמִ/י֙ יִכְבַּ֣ד יְהוָ֔ה וְ/נִרְאֶ֥ה בְ/שִׂמְחַתְ/כֶ֖ם וְ/הֵ֥ם יֵבֹֽשׁוּ
verses.translit: shm'v dbr yhvh hchrdym 'l dbrv 'mrv 'chykhm shn'ykhm mndykhm lm'n shmy ykhbd yhvh vnr'h bshmchtkhm vhm ybshv
verses.translation: Hear the word of the LORD , ye that tremble at his word; Your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name’s sake, said, Let the LORD be glorified: but he shall appear to your joy, and they shall be ashamed.

verses.original: ק֤וֹל שָׁאוֹן֙ מֵ/עִ֔יר ק֖וֹל מֵֽ/הֵיכָ֑ל ק֣וֹל יְהוָ֔ה מְשַׁלֵּ֥ם גְּמ֖וּל לְ/אֹיְבָֽי/ו
verses.translit: qvl sh'vn m'yr qvl mhykhl qvl yhvh mshlm gmvl l'ybyv
verses.translation: A voice of noise from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the LORD that rendereth recompence to his enemies.

verses.original: בְּ/טֶ֥רֶם תָּחִ֖יל יָלָ֑דָה בְּ/טֶ֨רֶם יָב֥וֹא חֵ֛בֶל לָ֖/הּ וְ/הִמְלִ֥יטָה זָכָֽר
verses.translit: btrm tchyl yldh btrm ybv' chbl lh vhmlyth zkhr
verses.translation: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man child.

verses.original: מִֽי שָׁמַ֣ע כָּ/זֹ֗את מִ֤י רָאָה֙ כָּ/אֵ֔לֶּה הֲ/י֤וּחַל אֶ֨רֶץ֙ בְּ/י֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד אִם יִוָּ֥לֵֽד גּ֖וֹי פַּ֣עַם אֶחָ֑ת כִּֽי חָ֛לָה גַּם יָלְדָ֥ה צִיּ֖וֹן אֶת בָּנֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: my shm' khz't my r'h kh'lh hyvchl 'rts byvm 'chd 'm yvld gvy p'm 'cht khy chlh gm yldh tsyvn 't bnyh
verses.translation: Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day? or shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.

verses.original: הַ/אֲנִ֥י אַשְׁבִּ֛יר וְ/לֹ֥א אוֹלִ֖יד יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אִם אֲנִ֧י הַ/מּוֹלִ֛יד וְ/עָצַ֖רְתִּי אָמַ֥ר אֱלֹהָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: h'ny 'shbyr vl' 'vlyd y'mr yhvh 'm 'ny hmvlyd v'tsrty 'mr 'lhykh
verses.translation: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? saith the LORD : shall I cause to bring forth, and shut the womb ? saith thy God.

verses.original: שִׂמְח֧וּ אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֛ם וְ/גִ֥ילוּ בָ֖/הּ כָּל אֹהֲבֶ֑י/הָ שִׂ֤ישׂוּ אִתָּ/הּ֙ מָשׂ֔וֹשׂ כָּל הַ/מִּֽתְאַבְּלִ֖ים עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: shmchv 't yrvshlm vgylv bh khl 'hbyh shyshv 'th mshvsh khl hmt'blym 'lyh
verses.translation: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem, and be glad with her, all ye that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all ye that mourn for her:

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽינְקוּ֙ וּ/שְׂבַעְתֶּ֔ם מִ/שֹּׁ֖ד תַּנְחֻמֶ֑י/הָ לְמַ֧עַן תָּמֹ֛צּוּ וְ/הִתְעַנַּגְתֶּ֖ם מִ/זִּ֥יז כְּבוֹדָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: lm'n tynqv vshb'tm mshd tnchmyh lm'n tmtsv vht'ngtm mzyz khbvdh
verses.translation: That ye may suck, and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that ye may milk out, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.

verses.original: כִּֽי כֹ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה הִנְ/נִ֣י נֹטֶֽה אֵ֠לֶי/הָ כְּ/נָהָ֨ר שָׁל֜וֹם וּ/כְ/נַ֧חַל שׁוֹטֵ֛ף כְּב֥וֹד גּוֹיִ֖ם וִֽ/ינַקְתֶּ֑ם עַל צַד֙ תִּנָּשֵׂ֔אוּ וְ/עַל בִּרְכַּ֖יִם תְּשָׁעֳשָֽׁעוּ
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh hnny nth 'lyh khnhr shlvm vkhnchl shvtf khbvd gvym vynqtm 'l tsd tnsh'v v'l brkhym tsh'sh'v
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD , Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream: then shall ye suck, ye shall be borne upon her sides, and be dandled upon her knees.

verses.original: כְּ/אִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִמּ֖/וֹ תְּנַחֲמֶ֑/נּוּ כֵּ֤ן אָֽנֹכִי֙ אֲנַ֣חֶמְ/כֶ֔ם וּ/בִ/ירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם תְּנֻחָֽמוּ
verses.translit: kh'ysh 'shr 'mv tnchmnv khn 'nkhy 'nchmkhm vbyrvshlm tnchmv
verses.translation: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.

verses.original: וּ/רְאִיתֶם֙ וְ/שָׂ֣שׂ לִבְּ/כֶ֔ם וְ/עַצְמוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם כַּ/דֶּ֣שֶׁא תִפְרַ֑חְנָה וְ/נוֹדְעָ֤ה יַד יְהוָה֙ אֶת עֲבָדָ֔י/ו וְ/זָעַ֖ם אֶת אֹיְבָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vr'ytm vshsh lbkhm v'tsmvtykhm khdsh' tprchnh vnvd'h yd yhvh 't 'bdyv vz'm 't 'ybyv
verses.translation: And when ye see this , your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb: and the hand of the LORD shall be known toward his servants, and his indignation toward his enemies.

verses.original: כִּֽי הִנֵּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בָּ/אֵ֣שׁ יָב֔וֹא וְ/כַ/סּוּפָ֖ה מַרְכְּבֹתָ֑י/ו לְ/הָשִׁ֤יב בְּ/חֵמָה֙ אַפּ֔/וֹ וְ/גַעֲרָת֖/וֹ בְּ/לַהֲבֵי אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: khy hnh yhvh b'sh ybv' vkhsvph mrkhbtyv lhshyb bchmh 'pv vg'rtv blhby 'sh
verses.translation: For, behold, the LORD will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.

verses.original: כִּ֤י בָ/אֵשׁ֙ יְהוָ֣ה נִשְׁפָּ֔ט וּ/בְ/חַרְבּ֖/וֹ אֶת כָּל בָּשָׂ֑ר וְ/רַבּ֖וּ חַֽלְלֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy b'sh yhvh nshpt vbchrbv 't khl bshr vrbv chlly yhvh
verses.translation: For by fire and by his sword will the LORD plead with all flesh: and the slain of the LORD shall be many.

verses.original: הַ/מִּתְקַדְּשִׁ֨ים וְ/הַ/מִּֽטַּהֲרִ֜ים אֶל הַ/גַּנּ֗וֹת אַחַ֤ר אחד אַחַת֙ בַּ/תָּ֔וֶךְ אֹֽכְלֵי֙ בְּשַׂ֣ר הַ/חֲזִ֔יר וְ/הַ/שֶּׁ֖קֶץ וְ/הָ/עַכְבָּ֑ר יַחְדָּ֥ו יָסֻ֖פוּ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hmtqdshym vhmthrym 'l hgnvt 'chr 'chd 'cht btvkh 'khly bshr hchzyr vhshqts vh'khbr ychdv yspv n'm yhvh
verses.translation: They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst, eating swine’s flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אָנֹכִ֗י מַעֲשֵׂי/הֶם֙ וּ/מַחְשְׁבֹ֣תֵי/הֶ֔ם בָּאָ֕ה לְ/קַבֵּ֥ץ אֶת כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם וְ/הַ/לְּשֹׁנ֑וֹת וּ/בָ֖אוּ וְ/רָא֥וּ אֶת כְּבוֹדִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'nkhy m'shyhm vmchshbtyhm b'h lqbts 't khl hgvym vhlshnvt vb'v vr'v 't khbvdy
verses.translation: For I know their works and their thoughts: it shall come, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֨י בָ/הֶ֜ם א֗וֹת וְ/שִׁלַּחְתִּ֣י מֵ/הֶ֣ם פְּ֠לֵיטִים אֶֽל הַ/גּוֹיִ֞ם תַּרְשִׁ֨ישׁ פּ֥וּל וְ/ל֛וּד מֹ֥שְׁכֵי קֶ֖שֶׁת תֻּבַ֣ל וְ/יָוָ֑ן הָ/אִיִּ֣ים הָ/רְחֹקִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא שָׁמְע֤וּ אֶת שִׁמְעִ/י֙ וְ/לֹא רָא֣וּ אֶת כְּבוֹדִ֔/י וְ/הִגִּ֥ידוּ אֶת כְּבוֹדִ֖/י בַּ/גּוֹיִֽם
verses.translit: vshmty bhm 'vt vshlchty mhm plytym 'l hgvym trshysh pvl vlvd mshkhy qsht tbl vyvn h'yym hrchqym 'shr l' shm'v 't shm'y vl' r'v 't khbvdy vhgydv 't khbvdy bgvym
verses.translation: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow, to Tubal, and Javan, to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.

verses.original: וְ/הֵבִ֣יאוּ אֶת כָּל אֲחֵי/כֶ֣ם מִ/כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֣ם מִנְחָ֣ה לַֽ/יהוָ֡ה בַּ/סּוּסִ֡ים וּ֠/בָ/רֶכֶב וּ/בַ/צַּבִּ֨ים וּ/בַ/פְּרָדִ֜ים וּ/בַ/כִּרְכָּר֗וֹת עַ֣ל הַ֥ר קָדְשִׁ֛/י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָבִיאוּ֩ בְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָ֛ה בִּ/כְלִ֥י טָה֖וֹר בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhby'v 't khl 'chykhm mkhl hgvym mnchh lyhvh bsvsym vbrkhb vbtsbym vbprdym vbkhrkhrvt 'l hr qdshy yrvshlm 'mr yhvh kh'shr yby'v bny yshr'l 't hmnchh bkhly thvr byt yhvh
verses.translation: And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the LORD out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, saith the LORD , as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/גַם מֵ/הֶ֥ם אֶקַּ֛ח לַ/כֹּהֲנִ֥ים לַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vgm mhm 'qch lkhhnym llvym 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites, saith the LORD .

verses.original: כִּ֣י כַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר הַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם הַ֠/חֳדָשִׁים וְ/הָ/אָ֨רֶץ הַ/חֲדָשָׁ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶׂ֛ה עֹמְדִ֥ים לְ/פָנַ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה כֵּ֛ן יַעֲמֹ֥ד זַרְעֲ/כֶ֖ם וְ/שִׁמְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khy kh'shr hshmym hchdshym vh'rts hchdshh 'shr 'ny 'shh 'mdym lpny n'm yhvh khn y'md zr'khm vshmkhm
verses.translation: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the LORD , so shall your seed and your name remain.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה מִֽ/דֵּי חֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ בְּ/חָדְשׁ֔/וֹ וּ/מִ/דֵּ֥י שַׁבָּ֖ת בְּ/שַׁבַּתּ֑/וֹ יָב֧וֹא כָל בָּשָׂ֛ר לְ/הִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֥ת לְ/פָנַ֖/י אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhyh mdy chdsh bchdshv vmdy shbt bshbtv ybv' khl bshr lhshtchvt lpny 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/יָצְא֣וּ וְ/רָא֔וּ בְּ/פִגְרֵי֙ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים הַ/פֹּשְׁעִ֖ים בִּ֑/י כִּ֣י תוֹלַעְתָּ֞/ם לֹ֣א תָמ֗וּת וְ/אִשָּׁ/ם֙ לֹ֣א תִכְבֶּ֔ה וְ/הָי֥וּ דֵרָא֖וֹן לְ/כָל בָּשָֽׂר
verses.translit: vyts'v vr'v bpgry h'nshym hpsh'ym by khy tvl'tm l' tmvt v'shm l' tkhbh vhyv dr'vn lkhl bshr
verses.translation: And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֥י יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן חִלְקִיָּ֑הוּ מִן הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/עֲנָת֔וֹת בְּ/אֶ֖רֶץ בִּנְיָמִֽן
verses.translit: dbry yrmyhv bn chlqyhv mn hkhhnym 'shr b'ntvt b'rts bnymn
verses.translation: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests that were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֤ה דְבַר יְהוָה֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו בִּ/ימֵ֛י יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בֶן אָמ֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה בִּ/שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה לְ/מָלְכֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'shr hyh dbr yhvh 'lyv bymy y'shyhv bn 'mvn mlkh yhvdh bshlsh 'shrh shnh lmlkhv
verses.translation: To whom the word of the LORD came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בִּ/ימֵ֨י יְהוֹיָקִ֤ים בֶּן יֹאשִׁיָּ֨הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה עַד תֹּם֙ עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לְ/צִדְקִיָּ֥הוּ בֶן יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה עַד גְּל֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַ/חֲמִישִֽׁי
verses.translit: vyhy bymy yhvyqym bn y'shyhv mlkh yhvdh 'd tm 'shty 'shrh shnh ltsdqyhv bn y'shyhv mlkh yhvdh 'd glvt yrvshlm bchdsh hchmyshy
verses.translation: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah, unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: בְּ/טֶ֨רֶם אצור/ך אֶצָּרְ/ךָ֤ בַ/בֶּ֨טֶן֙ יְדַעְתִּ֔י/ךָ וּ/בְ/טֶ֛רֶם תֵּצֵ֥א מֵ/רֶ֖חֶם הִקְדַּשְׁתִּ֑י/ךָ נָבִ֥יא לַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם נְתַתִּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: btrm 'tsvrkh 'tsrkh bbtn yd'tykh vbtrm tts' mrchm hqdshtykh nby' lgvym nttykh
verses.translation: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֗ר אֲהָהּ֙ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהֹוִ֔ה הִנֵּ֥ה לֹא יָדַ֖עְתִּי דַּבֵּ֑ר כִּי נַ֖עַר אָנֹֽכִי
verses.translit: v'mr 'hh 'dny yhvh hnh l' yd'ty dbr khy n'r 'nkhy
verses.translation: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD ! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔/י אַל תֹּאמַ֖ר נַ֣עַר אָנֹ֑כִי כִּ֠י עַֽל כָּל אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֶֽשְׁלָחֲ/ךָ֙ תֵּלֵ֔ךְ וְ/אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲצַוְּ/ךָ֖ תְּדַבֵּֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly 'l t'mr n'r 'nkhy khy 'l khl 'shr 'shlchkh tlkh v't khl 'shr 'tsvkh tdbr
verses.translation: But the LORD said unto me, Say not, I am a child: for thou shalt go to all that I shall send thee, and whatsoever I command thee thou shalt speak.

verses.original: אַל תִּירָ֖א מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֑ם כִּֽי אִתְּ/ךָ֥ אֲנִ֛י לְ/הַצִּלֶ֖/ךָ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'l tyr' mpnyhm khy 'tkh 'ny lhtslkh n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Be not afraid of their faces: for I am with thee to deliver thee, saith the LORD .
