verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח יְהוָה֙ אֶת יָד֔/וֹ וַ/יַּגַּ֖ע עַל פִּ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔/י הִנֵּ֛ה נָתַ֥תִּי דְבָרַ֖/י בְּ/פִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vyshlch yhvh 't ydv vyg' 'l py vy'mr yhvh 'ly hnh ntty dbry bpykh
verses.translation: Then the LORD put forth his hand, and touched my mouth. And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have put my words in thy mouth.

verses.original: רְאֵ֞ה הִפְקַדְתִּ֣י/ךָ הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֗ה עַל הַ/גּוֹיִם֙ וְ/עַל הַ/מַּמְלָכ֔וֹת לִ/נְת֥וֹשׁ וְ/לִ/נְת֖וֹץ וּ/לְ/הַאֲבִ֣יד וְ/לַ/הֲר֑וֹס לִ/בְנ֖וֹת וְ/לִ/נְטֽוֹעַ
verses.translit: r'h hpqdtykh hyvm hzh 'l hgvym v'l hmmlkhvt lntvsh vlntvts vlh'byd vlhrvs lbnvt vlntv'
verses.translation: See, I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to throw down, to build, and to plant.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י דְבַר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֣/י לֵ/אמֹ֔ר מָה אַתָּ֥ה רֹאֶ֖ה יִרְמְיָ֑הוּ וָ/אֹמַ֕ר מַקֵּ֥ל שָׁקֵ֖ד אֲנִ֥י רֹאֶֽה
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr mh 'th r'h yrmyhv v'mr mql shqd 'ny r'h
verses.translation: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying, Jeremiah, what seest thou? And I said, I see a rod of an almond tree.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖/י הֵיטַ֣בְתָּ לִ/רְא֑וֹת כִּֽי שֹׁקֵ֥ד אֲנִ֛י עַל דְּבָרִ֖/י לַ/עֲשֹׂתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly hytbt lr'vt khy shqd 'ny 'l dbry l'shtv
verses.translation: Then said the LORD unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֨י דְבַר יְהוָ֤ה אֵלַ/י֙ שֵׁנִ֣ית לֵ/אמֹ֔ר מָ֥ה אַתָּ֖ה רֹאֶ֑ה וָ/אֹמַ֗ר סִ֤יר נָפ֨וּחַ֙ אֲנִ֣י רֹאֶ֔ה וּ/פָנָ֖י/ו מִ/פְּנֵ֥י צָפֽוֹנָ/ה
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly shnyt l'mr mh 'th r'h v'mr syr npvch 'ny r'h vpnyv mpny tspvnh
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying, What seest thou? And I said, I see a seething pot; and the face thereof is toward the north.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑/י מִ/צָּפוֹן֙ תִּפָּתַ֣ח הָ/רָעָ֔ה עַ֥ל כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly mtspvn tptch hr'h 'l khl yshby h'rts
verses.translation: Then the LORD said unto me, Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land.

verses.original: כִּ֣י הִנְ/נִ֣י קֹרֵ֗א לְ/כָֽל מִשְׁפְּח֛וֹת מַמְלְכ֥וֹת צָפ֖וֹנָ/ה נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וּ/בָ֡אוּ וְֽ/נָתְנוּ֩ אִ֨ישׁ כִּסְא֜/וֹ פֶּ֣תַח שַׁעֲרֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם וְ/עַ֤ל כָּל חוֹמֹתֶ֨י/הָ֙ סָבִ֔יב וְ/עַ֖ל כָּל עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: khy hnny qr' lkhl mshpchvt mmlkhvt tspvnh n'm yhvh vb'v vntnv 'ysh khs'v ptch sh'ry yrvshlm v'l khl chvmtyh sbyb v'l khl 'ry yhvdh
verses.translation: For, lo, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north, saith the LORD ; and they shall come, and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls thereof round about, and against all the cities of Judah.

verses.original: וְ/דִבַּרְתִּ֤י מִשְׁפָּטַ/י֙ אוֹתָ֔/ם עַ֖ל כָּל רָעָתָ֑/ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲזָב֗וּ/נִי וַֽ/יְקַטְּרוּ֙ לֵ/אלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַ/יִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לְ/מַעֲשֵׂ֥י יְדֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vdbrty mshpty 'vtm 'l khl r'tm 'shr 'zbvny vyqtrv l'lhym 'chrym vyshtchvv lm'shy ydyhm
verses.translation: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, who have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּה֙ תֶּאְזֹ֣ר מָתְנֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/קַמְתָּ֙ וְ/דִבַּרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י אֲצַוֶּ֑/ךָּ אַל תֵּחַת֙ מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֔ם פֶּֽן אֲחִתְּ/ךָ֖ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th t'zr mtnykh vqmt vdbrt 'lyhm 't khl 'shr 'nkhy 'tsvkh 'l tcht mpnyhm pn 'chtkh lpnyhm
verses.translation: Thou therefore gird up thy loins, and arise, and speak unto them all that I command thee: be not dismayed at their faces, lest I confound thee before them.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֞י הִנֵּ֧ה נְתַתִּ֣י/ךָ הַ/יּ֗וֹם לְ/עִ֨יר מִבְצָ֜ר וּ/לְ/עַמּ֥וּד בַּרְזֶ֛ל וּ/לְ/חֹמ֥וֹת נְחֹ֖שֶׁת עַל כָּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ לְ/מַלְכֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ לְ/שָׂרֶ֔י/הָ לְ/כֹהֲנֶ֖י/הָ וּ/לְ/עַ֥ם הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: v'ny hnh nttykh hyvm l'yr mbtsr vl'mvd brzl vlchmvt nchsht 'l khl h'rts lmlkhy yhvdh lshryh lkhhnyh vl'm h'rts
verses.translation: For, behold, I have made thee this day a defenced city, and an iron pillar, and brasen walls against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against the princes thereof, against the priests thereof, and against the people of the land.

verses.original: וְ/נִלְחֲמ֥וּ אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ וְ/לֹא י֣וּכְלוּ לָ֑/ךְ כִּֽי אִתְּ/ךָ֥ אֲנִ֛י נְאֻם יְהוָ֖ה לְ/הַצִּילֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vnlchmv 'lykh vl' yvkhlv lkh khy 'tkh 'ny n'm yhvh lhtsylkh
verses.translation: And they shall fight against thee; but they shall not prevail against thee; for I am with thee, saith the LORD , to deliver thee.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.original: הָלֹ֡ךְ וְ/קָֽרָאתָ֩ בְ/אָזְנֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם לֵ/אמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה זָכַ֤רְתִּי לָ/ךְ֙ חֶ֣סֶד נְעוּרַ֔יִ/ךְ אַהֲבַ֖ת כְּלוּלֹתָ֑יִ/ךְ לֶכְתֵּ֤/ךְ אַחֲרַ/י֙ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר בְּ/אֶ֖רֶץ לֹ֥א זְרוּעָֽה
verses.translit: hlkh vqr't b'zny yrvshlm l'mr khh 'mr yhvh zkhrty lkh chsd n'vrykh 'hbt khlvltykh lkhtkh 'chry bmdbr b'rts l' zrv'h
verses.translation: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the LORD ; I remember thee, the kindness of thy youth, the love of thine espousals, when thou wentest after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.

verses.original: קֹ֤דֶשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לַ/יהוָ֔ה רֵאשִׁ֖ית תְּבוּאָתֹ֑/ה כָּל אֹכְלָ֣י/ו יֶאְשָׁ֔מוּ רָעָ֛ה תָּבֹ֥א אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: qdsh yshr'l lyhvh r'shyt tbv'th khl 'khlyv y'shmv r'h tb' 'lyhm n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Israel was holiness unto the LORD , and the firstfruits of his increase: all that devour him shall offend; evil shall come upon them, saith the LORD .

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְ/כָֽל מִשְׁפְּח֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: shm'v dbr yhvh byt y'qb vkhl mshpchvt byt yshr'l
verses.translation: Hear ye the word of the LORD , O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel:

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה מַה מָּצְא֨וּ אֲבוֹתֵי/כֶ֥ם בִּ/י֙ עָ֔וֶל כִּ֥י רָחֲק֖וּ מֵ/עָלָ֑/י וַ/יֵּֽלְכ֛וּ אַחֲרֵ֥י הַ/הֶ֖בֶל וַ/יֶּהְבָּֽלוּ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh mh mts'v 'bvtykhm by 'vl khy rchqv m'ly vylkhv 'chry hhbl vyhblv
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , What iniquity have your fathers found in me, that they are gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֣א אָמְר֔וּ אַיֵּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה הַ/מַּעֲלֶ֥ה אֹתָ֖/נוּ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם הַ/מּוֹלִ֨יךְ אֹתָ֜/נוּ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֗ר בְּ/אֶ֨רֶץ עֲרָבָ֤ה וְ/שׁוּחָה֙ בְּ/אֶ֨רֶץ֙ צִיָּ֣ה וְ/צַלְמָ֔וֶת בְּ/אֶ֗רֶץ לֹֽא עָ֤בַר בָּ/הּ֙ אִ֔ישׁ וְ/לֹֽא יָשַׁ֥ב אָדָ֖ם שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vl' 'mrv 'yh yhvh hm'lh 'tnv m'rts mtsrym hmvlykh 'tnv bmdbr b'rts 'rbh vshvchh b'rts tsyh vtslmvt b'rts l' 'br bh 'ysh vl' yshb 'dm shm
verses.translation: Neither said they, Where is the LORD that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, that led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought, and of the shadow of death, through a land that no man passed through, and where no man dwelt?

verses.original: וָ/אָבִ֤יא אֶתְ/כֶם֙ אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ הַ/כַּרְמֶ֔ל לֶ/אֱכֹ֥ל פִּרְיָ֖/הּ וְ/טוּבָ֑/הּ וַ/תָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ וַ/תְּטַמְּא֣וּ אֶת אַרְצִ֔/י וְ/נַחֲלָתִ֥/י שַׂמְתֶּ֖ם לְ/תוֹעֵבָֽה
verses.translit: v'by' 'tkhm 'l 'rts hkhrml l'khl pryh vtvbh vtb'v vttm'v 't 'rtsy vnchlty shmtm ltv'bh
verses.translation: And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when ye entered, ye defiled my land, and made mine heritage an abomination.

verses.original: הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֗ים לֹ֤א אָֽמְרוּ֙ אַיֵּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה וְ/תֹפְשֵׂ֤י הַ/תּוֹרָה֙ לֹ֣א יְדָע֔וּ/נִי וְ/הָ/רֹעִ֖ים פָּ֣שְׁעוּ בִ֑/י וְ/הַ/נְּבִיאִים֙ נִבְּא֣וּ בַ/בַּ֔עַל וְ/אַחֲרֵ֥י לֹֽא יוֹעִ֖לוּ הָלָֽכוּ
verses.translit: hkhhnym l' 'mrv 'yh yhvh vtpshy htvrh l' yd'vny vhr'ym psh'v by vhnby'ym nb'v bb'l v'chry l' yv'lv hlkhv
verses.translation: The priests said not, Where is the LORD ? and they that handle the law knew me not: the pastors also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן עֹ֛ד אָרִ֥יב אִתְּ/כֶ֖ם נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וְ/אֶת בְּנֵ֥י בְנֵי/כֶ֖ם אָרִֽיב
verses.translit: lkhn 'd 'ryb 'tkhm n'm yhvh v't bny bnykhm 'ryb
verses.translation: Wherefore I will yet plead with you, saith the LORD , and with your children’s children will I plead.

verses.original: כִּ֣י עִבְר֞וּ אִיֵּ֤י כִתִּיִּים֙ וּ/רְא֔וּ וְ/קֵדָ֛ר שִׁלְח֥וּ וְ/הִֽתְבּוֹנְנ֖וּ מְאֹ֑ד וּ/רְא֕וּ הֵ֥ן הָיְתָ֖ה כָּ/זֹֽאת
verses.translit: khy 'brv 'yy khtyym vr'v vqdr shlchv vhtbvnnv m'd vr'v hn hyth khz't
verses.translation: For pass over the isles of Chittim, and see; and send unto Kedar, and consider diligently, and see if there be such a thing.

verses.original: הַ/הֵימִ֥יר גּוֹי֙ אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְ/הֵ֖מָּה לֹ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/עַמִּ֛/י הֵמִ֥יר כְּבוֹד֖/וֹ בְּ/ל֥וֹא יוֹעִֽיל
verses.translit: hhymyr gvy 'lhym vhmh l' 'lhym v'my hmyr khbvdv blv' yv'yl
verses.translation: Hath a nation changed their gods, which are yet no gods? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit.

verses.original: שֹׁ֥מּוּ שָׁמַ֖יִם עַל זֹ֑את וְ/שַׂעֲר֛וּ חָרְב֥וּ מְאֹ֖ד נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: shmv shmym 'l z't vsh'rv chrbv m'd n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, saith the LORD .

verses.original: כִּֽי שְׁתַּ֥יִם רָע֖וֹת עָשָׂ֣ה עַמִּ֑/י אֹתִ֨/י עָזְב֜וּ מְק֣וֹר מַ֣יִם חַיִּ֗ים לַ/חְצֹ֤ב לָ/הֶם֙ בֹּאר֔וֹת בֹּארֹת֙ נִשְׁבָּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא יָכִ֖לוּ הַ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: khy shtym r'vt 'shh 'my 'ty 'zbv mqvr mym chyym lchtsb lhm b'rvt b'rt nshbrym 'shr l' ykhlv hmym
verses.translation: For my people have committed two evils; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters, and hewed them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.

verses.original: הַ/עֶ֨בֶד֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִם יְלִ֥יד בַּ֖יִת ה֑וּא מַדּ֖וּעַ הָיָ֥ה לָ/בַֽז
verses.translit: h'bd yshr'l 'm ylyd byt hv' mdv' hyh lbz
verses.translation: Is Israel a servant? is he a homeborn slave ? why is he spoiled?

verses.original: עָלָי/ו֙ יִשְׁאֲג֣וּ כְפִרִ֔ים נָתְנ֖וּ קוֹלָ֑/ם וַ/יָּשִׁ֤יתוּ אַרְצ/וֹ֙ לְ/שַׁמָּ֔ה עָרָ֥י/ו נצתה נִצְּת֖וּ מִ/בְּלִ֥י יֹשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: 'lyv ysh'gv khprym ntnv qvlm vyshytv 'rtsv lshmh 'ryv ntsth ntstv mbly yshb
verses.translation: The young lions roared upon him, and yelled, and they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant.

verses.original: גַּם בְּנֵי נֹ֖ף ו/תחפנס וְ/תַחְפַּנְחֵ֑ס יִרְע֖וּ/ךְ קָדְקֹֽד
verses.translit: gm bny nf vtchpns vtchpnchs yr'vkh qdqd
verses.translation: Also the children of Noph and Tahapanes have broken the crown of thy head.

verses.original: הֲ/לוֹא זֹ֖את תַּעֲשֶׂה לָּ֑/ךְ עָזְבֵ/ךְ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֔יִ/ךְ בְּ/עֵ֖ת מוֹלִיכֵ֥/ךְ בַּ/דָּֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: hlv' z't t'shh lkh 'zbkh 't yhvh 'lhykh b't mvlykhkh bdrkh
verses.translation: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself, in that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, when he led thee by the way?

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה מַה לָּ/ךְ֙ לְ/דֶ֣רֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִ/שְׁתּ֖וֹת מֵ֣י שִׁח֑וֹר וּ/מַה לָּ/ךְ֙ לְ/דֶ֣רֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר לִ/שְׁתּ֖וֹת מֵ֥י נָהָֽר
verses.translit: v'th mh lkh ldrkh mtsrym lshtvt my shchvr vmh lkh ldrkh 'shvr lshtvt my nhr
verses.translation: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt, to drink the waters of Sihor? or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria, to drink the waters of the river?

verses.original: תְּיַסְּרֵ֣/ךְ רָעָתֵ֗/ךְ וּ/מְשֻֽׁבוֹתַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ תּוֹכִחֻ֔/ךְ וּ/דְעִ֤י וּ/רְאִי֙ כִּי רַ֣ע וָ/מָ֔ר עָזְבֵ֖/ךְ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יִ/ךְ וְ/לֹ֤א פַחְדָּתִ/י֙ אֵלַ֔יִ/ךְ נְאֻם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִ֖ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: tysrkh r'tkh vmshbvtykh tvkhchkh vd'y vr'y khy r' vmr 'zbkh 't yhvh 'lhykh vl' pchdty 'lykh n'm 'dny yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Thine own wickedness shall correct thee, and thy backslidings shall reprove thee: know therefore and see that it is an evil thing and bitter, that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, and that my fear is not in thee, saith the Lord GOD of hosts.

verses.original: כִּ֣י מֵ/עוֹלָ֞ם שָׁבַ֣רְתִּי עֻלֵּ֗/ךְ נִתַּ֨קְתִּי֙ מוֹסְרֹתַ֔יִ/ךְ וַ/תֹּאמְרִ֖י לֹ֣א אעבד אֶעֱב֑וֹר כִּ֣י עַֽל כָּל גִּבְעָ֞ה גְּבֹהָ֗ה וְ/תַ֨חַת֙ כָּל עֵ֣ץ רַעֲנָ֔ן אַ֖תְּ צֹעָ֥ה זֹנָֽה
verses.translit: khy m'vlm shbrty 'lkh ntqty mvsrtykh vt'mry l' ''bd ''bvr khy 'l khl gb'h gbhh vtcht khl 'ts r'nn 't ts'h znh
verses.translation: For of old time I have broken thy yoke, and burst thy bands; and thou saidst, I will not transgress; when upon every high hill and under every green tree thou wanderest, playing the harlot.

verses.original: וְ/אָֽנֹכִי֙ נְטַעְתִּ֣י/ךְ שֹׂרֵ֔ק כֻּלֹּ֖/ה זֶ֣רַע אֱמֶ֑ת וְ/אֵיךְ֙ נֶהְפַּ֣כְתְּ לִ֔/י סוּרֵ֖י הַ/גֶּ֥פֶן נָכְרִיָּֽה
verses.translit: v'nkhy nt'tykh shrq khlh zr' 'mt v'ykh nhpkht ly svry hgpn nkhryh
verses.translation: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִם תְּכַבְּסִי֙ בַּ/נֶּ֔תֶר וְ/תַרְבִּי לָ֖/ךְ בֹּרִ֑ית נִכְתָּ֤ם עֲוֺנֵ/ךְ֙ לְ/פָנַ֔/י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥/י יְהוִֽה
verses.translit: khy 'm tkhbsy bntr vtrby lkh bryt nkhtm 'vnkh lpny n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: For though thou wash thee with nitre, and take thee much soap, yet thine iniquity is marked before me, saith the Lord GOD .

verses.original: אֵ֣יךְ תֹּאמְרִ֞י לֹ֣א נִטְמֵ֗אתִי אַחֲרֵ֤י הַ/בְּעָלִים֙ לֹ֣א הָלַ֔כְתִּי רְאִ֤י דַרְכֵּ/ךְ֙ בַּ/גַּ֔יְא דְּעִ֖י מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֑ית בִּכְרָ֥ה קַלָּ֖ה מְשָׂרֶ֥כֶת דְּרָכֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: 'ykh t'mry l' ntm'ty 'chry hb'lym l' hlkhty r'y drkhkh bgy' d'y mh 'shyt bkhrh qlh mshrkht drkhyh
verses.translation: How canst thou say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim? see thy way in the valley, know what thou hast done: thou art a swift dromedary traversing her ways;

verses.original: פֶּ֣רֶה לִמֻּ֣ד מִדְבָּ֗ר בְּ/אַוַּ֤ת נפש/ו נַפְשָׁ/הּ֙ שָׁאֲפָ֣ה ר֔וּחַ תַּאֲנָתָ֖/הּ מִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶ֑/נָּה כָּל מְבַקְשֶׁ֨י/הָ֙ לֹ֣א יִיעָ֔פוּ בְּ/חָדְשָׁ֖/הּ יִמְצָאֽוּ/נְהָ
verses.translit: prh lmd mdbr b'vt npshv npshh sh'ph rvch t'nth my yshybnh khl mbqshyh l' yy'pv bchdshh ymts'vnh
verses.translation: A wild ass used to the wilderness, that snuffeth up the wind at her pleasure; in her occasion who can turn her away? all they that seek her will not weary themselves; in her month they shall find her.

verses.original: מִנְעִ֤י רַגְלֵ/ךְ֙ מִ/יָּחֵ֔ף ו/גורנ/ך וּ/גְרוֹנֵ֖/ךְ מִ/צִּמְאָ֑ה וַ/תֹּאמְרִ֣י נוֹאָ֔שׁ ל֕וֹא כִּֽי אָהַ֥בְתִּי זָרִ֖ים וְ/אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֥ם אֵלֵֽךְ
verses.translit: mn'y rglkh mychf vgvrnkh vgrvnkh mtsm'h vt'mry nv'sh lv' khy 'hbty zrym v'chryhm 'lkh
verses.translation: Withhold thy foot from being unshod, and thy throat from thirst: but thou saidst, There is no hope: no; for I have loved strangers, and after them will I go.

verses.original: כְּ/בֹ֤שֶׁת גַּנָּב֙ כִּ֣י יִמָּצֵ֔א כֵּ֥ן הֹבִ֖ישׁוּ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֵ֤מָּה מַלְכֵי/הֶם֙ שָֽׂרֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/כֹהֲנֵי/הֶ֖ם וּ/נְבִיאֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khbsht gnb khy ymts' khn hbyshv byt yshr'l hmh mlkhyhm shryhm vkhhnyhm vnby'yhm
verses.translation: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets,

verses.original: אֹמְרִ֨ים לָ/עֵ֜ץ אָ֣בִ/י אַ֗תָּה וְ/לָ/אֶ֨בֶן֙ אַ֣תְּ ילדת/ני יְלִדְתָּ֔/נוּ כִּֽי פָנ֥וּ אֵלַ֛/י עֹ֖רֶף וְ/לֹ֣א פָנִ֑ים וּ/בְ/עֵ֤ת רָֽעָתָ/ם֙ יֹֽאמְר֔וּ ק֖וּמָ/ה וְ/הוֹשִׁיעֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: 'mrym l'ts 'by 'th vl'bn 't yldtny yldtnv khy pnv 'ly 'rf vl' pnym vb't r'tm y'mrv qvmh vhvshy'nv
verses.translation: Saying to a stock, Thou art my father; and to a stone, Thou hast brought me forth: for they have turned their back unto me, and not their face: but in the time of their trouble they will say, Arise, and save us.

verses.original: וְ/אַיֵּ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֣יתָ לָּ֔/ךְ יָק֕וּמוּ אִם יוֹשִׁיע֖וּ/ךָ בְּ/עֵ֣ת רָעָתֶ֑/ךָ כִּ֚י מִסְפַּ֣ר עָרֶ֔י/ךָ הָי֥וּ אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: v'yh 'lhykh 'shr 'shyt lkh yqvmv 'm yvshy'vkh b't r'tkh khy mspr 'rykh hyv 'lhykh yhvdh
verses.translation: But where are thy gods that thou hast made thee? let them arise, if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble: for according to the number of thy cities are thy gods, O Judah.

verses.original: לָ֥/מָּה תָרִ֖יבוּ אֵלָ֑/י כֻּלְּ/כֶ֛ם פְּשַׁעְתֶּ֥ם בִּ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: lmh trybv 'ly khlkhm psh'tm by n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Wherefore will ye plead with me? ye all have transgressed against me, saith the LORD .

verses.original: לַ/שָּׁוְא֙ הִכֵּ֣יתִי אֶת בְּנֵי/כֶ֔ם מוּסָ֖ר לֹ֣א לָקָ֑חוּ אָכְלָ֧ה חַרְבְּ/כֶ֛ם נְבִֽיאֵי/כֶ֖ם כְּ/אַרְיֵ֥ה מַשְׁחִֽית
verses.translit: lshv' hkhyty 't bnykhm mvsr l' lqchv 'khlh chrbkhm nby'ykhm kh'ryh mshchyt
verses.translation: In vain have I smitten your children; they received no correction: your own sword hath devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.

verses.original: הַ/דּ֗וֹר אַתֶּם֙ רְא֣וּ דְבַר יְהוָ֔ה הֲ/מִדְבָּ֤ר הָיִ֨יתִי֙ לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֛ם אֶ֥רֶץ מַאְפֵּ֖לְיָ֑ה מַדּ֜וּעַ אָמְר֤וּ עַמִּ/י֙ רַ֔דְנוּ לֽוֹא נָב֥וֹא ע֖וֹד אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: hdvr 'tm r'v dbr yhvh hmdbr hyyty lyshr'l 'm 'rts m'plyh mdv' 'mrv 'my rdnv lv' nbv' 'vd 'lykh
verses.translation: O generation, see ye the word of the LORD . Have I been a wilderness unto Israel? a land of darkness? wherefore say my people, We are lords; we will come no more unto thee?

verses.original: הֲ/תִשְׁכַּ֤ח בְּתוּלָה֙ עֶדְיָ֔/הּ כַּלָּ֖ה קִשֻּׁרֶ֑י/הָ וְ/עַמִּ֣/י שְׁכֵח֔וּ/נִי יָמִ֖ים אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר
verses.translit: htshkhch btvlh 'dyh khlh qshryh v'my shkhchvny ymym 'yn mspr
verses.translation: Can a maid forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? yet my people have forgotten me days without number.

verses.original: מַה תֵּיטִ֥בִי דַּרְכֵּ֖/ךְ לְ/בַקֵּ֣שׁ אַהֲבָ֑ה לָ/כֵן֙ גַּ֣ם אֶת הָ/רָע֔וֹת למדתי לִמַּ֖דְתְּ אֶת דְּרָכָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: mh tytby drkhkh lbqsh 'hbh lkhn gm 't hr'vt lmdty lmdt 't drkhykh
verses.translation: Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways.

verses.original: גַּ֤ם בִּ/כְנָפַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ נִמְצְא֔וּ דַּ֛ם נַפְשׁ֥וֹת אֶבְיוֹנִ֖ים נְקִיִּ֑ים לֹֽא בַ/מַּחְתֶּ֥רֶת מְצָאתִ֖י/ם כִּ֥י עַל כָּל אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: gm bkhnpykh nmts'v dm npshvt 'byvnym nqyym l' bmchtrt mts'tym khy 'l khl 'lh
verses.translation: Also in thy skirts is found the blood of the souls of the poor innocents: I have not found it by secret search, but upon all these.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּֽאמְרִי֙ כִּ֣י נִקֵּ֔יתִי אַ֛ךְ שָׁ֥ב אַפּ֖/וֹ מִמֶּ֑/נִּי הִנְ/נִי֙ נִשְׁפָּ֣ט אוֹתָ֔/ךְ עַל אָמְרֵ֖/ךְ לֹ֥א חָטָֽאתִי
verses.translit: vt'mry khy nqyty 'kh shb 'pv mmny hnny nshpt 'vtkh 'l 'mrkh l' cht'ty
verses.translation: Yet thou sayest, Because I am innocent, surely his anger shall turn from me. Behold, I will plead with thee, because thou sayest, I have not sinned.

verses.original: מַה תֵּזְלִ֥י מְאֹ֖ד לְ/שַׁנּ֣וֹת אֶת דַּרְכֵּ֑/ךְ גַּ֤ם מִ/מִּצְרַ֨יִם֙ תֵּב֔וֹשִׁי כַּ/אֲשֶׁר בֹּ֖שְׁתְּ מֵ/אַשּֽׁוּר
verses.translit: mh tzly m'd lshnvt 't drkhkh gm mmtsrym tbvshy kh'shr bsht m'shvr
verses.translation: Why gaddest thou about so much to change thy way? thou also shalt be ashamed of Egypt, as thou wast ashamed of Assyria.

verses.original: גַּ֣ם מֵ/אֵ֥ת זֶה֙ תֵּֽצְאִ֔י וְ/יָדַ֖יִ/ךְ עַל רֹאשֵׁ֑/ךְ כִּֽי מָאַ֤ס יְהֹוָה֙ בְּ/מִבְטַחַ֔יִ/ךְ וְ/לֹ֥א תַצְלִ֖יחִי לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: gm m't zh tts'y vydykh 'l r'shkh khy m's yhvh bmbtchykh vl' ttslychy lhm
verses.translation: Yea, thou shalt go forth from him, and thine hands upon thine head: for the LORD hath rejected thy confidences, and thou shalt not prosper in them.

verses.original: לֵ/אמֹ֡ר הֵ֣ן יְשַׁלַּ֣ח אִ֣ישׁ אֶת אִשְׁתּ/וֹ֩ וְ/הָלְכָ֨ה מֵ/אִתּ֜/וֹ וְ/הָיְתָ֣ה לְ/אִישׁ אַחֵ֗ר הֲ/יָשׁ֤וּב אֵלֶ֨י/הָ֙ ע֔וֹד הֲ/ל֛וֹא חָנ֥וֹף תֶּחֱנַ֖ף הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/הִ֑יא וְ/אַ֗תְּ זָנִית֙ רֵעִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים וְ/שׁ֥וֹב אֵלַ֖/י נְאֻם יְהֹוָֽה
verses.translit: l'mr hn yshlch 'ysh 't 'shtv vhlkhh m'tv vhyth l'ysh 'chr hyshvb 'lyh 'vd hlv' chnvf tchnf h'rts hhy' v't znyt r'ym rbym vshvb 'ly n'm yhvh
verses.translation: They say, If a man put away his wife, and she go from him, and become another man’s, shall he return unto her again? shall not that land be greatly polluted? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers; yet return again to me, saith the LORD .

verses.original: שְׂאִֽי עֵינַ֨יִ/ךְ עַל שְׁפָיִ֜ם וּ/רְאִ֗י אֵיפֹה֙ לֹ֣א שגלת שֻׁכַּ֔בְתְּ עַל דְּרָכִים֙ יָשַׁ֣בְתְּ לָ/הֶ֔ם כַּ/עֲרָבִ֖י בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר וַ/תַּחֲנִ֣יפִי אֶ֔רֶץ בִּ/זְנוּתַ֖יִ/ךְ וּ/בְ/רָעָתֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: sh'y 'ynykh 'l shpym vr'y 'yph l' shglt shkhbt 'l drkhym yshbt lhm kh'rby bmdbr vtchnypy 'rts bznvtykh vbr'tkh
verses.translation: Lift up thine eyes unto the high places, and see where thou hast not been lien with. In the ways hast thou sat for them, as the Arabian in the wilderness; and thou hast polluted the land with thy whoredoms and with thy wickedness.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמָּנְע֣וּ רְבִבִ֔ים וּ/מַלְק֖וֹשׁ ל֣וֹא הָיָ֑ה וּ/מֵ֨צַח אִשָּׁ֤ה זוֹנָה֙ הָ֣יָה לָ֔/ךְ מֵאַ֖נְתְּ הִכָּלֵֽם
verses.translit: vymn'v rbbym vmlqvsh lv' hyh vmtsch 'shh zvnh hyh lkh m'nt hkhlm
verses.translation: Therefore the showers have been withholden, and there hath been no latter rain; and thou hadst a whore’s forehead, thou refusedst to be ashamed.

verses.original: הֲ/ל֣וֹא מֵ/עַ֔תָּה קראתי קָרָ֥את לִ֖/י אָבִ֑/י אַלּ֥וּף נְעֻרַ֖/י אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: hlv' m'th qr'ty qr't ly 'by 'lvf n'ry 'th
verses.translation: Wilt thou not from this time cry unto me, My father, thou art the guide of my youth?

verses.original: הֲ/יִנְטֹ֣ר לְ/עוֹלָ֔ם אִם יִשְׁמֹ֖ר לָ/נֶ֑צַח הִנֵּ֥ה דברתי דִבַּ֛רְתְּ וַ/תַּעֲשִׂ֥י הָ/רָע֖וֹת וַ/תּוּכָֽל
verses.translit: hyntr l'vlm 'm yshmr lntsch hnh dbrty dbrt vt'shy hr'vt vtvkhl
verses.translation: Will he reserve his anger for ever? will he keep it to the end? Behold, thou hast spoken and done evil things as thou couldest.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗/י בִּ/ימֵי֙ יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ הַ/מֶּ֔לֶךְ הֲֽ/רָאִ֔יתָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשְׂתָ֖ה מְשֻׁבָ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֹלְכָ֨ה הִ֜יא עַל כָּל הַ֣ר גָּבֹ֗הַּ וְ/אֶל תַּ֛חַת כָּל עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָ֖ן וַ/תִּזְנִי שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly bymy y'shyhv hmlkh hr'yt 'shr 'shth mshbh yshr'l hlkhh hy' 'l khl hr gbh v'l tcht khl 'ts r'nn vtzny shm
verses.translation: The LORD said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king, Hast thou seen that which backsliding Israel hath done? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree, and there hath played the harlot.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֗ר אַחֲרֵ֨י עֲשׂוֹתָ֧/הּ אֶת כָּל אֵ֛לֶּה אֵלַ֥/י תָּשׁ֖וּב וְ/לֹא שָׁ֑בָה ו/תראה וַ/תֵּ֛רֶא בָּגוֹדָ֥ה אֲחוֹתָ֖/הּ יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: v'mr 'chry 'shvth 't khl 'lh 'ly tshvb vl' shbh vtr'h vtr' bgvdh 'chvth yhvdh
verses.translation: And I said after she had done all these things , Turn thou unto me. But she returned not. And her treacherous sister Judah saw it .

verses.original: וָ/אֵ֗רֶא כִּ֤י עַל כָּל אֹדוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִֽאֲפָה֙ מְשֻׁבָ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁלַּחְתִּ֕י/הָ וָ/אֶתֵּ֛ן אֶת סֵ֥פֶר כְּרִיתֻתֶ֖י/הָ אֵלֶ֑י/הָ וְ/לֹ֨א יָֽרְאָ֜ה בֹּֽגֵדָ֤ה יְהוּדָה֙ אֲחוֹתָ֔/הּ וַ/תֵּ֖לֶךְ וַ/תִּ֥זֶן גַּם הִֽיא
verses.translit: v'r' khy 'l khl 'dvt 'shr n'ph mshbh yshr'l shlchtyh v'tn 't spr khryttyh 'lyh vl' yr'h bgdh yhvdh 'chvth vtlkh vtzn gm hy'
verses.translation: And I saw, when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not, but went and played the harlot also.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ מִ/קֹּ֣ל זְנוּתָ֔/הּ וַ/תֶּחֱנַ֖ף אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/תִּנְאַ֥ף אֶת הָ/אֶ֖בֶן וְ/אֶת הָ/עֵֽץ
verses.translit: vhyh mql znvth vtchnf 't h'rts vtn'f 't h'bn v't h'ts
verses.translation: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom, that she defiled the land, and committed adultery with stones and with stocks.

verses.original: וְ/גַם בְּ/כָל זֹ֗את לֹא שָׁ֨בָה אֵלַ֜/י בָּגוֹדָ֧ה אֲחוֹתָ֛/הּ יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּ/כָל לִבָּ֑/הּ כִּ֥י אִם בְּ/שֶׁ֖קֶר נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vgm bkhl z't l' shbh 'ly bgvdh 'chvth yhvdh bkhl lbh khy 'm bshqr n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And yet for all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not turned unto me with her whole heart, but feignedly, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔/י צִדְּקָ֥ה נַפְשָׁ֖/הּ מְשֻׁבָ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ/בֹּגֵדָ֖ה יְהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly tsdqh npshh mshbh yshr'l mbgdh yhvdh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me, The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah.

verses.original: הָלֹ֡ךְ וְ/קָֽרָאתָ֩ אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֨ים הָ/אֵ֜לֶּה צָפ֗וֹנָ/ה וְ֠/אָמַרְתָּ שׁ֣וּבָ/ה מְשֻׁבָ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה לֽוֹא אַפִּ֥יל פָּנַ֖/י בָּ/כֶ֑ם כִּֽי חָסִ֤יד אֲנִי֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה לֹ֥א אֶטּ֖וֹר לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: hlkh vqr't 't hdbrym h'lh tspvnh v'mrt shvbh mshbh yshr'l n'm yhvh lv' 'pyl pny bkhm khy chsyd 'ny n'm yhvh l' 'tvr l'vlm
verses.translation: Go and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, Return, thou backsliding Israel, saith the LORD ; and I will not cause mine anger to fall upon you: for I am merciful, saith the LORD , and I will not keep anger for ever.

verses.original: אַ֚ךְ דְּעִ֣י עֲוֺנֵ֔/ךְ כִּ֛י בַּ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהַ֖יִ/ךְ פָּשָׁ֑עַתְּ וַ/תְּפַזְּרִ֨י אֶת דְּרָכַ֜יִ/ךְ לַ/זָּרִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת כָּל עֵ֣ץ רַעֲנָ֔ן וּ/בְ/קוֹלִ֥/י לֹא שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם נְאֻם יְהֹוָֽה
verses.translit: 'kh d'y 'vnkh khy byhvh 'lhykh psh't vtpzry 't drkhykh lzrym tcht khl 'ts r'nn vbqvly l' shm'tm n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Only acknowledge thine iniquity, that thou hast transgressed against the LORD thy God, and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree, and ye have not obeyed my voice, saith the LORD .

verses.original: שׁ֣וּבוּ בָנִ֤ים שׁוֹבָבִים֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י אָנֹכִ֖י בָּעַ֣לְתִּי בָ/כֶ֑ם וְ/לָקַחְתִּ֨י אֶתְ/כֶ֜ם אֶחָ֣ד מֵ/עִ֗יר וּ/שְׁנַ֨יִם֙ מִ/מִּשְׁפָּחָ֔ה וְ/הֵבֵאתִ֥י אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם צִיּֽוֹן
verses.translit: shvbv bnym shvbbym n'm yhvh khy 'nkhy b'lty bkhm vlqchty 'tkhm 'chd m'yr vshnym mmshpchh vhb'ty 'tkhm tsyvn
verses.translation: Turn, O backsliding children, saith the LORD ; for I am married unto you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion:

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י לָ/כֶ֛ם רֹעִ֖ים כְּ/לִבִּ֑/י וְ/רָע֥וּ אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם דֵּעָ֥ה וְ/הַשְׂכֵּֽיל
verses.translit: vntty lkhm r'ym khlby vr'v 'tkhm d'h vhshkhyl
verses.translation: And I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֡ה כִּ֣י תִרְבּוּ֩ וּ/פְרִיתֶ֨ם בָּ/אָ֜רֶץ בַּ/יָּמִ֤ים הָ/הֵ֨מָּה֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה לֹא יֹ֣אמְרוּ ע֗וֹד אֲרוֹן֙ בְּרִית יְהוָ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א יַעֲלֶ֖ה עַל לֵ֑ב וְ/לֹ֤א יִזְכְּרוּ ב/וֹ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יִפְקֹ֔דוּ וְ/לֹ֥א יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה עֽוֹד
verses.translit: vhyh khy trbv vprytm b'rts bymym hhmh n'm yhvh l' y'mrv 'vd 'rvn bryt yhvh vl' y'lh 'l lb vl' yzkhrv bv vl' ypqdv vl' y'shh 'vd
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when ye be multiplied and increased in the land, in those days, saith the LORD , they shall say no more, The ark of the covenant of the LORD : neither shall it come to mind: neither shall they remember it; neither shall they visit it; neither shall that be done any more.

verses.original: בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֗יא יִקְרְא֤וּ לִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ כִּסֵּ֣א יְהוָ֔ה וְ/נִקְוּ֨וּ אֵלֶ֧י/הָ כָֽל הַ/גּוֹיִ֛ם לְ/שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה לִ/ירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/לֹא יֵלְכ֣וּ ע֔וֹד אַחֲרֵ֕י שְׁרִר֖וּת לִבָּ֥/ם הָ/רָֽע
verses.translit: b't hhy' yqr'v lyrvshlm khs' yhvh vnqvv 'lyh khl hgvym lshm yhvh lyrvshlm vl' ylkhv 'vd 'chry shrrvt lbm hr'
verses.translation: At that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of the LORD ; and all the nations shall be gathered unto it, to the name of the LORD , to Jerusalem: neither shall they walk any more after the imagination of their evil heart.

verses.original: בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֔מָּה יֵלְכ֥וּ בֵית יְהוּדָ֖ה עַל בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/יָבֹ֤אוּ יַחְדָּו֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹן עַל הָ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִנְחַ֖לְתִּי אֶת אֲבוֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: bymym hhmh ylkhv byt yhvdh 'l byt yshr'l vyb'v ychdv m'rts tspvn 'l h'rts 'shr hnchlty 't 'bvtykhm
verses.translation: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers.

verses.original: וְ/אָנֹכִ֣י אָמַ֗רְתִּי אֵ֚יךְ אֲשִׁיתֵ֣/ךְ בַּ/בָּנִ֔ים וְ/אֶתֶּן לָ/ךְ֙ אֶ֣רֶץ חֶמְדָּ֔ה נַחֲלַ֥ת צְבִ֖י צִבְא֣וֹת גּוֹיִ֑ם וָ/אֹמַ֗ר אָבִ/י֙ תקראו תִּקְרְאִי לִ֔/י וּ/מֵ/אַחֲרַ֖/י לֹ֥א תשובו תָשֽׁוּבִי
verses.translit: v'nkhy 'mrty 'ykh 'shytkh bbnym v'tn lkh 'rts chmdh nchlt tsby tsb'vt gvym v'mr 'by tqr'v tqr'y ly vm'chry l' tshvbv tshvby
verses.translation: But I said, How shall I put thee among the children, and give thee a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations? and I said, Thou shalt call me, My father; and shalt not turn away from me.

verses.original: אָכֵ֛ן בָּגְדָ֥ה אִשָּׁ֖ה מֵ/רֵעָ֑/הּ כֵּ֣ן בְּגַדְתֶּ֥ם בִּ֛/י בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'khn bgdh 'shh mr'h khn bgdtm by byt yshr'l n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Surely as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband, so have ye dealt treacherously with me, O house of Israel, saith the LORD .

verses.original: ק֚וֹל עַל שְׁפָיִ֣ים נִשְׁמָ֔ע בְּכִ֥י תַחֲנוּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֤י הֶעֱוּוּ֙ אֶת דַּרְכָּ֔/ם שָׁכְח֖וּ אֶת יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: qvl 'l shpyym nshm' bkhy tchnvny bny yshr'l khy h'vv 't drkhm shkhchv 't yhvh 'lhyhm
verses.translation: A voice was heard upon the high places, weeping and supplications of the children of Israel: for they have perverted their way, and they have forgotten the LORD their God.

verses.original: שׁ֚וּבוּ בָּנִ֣ים שׁוֹבָבִ֔ים אֶרְפָּ֖ה מְשׁוּבֹֽתֵי/כֶ֑ם הִנְ/נוּ֙ אָתָ֣נוּ לָ֔/ךְ כִּ֥י אַתָּ֖ה יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: shvbv bnym shvbbym 'rph mshvbtykhm hnnv 'tnv lkh khy 'th yhvh 'lhynv
verses.translation: Return, ye backsliding children, and I will heal your backslidings. Behold, we come unto thee; for thou art the LORD our God.

verses.original: אָכֵ֥ן לַ/שֶּׁ֛קֶר מִ/גְּבָע֖וֹת הָמ֣וֹן הָרִ֑ים אָכֵן֙ בַּ/יהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ תְּשׁוּעַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 'khn lshqr mgb'vt hmvn hrym 'khn byhvh 'lhynv tshv't yshr'l
verses.translation: Truly in vain is salvation hoped for from the hills, and from the multitude of mountains: truly in the LORD our God is the salvation of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/בֹּ֗שֶׁת אָֽכְלָ֛ה אֶת יְגִ֥יעַ אֲבוֹתֵ֖י/נוּ מִ/נְּעוּרֵ֑י/נוּ אֶת צֹאנָ/ם֙ וְ/אֶת בְּקָרָ֔/ם אֶת בְּנֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/אֶת בְּנוֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vhbsht 'khlh 't ygy' 'bvtynv mn'vrynv 't ts'nm v't bqrm 't bnyhm v't bnvtyhm
verses.translation: For shame hath devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

verses.original: נִשְׁכְּבָ֣ה בְּ/בָשְׁתֵּ֗/נוּ וּֽ/תְכַסֵּ/נוּ֮ כְּלִמָּתֵ/נוּ֒ כִּי֩ לַ/יהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֜י/נוּ חָטָ֗אנוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ֙ וַ/אֲבוֹתֵ֔י/נוּ מִ/נְּעוּרֵ֖י/נוּ וְ/עַד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֔עְנוּ בְּ/ק֖וֹל יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: nshkhbh bbshtnv vtkhsnv khlmtnv khy lyhvh 'lhynv cht'nv 'nchnv v'bvtynv mn'vrynv v'd hyvm hzh vl' shm'nv bqvl yhvh 'lhynv
verses.translation: We lie down in our shame, and our confusion covereth us: for we have sinned against the LORD our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even unto this day, and have not obeyed the voice of the LORD our God.

verses.original: אִם תָּשׁ֨וּב יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל נְאֻם יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖/י תָּשׁ֑וּב וְ/אִם תָּסִ֧יר שִׁקּוּצֶ֛י/ךָ מִ/פָּנַ֖/י וְ/לֹ֥א תָנֽוּד
verses.translit: 'm tshvb yshr'l n'm yhvh 'ly tshvb v'm tsyr shqvtsykh mpny vl' tnvd
verses.translation: If thou wilt return, O Israel, saith the LORD , return unto me: and if thou wilt put away thine abominations out of my sight, then shalt thou not remove.

verses.original: וְ/נִשְׁבַּ֨עְתָּ֙ חַי יְהוָ֔ה בֶּ/אֱמֶ֖ת בְּ/מִשְׁפָּ֣ט וּ/בִ/צְדָקָ֑ה וְ/הִתְבָּ֥רְכוּ ב֛/וֹ גּוֹיִ֖ם וּ/ב֥/וֹ יִתְהַלָּֽלוּ
verses.translit: vnshb't chy yhvh b'mt bmshpt vbtsdqh vhtbrkhv bv gvym vbv ythllv
verses.translation: And thou shalt swear, The LORD liveth, in truth, in judgment, and in righteousness; and the nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.

verses.original: כִּי כֹ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה לְ/אִ֤ישׁ יְהוּדָה֙ וְ/לִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם נִ֥ירוּ לָ/כֶ֖ם נִ֑יר וְ/אַֽל תִּזְרְע֖וּ אֶל קוֹצִֽים
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh l'ysh yhvdh vlyrvshlm nyrv lkhm nyr v'l tzr'v 'l qvtsym
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD to the men of Judah and Jerusalem, Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns.

verses.original: הִמֹּ֣לוּ לַ/יהֹוָ֗ה וְ/הָסִ֨רוּ֙ עָרְל֣וֹת לְבַבְ/כֶ֔ם אִ֥ישׁ יְהוּדָ֖ה וְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם פֶּן תֵּצֵ֨א כָ/אֵ֜שׁ חֲמָתִ֗/י וּ/בָעֲרָה֙ וְ/אֵ֣ין מְכַבֶּ֔ה מִ/פְּנֵ֖י רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: hmlv lyhvh vhsrv 'rlvt lbbkhm 'ysh yhvdh vyshby yrvshlm pn tts' kh'sh chmty vb'rh v'yn mkhbh mpny r' m'llykhm
verses.translation: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD , and take away the foreskins of your heart, ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem: lest my fury come forth like fire, and burn that none can quench it , because of the evil of your doings.

verses.original: הַגִּ֣ידוּ בִֽ/יהוּדָ֗ה וּ/בִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ הַשְׁמִ֔יעוּ וְ/אִמְר֕וּ ו/תקעו תִּקְע֥וּ שׁוֹפָ֖ר בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ קִרְא֤וּ מַלְאוּ֙ וְ/אִמְר֔וּ הֵאָסְפ֥וּ וְ/נָב֖וֹאָה אֶל עָרֵ֥י הַ/מִּבְצָֽר
verses.translit: hgydv byhvdh vbyrvshlm hshmy'v v'mrv vtq'v tq'v shvpr b'rts qr'v ml'v v'mrv h'spv vnbv'h 'l 'ry hmbtsr
verses.translation: Declare ye in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, Blow ye the trumpet in the land: cry, gather together, and say, Assemble yourselves, and let us go into the defenced cities.

verses.original: שְׂאוּ נֵ֣ס צִיּ֔וֹנָ/ה הָעִ֖יזוּ אַֽל תַּעֲמֹ֑דוּ כִּ֣י רָעָ֗ה אָנֹכִ֛י מֵבִ֥יא מִ/צָּפ֖וֹן וְ/שֶׁ֥בֶר גָּדֽוֹל
verses.translit: sh'v ns tsyvnh h'yzv 'l t'mdv khy r'h 'nkhy mby' mtspvn vshbr gdvl
verses.translation: Set up the standard toward Zion: retire, stay not: for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.

verses.original: עָלָ֤ה אַרְיֵה֙ מִֽ/סֻּבְּכ֔/וֹ וּ/מַשְׁחִ֣ית גּוֹיִ֔ם נָסַ֖ע יָצָ֣א מִ/מְּקֹמ֑/וֹ לָ/שׂ֤וּם אַרְצֵ/ךְ֙ לְ/שַׁמָּ֔ה עָרַ֥יִ/ךְ תִּצֶּ֖ינָה מֵ/אֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: 'lh 'ryh msbkhv vmshchyt gvym ns' yts' mmqmv lshvm 'rtskh lshmh 'rykh ttsynh m'yn yvshb
verses.translation: The lion is come up from his thicket, and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate; and thy cities shall be laid waste, without an inhabitant.

verses.original: עַל זֹ֛את חִגְר֥וּ שַׂקִּ֖ים סִפְד֣וּ וְ/הֵילִ֑ילוּ כִּ֥י לֹא שָׁ֛ב חֲר֥וֹן אַף יְהֹוָ֖ה מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: 'l z't chgrv shqym spdv vhylylv khy l' shb chrvn 'f yhvh mmnv
verses.translation: For this gird you with sackcloth, lament and howl: for the fierce anger of the LORD is not turned back from us.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֤ה בַ/יּוֹם הַ/הוּא֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה יֹאבַ֥ד לֵב הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ וְ/לֵ֣ב הַ/שָּׂרִ֑ים וְ/נָשַׁ֨מּוּ֙ הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וְ/הַ/נְּבִיאִ֖ים יִתְמָֽהוּ
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' n'm yhvh y'bd lb hmlkh vlb hshrym vnshmv hkhhnym vhnby'ym ytmhv
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass at that day, saith the LORD , that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֞ר אֲהָ֣הּ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה אָכֵן֩ הַשֵּׁ֨א הִשֵּׁ֜אתָ לָ/עָ֤ם הַ/זֶּה֙ וְ/לִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֣ם לֵ/אמֹ֔ר שָׁל֖וֹם יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֑ם וְ/נָגְעָ֥ה חֶ֖רֶב עַד הַ/נָּֽפֶשׁ
verses.translit: v'mr 'hh 'dny yhvh 'khn hsh' hsh't l'm hzh vlyrvshlm l'mr shlvm yhyh lkhm vng'h chrb 'd hnpsh
verses.translation: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD ! surely thou hast greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall have peace; whereas the sword reacheth unto the soul.

verses.original: בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֗יא יֵאָמֵ֤ר לָֽ/עָם הַ/זֶּה֙ וְ/לִ/יר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם ר֣וּחַ צַ֤ח שְׁפָיִים֙ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר דֶּ֖רֶךְ בַּת עַמִּ֑/י ל֥וֹא לִ/זְר֖וֹת וְ/ל֥וֹא לְ/הָבַֽר
verses.translit: b't hhy' y'mr l'm hzh vlyrvshlm rvch tsch shpyym bmdbr drkh bt 'my lv' lzrvt vlv' lhbr
verses.translation: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to fan, nor to cleanse,

verses.original: ר֧וּחַ מָלֵ֛א מֵ/אֵ֖לֶּה יָ֣בוֹא לִ֑/י עַתָּ֕ה גַּם אֲנִ֛י אֲדַבֵּ֥ר מִשְׁפָּטִ֖ים אוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: rvch ml' m'lh ybv' ly 'th gm 'ny 'dbr mshptym 'vtm
verses.translation: Even a full wind from those places shall come unto me: now also will I give sentence against them.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה כַּ/עֲנָנִ֣ים יַעֲלֶ֗ה וְ/כַ/סּוּפָה֙ מַרְכְּבוֹתָ֔י/ו קַלּ֥וּ מִ/נְּשָׁרִ֖ים סוּסָ֑י/ו א֥וֹי לָ֖/נוּ כִּ֥י שֻׁדָּֽדְנוּ
verses.translit: hnh kh'nnym y'lh vkhsvph mrkhbvtyv qlv mnshrym svsyv 'vy lnv khy shddnv
verses.translation: Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots shall be as a whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe unto us! for we are spoiled.

verses.original: כַּבְּסִ֨י מֵ/רָעָ֤ה לִבֵּ/ךְ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לְמַ֖עַן תִּוָּשֵׁ֑עִי עַד מָתַ֛י תָּלִ֥ין בְּ/קִרְבֵּ֖/ךְ מַחְשְׁב֥וֹת אוֹנֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khbsy mr'h lbkh yrvshlm lm'n tvsh'y 'd mty tlyn bqrbkh mchshbvt 'vnkh
verses.translation: O Jerusalem, wash thine heart from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved. How long shall thy vain thoughts lodge within thee?

verses.original: כִּ֛י ק֥וֹל מַגִּ֖יד מִ/דָּ֑ן וּ/מַשְׁמִ֥יעַ אָ֖וֶן מֵ/הַ֥ר אֶפְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: khy qvl mgyd mdn vmshmy' 'vn mhr 'prym
verses.translation: For a voice declareth from Dan, and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim.

verses.original: הַזְכִּ֣ירוּ לַ/גּוֹיִ֗ם הִנֵּה֙ הַשְׁמִ֣יעוּ עַל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם נֹצְרִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ הַ/מֶּרְחָ֑ק וַֽ/יִּתְּנ֛וּ עַל עָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה קוֹלָֽ/ם
verses.translit: hzkhyrv lgvym hnh hshmy'v 'l yrvshlm ntsrym b'ym m'rts hmrchq vytnv 'l 'ry yhvdh qvlm
verses.translation: Make ye mention to the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem, that watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Judah.

verses.original: כְּ/שֹׁמְרֵ֣י שָׂדַ֔י הָי֥וּ עָלֶ֖י/הָ מִ/סָּבִ֑יב כִּי אֹתִ֥/י מָרָ֖תָה נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khshmry shdy hyv 'lyh msbyb khy 'ty mrth n'm yhvh
verses.translation: As keepers of a field, are they against her round about; because she hath been rebellious against me, saith the LORD .

verses.original: דַּרְכֵּ/ךְ֙ וּ/מַ֣עֲלָלַ֔יִ/ךְ עָשׂ֥וֹ אֵ֖לֶּה לָ֑/ךְ זֹ֤את רָעָתֵ/ךְ֙ כִּ֣י מָ֔ר כִּ֥י נָגַ֖ע עַד לִבֵּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: drkhkh vm'llykh 'shv 'lh lkh z't r'tkh khy mr khy ng' 'd lbkh
verses.translation: Thy way and thy doings have procured these things unto thee; this is thy wickedness, because it is bitter, because it reacheth unto thine heart.

verses.original: מֵעַ֣/י מֵעַ֨/י אחולה אוֹחִ֜ילָה קִיר֥וֹת לִבִּ֛/י הֹֽמֶה לִּ֥/י לִבִּ֖/י לֹ֣א אַחֲרִ֑ישׁ כִּ֣י ק֤וֹל שׁוֹפָר֙ שמעתי שָׁמַ֣עַתְּ נַפְשִׁ֔/י תְּרוּעַ֖ת מִלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: m'y m'y 'chvlh 'vchylh qyrvt lby hmh ly lby l' 'chrysh khy qvl shvpr shm'ty shm't npshy trv't mlchmh
verses.translation: My bowels, my bowels! I am pained at my very heart; my heart maketh a noise in me; I cannot hold my peace, because thou hast heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.

verses.original: שֶׁ֤בֶר עַל שֶׁ֨בֶר֙ נִקְרָ֔א כִּ֥י שֻׁדְּדָ֖ה כָּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ פִּתְאֹם֙ שֻׁדְּד֣וּ אֹהָלַ֔/י רֶ֖גַע יְרִיעֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: shbr 'l shbr nqr' khy shddh khl h'rts pt'm shddv 'hly rg' yry'ty
verses.translation: Destruction upon destruction is cried; for the whole land is spoiled: suddenly are my tents spoiled, and my curtains in a moment.

verses.original: עַד מָתַ֖י אֶרְאֶה נֵּ֑ס אֶשְׁמְעָ֖ה ק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר
verses.translit: 'd mty 'r'h ns 'shm'h qvl shvpr
verses.translation: How long shall I see the standard, and hear the sound of the trumpet?

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֱוִ֣יל עַמִּ֗/י אוֹתִ/י֙ לֹ֣א יָדָ֔עוּ בָּנִ֤ים סְכָלִים֙ הֵ֔מָּה וְ/לֹ֥א נְבוֹנִ֖ים הֵ֑מָּה חֲכָמִ֥ים הֵ֨מָּה֙ לְ/הָרַ֔ע וּ/לְ/הֵיטִ֖יב לֹ֥א יָדָֽעוּ
verses.translit: khy 'vyl 'my 'vty l' yd'v bnym skhlym hmh vl' nbvnym hmh chkhmym hmh lhr' vlhytyb l' yd'v
verses.translation: For my people is foolish, they have not known me; they are sottish children, and they have none understanding: they are wise to do evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.

verses.original: רָאִ֨יתִי֙ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/הִנֵּה תֹ֖הוּ וָ/בֹ֑הוּ וְ/אֶל הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וְ/אֵ֥ין אוֹרָֽ/ם
verses.translit: r'yty 't h'rts vhnh thv vbhv v'l hshmym v'yn 'vrm
verses.translation: I beheld the earth, and, lo, it was without form, and void; and the heavens, and they had no light.

verses.original: רָאִ֨יתִי֙ הֶֽ/הָרִ֔ים וְ/הִנֵּ֖ה רֹעֲשִׁ֑ים וְ/כָל הַ/גְּבָע֖וֹת הִתְקַלְקָֽלוּ
verses.translit: r'yty hhrym vhnh r'shym vkhl hgb'vt htqlqlv
verses.translation: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved lightly.

verses.original: רָאִ֕יתִי וְ/הִנֵּ֖ה אֵ֣ין הָ/אָדָ֑ם וְ/כָל ע֥וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם נָדָֽדוּ
verses.translit: r'yty vhnh 'yn h'dm vkhl 'vf hshmym nddv
verses.translation: I beheld, and, lo, there was no man, and all the birds of the heavens were fled.

verses.original: רָאִ֕יתִי וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה הַ/כַּרְמֶ֖ל הַ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר וְ/כָל עָרָ֗י/ו נִתְּצוּ֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מִ/פְּנֵ֖י חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: r'yty vhnh hkhrml hmdbr vkhl 'ryv nttsv mpny yhvh mpny chrvn 'pv
verses.translation: I beheld, and, lo, the fruitful place was a wilderness, and all the cities thereof were broken down at the presence of the LORD , and by his fierce anger.

verses.original: כִּי כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שְׁמָמָ֥ה תִהְיֶ֖ה כָּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/כָלָ֖ה לֹ֥א אֶעֱשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh shmmh thyh khl h'rts vkhlh l' ''shh
verses.translation: For thus hath the LORD said, The whole land shall be desolate; yet will I not make a full end.

verses.original: עַל זֹאת֙ תֶּאֱבַ֣ל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/קָדְר֥וּ הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם מִ/מָּ֑עַל עַ֤ל כִּי דִבַּ֨רְתִּי֙ זַמֹּ֔תִי וְ/לֹ֥א נִחַ֖מְתִּי וְ/לֹא אָשׁ֥וּב מִמֶּֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: 'l z't t'bl h'rts vqdrv hshmym mm'l 'l khy dbrty zmty vl' nchmty vl' 'shvb mmnh
verses.translation: For this shall the earth mourn, and the heavens above be black: because I have spoken it , I have purposed it , and will not repent, neither will I turn back from it.

verses.original: מִ/קּ֨וֹל פָּרָ֜שׁ וְ/רֹ֣מֵה קֶ֗שֶׁת בֹּרַ֨חַת֙ כָּל הָ/עִ֔יר בָּ֚אוּ בֶּ/עָבִ֔ים וּ/בַ/כֵּפִ֖ים עָל֑וּ כָּל הָ/עִ֣יר עֲזוּבָ֔ה וְ/אֵין יוֹשֵׁ֥ב בָּ/הֵ֖ן אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: mqvl prsh vrmh qsht brcht khl h'yr b'v b'bym vbkhpym 'lv khl h'yr 'zvbh v'yn yvshb bhn 'ysh
verses.translation: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen; they shall go into thickets, and climb up upon the rocks: every city shall be forsaken, and not a man dwell therein.

verses.original: ו/אתי וְ/אַ֨תְּ שָׁד֜וּד מַֽה תַּעֲשִׂ֗י כִּֽי תִלְבְּשִׁ֨י שָׁנִ֜י כִּי תַעְדִּ֣י עֲדִי זָהָ֗ב כִּֽי תִקְרְעִ֤י בַ/פּוּךְ֙ עֵינַ֔יִ/ךְ לַ/שָּׁ֖וְא תִּתְיַפִּ֑י מָאֲסוּ בָ֥/ךְ עֹגְבִ֖ים נַפְשֵׁ֥/ךְ יְבַקֵּֽשׁוּ
verses.translit: v'ty v't shdvd mh t'shy khy tlbshy shny khy t'dy 'dy zhb khy tqr'y bpvkh 'ynykh lshv' ttypy m'sv bkh 'gbym npshkh ybqshv
verses.translation: And when thou art spoiled, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou rentest thy face with painting, in vain shalt thou make thyself fair; thy lovers will despise thee, they will seek thy life.

verses.original: כִּי֩ ק֨וֹל כְּ/חוֹלָ֜ה שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי צָרָה֙ כְּ/מַבְכִּירָ֔ה ק֧וֹל בַּת צִיּ֛וֹן תִּתְיַפֵּ֖חַ תְּפָרֵ֣שׂ כַּפֶּ֑י/הָ אֽוֹי נָ֣א לִ֔/י כִּֽי עָיְפָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖/י לְ/הֹרְגִֽים
verses.translit: khy qvl khchvlh shm'ty tsrh khmbkhyrh qvl bt tsyvn ttypch tprsh khpyh 'vy n' ly khy 'yph npshy lhrgym
verses.translation: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, and the anguish as of her that bringeth forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, that bewaileth herself, that spreadeth her hands, saying , Woe is me now! for my soul is wearied because of murderers.

verses.original: שׁוֹטְט֞וּ בְּ/חוּצ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם וּ/רְאוּ נָ֤א וּ/דְעוּ֙ וּ/בַקְשׁ֣וּ בִ/רְחוֹבוֹתֶ֔י/הָ אִם תִּמְצְא֣וּ אִ֔ישׁ אִם יֵ֛שׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט מְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אֱמוּנָ֑ה וְ/אֶסְלַ֖ח לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: shvttv bchvtsvt yrvshlm vr'v n' vd'v vbqshv brchvbvtyh 'm tmts'v 'ysh 'm ysh 'shh mshpt mbqsh 'mvnh v'slch lh
verses.translation: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places thereof, if ye can find a man, if there be any that executeth judgment, that seeketh the truth; and I will pardon it.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֥ם חַי יְהֹוָ֖ה יֹאמֵ֑רוּ לָ/כֵ֥ן לַ/שֶּׁ֖קֶר יִשָּׁבֵֽעוּ
verses.translit: v'm chy yhvh y'mrv lkhn lshqr yshb'v
verses.translation: And though they say, The LORD liveth; surely they swear falsely.

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֗ה עֵינֶי/ךָ֮ הֲ/ל֣וֹא לֶ/אֱמוּנָה֒ הִכִּ֤יתָה אֹתָ/ם֙ וְֽ/לֹא חָ֔לוּ כִּלִּיתָ֕/ם מֵאֲנ֖וּ קַ֣חַת מוּסָ֑ר חִזְּק֤וּ פְנֵי/הֶם֙ מִ/סֶּ֔לַע מֵאֲנ֖וּ לָ/שֽׁוּב
verses.translit: yhvh 'ynykh hlv' l'mvnh hkhyth 'tm vl' chlv khlytm m'nv qcht mvsr chzqv pnyhm msl' m'nv lshvb
verses.translation: O LORD , are not thine eyes upon the truth? thou hast stricken them, but they have not grieved; thou hast consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they have refused to return.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי אַךְ דַּלִּ֖ים הֵ֑ם נוֹאֲל֕וּ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָדְעוּ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהוָ֔ה מִשְׁפַּ֖ט אֱלֹהֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'ny 'mrty 'kh dlym hm nv'lv khy l' yd'v drkh yhvh mshpt 'lhyhm
verses.translation: Therefore I said, Surely these are poor; they are foolish: for they know not the way of the LORD , nor the judgment of their God.

verses.original: אֵֽלֲכָה לִּ֤/י אֶל הַ/גְּדֹלִים֙ וַ/אֲדַבְּרָ֣ה אוֹתָ֔/ם כִּ֣י הֵ֗מָּה יָדְעוּ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהוָ֔ה מִשְׁפַּ֖ט אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֑ם אַ֣ךְ הֵ֤מָּה יַחְדָּו֙ שָׁ֣בְרוּ עֹ֔ל נִתְּק֖וּ מוֹסֵרֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'lkhh ly 'l hgdlym v'dbrh 'vtm khy hmh yd'v drkh yhvh mshpt 'lhyhm 'kh hmh ychdv shbrv 'l ntqv mvsrvt
verses.translation: I will get me unto the great men, and will speak unto them; for they have known the way of the LORD , and the judgment of their God: but these have altogether broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.

verses.original: עַל כֵּן֩ הִכָּ֨/ם אַרְיֵ֜ה מִ/יַּ֗עַר זְאֵ֤ב עֲרָבוֹת֙ יְשָׁדְדֵ֔/ם נָמֵ֤ר שֹׁקֵד֙ עַל עָ֣רֵי/הֶ֔ם כָּל הַ/יּוֹצֵ֥א מֵ/הֵ֖נָּה יִטָּרֵ֑ף כִּ֤י רַבּוּ֙ פִּשְׁעֵי/הֶ֔ם עָצְמ֖וּ משבותי/הם מְשׁוּבוֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: 'l khn hkhm 'ryh my'r z'b 'rbvt yshddm nmr shqd 'l 'ryhm khl hyvts' mhnh ytrf khy rbv psh'yhm 'tsmv mshbvtyhm mshvbvtyhm
verses.translation: Wherefore a lion out of the forest shall slay them, and a wolf of the evenings shall spoil them, a leopard shall watch over their cities: every one that goeth out thence shall be torn in pieces: because their transgressions are many, and their backslidings are increased.

verses.original: אֵ֤י לָ/זֹאת֙ אסלוח אֶֽסְלַֽח לָ֔/ךְ בָּנַ֣יִ/ךְ עֲזָב֔וּ/נִי וַ/יִּשָּׁבְע֖וּ בְּ/לֹ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים וָ/אַשְׂבִּ֤עַ אוֹתָ/ם֙ וַ/יִּנְאָ֔פוּ וּ/בֵ֥ית זוֹנָ֖ה יִתְגֹּדָֽדוּ
verses.translit: 'y lz't 'slvch 'slch lkh bnykh 'zbvny vyshb'v bl' 'lhym v'shb' 'vtm vyn'pv vbyt zvnh ytgddv
verses.translation: How shall I pardon thee for this? thy children have forsaken me, and sworn by them that are no gods: when I had fed them to the full, they then committed adultery, and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots’ houses.

verses.original: סוּסִ֥ים מְיֻזָּנִ֖ים מַשְׁכִּ֣ים הָי֑וּ אִ֛ישׁ אֶל אֵ֥שֶׁת רֵעֵ֖/הוּ יִצְהָֽלוּ
verses.translit: svsym myznym mshkhym hyv 'ysh 'l 'sht r'hv ytshlv
verses.translation: They were as fed horses in the morning: every one neighed after his neighbour’s wife.

verses.original: הַֽ/עַל אֵ֥לֶּה לוֹא אֶפְקֹ֖ד נְאֻם יְהֹוָ֑ה וְ/אִם֙ בְּ/ג֣וֹי אֲשֶׁר כָּ/זֶ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתְנַקֵּ֖ם נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: h'l 'lh lv' 'pqd n'm yhvh v'm bgvy 'shr khzh l' ttnqm npshy
verses.translation: Shall I not visit for these things ? saith the LORD : and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

verses.original: עֲל֤וּ בְ/שָׁרוֹתֶ֨י/הָ֙ וְ/שַׁחֵ֔תוּ וְ/כָלָ֖ה אַֽל תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ הָסִ֨ירוּ֙ נְטִ֣ישׁוֹתֶ֔י/הָ כִּ֛י ל֥וֹא לַ/יהוָ֖ה הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: 'lv bshrvtyh vshchtv vkhlh 'l t'shv hsyrv ntyshvtyh khy lv' lyhvh hmh
verses.translation: Go ye up upon her walls, and destroy; but make not a full end: take away her battlements; for they are not the LORD’s .

verses.original: כִּי֩ בָג֨וֹד בָּגְד֜וּ בִּ֗/י בֵּ֧ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וּ/בֵ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy bgvd bgdv by byt yshr'l vbyt yhvdh n'm yhvh
verses.translation: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me, saith the LORD .

verses.original: כִּֽחֲשׁוּ֙ בַּ/יהוָ֔ה וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹא ה֑וּא וְ/לֹא תָב֤וֹא עָלֵ֨י/נוּ֙ רָעָ֔ה וְ/חֶ֥רֶב וְ/רָעָ֖ב ל֥וֹא נִרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: khchshv byhvh vy'mrv l' hv' vl' tbv' 'lynv r'h vchrb vr'b lv' nr'h
verses.translation: They have belied the LORD , and said, It is not he; neither shall evil come upon us; neither shall we see sword nor famine:

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נְּבִיאִים֙ יִֽהְי֣וּ לְ/ר֔וּחַ וְ/הַ/דִּבֵּ֖ר אֵ֣ין בָּ/הֶ֑ם כֹּ֥ה יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vhnby'ym yhyv lrvch vhdbr 'yn bhm khh y'shh lhm
verses.translation: And the prophets shall become wind, and the word is not in them: thus shall it be done unto them.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י צְבָא֔וֹת יַ֚עַן דַּבֶּרְ/כֶ֔ם אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֖ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה הִנְ/נִ֣י נֹתֵן֩ דְּבָרַ֨/י בְּ/פִ֜י/ךָ לְ/אֵ֗שׁ וְ/הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּ֛ה עֵצִ֖ים וַ/אֲכָלָֽתַ/ם
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy tsb'vt y'n dbrkhm 't hdbr hzh hnny ntn dbry bpykh l'sh vh'm hzh 'tsym v'khltm
verses.translation: Wherefore thus saith the LORD God of hosts, Because ye speak this word, behold, I will make my words in thy mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֣י מֵבִיא֩ עֲלֵי/כֶ֨ם גּ֧וֹי מִ/מֶּרְחָ֛ק בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נְאֻם יְהֹוָ֑ה גּ֣וֹי אֵיתָ֣ן ה֗וּא גּ֤וֹי מֵ/עוֹלָם֙ ה֔וּא גּ֚וֹי לֹא תֵדַ֣ע לְשֹׁנ֔/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א תִשְׁמַ֖ע מַה יְדַבֵּֽר
verses.translit: hnny mby' 'lykhm gvy mmrchq byt yshr'l n'm yhvh gvy 'ytn hv' gvy m'vlm hv' gvy l' td' lshnv vl' tshm' mh ydbr
verses.translation: Lo, I will bring a nation upon you from far, O house of Israel, saith the LORD : it is a mighty nation, it is an ancient nation, a nation whose language thou knowest not, neither understandest what they say.

verses.original: אַשְׁפָּת֖/וֹ כְּ/קֶ֣בֶר פָּת֑וּחַ כֻּלָּ֖/ם גִּבּוֹרִֽים
verses.translit: 'shptv khqbr ptvch khlm gbvrym
verses.translation: Their quiver is as an open sepulchre, they are all mighty men.

verses.original: וְ/אָכַ֨ל קְצִֽירְ/ךָ֜ וְ/לַחְמֶ֗/ךָ יֹאכְלוּ֙ בָּנֶ֣י/ךָ וּ/בְנוֹתֶ֔י/ךָ יֹאכַ֤ל צֹאנְ/ךָ֙ וּ/בְקָרֶ֔/ךָ יֹאכַ֥ל גַּפְנְ/ךָ֖ וּ/תְאֵנָתֶ֑/ךָ יְרֹשֵׁ֞שׁ עָרֵ֣י מִבְצָרֶ֗י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֛ה בּוֹטֵ֥חַ בָּ/הֵ֖נָּה בֶּ/חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: v'khl qtsyrkh vlchmkh y'khlv bnykh vbnvtykh y'khl ts'nkh vbqrkh y'khl gpnkh vt'ntkh yrshsh 'ry mbtsrykh 'shr 'th bvtch bhnh bchrb
verses.translation: And they shall eat up thine harvest, and thy bread, which thy sons and thy daughters should eat: they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds: they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees: they shall impoverish thy fenced cities, wherein thou trustedst, with the sword.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֛ם בַּ/יָּמִ֥ים הָ/הֵ֖מָּה נְאֻם יְהֹוָ֑ה לֹֽא אֶעֱשֶׂ֥ה אִתְּ/כֶ֖ם כָּלָֽה
verses.translit: vgm bymym hhmh n'm yhvh l' ''shh 'tkhm khlh
verses.translation: Nevertheless in those days, saith the LORD , I will not make a full end with you.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ כִּ֣י תֹאמְר֔וּ תַּ֣חַת מֶ֗ה עָשָׂ֨ה יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛י/נוּ לָ֖/נוּ אֶת כָּל אֵ֑לֶּה וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר עֲזַבְתֶּ֤ם אוֹתִ/י֙ וַ/תַּעַבְד֞וּ אֱלֹהֵ֤י נֵכָר֙ בְּ/אַרְצְ/כֶ֔ם כֵּ֚ן תַּעַבְד֣וּ זָרִ֔ים בְּ/אֶ֖רֶץ לֹ֥א לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhyh khy t'mrv tcht mh 'shh yhvh 'lhynv lnv 't khl 'lh v'mrt 'lyhm kh'shr 'zbtm 'vty vt'bdv 'lhy nkhr b'rtskhm khn t'bdv zrym b'rts l' lkhm
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when ye shall say, Wherefore doeth the LORD our God all these things unto us? then shalt thou answer them, Like as ye have forsaken me, and served strange gods in your land, so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours.

verses.original: הַגִּ֥ידוּ זֹ֖את בְּ/בֵ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְ/הַשְׁמִיע֥וּ/הָ בִ/יהוּדָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: hgydv z't bbyt y'qb vhshmy'vh byhvdh l'mr
verses.translation: Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ נָ֣א זֹ֔את עַ֥ם סָכָ֖ל וְ/אֵ֣ין לֵ֑ב עֵינַ֤יִם לָ/הֶם֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יִרְא֔וּ אָזְנַ֥יִם לָ/הֶ֖ם וְ/לֹ֥א יִשְׁמָֽעוּ
verses.translit: shm'v n' z't 'm skhl v'yn lb 'ynym lhm vl' yr'v 'znym lhm vl' yshm'v
verses.translation: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear not:

verses.original: הַ/אוֹתִ֨/י לֹא תִירָ֜אוּ נְאֻם יְהֹוָ֗ה אִ֤ם מִ/פָּנַ/י֙ לֹ֣א תָחִ֔ילוּ אֲשֶׁר שַׂ֤מְתִּי חוֹל֙ גְּב֣וּל לַ/יָּ֔ם חָק עוֹלָ֖ם וְ/לֹ֣א יַעַבְרֶ֑/נְהוּ וַ/יִּֽתְגָּעֲשׁוּ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יוּכָ֔לוּ וְ/הָמ֥וּ גַלָּ֖י/ו וְ/לֹ֥א יַעַבְרֻֽ/נְהוּ
verses.translit: h'vty l' tyr'v n'm yhvh 'm mpny l' tchylv 'shr shmty chvl gbvl lym chq 'vlm vl' y'brnhv vytg'shv vl' yvkhlv vhmv glyv vl' y'brnhv
verses.translation: Fear ye not me? saith the LORD : will ye not tremble at my presence, which have placed the sand for the bound of the sea by a perpetual decree, that it cannot pass it: and though the waves thereof toss themselves, yet can they not prevail; though they roar, yet can they not pass over it?

verses.original: וְ/לָ/עָ֤ם הַ/זֶּה֙ הָיָ֔ה לֵ֖ב סוֹרֵ֣ר וּ/מוֹרֶ֑ה סָ֖רוּ וַ/יֵּלֵֽכוּ
verses.translit: vl'm hzh hyh lb svrr vmvrh srv vylkhv
verses.translation: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא אָמְר֣וּ בִ/לְבָבָ֗/ם נִ֤ירָא נָא֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ הַ/נֹּתֵ֗ן גֶּ֛שֶׁם ו/ירה יוֹרֶ֥ה וּ/מַלְק֖וֹשׁ בְּ/עִתּ֑/וֹ שְׁבֻע֛וֹת חֻקּ֥וֹת קָצִ֖יר יִשְׁמָר לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vl' 'mrv blbbm nyr' n' 't yhvh 'lhynv hntn gshm vyrh yvrh vmlqvsh b'tv shb'vt chqvt qtsyr yshmr lnv
verses.translation: Neither say they in their heart, Let us now fear the LORD our God, that giveth rain, both the former and the latter, in his season: he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest.

verses.original: עֲוֺנוֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם הִטּוּ אֵ֑לֶּה וְ/חַטֹּ֣אותֵי/כֶ֔ם מָנְע֥וּ הַ/טּ֖וֹב מִ/כֶּֽם
verses.translit: 'vnvtykhm htv 'lh vcht'vtykhm mn'v htvb mkhm
verses.translation: Your iniquities have turned away these things , and your sins have withholden good things from you.

verses.original: כִּי נִמְצְא֥וּ בְ/עַמִּ֖/י רְשָׁעִ֑ים יָשׁוּר֙ כְּ/שַׁ֣ךְ יְקוּשִׁ֔ים הִצִּ֥יבוּ מַשְׁחִ֖ית אֲנָשִׁ֥ים יִלְכֹּֽדוּ
verses.translit: khy nmts'v b'my rsh'ym yshvr khshkh yqvshym htsybv mshchyt 'nshym ylkhdv
verses.translation: For among my people are found wicked men: they lay wait, as he that setteth snares; they set a trap, they catch men.

verses.original: כִּ/כְלוּב֙ מָ֣לֵא ע֔וֹף כֵּ֥ן בָּתֵּי/הֶ֖ם מְלֵאִ֣ים מִרְמָ֑ה עַל כֵּ֥ן גָּדְל֖וּ וַֽ/יַּעֲשִֽׁירוּ
verses.translit: khkhlvb ml' 'vf khn btyhm ml'ym mrmh 'l khn gdlv vy'shyrv
verses.translation: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich.

verses.original: שָׁמְנ֣וּ עָשְׁת֗וּ גַּ֚ם עָֽבְר֣וּ דִבְרֵי רָ֔ע דִּ֣ין לֹא דָ֔נוּ דִּ֥ין יָת֖וֹם וְ/יַצְלִ֑יחוּ וּ/מִשְׁפַּ֥ט אֶבְיוֹנִ֖ים לֹ֥א שָׁפָֽטוּ
verses.translit: shmnv 'shtv gm 'brv dbry r' dyn l' dnv dyn ytvm vytslychv vmshpt 'byvnym l' shptv
verses.translation: They are waxen fat, they shine: yea, they overpass the deeds of the wicked: they judge not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, yet they prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.

verses.original: הַֽ/עַל אֵ֥לֶּה לֹֽא אֶפְקֹ֖ד נְאֻם יְהֹוָ֑ה אִ֚ם בְּ/ג֣וֹי אֲשֶׁר כָּ/זֶ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתְנַקֵּ֖ם נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: h'l 'lh l' 'pqd n'm yhvh 'm bgvy 'shr khzh l' ttnqm npshy
verses.translation: Shall I not visit for these things ? saith the LORD : shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

verses.original: שַׁמָּה֙ וְ/שַׁ֣עֲרוּרָ֔ה נִהְיְתָ֖ה בָּ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: shmh vsh'rvrh nhyth b'rts
verses.translation: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land;

verses.original: הַ/נְּבִיאִ֞ים נִבְּא֣וּ בַ/שֶּׁ֗קֶר וְ/הַ/כֹּהֲנִים֙ יִרְדּ֣וּ עַל יְדֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/עַמִּ֖/י אָ֣הֲבוּ כֵ֑ן וּ/מַֽה תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ לְ/אַחֲרִיתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: hnby'ym nb'v bshqr vhkhhnym yrdv 'l ydyhm v'my 'hbv khn vmh t'shv l'chryth
verses.translation: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love to have it so: and what will ye do in the end thereof?

verses.original: הָעִ֣זוּ בְּנֵ֣י בִניָמִ֗ן מִ/קֶּ֨רֶב֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וּ/בִ/תְק֨וֹעַ֙ תִּקְע֣וּ שׁוֹפָ֔ר וְ/עַל בֵּ֥ית הַכֶּ֖רֶם שְׂא֣וּ מַשְׂאֵ֑ת כִּ֥י רָעָ֛ה נִשְׁקְפָ֥ה מִ/צָּפ֖וֹן וְ/שֶׁ֥בֶר גָּדֽוֹל
verses.translit: h'zv bny bnymn mqrb yrvshlm vbtqv' tq'v shvpr v'l byt hkhrm sh'v msh't khy r'h nshqph mtspvn vshbr gdvl
verses.translation: O ye children of Benjamin, gather yourselves to flee out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and set up a sign of fire in Beth-haccerem: for evil appeareth out of the north, and great destruction.

verses.original: הַ/נָּוָה֙ וְ/הַ/מְּעֻנָּגָ֔ה דָּמִ֖יתִי בַּת צִיּֽוֹן
verses.translit: hnvh vhm'ngh dmyty bt tsyvn
verses.translation: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman .

verses.original: אֵלֶ֛י/הָ יָבֹ֥אוּ רֹעִ֖ים וְ/עֶדְרֵי/הֶ֑ם תָּקְע֨וּ עָלֶ֤י/הָ אֹהָלִים֙ סָבִ֔יב רָע֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'lyh yb'v r'ym v'dryhm tq'v 'lyh 'hlym sbyb r'v 'ysh 't ydv
verses.translation: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her; they shall pitch their tents against her round about; they shall feed every one in his place.

verses.original: קַדְּשׁ֤וּ עָלֶ֨י/הָ֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה ק֖וּמוּ וְ/נַעֲלֶ֣ה בַֽ/צָּהֳרָ֑יִם א֥וֹי לָ֨/נוּ֙ כִּי פָנָ֣ה הַ/יּ֔וֹם כִּ֥י יִנָּט֖וּ צִלְלֵי עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: qdshv 'lyh mlchmh qvmv vn'lh btshrym 'vy lnv khy pnh hyvm khy yntv tslly 'rb
verses.translation: Prepare ye war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe unto us! for the day goeth away, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.

verses.original: ק֚וּמוּ וְ/נַעֲלֶ֣ה בַ/לָּ֔יְלָה וְ/נַשְׁחִ֖יתָה אַרְמְנוֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: qvmv vn'lh blylh vnshchyth 'rmnvtyh
verses.translation: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת כִּרְת֣וּ עֵצָ֔ה וְ/שִׁפְכ֥וּ עַל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם סֹלְלָ֑ה הִ֚יא הָ/עִ֣יר הָפְקַ֔ד כֻּלָּ֖/הּ עֹ֥שֶׁק בְּ/קִרְבָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt khrtv 'tsh vshpkhv 'l yrvshlm sllh hy' h'yr hpqd khlh 'shq bqrbh
verses.translation: For thus hath the LORD of hosts said, Hew ye down trees, and cast a mount against Jerusalem: this is the city to be visited; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her.

verses.original: כְּ/הָקִ֥יר בור בַּ֨יִר֙ מֵימֶ֔י/הָ כֵּ֖ן הֵקֵ֣רָה רָעָתָ֑/הּ חָמָ֣ס וָ֠/שֹׁד יִשָּׁ֨מַע בָּ֧/הּ עַל פָּנַ֛/י תָּמִ֖יד חֳלִ֥י וּ/מַכָּֽה
verses.translit: khhqyr bvr byr mymyh khn hqrh r'th chms vshd yshm' bh 'l pny tmyd chly vmkhh
verses.translation: As a fountain casteth out her waters, so she casteth out her wickedness: violence and spoil is heard in her; before me continually is grief and wounds.

verses.original: הִוָּסְרִי֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם פֶּן תֵּקַ֥ע נַפְשִׁ֖/י מִמֵּ֑/ךְ פֶּן אֲשִׂימֵ֣/ךְ שְׁמָמָ֔ה אֶ֖רֶץ ל֥וֹא נוֹשָֽׁבָה
verses.translit: hvsry yrvshlm pn tq' npshy mmkh pn 'shymkh shmmh 'rts lv' nvshbh
verses.translation: Be thou instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from thee; lest I make thee desolate, a land not inhabited.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת עוֹלֵ֛ל יְעוֹלְל֥וּ כַ/גֶּ֖פֶן שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הָשֵׁב֙ יָדְ/ךָ֔ כְּ/בוֹצֵ֖ר עַל סַלְסִלּֽוֹת
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'vll y'vllv khgpn sh'ryt yshr'l hshb ydkh khbvtsr 'l slslvt
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, They shall throughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine: turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets.

verses.original: עַל מִ֨י אֲדַבְּרָ֤ה וְ/אָעִ֨ידָה֙ וְ/יִשְׁמָ֔עוּ הִנֵּה֙ עֲרֵלָ֣ה אָזְנָ֔/ם וְ/לֹ֥א יוּכְל֖וּ לְ/הַקְשִׁ֑יב הִנֵּ֣ה דְבַר יְהוָ֗ה הָיָ֥ה לָ/הֶ֛ם לְ/חֶרְפָּ֖ה לֹ֥א יַחְפְּצוּ בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'l my 'dbrh v''ydh vyshm'v hnh 'rlh 'znm vl' yvkhlv lhqshyb hnh dbr yhvh hyh lhm lchrph l' ychptsv bv
verses.translation: To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of the LORD is unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֩ חֲמַ֨ת יְהוָ֤ה מָלֵ֨אתִי֙ נִלְאֵ֣יתִי הָכִ֔יל שְׁפֹ֤ךְ עַל עוֹלָל֙ בַּ/ח֔וּץ וְ/עַ֛ל ס֥וֹד בַּחוּרִ֖ים יַחְדָּ֑ו כִּֽי גַם אִ֤ישׁ עִם אִשָּׁה֙ יִלָּכֵ֔דוּ זָקֵ֖ן עִם מְלֵ֥א יָמִֽים
verses.translit: v't chmt yhvh ml'ty nl'yty hkhyl shpkh 'l 'vll bchvts v'l svd bchvrym ychdv khy gm 'ysh 'm 'shh ylkhdv zqn 'm ml' ymym
verses.translation: Therefore I am full of the fury of the LORD ; I am weary with holding in: I will pour it out upon the children abroad, and upon the assembly of young men together: for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with him that is full of days.

verses.original: וְ/נָסַ֤בּוּ בָֽתֵּי/הֶם֙ לַ/אֲחֵרִ֔ים שָׂד֥וֹת וְ/נָשִׁ֖ים יַחְדָּ֑ו כִּֽי אַטֶּ֧ה אֶת יָדִ֛/י עַל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָ/אָ֖רֶץ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vnsbv btyhm l'chrym shdvt vnshym ychdv khy 'th 't ydy 'l yshby h'rts n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And their houses shall be turned unto others, with their fields and wives together: for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, saith the LORD .

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִ/קְּטַנָּ/ם֙ וְ/עַד גְּדוֹלָ֔/ם כֻּלּ֖/וֹ בּוֹצֵ֣עַ בָּ֑צַע וּ/מִ/נָּבִיא֙ וְ/עַד כֹּהֵ֔ן כֻּלּ֖/וֹ עֹ֥שֶׂה שָּֽׁקֶר
verses.translit: khy mqtnm v'd gdvlm khlv bvts' bts' vmnby' v'd khhn khlv 'shh shqr
verses.translation: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְרַפְּא֞וּ אֶת שֶׁ֤בֶר עַמִּ/י֙ עַל נְקַלָּ֔ה לֵ/אמֹ֖ר שָׁל֣וֹם שָׁל֑וֹם וְ/אֵ֖ין שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyrp'v 't shbr 'my 'l nqlh l'mr shlvm shlvm v'yn shlvm
verses.translation: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.

verses.original: הֹבִ֕ישׁוּ כִּ֥י תוֹעֵבָ֖ה עָשׂ֑וּ גַּם בּ֣וֹשׁ לֹֽא יֵב֗וֹשׁוּ גַּם הַכְלִים֙ לֹ֣א יָדָ֔עוּ לָ/כֵ֞ן יִפְּל֧וּ בַ/נֹּפְלִ֛ים בְּ/עֵת פְּקַדְתִּ֥י/ם יִכָּשְׁל֖וּ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hbyshv khy tv'bh 'shv gm bvsh l' ybvshv gm hkhlym l' yd'v lkhn yplv bnplym b't pqdtym ykhshlv 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down, saith the LORD .

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֡ה עִמְדוּ֩ עַל דְּרָכִ֨ים וּ/רְא֜וּ וְ/שַׁאֲל֣וּ לִ/נְתִב֣וֹת עוֹלָ֗ם אֵי זֶ֨ה דֶ֤רֶךְ הַ/טּוֹב֙ וּ/לְכוּ בָ֔/הּ וּ/מִצְא֥וּ מַרְגּ֖וֹעַ לְ/נַפְשְׁ/כֶ֑ם וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹ֥א נֵלֵֽךְ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'mdv 'l drkhym vr'v vsh'lv lntbvt 'vlm 'y zh drkh htvb vlkhv bh vmts'v mrgv' lnpshkhm vy'mrv l' nlkh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , Stand ye in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and ye shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein .

verses.original: וַ/הֲקִמֹתִ֤י עֲלֵי/כֶם֙ צֹפִ֔ים הַקְשִׁ֖יבוּ לְ/ק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָ֑ר וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹ֥א נַקְשִֽׁיב
verses.translit: vhqmty 'lykhm tspym hqshybv lqvl shvpr vy'mrv l' nqshyb
verses.translation: Also I set watchmen over you, saying , Hearken to the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hearken.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֖ן שִׁמְע֣וּ הַ/גּוֹיִ֑ם וּ/דְעִ֥י עֵדָ֖ה אֶת אֲשֶׁר בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: lkhn shm'v hgvym vd'y 'dh 't 'shr bm
verses.translation: Therefore hear, ye nations, and know, O congregation, what is among them.

verses.original: שִׁמְעִ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י מֵבִ֥יא רָעָ֛ה אֶל הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּ֖ה פְּרִ֣י מַחְשְׁבוֹתָ֑/ם כִּ֤י עַל דְּבָרַ/י֙ לֹ֣א הִקְשִׁ֔יבוּ וְ/תוֹרָתִ֖/י וַ/יִּמְאֲסוּ בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: shm'y h'rts hnh 'nkhy mby' r'h 'l h'm hzh pry mchshbvtm khy 'l dbry l' hqshybv vtvrty vym'sv bh
verses.translation: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened unto my words, nor to my law, but rejected it.

verses.original: לָ/מָּה זֶּ֨ה לִ֤/י לְבוֹנָה֙ מִ/שְּׁבָ֣א תָב֔וֹא וְ/קָנֶ֥ה הַ/טּ֖וֹב מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מֶרְחָ֑ק עֹלֽוֹתֵי/כֶם֙ לֹ֣א לְ/רָצ֔וֹן וְ/זִבְחֵי/כֶ֖ם לֹא עָ֥רְבוּ לִֽ/י
verses.translit: lmh zh ly lbvnh mshb' tbv' vqnh htvb m'rts mrchq 'lvtykhm l' lrtsvn vzbchykhm l' 'rbv ly
verses.translation: To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt offerings are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet unto me.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְ/נִ֥י נֹתֵ֛ן אֶל הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּ֖ה מִכְשֹׁלִ֑ים וְ/כָ֣שְׁלוּ בָ֠/ם אָב֨וֹת וּ/בָנִ֥ים יַחְדָּ֛ו שָׁכֵ֥ן וְ/רֵע֖/וֹ יאבדו וְ/אָבָֽדוּ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh hnny ntn 'l h'm hzh mkhshlym vkhshlv bm 'bvt vbnym ychdv shkhn vr'v y'bdv v'bdv
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD , Behold, I will lay stumblingblocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנֵּ֛ה עַ֥ם בָּ֖א מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֑וֹן וְ/ג֣וֹי גָּד֔וֹל יֵע֖וֹר מִ/יַּרְכְּתֵי אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh hnh 'm b' m'rts tspvn vgvy gdvl y'vr myrkhty 'rts
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , Behold, a people cometh from the north country, and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth.

verses.original: קֶ֣שֶׁת וְ/כִיד֞וֹן יַחֲזִ֗יקוּ אַכְזָרִ֥י הוּא֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יְרַחֵ֔מוּ קוֹלָ/ם֙ כַּ/יָּ֣ם יֶהֱמֶ֔ה וְ/עַל סוּסִ֖ים יִרְכָּ֑בוּ עָר֗וּךְ כְּ/אִישׁ֙ לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ בַּת צִיּֽוֹן
verses.translit: qsht vkhydvn ychzyqv 'khzry hv' vl' yrchmv qvlm khym yhmh v'l svsym yrkhbv 'rvkh kh'ysh lmlchmh 'lykh bt tsyvn
verses.translation: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, set in array as men for war against thee, O daughter of Zion.

verses.original: שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ אֶת שָׁמְע֖/וֹ רָפ֣וּ יָדֵ֑י/נוּ צָרָה֙ הֶחֱזִיקַ֔תְ/נוּ חִ֖יל כַּ/יּוֹלֵדָֽה
verses.translit: shm'nv 't shm'v rpv ydynv tsrh hchzyqtnv chyl khyvldh
verses.translation: We have heard the fame thereof: our hands wax feeble: anguish hath taken hold of us, and pain, as of a woman in travail.

verses.original: אַל תצאי תֵּֽצְאוּ֙ הַ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה וּ/בַ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ אַל תלכי תֵּלֵ֑כוּ כִּ֚י חֶ֣רֶב לְ/אֹיֵ֔ב מָג֖וֹר מִ/סָּבִֽיב
verses.translit: 'l tts'y tts'v hshdh vbdrkh 'l tlkhy tlkhv khy chrb l'yb mgvr msbyb
verses.translation: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side.

verses.original: בַּת עַמִּ֤/י חִגְרִי שָׂק֙ וְ/הִתְפַּלְּשִׁ֣י בָ/אֵ֔פֶר אֵ֤בֶל יָחִיד֙ עֲשִׂ֣י לָ֔/ךְ מִסְפַּ֖ד תַּמְרוּרִ֑ים כִּ֣י פִתְאֹ֔ם יָבֹ֥א הַ/שֹּׁדֵ֖ד עָלֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: bt 'my chgry shq vhtplshy b'pr 'bl ychyd 'shy lkh mspd tmrvrym khy pt'm yb' hshdd 'lynv
verses.translation: O daughter of my people, gird thee with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make thee mourning, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation: for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.

verses.original: בָּח֛וֹן נְתַתִּ֥י/ךָ בְ/עַמִּ֖/י מִבְצָ֑ר וְ/תֵדַ֕ע וּ/בָחַנְתָּ֖ אֶת דַּרְכָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: bchvn nttykh b'my mbtsr vtd' vbchnt 't drkhm
verses.translation: I have set thee for a tower and a fortress among my people, that thou mayest know and try their way.

verses.original: כֻּלָּ/ם֙ סָרֵ֣י סֽוֹרְרִ֔ים הֹלְכֵ֥י רָכִ֖יל נְחֹ֣שֶׁת וּ/בַרְזֶ֑ל כֻּלָּ֥/ם מַשְׁחִיתִ֖ים הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: khlm sry svrrym hlkhy rkhyl nchsht vbrzl khlm mshchytym hmh
verses.translation: They are all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: they are brass and iron; they are all corrupters.

verses.original: נָחַ֣ר מַפֻּ֔חַ מ/אשת/ם מֵ/אֵ֖שׁ תַּ֣ם עֹפָ֑רֶת לַ/שָּׁוְא֙ צָרַ֣ף צָר֔וֹף וְ/רָעִ֖ים לֹ֥א נִתָּֽקוּ
verses.translit: nchr mpch m'shtm m'sh tm 'prt lshv' tsrf tsrvf vr'ym l' ntqv
verses.translation: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed of the fire; the founder melteth in vain: for the wicked are not plucked away.

verses.original: כֶּ֣סֶף נִמְאָ֔ס קָרְא֖וּ לָ/הֶ֑ם כִּֽי מָאַ֥ס יְהוָ֖ה בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khsf nm's qr'v lhm khy m's yhvh bhm
verses.translation: Reprobate silver shall men call them, because the LORD hath rejected them.

verses.original: הַ/דָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ מֵ/אֵ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr hyh 'l yrmyhv m't yhvh l'mr
verses.translation: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD , saying,

verses.original: עֲמֹ֗ד בְּ/שַׁ֨עַר֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וְ/קָרָ֣אתָ שָּׁ֔ם אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֖ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֞ שִׁמְע֣וּ דְבַר יְהוָ֗ה כָּל יְהוּדָה֙ הַ/בָּאִים֙ בַּ/שְּׁעָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה לְ/הִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֖ת לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'md bsh'r byt yhvh vqr't shm 't hdbr hzh v'mrt shm'v dbr yhvh khl yhvdh hb'ym bsh'rym h'lh lhshtchvt lyhvh
verses.translation: Stand in the gate of the LORD’s house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of the LORD , all ye of Judah, that enter in at these gates to worship the LORD .

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֵיטִ֥יבוּ דַרְכֵי/כֶ֖ם וּ/מַֽעַלְלֵי/כֶ֑ם וַ/אֲשַׁכְּנָ֣ה אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם בַּ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hytybv drkhykhm vm'llykhm v'shkhnh 'tkhm bmqvm hzh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.

verses.original: אַל תִּבְטְח֣וּ לָ/כֶ֔ם אֶל דִּבְרֵ֥י הַ/שֶּׁ֖קֶר לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הֵיכַ֤ל יְהוָה֙ הֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה הֵיכַ֥ל יְהוָ֖ה הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: 'l tbtchv lkhm 'l dbry hshqr l'mr hykhl yhvh hykhl yhvh hykhl yhvh hmh
verses.translation: Trust ye not in lying words, saying, The temple of the LORD , The temple of the LORD , The temple of the LORD , are these.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִם הֵיטֵיב֙ תֵּיטִ֔יבוּ אֶת דַּרְכֵי/כֶ֖ם וְ/אֶת מַֽעַלְלֵי/כֶ֑ם אִם עָשׂ֤וֹ תַֽעֲשׂוּ֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט בֵּ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ וּ/בֵ֥ין רֵעֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: khy 'm hytyb tytybv 't drkhykhm v't m'llykhm 'm 'shv t'shv mshpt byn 'ysh vbyn r'hv
verses.translation: For if ye throughly amend your ways and your doings; if ye throughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;

verses.original: גֵּ֣ר יָת֤וֹם וְ/אַלְמָנָה֙ לֹ֣א תַֽעֲשֹׁ֔קוּ וְ/דָ֣ם נָקִ֔י אַֽל תִּשְׁפְּכ֖וּ בַּ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/אַחֲרֵ֨י אֱלֹהִ֧ים אֲחֵרִ֛ים לֹ֥א תֵלְכ֖וּ לְ/רַ֥ע לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: gr ytvm v'lmnh l' t'shqv vdm nqy 'l tshpkhv bmqvm hzh v'chry 'lhym 'chrym l' tlkhv lr' lkhm
verses.translation: If ye oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt:

verses.original: וְ/שִׁכַּנְתִּ֤י אֶתְ/כֶם֙ בַּ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה בָּ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לַ/אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם לְ/מִן עוֹלָ֖ם וְ/עַד עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vshkhnty 'tkhm bmqvm hzh b'rts 'shr ntty l'bvtykhm lmn 'vlm v'd 'vlm
verses.translation: Then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה אַתֶּם֙ בֹּטְחִ֣ים לָ/כֶ֔ם עַל דִּבְרֵ֖י הַ/שָּׁ֑קֶר לְ/בִלְתִּ֖י הוֹעִֽיל
verses.translit: hnh 'tm btchym lkhm 'l dbry hshqr lblty hv'yl
verses.translation: Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.

verses.original: הֲ/גָנֹ֤ב רָצֹ֨חַ֙ וְֽ/נָאֹ֔ף וְ/הִשָּׁבֵ֥עַ לַ/שֶּׁ֖קֶר וְ/קַטֵּ֣ר לַ/בָּ֑עַל וְ/הָלֹ֗ךְ אַחֲרֵ֛י אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא יְדַעְתֶּֽם
verses.translit: hgnb rtsch vn'f vhshb' lshqr vqtr lb'l vhlkh 'chry 'lhym 'chrym 'shr l' yd'tm
verses.translation: Will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods whom ye know not;

verses.original: וּ/בָאתֶ֞ם וַ/עֲמַדְתֶּ֣ם לְ/פָנַ֗/י בַּ/בַּ֤יִת הַ/זֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִקְרָא שְׁמִ֣/י עָלָ֔י/ו וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם נִצַּ֑לְנוּ לְמַ֣עַן עֲשׂ֔וֹת אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/תּוֹעֵב֖וֹת הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vb'tm v'mdtm lpny bbyt hzh 'shr nqr' shmy 'lyv v'mrtm ntslnv lm'n 'shvt 't khl htv'bvt h'lh
verses.translation: And come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?

verses.original: הַ/מְעָרַ֣ת פָּרִצִ֗ים הָיָ֨ה הַ/בַּ֧יִת הַ/זֶּ֛ה אֲשֶׁר נִקְרָֽא שְׁמִ֥/י עָלָ֖י/ו בְּ/עֵינֵי/כֶ֑ם גַּ֧ם אָנֹכִ֛י הִנֵּ֥ה רָאִ֖יתִי נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hm'rt prtsym hyh hbyt hzh 'shr nqr' shmy 'lyv b'ynykhm gm 'nkhy hnh r'yty n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it , saith the LORD .

verses.original: כִּ֣י לְכוּ נָ֗א אֶל מְקוֹמִ/י֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/שִׁיל֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר שִׁכַּ֧נְתִּֽי שְׁמִ֛/י שָׁ֖ם בָּ/רִֽאשׁוֹנָ֑ה וּ/רְאוּ֙ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂ֣יתִי ל֔/וֹ מִ/פְּנֵ֕י רָעַ֖ת עַמִּ֥/י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: khy lkhv n' 'l mqvmy 'shr bshylv 'shr shkhnty shmy shm br'shvnh vr'v 't 'shr 'shyty lv mpny r't 'my yshr'l
verses.translation: But go ye now unto my place which was in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה יַ֧עַן עֲשׂוֹתְ/כֶ֛ם אֶת כָּל הַ/מַּֽעֲשִׂ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וָ/אֲדַבֵּ֨ר אֲלֵי/כֶ֜ם הַשְׁכֵּ֤ם וְ/דַבֵּר֙ וְ/לֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֔ם וָ/אֶקְרָ֥א אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם וְ/לֹ֥א עֲנִיתֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th y'n 'shvtkhm 't khl hm'shym h'lh n'm yhvh v'dbr 'lykhm hshkhm vdbr vl' shm'tm v'qr' 'tkhm vl' 'nytm
verses.translation: And now, because ye have done all these works, saith the LORD , and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but ye heard not; and I called you, but ye answered not;

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֜יתִי לַ/בַּ֣יִת אֲשֶׁ֧ר נִֽקְרָא שְׁמִ֣/י עָלָ֗י/ו אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתֶּם֙ בֹּטְחִ֣ים בּ֔/וֹ וְ/לַ֨/מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥תִּי לָ/כֶ֖ם וְ/לַ/אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי לְ/שִׁלֽוֹ
verses.translit: v'shyty lbyt 'shr nqr' shmy 'lyv 'shr 'tm btchym bv vlmqvm 'shr ntty lkhm vl'bvtykhm kh'shr 'shyty lshlv
verses.translation: Therefore will I do unto this house, which is called by my name, wherein ye trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.

verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁלַכְתִּ֥י אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מֵ/עַ֣ל פָּנָ֑/י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִשְׁלַ֨כְתִּי֙ אֶת כָּל אֲחֵי/כֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת כָּל זֶ֥רַע אֶפְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vhshlkhty 'tkhm m'l pny kh'shr hshlkhty 't khl 'chykhm 't khl zr' 'prym
verses.translation: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, even the whole seed of Ephraim.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֞ה אַל תִּתְפַּלֵּ֣ל בְּעַד הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֗ה וְ/אַל תִּשָּׂ֧א בַעֲדָ֛/ם רִנָּ֥ה וּ/תְפִלָּ֖ה וְ/אַל תִּפְגַּע בִּ֑/י כִּי אֵינֶ֥/נִּי שֹׁמֵ֖עַ אֹתָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: v'th 'l ttpll b'd h'm hzh v'l tsh' b'dm rnh vtplh v'l tpg' by khy 'ynny shm' 'tkh
verses.translation: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear thee.

verses.original: הַֽ/אֵינְ/ךָ֣ רֹאֶ֔ה מָ֛ה הֵ֥מָּה עֹשִׂ֖ים בְּ/עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וּ/בְ/חֻצ֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: h'ynkh r'h mh hmh 'shym b'ry yhvdh vbchtsvt yrvshlm
verses.translation: Seest thou not what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

verses.original: הַ/בָּנִ֞ים מְלַקְּטִ֣ים עֵצִ֗ים וְ/הָֽ/אָבוֹת֙ מְבַעֲרִ֣ים אֶת הָ/אֵ֔שׁ וְ/הַ/נָּשִׁ֖ים לָשׁ֣וֹת בָּצֵ֑ק לַ/עֲשׂ֨וֹת כַּוָּנִ֜ים לִ/מְלֶ֣כֶת הַ/שָּׁמַ֗יִם וְ/הַסֵּ֤ךְ נְסָכִים֙ לֵ/אלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְמַ֖עַן הַכְעִסֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: hbnym mlqtym 'tsym vh'bvt mb'rym 't h'sh vhnshym lshvt btsq l'shvt khvnym lmlkht hshmym vhskh nskhym l'lhym 'chrym lm'n hkh'sny
verses.translation: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.

verses.original: הַ/אֹתִ֛/י הֵ֥ם מַכְעִסִ֖ים נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה הֲ/ל֣וֹא אֹתָ֔/ם לְמַ֖עַן בֹּ֥שֶׁת פְּנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: h'ty hm mkh'sym n'm yhvh hlv' 'tm lm'n bsht pnyhm
verses.translation: Do they provoke me to anger? saith the LORD : do they not provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces?

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן כֹּה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהֹוִ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה אַפִּ֤/י וַֽ/חֲמָתִ/י֙ נִתֶּ֨כֶת֙ אֶל הַ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה עַל הָֽ/אָדָם֙ וְ/עַל הַ/בְּהֵמָ֔ה וְ/עַל עֵ֥ץ הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה וְ/עַל פְּרִ֣י הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֑ה וּ/בָעֲרָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א תִכְבֶּֽה
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnh 'py vchmty ntkht 'l hmqvm hzh 'l h'dm v'l hbhmh v'l 'ts hshdh v'l pry h'dmh vb'rh vl' tkhbh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD ; Behold, mine anger and my fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עֹלוֹתֵי/כֶ֛ם סְפ֥וּ עַל זִבְחֵי/כֶ֖ם וְ/אִכְל֥וּ בָשָֽׂר
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l 'lvtykhm spv 'l zbchykhm v'khlv bshr
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.

verses.original: כִּ֠י לֹֽא דִבַּ֤רְתִּי אֶת אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶם֙ וְ/לֹ֣א צִוִּיתִ֔י/ם בְּ/י֛וֹם הוציא הוֹצִיאִ֥/י אוֹתָ֖/ם מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם עַל דִּבְרֵ֥י עוֹלָ֖ה וָ/זָֽבַח
verses.translit: khy l' dbrty 't 'bvtykhm vl' tsvytym byvm hvtsy' hvtsy'y 'vtm m'rts mtsrym 'l dbry 'vlh vzbch
verses.translation: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִֽם אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ֠/זֶּה צִוִּ֨יתִי אוֹתָ֤/ם לֵ/אמֹר֙ שִׁמְע֣וּ בְ/קוֹלִ֔/י וְ/הָיִ֤יתִי לָ/כֶם֙ לֵֽ/אלֹהִ֔ים וְ/אַתֶּ֖ם תִּֽהְיוּ לִ֣/י לְ/עָ֑ם וַ/הֲלַכְתֶּ֗ם בְּ/כָל הַ/דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם לְמַ֖עַן יִיטַ֥ב לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khy 'm 't hdbr hzh tsvyty 'vtm l'mr shm'v bqvly vhyyty lkhm l'lhym v'tm thyv ly l'm vhlkhtm bkhl hdrkh 'shr 'tsvh 'tkhm lm'n yytb lkhm
verses.translation: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your God, and ye shall be my people: and walk ye in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֤א שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ וְ/לֹֽא הִטּ֣וּ אֶת אָזְנָ֔/ם וַ/יֵּֽלְכוּ֙ בְּ/מֹ֣עֵצ֔וֹת בִּ/שְׁרִר֖וּת לִבָּ֣/ם הָ/רָ֑ע וַ/יִּהְי֥וּ לְ/אָח֖וֹר וְ/לֹ֥א לְ/פָנִֽים
verses.translit: vl' shm'v vl' htv 't 'znm vylkhv bm'tsvt bshrrvt lbm hr' vyhyv l'chvr vl' lpnym
verses.translation: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels and in the imagination of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.

verses.original: לְ/מִן הַ/יּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצְא֤וּ אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶם֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וָ/אֶשְׁלַ֤ח אֲלֵי/כֶם֙ אֶת כָּל עֲבָדַ֣/י הַ/נְּבִיאִ֔ים י֖וֹם הַשְׁכֵּ֥ם וְ/שָׁלֹֽחַ
verses.translit: lmn hyvm 'shr yts'v 'bvtykhm m'rts mtsrym 'd hyvm hzh v'shlch 'lykhm 't khl 'bdy hnby'ym yvm hshkhm vshlch
