verses.translation: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day I have even sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them:

verses.original: וְ/ל֤וֹא שָׁמְעוּ֙ אֵלַ֔/י וְ/לֹ֥א הִטּ֖וּ אֶת אָזְנָ֑/ם וַ/יַּקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת עָרְפָּ֔/ם הֵרֵ֖עוּ מֵ/אֲבוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vlv' shm'v 'ly vl' htv 't 'znm vyqshv 't 'rpm hr'v m'bvtm
verses.translation: Yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: they did worse than their fathers.

verses.original: וְ/דִבַּרְתָּ֤ אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ אֶת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה וְ/לֹ֥א יִשְׁמְע֖וּ אֵלֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/קָרָ֥אתָ אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/לֹ֥א יַעֲנֽוּ/כָה
verses.translit: vdbrt 'lyhm 't khl hdbrym h'lh vl' yshm'v 'lykh vqr't 'lyhm vl' y'nvkhh
verses.translation: Therefore thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer thee.

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם זֶ֤ה הַ/גּוֹי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֽוֹא שָׁמְע֗וּ בְּ/קוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י/ו וְ/לֹ֥א לָקְח֖וּ מוּסָ֑ר אָֽבְדָה֙ הָֽ/אֱמוּנָ֔ה וְ/נִכְרְתָ֖ה מִ/פִּי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyhm zh hgvy 'shr lv' shm'v bqvl yhvh 'lhyv vl' lqchv mvsr 'bdh h'mvnh vnkhrth mpyhm
verses.translation: But thou shalt say unto them, This is a nation that obeyeth not the voice of the LORD their God, nor receiveth correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.

verses.original: גָּזִּ֤י נִזְרֵ/ךְ֙ וְֽ/הַשְׁלִ֔יכִי וּ/שְׂאִ֥י עַל שְׁפָיִ֖ם קִינָ֑ה כִּ֚י מָאַ֣ס יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יִּטֹּ֖שׁ אֶת דּ֥וֹר עֶבְרָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: gzy nzrkh vhshlykhy vsh'y 'l shpym qynh khy m's yhvh vytsh 't dvr 'brtv
verses.translation: Cut off thine hair, O Jerusalem , and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on high places; for the LORD hath rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.

verses.original: כִּֽי עָשׂ֨וּ בְנֵי יְהוּדָ֥ה הָ/רַ֛ע בְּ/עֵינַ֖/י נְאֻום יְהוָ֑ה שָׂ֣מוּ שִׁקּֽוּצֵי/הֶ֗ם בַּ/בַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר נִקְרָא שְׁמִ֥/י עָלָ֖י/ו לְ/טַמְּאֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy 'shv bny yhvdh hr' b'yny n'vm yhvh shmv shqvtsyhm bbyt 'shr nqr' shmy 'lyv ltm'v
verses.translation: For the children of Judah have done evil in my sight, saith the LORD : they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to pollute it.

verses.original: וּ/בָנ֞וּ בָּמ֣וֹת הַ/תֹּ֗פֶת אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּ/גֵ֣יא בֶן הִנֹּ֔ם לִ/שְׂרֹ֛ף אֶת בְּנֵי/הֶ֥ם וְ/אֶת בְּנֹתֵי/הֶ֖ם בָּ/אֵ֑שׁ אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א צִוִּ֔יתִי וְ/לֹ֥א עָלְתָ֖ה עַל לִבִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vbnv bmvt htpt 'shr bgy' bn hnm lshrf 't bnyhm v't bntyhm b'sh 'shr l' tsvyty vl' 'lth 'l lby
verses.translation: And they have built the high places of Tophet, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my heart.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן הִנֵּֽה יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וְ/לֹא יֵאָמֵ֨ר ע֤וֹד הַ/תֹּ֨פֶת֙ וְ/גֵ֣יא בֶן הִנֹּ֔ם כִּ֖י אִם גֵּ֣יא הַ/הֲרֵגָ֑ה וְ/קָבְר֥וּ בְ/תֹ֖פֶת מֵ/אֵ֥ין מָקֽוֹם
verses.translit: lkhn hnh ymym b'ym n'm yhvh vl' y'mr 'vd htpt vgy' bn hnm khy 'm gy' hhrgh vqbrv btpt m'yn mqvm
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD , that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.

verses.original: וְֽ/הָ֨יְתָ֜ה נִבְלַ֨ת הָ/עָ֤ם הַ/זֶּה֙ לְ/מַֽאֲכָ֔ל לְ/ע֥וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וּ/לְ/בֶהֱמַ֣ת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/אֵ֖ין מַחֲרִֽיד
verses.translit: vhyth nblt h'm hzh lm'khl l'vf hshmym vlbhmt h'rts v'yn mchryd
verses.translation: And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray them away.

verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁבַּתִּ֣י מֵ/עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה וּ/מֵֽ/חֻצוֹת֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם ק֤וֹל שָׂשׂוֹן֙ וְ/ק֣וֹל שִׂמְחָ֔ה ק֥וֹל חָתָ֖ן וְ/ק֣וֹל כַּלָּ֑ה כִּ֥י לְ/חָרְבָּ֖ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vhshbty m'ry yhvdh vmchtsvt yrvshlm qvl shshvn vqvl shmchh qvl chtn vqvl khlh khy lchrbh thyh h'rts
verses.translation: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: for the land shall be desolate.

verses.original: בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֣יא נְאֻם יְהוָ֡ה ו/יציאו יוֹצִ֣יאוּ אֶת עַצְמ֣וֹת מַלְכֵֽי יְהוּדָ֣ה וְ/אֶת עַצְמוֹת שָׂרָי/ו֩ וְ/אֶת עַצְמ֨וֹת הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֜ים וְ/אֵ֣ת עַצְמ֣וֹת הַ/נְּבִיאִ֗ים וְ/אֵ֛ת עַצְמ֥וֹת יוֹשְׁבֵֽי יְרוּשָׁלִָ֖ם מִ/קִּבְרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: b't hhy' n'm yhvh vytsy'v yvtsy'v 't 'tsmvt mlkhy yhvdh v't 'tsmvt shryv v't 'tsmvt hkhhnym v't 'tsmvt hnby'ym v't 'tsmvt yvshby yrvshlm mqbryhm
verses.translation: At that time, saith the LORD , they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves:

verses.original: וּ/שְׁטָחוּ/ם֩ לַ/שֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ וְ/לַ/יָּרֵ֜חַ וּ/לְ/כֹ֣ל צְבָ֣א הַ/שָּׁמַ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲהֵב֜וּ/ם וַ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֲבָדוּ/ם֙ וַֽ/אֲשֶׁר֙ הָלְכ֣וּ אַֽחֲרֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר דְּרָשׁ֔וּ/ם וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לָ/הֶ֑ם לֹ֤א יֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יִקָּבֵ֔רוּ לְ/דֹ֛מֶן עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אֲדָמָ֖ה יִֽהְיֽוּ
verses.translit: vshtchvm lshmsh vlyrch vlkhl tsb' hshmym 'shr 'hbvm v'shr 'bdvm v'shr hlkhv 'chryhm v'shr drshvm v'shr hshtchvv lhm l' y'spv vl' yqbrv ldmn 'l pny h'dmh yhyv
verses.translation: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.

verses.original: וְ/נִבְחַ֥ר מָ֨וֶת֙ מֵֽ/חַיִּ֔ים לְ/כֹ֗ל הַ/שְּׁאֵרִית֙ הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִ֔ים מִן הַ/מִּשְׁפָּחָ֥ה הָֽ/רָעָ֖ה הַ/זֹּ֑את בְּ/כָל הַ/מְּקֹמ֤וֹת הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִדַּחְתִּ֣י/ם שָׁ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vnbchr mvt mchyym lkhl hsh'ryt hnsh'rym mn hmshpchh hr'h hz't bkhl hmqmvt hnsh'rym 'shr hdchtym shm n'm yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places whither I have driven them, saith the LORD of hosts.

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הֲ/יִפְּל֖וּ וְ/לֹ֣א יָק֑וּמוּ אִם יָשׁ֖וּב וְ/לֹ֥א יָשֽׁוּב
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr yhvh hyplv vl' yqvmv 'm yshvb vl' yshvb
verses.translation: Moreover thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD ; Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return?

verses.original: מַדּ֨וּעַ שׁוֹבְבָ֜ה הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּ֛ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם מְשֻׁבָ֣ה נִצַּ֑חַת הֶחֱזִ֨יקוּ֙ בַּ/תַּרְמִ֔ית מֵאֲנ֖וּ לָ/שֽׁוּב
verses.translit: mdv' shvbbh h'm hzh yrvshlm mshbh ntscht hchzyqv btrmyt m'nv lshvb
verses.translation: Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.

verses.original: הִקְשַׁ֤בְתִּי וָֽ/אֶשְׁמָע֙ לוֹא כֵ֣ן יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ אֵ֣ין אִ֗ישׁ נִחָם֙ עַל רָ֣עָת֔/וֹ לֵ/אמֹ֖ר מֶ֣ה עָשִׂ֑יתִי כֻּלֹּ֗/ה שָׁ֚ב ב/מרצות/ם בִּ/מְר֣וּצָתָ֔/ם כְּ/ס֥וּס שׁוֹטֵ֖ף בַּ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: hqshbty v'shm' lv' khn ydbrv 'yn 'ysh nchm 'l r'tv l'mr mh 'shyty khlh shb bmrtsvtm bmrvtstm khsvs shvtf bmlchmh
verses.translation: I hearkened and heard, but they spake not aright: no man repented him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? every one turned to his course, as the horse rusheth into the battle.

verses.original: גַּם חֲסִידָ֣ה בַ/שָּׁמַ֗יִם יָֽדְעָה֙ מֽוֹעֲדֶ֔י/הָ וְ/תֹ֤ר ו/סוס וְ/סִיס֙ וְ/עָג֔וּר שָׁמְר֖וּ אֶת עֵ֣ת בֹּאָ֑/נָה וְ/עַמִּ֕/י לֹ֣א יָֽדְע֔וּ אֵ֖ת מִשְׁפַּ֥ט יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: gm chsydh bshmym yd'h mv'dyh vtr vsvs vsys v'gvr shmrv 't 't b'nh v'my l' yd'v 't mshpt yhvh
verses.translation: Yea, the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming; but my people know not the judgment of the LORD .

verses.original: אֵיכָ֤ה תֹֽאמְרוּ֙ חֲכָמִ֣ים אֲנַ֔חְנוּ וְ/תוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה אִתָּ֑/נוּ אָכֵן֙ הִנֵּ֣ה לַ/שֶּׁ֣קֶר עָשָׂ֔ה עֵ֖ט שֶׁ֥קֶר סֹפְרִֽים
verses.translit: 'ykhh t'mrv chkhmym 'nchnv vtvrt yhvh 'tnv 'khn hnh lshqr 'shh 't shqr sprym
verses.translation: How do ye say, We are wise, and the law of the LORD is with us? Lo, certainly in vain made he it; the pen of the scribes is in vain.

verses.original: הֹבִ֣ישׁוּ חֲכָמִ֔ים חַ֖תּוּ וַ/יִּלָּכֵ֑דוּ הִנֵּ֤ה בִ/דְבַר יְהוָה֙ מָאָ֔סוּ וְ/חָכְמַֽת מֶ֖ה לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: hbyshv chkhmym chtv vylkhdv hnh bdbr yhvh m'sv vchkhmt mh lhm
verses.translation: The wise men are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of the LORD ; and what wisdom is in them?

verses.original: לָ/כֵן֩ אֶתֵּ֨ן אֶת נְשֵׁי/הֶ֜ם לַ/אֲחֵרִ֗ים שְׂדֽוֹתֵי/הֶם֙ לְ/י֣וֹרְשִׁ֔ים כִּ֤י מִ/קָּטֹן֙ וְ/עַד גָּד֔וֹל כֻּלֹּ֖/ה בֹּצֵ֣עַ בָּ֑צַע מִ/נָּבִיא֙ וְ/עַד כֹּהֵ֔ן כֻּלֹּ֖/ה עֹ֥שֶׂה שָּֽׁקֶר
verses.translit: lkhn 'tn 't nshyhm l'chrym shdvtyhm lyvrshym khy mqtn v'd gdvl khlh bts' bts' mnby' v'd khhn khlh 'shh shqr
verses.translation: Therefore will I give their wives unto others, and their fields to them that shall inherit them: for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness, from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.

verses.original: וַ/יְרַפּ֞וּ אֶת שֶׁ֤בֶר בַּת עַמִּ/י֙ עַל נְקַלָּ֔ה לֵ/אמֹ֖ר שָׁל֣וֹם שָׁל֑וֹם וְ/אֵ֖ין שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyrpv 't shbr bt 'my 'l nqlh l'mr shlvm shlvm v'yn shlvm
verses.translation: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.

verses.original: הֹבִ֕שׁוּ כִּ֥י תוֹעֵבָ֖ה עָשׂ֑וּ גַּם בּ֣וֹשׁ לֹֽא יֵבֹ֗שׁוּ וְ/הִכָּלֵם֙ לֹ֣א יָדָ֔עוּ לָ/כֵ֞ן יִפְּל֣וּ בַ/נֹּפְלִ֗ים בְּ/עֵ֧ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֛/ם יִכָּשְׁל֖וּ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hbshv khy tv'bh 'shv gm bvsh l' ybshv vhkhlm l' yd'v lkhn yplv bnplym b't pqdtm ykhshlv 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, saith the LORD .

verses.original: אָסֹ֥ף אֲסִיפֵ֖/ם נְאֻם יְהֹוָ֑ה אֵין֩ עֲנָבִ֨ים בַּ/גֶּ֜פֶן וְ/אֵ֧ין תְּאֵנִ֣ים בַּ/תְּאֵנָ֗ה וְ/הֶֽ/עָלֶה֙ נָבֵ֔ל וָ/אֶתֵּ֥ן לָ/הֶ֖ם יַעַבְרֽוּ/ם
verses.translit: 'sf 'sypm n'm yhvh 'yn 'nbym bgpn v'yn t'nym bt'nh vh'lh nbl v'tn lhm y'brvm
verses.translation: I will surely consume them, saith the LORD : there shall be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them.

verses.original: עַל מָה֙ אֲנַ֣חְנוּ יֹֽשְׁבִ֔ים הֵֽאָסְפ֗וּ וְ/נָב֛וֹא אֶל עָרֵ֥י הַ/מִּבְצָ֖ר וְ/נִדְּמָה שָּׁ֑ם כִּי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י/נוּ הֲדִמָּ֨/נוּ֙ וַ/יַּשְׁקֵ֣/נוּ מֵי רֹ֔אשׁ כִּ֥י חָטָ֖אנוּ לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'l mh 'nchnv yshbym h'spv vnbv' 'l 'ry hmbtsr vndmh shm khy yhvh 'lhynv hdmnv vyshqnv my r'sh khy cht'nv lyhvh
verses.translation: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the defenced cities, and let us be silent there: for the LORD our God hath put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD .

verses.original: קַוֵּ֥ה לְ/שָׁל֖וֹם וְ/אֵ֣ין ט֑וֹב לְ/עֵ֥ת מַרְפֵּ֖ה וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה בְעָתָֽה
verses.translit: qvh lshlvm v'yn tvb l't mrph vhnh b'th
verses.translation: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of health, and behold trouble!

verses.original: מִ/דָּ֤ן נִשְׁמַע֙ נַחְרַ֣ת סוּסָ֗י/ו מִ/קּוֹל֙ מִצְהֲל֣וֹת אַבִּירָ֔י/ו רָעֲשָׁ֖ה כָּל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יָּב֗וֹאוּ וַ/יֹּֽאכְלוּ֙ אֶ֣רֶץ וּ/מְלוֹאָ֔/הּ עִ֖יר וְ/יֹ֥שְׁבֵי בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: mdn nshm' nchrt svsyv mqvl mtshlvt 'byryv r'shh khl h'rts vybv'v vy'khlv 'rts vmlv'h 'yr vyshby bh
verses.translation: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein.

verses.original: כִּי֩ הִנְ/נִ֨י מְשַׁלֵּ֜חַ בָּ/כֶ֗ם נְחָשִׁים֙ צִפְעֹנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵין לָ/הֶ֖ם לָ֑חַשׁ וְ/נִשְּׁכ֥וּ אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy hnny mshlch bkhm nchshym tsp'nym 'shr 'yn lhm lchsh vnshkhv 'tkhm n'm yhvh
verses.translation: For, behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which will not be charmed, and they shall bite you, saith the LORD .

verses.original: מַבְלִ֥יגִיתִ֖/י עֲלֵ֣י יָג֑וֹן עָלַ֖/י לִבִּ֥/י דַוָּֽי
verses.translit: mblygyty 'ly ygvn 'ly lby dvy
verses.translation: When I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart is faint in me.

verses.original: הִנֵּה ק֞וֹל שַֽׁוְעַ֣ת בַּת עַמִּ֗/י מֵ/אֶ֨רֶץ֙ מַרְחַקִּ֔ים הַֽ/יהוָה֙ אֵ֣ין בְּ/צִיּ֔וֹן אִם מַלְכָּ֖/הּ אֵ֣ין בָּ֑/הּ מַדּ֗וּעַ הִכְעִס֛וּ/נִי בִּ/פְסִלֵי/הֶ֖ם בְּ/הַבְלֵ֥י נֵכָֽר
verses.translit: hnh qvl shv't bt 'my m'rts mrchqym hyhvh 'yn btsyvn 'm mlkhh 'yn bh mdv' hkh'svny bpslyhm bhbly nkhr
verses.translation: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country: Is not the LORD in Zion? is not her king in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images, and with strange vanities?

verses.original: עָבַ֥ר קָצִ֖יר כָּ֣לָה קָ֑יִץ וַ/אֲנַ֖חְנוּ ל֥וֹא נוֹשָֽׁעְנוּ
verses.translit: 'br qtsyr khlh qyts v'nchnv lv' nvsh'nv
verses.translation: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.

verses.original: עַל שֶׁ֥בֶר בַּת עַמִּ֖/י הָשְׁבָּ֑רְתִּי קָדַ֕רְתִּי שַׁמָּ֖ה הֶחֱזִקָֽתְ/נִי
verses.translit: 'l shbr bt 'my hshbrty qdrty shmh hchzqtny
verses.translation: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment hath taken hold on me.

verses.original: הַ/צֳרִי֙ אֵ֣ין בְּ/גִלְעָ֔ד אִם רֹפֵ֖א אֵ֣ין שָׁ֑ם כִּ֗י מַדּ֨וּעַ֙ לֹ֣א עָֽלְתָ֔ה אֲרֻכַ֖ת בַּת עַמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: htsry 'yn bgl'd 'm rp' 'yn shm khy mdv' l' 'lth 'rkht bt 'my
verses.translation: Is there no balm in Gilead; is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?

verses.original: מִֽי יִתְּנֵ֣/נִי בַ/מִּדְבָּ֗ר מְלוֹן֙ אֹֽרְחִ֔ים וְ/אֶֽעֶזְבָה֙ אֶת עַמִּ֔/י וְ/אֵלְכָ֖ה מֵֽ/אִתָּ֑/ם כִּ֤י כֻלָּ/ם֙ מְנָ֣אֲפִ֔ים עֲצֶ֖רֶת בֹּגְדִֽים
verses.translit: my ytnny bmdbr mlvn 'rchym v''zbh 't 'my v'lkhh m'tm khy khlm mn'pym 'tsrt bgdym
verses.translation: Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּדְרְכ֤וּ אֶת לְשׁוֹנָ/ם֙ קַשְׁתָּ֣/ם שֶׁ֔קֶר וְ/לֹ֥א לֶ/אֱמוּנָ֖ה גָּבְר֣וּ בָ/אָ֑רֶץ כִּי֩ מֵ/רָעָ֨ה אֶל רָעָ֧ה יָצָ֛אוּ וְ/אֹתִ֥/י לֹֽא יָדָ֖עוּ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vydrkhv 't lshvnm qshtm shqr vl' l'mvnh gbrv b'rts khy mr'h 'l r'h yts'v v'ty l' yd'v n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.

verses.original: אִ֤ישׁ מֵ/רֵעֵ֨/הוּ֙ הִשָּׁמֵ֔רוּ וְ/עַל כָּל אָ֖ח אַל תִּבְטָ֑חוּ כִּ֤י כָל אָח֙ עָק֣וֹב יַעְקֹ֔ב וְ/כָל רֵ֖עַ רָכִ֥יל יַהֲלֹֽךְ
verses.translit: 'ysh mr'hv hshmrv v'l khl 'ch 'l tbtchv khy khl 'ch 'qvb y'qb vkhl r' rkhyl yhlkh
verses.translation: And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies: but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אִ֤ישׁ בְּ/רֵעֵ֨/הוּ֙ יְהָתֵ֔לּוּ וֶ/אֱמֶ֖ת לֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ לִמְּד֧וּ לְשׁוֹנָ֛/ם דַּבֶּר שֶׁ֖קֶר הַעֲוֵ֥ה נִלְאֽוּ
verses.translit: v'ysh br'hv yhtlv v'mt l' ydbrv lmdv lshvnm dbr shqr h'vh nl'v
verses.translation: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.

verses.original: שִׁבְתְּ/ךָ֖ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ מִרְמָ֑ה בְּ/מִרְמָ֛ה מֵאֲנ֥וּ דַֽעַת אוֹתִ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: shbtkh btvkh mrmh bmrmh m'nv d't 'vty n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And they will deceive every one his neighbour, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies, and weary themselves to commit iniquity.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הִנְ/נִ֥י צוֹרְפָ֖/ם וּ/בְחַנְתִּ֑י/ם כִּֽי אֵ֣יךְ אֶעֱשֶׂ֔ה מִ/פְּנֵ֖י בַּת עַמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt hnny tsvrpm vbchntym khy 'ykh ''shh mpny bt 'my
verses.translation: Thine habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, saith the LORD .

verses.original: חֵ֥ץ שוחט שָׁח֛וּט לְשׁוֹנָ֖/ם מִרְמָ֣ה דִבֵּ֑ר בְּ/פִ֗י/ו שָׁל֤וֹם אֶת רֵעֵ֨/הוּ֙ יְדַבֵּ֔ר וּ/בְ/קִרְבּ֖/וֹ יָשִׂ֥ים אָרְבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: chts shvcht shchvt lshvnm mrmh dbr bpyv shlvm 't r'hv ydbr vbqrbv yshym 'rbv
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how shall I do for the daughter of my people?

verses.original: הַ/עַל אֵ֥לֶּה לֹֽא אֶפְקָד בָּ֖/ם נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה אִ֚ם בְּ/ג֣וֹי אֲשֶׁר כָּ/זֶ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתְנַקֵּ֖ם נַפְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: h'l 'lh l' 'pqd bm n'm yhvh 'm bgvy 'shr khzh l' ttnqm npshy
verses.translation: Their tongue is as an arrow shot out; it speaketh deceit: one speaketh peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he layeth his wait.

verses.original: עַל הֶ֨/הָרִ֜ים אֶשָּׂ֧א בְכִ֣י וָ/נֶ֗הִי וְ/עַל נְא֤וֹת מִדְבָּר֙ קִינָ֔ה כִּ֤י נִצְּתוּ֙ מִ/בְּלִי אִ֣ישׁ עֹבֵ֔ר וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ ק֣וֹל מִקְנֶ֑ה מֵ/ע֤וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ וְ/עַד בְּהֵמָ֔ה נָדְד֖וּ הָלָֽכוּ
verses.translit: 'l hhrym 'sh' bkhy vnhy v'l n'vt mdbr qynh khy ntstv mbly 'ysh 'br vl' shm'v qvl mqnh m'vf hshmym v'd bhmh nddv hlkhv
verses.translation: Shall I not visit them for these things ? saith the LORD : shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֧י אֶת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֛ם לְ/גַלִּ֖ים מְע֣וֹן תַּנִּ֑ים וְ/אֶת עָרֵ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה אֶתֵּ֥ן שְׁמָמָ֖ה מִ/בְּלִ֖י יוֹשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: vntty 't yrvshlm lglym m'vn tnym v't 'ry yhvdh 'tn shmmh mbly yvshb
verses.translation: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none can pass through them; neither can men hear the voice of the cattle; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled; they are gone.

verses.original: מִֽי הָ/אִ֤ישׁ הֶֽ/חָכָם֙ וְ/יָבֵ֣ן אֶת זֹ֔את וַ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר פִּֽי יְהוָ֛ה אֵלָ֖י/ו וְ/יַגִּדָ֑/הּ עַל מָה֙ אָבְדָ֣ה הָ/אָ֔רֶץ נִצְּתָ֥ה כַ/מִּדְבָּ֖ר מִ/בְּלִ֖י עֹבֵֽר
verses.translit: my h'ysh hchkhm vybn 't z't v'shr dbr py yhvh 'lyv vygdh 'l mh 'bdh h'rts ntsth khmdbr mbly 'br
verses.translation: And I will make Jerusalem heaps, and a den of dragons; and I will make the cities of Judah desolate, without an inhabitant.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה עַל עָזְבָ/ם֙ אֶת תּ֣וֹרָתִ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/לֹא שָׁמְע֥וּ בְ/קוֹלִ֖/י וְ/לֹא הָ֥לְכוּ בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l 'zbm 't tvrty 'shr ntty lpnyhm vl' shm'v bqvly vl' hlkhv bh
verses.translation: Who is the wise man, that may understand this? and who is he to whom the mouth of the LORD hath spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perisheth and is burned up like a wilderness, that none passeth through?

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֣לְכ֔וּ אַחֲרֵ֖י שְׁרִר֣וּת לִבָּ֑/ם וְ/אַחֲרֵי֙ הַ/בְּעָלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִמְּד֖וּ/ם אֲבוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vylkhv 'chry shrrvt lbm v'chry hb'lym 'shr lmdvm 'bvtm
verses.translation: And the LORD saith, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein;

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְ/נִ֧י מַאֲכִילָ֛/ם אֶת הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּ֖ה לַֽעֲנָ֑ה וְ/הִשְׁקִיתִ֖י/ם מֵי רֹֽאשׁ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hnny m'khylm 't h'm hzh l'nh vhshqytym my r'sh
verses.translation: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart, and after Baalim, which their fathers taught them:

verses.original: וַ/הֲפִֽצוֹתִי/ם֙ בַּ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יָֽדְע֔וּ הֵ֖מָּה וַֽ/אֲבוֹתָ֑/ם וְ/שִׁלַּחְתִּ֤י אַֽחֲרֵי/הֶם֙ אֶת הַ/חֶ֔רֶב עַ֥ד כַּלּוֹתִ֖/י אוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhptsvtym bgvym 'shr l' yd'v hmh v'bvtm vshlchty 'chryhm 't hchrb 'd khlvty 'vtm
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הִתְבּֽוֹנְנ֛וּ וְ/קִרְא֥וּ לַ/מְקוֹנְנ֖וֹת וּ/תְבוֹאֶ֑ינָה וְ/אֶל הַ/חֲכָמ֥וֹת שִׁלְח֖וּ וְ/תָבֽוֹאנָה
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt htbvnnv vqr'v lmqvnnvt vtbv'ynh v'l hchkhmvt shlchv vtbv'nh
verses.translation: I will scatter them also among the heathen, whom neither they nor their fathers have known: and I will send a sword after them, till I have consumed them.

verses.original: וּ/תְמַהֵ֕רְנָה וְ/תִשֶּׂ֥נָה עָלֵ֖י/נוּ נֶ֑הִי וְ/תֵרַ֤דְנָה עֵינֵ֨י/נוּ֙ דִּמְעָ֔ה וְ/עַפְעַפֵּ֖י/נוּ יִזְּלוּ מָֽיִם
verses.translit: vtmhrnh vtshnh 'lynv nhy vtrdnh 'ynynv dm'h v'p'pynv yzlv mym
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Consider ye, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for cunning women , that they may come:

verses.original: כִּ֣י ק֥וֹל נְהִ֛י נִשְׁמַ֥ע מִ/צִּיּ֖וֹן אֵ֣יךְ שֻׁדָּ֑דְנוּ בֹּ֤שְׁנֽוּ מְאֹד֙ כִּֽי עָזַ֣בְנוּ אָ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י הִשְׁלִ֖יכוּ מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: khy qvl nhy nshm' mtsyvn 'ykh shddnv bshnv m'd khy 'zbnv 'rts khy hshlykhv mshkhnvtynv
verses.translation: And let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.

verses.original: כִּֽי שְׁמַ֤עְנָה נָשִׁים֙ דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה וְ/תִקַּ֥ח אָזְנְ/כֶ֖ם דְּבַר פִּ֑י/ו וְ/לַמֵּ֤דְנָה בְנֽוֹתֵי/כֶם֙ נֶ֔הִי וְ/אִשָּׁ֥ה רְעוּתָ֖/הּ קִינָֽה
verses.translit: khy shm'nh nshym dbr yhvh vtqch 'znkhm dbr pyv vlmdnh bnvtykhm nhy v'shh r'vth qynh
verses.translation: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we spoiled! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because our dwellings have cast us out.

verses.original: כִּֽי עָ֤לָה מָ֨וֶת֙ בְּ/חַלּוֹנֵ֔י/נוּ בָּ֖א בְּ/אַרְמְנוֹתֵ֑י/נוּ לְ/הַכְרִ֤ית עוֹלָל֙ מִ/ח֔וּץ בַּחוּרִ֖ים מֵ/רְחֹבֽוֹת
verses.translit: khy 'lh mvt bchlvnynv b' b'rmnvtynv lhkhryt 'vll mchvts bchvrym mrchbvt
verses.translation: Yet hear the word of the LORD , O ye women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth, and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbour lamentation.

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֗ר כֹּ֚ה נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וְ/נָֽפְלָה֙ נִבְלַ֣ת הָֽ/אָדָ֔ם כְּ/דֹ֖מֶן עַל פְּנֵ֣י הַ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה וּ/כְ/עָמִ֛יר מֵ/אַחֲרֵ֥י הַ/קֹּצֵ֖ר וְ/אֵ֥ין מְאַסֵּֽף
verses.translit: dbr khh n'm yhvh vnplh nblt h'dm khdmn 'l pny hshdh vkh'myr m'chry hqtsr v'yn m'sf
verses.translation: For death is come up into our windows, and is entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from without, and the young men from the streets.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אַל יִתְהַלֵּ֤ל חָכָם֙ בְּ/חָכְמָת֔/וֹ וְ/אַל יִתְהַלֵּ֥ל הַ/גִּבּ֖וֹר בִּ/גְבֽוּרָת֑/וֹ אַל יִתְהַלֵּ֥ל עָשִׁ֖יר בְּ/עָשְׁרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'l ythll chkhm bchkhmtv v'l ythll hgbvr bgbvrtv 'l ythll 'shyr b'shrv
verses.translation: Speak, Thus saith the LORD , Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman, and none shall gather them .

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם בְּ/זֹ֞את יִתְהַלֵּ֣ל הַ/מִּתְהַלֵּ֗ל הַשְׂכֵּל֮ וְ/יָדֹ֣עַ אוֹתִ/י֒ כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה עֹ֥שֶׂה חֶ֛סֶד מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ/צְדָקָ֖ה בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי בְ/אֵ֥לֶּה חָפַ֖צְתִּי נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy 'm bz't ythll hmthll hshkhl vyd' 'vty khy 'ny yhvh 'shh chsd mshpt vtsdqh b'rts khy b'lh chptsty n'm yhvh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty man glory in his might, let not the rich man glory in his riches:

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וּ/פָ֣קַדְתִּ֔י עַל כָּל מ֖וּל בְּ/עָרְלָֽה
verses.translit: hnh ymym b'ym n'm yhvh vpqdty 'l khl mvl b'rlh
verses.translation: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the LORD which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the LORD .

verses.original: עַל מִצְרַ֣יִם וְ/עַל יְהוּדָ֗ה וְ/עַל אֱד֞וֹם וְ/עַל בְּנֵ֤י עַמּוֹן֙ וְ/עַל מוֹאָ֔ב וְ/עַל֙ כָּל קְצוּצֵ֣י פֵאָ֔ה הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר כִּ֤י כָל הַ/גּוֹיִם֙ עֲרֵלִ֔ים וְ/כָל בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַרְלֵי לֵֽב
verses.translit: 'l mtsrym v'l yhvdh v'l 'dvm v'l bny 'mvn v'l mv'b v'l khl qtsvtsy p'h hyshbym bmdbr khy khl hgvym 'rlym vkhl byt yshr'l 'rly lb
verses.translation: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD , that I will punish all them which are circumcised with the uncircumcised;

Egypt, and Judah, and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all that are in the utmost corners, that dwell in the wilderness: for all these nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in the heart.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֣וּ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: shm'v 't hdbr 'shr dbr yhvh 'lykhm byt yshr'l
verses.translation: Hear ye the word which the LORD speaketh unto you, O house of Israel:

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אֶל דֶּ֤רֶךְ הַ/גּוֹיִם֙ אַל תִּלְמָ֔דוּ וּ/מֵ/אֹת֥וֹת הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם אַל תֵּחָ֑תּוּ כִּֽי יֵחַ֥תּוּ הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם מֵ/הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'l drkh hgvym 'l tlmdv vm'tvt hshmym 'l tchtv khy ychtv hgvym mhmh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , Learn not the way of the heathen, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.

verses.original: כִּֽי חֻקּ֥וֹת הָֽ/עַמִּ֖ים הֶ֣בֶל ה֑וּא כִּֽי עֵץ֙ מִ/יַּ֣עַר כְּרָת֔/וֹ מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְדֵ֥י חָרָ֖שׁ בַּֽ/מַּעֲצָֽד
verses.translit: khy chqvt h'mym hbl hv' khy 'ts my'r khrtv m'shh ydy chrsh bm'tsd
verses.translation: For the customs of the people are vain: for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.

verses.original: בְּ/כֶ֥סֶף וּ/בְ/זָהָ֖ב יְיַפֵּ֑/הוּ בְּ/מַסְמְר֧וֹת וּ/בְ/מַקָּב֛וֹת יְחַזְּק֖וּ/ם וְ/ל֥וֹא יָפִֽיק
verses.translit: bkhsf vbzhb yyphv bmsmrvt vbmqbvt ychzqvm vlv' ypyq
verses.translation: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.

verses.original: כְּ/תֹ֨מֶר מִקְשָׁ֥ה הֵ֨מָּה֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ נָשׂ֥וֹא יִנָּשׂ֖וּא כִּ֣י לֹ֣א יִצְעָ֑דוּ אַל תִּֽירְא֤וּ מֵ/הֶם֙ כִּי לֹ֣א יָרֵ֔עוּ וְ/גַם הֵיטֵ֖יב אֵ֥ין אוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khtmr mqshh hmh vl' ydbrv nshv' ynshv' khy l' yts'dv 'l tyr'v mhm khy l' yr'v vgm hytyb 'yn 'vtm
verses.translation: They are upright as the palm tree, but speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also is it in them to do good.

verses.original: מֵ/אֵ֥ין כָּמ֖וֹ/ךָ יְהוָ֑ה גָּד֥וֹל אַתָּ֛ה וְ/גָד֥וֹל שִׁמְ/ךָ֖ בִּ/גְבוּרָֽה
verses.translit: m'yn khmvkh yhvh gdvl 'th vgdvl shmkh bgbvrh
verses.translation: Forasmuch as there is none like unto thee, O LORD ; thou art great, and thy name is great in might.

verses.original: מִ֣י לֹ֤א יִֽרָאֲ/ךָ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם כִּ֥י לְ/ךָ֖ יָאָ֑תָה כִּ֣י בְ/כָל חַכְמֵ֧י הַ/גּוֹיִ֛ם וּ/בְ/כָל מַלְכוּתָ֖/ם מֵ/אֵ֥ין כָּמֽוֹ/ךָ
verses.translit: my l' yr'kh mlkh hgvym khy lkh y'th khy bkhl chkhmy hgvym vbkhl mlkhvtm m'yn khmvkh
verses.translation: Who would not fear thee, O King of nations? for to thee doth it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like unto thee.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/אַחַ֖ת יִבְעֲר֣וּ וְ/יִכְסָ֑לוּ מוּסַ֥ר הֲבָלִ֖ים עֵ֥ץ הֽוּא
verses.translit: vb'cht yb'rv vykhslv mvsr hblym 'ts hv'
verses.translation: But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock is a doctrine of vanities.

verses.original: כֶּ֣סֶף מְרֻקָּ֞ע מִ/תַּרְשִׁ֣ישׁ יוּבָ֗א וְ/זָהָב֙ מֵֽ/אוּפָ֔ז מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חָרָ֖שׁ וִ/ידֵ֣י צוֹרֵ֑ף תְּכֵ֤לֶת וְ/אַרְגָּמָן֙ לְבוּשָׁ֔/ם מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֲכָמִ֖ים כֻּלָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: khsf mrq' mtrshysh yvb' vzhb m'vpz m'shh chrsh vydy tsvrf tkhlt v'rgmn lbvshm m'shh chkhmym khlm
verses.translation: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the founder: blue and purple is their clothing: they are all the work of cunning men .

verses.original: וַֽ/יהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהִים֙ אֱמֶ֔ת הֽוּא אֱלֹהִ֥ים חַיִּ֖ים וּ/מֶ֣לֶךְ עוֹלָ֑ם מִ/קִּצְפּ/וֹ֙ תִּרְעַ֣שׁ הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/לֹֽא יָכִ֥לוּ גוֹיִ֖ם זַעְמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyhvh 'lhym 'mt hv' 'lhym chyym vmlkh 'vlm mqtspv tr'sh h'rts vl' ykhlv gvym z'mv
verses.translation: But the LORD is the true God, he is the living God, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.

verses.original: כִּ/דְנָה֙ תֵּאמְר֣וּן לְ/ה֔וֹם אֱלָ֣הַיָּ֔/א דִּֽי שְׁמַיָּ֥/א וְ/אַרְקָ֖/א לָ֣א עֲבַ֑דוּ יֵאבַ֧דוּ מֵֽ/אַרְעָ֛/א וּ/מִן תְּח֥וֹת שְׁמַיָּ֖/א אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: khdnh t'mrvn lhvm 'lhy' dy shmy' v'rq' l' 'bdv y'bdv m'r'' vmn tchvt shmy' 'lh
verses.translation: Thus shall ye say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, even they shall perish from the earth, and from under these heavens.

verses.original: עֹשֵׂ֥ה אֶ֨רֶץ֙ בְּ/כֹח֔/וֹ מֵכִ֥ין תֵּבֵ֖ל בְּ/חָכְמָת֑/וֹ וּ/בִ/תְבוּנָת֖/וֹ נָטָ֥ה שָׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: 'shh 'rts bkhchv mkhyn tbl bchkhmtv vbtbvntv nth shmym
verses.translation: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion.

verses.original: לְ/ק֨וֹל תִּתּ֜/וֹ הֲמ֥וֹן מַ֨יִם֙ בַּ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וַ/יַּעֲלֶ֥ה נְשִׂאִ֖ים מִ/קְצֵ֣ה ארץ הָ/אָ֑רֶץ בְּרָקִ֤ים לַ/מָּטָר֙ עָשָׂ֔ה וַ/יּ֥וֹצֵא ר֖וּחַ מֵ/אֹצְרֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: lqvl ttv hmvn mym bshmym vy'lh nsh'ym mqtsh 'rts h'rts brqym lmtr 'shh vyvts' rvch m'tsrtyv
verses.translation: When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.

verses.original: נִבְעַ֤ר כָּל אָדָם֙ מִ/דַּ֔עַת הֹבִ֥ישׁ כָּל צוֹרֵ֖ף מִ/פָּ֑סֶל כִּ֛י שֶׁ֥קֶר נִסְכּ֖/וֹ וְ/לֹא ר֥וּחַ בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: nb'r khl 'dm md't hbysh khl tsvrf mpsl khy shqr nskhv vl' rvch bm
verses.translation: Every man is brutish in his knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

verses.original: הֶ֣בֶל הֵ֔מָּה מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה תַּעְתֻּעִ֑ים בְּ/עֵ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖/ם יֹאבֵֽדוּ
verses.translit: hbl hmh m'shh t't'ym b't pqdtm y'bdv
verses.translation: They are vanity, and the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

verses.original: לֹֽא כְ/אֵ֜לֶּה חֵ֣לֶק יַעֲקֹ֗ב כִּֽי יוֹצֵ֤ר הַ/כֹּל֙ ה֔וּא וְ/יִ֨שְׂרָאֵ֔ל שֵׁ֖בֶט נַֽחֲלָת֑/וֹ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: l' kh'lh chlq y'qb khy yvtsr hkhl hv' vyshr'l shbt nchltv yhvh tsb'vt shmv
verses.translation: The portion of Jacob is not like them: for he is the former of all things; and Israel is the rod of his inheritance: The LORD of hosts is his name.

verses.original: אִסְפִּ֥י מֵ/אֶ֖רֶץ כִּנְעָתֵ֑/ךְ ישבתי יֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בַּ/מָּצֽוֹר
verses.translit: 'spy m'rts khn'tkh yshbty yshbt bmtsvr
verses.translation: Gather up thy wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.

verses.original: כִּֽי כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְ/נִ֥י קוֹלֵ֛עַ אֶת יוֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָ/אָ֖רֶץ בַּ/פַּ֣עַם הַ/זֹּ֑את וַ/הֲצֵר֥וֹתִי לָ/הֶ֖ם לְמַ֥עַן יִמְצָֽאוּ
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh hnny qvl' 't yvshby h'rts bp'm hz't vhtsrvty lhm lm'n ymts'v
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD , Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once, and will distress them, that they may find it so .

verses.original: א֥וֹי לִ/י֙ עַל שִׁבְרִ֔/י נַחְלָ֖ה מַכָּתִ֑/י וַ/אֲנִ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי אַ֛ךְ זֶ֥ה חֳלִ֖י וְ/אֶשָּׂאֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: 'vy ly 'l shbry nchlh mkhty v'ny 'mrty 'kh zh chly v'sh'nv
verses.translation: Woe is me for my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this is a grief, and I must bear it.

verses.original: אָהֳלִ֣/י שֻׁדָּ֔ד וְ/כָל מֵיתָרַ֖/י נִתָּ֑קוּ בָּנַ֤/י יְצָאֻ֨/נִי֙ וְ/אֵינָ֔/ם אֵין נֹטֶ֥ה עוֹד֙ אָהֳלִ֔/י וּ/מֵקִ֖ים יְרִיעוֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'hly shdd vkhl mytry ntqv bny yts'ny v'ynm 'yn nth 'vd 'hly vmqym yry'vty
verses.translation: My tabernacle is spoiled, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth of me, and they are not: there is none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.

verses.original: כִּ֤י נִבְעֲרוּ֙ הָֽ/רֹעִ֔ים וְ/אֶת יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֣א דָרָ֑שׁוּ עַל כֵּן֙ לֹ֣א הִשְׂכִּ֔ילוּ וְ/כָל מַרְעִיתָ֖/ם נָפֽוֹצָה
verses.translit: khy nb'rv hr'ym v't yhvh l' drshv 'l khn l' hshkhylv vkhl mr'ytm npvtsh
verses.translation: For the pastors are become brutish, and have not sought the LORD : therefore they shall not prosper, and all their flocks shall be scattered.

verses.original: ק֤וֹל שְׁמוּעָה֙ הִנֵּ֣ה בָאָ֔ה וְ/רַ֥עַשׁ גָּד֖וֹל מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֑וֹן לָ/שׂ֞וּם אֶת עָרֵ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה שְׁמָמָ֖ה מְע֥וֹן תַּנִּֽים
verses.translit: qvl shmv'h hnh b'h vr'sh gdvl m'rts tspvn lshvm 't 'ry yhvdh shmmh m'vn tnym
verses.translation: Behold, the noise of the bruit is come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah desolate, and a den of dragons.

verses.original: יָדַ֣עְתִּי יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י לֹ֥א לָ/אָדָ֖ם דַּרְכּ֑/וֹ לֹֽא לְ/אִ֣ישׁ הֹלֵ֔ךְ וְ/הָכִ֖ין אֶֽת צַעֲדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: yd'ty yhvh khy l' l'dm drkhv l' l'ysh hlkh vhkhyn 't ts'dv
verses.translation: O LORD , I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man that walketh to direct his steps.

verses.original: יַסְּרֵ֥/נִי יְהוָ֖ה אַךְ בְּ/מִשְׁפָּ֑ט אַל בְּ/אַפְּ/ךָ֖ פֶּן תַּמְעִטֵֽ/נִי
verses.translit: ysrny yhvh 'kh bmshpt 'l b'pkh pn tm'tny
verses.translation: O LORD , correct me, but with judgment; not in thine anger, lest thou bring me to nothing.

verses.original: שְׁפֹ֣ךְ חֲמָתְ/ךָ֗ עַל הַ/גּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא יְדָע֔וּ/ךָ וְ/עַל֙ מִשְׁפָּח֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/שִׁמְ/ךָ֖ לֹ֣א קָרָ֑אוּ כִּֽי אָכְל֣וּ אֶֽת יַעֲקֹ֗ב וַ/אֲכָלֻ֨/הוּ֙ וַ/יְכַלֻּ֔/הוּ וְ/אֶת נָוֵ֖/הוּ הֵשַֽׁמּוּ
verses.translit: shpkh chmtkh 'l hgvym 'shr l' yd'vkh v'l mshpchvt 'shr bshmkh l' qr'v khy 'khlv 't y'qb v'khlhv vykhlhv v't nvhv hshmv
verses.translation: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not, and upon the families that call not on thy name: for they have eaten up Jacob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.

verses.original: הַ/דָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ מֵ/אֵ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr hyh 'l yrmyhv m't yhvh l'mr
verses.translation: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD , saying,

verses.original: שִׁמְע֕וּ אֶת דִּבְרֵ֖י הַ/בְּרִ֣ית הַ/זֹּ֑את וְ/דִבַּרְתָּ/ם֙ אֶל אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ/עַל יֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: shm'v 't dbry hbryt hz't vdbrtm 'l 'ysh yhvdh v'l yshby yrvshlm
verses.translation: Hear ye the words of this covenant, and speak unto the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם כֹּֽה אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אָר֣וּר הָ/אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יִשְׁמַ֔ע אֶת דִּבְרֵ֖י הַ/בְּרִ֥ית הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l 'rvr h'ysh 'shr l' yshm' 't dbry hbryt hz't
verses.translation: And say thou unto them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Cursed be the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant,

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּ֣יתִי אֶת אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֡ם בְּ/י֣וֹם הוֹצִיאִֽ/י אוֹתָ֣/ם מֵ/אֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַיִם֩ מִ/כּ֨וּר הַ/בַּרְזֶ֜ל לֵ/אמֹ֗ר שִׁמְע֤וּ בְ/קוֹלִ/י֙ וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם אוֹתָ֔/ם כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר אֲצַוֶּ֖ה אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם וִ/הְיִ֤יתֶם לִ/י֙ לְ/עָ֔ם וְ/אָ֣נֹכִ֔י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָ/כֶ֖ם לֵ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: 'shr tsvyty 't 'bvtykhm byvm hvtsy'y 'vtm m'rts mtsrym mkhvr hbrzl l'mr shm'v bqvly v'shytm 'vtm khkhl 'shr 'tsvh 'tkhm vhyytm ly l'm v'nkhy 'hyh lkhm l'lhym
verses.translation: Which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so shall ye be my people, and I will be your God:

verses.original: לְמַעַן֩ הָקִ֨ים אֶת הַ/שְּׁבוּעָ֜ה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי לַ/אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֗ם לָ/תֵ֤ת לָ/הֶם֙ אֶ֣רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֛ב וּ/דְבַ֖שׁ כַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וָ/אַ֥עַן וָ/אֹמַ֖ר אָמֵ֥ן יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: lm'n hqym 't hshbv'h 'shr nshb'ty l'bvtykhm ltt lhm 'rts zbt chlb vdbsh khyvm hzh v''n v'mr 'mn yhvh
verses.translation: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day. Then answered I, and said, So be it, O LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔/י קְרָ֨א אֶת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֤ים הָ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ בְּ/עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּ/בְ/חֻצ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר שִׁמְע֗וּ אֶת דִּבְרֵי֙ הַ/בְּרִ֣ית הַ/זֹּ֔את וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly qr' 't khl hdbrym h'lh b'ry yhvdh vbchtsvt yrvshlm l'mr shm'v 't dbry hbryt hz't v'shytm 'vtm
verses.translation: Then the LORD said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear ye the words of this covenant, and do them.

verses.original: כִּי֩ הָעֵ֨ד הַעִדֹ֜תִי בַּ/אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֗ם בְּ/יוֹם֩ הַעֲלוֹתִ֨/י אוֹתָ֜/ם מֵ/אֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ וְ/עַד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה הַשְׁכֵּ֥ם וְ/הָעֵ֖ד לֵ/אמֹ֑ר שִׁמְע֖וּ בְּ/קוֹלִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy h'd h'dty b'bvtykhm byvm h'lvty 'vtm m'rts mtsrym v'd hyvm hzh hshkhm vh'd l'mr shm'v bqvly
verses.translation: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even unto this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֤א שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ וְ/לֹֽא הִטּ֣וּ אֶת אָזְנָ֔/ם וַ/יֵּ֣לְכ֔וּ אִ֕ישׁ בִּ/שְׁרִיר֖וּת לִבָּ֣/ם הָ/רָ֑ע וָ/אָבִ֨יא עֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם אֶֽת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֧י הַ/בְּרִית הַ/זֹּ֛את אֲשֶׁר צִוִּ֥יתִי לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת וְ/לֹ֥א עָשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: vl' shm'v vl' htv 't 'znm vylkhv 'ysh bshryrvt lbm hr' v'by' 'lyhm 't khl dbry hbryt hz't 'shr tsvyty l'shvt vl' 'shv
verses.translation: Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart: therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do; but they did them not.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑/י נִֽמְצָא קֶ֨שֶׁר֙ בְּ/אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה וּ/בְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly nmts' qshr b'ysh yhvdh vbyshby yrvshlm
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

verses.original: שָׁ֩בוּ֩ עַל עֲוֺנֹ֨ת אֲבוֹתָ֜/ם הָ/רִֽאשֹׁנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר מֵֽאֲנוּ֙ לִ/שְׁמ֣וֹעַ אֶת דְּבָרַ֔/י וְ/הֵ֣מָּה הָלְכ֗וּ אַחֲרֵ֛י אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים לְ/עָבְדָ֑/ם הֵפֵ֤רוּ בֵֽית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וּ/בֵ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶת בְּרִיתִ֕/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖תִּי אֶת אֲבוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: shbv 'l 'vnt 'bvtm hr'shnym 'shr m'nv lshmv' 't dbry vhmh hlkhv 'chry 'lhym 'chrym l'bdm hprv byt yshr'l vbyt yhvdh 't bryty 'shr khrty 't 'bvtm
verses.translation: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, which refused to hear my words; and they went after other gods to serve them: the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנְ/נִ֨י מֵבִ֤יא אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא יוּכְל֖וּ לָ/צֵ֣את מִמֶּ֑/נָּה וְ/זָעֲק֣וּ אֵלַ֔/י וְ/לֹ֥א אֶשְׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh hnny mby' 'lyhm r'h 'shr l' yvkhlv lts't mmnh vz'qv 'ly vl' 'shm' 'lyhm
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD , Behold, I will bring evil upon them, which they shall not be able to escape; and though they shall cry unto me, I will not hearken unto them.

verses.original: וְ/הָֽלְכ֞וּ עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה וְ/יֹשְׁבֵי֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ/זָֽעֲקוּ֙ אֶל הָ֣/אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥ם מְקַטְּרִ֖ים לָ/הֶ֑ם וְ/הוֹשֵׁ֛עַ לֹֽא יוֹשִׁ֥יעוּ לָ/הֶ֖ם בְּ/עֵ֥ת רָעָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhlkhv 'ry yhvdh vyshby yrvshlm vz'qv 'l h'lhym 'shr hm mqtrym lhm vhvsh' l' yvshy'v lhm b't r'tm
verses.translation: Then shall the cities of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem go, and cry unto the gods unto whom they offer incense: but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble.

verses.original: כִּ֚י מִסְפַּ֣ר עָרֶ֔י/ךָ הָי֥וּ אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ יְהוּדָ֑ה וּ/מִסְפַּ֞ר חֻצ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם שַׂמְתֶּ֤ם מִזְבְּחוֹת֙ לַ/בֹּ֔שֶׁת מִזְבְּח֖וֹת לְ/קַטֵּ֥ר לַ/בָּֽעַל
verses.translit: khy mspr 'rykh hyv 'lhykh yhvdh vmspr chtsvt yrvshlm shmtm mzbchvt lbsht mzbchvt lqtr lb'l
verses.translation: For according to the number of thy cities were thy gods, O Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have ye set up altars to that shameful thing, even altars to burn incense unto Baal.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֗ה אַל תִּתְפַּלֵּל֙ בְּעַד הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/אַל תִּשָּׂ֥א בַעֲדָ֖/ם רִנָּ֣ה וּ/תְפִלָּ֑ה כִּ֣י אֵינֶ֣/נִּי שֹׁמֵ֗עַ בְּ/עֵ֛ת קָרְאָ֥/ם אֵלַ֖/י בְּעַ֥ד רָעָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'th 'l ttpll b'd h'm hzh v'l tsh' b'dm rnh vtplh khy 'ynny shm' b't qr'm 'ly b'd r'tm
verses.translation: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up a cry or prayer for them: for I will not hear them in the time that they cry unto me for their trouble.

verses.original: מֶ֣ה לִֽ/ידִידִ֞/י בְּ/בֵיתִ֗/י עֲשׂוֹתָ֤/הּ הַֽ/מְזִמָּ֨תָ/ה֙ הָֽ/רַבִּ֔ים וּ/בְשַׂר קֹ֖דֶשׁ יַעַבְר֣וּ מֵֽ/עָלָ֑יִ/ךְ כִּ֥י רָעָתֵ֖/כִי אָ֥ז תַּעֲלֹֽזִי
verses.translit: mh lydydy bbyty 'shvth hmzmth hrbym vbshr qdsh y'brv m'lykh khy r'tkhy 'z t'lzy
verses.translation: What hath my beloved to do in mine house, seeing she hath wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from thee? when thou doest evil, then thou rejoicest.

verses.original: זַ֤יִת רַֽעֲנָן֙ יְפֵ֣ה פְרִי תֹ֔אַר קָרָ֥א יְהוָ֖ה שְׁמֵ֑/ךְ לְ/ק֣וֹל הֲמוּלָּ֣ה גְדֹלָ֗ה הִצִּ֥ית אֵשׁ֙ עָלֶ֔י/הָ וְ/רָע֖וּ דָּלִיּוֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: zyt r'nn yph pry t'r qr' yhvh shmkh lqvl hmvlh gdlh htsyt 'sh 'lyh vr'v dlyvtyv
verses.translation: The LORD called thy name, A green olive tree, fair, and of goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it, and the branches of it are broken.

verses.original: וַ/יהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ הַ/נּוֹטֵ֣עַ אוֹתָ֔/ךְ דִּבֶּ֥ר עָלַ֖יִ/ךְ רָעָ֑ה בִּ֠/גְלַל רָעַ֨ת בֵּֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּ/בֵ֣ית יְהוּדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשׂ֥וּ לָ/הֶ֛ם לְ/הַכְעִסֵ֖/נִי לְ/קַטֵּ֥ר לַ/בָּֽעַל
verses.translit: vyhvh tsb'vt hnvt' 'vtkh dbr 'lykh r'h bgll r't byt yshr'l vbyt yhvdh 'shr 'shv lhm lhkh'sny lqtr lb'l
verses.translation: For the LORD of hosts, that planted thee, hath pronounced evil against thee, for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal.

verses.original: וַֽ/יהוָ֥ה הֽוֹדִיעַ֖/נִי וָֽ/אֵדָ֑עָ/ה אָ֖ז הִרְאִיתַ֥/נִי מַעַלְלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyhvh hvdy'ny v'd'h 'z hr'ytny m'llyhm
verses.translation: And the LORD hath given me knowledge of it , and I know it: then thou shewedst me their doings.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֕י כְּ/כֶ֥בֶשׂ אַלּ֖וּף יוּבַ֣ל לִ/טְב֑וֹחַ וְ/לֹֽא יָדַ֜עְתִּי כִּֽי עָלַ֣/י חָשְׁב֣וּ מַחֲשָׁב֗וֹת נַשְׁחִ֨יתָה עֵ֤ץ בְּ/לַחְמ/וֹ֙ וְ/נִכְרְתֶ֨/נּוּ֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּ֔ים וּ/שְׁמ֖/וֹ לֹֽא יִזָּכֵ֥ר עֽוֹד
verses.translit: v'ny khkhbsh 'lvf yvbl ltbvch vl' yd'ty khy 'ly chshbv mchshbvt nshchyth 'ts blchmv vnkhrtnv m'rts chyym vshmv l' yzkhr 'vd
verses.translation: But I was like a lamb or an ox that is brought to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me, saying , Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.

verses.original: וַֽ/יהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ שֹׁפֵ֣ט צֶ֔דֶק בֹּחֵ֥ן כְּלָי֖וֹת וָ/לֵ֑ב אֶרְאֶ֤ה נִקְמָֽתְ/ךָ֙ מֵ/הֶ֔ם כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ גִּלִּ֥יתִי אֶת רִיבִֽ/י
verses.translit: vyhvh tsb'vt shpt tsdq bchn khlyvt vlb 'r'h nqmtkh mhm khy 'lykh glyty 't ryby
verses.translation: But, O LORD of hosts, that judgest righteously, that triest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I revealed my cause.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ עַל אַנְשֵׁ֣י עֲנָת֔וֹת הַֽ/מְבַקְשִׁ֥ים אֶֽת נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֖ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לֹ֤א תִנָּבֵא֙ בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א תָמ֖וּת בְּ/יָדֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh 'l 'nshy 'ntvt hmbqshym 't npshkh l'mr l' tnb' bshm yhvh vl' tmvt bydnv
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD of the men of Anathoth, that seek thy life, saying, Prophesy not in the name of the LORD , that thou die not by our hand:

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הִנְ/נִ֥י פֹקֵ֖ד עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם הַ/בַּֽחוּרִים֙ יָמֻ֣תוּ בַ/חֶ֔רֶב בְּנֵי/הֶם֙ וּ/בְנ֣וֹתֵי/הֶ֔ם יָמֻ֖תוּ בָּ/רָעָֽב
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt hnny pqd 'lyhm hbchvrym ymtv bchrb bnyhm vbnvtyhm ymtv br'b
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine:

verses.original: וּ/שְׁאֵרִ֕ית לֹ֥א תִֽהְיֶ֖ה לָ/הֶ֑ם כִּֽי אָבִ֥יא רָעָ֛ה אֶל אַנְשֵׁ֥י עֲנָת֖וֹת שְׁנַ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vsh'ryt l' thyh lhm khy 'by' r'h 'l 'nshy 'ntvt shnt pqdtm
verses.translation: And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.

verses.original: צַדִּ֤יק אַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י אָרִ֖יב אֵלֶ֑י/ךָ אַ֤ךְ מִשְׁפָּטִים֙ אֲדַבֵּ֣ר אוֹתָ֔/ךְ מַדּ֗וּעַ דֶּ֤רֶךְ רְשָׁעִים֙ צָלֵ֔חָה שָׁל֖וּ כָּל בֹּ֥גְדֵי בָֽגֶד
verses.translit: tsdyq 'th yhvh khy 'ryb 'lykh 'kh mshptym 'dbr 'vtkh mdv' drkh rsh'ym tslchh shlv khl bgdy bgd
verses.translation: Righteous art thou, O LORD , when I plead with thee: yet let me talk with thee of thy judgments: Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper? wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously?

verses.original: נְטַעְתָּ/ם֙ גַּם שֹׁרָ֔שׁוּ יֵלְכ֖וּ גַּם עָ֣שׂוּ פֶ֑רִי קָר֤וֹב אַתָּה֙ בְּ/פִי/הֶ֔ם וְ/רָח֖וֹק מִ/כִּלְיוֹתֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: nt'tm gm shrshv ylkhv gm 'shv pry qrvb 'th bpyhm vrchvq mkhlyvtyhm
verses.translation: Thou hast planted them, yea, they have taken root: they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: thou art near in their mouth, and far from their reins.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ יְדַעְתָּ֔/נִי תִּרְאֵ֕/נִי וּ/בָחַנְתָּ֥ לִבִּ֖/י אִתָּ֑/ךְ הַתִּקֵ/ם֙ כְּ/צֹ֣אן לְ/טִבְחָ֔ה וְ/הַקְדִּשֵׁ֖/ם לְ/י֥וֹם הֲרֵגָֽה
verses.translit: v'th yhvh yd'tny tr'ny vbchnt lby 'tkh htqm khts'n ltbchh vhqdshm lyvm hrgh
verses.translation: But thou, O LORD , knowest me: thou hast seen me, and tried mine heart toward thee: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.

verses.original: עַד מָתַי֙ תֶּאֱבַ֣ל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/עֵ֥שֶׂב כָּל הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה יִיבָ֑שׁ מֵ/רָעַ֣ת יֹֽשְׁבֵי בָ֗/הּ סָפְתָ֤ה בְהֵמוֹת֙ וָ/ע֔וֹף כִּ֣י אָמְר֔וּ לֹ֥א יִרְאֶ֖ה אֶת אַחֲרִיתֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: 'd mty t'bl h'rts v'shb khl hshdh yybsh mr't yshby bh spth bhmvt v'vf khy 'mrv l' yr'h 't 'chrytnv
verses.translation: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֶת רַגְלִ֥ים רַ֨צְתָּה֙ וַ/יַּלְא֔וּ/ךָ וְ/אֵ֥יךְ תְּתַֽחֲרֶ֖ה אֶת הַ/סּוּסִ֑ים וּ/בְ/אֶ֤רֶץ שָׁלוֹם֙ אַתָּ֣ה בוֹטֵ֔חַ וְ/אֵ֥יךְ תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בִּ/גְא֥וֹן הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: khy 't rglym rtsth vyl'vkh v'ykh ttchrh 't hsvsym vb'rts shlvm 'th bvtch v'ykh t'shh bg'vn hyrdn
verses.translation: If thou hast run with the footmen, and they have wearied thee, then how canst thou contend with horses? and if in the land of peace, wherein thou trustedst, they wearied thee , then how wilt thou do in the swelling of Jordan?

verses.original: כִּ֧י גַם אַחֶ֣י/ךָ וּ/בֵית אָבִ֗י/ךָ גַּם הֵ֨מָּה֙ בָּ֣גְדוּ בָ֔/ךְ גַּם הֵ֛מָּה קָרְא֥וּ אַחֲרֶ֖י/ךָ מָלֵ֑א אַל תַּאֲמֵ֣ן בָּ֔/ם כִּֽי יְדַבְּר֥וּ אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ טוֹבֽוֹת
verses.translit: khy gm 'chykh vbyt 'bykh gm hmh bgdv bkh gm hmh qr'v 'chrykh ml' 'l t'mn bm khy ydbrv 'lykh tvbvt
verses.translation: For even thy brethren, and the house of thy father, even they have dealt treacherously with thee; yea, they have called a multitude after thee: believe them not, though they speak fair words unto thee.

verses.original: עָזַ֨בְתִּי֙ אֶת בֵּיתִ֔/י נָטַ֖שְׁתִּי אֶת נַחֲלָתִ֑/י נָתַ֛תִּי אֶת יְדִד֥וּת נַפְשִׁ֖/י בְּ/כַ֥ף אֹיְבֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: 'zbty 't byty ntshty 't nchlty ntty 't yddvt npshy bkhf 'ybyh
verses.translation: I have forsaken mine house, I have left mine heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.

verses.original: הָיְתָה לִּ֥/י נַחֲלָתִ֖/י כְּ/אַרְיֵ֣ה בַ/יָּ֑עַר נָתְנָ֥ה עָלַ֛/י בְּ/קוֹלָ֖/הּ עַל כֵּ֥ן שְׂנֵאתִֽי/הָ
verses.translit: hyth ly nchlty kh'ryh by'r ntnh 'ly bqvlh 'l khn shn'tyh
verses.translation: Mine heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest; it crieth out against me: therefore have I hated it.

verses.original: הַ/עַ֨יִט צָב֤וּעַ נַחֲלָתִ/י֙ לִ֔/י הַ/עַ֖יִט סָבִ֣יב עָלֶ֑י/הָ לְכ֗וּ אִסְפ֛וּ כָּל חַיַּ֥ת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה הֵתָ֥יוּ לְ/אָכְלָֽה
verses.translit: h'yt tsbv' nchlty ly h'yt sbyb 'lyh lkhv 'spv khl chyt hshdh htyv l'khlh
verses.translation: Mine heritage is unto me as a speckled bird, the birds round about are against her; come ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.

verses.original: רֹעִ֤ים רַבִּים֙ שִֽׁחֲת֣וּ כַרְמִ֔/י בֹּסְס֖וּ אֶת חֶלְקָתִ֑/י נָֽתְנ֛וּ אֶת חֶלְקַ֥ת חֶמְדָּתִ֖/י לְ/מִדְבַּ֥ר שְׁמָמָֽה
verses.translit: r'ym rbym shchtv khrmy bssv 't chlqty ntnv 't chlqt chmdty lmdbr shmmh
verses.translation: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

verses.original: שָׂמָ/הּ֙ לִ/שְׁמָמָ֔ה אָבְלָ֥ה עָלַ֖/י שְׁמֵמָ֑ה נָשַׁ֨מָּה֙ כָּל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ שָׂ֥ם עַל לֵֽב
verses.translit: shmh lshmmh 'blh 'ly shmmh nshmh khl h'rts khy 'yn 'ysh shm 'l lb
verses.translation: They have made it desolate, and being desolate it mourneth unto me; the whole land is made desolate, because no man layeth it to heart.

verses.original: עַֽל כָּל שְׁפָיִ֣ם בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֗ר בָּ֚אוּ שֹֽׁדְדִ֔ים כִּ֣י חֶ֤רֶב לַֽ/יהוָה֙ אֹֽכְלָ֔ה מִ/קְצֵה אֶ֖רֶץ וְ/עַד קְצֵ֣ה הָ/אָ֑רֶץ אֵ֥ין שָׁל֖וֹם לְ/כָל בָּשָֽׂר
verses.translit: 'l khl shpym bmdbr b'v shddym khy chrb lyhvh 'khlh mqtsh 'rts v'd qtsh h'rts 'yn shlvm lkhl bshr
verses.translation: The spoilers are come upon all high places through the wilderness: for the sword of the LORD shall devour from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land: no flesh shall have peace.

verses.original: זָרְע֤וּ חִטִּים֙ וְ/קֹצִ֣ים קָצָ֔רוּ נֶחְל֖וּ לֹ֣א יוֹעִ֑לוּ וּ/בֹ֨שׁוּ֙ מִ/תְּבוּאֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם מֵ/חֲר֖וֹן אַף יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: zr'v chtym vqtsym qtsrv nchlv l' yv'lv vbshv mtbv'tykhm mchrvn 'f yhvh
verses.translation: They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: they have put themselves to pain, but shall not profit: and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the LORD .

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עַל כָּל שְׁכֵנַ/י֙ הָֽ/רָעִ֔ים הַ/נֹּֽגְעִים֙ בַּֽ/נַּחֲלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר הִנְחַ֥לְתִּי אֶת עַמִּ֖/י אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הִנְ/נִ֤י נֹֽתְשָׁ/ם֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל אַדְמָתָ֔/ם וְ/אֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה אֶתּ֥וֹשׁ מִ/תּוֹכָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'l khl shkhny hr'ym hng'ym bnchlh 'shr hnchlty 't 'my 't yshr'l hnny ntshm m'l 'dmtm v't byt yhvdh 'tvsh mtvkhm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD against all mine evil neighbours, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit; Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Judah from among them.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה אַֽחֲרֵי֙ נָתְשִׁ֣/י אוֹתָ֔/ם אָשׁ֖וּב וְ/רִֽחַמְתִּ֑י/ם וַ/הֲשִׁבֹתִ֛י/ם אִ֥ישׁ לְ/נַחֲלָת֖/וֹ וְ/אִ֥ישׁ לְ/אַרְצֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhyh 'chry ntshy 'vtm 'shvb vrchmtym vhshbtym 'ysh lnchltv v'ysh l'rtsv
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, after that I have plucked them out I will return, and have compassion on them, and will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֡ה אִם לָמֹ֣ד יִלְמְדוּ֩ אֶת דַּֽרְכֵ֨י עַמִּ֜/י לְ/הִשָּׁבֵ֤עַ בִּ/שְׁמִ/י֙ חַי יְהוָ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר לִמְּדוּ֙ אֶת עַמִּ֔/י לְ/הִשָּׁבֵ֖עַ בַּ/בָּ֑עַל וְ/נִבְנ֖וּ בְּ/ת֥וֹךְ עַמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vhyh 'm lmd ylmdv 't drkhy 'my lhshb' bshmy chy yhvh kh'shr lmdv 't 'my lhshb' bb'l vnbnv btvkh 'my
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, The LORD liveth; as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built in the midst of my people.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֖ם לֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑עוּ וְ/נָ֨תַשְׁתִּ֜י אֶת הַ/גּ֥וֹי הַ/ה֛וּא נָת֥וֹשׁ וְ/אַבֵּ֖ד נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'm l' yshm'v vntshty 't hgvy hhv' ntvsh v'bd n'm yhvh
verses.translation: But if they will not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation, saith the LORD .

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗/י הָל֞וֹךְ וְ/קָנִ֤יתָ לְּ/ךָ֙ אֵז֣וֹר פִּשְׁתִּ֔ים וְ/שַׂמְתּ֖/וֹ עַל מָתְנֶ֑י/ךָ וּ/בַ/מַּ֖יִם לֹ֥א תְבִאֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'ly hlvkh vqnyt lkh 'zvr pshtym vshmtv 'l mtnykh vbmym l' tb'hv
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD unto me, Go and get thee a linen girdle, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.

verses.original: וָ/אֶקְנֶ֥ה אֶת הָ/אֵז֖וֹר כִּ/דְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וָ/אָשִׂ֖ם עַל מָתְנָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'qnh 't h'zvr khdbr yhvh v'shm 'l mtny
verses.translation: So I got a girdle according to the word of the LORD , and put it on my loins.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֧י דְבַר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖/י שֵׁנִ֥ית לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly shnyt l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying,

verses.original: קַ֧ח אֶת הָ/אֵז֛וֹר אֲשֶׁ֥ר קָנִ֖יתָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל מָתְנֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/קוּם֙ לֵ֣ךְ פְּרָ֔תָ/ה וְ/טָמְנֵ֥/הוּ שָׁ֖ם בִּ/נְקִ֥יק הַ/סָּֽלַע
verses.translit: qch 't h'zvr 'shr qnyt 'shr 'l mtnykh vqvm lkh prth vtmnhv shm bnqyq hsl'
verses.translation: Take the girdle that thou hast got, which is upon thy loins, and arise, go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.

verses.original: וָ/אֵלֵ֕ךְ וָ/אֶטְמְנֵ֖/הוּ בִּ/פְרָ֑ת כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אוֹתִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'lkh v'tmnhv bprt kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'vty
verses.translation: So I went, and hid it by Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֕י מִ/קֵּ֖ץ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗/י ק֚וּם לֵ֣ךְ פְּרָ֔תָ/ה וְ/קַ֤ח מִ/שָּׁם֙ אֶת הָ֣/אֵז֔וֹר אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתִ֖י/ךָ לְ/טָמְנ/וֹ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyhy mqts ymym rbym vy'mr yhvh 'ly qvm lkh prth vqch mshm 't h'zvr 'shr tsvytykh ltmnv shm
verses.translation: And it came to pass after many days, that the LORD said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there.

verses.original: וָ/אֵלֵ֣ךְ פְּרָ֔תָ/ה וָ/אֶחְפֹּ֗ר וָֽ/אֶקַּח֙ אֶת הָ֣/אֵז֔וֹר מִן הַ/מָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר טְמַנְתִּ֣י/ו שָׁ֑מָּ/ה וְ/הִנֵּה֙ נִשְׁחַ֣ת הָ/אֵז֔וֹר לֹ֥א יִצְלַ֖ח לַ/כֹּֽל
verses.translit: v'lkh prth v'chpr v'qch 't h'zvr mn hmqvm 'shr tmntyv shmh vhnh nshcht h'zvr l' ytslch lkhl
verses.translation: Then I went to Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

verses.original: כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה כָּ֠כָה אַשְׁחִ֞ית אֶת גְּא֧וֹן יְהוּדָ֛ה וְ/אֶת גְּא֥וֹן יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם הָ/רָֽב
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh khkhh 'shchyt 't g'vn yhvdh v't g'vn yrvshlm hrb
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.

verses.original: הָ/עָם֩ הַ/זֶּ֨ה הָ/רָ֜ע הַֽ/מֵּאֲנִ֣ים לִ/שְׁמ֣וֹעַ אֶת דְּבָרַ֗/י הַ/הֹֽלְכִים֙ בִּ/שְׁרִר֣וּת לִבָּ֔/ם וַ/יֵּלְכ֗וּ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְ/עָבְדָ֖/ם וּ/לְ/הִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֣ת לָ/הֶ֑ם וִ/יהִי֙ כָּ/אֵז֣וֹר הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא יִצְלַ֖ח לַ/כֹּֽל
verses.translit: h'm hzh hr' hm'nym lshmv' 't dbry hhlkhym bshrrvt lbm vylkhv 'chry 'lhym 'chrym l'bdm vlhshtchvt lhm vyhy kh'zvr hzh 'shr l' ytslch lkhl
verses.translation: This evil people, which refuse to hear my words, which walk in the imagination of their heart, and walk after other gods, to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is good for nothing.

verses.original: כִּ֡י כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֩ יִדְבַּ֨ק הָ/אֵז֜וֹר אֶל מָתְנֵי אִ֗ישׁ כֵּ֣ן הִדְבַּ֣קְתִּי אֵ֠לַ/י אֶת כָּל בֵּ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וְ/אֶת כָּל בֵּ֤ית יְהוּדָה֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה לִֽ/הְי֥וֹת לִ/י֙ לְ/עָ֔ם וּ/לְ/שֵׁ֥ם וְ/לִ/תְהִלָּ֖ה וּ/לְ/תִפְאָ֑רֶת וְ/לֹ֖א שָׁמֵֽעוּ
verses.translit: khy kh'shr ydbq h'zvr 'l mtny 'ysh khn hdbqty 'ly 't khl byt yshr'l v't khl byt yhvdh n'm yhvh lhyvt ly l'm vlshm vlthlh vltp'rt vl' shm'v
verses.translation: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith the LORD ; that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֨ אֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֗ה כֹּֽה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כָּל נֵ֖בֶל יִמָּ֣לֵא יָ֑יִן וְ/אָמְר֣וּ אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ הֲ/יָדֹ֨עַ֙ לֹ֣א נֵדַ֔ע כִּ֥י כָל נֵ֖בֶל יִמָּ֥לֵא יָֽיִן
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyhm 't hdbr hzh khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l khl nbl yml' yyn v'mrv 'lykh hyd' l' nd' khy khl nbl yml' yyn
verses.translation: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word; Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto thee, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֨ אֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה הִנְ/נִ֣י מְמַלֵּ֣א אֶת כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ/אָ֪רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֟את וְ/אֶת הַ/מְּלָכִ֣ים הַ/יֹּשְׁבִים֩ לְ/דָוִ֨ד עַל כִּסְא֜/וֹ וְ/אֶת הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ/אֶת הַ/נְּבִיאִ֗ים וְ/אֵ֛ת כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֖ם שִׁכָּרֽוֹן
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr yhvh hnny mml' 't khl yshby h'rts hz't v't hmlkhym hyshbym ldvd 'l khs'v v't hkhhnym v't hnby'ym v't khl yshby yrvshlm shkhrvn
verses.translation: Then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the LORD , Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings that sit upon David’s throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.

verses.original: וְ/נִפַּצְתִּי/ם֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶל אָחִ֜י/ו וְ/הָ/אָב֧וֹת וְ/הַ/בָּנִ֛ים יַחְדָּ֖ו נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה לֹֽא אֶחְמ֧וֹל וְ/לֹֽא אָח֛וּס וְ/לֹ֥א אֲרַחֵ֖ם מֵ/הַשְׁחִיתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vnptstym 'ysh 'l 'chyv vh'bvt vhbnym ychdv n'm yhvh l' 'chmvl vl' 'chvs vl' 'rchm mhshchytm
verses.translation: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, saith the LORD : I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy them.

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ וְ/הַאֲזִ֖ינוּ אַל תִּגְבָּ֑הוּ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר
verses.translit: shm'v vh'zynv 'l tgbhv khy yhvh dbr
verses.translation: Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud: for the LORD hath spoken.

verses.original: תְּנוּ֩ לַ/יהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֤ם כָּבוֹד֙ בְּ/טֶ֣רֶם יַחְשִׁ֔ךְ וּ/בְ/טֶ֛רֶם יִֽתְנַגְּפ֥וּ רַגְלֵי/כֶ֖ם עַל הָ֣רֵי נָ֑שֶׁף וְ/קִוִּיתֶ֤ם לְ/אוֹר֙ וְ/שָׂמָ֣/הּ לְ/צַלְמָ֔וֶת ישית וְ/שִׁ֖ית לַ/עֲרָפֶֽל
verses.translit: tnv lyhvh 'lhykhm khbvd btrm ychshkh vbtrm ytngpv rglykhm 'l hry nshf vqvytm l'vr vshmh ltslmvt yshyt vshyt l'rpl
verses.translation: Give glory to the LORD your God, before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while ye look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death, and make it gross darkness.

verses.original: וְ/אִם֙ לֹ֣א תִשְׁמָע֔וּ/הָ בְּ/מִסְתָּרִ֥ים תִּבְכֶּֽה נַפְשִׁ֖/י מִ/פְּנֵ֣י גֵוָ֑ה וְ/דָמֹ֨עַ תִּדְמַ֜ע וְ/תֵרַ֤ד עֵינִ/י֙ דִּמְעָ֔ה כִּ֥י נִשְׁבָּ֖ה עֵ֥דֶר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'm l' tshm'vh bmstrym tbkhh npshy mpny gvh vdm' tdm' vtrd 'yny dm'h khy nshbh 'dr yhvh
verses.translation: But if ye will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for your pride; and mine eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because the LORD’s flock is carried away captive.

verses.original: אֱמֹ֥ר לַ/מֶּ֛לֶךְ וְ/לַ/גְּבִירָ֖ה הַשְׁפִּ֣ילוּ שֵׁ֑בוּ כִּ֤י יָרַד֙ מַרְאֲשׁ֣וֹתֵי/כֶ֔ם עֲטֶ֖רֶת תִּֽפְאַרְתְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'mr lmlkh vlgbyrh hshpylv shbv khy yrd mr'shvtykhm 'trt tp'rtkhm
verses.translation: Say unto the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down, even the crown of your glory.

verses.original: עָרֵ֥י הַ/נֶּ֛גֶב סֻגְּר֖וּ וְ/אֵ֣ין פֹּתֵ֑חַ הָגְלָ֧ת יְהוּדָ֛ה כֻּלָּ֖/הּ הָגְלָ֥ת שְׁלוֹמִֽים
verses.translit: 'ry hngb sgrv v'yn ptch hglt yhvdh khlh hglt shlvmym
verses.translation: The cities of the south shall be shut up, and none shall open them: Judah shall be carried away captive all of it, it shall be wholly carried away captive.

verses.original: שאי שְׂא֤וּ עֵֽינֵי/כֶם֙ ו/ראי וּ/רְא֔וּ הַ/בָּאִ֖ים מִ/צָּפ֑וֹן אַיֵּ֗ה הָ/עֵ֨דֶר֙ נִתַּן לָ֔/ךְ צֹ֖אן תִּפְאַרְתֵּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: sh'y sh'v 'ynykhm vr'y vr'v hb'ym mtspvn 'yh h'dr ntn lkh ts'n tp'rtkh
verses.translation: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where is the flock that was given thee, thy beautiful flock?

verses.original: מַה תֹּֽאמְרִי֙ כִּֽי יִפְקֹ֣ד עָלַ֔יִ/ךְ וְ֠/אַתְּ לִמַּ֨דְתְּ אֹתָ֥/ם עָלַ֛יִ/ךְ אַלֻּפִ֖ים לְ/רֹ֑אשׁ הֲ/ל֤וֹא חֲבָלִים֙ יֹאחֱז֔וּ/ךְ כְּמ֖וֹ אֵ֥שֶׁת לֵדָֽה
verses.translit: mh t'mry khy ypqd 'lykh v't lmdt 'tm 'lykh 'lpym lr'sh hlv' chblym y'chzvkh khmv 'sht ldh
verses.translation: What wilt thou say when he shall punish thee? for thou hast taught them to be captains, and as chief over thee: shall not sorrows take thee, as a woman in travail?

verses.original: וְ/כִ֤י תֹאמְרִי֙ בִּ/לְבָבֵ֔/ךְ מַדּ֖וּעַ קְרָאֻ֣/נִי אֵ֑לֶּה בְּ/רֹ֧ב עֲוֺנֵ֛/ךְ נִגְל֥וּ שׁוּלַ֖יִ/ךְ נֶחְמְס֥וּ עֲקֵבָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: vkhy t'mry blbbkh mdv' qr'ny 'lh brb 'vnkh nglv shvlykh nchmsv 'qbykh
verses.translation: And if thou say in thine heart, Wherefore come these things upon me? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered, and thy heels made bare.

verses.original: הֲ/יַהֲפֹ֤ךְ כּוּשִׁי֙ עוֹר֔/וֹ וְ/נָמֵ֖ר חֲבַרְבֻּרֹתָ֑י/ו גַּם אַתֶּם֙ תּוּכְל֣וּ לְ/הֵיטִ֔יב לִמֻּדֵ֖י הָרֵֽעַ
verses.translit: hyhpkh khvshy 'vrv vnmr chbrbrtyv gm 'tm tvkhlv lhytyb lmdy hr'
verses.translation: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.

verses.original: וַ/אֲפִיצֵ֖/ם כְּ/קַשׁ עוֹבֵ֑ר לְ/ר֖וּחַ מִדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: v'pytsm khqsh 'vbr lrvch mdbr
verses.translation: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness.

verses.original: זֶ֣ה גוֹרָלֵ֧/ךְ מְנָת מִדַּ֛יִ/ךְ מֵֽ/אִתִּ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ שָׁכַ֣חַתְּ אוֹתִ֔/י וַֽ/תִּבְטְחִ֖י בַּ/שָּֽׁקֶר
verses.translit: zh gvrlkh mnt mdykh m'ty n'm yhvh 'shr shkhcht 'vty vtbtchy bshqr
verses.translation: This is thy lot, the portion of thy measures from me, saith the LORD ; because thou hast forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.

verses.original: וְ/גַם אֲנִ֛י חָשַׂ֥פְתִּי שׁוּלַ֖יִ/ךְ עַל פָּנָ֑יִ/ךְ וְ/נִרְאָ֖ה קְלוֹנֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vgm 'ny chshpty shvlykh 'l pnykh vnr'h qlvnkh
verses.translation: Therefore will I discover thy skirts upon thy face, that thy shame may appear.

verses.original: נִֽאֻפַ֤יִ/ךְ וּ/מִצְהֲלוֹתַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ זִמַּ֣ת זְנוּתֵ֔/ךְ עַל גְּבָעוֹת֙ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה רָאִ֖יתִי שִׁקּוּצָ֑יִ/ךְ א֥וֹי לָ/ךְ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לֹ֣א תִטְהֲרִ֔י אַחֲרֵ֥י מָתַ֖י עֹֽד
verses.translit: n'pykh vmtshlvtykh zmt znvtkh 'l gb'vt bshdh r'yty shqvtsykh 'vy lkh yrvshlm l' tthry 'chry mty 'd
verses.translation: I have seen thine adulteries, and thy neighings, the lewdness of thy whoredom, and thine abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe unto thee, O Jerusalem! wilt thou not be made clean? when shall it once be ?

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָיָ֤ה דְבַר יְהוָה֙ אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ עַל דִּבְרֵ֖י הַ/בַּצָּרֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'shr hyh dbr yhvh 'l yrmyhv 'l dbry hbtsrvt
verses.translation: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth.

verses.original: אָבְלָ֣ה יְהוּדָ֔ה וּ/שְׁעָרֶ֥י/הָ אֻמְלְל֖וּ קָדְר֣וּ לָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/צִוְחַ֥ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם עָלָֽתָה
verses.translit: 'blh yhvdh vsh'ryh 'mllv qdrv l'rts vtsvcht yrvshlm 'lth
verses.translation: Judah mourneth, and the gates thereof languish; they are black unto the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.

verses.original: וְ/אַדִּ֣רֵי/הֶ֔ם שָׁלְח֥וּ צעורי/הם צְעִירֵי/הֶ֖ם לַ/מָּ֑יִם בָּ֣אוּ עַל גֵּבִ֞ים לֹא מָ֣צְאוּ מַ֗יִם שָׁ֤בוּ כְלֵי/הֶם֙ רֵיקָ֔ם בֹּ֥שׁוּ וְ/הָכְלְמ֖וּ וְ/חָפ֥וּ רֹאשָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: v'dryhm shlchv ts'vryhm ts'yryhm lmym b'v 'l gbym l' mts'v mym shbv khlyhm ryqm bshv vhkhlmv vchpv r'shm
verses.translation: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.

verses.original: בַּ/עֲב֤וּר הָ/אֲדָמָה֙ חַ֔תָּה כִּ֛י לֹא הָיָ֥ה גֶ֖שֶׁם בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ בֹּ֥שׁוּ אִכָּרִ֖ים חָפ֥וּ רֹאשָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: b'bvr h'dmh chth khy l' hyh gshm b'rts bshv 'khrym chpv r'shm
verses.translation: Because the ground is chapt, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.

verses.original: כִּ֤י גַם אַיֶּ֨לֶת֙ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה יָלְדָ֖ה וְ/עָז֑וֹב כִּ֥י לֹֽא הָיָ֖ה דֶּֽשֶׁא
verses.translit: khy gm 'ylt bshdh yldh v'zvb khy l' hyh dsh'
verses.translation: Yea, the hind also calved in the field, and forsook it , because there was no grass.

verses.original: וּ/פְרָאִים֙ עָמְד֣וּ עַל שְׁפָיִ֔ם שָׁאֲפ֥וּ ר֖וּחַ כַּ/תַּנִּ֑ים כָּל֥וּ עֵינֵי/הֶ֖ם כִּי אֵ֥ין עֵֽשֶׂב
verses.translit: vpr'ym 'mdv 'l shpym sh'pv rvch khtnym khlv 'ynyhm khy 'yn 'shb
verses.translation: And the wild asses did stand in the high places, they snuffed up the wind like dragons; their eyes did fail, because there was no grass.

verses.original: אִם עֲוֺנֵ֨י/נוּ֙ עָ֣נוּ בָ֔/נוּ יְהוָ֕ה עֲשֵׂ֖ה לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֶ֑/ךָ כִּֽי רַבּ֥וּ מְשׁוּבֹתֵ֖י/נוּ לְ/ךָ֥ חָטָֽאנוּ
verses.translit: 'm 'vnynv 'nv bnv yhvh 'shh lm'n shmkh khy rbv mshvbtynv lkh cht'nv
verses.translation: O LORD , though our iniquities testify against us, do thou it for thy name’s sake: for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against thee.

verses.original: מִקְוֵה֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֽוֹשִׁיע֖/וֹ בְּ/עֵ֣ת צָרָ֑ה לָ֤/מָּה תִֽהְיֶה֙ כְּ/גֵ֣ר בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ וּ/כְ/אֹרֵ֖חַ נָטָ֥ה לָ/לֽוּן
verses.translit: mqvh yshr'l mvshy'v b't tsrh lmh thyh khgr b'rts vkh'rch nth llvn
verses.translation: O the hope of Israel, the saviour thereof in time of trouble, why shouldest thou be as a stranger in the land, and as a wayfaring man that turneth aside to tarry for a night?

verses.original: לָ֤/מָּה תִֽהְיֶה֙ כְּ/אִ֣ישׁ נִדְהָ֔ם כְּ/גִבּ֖וֹר לֹא יוּכַ֣ל לְ/הוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְ/אַתָּ֧ה בְ/קִרְבֵּ֣/נוּ יְהוָ֗ה וְ/שִׁמְ/ךָ֛ עָלֵ֥י/נוּ נִקְרָ֖א אַל תַּנִּחֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: lmh thyh kh'ysh ndhm khgbvr l' yvkhl lhvshy' v'th bqrbnv yhvh vshmkh 'lynv nqr' 'l tnchnv
verses.translation: Why shouldest thou be as a man astonied, as a mighty man that cannot save? yet thou, O LORD , art in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name; leave us not.

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה לָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֗ה כֵּ֤ן אָֽהֲבוּ֙ לָ/נ֔וּעַ רַגְלֵי/הֶ֖ם לֹ֣א חָשָׂ֑כוּ וַ/יהוָה֙ לֹ֣א רָצָ֔/ם עַתָּה֙ יִזְכֹּ֣ר עֲוֺנָ֔/ם וְ/יִפְקֹ֖ד חַטֹּאתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh l'm hzh khn 'hbv lnv' rglyhm l' chshkhv vyhvh l' rtsm 'th yzkhr 'vnm vypqd cht'tm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD unto this people, Thus have they loved to wander, they have not refrained their feet, therefore the LORD doth not accept them; he will now remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑/י אַל תִּתְפַּלֵּ֛ל בְּעַד הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּ֖ה לְ/טוֹבָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly 'l ttpll b'd h'm hzh ltvbh
verses.translation: Then said the LORD unto me, Pray not for this people for their good.

verses.original: כִּ֣י יָצֻ֗מוּ אֵינֶ֤/נִּי שֹׁמֵ֨עַ֙ אֶל רִנָּתָ֔/ם וְ/כִ֧י יַעֲל֛וּ עֹלָ֥ה וּ/מִנְחָ֖ה אֵינֶ֣/נִּי רֹצָ֑/ם כִּ֗י בַּ/חֶ֨רֶב֙ וּ/בָ/רָעָ֣ב וּ/בַ/דֶּ֔בֶר אָנֹכִ֖י מְכַלֶּ֥ה אוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy ytsmv 'ynny shm' 'l rntm vkhy y'lv 'lh vmnchh 'ynny rtsm khy bchrb vbr'b vbdbr 'nkhy mkhlh 'vtm
verses.translation: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and an oblation, I will not accept them: but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֞ר אֲהָ֣הּ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה הַ/נְּבִאִ֜ים אֹמְרִ֤ים לָ/הֶם֙ לֹֽא תִרְא֣וּ חֶ֔רֶב וְ/רָעָ֖ב לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֑ם כִּֽי שְׁל֤וֹם אֱמֶת֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן לָ/כֶ֔ם בַּ/מָּק֖וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: v'mr 'hh 'dny yhvh hnh hnb'ym 'mrym lhm l' tr'v chrb vr'b l' yhyh lkhm khy shlvm 'mt 'tn lkhm bmqvm hzh
verses.translation: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD ! behold, the prophets say unto them, Ye shall not see the sword, neither shall ye have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗/י שֶׁ֚קֶר הַ/נְּבִאִים֙ נִבְּאִ֣ים בִּ/שְׁמִ֔/י לֹ֤א שְׁלַחְתִּי/ם֙ וְ/לֹ֣א צִוִּיתִ֔י/ם וְ/לֹ֥א דִבַּ֖רְתִּי אֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם חֲז֨וֹן שֶׁ֜קֶר וְ/קֶ֤סֶם ו/אלול וֶֽ/אֱלִיל֙ ו/תרמות וְ/תַרְמִ֣ית לִבָּ֔/ם הֵ֖מָּה מִֽתְנַבְּאִ֥ים לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly shqr hnb'ym nb'ym bshmy l' shlchtym vl' tsvytym vl' dbrty 'lyhm chzvn shqr vqsm v'lvl v'lyl vtrmvt vtrmyt lbm hmh mtnb'ym lkhm
verses.translation: Then the LORD said unto me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name: I sent them not, neither have I commanded them, neither spake unto them: they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination, and a thing of nought, and the deceit of their heart.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עַֽל הַ/נְּבִאִ֞ים הַ/נִּבְּאִ֣ים בִּ/שְׁמִ/י֮ וַ/אֲנִ֣י לֹֽא שְׁלַחְתִּי/ם֒ וְ/הֵ֨מָּה֙ אֹֽמְרִ֔ים חֶ֣רֶב וְ/רָעָ֔ב לֹ֥א יִהְיֶ֖ה בָּ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֑את בַּ/חֶ֤רֶב וּ/בָֽ/רָעָב֙ יִתַּ֔מּוּ הַ/נְּבִאִ֖ים הָ/הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh 'l hnb'ym hnb'ym bshmy v'ny l' shlchtym vhmh 'mrym chrb vr'b l' yhyh b'rts hz't bchrb vbr'b ytmv hnb'ym hhmh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name, and I sent them not, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/עָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר הֵ֣מָּה נִבְּאִ֣ים לָ/הֶ֡ם יִֽהְי֣וּ מֻשְׁלָכִים֩ בְּ/חֻצ֨וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם מִ/פְּנֵ֣י הָ/רָעָ֣ב וְ/הַ/חֶ֗רֶב וְ/אֵ֤ין מְקַבֵּר֙ לָ/הֵ֔מָּה הֵ֣מָּה נְשֵׁי/הֶ֔ם וּ/בְנֵי/הֶ֖ם וּ/בְנֹֽתֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/שָׁפַכְתִּ֥י עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם אֶת רָעָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vh'm 'shr hmh nb'ym lhm yhyv mshlkhym bchtsvt yrvshlm mpny hr'b vhchrb v'yn mqbr lhmh hmh nshyhm vbnyhm vbntyhm vshpkhty 'lyhm 't r'tm
verses.translation: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them, them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness upon them.

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֤ אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֔ה תֵּרַ֨דְנָה עֵינַ֥/י דִּמְעָ֛ה לַ֥יְלָה וְ/יוֹמָ֖ם וְ/אַל תִּדְמֶ֑ינָה כִּי֩ שֶׁ֨בֶר גָּד֜וֹל נִשְׁבְּרָ֗ה בְּתוּלַת֙ בַּת עַמִּ֔/י מַכָּ֖ה נַחְלָ֥ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyhm 't hdbr hzh trdnh 'yny dm'h lylh vyvmm v'l tdmynh khy shbr gdvl nshbrh btvlt bt 'my mkhh nchlh m'd
verses.translation: Therefore thou shalt say this word unto them; Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease: for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous blow.

verses.original: אִם יָצָ֣אתִי הַ/שָּׂדֶ֗ה וְ/הִנֵּה֙ חַלְלֵי חֶ֔רֶב וְ/אִם֙ בָּ֣אתִי הָ/עִ֔יר וְ/הִנֵּ֖ה תַּחֲלוּאֵ֣י רָעָ֑ב כִּֽי גַם נָבִ֧יא גַם כֹּהֵ֛ן סָחֲר֥וּ אֶל אֶ֖רֶץ וְ/לֹ֥א יָדָֽעוּ
verses.translit: 'm yts'ty hshdh vhnh chlly chrb v'm b'ty h'yr vhnh tchlv'y r'b khy gm nby' gm khhn schrv 'l 'rts vl' yd'v
verses.translation: If I go forth into the field, then behold the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then behold them that are sick with famine! yea, both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not.

verses.original: הֲ/מָאֹ֨ס מָאַ֜סְתָּ אֶת יְהוּדָ֗ה אִם בְּ/צִיּוֹן֙ גָּעֲלָ֣ה נַפְשֶׁ֔/ךָ מַדּ֨וּעַ֙ הִכִּיתָ֔/נוּ וְ/אֵ֥ין לָ֖/נוּ מַרְפֵּ֑א קַוֵּ֤ה לְ/שָׁלוֹם֙ וְ/אֵ֣ין ט֔וֹב וּ/לְ/עֵ֥ת מַרְפֵּ֖א וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה בְעָתָֽה
verses.translit: hm's m'st 't yhvdh 'm btsyvn g'lh npshkh mdv' hkhytnv v'yn lnv mrp' qvh lshlvm v'yn tvb vl't mrp' vhnh b'th
verses.translation: Hast thou utterly rejected Judah? hath thy soul lothed Zion? why hast thou smitten us, and there is no healing for us? we looked for peace, and there is no good; and for the time of healing, and behold trouble!

verses.original: יָדַ֧עְנוּ יְהוָ֛ה רִשְׁעֵ֖/נוּ עֲוֺ֣ן אֲבוֹתֵ֑י/נוּ כִּ֥י חָטָ֖אנוּ לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: yd'nv yhvh rsh'nv 'vn 'bvtynv khy cht'nv lkh
verses.translation: We acknowledge, O LORD , our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers: for we have sinned against thee.

verses.original: אַל תִּנְאַץ֙ לְמַ֣עַן שִׁמְ/ךָ֔ אַל תְּנַבֵּ֖ל כִּסֵּ֣א כְבוֹדֶ֑/ךָ זְכֹ֕ר אַל תָּפֵ֥ר בְּרִֽיתְ/ךָ֖ אִתָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: 'l tn'ts lm'n shmkh 'l tnbl khs' khbvdkh zkhr 'l tpr brytkh 'tnv
verses.translation: Do not abhor us , for thy name’s sake, do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us.

verses.original: הֲ/יֵ֨שׁ בְּ/הַבְלֵ֤י הַ/גּוֹיִם֙ מַגְשִׁמִ֔ים וְ/אִם הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם יִתְּנ֣וּ רְבִבִ֑ים הֲ/לֹ֨א אַתָּה ה֜וּא יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֨י/נוּ֙ וּ֨/נְקַוֶּה לָּ֔/ךְ כִּֽי אַתָּ֥ה עָשִׂ֖יתָ אֶת כָּל אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: hysh bhbly hgvym mgshmym v'm hshmym ytnv rbbym hl' 'th hv' yhvh 'lhynv vnqvh lkh khy 'th 'shyt 't khl 'lh
verses.translation: Are there any among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain? or can the heavens give showers? art not thou he, O LORD our God? therefore we will wait upon thee: for thou hast made all these things .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔/י אִם יַעֲמֹ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֤ה וּ/שְׁמוּאֵל֙ לְ/פָנַ֔/י אֵ֥ין נַפְשִׁ֖/י אֶל הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֑ה שַׁלַּ֥ח מֵֽ/עַל פָּנַ֖/י וְ/יֵצֵֽאוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly 'm y'md mshh vshmv'l lpny 'yn npshy 'l h'm hzh shlch m'l pny vyts'v
verses.translation: Then said the LORD unto me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind could not be toward this people: cast them out of my sight, and let them go forth.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֛ה כִּֽי יֹאמְר֥וּ אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ אָ֣נָה נֵצֵ֑א וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֨ אֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לַ/מָּ֤וֶת לַ/מָּ֨וֶת֙ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר לַ/חֶ֨רֶב֙ לַ/חֶ֔רֶב וַ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר לָֽ/רָעָב֙ לָֽ/רָעָ֔ב וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַ/שְּׁבִ֖י לַ/שֶּֽׁבִי
verses.translit: vhyh khy y'mrv 'lykh 'nh nts' v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr yhvh 'shr lmvt lmvt v'shr lchrb lchrb v'shr lr'b lr'b v'shr lshby lshby
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, if they say unto thee, Whither shall we go forth? then thou shalt tell them, Thus saith the LORD ; Such as are for death, to death; and such as are for the sword, to the sword; and such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for the captivity, to the captivity.

verses.original: וּ/פָקַדְתִּ֨י עֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם אַרְבַּ֤ע מִשְׁפָּחוֹת֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה אֶת הַ/חֶ֣רֶב לַֽ/הֲרֹ֔ג וְ/אֶת הַ/כְּלָבִ֖ים לִ/סְחֹ֑ב וְ/אֶת ע֧וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֛יִם וְ/אֶת בֶּהֱמַ֥ת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לֶ/אֱכֹ֥ל וּ/לְ/הַשְׁחִֽית
verses.translit: vpqdty 'lyhm 'rb' mshpchvt n'm yhvh 't hchrb lhrg v't hkhlbym lschb v't 'vf hshmym v't bhmt h'rts l'khl vlhshchyt
verses.translation: And I will appoint over them four kinds, saith the LORD : the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and destroy.

verses.original: וּ/נְתַתִּ֣י/ם ל/זועה לְ/זַֽעֲוָ֔ה לְ/כֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ בִּ֠/גְלַל מְנַשֶּׁ֤ה בֶן יְחִזְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה עַ֥ל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֖ה בִּ/ירוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: vnttym lzv'h lz'vh lkhl mmlkhvt h'rts bgll mnshh bn ychzqyhv mlkh yhvdh 'l 'shr 'shh byrvshlm
verses.translation: And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.

verses.original: כִּ֠י מִֽי יַחְמֹ֤ל עָלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וּ/מִ֖י יָנ֣וּד לָ֑/ךְ וּ/מִ֣י יָס֔וּר לִ/שְׁאֹ֥ל לְ/שָׁלֹ֖ם לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khy my ychml 'lykh yrvshlm vmy ynvd lkh vmy ysvr lsh'l lshlm lkh
verses.translation: For who shall have pity upon thee, O Jerusalem? or who shall bemoan thee? or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest?

verses.original: אַ֣תְּ נָטַ֥שְׁתְּ אֹתִ֛/י נְאֻם יְהוָ֖ה אָח֣וֹר תֵּלֵ֑כִי וָ/אַ֨ט אֶת יָדִ֤/י עָלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ וָֽ/אַשְׁחִיתֵ֔/ךְ נִלְאֵ֖יתִי הִנָּחֵֽם
verses.translit: 't ntsht 'ty n'm yhvh 'chvr tlkhy v't 't ydy 'lykh v'shchytkh nl'yty hnchm
verses.translation: Thou hast forsaken me, saith the LORD , thou art gone backward: therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee, and destroy thee; I am weary with repenting.

verses.original: וָ/אֶזְרֵ֥/ם בְּ/מִזְרֶ֖ה בְּ/שַׁעֲרֵ֣י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ שִׁכַּ֤לְתִּי אִבַּ֨דְתִּי֙ אֶת עַמִּ֔/י מִ/דַּרְכֵי/הֶ֖ם לוֹא שָֽׁבוּ
verses.translit: v'zrm bmzrh bsh'ry h'rts shkhlty 'bdty 't 'my mdrkhyhm lv' shbv
verses.translation: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave them of children, I will destroy my people, since they return not from their ways.

verses.original: עָֽצְמוּ לִ֤/י אַלְמְנֹתָ/ו֙ מֵ/ח֣וֹל יַמִּ֔ים הֵבֵ֨אתִי לָ/הֶ֥ם עַל אֵ֛ם בָּח֖וּר שֹׁדֵ֣ד בַּֽ/צָּהֳרָ֑יִם הִפַּ֤לְתִּי עָלֶ֨י/הָ֙ פִּתְאֹ֔ם עִ֖יר וּ/בֶהָלֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'tsmv ly 'lmntv mchvl ymym hb'ty lhm 'l 'm bchvr shdd btshrym hplty 'lyh pt'm 'yr vbhlvt
verses.translation: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday: I have caused him to fall upon it suddenly, and terrors upon the city.

verses.original: אֻמְלְלָ֞ה יֹלֶ֣דֶת הַ/שִּׁבְעָ֗ה נָפְחָ֥ה נַפְשָׁ֛/הּ באה בָּ֥א שִׁמְשָׁ֛/הּ בְּ/עֹ֥ד יוֹמָ֖ם בּ֣וֹשָׁה וְ/חָפֵ֑רָה וּ/שְׁאֵֽרִיתָ֗/ם לַ/חֶ֧רֶב אֶתֵּ֛ן לִ/פְנֵ֥י אֹיְבֵי/הֶ֖ם נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'mllh yldt hshb'h npchh npshh b'h b' shmshh b'd yvmm bvshh vchprh vsh'rytm lchrb 'tn lpny 'ybyhm n'm yhvh
verses.translation: She that hath borne seven languisheth: she hath given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while it was yet day: she hath been ashamed and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, saith the LORD .

verses.original: אֽוֹי לִ֣/י אִמִּ֔/י כִּ֣י יְלִדְתִּ֗/נִי אִ֥ישׁ רִ֛יב וְ/אִ֥ישׁ מָד֖וֹן לְ/כָל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ לֹֽא נָשִׁ֥יתִי וְ/לֹא נָֽשׁוּ בִ֖/י כֻּלֹּ֥/ה מְקַלְלַֽו/נִי
verses.translit: 'vy ly 'my khy yldtny 'ysh ryb v'ysh mdvn lkhl h'rts l' nshyty vl' nshv by khlh mqllvny
verses.translation: Woe is me, my mother, that thou hast borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have neither lent on usury, nor men have lent to me on usury; yet every one of them doth curse me.

verses.original: אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אִם לֹ֥א שרות/ך שֵֽׁרִיתִ֖י/ךָ לְ/ט֑וֹב אִם ל֣וֹא הִפְגַּ֣עְתִּֽי בְ/ךָ֗ בְּ/עֵ֥ת רָעָ֛ה וּ/בְ/עֵ֥ת צָרָ֖ה אֶת הָ/אֹיֵֽב
verses.translit: 'mr yhvh 'm l' shrvtkh shrytykh ltvb 'm lv' hpg'ty bkh b't r'h vb't tsrh 't h'yb
verses.translation: The LORD said, Verily it shall be well with thy remnant; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.
