verses.original: הֲ/יָרֹ֨עַ בַּרְזֶ֧ל בַּרְזֶ֛ל מִ/צָּפ֖וֹן וּ/נְחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: hyr' brzl brzl mtspvn vnchsht
verses.translation: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?

verses.original: חֵילְ/ךָ֧ וְ/אוֹצְרוֹתֶ֛י/ךָ לָ/בַ֥ז אֶתֵּ֖ן לֹ֣א בִ/מְחִ֑יר וּ/בְ/כָל חַטֹּאותֶ֖י/ךָ וּ/בְ/כָל גְּבוּלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: chylkh v'vtsrvtykh lbz 'tn l' bmchyr vbkhl cht'vtykh vbkhl gbvlykh
verses.translation: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price, and that for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.

verses.original: וְ/הַֽעֲבַרְתִּי֙ אֶת אֹ֣יְבֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/אֶ֖רֶץ לֹ֣א יָדָ֑עְתָּ כִּֽי אֵ֛שׁ קָדְחָ֥ה בְ/אַפִּ֖/י עֲלֵי/כֶ֥ם תּוּקָֽד
verses.translit: vh'brty 't 'ybykh b'rts l' yd't khy 'sh qdchh b'py 'lykhm tvqd
verses.translation: And I will make thee to pass with thine enemies into a land which thou knowest not: for a fire is kindled in mine anger, which shall burn upon you.

verses.original: אַתָּ֧ה יָדַ֣עְתָּ יְהוָ֗ה זָכְרֵ֤/נִי וּ/פָקְדֵ֨/נִי֙ וְ/הִנָּ֤קֶם לִ/י֙ מֵ/רֹ֣דְפַ֔/י אַל לְ/אֶ֥רֶךְ אַפְּ/ךָ֖ תִּקָּחֵ֑/נִי דַּ֕ע שְׂאֵתִ֥/י עָלֶ֖י/ךָ חֶרְפָּֽה
verses.translit: 'th yd't yhvh zkhrny vpqdny vhnqm ly mrdpy 'l l'rkh 'pkh tqchny d' sh'ty 'lykh chrph
verses.translation: O LORD , thou knowest: remember me, and visit me, and revenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in thy longsuffering: know that for thy sake I have suffered rebuke.

verses.original: נִמְצְא֤וּ דְבָרֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וָ/אֹ֣כְלֵ֔/ם וַ/יְהִ֤י דברי/ך דְבָֽרְ/ךָ֙ לִ֔/י לְ/שָׂשׂ֖וֹן וּ/לְ/שִׂמְחַ֣ת לְבָבִ֑/י כִּֽי נִקְרָ֤א שִׁמְ/ךָ֙ עָלַ֔/י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י צְבָאֽוֹת
verses.translit: nmts'v dbrykh v'khlm vyhy dbrykh dbrkh ly lshshvn vlshmcht lbby khy nqr' shmkh 'ly yhvh 'lhy tsb'vt
verses.translation: Thy words were found, and I did eat them; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart: for I am called by thy name, O LORD God of hosts.

verses.original: לֹֽא יָשַׁ֥בְתִּי בְ/סוֹד מְשַׂחֲקִ֖ים וָֽ/אֶעְלֹ֑ז מִ/פְּנֵ֤י יָֽדְ/ךָ֙ בָּדָ֣ד יָשַׁ֔בְתִּי כִּֽי זַ֖עַם מִלֵּאתָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: l' yshbty bsvd mshchqym v''lz mpny ydkh bdd yshbty khy z'm ml'tny
verses.translation: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of thy hand: for thou hast filled me with indignation.

verses.original: לָ֣/מָּה הָיָ֤ה כְאֵבִ/י֙ נֶ֔צַח וּ/מַכָּתִ֖/י אֲנוּשָׁ֑ה֙ מֵֽאֲנָה֙ הֵֽרָפֵ֔א הָי֨וֹ תִֽהְיֶ֥ה לִ/י֙ כְּמ֣וֹ אַכְזָ֔ב מַ֖יִם לֹ֥א נֶאֱמָֽנוּ
verses.translit: lmh hyh kh'by ntsch vmkhty 'nvshh m'nh hrp' hyv thyh ly khmv 'khzb mym l' n'mnv
verses.translation: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuseth to be healed? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar, and as waters that fail?

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אִם תָּשׁ֤וּב וַ/אֲשִֽׁיבְ/ךָ֙ לְ/פָנַ֣/י תַּֽעֲמֹ֔ד וְ/אִם תּוֹצִ֥יא יָקָ֛ר מִ/זּוֹלֵ֖ל כְּ/פִ֣/י תִֽהְיֶ֑ה יָשֻׁ֤בוּ הֵ֨מָּה֙ אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/אַתָּ֖ה לֹֽא תָשׁ֥וּב אֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh 'm tshvb v'shybkh lpny t'md v'm tvtsy' yqr mzvll khpy thyh yshbv hmh 'lykh v'th l' tshvb 'lyhm
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD , If thou return, then will I bring thee again, and thou shalt stand before me: and if thou take forth the precious from the vile, thou shalt be as my mouth: let them return unto thee; but return not thou unto them.

verses.original: וּ/נְתַתִּ֜י/ךָ לָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֗ה לְ/חוֹמַ֤ת נְחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ בְּצוּרָ֔ה וְ/נִלְחֲמ֥וּ אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ וְ/לֹא י֣וּכְלוּ לָ֑/ךְ כִּֽי אִתְּ/ךָ֥ אֲנִ֛י לְ/הוֹשִֽׁיעֲ/ךָ֥ וּ/לְ/הַצִּילֶ֖/ךָ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vnttykh l'm hzh lchvmt nchsht btsvrh vnlchmv 'lykh vl' yvkhlv lkh khy 'tkh 'ny lhvshy'kh vlhtsylkh n'm yhvh
verses.translation: And I will make thee unto this people a fenced brasen wall: and they shall fight against thee, but they shall not prevail against thee: for I am with thee to save thee and to deliver thee, saith the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הִצַּלְתִּ֖י/ךָ מִ/יַּ֣ד רָעִ֑ים וּ/פְדִתִ֖י/ךָ מִ/כַּ֥ף עָרִצִֽים
verses.translit: vhtsltykh myd r'ym vpdtykh mkhf 'rtsym
verses.translation: And I will deliver thee out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem thee out of the hand of the terrible.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: The word of the LORD came also unto me, saying,

verses.original: לֹֽא תִקַּ֥ח לְ/ךָ֖ אִשָּׁ֑ה וְ/לֹֽא יִהְי֤וּ לְ/ךָ֙ בָּנִ֣ים וּ/בָנ֔וֹת בַּ/מָּק֖וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: l' tqch lkh 'shh vl' yhyv lkh bnym vbnvt bmqvm hzh
verses.translation: Thou shalt not take thee a wife, neither shalt thou have sons or daughters in this place.

verses.original: כִּי כֹ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עַל הַ/בָּנִים֙ וְ/עַל הַ/בָּנ֔וֹת הַ/יִּלּוֹדִ֖ים בַּ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/עַֽל אִמֹּתָ֞/ם הַ/יֹּלְד֣וֹת אוֹתָ֗/ם וְ/עַל אֲבוֹתָ֛/ם הַ/מּוֹלִדִ֥ים אוֹתָ֖/ם בָּ/אָ֥רֶץ הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh 'l hbnym v'l hbnvt hylvdym bmqvm hzh v'l 'mtm hyldvt 'vtm v'l 'bvtm hmvldym 'vtm b'rts hz't
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bare them, and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land;

verses.original: מְמוֹתֵ֨י תַחֲלֻאִ֜ים יָמֻ֗תוּ לֹ֤א יִסָּֽפְדוּ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יִקָּבֵ֔רוּ לְ/דֹ֛מֶן עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אֲדָמָ֖ה יִֽהְי֑וּ וּ/בַ/חֶ֤רֶב וּ/בָֽ/רָעָב֙ יִכְל֔וּ וְ/הָיְתָ֤ה נִבְלָתָ/ם֙ לְ/מַאֲכָ֔ל לְ/ע֥וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וּ/לְ/בֶהֱמַ֥ת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: mmvty tchl'ym ymtv l' yspdv vl' yqbrv ldmn 'l pny h'dmh yhyv vbchrb vbr'b ykhlv vhyth nbltm lm'khl l'vf hshmym vlbhmt h'rts
verses.translation: They shall die of grievous deaths; they shall not be lamented; neither shall they be buried; but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth: and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.

verses.original: כִּֽי כֹ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אַל תָּבוֹא֙ בֵּ֣ית מַרְזֵ֔חַ וְ/אַל תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לִ/סְפּ֔וֹד וְ/אַל תָּנֹ֖ד לָ/הֶ֑ם כִּֽי אָסַ֨פְתִּי אֶת שְׁלוֹמִ֜/י מֵ/אֵ֨ת הָ/עָ֤ם הַ/זֶּה֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה אֶת הַ/חֶ֖סֶד וְ/אֶת הָֽ/רַחֲמִֽים
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh 'l tbv' byt mrzch v'l tlkh lspvd v'l tnd lhm khy 'spty 't shlvmy m't h'm hzh n'm yhvh 't hchsd v't hrchmym
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD , Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament nor bemoan them: for I have taken away my peace from this people, saith the LORD , even lovingkindness and mercies.

verses.original: וּ/מֵ֨תוּ גְדֹלִ֧ים וּ/קְטַנִּ֛ים בָּ/אָ֥רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֖את לֹ֣א יִקָּבֵ֑רוּ וְ/לֹֽא יִסְפְּד֣וּ לָ/הֶ֔ם וְ/לֹ֣א יִתְגֹּדַ֔ד וְ/לֹ֥א יִקָּרֵ֖חַ לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vmtv gdlym vqtnym b'rts hz't l' yqbrv vl' yspdv lhm vl' ytgdd vl' yqrch lhm
verses.translation: Both the great and the small shall die in this land: they shall not be buried, neither shall men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them:

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא יִפְרְס֥וּ לָ/הֶ֛ם עַל אֵ֖בֶל לְ/נַחֲמ֣/וֹ עַל מֵ֑ת וְ/לֹֽא יַשְׁק֤וּ אוֹתָ/ם֙ כּ֣וֹס תַּנְחוּמִ֔ים עַל אָבִ֖י/ו וְ/עַל אִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vl' yprsv lhm 'l 'bl lnchmv 'l mt vl' yshqv 'vtm khvs tnchvmym 'l 'byv v'l 'mv
verses.translation: Neither shall men tear themselves for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.

verses.original: וּ/בֵית מִשְׁתֶּ֥ה לֹא תָב֖וֹא לָ/שֶׁ֣בֶת אוֹתָ֑/ם לֶ/אֱכֹ֖ל וְ/לִ/שְׁתּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vbyt mshth l' tbv' lshbt 'vtm l'khl vlshtvt
verses.translation: Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְ/נִ֨י מַשְׁבִּ֜ית מִן הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֛ה לְ/עֵינֵי/כֶ֖ם וּ/בִֽ/ימֵי/כֶ֑ם ק֤וֹל שָׂשׂוֹן֙ וְ/ק֣וֹל שִׂמְחָ֔ה ק֥וֹל חָתָ֖ן וְ/ק֥וֹל כַּלָּֽה
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hnny mshbyt mn hmqvm hzh l'ynykhm vbymykhm qvl shshvn vqvl shmchh qvl chtn vqvl khlh
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes, and in your days, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כִּ֤י תַגִּיד֙ לָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וְ/אָמְר֣וּ אֵלֶ֗י/ךָ עַל מֶה֩ דִבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה עָלֵ֨י/נוּ֙ אֵ֣ת כָּל הָ/רָעָ֤ה הַ/גְּדוֹלָה֙ הַ/זֹּ֔את וּ/מֶ֤ה עֲוֺנֵ֨/נוּ֙ וּ/מֶ֣ה חַטָּאתֵ֔/נוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖אנוּ לַֽ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vhyh khy tgyd l'm hzh 't khl hdbrym h'lh v'mrv 'lykh 'l mh dbr yhvh 'lynv 't khl hr'h hgdvlh hz't vmh 'vnnv vmh cht'tnv 'shr cht'nv lyhvh 'lhynv
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when thou shalt shew this people all these words, and they shall say unto thee, Wherefore hath the LORD pronounced all this great evil against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin that we have committed against the LORD our God?

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם עַל֩ אֲשֶׁר עָזְב֨וּ אֲבוֹתֵי/כֶ֤ם אוֹתִ/י֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יֵּלְכ֗וּ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַ/יַּעַבְד֖וּ/ם וַ/יִּשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לָ/הֶ֑ם וְ/אֹתִ֣/י עָזָ֔בוּ וְ/אֶת תּוֹרָתִ֖/י לֹ֥א שָׁמָֽרוּ
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyhm 'l 'shr 'zbv 'bvtykhm 'vty n'm yhvh vylkhv 'chry 'lhym 'chrym vy'bdvm vyshtchvv lhm v'ty 'zbv v't tvrty l' shmrv
verses.translation: Then shalt thou say unto them, Because your fathers have forsaken me, saith the LORD , and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshipped them, and have forsaken me, and have not kept my law;

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּ֛ם הֲרֵעֹתֶ֥ם לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת מֵ/אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/הִנְּ/כֶ֣ם הֹלְכִ֗ים אִ֚ישׁ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ שְׁרִר֣וּת לִבּֽ/וֹ הָ/רָ֔ע לְ/בִלְתִּ֖י שְׁמֹ֥עַ אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'tm hr'tm l'shvt m'bvtykhm vhnkhm hlkhym 'ysh 'chry shrrvt lbv hr' lblty shm' 'ly
verses.translation: And ye have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, ye walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart, that they may not hearken unto me:

verses.original: וְ/הֵטַלְתִּ֣י אֶתְ/כֶ֗ם מֵ/עַל֙ הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֔את עַל הָ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יְדַעְתֶּ֔ם אַתֶּ֖ם וַ/אֲבֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם וַ/עֲבַדְתֶּם שָׁ֞ם אֶת אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֲחֵרִים֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָ/לַ֔יְלָה אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא אֶתֵּ֥ן לָ/כֶ֖ם חֲנִינָֽה
verses.translit: vhtlty 'tkhm m'l h'rts hz't 'l h'rts 'shr l' yd'tm 'tm v'bvtykhm v'bdtm shm 't 'lhym 'chrym yvmm vlylh 'shr l' 'tn lkhm chnynh
verses.translation: Therefore will I cast you out of this land into a land that ye know not, neither ye nor your fathers; and there shall ye serve other gods day and night; where I will not shew you favour.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֛ן הִנֵּֽה יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וְ/לֹֽא יֵאָמֵ֥ר עוֹד֙ חַי יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלָ֛ה אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: lkhn hnh ymym b'ym n'm yhvh vl' y'mr 'vd chy yhvh 'shr h'lh 't bny yshr'l m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD , that it shall no more be said, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם חַי יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶעֱלָ֜ה אֶת בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹן וּ/מִ/כֹּל֙ הָֽ/אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִדִּיחָ֖/ם שָׁ֑מָּ/ה וַ/הֲשִֽׁבֹתִי/ם֙ עַל אַדְמָתָ֔/ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לַ/אֲבוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy 'm chy yhvh 'shr h'lh 't bny yshr'l m'rts tspvn vmkhl h'rtsvt 'shr hdychm shmh vhshbtym 'l 'dmtm 'shr ntty l'bvtm
verses.translation: But, The LORD liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֨י שֹׁלֵ֜חַ ל/דוגים לְ/דַיָּגִ֥ים רַבִּ֛ים נְאֻם יְהוָ֖ה וְ/דִיג֑וּ/ם וְ/אַֽחֲרֵי כֵ֗ן אֶשְׁלַח֙ לְ/רַבִּ֣ים צַיָּדִ֔ים וְ/צָד֞וּ/ם מֵ/עַ֤ל כָּל הַר֙ וּ/מֵ/עַ֣ל כָּל גִּבְעָ֔ה וּ/מִ/נְּקִיקֵ֖י הַ/סְּלָעִֽים
verses.translit: hnny shlch ldvgym ldygym rbym n'm yhvh vdygvm v'chry khn 'shlch lrbym tsydym vtsdvm m'l khl hr vm'l khl gb'h vmnqyqy hsl'ym
verses.translation: Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith the LORD , and they shall fish them; and after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.

verses.original: כִּ֤י עֵינַ/י֙ עַל כָּל דַּרְכֵי/הֶ֔ם לֹ֥א נִסְתְּר֖וּ מִ/לְּ/פָנָ֑/י וְ/לֹֽא נִצְפַּ֥ן עֲוֺנָ֖/ם מִ/נֶּ֥גֶד עֵינָֽ/י
verses.translit: khy 'yny 'l khl drkhyhm l' nstrv mlpny vl' ntspn 'vnm mngd 'yny
verses.translation: For mine eyes are upon all their ways: they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes.

verses.original: וְ/שִׁלַּמְתִּ֣י רִֽאשׁוֹנָ֗ה מִשְׁנֵ֤ה עֲוֺנָ/ם֙ וְ/חַטָּאתָ֔/ם עַ֖ל חַלְּלָ֣/ם אֶת אַרְצִ֑/י בְּ/נִבְלַ֤ת שִׁקּֽוּצֵי/הֶם֙ וְ/תוֹעֲב֣וֹתֵי/הֶ֔ם מָלְא֖וּ אֶת נַחֲלָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: vshlmty r'shvnh mshnh 'vnm vcht'tm 'l chllm 't 'rtsy bnblt shqvtsyhm vtv'bvtyhm ml'v 't nchlty
verses.translation: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double; because they have defiled my land, they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things.

verses.original: יְהוָ֞ה עֻזִּ֧/י וּ/מָעֻזִּ֛/י וּ/מְנוּסִ֖/י בְּ/י֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה אֵלֶ֗י/ךָ גּוֹיִ֤ם יָבֹ֨אוּ֙ מֵֽ/אַפְסֵי אָ֔רֶץ וְ/יֹאמְר֗וּ אַךְ שֶׁ֨קֶר֙ נָחֲל֣וּ אֲבוֹתֵ֔י/נוּ הֶ֖בֶל וְ/אֵֽין בָּ֥/ם מוֹעִֽיל
verses.translit: yhvh 'zy vm'zy vmnvsy byvm tsrh 'lykh gvym yb'v m'psy 'rts vy'mrv 'kh shqr nchlv 'bvtynv hbl v'yn bm mv'yl
verses.translation: O LORD , my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and things wherein there is no profit.

verses.original: הֲ/יַעֲשֶׂה לּ֥/וֹ אָדָ֖ם אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְ/הֵ֖מָּה לֹ֥א אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: hy'shh lv 'dm 'lhym vhmh l' 'lhym
verses.translation: Shall a man make gods unto himself, and they are no gods?

verses.original: לָ/כֵן֙ הִנְ/נִ֣י מֽוֹדִיעָ֔/ם בַּ/פַּ֣עַם הַ/זֹּ֔את אוֹדִיעֵ֥/ם אֶת יָדִ֖/י וְ/אֶת גְּבֽוּרָתִ֑/י וְ/יָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי שְׁמִ֥/י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn hnny mvdy'm bp'm hz't 'vdy'm 't ydy v't gbvrty vyd'v khy shmy yhvh
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, I will this once cause them to know, I will cause them to know mine hand and my might; and they shall know that my name is The LORD . : or, JEHOVAH

verses.original: חַטַּ֣את יְהוּדָ֗ה כְּתוּבָ֛ה בְּ/עֵ֥ט בַּרְזֶ֖ל בְּ/צִפֹּ֣רֶן שָׁמִ֑יר חֲרוּשָׁה֙ עַל ל֣וּחַ לִבָּ֔/ם וּ/לְ/קַרְנ֖וֹת מִזְבְּחוֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: cht't yhvdh khtvbh b't brzl btsprn shmyr chrvshh 'l lvch lbm vlqrnvt mzbchvtykhm
verses.translation: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond: it is graven upon the table of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars;

verses.original: כִּ/זְכֹּ֤ר בְּנֵי/הֶם֙ מִזְבְּחוֹתָ֔/ם וַ/אֲשֵׁרֵי/הֶ֖ם עַל עֵ֣ץ רַֽעֲנָ֑ן עַ֖ל גְּבָע֥וֹת הַ/גְּבֹהֽוֹת
verses.translit: khzkhr bnyhm mzbchvtm v'shryhm 'l 'ts r'nn 'l gb'vt hgbhvt
verses.translation: Whilst their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills.

verses.original: הֲרָרִ/י֙ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה חֵילְ/ךָ֥ כָל אוֹצְרוֹתֶ֖י/ךָ לָ/בַ֣ז אֶתֵּ֑ן בָּמֹתֶ֕י/ךָ בְּ/חַטָּ֖את בְּ/כָל גְּבוּלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: hrry bshdh chylkh khl 'vtsrvtykh lbz 'tn bmtykh bcht't bkhl gbvlykh
verses.translation: O my mountain in the field, I will give thy substance and all thy treasures to the spoil, and thy high places for sin, throughout all thy borders.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁמַטְתָּ֗ה וּ/בְ/ךָ֙ מִ/נַּחֲלָֽתְ/ךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תִּי לָ֔/ךְ וְ/הַעֲבַדְתִּ֨י/ךָ֙ אֶת אֹ֣יְבֶ֔י/ךָ בָּ/אָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא יָדָ֑עְתָּ כִּֽי אֵ֛שׁ קְדַחְתֶּ֥ם בְּ/אַפִּ֖/י עַד עוֹלָ֥ם תּוּקָֽד
verses.translit: vshmtth vbkh mnchltkh 'shr ntty lkh vh'bdtykh 't 'ybykh b'rts 'shr l' yd't khy 'sh qdchtm b'py 'd 'vlm tvqd
verses.translation: And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not: for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger, which shall burn for ever.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אָר֤וּר הַ/גֶּ֨בֶר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִבְטַ֣ח בָּֽ/אָדָ֔ם וְ/שָׂ֥ם בָּשָׂ֖ר זְרֹע֑/וֹ וּ/מִן יְהוָ֖ה יָס֥וּר לִבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'rvr hgbr 'shr ybtch b'dm vshm bshr zr'v vmn yhvh ysvr lbv
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; Cursed be the man that trusteth in man, and maketh flesh his arm, and whose heart departeth from the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ כְּ/עַרְעָ֣ר בָּֽ/עֲרָבָ֔ה וְ/לֹ֥א יִרְאֶ֖ה כִּי יָב֣וֹא ט֑וֹב וְ/שָׁכַ֤ן חֲרֵרִים֙ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר אֶ֥רֶץ מְלֵחָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א תֵשֵֽׁב
verses.translit: vhyh kh'r'r b'rbh vl' yr'h khy ybv' tvb vshkhn chrrym bmdbr 'rts mlchh vl' tshb
verses.translation: For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, in a salt land and not inhabited.

verses.original: בָּר֣וּךְ הַ/גֶּ֔בֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְטַ֖ח בַּֽ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/הָיָ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה מִבְטַחֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: brvkh hgbr 'shr ybtch byhvh vhyh yhvh mbtchv
verses.translation: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD , and whose hope the LORD is.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֞ה כְּ/עֵ֣ץ שָׁת֣וּל עַל מַ֗יִם וְ/עַל יוּבַל֙ יְשַׁלַּ֣ח שָֽׁרָשָׁ֔י/ו וְ/לֹ֤א ירא יִרְאֶה֙ כִּֽי יָבֹ֣א חֹ֔ם וְ/הָיָ֥ה עָלֵ֖/הוּ רַֽעֲנָ֑ן וּ/בִ/שְׁנַ֤ת בַּצֹּ֨רֶת֙ לֹ֣א יִדְאָ֔ג וְ/לֹ֥א יָמִ֖ישׁ מֵ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת פֶּֽרִי
verses.translit: vhyh kh'ts shtvl 'l mym v'l yvbl yshlch shrshyv vl' yr' yr'h khy yb' chm vhyh 'lhv r'nn vbshnt btsrt l' yd'g vl' ymysh m'shvt pry
verses.translation: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.

verses.original: עָקֹ֥ב הַ/לֵּ֛ב מִ/כֹּ֖ל וְ/אָנֻ֣שׁ ה֑וּא מִ֖י יֵדָעֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: 'qb hlb mkhl v'nsh hv' my yd'nv
verses.translation: The heart is deceitful above all things , and desperately wicked: who can know it?

verses.original: אֲנִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה חֹקֵ֥ר לֵ֖ב בֹּחֵ֣ן כְּלָי֑וֹת וְ/לָ/תֵ֤ת לְ/אִישׁ֙ כ/דרכ/ו כִּ/דְרָכָ֔י/ו כִּ/פְרִ֖י מַעֲלָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'ny yhvh chqr lb bchn khlyvt vltt l'ysh khdrkhv khdrkhyv khpry m'llyv
verses.translation: I the LORD search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.

verses.original: קֹרֵ֤א דָגַר֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יָלָ֔ד עֹ֥שֶׂה עֹ֖שֶׁר וְ/לֹ֣א בְ/מִשְׁפָּ֑ט בַּ/חֲצִ֤י ימ/ו יָמָי/ו֙ יַעַזְבֶ֔/נּוּ וּ/בְ/אַחֲרִית֖/וֹ יִהְיֶ֥ה נָבָֽל
verses.translit: qr' dgr vl' yld 'shh 'shr vl' bmshpt bchtsy ymv ymyv y'zbnv vb'chrytv yhyh nbl
verses.translation: As the partridge sitteth on eggs , and hatcheth them not; so he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.

verses.original: כִּסֵּ֣א כָב֔וֹד מָר֖וֹם מֵֽ/רִאשׁ֑וֹן מְק֖וֹם מִקְדָּשֵֽׁ/נוּ
verses.translit: khs' khbvd mrvm mr'shvn mqvm mqdshnv
verses.translation: A glorious high throne from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary.

verses.original: מִקְוֵ֤ה יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יְהוָ֔ה כָּל עֹזְבֶ֖י/ךָ יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ יסור/י וְ/סוּרַ/י֙ בָּ/אָ֣רֶץ יִכָּתֵ֔בוּ כִּ֥י עָזְב֛וּ מְק֥וֹר מַֽיִם חַיִּ֖ים אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: mqvh yshr'l yhvh khl 'zbykh ybshv ysvry vsvry b'rts ykhtbv khy 'zbv mqvr mym chyym 't yhvh
verses.translation: O LORD , the hope of Israel, all that forsake thee shall be ashamed, and they that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken the LORD , the fountain of living waters.

verses.original: רְפָאֵ֤/נִי יְהוָה֙ וְ/אֵ֣רָפֵ֔א הוֹשִׁיעֵ֖/נִי וְ/אִוָּשֵׁ֑עָה כִּ֥י תְהִלָּתִ֖/י אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: rp'ny yhvh v'rp' hvshy'ny v'vsh'h khy thlty 'th
verses.translation: Heal me, O LORD , and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.

verses.original: הִנֵּה הֵ֕מָּה אֹמְרִ֖ים אֵלָ֑/י אַיֵּ֥ה דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה יָ֥בוֹא נָֽא
verses.translit: hnh hmh 'mrym 'ly 'yh dbr yhvh ybv' n'
verses.translation: Behold, they say unto me, Where is the word of the LORD ? let it come now.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֞י לֹא אַ֣צְתִּי מֵ/רֹעֶ֣ה אַחֲרֶ֗י/ךָ וְ/י֥וֹם אָנ֛וּשׁ לֹ֥א הִתְאַוֵּ֖יתִי אַתָּ֣ה יָדָ֑עְתָּ מוֹצָ֣א שְׂפָתַ֔/י נֹ֥כַח פָּנֶ֖י/ךָ הָיָֽה
verses.translit: v'ny l' 'tsty mr'h 'chrykh vyvm 'nvsh l' ht'vyty 'th yd't mvts' shpty nkhch pnykh hyh
verses.translation: As for me, I have not hastened from being a pastor to follow thee: neither have I desired the woeful day; thou knowest: that which came out of my lips was right before thee.

verses.original: אַל תִּֽהְיֵה לִ֖/י לִ/מְחִתָּ֑ה מַֽחֲסִ/י אַ֖תָּה בְּ/י֥וֹם רָעָֽה
verses.translit: 'l thyh ly lmchth mchsy 'th byvm r'h
verses.translation: Be not a terror unto me: thou art my hope in the day of evil.

verses.original: יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ רֹדְפַ/י֙ וְ/אַל אֵבֹ֣שָׁה אָ֔נִי יֵחַ֣תּוּ הֵ֔מָּה וְ/אַל אֵחַ֖תָּה אָ֑נִי הָבִ֤יא עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ י֣וֹם רָעָ֔ה וּ/מִשְׁנֶ֥ה שִׁבָּר֖וֹן שָׁבְרֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: ybshv rdpy v'l 'bshh 'ny ychtv hmh v'l 'chth 'ny hby' 'lyhm yvm r'h vmshnh shbrvn shbrm
verses.translation: Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded: let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.

verses.original: כֹּה אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗/י הָלֹ֤ךְ וְ/עָֽמַדְתָּ֙ בְּ/שַׁ֣עַר בְּנֵֽי עם הָ/עָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָבֹ֤אוּ ב/וֹ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר יֵ֣צְאוּ ב֑/וֹ וּ/בְ/כֹ֖ל שַׁעֲרֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'ly hlkh v'mdt bsh'r bny 'm h'm 'shr yb'v bv mlkhy yhvdh v'shr yts'v bv vbkhl sh'ry yrvshlm
verses.translation: Thus said the LORD unto me; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, whereby the kings of Judah come in, and by the which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲ֠לֵי/הֶם שִׁמְע֨וּ דְבַר יְהוָ֜ה מַלְכֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ וְ/כָל יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ/כֹ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הַ/בָּאִ֖ים בַּ/שְּׁעָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyhm shm'v dbr yhvh mlkhy yhvdh vkhl yhvdh vkhl yshby yrvshlm hb'ym bsh'rym h'lh
verses.translation: And say unto them, Hear ye the word of the LORD , ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִשָּׁמְר֖וּ בְּ/נַפְשֽׁוֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/אַל תִּשְׂא֤וּ מַשָּׂא֙ בְּ/י֣וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּ֔ת וַ/הֲבֵאתֶ֖ם בְּ/שַׁעֲרֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh hshmrv bnpshvtykhm v'l tsh'v msh' byvm hshbt vhb'tm bsh'ry yrvshlm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem;

verses.original: וְ/לֹא תוֹצִ֨יאוּ מַשָּׂ֤א מִ/בָּֽתֵּי/כֶם֙ בְּ/י֣וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּ֔ת וְ/כָל מְלָאכָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַֽעֲשׂ֑וּ וְ/קִדַּשְׁתֶּם֙ אֶת י֣וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּ֔ת כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתִי אֶת אֲבוֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vl' tvtsy'v msh' mbtykhm byvm hshbt vkhl ml'khh l' t'shv vqdshtm 't yvm hshbt kh'shr tsvyty 't 'bvtykhm
verses.translation: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do ye any work, but hallow ye the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֣א שָֽׁמְע֔וּ וְ/לֹ֥א הִטּ֖וּ אֶת אָזְנָ֑/ם וַ/יַּקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת עָרְפָּ֔/ם לְ/בִלְתִּ֣י שומע שְׁמ֔וֹעַ וּ/לְ/בִלְתִּ֖י קַ֥חַת מוּסָֽר
verses.translit: vl' shm'v vl' htv 't 'znm vyqshv 't 'rpm lblty shvm' shmv' vlblty qcht mvsr
verses.translation: But they obeyed not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, nor receive instruction.

verses.original: וְ֠/הָיָה אִם שָׁמֹ֨עַ תִּשְׁמְע֤וּ/ן אֵלַ/י֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה לְ/בִלְתִּ֣י הָבִ֣יא מַשָּׂ֗א בְּ/שַׁעֲרֵ֛י הָ/עִ֥יר הַ/זֹּ֖את בְּ/י֣וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּ֑ת וּ/לְ/קַדֵּשׁ֙ אֶת י֣וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּ֔ת לְ/בִלְתִּ֥י עֲשֽׂוֹת ב/ה בּ֖/וֹ כָּל מְלָאכָֽה
verses.translit: vhyh 'm shm' tshm'vn 'ly n'm yhvh lblty hby' msh' bsh'ry h'yr hz't byvm hshbt vlqdsh 't yvm hshbt lblty 'shvt bh bv khl ml'khh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, if ye diligently hearken unto me, saith the LORD , to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but hallow the sabbath day, to do no work therein;

verses.original: וּ/בָ֣אוּ בְ/שַׁעֲרֵ֣י הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֡את מְלָכִ֣ים וְ/שָׂרִ֡ים יֹשְׁבִים֩ עַל כִּסֵּ֨א דָוִ֜ד רֹכְבִ֣ים בָּ/רֶ֣כֶב וּ/בַ/סּוּסִ֗ים הֵ֚מָּה וְ/שָׂ֣רֵי/הֶ֔ם אִ֥ישׁ יְהוּדָ֖ה וְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְ/יָשְׁבָ֥ה הָֽ/עִיר הַ/זֹּ֖את לְ/עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vb'v bsh'ry h'yr hz't mlkhym vshrym yshbym 'l khs' dvd rkhbym brkhb vbsvsym hmh vshryhm 'ysh yhvdh vyshby yrvshlm vyshbh h'yr hz't l'vlm
verses.translation: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem: and this city shall remain for ever.

verses.original: וּ/בָ֣אוּ מֵ/עָרֵֽי יְ֠הוּדָה וּ/מִ/סְּבִיב֨וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם וּ/מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֗ן וּ/מִן הַ/שְּׁפֵלָ֤ה וּ/מִן הָ/הָר֙ וּ/מִן הַ/נֶּ֔גֶב מְבִאִ֛ים עוֹלָ֥ה וְ/זֶ֖בַח וּ/מִנְחָ֣ה וּ/לְבוֹנָ֑ה וּ/מְבִאֵ֥י תוֹדָ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vb'v m'ry yhvdh vmsbybvt yrvshlm vm'rts bnymn vmn hshplh vmn hhr vmn hngb mb'ym 'vlh vzbch vmnchh vlbvnh vmb'y tvdh byt yhvh
verses.translation: And they shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meat offerings, and incense, and bringing sacrifices of praise, unto the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אִם לֹ֨א תִשְׁמְע֜וּ אֵלַ֗/י לְ/קַדֵּשׁ֙ אֶת י֣וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּ֔ת וּ/לְ/בִלְתִּ֣י שְׂאֵ֣ת מַשָּׂ֗א וּ/בֹ֛א בְּ/שַׁעֲרֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בְּ/י֣וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּ֑ת וְ/הִצַּ֧תִּי אֵ֣שׁ בִּ/שְׁעָרֶ֗י/הָ וְ/אָֽכְלָ֛ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וְ/לֹ֥א תִכְבֶּֽה
verses.translit: v'm l' tshm'v 'ly lqdsh 't yvm hshbt vlblty sh't msh' vb' bsh'ry yrvshlm byvm hshbt vhtsty 'sh bsh'ryh v'khlh 'rmnvt yrvshlm vl' tkhbh
verses.translation: But if ye will not hearken unto me to hallow the sabbath day, and not to bear a burden, even entering in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.

verses.original: הַ/דָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ מֵ/אֵ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr hyh 'l yrmyhv m't yhvh l'mr
verses.translation: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD , saying,

verses.original: ק֥וּם וְ/יָרַדְתָּ֖ בֵּ֣ית הַ/יּוֹצֵ֑ר וְ/שָׁ֖מָּ/ה אַשְׁמִֽיעֲ/ךָ֥ אֶת דְּבָרָֽ/י
verses.translit: qvm vyrdt byt hyvtsr vshmh 'shmy'kh 't dbry
verses.translation: Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause thee to hear my words.

verses.original: וָ/אֵרֵ֖ד בֵּ֣ית הַ/יּוֹצֵ֑ר ו/הנ/הו וְ/הִנֵּה ה֛וּא עֹשֶׂ֥ה מְלָאכָ֖ה עַל הָ/אָבְנָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'rd byt hyvtsr vhnhv vhnh hv' 'shh ml'khh 'l h'bnym
verses.translation: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and, behold, he wrought a work on the wheels.

verses.original: וְ/נִשְׁחַ֣ת הַ/כְּלִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר ה֥וּא עֹשֶׂ֛ה בַּ/חֹ֖מֶר בְּ/יַ֣ד הַ/יּוֹצֵ֑ר וְ/שָׁ֗ב וַֽ/יַּעֲשֵׂ֨/הוּ֙ כְּלִ֣י אַחֵ֔ר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָשַׁ֛ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י הַ/יּוֹצֵ֖ר לַ/עֲשֽׂוֹת
verses.translit: vnshcht hkhly 'shr hv' 'shh bchmr byd hyvtsr vshb vy'shhv khly 'chr kh'shr yshr b'yny hyvtsr l'shvt
verses.translation: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter: so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֽוֹר
verses.translit: vyhy dbr yhvh 'ly l'mvr
verses.translation: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

verses.original: הֲ/כַ/יּוֹצֵ֨ר הַ/זֶּ֜ה לֹא אוּכַ֨ל לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת לָ/כֶ֛ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה הִנֵּ֤ה כַ/חֹ֨מֶר֙ בְּ/יַ֣ד הַ/יּוֹצֵ֔ר כֵּן אַתֶּ֥ם בְּ/יָדִ֖/י בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: hkhyvtsr hzh l' 'vkhl l'shvt lkhm byt yshr'l n'm yhvh hnh khchmr byd hyvtsr khn 'tm bydy byt yshr'l
verses.translation: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD . Behold, as the clay is in the potter’s hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.

verses.original: רֶ֣גַע אֲדַבֵּ֔ר עַל גּ֖וֹי וְ/עַל מַמְלָכָ֑ה לִ/נְת֥וֹשׁ וְ/לִ/נְת֖וֹץ וּֽ/לְ/הַאֲבִֽיד
verses.translit: rg' 'dbr 'l gvy v'l mmlkhh lntvsh vlntvts vlh'byd
verses.translation: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up, and to pull down, and to destroy it;

verses.original: וְ/שָׁב֙ הַ/גּ֣וֹי הַ/ה֔וּא מֵ/רָ֣עָת֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי עָלָ֑י/ו וְ/נִֽחַמְתִּי֙ עַל הָ֣/רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָשַׁ֖בְתִּי לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vshb hgvy hhv' mr'tv 'shr dbrty 'lyv vnchmty 'l hr'h 'shr chshbty l'shvt lv
verses.translation: If that nation, against whom I have pronounced, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them.

verses.original: וְ/רֶ֣גַע אֲדַבֵּ֔ר עַל גּ֖וֹי וְ/עַל מַמְלָכָ֑ה לִ/בְנֹ֖ת וְ/לִ/נְטֹֽעַ
verses.translit: vrg' 'dbr 'l gvy v'l mmlkhh lbnt vlnt'
verses.translation: And at what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it;

verses.original: וְ/עָשָׂ֤ה ה/רעה הָ/רַע֙ בְּ/עֵינַ֔/י לְ/בִלְתִּ֖י שְׁמֹ֣עַ בְּ/קוֹלִ֑/י וְ/נִֽחַמְתִּי֙ עַל הַ/טּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָמַ֖רְתִּי לְ/הֵיטִ֥יב אוֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'shh hr'h hr' b'yny lblty shm' bqvly vnchmty 'l htvbh 'shr 'mrty lhytyb 'vtv
verses.translation: If it do evil in my sight, that it obey not my voice, then I will repent of the good, wherewith I said I would benefit them.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֡ה אֱמָר נָ֣א אֶל אִישׁ יְהוּדָה֩ וְ/עַל יוֹשְׁבֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם לֵ/אמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י יוֹצֵ֤ר עֲלֵי/כֶם֙ רָעָ֔ה וְ/חֹשֵׁ֥ב עֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם מַֽחֲשָׁבָ֑ה שׁ֣וּבוּ נָ֗א אִ֚ישׁ מִ/דַּרְכּ֣/וֹ הָֽ/רָעָ֔ה וְ/הֵיטִ֥יבוּ דַרְכֵי/כֶ֖ם וּ/מַעַלְלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th 'mr n' 'l 'ysh yhvdh v'l yvshby yrvshlm l'mr khh 'mr yhvh hnh 'nkhy yvtsr 'lykhm r'h vchshb 'lykhm mchshbh shvbv n' 'ysh mdrkhv hr'h vhytybv drkhykhm vm'llykhm
verses.translation: Now therefore go to, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus saith the LORD ; Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a device against you: return ye now every one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good.

verses.original: וְ/אָמְר֖וּ נוֹאָ֑שׁ כִּֽי אַחֲרֵ֤י מַחְשְׁבוֹתֵ֨י/נוּ֙ נֵלֵ֔ךְ וְ/אִ֛ישׁ שְׁרִר֥וּת לִבּֽ/וֹ הָ/רָ֖ע נַעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: v'mrv nv'sh khy 'chry mchshbvtynv nlkh v'ysh shrrvt lbv hr' n'shh
verses.translation: And they said, There is no hope: but we will walk after our own devices, and we will every one do the imagination of his evil heart.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שַֽׁאֲלוּ נָא֙ בַּ/גּוֹיִ֔ם מִ֥י שָׁמַ֖ע כָּ/אֵ֑לֶּה שַֽׁעֲרֻרִת֙ עָשְׂתָ֣ה מְאֹ֔ד בְּתוּלַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh sh'lv n' bgvym my shm' kh'lh sh'rrt 'shth m'd btvlt yshr'l
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD ; Ask ye now among the heathen, who hath heard such things: the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing.

verses.original: הֲ/יַעֲזֹ֥ב מִ/צּ֛וּר שָׂדַ֖י שֶׁ֣לֶג לְבָנ֑וֹן אִם יִנָּתְשׁ֗וּ מַ֛יִם זָרִ֥ים קָרִ֖ים נוֹזְלִֽים
verses.translit: hy'zb mtsvr shdy shlg lbnvn 'm yntshv mym zrym qrym nvzlym
verses.translation: Will a man leave the snow of Lebanon which cometh from the rock of the field? or shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken?

verses.original: כִּֽי שְׁכֵחֻ֥/נִי עַמִּ֖/י לַ/שָּׁ֣וְא יְקַטֵּ֑רוּ וַ/יַּכְשִׁל֤וּ/ם בְּ/דַרְכֵי/הֶם֙ שְׁבִילֵ֣י עוֹלָ֔ם לָ/לֶ֣כֶת נְתִיב֔וֹת דֶּ֖רֶךְ לֹ֥א סְלוּלָֽה
verses.translit: khy shkhchny 'my lshv' yqtrv vykhshlvm bdrkhyhm shbyly 'vlm llkht ntybvt drkh l' slvlh
verses.translation: Because my people hath forgotten me, they have burned incense to vanity, and they have caused them to stumble in their ways from the ancient paths, to walk in paths, in a way not cast up;

verses.original: לָ/שׂ֥וּם אַרְצָ֛/ם לְ/שַׁמָּ֖ה שרוקת שְׁרִיק֣וֹת עוֹלָ֑ם כֹּ֚ל עוֹבֵ֣ר עָלֶ֔י/הָ יִשֹּׁ֖ם וְ/יָנִ֥יד בְּ/רֹאשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: lshvm 'rtsm lshmh shrvqt shryqvt 'vlm khl 'vbr 'lyh yshm vynyd br'shv
verses.translation: To make their land desolate, and a perpetual hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished, and wag his head.

verses.original: כְּ/רֽוּחַ קָדִ֥ים אֲפִיצֵ֖/ם לִ/פְנֵ֣י אוֹיֵ֑ב עֹ֧רֶף וְ/לֹֽא פָנִ֛ים אֶרְאֵ֖/ם בְּ/י֥וֹם אֵידָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khrvch qdym 'pytsm lpny 'vyb 'rf vl' pnym 'r'm byvm 'ydm
verses.translation: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will shew them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֗וּ לְכ֨וּ וְ/נַחְשְׁבָ֣ה עַֽל יִרְמְיָהוּ֮ מַחֲשָׁבוֹת֒ כִּי֩ לֹא תֹאבַ֨ד תּוֹרָ֜ה מִ/כֹּהֵ֗ן וְ/עֵצָה֙ מֵֽ/חָכָ֔ם וְ/דָבָ֖ר מִ/נָּבִ֑יא לְכוּ֙ וְ/נַכֵּ֣/הוּ בַ/לָּשׁ֔וֹן וְ/אַל נַקְשִׁ֖יבָה אֶל כָּל דְּבָרָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mrv lkhv vnchshbh 'l yrmyhv mchshbvt khy l' t'bd tvrh mkhhn v'tsh mchkhm vdbr mnby' lkhv vnkhhv blshvn v'l nqshybh 'l khl dbryv
verses.translation: Then said they, Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.

verses.original: הַקְשִׁ֥יבָ/ה יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑/י וּ/שְׁמַ֖ע לְ/ק֥וֹל יְרִיבָֽ/י
verses.translit: hqshybh yhvh 'ly vshm' lqvl yryby
verses.translation: Give heed to me, O LORD , and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.

verses.original: הַ/יְשֻׁלַּ֤ם תַּֽחַת טוֹבָה֙ רָעָ֔ה כִּֽי כָר֥וּ שׁוּחָ֖ה לְ/נַפְשִׁ֑/י זְכֹ֣ר עָמְדִ֣/י לְ/פָנֶ֗י/ךָ לְ/דַבֵּ֤ר עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ טוֹבָ֔ה לְ/הָשִׁ֥יב אֶת חֲמָתְ/ךָ֖ מֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: hyshlm tcht tvbh r'h khy khrv shvchh lnpshy zkhr 'mdy lpnykh ldbr 'lyhm tvbh lhshyb 't chmtkh mhm
verses.translation: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have digged a pit for my soul. Remember that I stood before thee to speak good for them, and to turn away thy wrath from them.

verses.original: לָ/כֵן֩ תֵּ֨ן אֶת בְּנֵי/הֶ֜ם לָ/רָעָ֗ב וְ/הַגִּרֵ/ם֮ עַל יְדֵי חֶרֶב֒ וְ/תִֽהְיֶ֨נָה נְשֵׁי/הֶ֤ם שַׁכֻּלוֹת֙ וְ/אַלְמָנ֔וֹת וְ/אַ֨נְשֵׁי/הֶ֔ם יִֽהְי֖וּ הֲרֻ֣גֵי מָ֑וֶת בַּח֣וּרֵי/הֶ֔ם מֻכֵּי חֶ֖רֶב בַּ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn tn 't bnyhm lr'b vhgrm 'l ydy chrb vthynh nshyhm shkhlvt v'lmnvt v'nshyhm yhyv hrgy mvt bchvryhm mkhy chrb bmlchmh
verses.translation: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and pour out their blood by the force of the sword; and let their wives be bereaved of their children, and be widows; and let their men be put to death; let their young men be slain by the sword in battle.

verses.original: תִּשָּׁמַ֤ע זְעָקָה֙ מִ/בָּ֣תֵּי/הֶ֔ם כִּֽי תָבִ֧יא עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם גְּד֖וּד פִּתְאֹ֑ם כִּֽי כָר֤וּ שיחה שׁוּחָה֙ לְ/לָכְדֵ֔/נִי וּ/פַחִ֖ים טָמְנ֥וּ לְ/רַגְלָֽ/י
verses.translit: tshm' z'qh mbtyhm khy tby' 'lyhm gdvd pt'm khy khrv shychh shvchh llkhdny vpchym tmnv lrgly
verses.translation: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them: for they have digged a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה יְ֠הוָה יָדַ֜עְתָּ אֶֽת כָּל עֲצָתָ֤/ם עָלַ/י֙ לַ/מָּ֔וֶת אַל תְּכַפֵּר֙ עַל עֲוֺנָ֔/ם וְ/חַטָּאתָ֖/ם מִ/לְּ/פָנֶ֣י/ךָ אַל תֶּ֑מְחִי ו/היו וְ/יִהְי֤וּ מֻכְשָׁלִים֙ לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/עֵ֥ת אַפְּ/ךָ֖ עֲשֵׂ֥ה בָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th yhvh yd't 't khl 'tstm 'ly lmvt 'l tkhpr 'l 'vnm vcht'tm mlpnykh 'l tmchy vhyv vyhyv mkhshlym lpnykh b't 'pkh 'shh bhm
verses.translation: Yet, LORD , thou knowest all their counsel against me to slay me: forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from thy sight, but let them be overthrown before thee; deal thus with them in the time of thine anger.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הָל֛וֹךְ וְ/קָנִ֥יתָ בַקְבֻּ֖ק יוֹצֵ֣ר חָ֑רֶשׂ וּ/מִ/זִּקְנֵ֣י הָ/עָ֔ם וּ/מִ/זִּקְנֵ֖י הַ/כֹּהֲנִֽים
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh hlvkh vqnyt bqbq yvtsr chrsh vmzqny h'm vmzqny hkhhnym
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , Go and get a potter’s earthen bottle, and take of the ancients of the people, and of the ancients of the priests;

verses.original: וְ/יָצָ֨אתָ֙ אֶל גֵּ֣יא בֶן הִנֹּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֕ר פֶּ֖תַח שַׁ֣עַר ה/חרסות הַֽ/חַרְסִ֑ית וְ/קָרָ֣אתָ שָּׁ֔ם אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁר אֲדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vyts't 'l gy' bn hnm 'shr ptch sh'r hchrsvt hchrsyt vqr't shm 't hdbrym 'shr 'dbr 'lykh
verses.translation: And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the east gate, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee,

verses.original: וְ/אָֽמַרְתָּ֙ שִׁמְע֣וּ דְבַר יְהוָ֔ה מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וְ/יֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כֹּֽה אָמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הִנְ/נִ֨י מֵבִ֤יא רָעָה֙ עַל הַ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּל שֹׁמְעָ֖/הּ תִּצַּ֥לְנָה אָזְנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'mrt shm'v dbr yhvh mlkhy yhvdh vyshby yrvshlm khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hnny mby' r'h 'l hmqvm hzh 'shr khl shm'h ttslnh 'znyv
verses.translation: And say, Hear ye the word of the LORD , O kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem; Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, the which whosoever heareth, his ears shall tingle.

verses.original: יַ֣עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲזָבֻ֗/נִי וַֽ/יְנַכְּר֞וּ אֶת הַ/מָּק֤וֹם הַ/זֶּה֙ וַ/יְקַטְּרוּ ב/וֹ֙ לֵ/אלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא יְדָע֛וּ/ם הֵ֥מָּה וַ/אֲבֽוֹתֵי/הֶ֖ם וּ/מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וּ/מָֽלְא֛וּ אֶת הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֖ה דַּ֥ם נְקִיִּֽם
verses.translit: y'n 'shr 'zbny vynkhrv 't hmqvm hzh vyqtrv bv l'lhym 'chrym 'shr l' yd'vm hmh v'bvtyhm vmlkhy yhvdh vml'v 't hmqvm hzh dm nqym
verses.translation: Because they have forsaken me, and have estranged this place, and have burned incense in it unto other gods, whom neither they nor their fathers have known, nor the kings of Judah, and have filled this place with the blood of innocents;

verses.original: וּ/בָנ֞וּ אֶת בָּמ֣וֹת הַ/בַּ֗עַל לִ/שְׂרֹ֧ף אֶת בְּנֵי/הֶ֛ם בָּ/אֵ֖שׁ עֹל֣וֹת לַ/בָּ֑עַל אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא צִוִּ֨יתִי֙ וְ/לֹ֣א דִבַּ֔רְתִּי וְ/לֹ֥א עָלְתָ֖ה עַל לִבִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vbnv 't bmvt hb'l lshrf 't bnyhm b'sh 'lvt lb'l 'shr l' tsvyty vl' dbrty vl' 'lth 'l lby
verses.translation: They have built also the high places of Baal, to burn their sons with fire for burnt offerings unto Baal, which I commanded not, nor spake it , neither came it into my mind:

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן הִנֵּֽה יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה וְ/לֹא יִקָּרֵא֩ לַ/מָּק֨וֹם הַ/זֶּ֥ה ע֛וֹד הַ/תֹּ֖פֶת וְ/גֵ֣יא בֶן הִנֹּ֑ם כִּ֖י אִם גֵּ֥יא הַ/הֲרֵגָֽה
verses.translit: lkhn hnh ymym b'ym n'm yhvh vl' yqr' lmqvm hzh 'vd htpt vgy' bn hnm khy 'm gy' hhrgh
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD , that this place shall no more be called Tophet, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of slaughter.

verses.original: וּ֠/בַקֹּתִי אֶת עֲצַ֨ת יְהוּדָ֤ה וִ/ירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ בַּ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/הִפַּלְתִּ֤י/ם בַּ/חֶ֨רֶב֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י אֹֽיְבֵי/הֶ֔ם וּ/בְ/יַ֖ד מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י נַפְשָׁ֑/ם וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י אֶת נִבְלָתָ/ם֙ לְ/מַֽאֲכָ֔ל לְ/ע֥וֹף הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וּ/לְ/בֶהֱמַ֥ת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vbqty 't 'tst yhvdh vyrvshlm bmqvm hzh vhpltym bchrb lpny 'ybyhm vbyd mbqshy npshm vntty 't nbltm lm'khl l'vf hshmym vlbhmt h'rts
verses.translation: And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of them that seek their lives: and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתִּי֙ אֶת הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את לְ/שַׁמָּ֖ה וְ/לִ/שְׁרֵקָ֑ה כֹּ֚ל עֹבֵ֣ר עָלֶ֔י/הָ יִשֹּׁ֥ם וְ/יִשְׁרֹ֖ק עַל כָּל מַכֹּתֶֽ/הָ
verses.translit: vshmty 't h'yr hz't lshmh vlshrqh khl 'br 'lyh yshm vyshrq 'l khl mkhth
verses.translation: And I will make this city desolate, and an hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof.

verses.original: וְ/הַֽאֲכַלְתִּ֞י/ם אֶת בְּשַׂ֣ר בְּנֵי/הֶ֗ם וְ/אֵת֙ בְּשַׂ֣ר בְּנֹתֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/אִ֥ישׁ בְּשַׂר רֵעֵ֖/הוּ יֹאכֵ֑לוּ בְּ/מָצוֹר֙ וּ/בְ/מָצ֔וֹק אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצִ֧יקוּ לָ/הֶ֛ם אֹיְבֵי/הֶ֖ם וּ/מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י נַפְשָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: vh'khltym 't bshr bnyhm v't bshr bntyhm v'ysh bshr r'hv y'khlv bmtsvr vbmtsvq 'shr ytsyqv lhm 'ybyhm vmbqshy npshm
verses.translation: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness, wherewith their enemies, and they that seek their lives, shall straiten them.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁבַרְתָּ֖ הַ/בַּקְבֻּ֑ק לְ/עֵינֵי֙ הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים הַ/הֹלְכִ֖ים אוֹתָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vshbrt hbqbq l'yny h'nshym hhlkhym 'vtkh
verses.translation: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee,

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֨ אֲלֵי/הֶ֜ם כֹּה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת כָּ֣כָה אֶשְׁבֹּ֞ר אֶת הָ/עָ֤ם הַ/זֶּה֙ וְ/אֶת הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁבֹּר֙ אֶת כְּלִ֣י הַ/יּוֹצֵ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא יוּכַ֥ל לְ/הֵרָפֵ֖ה ע֑וֹד וּ/בְ/תֹ֣פֶת יִקְבְּר֔וּ מֵ/אֵ֥ין מָק֖וֹם לִ/קְבּֽוֹר
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyhm khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt khkhh 'shbr 't h'm hzh v't h'yr hz't kh'shr yshbr 't khly hyvtsr 'shr l' yvkhl lhrph 'vd vbtpt yqbrv m'yn mqvm lqbvr
verses.translation: And shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Even so will I break this people and this city, as one breaketh a potter’s vessel, that cannot be made whole again: and they shall bury them in Tophet, till there be no place to bury.

verses.original: כֵּֽן אֶעֱשֶׂ֞ה לַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֛ה נְאֻם יְהוָ֖ה וּ/לְ/יֽוֹשְׁבָ֑י/ו וְ/לָ/תֵ֛ת אֶת הָ/עִ֥יר הַ/זֹּ֖את כְּ/תֹֽפֶת
verses.translit: khn ''shh lmqvm hzh n'm yhvh vlyvshbyv vltt 't h'yr hz't khtpt
verses.translation: Thus will I do unto this place, saith the LORD , and to the inhabitants thereof, and even make this city as Tophet:

verses.original: וְ/הָי֞וּ בָּתֵּ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם וּ/בָתֵּי֙ מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה כִּ/מְק֥וֹם הַ/תֹּ֖פֶת הַ/טְּמֵאִ֑ים לְ/כֹ֣ל הַ/בָּתִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר קִטְּר֜וּ עַל גַּגֹּֽתֵי/הֶם֙ לְ/כֹל֙ צְבָ֣א הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/הַסֵּ֥ךְ נְסָכִ֖ים לֵ/אלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִֽים
verses.translit: vhyv bty yrvshlm vbty mlkhy yhvdh khmqvm htpt htm'ym lkhl hbtym 'shr qtrv 'l ggtyhm lkhl tsb' hshmym vhskh nskhym l'lhym 'chrym
verses.translation: And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, shall be defiled as the place of Tophet, because of all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense unto all the host of heaven, and have poured out drink offerings unto other gods.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤א יִרְמְיָ֨הוּ֙ מֵֽ/הַ/תֹּ֔פֶת אֲשֶׁ֨ר שְׁלָח֧/וֹ יְהוָ֛ה שָׁ֖ם לְ/הִנָּבֵ֑א וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹד֙ בַּ/חֲצַ֣ר בֵּית יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֶל כָּל הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vyb' yrmyhv mhtpt 'shr shlchv yhvh shm lhnb' vy'md bchtsr byt yhvh vy'mr 'l khl h'm
verses.translation: Then came Jeremiah from Tophet, whither the LORD had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the LORD’s house; and said to all the people,

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְ/נִ֨י מבי מֵבִ֜יא אֶל הָ/עִ֤יר הַ/זֹּאת֙ וְ/עַל כָּל עָרֶ֔י/הָ אֵ֚ת כָּל הָ֣/רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי עָלֶ֑י/הָ כִּ֤י הִקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת עָרְפָּ֔/ם לְ/בִלְתִּ֖י שְׁמ֥וֹעַ אֶת דְּבָרָֽ/י
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l hnny mby mby' 'l h'yr hz't v'l khl 'ryh 't khl hr'h 'shr dbrty 'lyh khy hqshv 't 'rpm lblty shmv' 't dbry
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their necks, that they might not hear my words.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֤ע פַּשְׁחוּר֙ בֶּן אִמֵּ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/הֽוּא פָקִ֥יד נָגִ֖יד בְּ/בֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֶֽת יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ נִבָּ֖א אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vyshm' pshchvr bn 'mr hkhhn vhv' pqyd ngyd bbyt yhvh 't yrmyhv nb' 't hdbrym h'lh
verses.translation: Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest, who was also chief governor in the house of the LORD , heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכֶּ֣ה פַשְׁח֔וּר אֵ֖ת יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַ/נָּבִ֑יא וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן אֹת֜/וֹ עַל הַ/מַּהְפֶּ֗כֶת אֲשֶׁ֨ר בְּ/שַׁ֤עַר בִּנְיָמִן֙ הָֽ/עֶלְי֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/בֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vykhh pshchvr 't yrmyhv hnby' vytn 'tv 'l hmhpkht 'shr bsh'r bnymn h'lyvn 'shr bbyt yhvh
verses.translation: Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the high gate of Benjamin, which was by the house of the LORD .

verses.original: וַֽ/יְהִי֙ מִֽ/מָּחֳרָ֔ת וַ/יֹּצֵ֥א פַשְׁח֛וּר אֶֽת יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מִן הַ/מַּהְפָּ֑כֶת וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜י/ו יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ לֹ֤א פַשְׁחוּר֙ קָרָ֤א יְהוָה֙ שְׁמֶ֔/ךָ כִּ֖י אִם מָג֥וֹר מִ/סָּבִֽיב
verses.translit: vyhy mmchrt vyts' pshchvr 't yrmyhv mn hmhpkht vy'mr 'lyv yrmyhv l' pshchvr qr' yhvh shmkh khy 'm mgvr msbyb
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then said Jeremiah unto him, The LORD hath not called thy name Pashur, but Magor-missabib.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֡ה הִנְ/נִי֩ נֹתֶנְ/ךָ֨ לְ/מָג֜וֹר לְ/ךָ֣ וּ/לְ/כָל אֹהֲבֶ֗י/ךָ וְ/נָֽפְל֛וּ בְּ/חֶ֥רֶב אֹיְבֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/עֵינֶ֣י/ךָ רֹא֑וֹת וְ/אֶת כָּל יְהוּדָ֗ה אֶתֵּן֙ בְּ/יַ֣ד מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וְ/הִגְלָ֥/ם בָּבֶ֖לָ/ה וְ/הִכָּ֥/ם בֶּ/חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh hnny ntnkh lmgvr lkh vlkhl 'hbykh vnplv bchrb 'ybyhm v'ynykh r'vt v't khl yhvdh 'tn byd mlkh bbl vhglm bblh vhkhm bchrb
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD , Behold, I will make thee a terror to thyself, and to all thy friends: and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and thine eyes shall behold it: and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive into Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֗י אֶת כָּל חֹ֨סֶן֙ הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את וְ/אֶת כָּל יְגִיעָ֖/הּ וְ/אֶת כָּל יְקָרָ֑/הּ וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל אוֹצְר֜וֹת מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֗ה אֶתֵּן֙ בְּ/יַ֣ד אֹֽיְבֵי/הֶ֔ם וּ/בְזָזוּ/ם֙ וּ/לְקָח֔וּ/ם וֶ/הֱבִיא֖וּ/ם בָּבֶֽלָ/ה
verses.translit: vntty 't khl chsn h'yr hz't v't khl ygy'h v't khl yqrh v't khl 'vtsrvt mlkhy yhvdh 'tn byd 'ybyhm vbzzvm vlqchvm vhby'vm bblh
verses.translation: Moreover I will deliver all the strength of this city, and all the labours thereof, and all the precious things thereof, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies, which shall spoil them, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה פַשְׁח֗וּר וְ/כֹל֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י בֵיתֶ֔/ךָ תֵּלְכ֖וּ בַּ/שֶּׁ֑בִי וּ/בָבֶ֣ל תָּב֗וֹא וְ/שָׁ֤ם תָּמוּת֙ וְ/שָׁ֣ם תִּקָּבֵ֔ר אַתָּה֙ וְ/כָל אֹ֣הֲבֶ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁר נִבֵּ֥אתָ לָ/הֶ֖ם בַּ/שָּֽׁקֶר
verses.translit: v'th pshchvr vkhl yshby bytkh tlkhv bshby vbbl tbv' vshm tmvt vshm tqbr 'th vkhl 'hbykh 'shr nb't lhm bshqr
verses.translation: And thou, Pashur, and all that dwell in thine house shall go into captivity: and thou shalt come to Babylon, and there thou shalt die, and shalt be buried there, thou, and all thy friends, to whom thou hast prophesied lies.

verses.original: פִּתִּיתַ֤/נִי יְהוָה֙ וָֽ/אֶפָּ֔ת חֲזַקְתַּ֖/נִי וַ/תּוּכָ֑ל הָיִ֤יתִי לִ/שְׂחוֹק֙ כָּל הַ/יּ֔וֹם כֻּלֹּ֖/ה לֹעֵ֥ג לִֽ/י
verses.translit: ptytny yhvh v'pt chzqtny vtvkhl hyyty lshchvq khl hyvm khlh l'g ly
verses.translation: O LORD , thou hast deceived me, and I was deceived: thou art stronger than I, and hast prevailed: I am in derision daily, every one mocketh me.

verses.original: כִּֽי מִ/דֵּ֤י אֲדַבֵּר֙ אֶזְעָ֔ק חָמָ֥ס וָ/שֹׁ֖ד אֶקְרָ֑א כִּֽי הָיָ֨ה דְבַר יְהוָ֥ה לִ֛/י לְ/חֶרְפָּ֥ה וּ/לְ/קֶ֖לֶס כָּל הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: khy mdy 'dbr 'z'q chms vshd 'qr' khy hyh dbr yhvh ly lchrph vlqls khl hyvm
verses.translation: For since I spake, I cried out, I cried violence and spoil; because the word of the LORD was made a reproach unto me, and a derision, daily.

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתִּ֣י לֹֽא אֶזְכְּרֶ֗/נּוּ וְ/לֹֽא אֲדַבֵּ֥ר עוֹד֙ בִּ/שְׁמ֔/וֹ וְ/הָיָ֤ה בְ/לִבִּ/י֙ כְּ/אֵ֣שׁ בֹּעֶ֔רֶת עָצֻ֖ר בְּ/עַצְמֹתָ֑/י וְ/נִלְאֵ֥יתִי כַּֽלְכֵ֖ל וְ/לֹ֥א אוּכָֽל
verses.translit: v'mrty l' 'zkhrnv vl' 'dbr 'vd bshmv vhyh blby kh'sh b'rt 'tsr b'tsmty vnl'yty khlkhl vl' 'vkhl
verses.translation: Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not stay .

verses.original: כִּ֣י שָׁמַ֜עְתִּי דִּבַּ֣ת רַבִּים֮ מָג֣וֹר מִ/סָּבִיב֒ הַגִּ֨ידוּ֙ וְ/נַגִּידֶ֔/נּוּ כֹּ֚ל אֱנ֣וֹשׁ שְׁלוֹמִ֔/י שֹׁמְרֵ֖י צַלְעִ֑/י אוּלַ֤י יְפֻתֶּה֙ וְ/נ֣וּכְלָה ל֔/וֹ וְ/נִקְחָ֥ה נִקְמָתֵ֖/נוּ מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: khy shm'ty dbt rbym mgvr msbyb hgydv vngydnv khl 'nvsh shlvmy shmry tsl'y 'vly ypth vnvkhlh lv vnqchh nqmtnv mmnv
verses.translation: For I heard the defaming of many, fear on every side. Report, say they , and we will report it. All my familiars watched for my halting, saying , Peradventure he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.

verses.original: וַֽ/יהוָ֤ה אוֹתִ/י֙ כְּ/גִבּ֣וֹר עָרִ֔יץ עַל כֵּ֛ן רֹדְפַ֥/י יִכָּשְׁל֖וּ וְ/לֹ֣א יֻכָ֑לוּ בֹּ֤שׁוּ מְאֹד֙ כִּֽי לֹ֣א הִשְׂכִּ֔ילוּ כְּלִמַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לֹ֥א תִשָּׁכֵֽחַ
verses.translit: vyhvh 'vty khgbvr 'ryts 'l khn rdpy ykhshlv vl' ykhlv bshv m'd khy l' hshkhylv khlmt 'vlm l' tshkhch
verses.translation: But the LORD is with me as a mighty terrible one: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail: they shall be greatly ashamed; for they shall not prosper: their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten.

verses.original: וַ/יהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ בֹּחֵ֣ן צַדִּ֔יק רֹאֶ֥ה כְלָי֖וֹת וָ/לֵ֑ב אֶרְאֶ֤ה נִקְמָֽתְ/ךָ֙ מֵ/הֶ֔ם כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ גִּלִּ֥יתִי אֶת רִיבִֽ/י
verses.translit: vyhvh tsb'vt bchn tsdyq r'h khlyvt vlb 'r'h nqmtkh mhm khy 'lykh glyty 't ryby
verses.translation: But, O LORD of hosts, that triest the righteous, and seest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them: for unto thee have I opened my cause.

verses.original: שִׁ֚ירוּ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה הַֽלְל֖וּ אֶת יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י הִצִּ֛יל אֶת נֶ֥פֶשׁ אֶבְי֖וֹן מִ/יַּ֥ד מְרֵעִֽים
verses.translit: shyrv lyhvh hllv 't yhvh khy htsyl 't npsh 'byvn myd mr'ym
verses.translation: Sing unto the LORD , praise ye the LORD : for he hath delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.

verses.original: אָר֣וּר הַ/יּ֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻלַּ֖דְתִּי בּ֑/וֹ י֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר יְלָדַ֥תְ/נִי אִמִּ֖/י אַל יְהִ֥י בָרֽוּךְ
verses.translit: 'rvr hyvm 'shr yldty bv yvm 'shr yldtny 'my 'l yhy brvkh
verses.translation: Cursed be the day wherein I was born: let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed.

verses.original: אָר֣וּר הָ/אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר בִּשַּׂ֤ר אֶת אָבִ/י֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר יֻֽלַּד לְ/ךָ֖ בֵּ֣ן זָכָ֑ר שַׂמֵּ֖חַ שִׂמֳּחָֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: 'rvr h'ysh 'shr bshr 't 'by l'mr yld lkh bn zkhr shmch shmchhv
verses.translation: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man child is born unto thee; making him very glad.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ הָ/אִ֣ישׁ הַ/ה֔וּא כֶּֽ/עָרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר הָפַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֣א נִחָ֑ם וְ/שָׁמַ֤ע זְעָקָה֙ בַּ/בֹּ֔קֶר וּ/תְרוּעָ֖ה בְּ/עֵ֥ת צָהֳרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vhyh h'ysh hhv' kh'rym 'shr hpkh yhvh vl' nchm vshm' z'qh bbqr vtrv'h b't tshrym
verses.translation: And let that man be as the cities which the LORD overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide;

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא מוֹתְתַ֖/נִי מֵ/רָ֑חֶם וַ/תְּהִי לִ֤/י אִמִּ/י֙ קִבְרִ֔/י וְ/רַחְמָ֖/הֿ הֲרַ֥ת עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: 'shr l' mvttny mrchm vthy ly 'my qbry vrchmh hrt 'vlm
verses.translation: Because he slew me not from the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb to be always great with me .

verses.original: לָ֤/מָּה זֶּה֙ מֵ/רֶ֣חֶם יָצָ֔אתִי לִ/רְא֥וֹת עָמָ֖ל וְ/יָג֑וֹן וַ/יִּכְל֥וּ בְּ/בֹ֖שֶׁת יָמָֽ/י
verses.translit: lmh zh mrchm yts'ty lr'vt 'ml vygvn vykhlv bbsht ymy
verses.translation: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?

verses.original: הַ/דָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר הָיָ֥ה אֶֽל יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מֵ/אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה בִּ/שְׁלֹ֨חַ אֵלָ֜י/ו הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֗הוּ אֶת פַּשְׁחוּר֙ בֶּן מַלְכִּיָּ֔ה וְ/אֶת צְפַנְיָ֧ה בֶן מַעֲשֵׂיָ֛ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: hdbr 'shr hyh 'l yrmyhv m't yhvh bshlch 'lyv hmlkh tsdqyhv 't pshchvr bn mlkhyh v't tspnyh bn m'shyh hkhhn l'mr
verses.translation: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the LORD , when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Melchiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,

verses.original: דְּרָשׁ נָ֤א בַעֲדֵ֨/נוּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל נִלְחָ֣ם עָלֵ֑י/נוּ אוּלַי֩ יַעֲשֶׂ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אוֹתָ֨/נוּ֙ כְּ/כָל נִפְלְאֹתָ֔י/ו וְ/יַעֲלֶ֖ה מֵ/עָלֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: drsh n' b'dnv 't yhvh khy nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl nlchm 'lynv 'vly y'shh yhvh 'vtnv khkhl npl'tyv vy'lh m'lynv
verses.translation: Enquire, I pray thee, of the LORD for us; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon maketh war against us; if so be that the LORD will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ אֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם כֹּ֥ה תֹאמְרֻ֖/ן אֶל צִדְקִיָּֽהוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr yrmyhv 'lyhm khh t'mrn 'l tsdqyhv
verses.translation: Then said Jeremiah unto them, Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah:

verses.original: כֹּֽה אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הִנְ/נִ֣י מֵסֵב֮ אֶת כְּלֵ֣י הַ/מִּלְחָמָה֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/יֶדְ/כֶם֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם נִלְחָמִ֣ים בָּ֗/ם אֶת מֶ֤לֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים הַ/צָּרִ֣ים עֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם מִ/ח֖וּץ לַֽ/חוֹמָ֑ה וְ/אָסַפְתִּ֣י אוֹתָ֔/ם אֶל תּ֖וֹךְ הָ/עִ֥יר הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l hnny msb 't khly hmlchmh 'shr bydkhm 'shr 'tm nlchmym bm 't mlkh bbl v't hkhshdym htsrym 'lykhm mchvts lchvmh v'spty 'vtm 'l tvkh h'yr hz't
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD God of Israel; Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans, which besiege you without the walls, and I will assemble them into the midst of this city.

verses.original: וְ/נִלְחַמְתִּ֤י אֲנִי֙ אִתְּ/כֶ֔ם בְּ/יָ֥ד נְטוּיָ֖ה וּ/בִ/זְר֣וֹעַ חֲזָקָ֑ה וּ/בְ/אַ֥ף וּ/בְ/חֵמָ֖ה וּ/בְ/קֶ֥צֶף גָּדֽוֹל
verses.translit: vnlchmty 'ny 'tkhm byd ntvyh vbzrv' chzqh vb'f vbchmh vbqtsf gdvl
verses.translation: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.

verses.original: וְ/הִכֵּיתִ֗י אֶת יֽוֹשְׁבֵי֙ הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את וְ/אֶת הָ/אָדָ֖ם וְ/אֶת הַ/בְּהֵמָ֑ה בְּ/דֶ֥בֶר גָּד֖וֹל יָמֻֽתוּ
verses.translit: vhkhyty 't yvshby h'yr hz't v't h'dm v't hbhmh bdbr gdvl ymtv
verses.translation: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast: they shall die of a great pestilence.

verses.original: וְ/אַחֲרֵי כֵ֣ן נְאֻם יְהוָ֡ה אֶתֵּ֣ן אֶת צִדְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָ֣ה וְ/אֶת עֲבָדָ֣י/ו וְ/אֶת הָ/עָ֡ם וְ/אֶת הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִים֩ בָּ/עִ֨יר הַ/זֹּ֜את מִן הַ/דֶּ֣בֶר מִן הַ/חֶ֣רֶב וּ/מִן הָ/רָעָ֗ב בְּ/יַד֙ נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וּ/בְ/יַד֙ אֹֽיְבֵי/הֶ֔ם וּ/בְ/יַ֖ד מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י נַפְשָׁ֑/ם וְ/הִכָּ֣/ם לְ/פִי חֶ֔רֶב לֹֽא יָח֣וּס עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/לֹ֥א יַחְמֹ֖ל וְ/לֹ֥א יְרַחֵֽם
verses.translit: v'chry khn n'm yhvh 'tn 't tsdqyhv mlkh yhvdh v't 'bdyv v't h'm v't hnsh'rym b'yr hz't mn hdbr mn hchrb vmn hr'b byd nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl vbyd 'ybyhm vbyd mbqshy npshm vhkhm lpy chrb l' ychvs 'lyhm vl' ychml vl' yrchm
verses.translation: And afterward, saith the LORD , I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, and such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those that seek their life: and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל הָ/עָ֤ם הַ/זֶּה֙ תֹּאמַ֔ר כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה הִנְ/נִ֤י נֹתֵן֙ לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֔ם אֶת דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַ/חַיִּ֖ים וְ/אֶת דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַ/מָּֽוֶת
verses.translit: v'l h'm hzh t'mr khh 'mr yhvh hnny ntn lpnykhm 't drkh hchyym v't drkh hmvt
verses.translation: And unto this people thou shalt say, Thus saith the LORD ; Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.

verses.original: הַ/יֹּשֵׁב֙ בָּ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֔את יָמ֕וּת בַּ/חֶ֖רֶב וּ/בָ/רָעָ֣ב וּ/בַ/דָּ֑בֶר וְ/הַ/יּוֹצֵא֩ וְ/נָפַ֨ל עַל הַ/כַּשְׂדִּ֜ים הַ/צָּרִ֤ים עֲלֵי/כֶם֙ יחיה וְ/חָיָ֔ה וְ/הָֽיְתָה לּ֥/וֹ נַפְשׁ֖/וֹ לְ/שָׁלָֽל
verses.translit: hyshb b'yr hz't ymvt bchrb vbr'b vbdbr vhyvts' vnpl 'l hkhshdym htsrym 'lykhm ychyh vchyh vhyth lv npshv lshll
verses.translation: He that abideth in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goeth out, and falleth to the Chaldeans that besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be unto him for a prey.

verses.original: כִּ֣י שַׂ֣מְתִּי פָ֠נַ/י בָּ/עִ֨יר הַ/זֹּ֧את לְ/רָעָ֛ה וְ/לֹ֥א לְ/טוֹבָ֖ה נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה בְּ/יַד מֶ֤לֶךְ בָּבֶל֙ תִּנָּתֵ֔ן וּ/שְׂרָפָ֖/הּ בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: khy shmty pny b'yr hz't lr'h vl' ltvbh n'm yhvh byd mlkh bbl tntn vshrph b'sh
verses.translation: For I have set my face against this city for evil, and not for good, saith the LORD : it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/בֵית֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vlbyt mlkh yhvdh shm'v dbr yhvh
verses.translation: And touching the house of the king of Judah, say , Hear ye the word of the LORD ;

verses.original: בֵּ֣ית דָּוִ֗ד כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה דִּ֤ינוּ לַ/בֹּ֨קֶר֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וְ/הַצִּ֥ילוּ גָז֖וּל מִ/יַּ֣ד עוֹשֵׁ֑ק פֶּן תֵּצֵ֨א כָ/אֵ֜שׁ חֲמָתִ֗/י וּ/בָעֲרָה֙ וְ/אֵ֣ין מְכַבֶּ֔ה מִ/פְּנֵ֖י רֹ֥עַ מעללי/הם מַעַלְלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: byt dvd khh 'mr yhvh dynv lbqr mshpt vhtsylv gzvl myd 'vshq pn tts' kh'sh chmty vb'rh v'yn mkhbh mpny r' m'llyhm m'llykhm
verses.translation: O house of David, thus saith the LORD ; Execute judgment in the morning, and deliver him that is spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my fury go out like fire, and burn that none can quench it , because of the evil of your doings.

verses.original: הִנְ/נִ֨י אֵלַ֜יִ/ךְ יֹשֶׁ֧בֶת הָ/עֵ֛מֶק צ֥וּר הַ/מִּישֹׁ֖ר נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה הָ/אֹֽמְרִים֙ מִֽי יֵחַ֣ת עָלֵ֔י/נוּ וּ/מִ֥י יָב֖וֹא בִּ/מְעוֹנוֹתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: hnny 'lykh yshbt h'mq tsvr hmyshr n'm yhvh h'mrym my ycht 'lynv vmy ybv' bm'vnvtynv
verses.translation: Behold, I am against thee, O inhabitant of the valley, and rock of the plain, saith the LORD ; which say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter into our habitations?

verses.original: וּ/פָקַדְתִּ֧י עֲלֵי/כֶ֛ם כִּ/פְרִ֥י מַעַלְלֵי/כֶ֖ם נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה וְ/הִצַּ֤תִּי אֵשׁ֙ בְּ/יַעְרָ֔/הּ וְ/אָכְלָ֖ה כָּל סְבִיבֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vpqdty 'lykhm khpry m'llykhm n'm yhvh vhtsty 'sh by'rh v'khlh khl sbybyh
verses.translation: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, saith the LORD : and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof, and it shall devour all things round about it.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה רֵ֖ד בֵּֽית מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וְ/דִבַּרְתָּ֣ שָׁ֔ם אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֖ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh rd byt mlkh yhvdh vdbrt shm 't hdbr hzh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,

verses.original: וְ/אָֽמַרְתָּ֙ שְׁמַ֣ע דְּבַר יְהוָ֔ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה הַ/יֹּשֵׁ֖ב עַל כִּסֵּ֣א דָוִ֑ד אַתָּ֤ה וַ/עֲבָדֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֔ הַ/בָּאִ֖ים בַּ/שְּׁעָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: v'mrt shm' dbr yhvh mlkh yhvdh hyshb 'l khs' dvd 'th v'bdykh v'mkh hb'ym bsh'rym h'lh
verses.translation: And say, Hear the word of the LORD , O king of Judah, that sittest upon the throne of David, thou, and thy servants, and thy people that enter in by these gates:

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עֲשׂ֤וּ מִשְׁפָּט֙ וּ/צְדָקָ֔ה וְ/הַצִּ֥ילוּ גָז֖וּל מִ/יַּ֣ד עָשׁ֑וֹק וְ/גֵר֩ יָת֨וֹם וְ/אַלְמָנָ֤ה אַל תֹּנוּ֙ אַל תַּחְמֹ֔סוּ וְ/דָ֣ם נָקִ֔י אַֽל תִּשְׁפְּכ֖וּ בַּ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'shv mshpt vtsdqh vhtsylv gzvl myd 'shvq vgr ytvm v'lmnh 'l tnv 'l tchmsv vdm nqy 'l tshpkhv bmqvm hzh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD ; Execute ye judgment and righteousness, and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor: and do no wrong, do no violence to the stranger, the fatherless, nor the widow, neither shed innocent blood in this place.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִם עָשׂוֹ֙ תַּֽעֲשׂ֔וּ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֖ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה וּ/בָ֣אוּ בְ/שַׁעֲרֵ֣י הַ/בַּ֣יִת הַ/זֶּ֡ה מְלָכִים֩ יֹשְׁבִ֨ים לְ/דָוִ֜ד עַל כִּסְא֗/וֹ רֹֽכְבִים֙ בָּ/רֶ֣כֶב וּ/בַ/סּוּסִ֔ים ה֥וּא ו/עבד/ו וַ/עֲבָדָ֖י/ו וְ/עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy 'm 'shv t'shv 't hdbr hzh vb'v bsh'ry hbyt hzh mlkhym yshbym ldvd 'l khs'v rkhbym brkhb vbsvsym hv' v'bdv v'bdyv v'mv
verses.translation: For if ye do this thing indeed, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.

verses.original: וְ/אִם֙ לֹ֣א תִשְׁמְע֔וּ אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה בִּ֤/י נִשְׁבַּ֨עְתִּי֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה כִּי לְ/חָרְבָּ֥ה יִֽהְיֶ֖ה הַ/בַּ֥יִת הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: v'm l' tshm'v 't hdbrym h'lh by nshb'ty n'm yhvh khy lchrbh yhyh hbyt hzh
verses.translation: But if ye will not hear these words, I swear by myself, saith the LORD , that this house shall become a desolation.

verses.original: כִּֽי כֹ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עַל בֵּית֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה גִּלְעָ֥ד אַתָּ֛ה לִ֖/י רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/לְּבָנ֑וֹן אִם לֹ֤א אֲשִֽׁיתְ/ךָ֙ מִדְבָּ֔ר עָרִ֖ים לֹ֥א נושבה נוֹשָֽׁבוּ
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh 'l byt mlkh yhvdh gl'd 'th ly r'sh hlbnvn 'm l' 'shytkh mdbr 'rym l' nvshbh nvshbv
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD unto the king’s house of Judah; Thou art Gilead unto me, and the head of Lebanon: yet surely I will make thee a wilderness, and cities which are not inhabited.

verses.original: וְ/קִדַּשְׁתִּ֥י עָלֶ֛י/ךָ מַשְׁחִתִ֖ים אִ֣ישׁ וְ/כֵלָ֑י/ו וְ/כָֽרְתוּ֙ מִבְחַ֣ר אֲרָזֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/הִפִּ֖ילוּ עַל הָ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vqdshty 'lykh mshchtym 'ysh vkhlyv vkhrtv mbchr 'rzykh vhpylv 'l h'sh
verses.translation: And I will prepare destroyers against thee, every one with his weapons: and they shall cut down thy choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.

verses.original: וְ/עָֽבְרוּ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים עַ֖ל הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/זֹּ֑את וְ/אָֽמְרוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל רֵעֵ֔/הוּ עַל מֶ֨ה עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ כָּ֔כָה לָ/עִ֥יר הַ/גְּדוֹלָ֖ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: v'brv gvym rbym 'l h'yr hz't v'mrv 'ysh 'l r'hv 'l mh 'shh yhvh khkhh l'yr hgdvlh hz't
verses.translation: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbour, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this great city?

verses.original: וְ/אָ֣מְר֔וּ עַ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָֽזְב֔וּ אֶת בְּרִ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֛וּ לֵ/אלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים וַ/יַּעַבְדֽוּ/ם
verses.translit: v'mrv 'l 'shr 'zbv 't bryt yhvh 'lhyhm vyshtchvv l'lhym 'chrym vy'bdvm
verses.translation: Then they shall answer, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD their God, and worshipped other gods, and served them.

verses.original: אַל תִּבְכּ֣וּ לְ/מֵ֔ת וְ/אַל תָּנֻ֖דוּ ל֑/וֹ בְּכ֤וּ בָכוֹ֙ לַֽ/הֹלֵ֔ךְ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָשׁוּב֙ ע֔וֹד וְ/רָאָ֖ה אֶת אֶ֥רֶץ מוֹלַדְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'l tbkhv lmt v'l tndv lv bkhv bkhv lhlkh khy l' yshvb 'vd vr'h 't 'rts mvldtv
verses.translation: Weep ye not for the dead, neither bemoan him: but weep sore for him that goeth away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָֽמַר יְ֠הוָה אֶל שַׁלֻּ֨ם בֶּן יֹאשִׁיָּ֜הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה הַ/מֹּלֵךְ֙ תַּ֚חַת יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ אָבִ֔י/ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָצָ֖א מִן הַ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה לֹֽא יָשׁ֥וּב שָׁ֖ם עֽוֹד
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh 'l shlm bn y'shyhv mlkh yhvdh hmlkh tcht y'shyhv 'byv 'shr yts' mn hmqvm hzh l' yshvb shm 'vd
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah, which reigned instead of Josiah his father, which went forth out of this place; He shall not return thither any more:

verses.original: כִּ֗י בִּ/מְק֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר הִגְל֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ שָׁ֣ם יָמ֑וּת וְ/אֶת הָ/אָ֥רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֖את לֹֽא יִרְאֶ֥ה עֽוֹד
verses.translit: khy bmqvm 'shr hglv 'tv shm ymvt v't h'rts hz't l' yr'h 'vd
verses.translation: But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive, and shall see this land no more.

verses.original: ה֣וֹי בֹּנֶ֤ה בֵית/וֹ֙ בְּֽ/לֹא צֶ֔דֶק וַ/עֲלִיּוֹתָ֖י/ו בְּ/לֹ֣א מִשְׁפָּ֑ט בְּ/רֵעֵ֨/הוּ֙ יַעֲבֹ֣ד חִנָּ֔ם וּ/פֹעֲל֖/וֹ לֹ֥א יִתֶּן לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hvy bnh bytv bl' tsdq v'lyvtyv bl' mshpt br'hv y'bd chnm vp'lv l' ytn lv
verses.translation: Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong; that useth his neighbour’s service without wages, and giveth him not for his work;

verses.original: הָ/אֹמֵ֗ר אֶבְנֶה לִּ/י֙ בֵּ֣ית מִדּ֔וֹת וַ/עֲלִיּ֖וֹת מְרֻוָּחִ֑ים וְ/קָ֤רַֽע ל/וֹ֙ חַלּוֹנָ֔/י וְ/סָפ֣וּן בָּ/אָ֔רֶז וּ/מָשׁ֖וֹחַ בַּ/שָּׁשַֽׁר
verses.translit: h'mr 'bnh ly byt mdvt v'lyvt mrvchym vqr' lv chlvny vspvn b'rz vmshvch bshshr
verses.translation: That saith, I will build me a wide house and large chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and it is cieled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.

verses.original: הֲ/תִֽמְלֹ֔ךְ כִּ֥י אַתָּ֖ה מְתַחֲרֶ֣ה בָ/אָ֑רֶז אָבִ֜י/ךָ הֲ/ל֧וֹא אָכַ֣ל וְ/שָׁתָ֗ה וְ/עָשָׂ֤ה מִשְׁפָּט֙ וּ/צְדָקָ֔ה אָ֖ז ט֥וֹב לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: htmlkh khy 'th mtchrh b'rz 'bykh hlv' 'khl vshth v'shh mshpt vtsdqh 'z tvb lv
verses.translation: Shalt thou reign, because thou closest thyself in cedar? did not thy father eat and drink, and do judgment and justice, and then it was well with him?

verses.original: דָּ֛ן דִּין עָנִ֥י וְ/אֶבְי֖וֹן אָ֣ז ט֑וֹב הֲ/לוֹא הִ֛יא הַ/דַּ֥עַת אֹתִ֖/י נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: dn dyn 'ny v'byvn 'z tvb hlv' hy' hd't 'ty n'm yhvh
verses.translation: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then it was well with him: was not this to know me? saith the LORD .

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין עֵינֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/לִבְּ/ךָ֔ כִּ֖י אִם עַל בִּצְעֶ֑/ךָ וְ/עַ֤ל דַּֽם הַ/נָּקִי֙ לִ/שְׁפּ֔וֹךְ וְ/עַל הָ/עֹ֥שֶׁק וְ/עַל הַ/מְּרוּצָ֖ה לַ/עֲשֽׂוֹת
verses.translit: khy 'yn 'ynykh vlbkh khy 'm 'l bts'kh v'l dm hnqy lshpvkh v'l h'shq v'l hmrvtsh l'shvt
verses.translation: But thine eyes and thine heart are not but for thy covetousness, and for to shed innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do it .

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֞ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אֶל יְהוֹיָקִ֤ים בֶּן יֹאשִׁיָּ֨הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה לֹא יִסְפְּד֣וּ ל֔/וֹ ה֥וֹי אָחִ֖/י וְ/ה֣וֹי אָח֑וֹת לֹא יִסְפְּד֣וּ ל֔/וֹ ה֥וֹי אָד֖וֹן וְ/ה֥וֹי הֹדֹֽ/ה
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh 'l yhvyqym bn y'shyhv mlkh yhvdh l' yspdv lv hvy 'chy vhvy 'chvt l' yspdv lv hvy 'dvn vhvy hdh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah; They shall not lament for him, saying , Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! they shall not lament for him, saying , Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!

verses.original: קְבוּרַ֥ת חֲמ֖וֹר יִקָּבֵ֑ר סָח֣וֹב וְ/הַשְׁלֵ֔ךְ מֵ/הָ֖לְאָה לְ/שַׁעֲרֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם
verses.translit: qbvrt chmvr yqbr schvb vhshlkh mhl'h lsh'ry yrvshlm
verses.translation: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.

verses.original: עֲלִ֤י הַ/לְּבָנוֹן֙ וּֽ/צְעָ֔קִי וּ/בַ/בָּשָׁ֖ן תְּנִ֣י קוֹלֵ֑/ךְ וְ/צַֽעֲקִי֙ מֵֽ/עֲבָרִ֔ים כִּ֥י נִשְׁבְּר֖וּ כָּל מְאַהֲבָֽיִ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'ly hlbnvn vts'qy vbbshn tny qvlkh vts'qy m'brym khy nshbrv khl m'hbykh
verses.translation: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up thy voice in Bashan, and cry from the passages: for all thy lovers are destroyed.

verses.original: דִּבַּ֤רְתִּי אֵלַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ בְּ/שַׁלְוֺתַ֔יִ/ךְ אָמַ֖רְתְּ לֹ֣א אֶשְׁמָ֑ע זֶ֤ה דַרְכֵּ/ךְ֙ מִ/נְּעוּרַ֔יִ/ךְ כִּ֥י לֹֽא שָׁמַ֖עַתְּ בְּ/קוֹלִֽ/י
verses.translit: dbrty 'lykh bshlvtykh 'mrt l' 'shm' zh drkhkh mn'vrykh khy l' shm't bqvly
verses.translation: I spake unto thee in thy prosperity; but thou saidst, I will not hear. This hath been thy manner from thy youth, that thou obeyedst not my voice.

verses.original: כָּל רֹעַ֨יִ/ךְ֙ תִּרְעֶה ר֔וּחַ וּֽ/מְאַהֲבַ֖יִ/ךְ בַּ/שְּׁבִ֣י יֵלֵ֑כוּ כִּ֣י אָ֤ז תֵּבֹ֨שִׁי֙ וְ/נִכְלַ֔מְתְּ מִ/כֹּ֖ל רָעָתֵֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khl r'ykh tr'h rvch vm'hbykh bshby ylkhv khy 'z tbshy vnkhlmt mkhl r'tkh
verses.translation: The wind shall eat up all thy pastors, and thy lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shalt thou be ashamed and confounded for all thy wickedness.

verses.original: ישבתי יֹשַׁבְתְּ֙ בַּ/לְּבָנ֔וֹן מקננתי מְקֻנַּ֖נְתְּ בָּֽ/אֲרָזִ֑ים מַה נֵּחַנְתְּ֙ בְּ/בֹא לָ֣/ךְ חֲבָלִ֔ים חִ֖יל כַּ/יֹּלֵדָֽה
verses.translit: yshbty yshbt blbnvn mqnnty mqnnt b'rzym mh nchnt bb' lkh chblym chyl khyldh
verses.translation: O inhabitant of Lebanon, that makest thy nest in the cedars, how gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee, the pain as of a woman in travail!

verses.original: חַי אָנִי֮ נְאֻם יְהוָה֒ כִּ֣י אִם יִהְיֶ֞ה כָּנְיָ֤הוּ בֶן יְהֽוֹיָקִים֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה חוֹתָ֖ם עַל יַ֣ד יְמִינִ֑/י כִּ֥י מִ/שָּׁ֖ם אֶתְּקֶֽ/נְךָּ
verses.translit: chy 'ny n'm yhvh khy 'm yhyh khnyhv bn yhvyqym mlkh yhvdh chvtm 'l yd ymyny khy mshm 'tqnkh
verses.translation: As I live, saith the LORD , though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck thee thence;

verses.original: וּ/נְתַתִּ֗י/ךָ בְּ/יַד֙ מְבַקְשֵׁ֣י נַפְשֶׁ֔/ךָ וּ/בְ/יַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֥ה יָג֖וֹר מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֑ם וּ/בְ/יַ֛ד נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וּ/בְ/יַ֥ד הַ/כַּשְׂדִּֽים
verses.translit: vnttykh byd mbqshy npshkh vbyd 'shr 'th ygvr mpnyhm vbyd nbvkhdr'tsr mlkh bbl vbyd hkhshdym
verses.translation: And I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life, and into the hand of them whose face thou fearest, even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.

verses.original: וְ/הֵֽטַלְתִּ֣י אֹתְ/ךָ֗ וְ/אֶֽת אִמְּ/ךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְלָדַ֔תְ/ךָ עַ֚ל הָ/אָ֣רֶץ אַחֶ֔רֶת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא יֻלַּדְתֶּ֖ם שָׁ֑ם וְ/שָׁ֖ם תָּמֽוּתוּ
verses.translit: vhtlty 'tkh v't 'mkh 'shr yldtkh 'l h'rts 'chrt 'shr l' yldtm shm vshm tmvtv
verses.translation: And I will cast thee out, and thy mother that bare thee, into another country, where ye were not born; and there shall ye die.

verses.original: וְ/עַל הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁר הֵ֛ם מְנַשְּׂאִ֥ים אֶת נַפְשָׁ֖/ם לָ/שׁ֣וּב שָׁ֑ם שָׁ֖מָּ/ה לֹ֥א יָשֽׁוּבוּ
verses.translit: v'l h'rts 'shr hm mnsh'ym 't npshm lshvb shm shmh l' yshvbv
verses.translation: But to the land whereunto they desire to return, thither shall they not return.

verses.original: הַ/עֶ֨צֶב נִבְזֶ֜ה נָפ֗וּץ הָ/אִ֤ישׁ הַ/זֶּה֙ כָּנְיָ֔הוּ אִ֨ם כְּלִ֔י אֵ֥ין חֵ֖פֶץ בּ֑/וֹ מַדּ֤וּעַ הֽוּטֲלוּ֙ ה֣וּא וְ/זַרְע֔/וֹ וְ/הֻ֨שְׁלְכ֔וּ עַל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא יָדָֽעוּ
verses.translit: h'tsb nbzh npvts h'ysh hzh khnyhv 'm khly 'yn chpts bv mdv' hvtlv hv' vzr'v vhshlkhv 'l h'rts 'shr l' yd'v
verses.translation: Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol? is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure? wherefore are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they know not?

verses.original: אֶ֥רֶץ אֶ֖רֶץ אָ֑רֶץ שִׁמְעִ֖י דְּבַר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'rts 'rts 'rts shm'y dbr yhvh
verses.translation: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the LORD .

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה כִּתְב֞וּ אֶת הָ/אִ֤ישׁ הַ/זֶּה֙ עֲרִירִ֔י גֶּ֖בֶר לֹא יִצְלַ֣ח בְּ/יָמָ֑י/ו כִּי֩ לֹ֨א יִצְלַ֜ח מִ/זַּרְע֗/וֹ אִ֚ישׁ יֹשֵׁב֙ עַל כִּסֵּ֣א דָוִ֔ד וּ/מֹשֵׁ֥ל ע֖וֹד בִּ/יהוּדָֽה
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh khtbv 't h'ysh hzh 'ryry gbr l' ytslch bymyv khy l' ytslch mzr'v 'ysh yshb 'l khs' dvd vmshl 'vd byhvdh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD , Write ye this man childless, a man that shall not prosper in his days: for no man of his seed shall prosper, sitting upon the throne of David, and ruling any more in Judah.
